maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_INeverLose.label: BugsyText_INeverLose
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_INeverLose.en:
I'm BUGSY! I never lose when
it comes to bug #MON.
My research is going to make me
the authority on bug #MON!
Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_INeverLose.et:
Olen BUGSY! Ma ei kaota kunagi,
kui asi puudutab putuk-#MONe.
Minu uurimistöö teeb minust
putuk-#MONide asjatundja!
Näitan, mida olen õpingutega saavutanud.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_ResearchIn.label: BugsyText_ResearchIncomplete
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_ResearchIn.en:
Whoa, amazing! You're an expert on #MON!
My research isn't complete yet.
OK, you win. Take this BADGE.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_ResearchIn.et:
Vau, hämmastav! Sa oled #MONide asjatundja!
Minu uurimistöö pole veel valmis.
Olgu, sa võidad. Võta see MÄRK.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_HiveBadgeS.label: BugsyText_HiveBadgeSpeech
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_HiveBadgeS.en:
Do you know the benefits of HIVEBADGE?
If you have it, #MON up to L30
will obey you, even traded ones.
#MON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.
Here, I also want you to have this.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_HiveBadgeS.et:
Kas tead, mis kasu HIVEBADGE annab?
Sellega kuuletuvad sulle #MONid
kuni L30, ka vahetatud.
CUT-i oskavad #MONid saavad
seda ka väljaspool lahingut kasutada.
Säh, tahan sulle ka selle anda.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_FuryCutter.label: BugsyText_FuryCutterSpeech
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_FuryCutter.en:
TM49 contains FURY CUTTER.
If you don't miss, it gets stronger every turn.
The longer your battle goes, the better it gets.
Isn't that great? I discovered it!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_FuryCutter.et:
TM49 sisaldab FURY CUTTER.
Kui mööda ei löö, tugevneb see iga käiguga.
Mida kauem lahing kestab, seda parem.
Kas pole vahva? Mina avastasin selle!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_BugMonsAre.label: BugsyText_BugMonsAreDeep
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_BugMonsAre.en:
Bug #MON are deep. There are
many mysteries to be explored.
Study your favorites thoroughly.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugsyText_BugMonsAre.et:
Putuk-#MONid on sügavad. Uurida
on veel palju mõistatusi.
Uuri oma lemmikuid põhjalikult.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherBennySeenT.label: BugCatcherBennySeenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherBennySeenT.en:
Bug #MON evolve young. So they get
stronger that much faster.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherBennySeenT.et:
Putuk-#MONid arenevad noorelt. Nii
saavad nad palju kiiremini tugevaks.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherBennyAfter.label: BugCatcherBennyAfterBattleText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherBennyAfter.en: #MON become stronger if they evolve. Really!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlSeenText.label: BugCatcherAlSeenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlSeenText.en:
Bug #MON are cool and tough!
I'll prove it to you!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlSeenText.et:
Putuk-#MONid on lahedad ja kõvad!
Ma tõestan seda sulle!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlBeatenTe.label: BugCatcherAlBeatenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlBeatenTe.en: You proved how tough you are…

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlAfterBat.label: BugCatcherAlAfterBattleText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlAfterBat.en:
They're so cool, but most girls
don't like bug #MON.
I don't know why…
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherAlAfterBat.et:
Nad on nii lahedad, aga enamikule
tüdrukutest ei meeldi putuk-#MONid.
Ma ei tea, miks…

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshSeenTe.label: BugCatcherJoshSeenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshSeenTe.en:
You saved all the SLOWPOKE? Whew, you're mighty!
But my grown-up #MON are pretty tough too!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshSeenTe.et:
Sa päästsid kõik SLOWPOKE'd? Ohoo, sa oled vägev!
Aga mu täiskasvanud #MONid on ka päris kõvad!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshAfterB.label: BugCatcherJoshAfterBattleText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshAfterB.en: I guess I should teach them better moves…
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::BugCatcherJoshAfterB.et: Peaksin neile vist paremaid rünnakuid õpetama…

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay1SeenT.label: TwinsAmyandmay1SeenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay1SeenT.en: AMY: Hi! Are you challenging the LEADER? No way!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay1SeenT.et: AMY: Tere! Kutsud JUHTI väljakutsele? Ei iial!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2SeenT.label: TwinsAmyandmay2SeenText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2SeenT.en: MAY: You want to see the LEADER? We come first!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2SeenT.et: MAY: Tahad JUHTI näha? Enne meid ei pääse!

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2After.label: TwinsAmyandmay2AfterBattleText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2After.en: MAY: Our bug #MON lost! Oh, what a shame.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::TwinsAmyandmay2After.et: MAY: Meie putuk-#MON kaotas! Oi, milline häbi.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideText.label: AzaleaGymGuideText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideText.en:
Yo, challenger!
BUGSY's young, but his knowledge of
bug #MON is for real.
It's going to be tough without my advice.
Let's see… Bug #MON don't like fire.
Flying-type moves are super-effective too.
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideText.et:
Hei, väljakutsuja!
BUGSY on noor, aga tema teadmised
putuk-#MONidest on ehtsad.
Ilma minu nõuta läheb raskeks.
Vaatame… Putuk-#MONidele ei meeldi tuli.
Lendav-tüüpi rünnakud on samuti üliefektiivsed.

maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideWinTex.label: AzaleaGymGuideWinText
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideWinTex.en:
Well done! That was a great clash
of talented young trainers.
With people like you, the future of #MON is bright!
maps/AzaleaGym.asm::AzaleaGymGuideWinTex.et:
Tubli! See oli vägev heitlus
andekate noorte treenerite vahel.
Sinusugustega on #MONide tulevik helge!

maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartCooltrain.label: AzaleaMartCooltrainerMText
maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartCooltrain.en:
There's no GREAT BALL here. #
BALLS will have to do.
I wish KURT would make me some of his custom BALLS.
maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartCooltrain.et:
Siin pole GREAT BALL. #
PALLIDEGA peab leppima.
Kahju, et KURT ei tee mulle oma eri-PALLE.

maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartBugCatche.label: AzaleaMartBugCatcherText
maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartBugCatche.en:
A GREAT BALL is better for catching #MON than a # BALL.
But KURT's might be better sometimes.
maps/AzaleaMart.asm::AzaleaMartBugCatche.et:
GREAT BALL püüab #MONe paremini kui # PALL.
Aga KURDI omad võivad vahel paremad olla.

maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.en:
Do your #MON know HM moves?
Those moves can be used even if
your #MON has fainted.
This BILL guy created the system
for storing #MON in a PC.
BILL's PC can store up to 20 #MON per BOX.
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.et:
Kas su #MONid oskavad HM-rünnakuid?
Neid saab kasutada isegi siis,
kui su #MON on minestanud.
Üks BILLi-nimeline tüüp lõi süsteemi
#MONide hoidmiseks PCs.
BILLi PC mahutab kuni 20 #MONi BOXi kohta.

maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FFishingGuruText
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.en: BILL's PC can store up to 20 #MON per BOX.
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.et: BILLi PC mahutab kuni 20 #MONi BOXi kohta.

maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FPokefanFText
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.en:
Do you know about APRICORNS?
Crack one open, hollow it out and
fit it with a special device.
Then you can catch #MON with it.
Before # BALLS were invented,
everyone used APRICORNS.
maps/AzaleaPokecenter1F.asm::AzaleaPokec.et:
Kas tead APRICORNE?
Murra üks lahti, õõnesta ja
paigalda eriseade.
Siis saad sellega #MONe püüda.
Enne # PALLIDE leiutamist
kasutasid kõik APRICORNE.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalBefo.label: AzaleaTownRivalBeforeText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalBefo.en:
…Tell me something.
Is it true that TEAM ROCKET has returned?
What? You beat them? Hah! Quit lying.
You're not joking? Then let's see how good you are.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalBefo.et:
…Ütle mulle midagi.
Kas RAKETI KAMP on tõesti tagasi?
Mida? Sa alistasid nad? Hah! Ära luiska.
Ei tee nalja? Siis vaatame, kui hea sa oled.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalWinT.label: AzaleaTownRivalWinText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalWinT.en:
… Humph! Useless #MON!
Listen, you. You only won because
my #MON were weak.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalWinT.et:
… Hmph! Kasutud #MONid!
Kuula. Sa võitsid ainult seetõttu,
et mu #MONid olid nõrgad.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalAfte.label: AzaleaTownRivalAfterText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalAfte.en:
I hate the weak.
#MON, trainers. It doesn't matter who or what.
I'm going to be strong and wipe out the weak.
That goes for TEAM ROCKET too.
They act big and tough in a group.
But get them alone, and they're weak.
I hate them all.
You stay out of my way. A weakling
like you is only a distraction.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRivalAfte.et:
Ma vihkan nõrku.
#MONid, treenerid — vahet pole kes või mis.
Saan tugevaks ja pühin nõrgad minema.
See käib ka RAKETI KAMBA kohta.
Kambas mängivad nad kõva meest.
Aga üksinda on nad nõrgad.
Ma vihkan neid kõiki.
Hoia minu teelt eemale. Sinusugune
nõrguke ainult segab.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket1Te.label: AzaleaTownRocket1Text
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket1Te.en:
It's unsafe to go in there, so I'm standing guard.
Aren't I a good Samaritan?
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket1Te.et:
Sinna on ohtlik minna, seega valvan.
Kas ma pole tõesti hea inimene?

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket2Te.label: AzaleaTownRocket2Text
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket2Te.en:
Do you know about SLOWPOKETAIL? I heard it's tasty!
Aren't you glad I told you that?
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownRocket2Te.et:
Kas tead SLOWPOKETAILi? Kuulsin, et maitsev!
Kas pole tore, et sulle seda ütlesin?

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.label: AzaleaTownGrampsTextBefore
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.en:
The SLOWPOKE have disappeared from town…
I heard their TAILS are being sold somewhere.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.et:
SLOWPOKE'd on linnast kadunud…
Kuulsin, et kuskil müüakse nende sabu.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.label: AzaleaTownGrampsTextAfter
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.en:
The SLOWPOKE have returned.
Knowing them, they could've just been
goofing off somewhere.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownGrampsTex.et:
SLOWPOKE'd on tagasi.
Neid teades võisid nad lihtsalt
kuskil looderdada.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownTeacherTe.label: AzaleaTownTeacherText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownTeacherTe.en:
Did you come to get KURT to make some BALLS?
A lot of people do just that.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownTeacherTe.et:
Kas tulid KURTI käest PALLE tellima?
Paljud teevad just nii.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownYoungster.label: AzaleaTownYoungsterText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownYoungster.en:
Cut through AZALEA and you'll be in ILEX FOREST.
But these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.
The CHARCOAL MAN's #MON can CUT down trees.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownYoungster.et:
Läbi AZALEA jõuad ILEX FORESTISSE.
Aga need peenikesed puud teevad
läbipääsu võimatuks.
SÖEMEHE #MON oskab puid CUT-iga langetada.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText1.label: AzaleaTownKurtText1
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText1.en:
ILEX FOREST is restless!
What is going on?
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText1.et:
ILEX FOREST on rahutu!
Mis toimub?

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText2.label: AzaleaTownKurtText2
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText2.et: <PLAYER>, siin on su GS BALL tagasi!

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText3.label: AzaleaTownKurtText3
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText3.en: Could you go see why ILEX FOREST is so restless?
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownKurtText3.et: Kas läheksid vaatama, miks ILEX FOREST nii rahutu on?

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownSignText.label: AzaleaTownSignText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownSignText.en:
AZALEA TOWN Where People and
#MON Live in Happy Harmony
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownSignText.et:
AZALEA TOWN, kus inimesed ja
#MONid elavad õnnelikus üksmeeles

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaGymSignText.label: AzaleaGymSignText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaGymSignText.en:
AZALEA TOWN #MON GYM LEADER: BUGSY
The Walking Bug #MON Encyclopedia
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaGymSignText.et:
AZALEA TOWN #MON SAALI JUHT: BUGSY
Käiv putuk-#MONide entsüklopeedia

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::SlowpokeWellSignTex.label: SlowpokeWellSignText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::SlowpokeWellSignTex.en:
SLOWPOKE WELL
Also known as the RAINMAKER WELL.
Locals believe that a SLOWPOKE's yawn summons rain.
Records show that a SLOWPOKE's yawn
ended a drought 400 years ago.
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::SlowpokeWellSignTex.et:
SLOWPOKE WELL
Tuntud ka kui VIHMATOOJA KAEV.
Kohalike arvates kutsub SLOWPOKE haigutus vihma.
Ürikute järgi lõpetas SLOWPOKE haigutus
400 aastat tagasi põua.

maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownIlexFores.label: AzaleaTownIlexForestSignText
maps/AzaleaTown.asm::AzaleaTownIlexFores.en:
ILEX FOREST
Enter through the gate.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerWelcomesYou
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
BATTLE TOWER welcomes you!
I could show you to a BATTLE ROOM.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
LAHINGUTORN tervitab sind!
Võin sind LAHINGUTUPPA saata.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WantToGoInt.label: Text_WantToGoIntoABattleRoom
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WantToGoInt.en: Want to go into a BATTLE ROOM?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_RightThisWa.label: Text_RightThisWayToYourBattleRoom
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_RightThisWa.en:
Right this way to your BATTLE ROOM.
BATTLE TOWER is a facility made for #MON battles.
Countless #MON trainers gather
from all over to hold battles in
specially designed BATTLE ROOMS.
There are many BATTLE ROOMS in the BATTLE TOWER.
Each ROOM holds seven trainers.
If you defeat the seven in a ROOM,
and you have a good record, you
could become the ROOM's LEADER.
All LEADERS will be recorded in the
HONOR ROLL for posterity.
You may challenge in up to five
BATTLE ROOMS each day.
However, you may battle only once a
day in any given ROOM.
To interrupt a session, you must
SAVE. If not, you won't be able to
resume your ROOM challenge.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_RightThisWa.et:
Siiapoole su LAHINGUTUPPA.
LAHINGUTORN on #MON-lahingute jaoks loodud rajatis.
Lugematul hulgal #MON-treenereid koguneb
kõikjalt, et pidada lahinguid
spetsiaalselt loodud LAHINGUTUBADES.
LAHINGUTORNIS on palju LAHINGUTUBASID.
Igas TOAS on seitse treenerit.
Kui alistad toas kõik seitse,
ja sul on hea tulemus, võid
saada selle TOA JUHIKS.
Kõik JUHID jäädvustatakse
järelpõlvedele AUNIMEKIRJA.
Võid päevas väljakutseid esitada
kuni viies LAHINGUTOAS.
Kuid igas kindlas TOAS saad
võidelda vaid korra päevas.
Seansi katkestamiseks pead
SALVESTAMA. Muidu ei saa sa oma
TOA väljakutset jätkata.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_2
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
BATTLE TOWER is a facility made for #MON battles.
Countless #MON trainers gather
from all over to hold battles in
specially designed BATTLE ROOMS.
There are many BATTLE ROOMS in the BATTLE TOWER.
Each ROOM holds seven trainers.
Beat them all, and win a prize.
To interrupt a session, you must
SAVE. If not, you won't be able to
resume your ROOM challenge.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
LAHINGUTORN on #MON-lahingute jaoks loodud rajatis.
Lugematul hulgal #MON-treenereid koguneb
kõikjalt, et pidada lahinguid
spetsiaalselt loodud LAHINGUTUBADES.
LAHINGUTORNIS on palju LAHINGUTUBASID.
Igas TOAS on seitse treenerit.
Alista nad kõik ja võida auhind.
Seansi katkestamiseks pead
SALVESTAMA. Muidu ei saa sa oma
TOA väljakutset jätkata.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ReceivedALi.label: Text_ReceivedAListOfLeadersOnTheHonorRoll
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ReceivedALi.en: Received a list of LEADERS on the HONOR ROLL.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_PleaseConfi.label: Text_PleaseConfirmOnThisMonitor
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_PleaseConfi.en:
Please confirm on this monitor.
Thank you!

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ThanksForVi.label: Text_ThanksForVisiting
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ThanksForVi.en:
Thanks for visiting!
Congratulations!
You've beaten all the trainers!
Your feat may be worth registering,
<PLAYER>. With your results, you may
be chosen as a ROOM LEADER.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ThanksForVi.et:
Aitäh külastuse eest!
Palju õnne!
Alistasid kõik treenerid!
Su saavutus võib olla registreerimist väärt,
<PLAYER>. Oma tulemustega võid sa
saada valitud TOA JUHIKS.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_Congratulat.label: Text_CongratulationsYouveBeatenAllTheTrainers
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_Congratulat.en:
Congratulations!
You've beaten all the trainers!
For that, you get this great prize!
Would you like to register your
record with the CENTER?
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_Congratulat.et:
Palju õnne!
Alistasid kõik treenerid!
Selle eest saad selle vahva auhinna!
Kas soovid oma tulemuse
KESKUSES registreerida?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_YourPackIsS.label: Text_YourPackIsStuffedFull
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_YourPackIsS.en:
Oops, your PACK is stuffed full.
Please make room and come back.
Your registration is complete.
Please come again!
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_YourPackIsS.et:
Oih, su PACK on pilgeni täis.
Tee palun ruumi ja tule tagasi.
Sinu registreerimine on lõpetatud.
Tule palun jälle!

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WeHopeToSer.label: Text_WeHopeToServeYouAgain
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WeHopeToSer.en: We hope to serve you again.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WouldYouLik.label: Text_WouldYouLikeToHearAboutTheBattleTower
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WouldYouLik.en: Would you like to hear about the BATTLE TOWER?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.label: Text_CantBeRegistered
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.en:
Your record from the previous
BATTLE ROOM can't be registered. OK?
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.et:
Su eelmise LAHINGUTOA
tulemust ei saa registreerida. OK?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.label: Text_CantBeRegistered_PreviousRecordDeleted
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.en:
Your record from the previous
BATTLE ROOM can't be registered.
Also, the existing record will be deleted. OK?
Check the LEADER HONOR ROLL?
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CantBeRegis.et:
Su eelmise LAHINGUTOA
tulemust ei saa registreerida.
Samuti kustutatakse olemasolev tulemus. OK?
Vaadata JUHTIDE AUNIMEKIRI?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ReadBattleT.label: Text_ReadBattleTowerRules
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ReadBattleT.en:
BATTLE TOWER rules are written here.
Read the rules?
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_ReadBattleT.et:
Siia on kirjutatud LAHINGUTORNI reeglid.
Lugeda reeglid?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerRules
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
Three #MON may enter battles.
All three must be different.
The items they hold must also be different.
Certain #MON may also have
level restrictions placed on them.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
Lahingusse võib tuua kolm #MONi.
Kõik kolm peavad olema erinevad.
Ka nende hoitavad esemed peavad erinema.
Mõnele #MONile võib olla ka
seatud taseme piirang.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTower_LeftWithoutSaving
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
Excuse me! You didn't SAVE
before exiting the BATTLE ROOM.
I'm awfully sorry, but your challenge
will be declared invalid.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
Vabandage! Sa ei SALVESTANUD
enne LAHINGUTOAST lahkumist.
Mul on väga kahju, aga su väljakutse
kuulutatakse kehtetuks.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_YourMonWill.label: Text_YourMonWillBeHealedToFullHealth
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_YourMonWill.en: Your #MON will be healed to full health.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_NextUpOppon.label: Text_NextUpOpponentNo
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_NextUpOppon.en:
Next up, opponent no.{RAM}. Ready?
Your session will be SAVED before
connecting with the CENTER.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_NextUpOppon.et:
Järgmisena vastane nr {RAM}. Valmis?
Su seanss SALVESTATAKSE enne
KESKUSEGA ühendumist.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeE.label: Text_SaveBeforeEnteringBattleRoom
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeE.en:
Before entering the BATTLE ROOM,
your progress will be saved.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeE.et:
Enne LAHINGUTUPPA sisenemist
salvestatakse su edu.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeR.label: Text_SaveBeforeReentry
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeR.en:
Your record will be SAVED before
you go back into the previous ROOM.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_SaveBeforeR.et:
Su tulemus SALVESTATAKSE enne
eelmisse TUPPA naasmist.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CancelYourB.label: Text_CancelYourBattleRoomChallenge
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CancelYourB.en:
Cancel your BATTLE ROOM challenge?
We have your previous record on
file. Would you like to register it at the CENTER?
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_CancelYourB.et:
Katkestada oma LAHINGUTOA väljakutse?
Meil on su eelmine tulemus
talletatud. Kas registreerida see KESKUSES?

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WeveBeenWai.label: Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_WeveBeenWai.en:
We've been waiting for you. This way
to a BATTLE ROOM, please.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_FiveDayBatt.label: Text_FiveDayBattleLimit_Mobile
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_FiveDayBatt.en:
You may enter only five BATTLE ROOMS each day.
Please come back tomorrow.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_FiveDayBatt.et:
Päevas võid siseneda vaid viide LAHINGUTUPPA.
Tule palun homme tagasi.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_TooMuchTime.label: Text_TooMuchTimeElapsedNoRegister
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_TooMuchTime.en:
Sorry, but it's not possible to
register your current record at
the CENTER because too much time has
elapsed since the start of your challenge.
Sorry, but it's not possible to
register your most recent record at
the CENTER because too much time has
elapsed since the start of your challenge.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_TooMuchTime.et:
Vabandust, aga praegust tulemust
pole võimalik KESKUSES
registreerida, kuna väljakutse algusest
on möödunud liiga palju aega.
Vabandust, aga viimast tulemust
pole võimalik KESKUSES
registreerida, kuna väljakutse algusest
on möödunud liiga palju aega.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_AMonLevelEx.label: Text_AMonLevelExceeds
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_AMonLevelEx.en: One or more of your #MON's levels exceeds {NUM}.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_AMonLevelEx.et: Ühe või mitme su #MONi tase ületab {NUM}.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_MayNotEnter.label: Text_MayNotEnterABattleRoomUnderL70
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_MayNotEnter.en:
{RAM} may not enter a BATTLE ROOM under L70.
This BATTLE ROOM is for L{NUM}.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_MayNotEnter.et:
{RAM} ei tohi siseneda LAHINGUTUPPA alla L70.
See LAHINGUTUBA on L{NUM} jaoks.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerYoungster
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
Destroyed by the first opponent in
no time at all… I'm no good…
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
Esimene vastane hävitas mind
hetkega… Ma pole hea…

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerCooltrainerF
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
There are lots of BATTLE ROOMS, but
I'm going to win them all!
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
LAHINGUTUBASID on palju, aga
ma võidan need kõik!

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerGranny
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
It's a grueling task, not being
able to use items in battle.
Making your #MON hold items
is the key to winning battles.
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
See on kurnav töö, kui lahingus
ei saa esemeid kasutada.
#MONide käes esemeid hoida
on lahingute võitmise võti.

maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.label: Text_BattleTowerBugCatcher
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.en:
I'm trying to see how far I can go
using just bug #MON.
Don't let there be any fire #MON…
maps/BattleTower1F.asm::Text_BattleTower.et:
Üritan näha, kui kaugele jõuan
ainult putuk-#MONidega.
Ainult ei tohiks olla ühtki tule-#MONi…

maps/BattleTowerBattleRoom.asm::Script_B.label: Script_BeatenAllTrainers2
maps/BattleTowerBattleRoom.asm::Script_B.en: You'll be returned after you SAVE.

maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.label: BattleTowerOutsideSign
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.en:
Wow, the BATTLE TOWER is huge! My
neck is tired from looking up at it.
Wow, the BATTLE TOWER is huge!
Since there are a whole bunch of
trainers inside, there must also be
a wide variety of #MON.
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.et:
Vau, LAHINGUTORN on hiiglaslik! Mu
kael on väsinud sellele üles vaatamisest.
Vau, LAHINGUTORN on hiiglaslik!
Kuna sees on terve hulk
treenereid, peab seal ka olema
lai valik #MONe.

maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.en:
Wow, the BATTLE TOWER is huge!
There must be many kinds of #MON in there!
What on earth do they do here?
If the name says anything, I guess
it must be for #MON battles.
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.et:
Vau, LAHINGUTORN on hiiglaslik!
Seal peab olema palju #MONi liike!
Mida nad küll siin teevad?
Kui nimi midagi ütleb, siis vist
on see #MON-lahingute jaoks.

maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.label: BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.en:
You can use only three #MON.
It's so hard to decide which three
should go into battle…
Ehehehe… I sneaked out of work to come here.
I'm never giving up until I become a LEADER!
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.et:
Saad kasutada ainult kolme #MONi.
Nii raske on otsustada, millised kolm
peaksid lahingusse minema…
Ehehehe… Hiilisin töölt minema, et siia tulla.
Ma ei anna alla, kuni saan JUHIKS!

maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.label: BattleTowerOutsideSailorText
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.en:
Hehehe, I snuck out from work.
I can't bail out until I've won!
I have to win it all. That I must!
BATTLE TOWER
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.et:
Hehehe, hiilisin töölt minema.
Ma ei saa loobuda, kuni olen võitnud!
Pean kõik võitma. Seda ma pean!
LAHINGUTORN

maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.label: BattleTowerOutsideSignText
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.en:
BATTLE TOWER
Take the Ultimate Trainer Challenge!
The BATTLE TOWER's doors are closed…
It's open!
maps/BattleTowerOutside.asm::BattleTower.et:
LAHINGUTORN
Võta vastu Ülim Treeneri Väljakutse!
LAHINGUTORNI uksed on suletud…
See on avatud!

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillTakeThis.label: BillTakeThisEeveeText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillTakeThis.en:
BILL: Hi, <PLAYER>! Do us a favor and take this EEVEE.
It came over when I was adjusting the TIME CAPSULE.
Someone has to take care of it,
but I don't like being outside.
Can I count on you to play with it, <PLAYER>?
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillTakeThis.et:
BILL: Tere, <PLAYER>! Tee meile teene ja võta see EEVEE.
See tuli üle, kui seadistasin TIME CAPSULEt.
Keegi peab selle eest hoolitsema,
aga mulle ei meeldi väljas olla.
Kas võin loota, et sa sellega mängid, <PLAYER>?

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillImCounti.label: BillImCountingOnYouText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillImCounti.en:
BILL: I knew you'd come through!
Way to go! You're the real deal!
OK, I'm counting on you.
Take good care of it!
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillImCounti.et:
BILL: Teadsin, et sa tuled toime!
Tubli! Sa oled tõeline!
OK, loodan sinu peale.
Hoolitse selle eest hästi!

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillEeveeMay.label: BillEeveeMayEvolveText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillEeveeMay.en:
BILL: PROF.ELM claims EEVEE may
evolve in new and unknown ways.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillEeveeMay.et:
BILL: PROF.ELM väidab, et EEVEE võib
areneda uutel ja tundmatutel viisidel.

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPartyFul.label: BillPartyFullText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPartyFul.en: Whoa, wait. You can't carry any more #MON.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPartyFul.et: Oot, oota. Sa ei saa rohkem #MONe kaasas kanda.

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPopWontW.label: BillPopWontWorkText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPopWontW.en:
BILL: My pop, he won't work. All he
does is goof off all day long.
He's getting to be a real headache…
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillPopWontW.et:
BILL: Mu isa, ta ei tööta. Ta ainult
logeleb terve päeva.
Temast on saamas tõeline peavalu…

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.label: BillsMomText_BeforeEcruteak
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.en:
Oh, you collect #MON? My son BILL is an expert.
He just got called to the #MON
CENTER in ECRUTEAK CITY.
My husband went off to the GAME
CORNER without being called…
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.et:
Oh, sa kogud #MONe? Mu poeg BILL on ekspert.
Ta kutsuti just ECRUTEAK CITY
#MON KESKUSESSE.
Mu mees läks kutsumata
MÄNGUNURKA…

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.label: BillsMomText_AfterEcruteak
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.en:
My husband was once known as a
#MANIAC. BILL must have
taken after his father.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsMomText.et:
Mu meest tunti kunagi
#MANIAKINA. BILL on ilmselt
oma isasse läinud.

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.label: BillsYoungerSisterUsefulNumberText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.en:
Are you a trainer?
I've got a useful phone number for you.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.et:
Kas oled treener?
Mul on sulle kasulik telefoninumber.

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.label: BillsYoungerSisterRefusedNumberText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.en:
My brother made the PC #MON storage system.
I was going to give you BILL's number…
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.et:
Mu vend tegi PC #MON hoiusüsteemi.
Kavatsesin sulle BILLi numbri anda…

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.label: BillsYoungerSisterPhoneFullText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.en: You can't record any more numbers.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.et: Sa ei saa rohkem numbreid salvestada.

maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.label: BillsYoungerSisterStorageSystemText
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.en:
My big brother BILL made the PC
#MON storage system.
maps/BillsFamilysHouse.asm::BillsYounger.et:
Mu suur vend BILL tegi PC
#MON hoiusüsteemi.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaIntroTe.label: BillsGrandpaIntroText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaIntroTe.en:
Hm? You know BILL? He's my grandson.
He's in JOHTO. He does something
with PCs, so I'm house-sitting.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaIntroTe.et:
Hm? Tunned BILLi? Ta on mu pojapoeg.
Ta on JOHTOS. Ta teeb midagi
PCdega, seega valvan maja.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaAskToSe.label: BillsGrandpaAskToSeeMonText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaAskToSe.en: If you have that #MON, may I see it, please?
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaAskToSe.et: Kui sul see #MON on, kas tohin seda näha?

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaExcited.label: BillsGrandpaExcitedToSeeText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaExcited.en: You will show me? How good of you!

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaYouDont.label: BillsGrandpaYouDontHaveItTextText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaYouDont.en: You don't have it? That's too bad…

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownPo.label: BillsGrandpaShownPokemonText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownPo.en:
Ah, so that is {RAM}?
Isn't it cute! That's so kind of you.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownPo.et:
Ah, nii et see on {RAM}?
Kas pole nunnu! Väga lahke sinust.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaTokenOf.label: BillsGrandpaTokenOfAppreciationText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaTokenOf.en:
Thanks!
This is a token of my appreciation.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownAl.label: BillsGrandpaShownAllThePokemonText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownAl.en:
Thanks for showing me so many cute #MON.
I really enjoyed myself. I'm glad
I've lived such a long life.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaShownAl.et:
Aitäh, et näitasid nii palju nunnusid #MONe.
Mul oli tõesti tore. Hea meel,
et olen elanud nii pika elu.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaWrongPo.label: BillsGrandpaWrongPokemonText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaWrongPo.en:
Hm?
That's not the #MON that I was told about.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaWrongPo.et:
Hm?
See pole see #MON, kellest mulle räägiti.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaLickitu.label: BillsGrandpaLickitungText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaLickitu.en:
My grandson BILL told me about a
#MON that has a long tongue.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaLickitu.et:
Mu pojapoeg BILL rääkis mulle
#MONist, kellel on pikk keel.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaOddishT.label: BillsGrandpaOddishText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaOddishT.en:
Ah, my grandson mentioned a round,
green #MON that has leaves growing on its head.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaOddishT.et:
Ah, mu pojapoeg mainis ümarat,
rohelist #MONi, kelle peas kasvavad lehed.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaStaryuT.label: BillsGrandpaStaryuText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaStaryuT.en:
Do you know of a sea #MON that
has a red sphere in its body?
You know, the one that's shaped like a star?
I heard that it appears at night.
I would surely like to see it.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaStaryuT.et:
Kas tead mere-#MONi, kellel
on kehas punane kera?
Tead küll, seda tähekujulist?
Kuulsin, et see ilmub öösel.
Tahaksin seda kindlasti näha.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaGrowlit.label: BillsGrandpaGrowlitheText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaGrowlit.en:
BILL told me about a #MON that is
very loyal to its trainer.
It's supposed to ROAR well.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaGrowlit.et:
BILL rääkis mulle #MONist, kes on
oma treenerile väga truu.
See olevat hea RÖÖKIMA.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaVulpixT.label: BillsGrandpaVulpixText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaVulpixT.en:
I heard about a cute #MON that has six tails.
I would love to hug a cute #MON like that.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaVulpixT.et:
Kuulsin nunnust #MONist, kellel on kuus saba.
Sooviksin sellist nunnut #MONi kallistada.

maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaPichuTe.label: BillsGrandpaPichuText
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaPichuTe.en:
Do you know that hugely popular #MON?
The #MON that has a yellow body and red cheeks.
I would love to see what it looks
like before it evolves.
maps/BillsHouse.asm::BillsGrandpaPichuTe.et:
Kas tead seda ülipopulaarset #MONi?
#MONi, kellel on kollane keha ja punased põsed.
Sooviksin näha, milline see
välja näeb enne arenemist.

maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.label: BillsOlderSisterText
maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.en: My grandpa is at my brother BILL's on CERULEAN CAPE.
maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.et: Mu vanaisa on mu venna BILLi juures CERULEAN CAPE'il.

maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.label: BillsOlderSistersHouseYoungsterText
maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.en: I saw these weird, slow #MON on CYCLING ROAD.
maps/BillsOlderSistersHouse.asm::BillsOl.et: Nägin neid imelikke, aeglaseid #MONe CYCLING ROADIL.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsOut.label: Text_ClairIsOut
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsOut.en:
I am sorry.
CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, entered
the DRAGON'S DEN behind the GYM.
I have no idea when our LEADER will return.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsOut.et:
Mul on kahju.
Meie SAALI JUHT CLAIR läks SAALI taga olevasse DRAAKONI URKASSE.
Mul pole aimugi, millal JUHT naaseb.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsIn.label: Text_ClairIsIn
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsIn.en:
CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, is waiting for you.
However, it would be impossible for
a run-of-the-mill trainer to win.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsIn.et:
Meie SAALI JUHT CLAIR ootab sind.
Kuid tavalisel treeneril oleks võimatu võita.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsBea.label: Text_ClairIsBeaten
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsBea.en:
You defeated CLAIR?
That's amazing!
I've never heard of her losing to
anyone other than LANCE.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::Text_ClairIsBea.et:
Sa alistasid CLAIRI?
See on hämmastav!
Pole kuulnud, et ta oleks kellelegi peale LANCE'i kaotanud.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.label: BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.en:
No. Only chosen trainers may train
here. Please leave.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.et: Ei. Siin võivad treenida vaid valitud treenerid. Palun lahku.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.label: BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.en:
If CLAIR allows it, her grandfather--our MASTER --will also.
You may enter.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGramp.et:
Kui CLAIR lubab, siis lubab ka tema vanaisa — meie MEISTER.
Võid siseneda.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_W.label: BlackBeltText_WeirdRadio
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_W.en: My radio's busted? Lately, I only get this weird signal.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_W.et: Mu raadio on katki? Viimasel ajal saan ainult seda imelikku signaali.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_V.label: BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_V.en:
Arooo! Voices in my head!
Huh? I'm listening to my radio!
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackBeltText_V.et:
Arooo! Hääled mu peas!
Hä? Ma kuulan hoopis oma raadiot!

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.label: BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.en: Are you going to make your #MON forget some moves?
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.et: Kas kavatsed panna oma #MONi rünnakuid unustama?

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornYoung.label: BlackthornYoungsterText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornYoung.en: Dragon masters all come from the city of BLACKTHORN.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornYoung.et: Kõik draakonimeistrid on pärit BLACKTHORNI linnast.

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::MeetSantosText.label: MeetSantosText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::MeetSantosText.en:
SANTOS: …
It's Saturday…
I'm SANTOS of Saturday…
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::MeetSantosText.et:
SANTOS: …
On laupäev…
Olen SANTOS laupäevast…

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosGaveGiftT.label: SantosGaveGiftText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosGaveGiftT.en:
SANTOS: …
SPELL TAG…
Ghost-type moves get stronger…
It will frighten you…
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosGaveGiftT.et:
SANTOS: …
SPELL TAG…
Tont-tüüpi rünnakud tugevnevad…
See kohutab sind…

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosSaturdayT.label: SantosSaturdayText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosSaturdayT.en:
SANTOS: …
See you again on another Saturday…
I won't have any more gifts…
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::SantosSaturdayT.et:
SANTOS: …
Näeme jälle mõnel laupäeval…
Rohkem kinke mul pole…

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.label: BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.en:
Wow, you came through the ICE PATH?
You must be a real hotshot trainer!
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCoolt.et:
Vau, tulid läbi JÄÄRADA?
Sa pead olema tõeline meistertreener!

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCityS.label: BlackthornCitySignText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCityS.en:
BLACKTHORN CITY
A Quiet Mountain Retreat

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGymSi.label: BlackthornGymSignText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGymSi.en:
BLACKTHORN CITY #MON GYM LEADER: CLAIR
The Blessed User of Dragon #MON
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornGymSi.et:
BLACKTHORN CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: CLAIR
Õnnistatud draakon-#MONide kasutaja

maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCityT.label: BlackthornCityTrainerTipsText
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCityT.en:
TRAINER TIPS
A #MON holding a MIRACLEBERRY
will cure itself of any status problem.
maps/BlackthornCity.asm::BlackthornCityT.et:
TREENERI NIPID
MIRACLEBERRYT hoidev #MON ravib end igast seisundihäirest.

maps/BlackthornDragonSpeechHouse.asm::Bl.label: BlackthornDragonSpeechHouseGrannyText
maps/BlackthornDragonSpeechHouse.asm::Bl.en:
A clan of trainers who can freely
command dragons live right here in BLACKTHORN.
As a result, there are many legends
about dragons in this town.
maps/BlackthornDragonSpeechHouse.asm::Bl.et:
Treenerite klann, kes suudab vabalt
draakoneid juhtida, elab just siin BLACKTHORNIS.
Seetõttu on selles linnas palju
legende draakonitest.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairIntroText.label: ClairIntroText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairIntroText.en:
I am CLAIR.
The world's best dragon master.
I can hold my own against even the
#MON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR.
Do you still want to take me on?
…Fine. Let's do it!
As a GYM LEADER, I will use my full
power against any opponent!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairIntroText.et:
Olen CLAIR.
Maailma parim draakonimeister.
Saan hakkama isegi #MON LIIGA ELIITNELIKU vastu.
Kas ikka tahad minuga mõõtu võtta?
…Hea küll. Teeme ära!
SAALI JUHINA kasutan iga vastase vastu kogu oma väge!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairWinText.label: ClairWinText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairWinText.en:
I lost?
I don't believe it. There must be some mistake…
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairWinText.et:
Ma kaotasin?
Ma ei usu seda. Siin peab olema mingi eksitus…

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_GoTo.label: ClairText_GoToDragonsDen
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_GoTo.en:
I won't admit this.
I may have lost, but you're still
not ready for the #MON LEAGUE.
I know. You should take the dragon user challenge.
Behind this GYM is a place called DRAGON'S DEN.
There is a small shrine at its
center. Go there.
If you can prove that you've lost
your lazy ideals, I will recognize
you as a trainer worthy of a GYM BADGE!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_GoTo.et:
Ma ei tunnista seda.
Ehk kaotasin, aga sa pole veel #MON LIIGA jaoks valmis.
Tean. Sa peaksid vastu võtma draakonikasutaja katse.
Selle SAALI taga on paik nimega DRAAKONI URGAS.
Selle keskel on väike pühamu. Mine sinna.
Kui suudad tõestada, et oled loobunud oma laisast mõtteviisist, tunnistan sind SAALI MÄRGI vääriliseks!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_TooM.label: ClairText_TooMuchToExpect
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_TooM.en:
What's the matter?
Is it too much to expect of you?
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::ClairText_TooM.et:
Mis lahti?
Kas see on sinult liiga palju oodata?

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.label: BlackthornGymClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.en:
You've kept me waiting!
Here! Take this!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.et:
Sa panid mind ootama!
Säh! Võta see!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.label: BlackthornGymClairText_DescribeTM24
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.en:
That contains DRAGONBREATH.
No, it doesn't have anything to do with my breath.
If you don't want it, you don't have to take it.
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.et:
See sisaldab DRAGONBREATH.
Ei, sellel pole minu hingeõhuga midagi pistmist.
Kui ei taha, ei pea võtma.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.label: BlackthornGymClairText_BagFull
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.en: What is this? You don't have room?
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.et: Mis see on? Sul pole ruumi?

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.label: BlackthornGymClairText_League
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.en:
What's the matter?
Aren't you headed to the #MON LEAGUE?
Don't you know where it is?
From here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.
Then SURF east. The route there is very tough.
Don't you dare lose at the #MON LEAGUE!
If you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!
Give it everything you've got.
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymC.et:
Mis lahti?
Kas sa ei lähe #MON LIIGASSE?
Kas sa ei tea, kus see on?
Mine siit NEW BARK TOWNI.
Siis SURFa ida poole. Sealne tee on väga raske.
Ära julgegi #MON LIIGAS kaotada!
Kui kaotad, tunnen end sulle kaotamise pärast veel halvemini!
Anna endast kõik.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.label: CooltrainermPaulSeenText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.en:
Your first battle against dragons?
I'll show you how tough they are!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.et:
Su esimene lahing draakonite vastu?
Näitan, kui kõvad nad on!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.label: CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.en:
LANCE told you that he'd like to
see you again? Not a chance!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermPa.et: LANCE ütles, et tahaks sind veel näha? Ei mingil juhul!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.label: CooltrainermMikeSeenText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.en: My chance of losing? Not even one percent!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.et: Mu kaotamise võimalus? Isegi mitte üks protsent!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.label: CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.en:
I know my shortcomings now.
Thanks for showing me!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainermMi.et:
Nüüd tean oma nõrku kohti.
Aitäh, et näitasid!

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.label: CooltrainerfLolaSeenText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.en:
Dragons are sacred #MON.
They are full of life energy.
If you're not serious, you won't
be able to beat them.
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.et:
Draakonid on pühad #MONid.
Nad on täis elujõudu.
Kui sa pole tõsine, ei suuda sa neid võita.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.label: CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.en: Dragons are weak against dragontype moves.
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::CooltrainerfLo.et: Draakonid on nõrgad draakon-tüüpi rünnakute vastu.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.label: BlackthornGymGuideText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making!
It's been a long journey, but we
are almost done! Count on me!
CLAIR uses the mythical and sacred dragon-type #MON.
You can't damage them very easily.
But you know, they're supposed
to be weak against ice-type moves.
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION!
Teekond on olnud pikk, aga oleme peaaegu valmis! Loota võid minu peale!
CLAIR kasutab müütilisi ja pühi draakon-tüüpi #MONe.
Neid pole kerge kahjustada.
Aga tead, nad olevat nõrgad jää-tüüpi rünnakute vastu.

maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.label: BlackthornGymGuideWinText
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.en:
You were great to beat CLAIR!
All that's left is the #MON LEAGUE challenge.
You're on the way to becoming the #MON CHAMPION!
maps/BlackthornGym1F.asm::BlackthornGymG.et:
Sa olid suurepärane, et CLAIRI võitsid!
Jäänud on vaid #MON LIIGA katse.
Sa oled teel #MON TŠEMPIONIKS saama!

maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.label: CooltrainermCodySeenText
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.en: It's not as if we all use dragontype #MON.
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.et: Pole nii, et me kõik draakon-#MONe kasutaks.

maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.label: CooltrainermCodyBeatenText
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.en: Rats! If only I had a dragon!

maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.label: CooltrainermCodyAfterBattleText
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.en:
Members of our dragon-user clan
can use dragon #MON only after
our MASTER allows it.
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainermCo.et: Meie draakonikasutajate klanni liikmed saavad draakon-#MONe kasutada alles siis, kui MEISTER lubab.

maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainerfFr.label: CooltrainerfFranSeenText
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainerfFr.en:
I can't allow a nameless trainer past me!
CLAIR would be livid if I did!
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainerfFr.et:
Ma ei saa nimetut treenerit endast mööda lasta!
CLAIR läheks marru!

maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainerfFr.label: CooltrainerfFranAfterBattleText
maps/BlackthornGym2F.asm::CooltrainerfFr.en: Uh-oh… CLAIR is going to be mad…

maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartC.label: BlackthornMartCooltrainerMText
maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartC.en:
You can't buy MAX REVIVE, but it
fully restores a fainted #MON.
Beware--it won't restore PP, the
POWER POINTS needed for moves.
maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartC.et:
MAX REVIVEt ei saa osta, aga see
taastab täielikult minestanud #MONi.
Ettevaatust -- see ei taasta PP-d,
rünnakuteks vajalikke POWER POINTe.

maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartB.label: BlackthornMartBlackBeltText
maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartB.en:
MAX REPEL keeps weak #MON away from you.
It's the longest lasting of the REPEL sprays.
maps/BlackthornMart.asm::BlackthornMartB.et:
MAX REPEL hoiab nõrgad #MONid sinust eemal.
See on kõige kauem kestev REPEL-pihusti.

maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.label: BlackthornPokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.en:
Deep inside faroff INDIGO PLATEAU
is the #MON LEAGUE.
I hear the best trainers gather
there from around the country.
maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.et:
Sügaval kaugel INDIGO PLATEAUL
on #MON LIIGA.
Kuulen, et parimad treenerid kogunevad
sinna üle riigi.

maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.label: BlackthornPokecenter1FTwinText
maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.en:
There was this move I just had
to teach my #MON.
So I got the MOVE DELETER to make it forget an HM move.
maps/BlackthornPokecenter1F.asm::Blackth.et:
Oli üks rünnak, mille pidin
oma #MONile õpetama.
Seega lasin RÜNNAKUKUSTUTAJAL panna see HM-rünnaku unustama.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyHelloText.label: DaisyHelloText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyHelloText.en:
DAISY: Hi! My kid brother is the GYM
LEADER in VIRIDIAN CITY.
But he goes out of town so often,
it causes problems for the trainers.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyHelloText.et:
DAISY: Tere! Mu noorem vend on
VIRIDIAN CITY SAALI JUHT.
Aga ta käib nii tihti linnast ära,
et see tekitab treeneritele probleeme.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyOfferGroomingT.label: DaisyOfferGroomingText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyOfferGroomingT.en:
DAISY: Hi! Good timing. I'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?
Oh, your #MON are a bit dirty.
Would you like me to groom one?
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyOfferGroomingT.et:
DAISY: Tere! Hea ajastus. Kohe hakkan teed jooma.
Kas tahad seltsi teha?
Oh, su #MONid on pisut mustad.
Kas tahad, et üht sugeksin?

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyWhichMonText.label: DaisyWhichMonText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyWhichMonText.en: DAISY: Which one should I groom?

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlrightText.label: DaisyAlrightText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlrightText.en: DAISY: OK, I'll get it looking nice in no time.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlrightText.et: DAISY: OK, saan selle hetkega ilusaks.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAllDoneText.label: DaisyAllDoneText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAllDoneText.en:
DAISY: There you go! All done.
See? Doesn't it look nice?
It's such a cute #MON.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAllDoneText.et:
DAISY: Palun! Valmis.
Näed? Kas pole ilus?
See on nii nunnu #MON.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlreadyGroomed.label: DaisyAlreadyGroomedText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlreadyGroomed.en:
DAISY: I always have tea around
this time. Come join me.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyAlreadyGroomed.et:
DAISY: Joon alati sel ajal teed.
Tule seltsi tegema.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyRefusedText.label: DaisyRefusedText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyRefusedText.en:
DAISY: You don't want to have one
groomed? OK, we'll just have tea.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyRefusedText.et:
DAISY: Sa ei taha, et üht
sugeksin? OK, joome lihtsalt teed.

maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyCantGroomEggTe.label: DaisyCantGroomEggText
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyCantGroomEggTe.en: DAISY: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't groom an EGG.
maps/BluesHouse.asm::DaisyCantGroomEggTe.et: DAISY: Oh, vabandust. Ausalt öeldes ei saa ma EGGi sugeda.

maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoBe.label: BrunoScript_BrunoBeforeText
maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoBe.en:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR.
I always train to the extreme because I believe in our potential.
That is how we became strong.
Can you withstand our power?
Hm? I see no fear in you. You look
determined. Perfect for battle!
Ready, <PLAYER>? You will bow down
to our overwhelming power!
Hoo hah!
maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoBe.et:
Olen BRUNO ELIITNELIKUST.
Treenin alati äärmuseni, sest usun meie potentsiaali.
Nii saimegi tugevaks.
Kas pead meie väele vastu?
Hm? Ma ei näe sinus hirmu. Sa näed sihikindel välja. Ideaalne lahinguks!
Valmis, <PLAYER>? Sa kummardad meie ülekaaluka väe ees!
Huu hah!

maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoDe.label: BrunoScript_BrunoDefeatText
maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoDe.en:
Having lost, I have no right to say anything…
Go face your next challenge!
maps/BrunosRoom.asm::BrunoScript_BrunoDe.et:
Kaotanuna pole mul õigust midagi öelda…
Mine oma järgmise katsumuse vastu!

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.label: BurnedTowerRival_BeforeText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.en:
<……> <……> <……>
…Oh, it's you.
I came looking for some legendary
#MON that they say roosts here.
But there's nothing here!
Nothing after all the trouble of
coming to this dump? No way!
It's all your fault!
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.et:
<……> <……> <……>
…Oh, see oled sina.
Tulin otsima legendaarset #MONi, kes väidetavalt siin pesitseb.
Aga siin pole midagi!
Ei midagi, pärast kogu vaeva sellesse urkasse tulla? Kohutav!
Kõik on sinu süü!

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.label: BurnedTowerRival_WinText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.en:
…Humph!
This is why I hate battling wimps.
There's no challenge in it.
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.et:
…Hmph!
Sellepärast ma vihkangi nõrkudega võitlemist.
Seal pole mingit väljakutset.

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.label: BurnedTowerRival_AfterText1
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.en:
…Aw, whatever.
You would never be able to catch a
legendary #MON anyway.
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.et:
…Ah, ükskõik.
Sa poleks niikuinii suutnud legendaarset #MONi püüda.

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.label: BurnedTowerRival_LossText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.en:
…Humph!
This is why I hate battling wimps.
It's just a waste of my time.
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.et:
…Hmph!
Sellepärast ma vihkangi nõrkudega võitlemist.
See on lihtsalt aja raiskamine.

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.label: BurnedTowerRival_AfterText2
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.en:
Humph!
What are you doing falling into a
hole? Some genius you are!
Serves you right!
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTowerRival.et:
Hmph!
Mis mõttes sa auku kukud? Küll oled geenius!
Paraja said!

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.label: BurnedTower1FEusineIntroText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.en:
EUSINE: My name's EUSINE.
I'm on the trail of a #MON named SUICUNE.
And you are…?
<PLAYER>? Glad to meet you!
I heard rumors that SUICUNE is in
this BURNED TOWER, so I came to look.
But where exactly could it be?
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.et:
EUSINE: Minu nimi on EUSINE.
Olen #MONi nimega SUICUNE jälgedel.
Ja sina oled…?
<PLAYER>? Meeldiv tutvuda!
Kuulsin kuuldusi, et SUICUNE on siin BURNED TOWERIS, nii et tulin vaatama.
Aga kus ta täpselt olla võiks?

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.label: BurnedTower1FEusineText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.en:
EUSINE: I heard that SUICUNE is in
this BURNED TOWER, so I came to look.
But where exactly could it be?
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FEus.et:
EUSINE: Kuulsin, et SUICUNE on siin BURNED TOWERIS, nii et tulin vaatama.
Aga kus ta täpselt olla võiks?

maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FMor.label: BurnedTower1FMortyText
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FMor.en:
MORTY: ECRUTEAK's GYM LEADER has to
study what are said to be the
legendary #MON --SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.
EUSINE is here, so I've decided to
investigate the TOWER with him.
maps/BurnedTower1F.asm::BurnedTower1FMor.et:
MORTY: ECRUTEAKI SAALI JUHT peab uurima legendaarseid #MONe — SUICUNE, ENTEI ja RAIKOU.
EUSINE on siin, nii et otsustasin torni koos temaga uurida.

maps/BurnedTowerB1F.asm::BurnedTowerB1FE.label: BurnedTowerB1FEusineText
maps/BurnedTowerB1F.asm::BurnedTowerB1FE.en:
EUSINE: I dug a hole here, too…
I was shocked!
SUICUNE raced by like a blur, right
in front of my eyes!
For ten years I chased SUICUNE,
and I finally got to see it.
I'm all choked up!
<PLAYER>, I owe this all to you!
Thank you!
I heard that the legendary #MON
of ECRUTEAK test chosen humans by
allowing them to get close.
I'm going to track SUICUNE.
<PLAYER>, let's meet again!
Farewell!
maps/BurnedTowerB1F.asm::BurnedTowerB1FE.et:
EUSINE: Kaevasin siia ka augu…
Ma ehmatasin ära!
SUICUNE kihutas mööda nagu välk, otse mu silme ees!
Kümme aastat ajasin SUICUNET taga ja lõpuks nägin teda.
Mul on pisarad silmis!
<PLAYER>, kõik tänu sinule!
Aitäh!
Kuulsin, et ECRUTEAKI legendaarsed #MONid katsetavad valitud inimesi, lastes neil ligi.
Lähen SUICUNET jälitama.
<PLAYER>, kohtume veel!
Hüvasti!

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::ChefText_Eatathon.label: ChefText_Eatathon
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::ChefText_Eatathon.en:
Hi!
We're holding an eatathon contest.
We can't serve you right now. Sorry.
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::ChefText_Eatathon.et:
Tere!
Korraldame söömavõistlust.
Ei saa sind praegu teenindada. Vabandust.

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher1Text_Concen.label: Fisher1Text_Concentration
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher1Text_Concen.en:
Don't talk to me!
You'll break my concentration!
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher1Text_Concen.et:
Ära räägi minuga!
Sa lõhud mu keskendumise!

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher2Text_Quanti.label: Fisher2Text_Quantity
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher2Text_Quanti.en:
I take quantity over quality!
I'm happy when I'm full!
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher2Text_Quanti.et:
Eelistan kogust kvaliteedile!
Olen õnnelik, kui olen täis!

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher3Text_Golden.label: Fisher3Text_GoldenrodIsBest
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher3Text_Golden.en: The food is good here, but GOLDENROD has the best food anywhere.
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::Fisher3Text_Golden.et: Toit on siin hea, aga GOLDENRODIS on parim toit kõikjal.

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::TeacherText_NoCoin.label: TeacherText_NoCoinCase
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::TeacherText_NoCoin.en:
Nobody here will give you a COIN
CASE. You should look in JOHTO.
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::TeacherText_NoCoin.et:
Keegi siin ei anna sulle COIN
CASE. Vaata JOHTOST.

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::TeacherText_KeepEa.label: TeacherText_KeepEating
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::TeacherText_KeepEa.en:
Crunch… Crunch…
I can keep eating!

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::EatathonContestPos.label: EatathonContestPosterText
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::EatathonContestPos.en:
Eatathon Contest! No time limit!
A battle without end! The biggest
muncher gets it all for free!
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::EatathonContestPos.et:
Söömavõistlus! Ajapiirangut pole!
Lõputu lahing! Suurim
sööja saab kõik tasuta!

maps/CeladonCafe.asm::NoRoomForLeftovers.label: NoRoomForLeftoversText
maps/CeladonCafe.asm::NoRoomForLeftovers.et: Aga <PLAYER> ei saa veel üht eset hoida…

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityFisherT.label: CeladonCityFisherText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityFisherT.en:
This POLIWRATH is my partner.
I wonder if it'll ever evolve into a frog #MON.
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityFisherT.et:
See POLIWRATH on mu partner.
Huvitav, kas ta kunagi konn-#MONiks areneb.

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.label: CeladonCityTeacher1Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.en:
I lost at the machines.
I lost at the slot machines again…
We girls also play the slots now.
You should check them out too.
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.et:
Kaotasin automaatidel.
Kaotasin jälle mänguautomaatidel…
Ka meie, tüdrukud, mängime nüüd automaate.
Proovi sina ka.

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps1.label: CeladonCityGramps1Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps1.en:
GRIMER have been appearing lately.
See that pond out in front of the
house? GRIMER live there now.
Where did they come from? This is a serious problem…
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps1.et:
Viimasel ajal on ilmunud GRIMEReid.
Näed seda tiiki maja ees? Seal elavad nüüd GRIMERid.
Kust nad tulid? See on tõsine probleem…

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps2.label: CeladonCityGramps2Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps2.en:
Nihihi! This GYM is great! Only
girls are allowed here!
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGramps2.et: Nihihii! See SAAL on suurepärane! Siin on lubatud ainult tüdrukud!

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.label: CeladonCityYoungster1Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.en:
Want to know a secret?
CELADON MANSION has a hidden back door.
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.et:
Tahad saladust teada?
CELADONI MÕISAL on peidetud tagauks.

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.label: CeladonCityYoungster2Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.en:
They're holding an eating contest at the restaurant.
Just watching them go at it makes me feel bloated…
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityYoungst.et:
Restoranis peetakse söömisvõistlust.
Neid vaadates lähen isegi punni…

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.label: CeladonCityTeacher2Text
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.en:
CELADON DEPT.STORE has the biggest
and best selection of merchandise.
If you can't get it there, you
can't get it anywhere.
Gee… I sound like a sales clerk.
I love being surrounded by tall buildings!
Isn't it true that GOLDENROD #MON
CENTER was made much, much bigger?
That is so neat! I wish we had a
place like that in KANTO…
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTeacher.et:
CELADONI KAUBAMAJAS on suurim ja parim kaubavalik.
Kui sealt ei saa, siis mitte kuskilt.
Oih… ma kõlan nagu müügimees.
Mulle meeldib olla kõrgete hoonete keskel!
Kas pole tõsi, et GOLDENRODI #MON KESKUS tehti palju suuremaks?
See on nii lahe! Soovin, et meil oleks selline paik ka KANTOS…

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityLassTex.label: CeladonCityLassText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityLassTex.en:
Looking at the ground while I was
walking made me dizzy.
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityLassTex.et: Kõndides maha vaadates läks mul pea ringi.

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCitySignTex.label: CeladonCitySignText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCitySignTex.en:
CELADON CITY
The City of Rainbow Dreams

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonGymSignText.label: CeladonGymSignText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonGymSignText.en:
CELADON CITY #MON GYM LEADER: ERIKA
The Nature-Loving Princess
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonGymSignText.et:
CELADON CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: ERIKA
Loodust armastav printsess

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityDeptSto.label: CeladonCityDeptStoreSignText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityDeptSto.en: Find What You Need at CELADON DEPT.STORE!

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGameCor.label: CeladonCityGameCornerSignText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGameCor.en:
The Game Area for Grown-ups--CELADON GAME CORNER
The Playground for Everybody--CELADON GAME CORNER
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityGameCor.et:
Mänguala täiskasvanutele — CELADONI MÄNGUNURK
Mängumaa kõigile — CELADONI MÄNGUNURK

maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTrainer.label: CeladonCityTrainerTipsText
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTrainer.en:
TRAINER TIPS
GUARD SPEC. protects #MON
against SPECIAL attacks such as fire and water.
Get your items at CELADON DEPT. STORE!
maps/CeladonCity.asm::CeladonCityTrainer.et:
TREENERI NIPID
GUARD SPEC. kaitseb #MONi ERILISTE rünnakute, nagu tuli ja vesi, eest.
Hangi esemed CELADONI KAUBAMAJAST!

maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore1FReceptionistText
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Hello! Welcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE!
The directory is on the wall.
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Tere! Tere tulemast CELADONI KAUBAMAJJA!
Kataloog on seinal.

maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore1FGentlemanText
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
This DEPT.STORE is part of the same
chain as the one in GOLDENROD CITY.
They were both renovated at the same time.
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
See KAUBAMAJA kuulub samasse
ketti kui see GOLDENROD CITYS.
Mõlemad renoveeriti samal ajal.

maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore1FTeacherText
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
This is my first time here.
It's so big…
I'm afraid I'll get lost.
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
See on mu esimene kord siin.
See on nii suur…
Kardan, et eksin ära.

maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore1FDirectoryText
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
1F: SERVICE COUNTER
2F: TRAINER'S MARKET
3F: TM SHOP
4F: WISEMAN GIFTS
5F: DRUG STORE
6F: ROOFTOP SQUARE
maps/CeladonDeptStore1F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
1F: TEENINDUSLETT
2F: TREENERI TURG
3F: TM POOD
4F: TARGA MEHE KINGID
5F: APTEEK
6F: KATUSEVÄLJAK

maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore2FPokefanMText
maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
I just recently became a trainer.
My son encouraged me to do it.
I'm impressed by the selection of convenient items.
maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Sain alles hiljuti treeneriks.
Mu poeg julgustas mind seda tegema.
Olen muljet avaldatud mugavate esemete valikust.

maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore2FYoungsterText
maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
My dad's having a hard time learning
the names of items and how they are
supposed to be used…
maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Mu isal on raske õppida
esemete nimesid ja kuidas neid
kasutama peaks…

maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore2FDirectoryText
maps/CeladonDeptStore2F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Top Grade Items for Trainers!
2F: TRAINER'S MARKET

maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore3FYoungsterText
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
I can't decide which #MON I
should use this TM on…
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Ma ei suuda otsustada, millisel #MONil
seda TMi kasutada…

maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid1Text
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Uh-oh! I traded my #MON without
removing the UPGRADE from it.
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Oih! Vahetasin oma #MONi, ilma
et oleks eemaldanud UPGRADE selle küljest.

maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid2Text
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Yeah! I'm finally getting a PORYGON!
I'm no good at the slots, so I could
never get enough coins…
…Huh?
The traded PORYGON turned into a different #MON!
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Jaa! Saan lõpuks PORYGONi!
Ma pole automaatides hea, seega ei
suutnud kunagi piisavalt münte saada…
…Häh?
Vahetatud PORYGON muutus teiseks #MONiks!

maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore3FSuperNerdText
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.en: The TM SHOP sells some rare moves.
maps/CeladonDeptStore3F.asm::CeladonDept.et: TM POOD müüb mõningaid haruldasi rünnakuid.

maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore4FSuperNerdText
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.en: I'm here to buy SURF MAIL to send to my girlfriend.
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.et: Tulin ostma SURF MAILi, et saata oma tüdruksõbrale.

maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore4FYoungsterText
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
This is the only place where you
can buy LOVELY MAIL.
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
See on ainus koht, kus saad
osta LOVELY MAILi.

maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore4FDirectoryText
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Express Yourself With Gifts!
4F: WISEMAN GIFTS
maps/CeladonDeptStore4F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Väljenda end kingitustega!
4F: TARGA MEHE KINGID

maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore5FGentlemanText
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
I want to buy some items that raise
#MON stats, but I don't have enough money…
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Tahan osta esemeid, mis tõstavad
#MONi näitajaid, aga mul pole piisavalt raha…

maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore5FSailorText
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
I want PP UP, so I can raise the PP
of moves. But you can't buy it…
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Tahan PP UPi, et saaksin tõsta rünnakute
PP-d. Aga seda ei saa osta…

maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore5FTeacherText
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Using items on them makes #MON happy.
They hate certain items, though…
maps/CeladonDeptStore5F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Esemete kasutamine teeb #MONid õnnelikuks.
Mõnda eset nad siiski vihkavad…

maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonVend.label: CeladonVendingText
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonVend.en: A vending machine! Here's the menu.

maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonVend.label: CeladonVendingNoSpaceText
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonVend.en: There's no more room for stuff…

maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore6FSuperNerdText
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
A vending machine with a prize roulette…
You never see those anymore.
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Müügiautomaat auhinnaruletiga…
Neid enam ei näe.

maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.label: CeladonDeptStore6FYoungsterText
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.en:
Aww! There's no games here!
I wanted to play…
maps/CeladonDeptStore6F.asm::CeladonDept.et:
Ohh! Siin pole mänge!
Tahtsin mängida…

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerReceptionistText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Welcome!
You may exchange your coins for
fabulous prizes next door.
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Tere tulemast!
Võid oma mündid vahetada
vapustavate auhindade vastu kõrvaltoas.

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerPokefanMText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en: The slot machines are all state of the art.

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerTeacherText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
The weather outside is very nice.
It's this machine I want.
It cleaned me out yesterday, so it
should pay out today.
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Ilm väljas on väga kena.
See masin on see, mida tahan.
Eile puhastas see mind tühjaks, seega
täna peaks see välja maksma.

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerFishingGuruText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
This machine looks the same as the others.
I think this slot machine will pay out…
The odds vary among machines.
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
See masin näeb välja nagu teised.
Arvan, et see automaat maksab välja…
Võimalused erinevad masinate lõikes.

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherText1
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Whoa!
What? You want to play this machine?
Here, take my coins.
Gahahaha!
The coins just keep popping out!
Hm? What, kid? You want to play?
I'll share my luck with you!
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Oih!
Mida? Tahad seda masinat mängida?
Siin, võta mu mündid.
Gahahaha!
Mündid aina hüppavad välja!
Hm? Mida, poiss? Tahad mängida?
Jagan sinuga oma õnne!

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherText2
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Gahahaha!
It makes me feel good to do nice
things for other people!
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Gahahaha!
Mul on hea tunne teha teistele
inimestele head!

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherNoCoinCaseText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Hey, you don't have a COIN CASE.
How am I supposed to give you any coins, kid?
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Hei, sul pole COIN CASE.
Kuidas ma sulle münte annan, poiss?

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherFullCoinCaseText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Your COIN CASE is full.
Hey, your COIN CASE is full, kid.
You must be riding a winning streak too.
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Su COIN CASE on täis.
Hei, su COIN CASE on täis, poiss.
Sul peab ka võiduseeria olema.

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGymGu.label: CeladonGymGuideText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGymGu.en:
Hey! CHAMP in making!
Are you playing too? the slots too?
I'm trying to get enough coins for a prize #MON.
But I don't have enough coins yet…
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGymGu.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION!
Kas sa ka mängid? Ka automaate?
Üritan saada piisavalt münte auhinna-#MONi jaoks.
Aga mul pole veel piisavalt münte…

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerGrampsText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Is there any difference between these lines?
Hmmm… The odds are surely better for
PIKACHU's line, but… What to do?
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Kas nende ridade vahel on vahet?
Hmmm… Võimalused on kindlasti paremad
PIKACHU real, aga… Mida teha?

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerPoster1Text
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Hey!
Underneath this poster…
There's nothing!
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Hei!
Selle plakati all…
Pole midagi!

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerPoster2Text
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
Hey!
Underneath this poster…
There's nothing!
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Hei!
Selle plakati all…
Pole midagi!

maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.label: CeladonGameCornerSodaCanText
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.en:
A can of soda…
Someone must be coming back…
Huh? It's empty!
maps/CeladonGameCorner.asm::CeladonGameC.et:
Limonaadipurk…
Keegi peab tagasi tulema…
Häh? See on tühi!

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoomGentlemanText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en: I wanted PORYGON, but I was short by 100 coins…
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.et: Tahtsin PORYGONi, aga jäi 100 münti puudu…

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoomPharmacistText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en:
I don't want to lose my coins.
Whew…
I've got to stay calm and cool…
I can't lose my cool, or I'll lose all my money…
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.et:
Ma ei taha oma münte kaotada.
Uhh…
Pean jääma rahulikuks ja külmaks…
Ei tohi närvi kaotada, muidu kaotan kogu raha…

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_PrizeVendorIntroText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en:
Welcome!
We exchange your coins for fabulous prizes!
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.et:
Tere tulemast!
Vahetame su mündid vapustavate auhindade vastu!

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_NotEnoughRoomText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en: You have no room for it.

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_ComeAgainText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en: Oh. Please come back with coins!

maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_NoCoinCaseText
maps/CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoom.asm::Cel.en: Oh? You don't have a COIN CASE.

maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeforeBattleTe.label: ErikaBeforeBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeforeBattleTe.en:
ERIKA: Hello… Lovely weather,
isn't it? It's so pleasant…
…I'm afraid I may doze off…
My name is ERIKA. I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.
…Oh? All the way from JOHTO, you say? How nice…
Oh. I'm sorry, I didn't realize
that you wished to challenge me.
Very well, but I shall not lose.
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeforeBattleTe.et:
ERIKA: Tere… Ilus ilm, kas pole? Nii meeldiv…
…Kardan, et võin tukkuma jääda…
Mu nimi on ERIKA. Olen CELADONI SAALI JUHT.
…Oh? Sa ütled, et tulid välja JOHTOST? Kui tore…
Oh. Vabandust, ma ei taibanud, et soovid mulle väljakutset esitada.
Hea küll, aga ma ei kaota.

maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeatenText.label: ErikaBeatenText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeatenText.en:
ERIKA: Oh! I concede defeat…
You are remarkably strong…
I shall give you RAINBOWBADGE…
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaBeatenText.et:
ERIKA: Oh! Tunnistan kaotust…
Sa oled märkimisväärselt tugev…
Annan sulle RAINBOWBADGE…

maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaExplainTMText.label: ErikaExplainTMText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaExplainTMText.en:
ERIKA: That was a delightful match.
I felt inspired. Please, I wish you to have this TM.
It is GIGA DRAIN.
It is a wonderful move that drains
half the damage it inflicts to heal your #MON.
Please use it if it pleases you…
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaExplainTMText.et:
ERIKA: See oli meeldiv matš.
Tundsin end innustatuna. Palun, soovin, et võtaksid selle TM-i.
See on GIGA DRAIN.
Suurepärane rünnak, mis tervendab su #MONi poolega tekitatud kahjust.
Kasuta seda, kui see sulle meeldib…

maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaAfterBattleTex.label: ErikaAfterBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaAfterBattleTex.en:
ERIKA: Losing leaves a bitter aftertaste…
But knowing that there are strong
trainers spurs me to do better…
maps/CeladonGym.asm::ErikaAfterBattleTex.et:
ERIKA: Kaotus jätab kibeda järelmaigu…
Aga teadmine, et on tugevaid treenereid, sunnib mind paremini pingutama…

maps/CeladonGym.asm::LassMichelleSeenTex.label: LassMichelleSeenText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::LassMichelleSeenTex.en: Do you think a girls-only GYM is rare?
maps/CeladonGym.asm::LassMichelleSeenTex.et: Kas arvad, et ainult-tüdrukute SAAL on haruldane?

maps/CeladonGym.asm::LassMichelleAfterBa.label: LassMichelleAfterBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::LassMichelleAfterBa.en: I just got careless, that's all!

maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaSeenT.label: PicnickerTanyaSeenText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaSeenT.en: Oh, a battle? That's kind of scary, but OK!
maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaSeenT.et: Oh, lahing? See on veidi hirmus, aga olgu!

maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaAfter.label: PicnickerTanyaAfterBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaAfter.en:
Oh, look at all your BADGES. No
wonder I couldn't win!
maps/CeladonGym.asm::PicnickerTanyaAfter.et: Oh, vaata kõiki su MÄRKE. Pole ime, et ei suutnud võita!

maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaSeenText.label: BeautyJuliaSeenText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaSeenText.en: Were you looking at these flowers or at me?
maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaSeenText.et: Kas vaatasid neid lilli või mind?

maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaAfterBat.label: BeautyJuliaAfterBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaAfterBat.en: How do I go about becoming ladylike like ERIKA?
maps/CeladonGym.asm::BeautyJuliaAfterBat.et: Kuidas ma saaksin ERIKA moodi daamilikuks?

maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenT.label: TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenT.en: We'll show you #MON moves that ERIKA taught us!
maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenT.et: Näitame sulle #MONi rünnakuid, mida ERIKA meile õpetas!

maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1After.label: TwinsJoAndZoe1AfterBattleText
maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1After.en: ERIKA will get you back for us!
maps/CeladonGym.asm::TwinsJoAndZoe1After.et: ERIKA maksab sulle meie eest kätte!

maps/CeladonMansion1F.asm::CeladonMansio.label: CeladonMansionManagerText
maps/CeladonMansion1F.asm::CeladonMansio.en:
My dear #MON keep me company,
so I don't ever feel lonely.
