MEOWTH even brings money home.
maps/CeladonMansion1F.asm::CeladonMansio.et:
Mu kallid #MONid hoiavad mulle seltsi,
seega ma ei tunne end kunagi üksildasena.
MEOWTH toob isegi raha koju.

maps/CeladonMansion2F.asm::CeladonMansio.label: CeladonMansion2FComputerText
maps/CeladonMansion2F.asm::CeladonMansio.en:
<PLAYER> turned on the PC.
…
Someone was in the middle of composing an e-mail.
…I hope you'll come visit KANTO.
I think you'll be surprised at how
much things have changed here.
You'll also see many #MON that
aren't native to JOHTO.
To the PRODUCER
…
maps/CeladonMansion2F.asm::CeladonMansio.et:
<PLAYER> lülitas PC sisse.
…
Keegi oli parasjagu e-kirja koostamas.
…Loodan, et külastad KANTOT.
Arvan, et sind üllatab, kui
palju asjad on siin muutunud.
Näed ka palju #MONe, kes
pole JOHTOST pärit.
PRODUTSENDILE
…

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.label: GameFreakGameDesignerText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.en:
Is that right?
I'm the GAME DESIGNER!
Filling up your #DEX is tough, but don't give up!
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.et:
Kas nii on?
Olen MÄNGUDISAINER!
#DEXi täitmine on raske, aga ära anna alla!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.label: GameFreakGameDesignerCompletedPokedexText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.en:
Wow! Excellent! You completed your #DEX!
Congratulations!
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.et:
Vau! Suurepärane! Täitsid oma #DEXi!
Palju õnne!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.label: GameFreakGameDesignerAfterDiplomaText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.en:
The GRAPHIC ARTIST will print out a DIPLOMA for you.
You should go show it off.
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGame.et:
GRAAFIK prindib sulle DIPLOMI.
Peaksid sellega uhkeldama minema.

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.en:
I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.
I drew you!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistPrintDiplomaText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.en:
I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.
Oh, you completed your #DEX?
Want me to print out your DIPLOMA?
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.et:
Olen GRAAFIK.
Oh, täitsid oma #DEXi?
Kas tahad, et prindin su DIPLOMI?

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistRefusedText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.en: Give me a shout if you want your DIPLOMA printed.
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.et: Hõika, kui tahad oma DIPLOMI printida.

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistErrorText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.en: Something's wrong. I'll have to cancel printing.
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakGrap.et: Midagi on valesti. Pean printimise katkestama.

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakProg.label: GameFreakProgrammerText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakProg.en:
Who, me? I'm the PROGRAMMER.
Play the slot machines!
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakProg.et:
Kes, mina? Olen PROGRAMMEERIJA.
Mängi mänguautomaate!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakChar.label: GameFreakCharacterDesignerText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakChar.en:
Aren't the TWINS adorable?
JASMINE's pretty too.
Oh, I love them!
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::GameFreakChar.et:
Kas KAKSIKUD pole armsad?
Ka JASMINE on ilus.
Oh, ma armastan neid!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.label: CeladonMansion3FDrawingText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.en: It's a detailed drawing of a pretty girl.
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.et: See on detailne joonistus kenast tüdrukust.

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.label: CeladonMansion3FGameProgramText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.en:
It's the game program. Messing
with it could put a bug in the game!
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.et:
See on mänguprogramm. Sellega
nokitsemine võib mängu bugi tekitada!

maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.label: CeladonMansion3FReferenceMaterialText
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.en: It's crammed with reference materials. There's even a # DOLL.
maps/CeladonMansion3F.asm::CeladonMansio.et: See on täis abimaterjale. On isegi # DOLL.

maps/CeladonMansionRoof.asm::CeladonMans.label: CeladonMansionRoofFisherText
maps/CeladonMansionRoof.asm::CeladonMans.en:
High places--I do love them so!
I'd say the only thing that loves
heights as much as me is smoke!
maps/CeladonMansionRoof.asm::CeladonMans.et:
Kõrged kohad -- ma armastan neid nii väga!
Ütleksin, et ainus, kes armastab
kõrgusi sama palju kui mina, on suits!

maps/CeladonMansionRoof.asm::CeladonMans.label: CeladonMansionRoofGraffitiText
maps/CeladonMansionRoof.asm::CeladonMans.en:
There's graffiti on the wall…
<PLAYER> added a moustache!

maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistIntroText
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.en: Let me recount a terrifying tale…

maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistNotNightText
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.en:
Then again, it's not as scary while
it's still light outside.
Come back after sunset, OK?
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.et:
Teisalt pole see nii hirmus, kui
väljas on veel valge.
Tule tagasi pärast päikeseloojangut, eks?

maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistStoryText
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.en:
Once upon a time, there was a little
boy who was given a new BICYCLE…
He wanted to try it right away…
He was having so much fun that he
didn't notice the sun had set…
While riding home in the pitch-black
night, the bike suddenly slowed!
The pedals became heavy!
When he stopped pedaling, the bike
began slipping backwards!
It was as if the bike were cursed
and trying to drag him into oblivion!
…
…
SHRIEEEEK!
The boy had been riding uphill on CYCLING ROAD!
… Ba-dum ba-dum!
For listening so patiently, you may take this--TM03!
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.et:
Elas kord väike
poiss, kellele anti uus BICYCLE…
Ta tahtis seda kohe proovida…
Tal oli nii lõbus, et ta
ei märganud, et päike oli loojunud…
Sõites koju pilkases
pimeduses aeglustus ratas ootamatult!
Pedaalid muutusid raskeks!
Kui ta lõpetas väntamise, hakkas ratas
tagurpidi libisema!
Oli, nagu oleks ratas neetud
ja üritaks teda unustusehõlma tirida!
…
…
KILJATUS!
Poiss oli sõitnud CYCLING ROADIL ülesmäge!
… Pa-dum pa-dum!
Nii kannatlikult kuulamise eest võid võtta selle -- TM03!

maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistCurseText
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.en:
TM03 is CURSE.
It's a terrifying move that slowly
whittles down the victim's HP.
maps/CeladonMansionRoofHouse.asm::Celado.et:
TM03 on CURSE.
See on hirmutav rünnak, mis aeglaselt
närib ohvri HP-d.

maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.label: CeladonPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.en:
ERIKA is a master of grass #MON.
She'll make you pay if you don't watch yourself.
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.et:
ERIKA on rohu-#MONide meister.
Ta paneb sind maksma, kui ette ei vaata.

maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.label: CeladonPokecenter1FPharmacistText
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.en:
TEAM ROCKET's hideout is in the
basement of the GAME CORNER.
Oh, wait. That was three years ago.
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonPok.et:
RAKETI KAMBA peidik on
MÄNGUNURGA keldris.
Oh, oota. See oli kolm aastat tagasi.

maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonEus.label: CeladonEusineText1
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonEus.en:
EUSINE: Hi!
I'm back visiting my hometown.
It's been quite a while.
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::CeladonEus.et:
EUSINE: Tere!
Olen tagasi oma kodulinna külastamas.
Sellest on juba tükk aega möödas.

maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::EusineLeav.label: EusineLeavesCeladonText
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::EusineLeav.en:
<PLAYER>, have you heard?
There have been fresh rumors of a
rainbow-colored #MON appearing at TIN TOWER.
I've just had my party healed, so
now I'm headed to ECRUTEAK.
I'll be seeing you, <PLAYER>!
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::EusineLeav.et:
<PLAYER>, kas oled kuulnud?
On tekkinud värskeid kuuldusi
vikerkaarevärvi #MONist TIN TOWERIS.
Mul lasti just seltskond terveks ravida, seega
nüüd suundun ECRUTEAKI.
Näeme, <PLAYER>!

maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::NoBeastsTe.label: NoBeastsText
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::NoBeastsTe.en:
Oh, by the way, <PLAYER>.
Have you caught the legendary
#MON RAIKOU and ENTEI?
<……><……><……>
Okay…
If you catch even one, I hope that you'll inform me.
I'm counting on you, <PLAYER>!
maps/CeladonPokecenter1F.asm::NoBeastsTe.et:
Oh, muide, <PLAYER>.
Kas oled püüdnud legendaarsed
#MONid RAIKOU ja ENTEI?
<……><……><……>
Olgu…
Kui püüad kasvõi ühe, loodan, et annad mulle teada.
Loodan sinu peale, <PLAYER>!

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText1
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.en:
KANTO's POWER PLANT?
It's near the end of ROUTE 9, the
road that heads east from here.
I think there was an accident of some sort there.
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.et:
KANTO ELEKTRIJAAM?
See on ROUTE 9 lõpu lähedal, tee, mis suundub siit itta.
Seal juhtus vist mingi õnnetus.

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText2
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.en:
You're collecting every single kind of #MON?
That must be quite a challenge, but it sounds fun too.
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.et:
Kogud iga #MONi liiki?
See on ilmselt korralik väljakutse, aga tundub ka lõbus.

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySuper.label: CeruleanCitySuperNerdText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySuper.en:
The CAPE in the north is a good
place for dates. Girls like it!
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySuper.et: Põhjas olev NEEM on hea kohtingupaik. Tüdrukutele meeldib!

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerFText1
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.en: My SLOWBRO and I make an awesome combination!
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityCoolt.et: Mina ja mu SLOWBRO oleme vägev kombinatsioon!

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.label: CeruleanCityFisherText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.en: I'm a huge fan of CERULEAN GYM's MISTY.
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.et: Olen CERULEANI SAALI MISTY suur fänn.

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.label: CeruleanCityFisherRocketTipText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.en: I saw this shady guy go off toward CERULEAN's CAPE.
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityFishe.et: Nägin üht kahtlast tüüpi CERULEANI NEEME poole minemas.

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityYoung.label: CeruleanCityYoungsterText1
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityYoung.en:
There used to be a cave here that had
horribly powerful #MON in it.
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCityYoung.et: Siin oli kunagi koobas, kus olid kohutavalt võimsad #MONid.

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySignT.label: CeruleanCitySignText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySignT.en:
CERULEAN CITY
A Mysterious Blue Aura Surrounds It
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanCitySignT.et:
CERULEAN CITY
Seda ümbritseb müstiline sinine aura

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanGymSignTe.label: CeruleanGymSignText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanGymSignTe.en:
CERULEAN CITY #MON GYM LEADER: MISTY
The Tomboyish Mermaid
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanGymSignTe.et:
CERULEAN CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: MISTY
Poisilik merineitsi

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanBikeShopS.label: CeruleanBikeShopSignText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanBikeShopS.en:
There's a notice here…
The BIKE SHOP has moved to GOLDENROD CITY in JOHTO…
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanBikeShopS.et:
Siin on teade…
JALGRATTAPOOD on kolinud JOHTO GOLDENROD CITYSSE…

maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanPoliceSig.label: CeruleanPoliceSignText
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanPoliceSig.en:
There's a notice here…
Stamp out thievery and make the city
a friendlier, more cheerful place!
CERULEAN POLICE
maps/CeruleanCity.asm::CeruleanPoliceSig.et:
Siin on teade…
Kaotame varguse ja teeme linna sõbralikumaks ja rõõmsamaks!
CERULEANI POLITSEI

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntIn.label: CeruleanGymGruntIntroText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntIn.en:
Oops! I so sorry! You not hurt, okay?
I very busy. No time for talking with you. Not good for me if seen by somebody.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntIn.et:
Uups! Nii vabandust! Sina pole viga, olgu?
Mina väga hõivatud. Pole aega sinuga rääkida. Halb minule, kui keegi näeb.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBi.label: CeruleanGymGruntBigMistakeText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBi.en: Oh no! You seen me already! I make big mistake!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBi.et: Oh ei! Sina näeb mind juba! Mina teeb suur viga!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBy.label: CeruleanGymGruntByeText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBy.en:
Hey, you! Forget you see me, okay?
You see, hear, know nothing,
okay? Bye, kid! Nothing!
Bye-bye a go-go!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGruntBy.et:
Hei, sina! Unusta, et näed mind, olgu?
Sina näeb, kuuleb, tea mitte midagi, olgu? Nägemist, laps! Mitte midagi!
Pa-pa a go-go!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote1Te.label: CeruleanGymNote1Text
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote1Te.en: Sorry, I'll be out for a while. MISTY, GYM LEADER
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote1Te.et: Vabandust, olen mõnda aega eemal. MISTY, SAALI JUHT

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote2Te.label: CeruleanGymNote2Text
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote2Te.en: Since MISTY's out, we'll be away too. GYM TRAINERS
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymNote2Te.et: Kuna MISTY on ära, oleme meiegi eemal. SAALI TREENERID

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyIntroText.label: MistyIntroText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyIntroText.en:
MISTY: I was expecting you, you pest!
You may have a lot of JOHTO GYM
BADGES, but you'd better not take me too lightly.
My water-type #MON are tough!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyIntroText.et:
MISTY: Ootasin sind, tüütus!
Sul on ehk palju JOHTO SAALIMÄRKE, aga ära võta mind liiga kergelt.
Mu vee-tüüpi #MONid on kõvad!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyWinLossText.label: MistyWinLossText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyWinLossText.en:
MISTY: You really are good…
I'll admit that you are skilled…
Here you go. It's CASCADEBADGE.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyWinLossText.et:
MISTY: Sa oled tõesti hea…
Tunnistan, et oled osav…
Säh. See on CASCADEBADGE.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyFightDoneText.label: MistyFightDoneText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyFightDoneText.en:
MISTY: Are there many strong trainers in JOHTO? Like you, I mean.
I'm going to travel one day, so
I can battle some skilled trainers.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::MistyFightDoneText.et:
MISTY: Kas JOHTOS on palju tugevaid treenereid? Sinu moodi, ma mõtlen.
Kavatsen kunagi reisida, et osavate treeneritega võidelda.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfDianaSeenT.label: SwimmerfDianaSeenText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfDianaSeenT.en: Sorry about being away. Let's get on with it!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfDianaSeenT.et: Vabandust, et ära olin. Teeme siis ära!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfDianaBeate.label: SwimmerfDianaBeatenText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfDianaBeate.en: I give up! You're the winner!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaSeen.label: SwimmerfBrianaSeenText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaSeen.en: Don't let my elegant swimming unnerve you.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaSeen.et: Ära lase mu elegantsel ujumisel end häirida.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaBeat.label: SwimmerfBrianaBeatenText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaBeat.en: Ooh, you calmly disposed of me…

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaAfte.label: SwimmerfBrianaAfterBattleText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaAfte.en:
Don't be too smug about beating me.
MISTY will destroy you if you get complacent.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmerfBrianaAfte.et:
Ära ole mu võitmise pärast liiga enesekindel.
MISTY hävitab su, kui muutud loiuks.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerSeen.label: SwimmermParkerSeenText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerSeen.en:
Glub…
I'm first! Come and get me!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerSeen.et:
Glub…
Mina olen esimene! Tule ja püüa mind!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerAfte.label: SwimmermParkerAfterBattleText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerAfte.en:
MISTY has gotten much better in the past few years.
Don't let your guard down, or you'll be crushed!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::SwimmermParkerAfte.et:
MISTY on viimastel aastatel palju paremaks läinud.
Ära kaota valvsust, muidu murtakse sind!

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideTe.label: CeruleanGymGuideText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideTe.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making!
Since MISTY was away, I went out
for some fun too. He-he-he.
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideTe.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION!
Kuna MISTY oli ära, käisin minagi lõbutsemas. Hee-hee-hee.

maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideWi.label: CeruleanGymGuideWinText
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideWi.en:
Hoo, you showed me how tough you are.
As always, that was one heck of a great battle!
maps/CeruleanGym.asm::CeruleanGymGuideWi.et:
Ohoo, näitasid mulle, kui kõva oled.
Nagu alati, oli see üks vägev lahing!

maps/CeruleanGymBadgeSpeechHouse.asm::Ce.label: CeruleanGymBadgeSpeechHousePokefanMText
maps/CeruleanGymBadgeSpeechHouse.asm::Ce.en: Are you collecting KANTO GYM BADGES?

maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.label: CeruleanMart_CooltrainerMText
maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.en:
You'll run into many trainers on
the way to CERULEAN's CAPE.
They want to see how they stack
up against other trainers.
maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.et:
Kohtad palju treenereid
teel CERULEANI CAPE'ile.
Nad tahavad näha, kuidas nad
teiste treeneritega võrreldes seisavad.

maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.label: CeruleanMart_CooltrainerFText
maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.en:
MISTY is about the only person in
town who can beat the trainers at CERULEAN's CAPE.
maps/CeruleanMart.asm::CeruleanMart_Cool.et:
MISTY on umbes ainus linnas,
kes suudab alistada treenerid CERULEANI CAPE'il.

maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.en:
For battles, I'd much rather use
#MON I've been raising, even if
they're weaker than some newly caught #MON.
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.et:
Lahingutes kasutaksin pigem
#MONe, keda olen kasvatanud, isegi kui
nad on nõrgemad kui mõned äsja püütud #MONid.

maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText_Mobile
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.en:
Do you battle by mobile phone?
If time runs out during a battle,
waiting to see who won is really nerve wracking.
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.et:
Kas võitled mobiiltelefoni teel?
Kui lahingu ajal aeg otsa saab,
on võitja ootamine tõesti närvesööv.

maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FGymGuideText
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.en:
The MAGNET TRAIN travels at over
340 mph. It goes between KANTO and
JOHTO in almost no time at all.
It really makes JOHTO accessible.
maps/CeruleanPokecenter1F.asm::CeruleanP.et:
MAGNETRONG sõidab üle
340 mph. See jõuab KANTO ja
JOHTO vahet peaaegu hetkega.
See teeb JOHTO tõesti ligipääsetavaks.

maps/CeruleanPoliceStation.asm::Cerulean.label: CeruleanPoliceStationFishingGuruText
maps/CeruleanPoliceStation.asm::Cerulean.en:
I heard that some shady character is skulking about.
I won't stand for it if he turns out to be a thief.
maps/CeruleanPoliceStation.asm::Cerulean.et:
Kuulsin, et üks kahtlane tüüp hiilib ringi.
Ma ei salli seda, kui ta osutub vargaks.

maps/CeruleanPoliceStation.asm::Cerulean.label: CeruleanPoliceStationPokefanFText
maps/CeruleanPoliceStation.asm::Cerulean.en: We were held up by robbers before.

maps/CeruleanTradeSpeechHouse.asm::Cerul.label: CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseGrannyText
maps/CeruleanTradeSpeechHouse.asm::Cerul.en: My husband lives happily with #MON he got through trades.
maps/CeruleanTradeSpeechHouse.asm::Cerul.et: Mu mees elab õnnelikult #MONidega, kelle sai vahetuste teel.

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.label: CharcoalKilnBossText1
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.en:
All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared from the town.
The forest's protector may be angry with us…
It may be a bad omen. We should stay in.
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.et:
Kõik SLOWPOKE'd on linnast kadunud.
Metsa kaitsja on ehk meie peale vihane…
See võib olla halb enne. Jäägem sisse.

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.label: CharcoalKilnBossText2
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.en:
The SLOWPOKE have returned…
But my APPRENTICE hasn't come back from ILEX FOREST.
Where in the world is that lazy guy?
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.et:
SLOWPOKE'd on tagasi tulnud…
Aga mu õpipoiss pole ILEX FORESTIST naasnud.
Kus see laisk sell küll on?

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.label: CharcoalKilnBossText3
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.en:
You chased off TEAM ROCKET and
went to ILEX FOREST alone?
That takes guts! I like that. Come train with us.
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnBossT.et:
Sa ajasid RAKETI KAMBA minema ja
läksid üksi ILEX FORESTISSE?
See nõuab julgust! Meeldib. Tule meiega treenima.

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText1
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.en:
Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?
Are they out playing somewhere?
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.et:
Kuhu on kõik SLOWPOKE'd kadunud?
Kas nad mängivad kuskil?

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText2
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.en:
I'm sorry--I forgot to thank you.
This is CHARCOAL that I made.
Fire-type #MON would be happy to hold that.
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.et:
Vabandust – unustasin sind tänada.
See on CHARCOAL, mille valmistasin.
Tule-tüüpi #MON hoiaks seda hea meelega.

maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText3
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.en:
The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even found FARFETCH'D.
You're the coolest, man!
maps/CharcoalKiln.asm::CharcoalKilnAppre.et:
SLOWPOKE'd tulid tagasi ja sa leidsid isegi FARFETCH'D.
Sa oled kõige lahedam, semu!

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentIntro.label: GuideGentIntroText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentIntro.en:
You're a rookie trainer, aren't you? I can tell!
That's OK! Everyone is a rookie at some point!
If you'd like, I can teach you a few things.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentIntro.et:
Sa oled algaja treener, eks? Näen seda!
Pole hullu! Igaüks on kunagi algaja olnud!
Kui soovid, õpetan sulle mõne asja.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokec.label: GuideGentPokecenterText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokec.en:
This is a #MON CENTER. They heal
your #MON in no time at all.
You'll be relying on them a lot, so
you better learn about them.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokec.et:
See on #MON KESKUS. Nad ravivad
su #MONid hetkega terveks.
Sa hakkad neile palju lootma, seega
õpi neid hästi tundma.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentMartT.label: GuideGentMartText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentMartT.en:
This is a #MON MART.
They sell BALLS for catching wild
#MON and other useful items.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentMartT.et:
See on #MON MART.
Nad müüvad PALLE metsikute #MONide
püüdmiseks ja muid kasulikke esemeid.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentRoute.label: GuideGentRoute30Text
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentRoute.en:
ROUTE 30 is out this way.
Trainers will be battling their
prized #MON there.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentRoute.et:
ROUTE 30 jääb siiapoole.
Seal võitlevad treenerid oma
hinnatud #MONidega.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentSeaTe.label: GuideGentSeaText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentSeaTe.en:
This is the sea, as you can see.
Some #MON are found only in water.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentSeaTe.et:
See on meri, nagu näed.
Mõnd #MONi leidub ainult vees.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentGiftT.label: GuideGentGiftText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentGiftT.en:
Here…
It's my house! Thanks for your company.
Let me give you a small gift.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentGiftT.et:
Näe…
See on minu maja! Aitäh seltsi eest.
Lase mul sulle väike kingitus teha.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokeg.label: GuideGentPokegearText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokeg.en:
#GEAR becomes more useful as you add CARDS.
I wish you luck on your journey!
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentPokeg.et:
#GEAR muutub kasulikumaks, kui lisad KAARTE.
Soovin sulle teel õnne!

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentNoTex.label: GuideGentNoText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentNoTex.en:
Oh… It's something I enjoy doing…
Fine. Come see me when you like.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::GuideGentNoTex.et:
Oh… Mulle lihtsalt meeldib seda teha…
Hea küll. Tule millal soovid.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.label: CherrygroveRivalText_Seen
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.en:
<……> <……> <……>
You got a #MON at the LAB.
What a waste. A wimp like you.
<……> <……> <……>
Don't you get what I'm saying?
Well, I too, have a good #MON.
I'll show you what I mean!
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.et:
<……> <……> <……>
Sa said LABORIST #MONi.
Milline raiskamine. Sinusugune nõrguke.
<……> <……> <……>
Kas sa ei saa aru, mida ma räägin?
Ka minul on hea #MON.
Näitan sulle, mida mõtlen!

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::RivalCherrygro.label: RivalCherrygroveWinText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::RivalCherrygro.en: Humph. Are you happy you won?
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::RivalCherrygro.et: Hmph. Kas oled rõõmus, et võitsid?

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.label: CherrygroveRivalText_YouLost
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.en:
<……> <……> <……>
My name's ???.
I'm going to be the world's greatest #MON trainer.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.et:
<……> <……> <……>
Minu nimi on ???.
Minust saab maailma parim #MONi treener.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::RivalCherrygro.label: RivalCherrygroveLossText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::RivalCherrygro.en: Humph. That was a waste of time.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.label: CherrygroveRivalText_YouWon
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.en:
<……> <……> <……>
My name's ???.
I'm going to be the world's greatest #MON trainer.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveRiv.et:
<……> <……> <……>
Minu nimi on ???.
Minust saab maailma parim #MONi treener.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveTea.label: CherrygroveTeacherText_NoMapCard
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveTea.en:
Did you talk to the old man by the #MON CENTER?
He'll put a MAP of JOHTO on your #GEAR.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveTea.et:
Kas rääkisid vanamehega #MON KESKUSE juures?
Ta paneb su #GEARI JOHTO KAARDI.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveTea.label: CherrygroveTeacherText_HaveMapCard
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveTea.en: When you're with #MON, going anywhere is fun.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveYou.label: CherrygroveYoungsterText_NoPokedex
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveYou.en: MR.#MON's house is still farther up ahead.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveYou.label: CherrygroveYoungsterText_HavePokedex
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveYou.en:
I battled the trainers on the road.
My #MON lost. They're a mess! I
must take them to a #MON CENTER.
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveYou.et:
Võitlesin teel olevate treeneritega.
Mu #MONid kaotasid. Nad on räsitud!
Pean nad #MON KESKUSESSE viima.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::MysticWaterGuy.label: MysticWaterGuyTextBefore
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::MysticWaterGuy.en:
A #MON I caught had an item.
I think it's MYSTIC WATER.
I don't need it, so do you want it?
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::MysticWaterGuy.et:
#MONil, kelle püüdsin, oli ese.
Arvan, et see on MYSTIC WATER.
Mul pole seda vaja — kas soovid seda?

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::MysticWaterGuy.label: MysticWaterGuyTextAfter
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::MysticWaterGuy.en: Back to fishing for me, then.

maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveCit.label: CherrygroveCitySignText
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveCit.en:
CHERRYGROVE CITY
The City of Cute, Fragrant Flowers
maps/CherrygroveCity.asm::CherrygroveCit.et:
CHERRYGROVE CITY
Armsate, lõhnavate lillede linn

maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.label: CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseYoungsterText
maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.en:
#MON gain experience in battle
and change their form.
maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.et:
#MONid koguvad lahingus kogemust
ja muudavad oma kuju.

maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.label: CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseLassText
maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.en:
#MON change?
I would be shocked if one did that!
maps/CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouse.asm.et:
#MON muutub?
Ma oleksin šokeeritud, kui üks seda teeks!

maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.label: CherrygroveGymSpeechHousePokefanMText
maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.en:
You're trying to see how good you
are as a #MON trainer?
You better visit the #MON GYMS
all over JOHTO and collect BADGES.
maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.et:
Üritad näha, kui hea sa
#MON-treenerina oled?
Külasta parem #MON SAALE
üle JOHTO ja kogu MÄRKE.

maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.label: CherrygroveGymSpeechHouseBugCatcherText
maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.en:
When I get older, I'm going to be a GYM LEADER!
I make my #MON battle with my
friend's to make them tougher!
maps/CherrygroveGymSpeechHouse.asm::Cher.et:
Kui suureks saan, saab minust SAALI JUHT!
Lasen oma #MONidel võidelda sõbra
omadega, et neid kõvemaks teha!

maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.label: CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.en:
They're fresh out of # BALLS!
When will they get more of them?
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.et:
# BALLID on otsas!
Millal nad neid juurde saavad?

maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.label: CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText_PokeBallsInStock
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.en: # BALLS are in stock! Now I can catch #MON!
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.et: # BALLID on laos! Nüüd saan #MONe püüda!

maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.label: CherrygroveMartYoungsterText
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.en:
When I was walking in the grass, a
bug #MON poisoned my #MON!
I just kept going, but then my #MON fainted.
You should keep an ANTIDOTE with you.
maps/CherrygroveMart.asm::CherrygroveMar.et:
Kui kõndisin rohus, mürgitas
putuk-#MON mu #MONi!
Läksin edasi, aga siis mu #MON minestas.
Peaksid ANTIDOTE kaasas hoidma.

maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FFisherText
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.en:
It's great. I can store any number
of #MON, and it's all free.
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.et:
See on suurepärane. Saan hoida ükskõik
kui palju #MONe, ja see on tasuta.

maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.en: That PC is free for any trainer to use.
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.et: See PC on iga treeneri kasutada tasuta.

maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.en:
The COMMUNICATION CENTER upstairs was just built.
But they're still finishing it up.
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.et:
Üleval olev SIDEKESKUS ehitati just.
Aga seda alles viimistletakse.

maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText_CommCenterOpen
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.en:
The COMMUNICATION CENTER upstairs was just built.
I traded #MON there already!
maps/CherrygrovePokecenter1F.asm::Cherry.et:
Üleval olev SIDEKESKUS ehitati just.
Vahetasin seal juba #MONe!

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeEasierT.label: ChucksWifeEasierToFlyText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeEasierT.en:
You crossed the sea to get here?
That must have been hard.
It would be much easier if your
#MON knew how to FLY…
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeEasierT.et:
Ületasid siia jõudmiseks mere?
See pidi raske olema.
Oleks palju lihtsam, kui su #MON oskaks FLY-d…

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeBeatChu.label: ChucksWifeBeatChuckText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeBeatChu.en:
But you can't use FLY without this city's GYM BADGE.
If you beat the GYM LEADER here, come see me.
I'll have a nice gift for you.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeBeatChu.et:
Aga FLY-d ei saa kasutada ilma selle linna SAALI MÄRGITA.
Kui alistad siin SAALI JUHI, tule minu juurde.
Mul on sulle kena kingitus.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeGiveHMT.label: ChucksWifeGiveHMText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeGiveHMT.en:
That's CIANWOOD's GYM BADGE!
Then you should take this HM.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeGiveHMT.et:
See on CIANWOODI SAALI MÄRK!
Siis peaksid võtma selle HM-i.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeFlySpee.label: ChucksWifeFlySpeechText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeFlySpee.en:
Teach FLY to your #MON.
You will be able to FLY instantly
to anywhere you have visited.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeFlySpee.et:
Õpeta oma #MONile FLY.
Saad hetkega LENNATA igale poole, kus oled käinud.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeChubbyT.label: ChucksWifeChubbyText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeChubbyT.en:
My husband lost to you, so he needs to train harder.
That's good, since he was getting a little chubby.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::ChucksWifeChubbyT.et:
Mu abikaasa kaotas sulle, nii et ta peab kõvemini treenima.
See on hea, sest ta oli veidi tüsedaks läinud.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityYoung.label: CianwoodCityYoungsterText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityYoung.en:
If you use FLY, you can get back
to OLIVINE instantly.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityYoung.et: Kui kasutad FLY-d, saad hetkega OLIVINESSE tagasi.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityPokef.label: CianwoodCityPokefanMText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityPokef.en:
Boulders to the north of town can be crushed.
They may be hiding something.
Your #MON could use ROCK SMASH to break them.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityPokef.et:
Linnast põhja pool olevaid rahne saab purustada.
Ehk peidavad need midagi.
Su #MON võiks need ROCK SMASH-iga lõhkuda.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityLassT.label: CianwoodCityLassText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityLassT.en:
CHUCK, the GYM LEADER, spars with
his fighting #MON.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityLassT.et: SAALI JUHT CHUCK harjutab oma kaklus-#MONidega.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityUnuse.label: CianwoodCityUnusedText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityUnuse.en:
There are several islands between here and OLIVINE.
A mythical sea creature supposedly lives there.
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCityUnuse.et:
Siin ja OLIVINE vahel on mitu saart.
Seal olevat müütiline mereelukas.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineSuicuneText.label: EusineSuicuneText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineSuicuneText.en:
EUSINE: Yo, <PLAYER>.
Wasn't that SUICUNE just now?
I only caught a quick glimpse, but
I thought I saw SUICUNE running on the waves.
SUICUNE is beautiful and grand.
And it races through towns and
roads at simply awesome speeds.
It's wonderful…
I want to see SUICUNE up close…
I've decided.
I'll battle you as a trainer to earn SUICUNE's respect!
Come on, <PLAYER>. Let's battle now!
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineSuicuneText.et:
EUSINE: Hei, <PLAYER>.
Kas see polnud äsja SUICUNE?
Nägin vaid põgusalt, aga arvasin, et nägin SUICUNET lainetel jooksmas.
SUICUNE on kaunis ja suurejooneline.
Ja ta kihutab läbi linnade ja teede lihtsalt hämmastava kiirusega.
See on imeline…
Tahan SUICUNET lähedalt näha…
Otsustasin.
Võitlen sinuga treenerina, et pälvida SUICUNE lugupidamist!
Tule, <PLAYER>. Võitleme kohe!

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineBeatenText.label: EusineBeatenText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineBeatenText.en: I hate to admit it, but you win.

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineAfterText.label: EusineAfterText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineAfterText.en:
You're amazing, <PLAYER>!
No wonder #MON gravitate to you.
I get it now.
I'm going to keep searching for SUICUNE.
I'm sure we'll see each other again.
See you around!
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::EusineAfterText.et:
Sa oled hämmastav, <PLAYER>!
Pole ime, et #MONid sinu poole tõmbuvad.
Nüüd saan aru.
Jätkan SUICUNE otsimist.
Kindlasti kohtume veel.
Näeme!

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCitySignT.label: CianwoodCitySignText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodCitySignT.en:
CIANWOOD CITY
A Port Surrounded by Rough Seas

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodGymSignTe.label: CianwoodGymSignText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodGymSignTe.en:
CIANWOOD CITY #MON GYM
LEADER: CHUCK
His Roaring Fists Do the Talking
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodGymSignTe.et:
CIANWOOD CITY #MON SAAL
JUHT: CHUCK
Tema mürisevad rusikad räägivad

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPharmacyS.label: CianwoodPharmacySignText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPharmacyS.en:
500 Years of Tradition
CIANWOOD CITY PHARMACY
We Await Your Medicinal Queries
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPharmacyS.et:
500 aastat traditsiooni
CIANWOOD CITY APTEEK
Ootame teie tervisemuresid

maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPhotoStud.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioSignText
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPhotoStud.en:
CIANWOOD CITY PHOTO STUDIO
Take a Snapshot as a Keepsake!
maps/CianwoodCity.asm::CianwoodPhotoStud.et:
CIANWOOD CITY FOTOSTUUDIO
Tee mälestuseks pilti!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText1.label: ChuckIntroText1
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText1.en:
WAHAHAH!
So you've come this far!
Let me tell you, I'm tough!
My #MON will crush stones and shatter bones!
Watch this!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText1.et:
VAHAHAA!
Nii et oled nii kaugele jõudnud!
Ütlen sulle — ma olen kõva!
Mu #MONid purustavad kive ja murravad konte!
Vaata seda!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText3.label: ChuckIntroText3
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText3.en:
There! Scared now, are you?
What? It has nothing to
do with #MON? That's true!
Come on. We shall do battle!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckIntroText3.et:
Näed! Kartsid nüüd, mis?
Mis? Sellel pole #MONidega mingit pistmist? Tõsi!
Tule. Võitleme!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckLossText.label: ChuckLossText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckLossText.en:
Wha? Huh? I lost?
How about that! You're worthy of STORMBADGE!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckLossText.et:
Mis? Ah? Ma kaotasin?
No mis sa kostad! Sa oled STORMBADGE vääriline!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainBadgeT.label: ChuckExplainBadgeText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainBadgeT.en:
STORMBADGE makes all #MON up to
L70 obey, even traded ones.
It also lets your #MON use FLY
when you're not in a battle.
Here, take this too!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainBadgeT.et:
STORMBADGE paneb kõik #MONid kuni L70 kuuletuma, ka vahetatud.
Samuti saavad su #MONid väljaspool lahingut FLY-d kasutada.
Säh, võta seegi!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainTMText.label: ChuckExplainTMText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainTMText.en:
That is DYNAMICPUNCH.
It doesn't always hit, but when it
does, it causes confusion!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckExplainTMText.et:
See on DYNAMICPUNCH.
See ei taba alati, aga kui tabab, tekitab segadust!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckAfterText.label: ChuckAfterText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckAfterText.en:
WAHAHAH! I enjoyed battling you!
But a loss is a loss!
From now on, I'm going to train 24 hours a day!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::ChuckAfterText.et:
VAHAHAA! Nautisin sinuga võitlemist!
Aga kaotus on kaotus!
Nüüdsest treenin 24 tundi ööpäevas!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiSeen.label: BlackbeltYoshiSeenText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiSeen.en:
My #MON and I are bound together by friendship.
Our bond will never be broken!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiSeen.et:
Mind ja mu #MONe seob sõprus.
Meie side ei purune iial!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiAfte.label: BlackbeltYoshiAfterText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiAfte.en: You seem to have a strong bond with your #MON too!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltYoshiAfte.et: Tundub, et ka sinul on oma #MONidega tugev side!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltNobSeenTe.label: BlackbeltNobSeenText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltNobSeenTe.en: Words are useless. Let your fists do the talking!
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltNobSeenTe.et: Sõnad on kasutud. Las rusikad räägivad!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltLungSeenT.label: BlackbeltLungSeenText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltLungSeenT.en: My raging fists will shatter your #MON!

maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltLungAfter.label: BlackbeltLungAfterText
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltLungAfter.en: My #MON lost… My… my pride is shattered…
maps/CianwoodGym.asm::BlackbeltLungAfter.et: Mu #MON kaotas… Mu… mu uhkus on purustatud…

maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTeacherText
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.en:
You came from OLIVINE?
Do you remember the four islands along the way?
I heard that a mythical sea creature is hiding in them.
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.et:
Sa tulid OLIVINEIST?
Kas mäletad neid nelja saart tee ääres?
Kuulsin, et neis peidab end müütiline mereolend.

maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseLassText
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.en:
I heard that you can only see it if
you have a SILVER WING.
It must have the same scent as the creature.
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.et:
Kuulsin, et seda näeb ainult siis,
kui sul on SILVER WING.
Sel peab olema sama lõhn mis olendil.

maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTwinText
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.en:
I've heard that the whirlpools
around the islands are caused by the sea creature.
You might need a special move to get past them.
maps/CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Cianw.et:
Olen kuulnud, et saari ümbritsevad
veekeerised on selle mereolendi tekitatud.
Nende ületamiseks võib vaja minna erirünnakut.

maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistGiv.label: PharmacistGiveSecretpotionText
maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistGiv.en:
Your #MON appear to be fine.
Is something wor- rying you?
…
The LIGHTHOUSE #MON is in trouble?
I got it!
This ought to do the trick.
maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistGiv.et:
Su #MONid näivad terved.
Kas miski vaevab sind?
…
TULETORNI #MON on hädas?
Sain aru!
See peaks aitama.

maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistDes.label: PharmacistDescribeSecretpotionText
maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistDes.en:
My SECRETPOTION is a tad too strong.
I only offer it in an emergency.
maps/CianwoodPharmacy.asm::PharmacistDes.et:
Mu SECRETPOTION on veidi liiga tugev.
Pakun seda vaid hädaolukorras.

maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_Question
maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.en:
You have magnificent #MON with you.
How about a photo for a souvenir?
maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.et:
Sul on kaasas suurepärased #MONid.
Kuidas oleks fotoga mälestuseks?

maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_No
maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.en:
Oh, that's too bad. I thought it
would be a great memento…
maps/CianwoodPhotoStudio.asm::CianwoodPh.et:
Oh, kahju. Arvasin, et sellest
tuleks suurepärane mälestus…

maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FLassText
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.en:
Did you meet the #MANIAC?
He's always bragging about his rare #MON.
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.et:
Kas kohtasid #MANIAKKI?
Ta kiitleb alati oma haruldaste #MONidega.

maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.label: CianwoodGymGuideText
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.en:
The #MON GYM trainers here are macho bullies.
If I stick around, they might come after me.
Here's some advice: the GYM
LEADER uses the fighting-type.
So you should confound him with psychic #MON.
Wipe out his #MON before they
can use their physical strength.
And those boulders in the middle of the GYM?
If you don't move them correctly,
you won't reach the GYM LEADER.
If you get stuck, go outside.
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.et:
Siinse #MON SAALI treenerid on matšo-tõprad.
Kui ma siia jään, võivad nad mind taga ajada.
Siin on nõuanne: SAALI
JUHT kasutab kaklus-tüüpi.
Seega peaksid teda segadusse ajama vaimsete #MONidega.
Hävita ta #MONid, enne kui nad
saavad oma füüsilist jõudu kasutada.
Ja need rahnud SAALI keskel?
Kui sa neid õigesti ei liiguta,
ei jõua sa SAALI JUHINI.
Kui jääd hätta, mine välja.

maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.label: CianwoodGymGuideWinText
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.en:
<PLAYER>! You won! I could tell by looking at you!
Don't you get the urge to show off
your #MON to friends?
I wish I could show the #MON I
raised to my pal in VIOLET.
I've been battling my pal in VIOLET
using a MOBILE ADAPTER link.
I'm down 5-7 against him. I've gotta crank it up!
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodG.et:
<PLAYER>! Sa võitsid! Nägin seda sulle otsa vaadates!
Kas sul ei teki tahtmist oma
#MONe sõpradele näidata?
Sooviksin näidata #MONe, keda
kasvatasin, oma sõbrale VIOLETIS.
Olen võidelnud oma VIOLETI sõbraga
MOBILE ADAPTERi ühenduse teel.
Olen 5-7 kaotusseisus. Pean vinti keerama!

maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FSuperNerdText
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.en:
I love showing off the #MON that
I've raised. Don't you?
I'm going to get into a bunch of
battles, and show off my #MON!
maps/CianwoodPokecenter1F.asm::CianwoodP.et:
Mulle meeldib näidata #MONe, keda
olen kasvatanud. Kas sulle ka?
Hakkan pidama hulga
lahinguid ja näitan oma #MONe!

maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandB.label: CinnabarIslandBlueText
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandB.en:
Who are you?
Well, it's plain to see that you're a trainer…
My name's BLUE.
I was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…
That meddling RED did me in…
Anyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?
…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.
Take a good look around you…
A volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.
We can go on winning and losing in
#MON. But if nature so much as
twitches, we can lose in a second.
…
That's the way it is…
But, anyway, I'm still a trainer.
If I see a strong opponent, it makes me want to battle.
If you want to battle me, come to the VIRIDIAN GYM.
I'll take you on then.
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandB.et:
Kes sa oled?
Noh, on selge, et oled treener…
Minu nimi on BLUE.
Olin kunagi TŠEMPION, kuigi vaid lühikest aega…
See tüütu RED tegi mulle lõpu…
Igatahes, mida sa tahad? Tahad mind välja kutsuda või?
…Vastumeelselt ütlen, aga mul pole praegu lahingu tuju.
Vaata enda ümber hoolega…
Vulkaan purskab ja niisama lihtsalt kaob terve linn.
Me võime #MONides võita ja kaotada. Aga kui loodus vaid võpatab, kaotame hetkega.
…
Nii see on…
Aga igatahes, olen ikka treener.
Kui näen tugevat vastast, tekib tahtmine võidelda.
Kui tahad minuga võidelda, tule VIRIDIANI SAALI.
Siis võtan sinuga mõõtu.

maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandG.label: CinnabarIslandGymSignText
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandG.en:
There's a notice here…
CINNABAR GYM has relocated to SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
BLAINE
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandG.et:
Siin on teade…
CINNABARI SAAL on kolinud SEAFOAM ISLANDSILE. BLAINE

maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandS.label: CinnabarIslandSignText
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandS.en:
CINNABAR ISLAND
The Fiery Town of Burning Desire
maps/CinnabarIsland.asm::CinnabarIslandS.et:
CINNABAR ISLAND
Põleva ihaluse tuline linn

maps/CinnabarPokecenter1F.asm::CinnabarP.label: CinnabarPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/CinnabarPokecenter1F.asm::CinnabarP.en:
CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE apparently
lives alone in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS cave…
maps/CinnabarPokecenter1F.asm::CinnabarP.et:
CINNABARI SAALI BLAINE ilmselt
elab üksi SEAFOAM ISLANDSI koopas…

maps/CinnabarPokecenter1F.asm::CinnabarP.label: CinnabarPokecenter1FFisherText
maps/CinnabarPokecenter1F.asm::CinnabarP.en: It's been a year since the volcano erupted.

maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanMText
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.en:
My daughter likes to mimic people.
Her mimicry has earned her the
nickname COPYCAT around here.
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.et:
Mu tütrele meeldib inimesi matkida.
Ta matkimine on talle siin
teeninud hüüdnime COPYCAT.

maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.en:
My daughter is so self-centered…
She only has a few friends.
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.et:
Mu tütar on nii enesekeskne…
Tal on vaid mõni sõber.

maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.en:
She recently lost the # DOLL that
a boy gave her three years ago.
Ever since then, she's gotten even better at mimicry…
maps/CopycatsHouse1F.asm::CopycatsHouse1.et:
Ta kaotas hiljuti # DOLLi,
mille üks poiss talle kolm aastat tagasi andis.
Sestpeale on ta matkimises veelgi paremaks saanud…

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.label: CopycatText_Male_1
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.en:
<PLAYER>: Hi! Do you like #MON?
<PLAYER>: Uh, no, I just asked you.
<PLAYER>: Huh? You're strange!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.et:
<PLAYER>: Tere! Kas sulle meeldivad #MONid?
<PLAYER>: Öö, ei, ma just küsisin sinult.
<PLAYER>: Häh? Sa oled imelik!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Qu.label: CopycatText_QuickMimicking
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Qu.en:
COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But that's my favorite hobby!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Qu.et:
COPYCAT: Hmm? Lõpetada matkimine?
Aga see on mu lemmikharrastus!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.label: CopycatText_Male_2
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.en:
<PLAYER>: Hi! I heard that you
lost your favorite # DOLL.
<PLAYER>: If I find it, you'll give me a rail PASS?
<PLAYER>: I'll go find it for you.
You think you lost it when you went to VERMILION CITY?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.et:
<PLAYER>: Tere! Kuulsin, et
kaotasid oma lemmik-# DOLLi.
<PLAYER>: Kui ma selle leian, annad mulle rongi-PASSi?
<PLAYER>: Lähen otsin selle sulle üles.
Arvad, et kaotasid selle, kui käisid VERMILION CITYS?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Wo.label: CopycatText_Worried
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Wo.en:
COPYCAT: Pardon?
I shouldn't decide what you should do?
But I'm really worried… What if someone finds it?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Wo.et:
COPYCAT: Palun?
Ma ei tohiks otsustada, mida sa tegema pead?
Aga olen tõesti mures… Mis siis, kui keegi selle leiab?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.label: CopycatText_GiveDoll
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.en:
COPYCAT: Yay! That's my CLEFAIRY # DOLL!
See the tear where the right leg is
sewn on? That's proof!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.et:
COPYCAT: Jee! See on mu CLEFAIRY # DOLL!
Näed rebendit seal, kus parem jalg
on külge õmmeldud? See on tõestus!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.label: CopycatText_GivePass
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.en: OK. Here's the MAGNET TRAIN PASS like I promised!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Gi.et: OK. Siin on MAGNETRONGI PASS, nagu lubasin!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ex.label: CopycatText_ExplainPass
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ex.en:
COPYCAT: That's the PASS for the MAGNET TRAIN.
The rail company man gave me that
when they tore down our old house for the STATION.
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ex.et:
COPYCAT: See on MAGNETRONGI PASS.
Raudteefirma mees andis mulle selle,
kui nad JAAMA jaoks meie vana maja maha lammutasid.

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.label: CopycatText_Male_3
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.en:
<PLAYER>: Hi! Thanks a lot for the rail PASS!
<PLAYER>: Pardon?
<PLAYER>: Is it that fun to mimic my every move?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Ma.et:
<PLAYER>: Tere! Suur tänu rongi-PASSi eest!
<PLAYER>: Palun?
<PLAYER>: Kas iga mu liigutuse matkimine on nii lõbus?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_It.label: CopycatText_ItsAScream
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_It.en: COPYCAT: You bet! It's a scream!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_It.et: COPYCAT: Kindla peale! See on naljakas!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.label: CopycatText_Female_1
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.en:
<PLAYER>: Hi. You must like #MON.
<PLAYER>: No, not me. I asked you.
<PLAYER>: Pardon? You're weird!
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.et:
<PLAYER>: Tere. Sulle kindlasti meeldivad #MONid.
<PLAYER>: Ei, mitte mulle. Ma küsisin sinult.
<PLAYER>: Palun? Sa oled veider!

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.label: CopycatText_Female_2
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.en:
<PLAYER>: Hi. Did you really lose your # DOLL?
<PLAYER>: You'll really give me a
rail PASS if I find it for you?
<PLAYER>: Sure, I'll look for it!
You think you lost it when you were in VERMILION?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.et:
<PLAYER>: Tere. Kas kaotasid tõesti oma # DOLLi?
<PLAYER>: Annad mulle tõesti
rongi-PASSi, kui selle sulle leian?
<PLAYER>: Muidugi, otsin selle!
Arvad, et kaotasid selle, kui olid VERMILIONIS?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.label: CopycatText_Female_3
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.en:
<PLAYER>: Thank you for the rail PASS!
<PLAYER>: …Pardon?
<PLAYER>: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatText_Fe.et:
<PLAYER>: Aitäh rongi-PASSi eest!
<PLAYER>: …Palun?
<PLAYER>: Kas on tõesti nii lõbus
korrata, mida ma ütlen ja teen?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsDodrio.label: CopycatsDodrioText2
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsDodrio.en:
MIRROR, MIRROR ON THE WALL, WHO'S
THE FAIREST ONE OF ALL?
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsDodrio.et:
PEEGEL, PEEGEL SEINA PEAL, KES ON
KÕIGIST KAUNEIM MAAL?

maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsHouse2.label: CopycatsHouse2FDollText
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsHouse2.en:
This is a rare #MON! Huh?
It's only a doll…
maps/CopycatsHouse2F.asm::CopycatsHouse2.et:
See on haruldane #MON! Häh?
See on ainult nukk…

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoSe.label: KimonoGirlNaokoSeenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoSe.en: You have lovely #MON. May I see them in battle?
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoSe.et: Sul on armsad #MONid. Kas tohin neid lahingus näha?

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoAf.label: KimonoGirlNaokoAfterBattleText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoAf.en: I enjoyed that bout. I would like to see you again.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlNaokoAf.et: Nautisin seda matši. Tahaksin sind veel näha.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoSee.label: KimonoGirlSayoSeenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoSee.en:
I always dance with my #MON.
Of course, I also train them.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoSee.et:
Ma tantsin alati oma #MONidega.
Muidugi ka treenin neid.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoBea.label: KimonoGirlSayoBeatenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoBea.en: Oh, so close! I almost had you.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoBea.et: Oh, nii napilt! Peaaegu sain su kätte.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoAft.label: KimonoGirlSayoAfterBattleText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoAft.en:
Rhythm is important for both
dancing and #MON.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlSayoAft.et: Rütm on tähtis nii tantsus kui #MONides.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiSee.label: KimonoGirlZukiSeenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiSee.en:
Isn't my barrette pretty?
Oh. A #MON battle?
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiSee.et:
Kas mu juukseklamber pole ilus?
Oh. #MON-lahing?

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiAft.label: KimonoGirlZukiAfterBattleText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiAft.en: I put a different flower in my barrette every month.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlZukiAft.et: Panen igal kuul juukseklambrisse eri lille.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniSee.label: KimonoGirlKuniSeenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniSee.en: Oh, you're a cute trainer. Would you like to battle?
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniSee.et: Oh, sa oled armas treener. Kas tahad võidelda?

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniAft.label: KimonoGirlKuniAfterBattleText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniAft.en:
I trained a lot, so I thought I was
a capable trainer. I guess I'm not.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlKuniAft.et: Treenisin palju ja arvasin end tubli treener olevat. Vist ei ole.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiSee.label: KimonoGirlMikiSeenText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiSee.en: Do you like my dancing? I'm good at #MON too.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiSee.et: Kas mu tants meeldib? Ka #MONides olen hea.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiAft.label: KimonoGirlMikiAfterBattleText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiAft.en:
I can keep dancing because there are
people who enjoy what I do.
My #MON keep my spirits up too.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::KimonoGirlMikiAft.et:
Saan edasi tantsida, sest on inimesi, kellele mu tegemine meeldib.
Mu #MONid hoiavad ka mu tuju üleval.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyNeverLeftA.label: SurfGuyNeverLeftAScratchText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyNeverLeftA.en:
Not only are the KIMONO GIRLS great
dancers, they're also skilled at #MON.
I always challenge them, but I've
never even left a scratch…
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyNeverLeftA.et:
KIMONOTÜDRUKUD pole mitte ainult suurepärased tantsijad, vaid ka osavad #MONides.
Kutsun neid alati välja, aga pole isegi kriimu jätnud…

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLadGiftTex.label: SurfGuyLadGiftText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLadGiftTex.en:
Lad! If you can defeat all the
KIMONO GIRLS, I'll give you a gift.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLadGiftTex.et: Poiss! Kui suudad kõik KIMONOTÜDRUKUD alistada, annan sulle kingi.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLassieGift.label: SurfGuyLassieGiftText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLassieGift.en:
Lassie, if you can defeat all the
KIMONO GIRLS, I'll give you a gift.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLassieGift.et: Tüdruk, kui suudad kõik KIMONOTÜDRUKUD alistada, annan sulle kingi.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLikeADance.label: SurfGuyLikeADanceText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLikeADance.en:
The way you battled, it was like watching a dance.
It was a rare treat to see!
I want you to have this. Don't worry --take it!
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyLikeADance.et:
See, kuidas sa võitlesid, oli nagu tantsu vaadata.
Haruldane vaatepilt!
Tahan sulle selle anda. Ära muretse — võta!

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuySurfExplan.label: SurfGuySurfExplanationText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuySurfExplan.en:
That's SURF.
It's a move that lets #MON swim across water.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuySurfExplan.et:
See on SURF.
See rünnak laseb #MONil üle vee ujuda.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyElegantKim.label: SurfGuyElegantKimonoGirlsText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyElegantKim.en: I wish my #MON were as elegant as the KIMONO GIRLS…
maps/DanceTheater.asm::SurfGuyElegantKim.et: Soovin, et mu #MONid oleksid nii graatsilised kui KIMONOTÜDRUKUD…

maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterCoolt.label: DanceTheaterCooltrainerMText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterCoolt.en:
That man's always with his RHYDON.
Says he wants a #MON that can SURF and dance.
Is he trying to make a synchronized swimming #MON?
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterCoolt.et:
See mees on alati oma RHYDONiga.
Ütleb, et tahab #MONi, kes oskab SURF-i ja tantsida.
Kas ta üritab teha sünkroonujumise #MONi?

maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterGrann.label: DanceTheaterGrannyText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterGrann.en:
The KIMONO GIRLS are so beautiful…
But they have to go through rigorous training.
And they have to learn to follow
customs before appearing in public.
But if you love something, anything is possible.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterGrann.et:
KIMONOTÜDRUKUD on nii kaunid…
Aga nad peavad läbima range väljaõppe.
Ja enne avalikkuse ette astumist peavad nad õppima kombeid.
Aga kui midagi armastad, on kõik võimalik.

maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterFancy.label: DanceTheaterFancyPanelText
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterFancy.en: It's a fancy panel that's decorated with flowers.
maps/DanceTheater.asm::DanceTheaterFancy.et: See on uhke, lilledega kaunistatud paneel.

maps/DarkCaveBlackthornEntrance.asm::Dar.label: DarkCaveBlackthornEntrancePharmacistText1
maps/DarkCaveBlackthornEntrance.asm::Dar.en:
Whoa! You startled me there!
I had my BLACKGLASSES on, so I
didn't notice you at all.
What am I doing here?
Hey, don't you worry about it.
I'll give you a pair of BLACKGLASSES, so forget you saw me, OK?
maps/DarkCaveBlackthornEntrance.asm::Dar.et:
Oih! Sa ehmatasid mind!
Mul olid BLACKGLASSES ees, seega ma
ei märganud sind üldse.
Mida ma siin teen?
Hei, ära muretse selle pärast.
Annan sulle paari BLACKGLASSES, seega unusta, et mind nägid, OK?

maps/DarkCaveBlackthornEntrance.asm::Dar.label: DarkCaveBlackthornEntrancePharmacistText2
maps/DarkCaveBlackthornEntrance.asm::Dar.en: BLACKGLASSES ups the power of darktype moves.

maps/DayCare.asm::Text_GrampsLookingForY.label: Text_GrampsLookingForYou
maps/DayCare.asm::Text_GrampsLookingForY.en:
Gramps was looking for you.
I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.
There's something new in GOLDENROD
called the TRADE CORNER.
I was given an EGG TICKET that can be
traded in for a ODD EGG.
But since we run a DAY-CARE, we don't
need it. You may as well have it.
maps/DayCare.asm::Text_GrampsLookingForY.et:
Taat otsis sind.
Mina olen PÄEVAHOIU MEES.
GOLDENRODIS on midagi uut
nimega VAHETUSNURK.
Mulle anti EGG TICKET, mille saab
vahetada ODD EGG vastu.
Aga kuna peame PÄEVAHOIDU, pole
meil seda vaja. Võta sina.

maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareManText_GiveOdd.label: DayCareManText_GiveOddEgg
maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareManText_GiveOdd.en:
I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.
Do you know about EGGS?
I was raising #MON with my wife, you see.
We were shocked to find an EGG!
How incredible is that?
Well, wouldn't you like this EGG?
Then fine, this is yours to keep!
Come again.
maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareManText_GiveOdd.et:
Mina olen PÄEVAHOIU MEES.
Kas tead EGGidest?
Kasvatasin naisega #MONe, näed.
Ehmatasime, kui leidsime EGG!
Kas pole uskumatu?
No kas sa ei tahaks seda EGG?
Olgu siis, see jäägu sulle!
Tule jälle.

maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareText_DescribeOd.label: DayCareText_DescribeOddEgg
maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareText_DescribeOd.en:
I found that when I was caring for
someone's #MON before.
But the trainer didn't want the
EGG, so I'd kept it around.
maps/DayCare.asm::DayCareText_DescribeOd.et:
Leidsin selle, kui hoidsin kellegi
#MONi.
Aga treener ei tahtnud
EGG, nii et hoidsin seda alles.

maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText1
maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.en:
There's something written here.
Read it?

maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText2
maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.en:
To my brothers and sisters:
We take pride in serving #MON trainers.
When trainers talk to you, give them something useful.
Love, MONICA
Keep reading?
maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.et:
Mu vendadele ja õdedele:
Oleme uhked, et teenindame #MON-treenereid.
Kui treenerid sinuga räägivad, anna neile midagi kasulikku.
Armastusega, MONICA
Lugeda edasi?

maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText3
maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.en:
Monday, MONICA ROUTE 40
Tuesday, TUSCANY ROUTE 29
Wednesday, WESLEY LAKE OF RAGE
Thursday, ARTHUR ROUTE 36
Friday, FRIEDA ROUTE 32
Saturday, SANTOS BLACKTHORN CITY
Sunday, SUNNY ROUTE 37
maps/DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse.asm::DayOfWe.et:
Esmaspäev, MONICA ROUTE 40
Teisipäev, TUSCANY ROUTE 29
Kolmapäev, WESLEY LAKE OF RAGE
Neljapäev, ARTHUR ROUTE 36
Reede, FRIEDA ROUTE 32
Laupäev, SANTOS BLACKTHORN CITY
Pühapäev, SUNNY ROUTE 37

maps/DiglettsCave.asm::DiglettsCavePokef.label: DiglettsCavePokefanMText
maps/DiglettsCave.asm::DiglettsCavePokef.en:
A bunch of DIGLETT popped out of the
ground! That was shocking.
maps/DiglettsCave.asm::DiglettsCavePokef.et:
Hulk DIGLETTe hüppas maa
seest välja! See oli šokeeriv.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.label: DragonShrineElderGreetingText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.en:
Hm… Good to see you here.
No need to explain why you came.
CLAIR sent you here, didn't she?
That girl is a handful…
I am sorry, but I must test you.
Not to worry, you are to answer only a few questions.
Ready?
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.et:
Hm… Tore sind siin näha.
Pole vaja selgitada, miks tulid.
CLAIR saatis su siia, eks?
See tüdruk on tükk tegemist…
Mul on kahju, aga pean sind proovile panema.
Ära muretse, pead vastama vaid mõnele küsimusele.
Valmis?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.label: DragonShrineQuestion2Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.en: What helps you to win battles?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.label: DragonShrineQuestion3Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.en: What kind of trainer do you wish to battle?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.label: DragonShrineQuestion4Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.en: What is most important for raising #MON?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.label: DragonShrineQuestion5Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineQuest.en:
Strong #MON. Weak #MON.
Which is more important?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrinePasse.label: DragonShrinePassedTestText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrinePasse.en:
Hm… I see…
You care deeply for #MON.
Very commendable.
That conviction is what is important!
<PLAYER>, don't lose that belief.
It will see you through at the #MON LEAGUE.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrinePasse.et:
Hm… Ma näen…
Sa hoolid #MONidest sügavalt.
Väga kiiduväärt.
See veendumus ongi see, mis on tähtis!
<PLAYER>, ära kaota seda usku.
See aitab sind #MON LIIGAS läbi.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineMustI.label: DragonShrineMustIInformLanceText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineMustI.en:
CLAIR!
This child is impeccable, in skill and spirit!
Admit defeat and confer the RISINGBADGE!
…Or must I inform LANCE of this?
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineMustI.et:
CLAIR!
See laps on laitmatu, nii oskuses kui vaimus!
Tunnista kaotust ja anna RISINGBADGE!
…Või pean sellest LANCE'ile teatama?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.label: DragonShrineElderScoldsClairText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.en:
CLAIR…
Reflect upon what it is that you
lack and this child has.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.et:
CLAIR…
Mõtiskle selle üle, mis sul
puudub ja mis sel lapsel on.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineComeA.label: DragonShrineComeAgainText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineComeA.en: Come again, if you so desire.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineTakeT.label: DragonShrineTakeThisDratiniText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineTakeT.en:
Hm… Good to see you here.
Your arrival is most fortunate.
I have something for you.
Take this DRATINI as proof that I
have recognized your worth.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineTakeT.et:
Hm… Tore sind siin näha.
Su saabumine on väga õnnelik.
Mul on sulle midagi.
Võta see DRATINI tõestuseks, et
olen su väärtust tunnustanud.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineSymbo.label: DragonShrineSymbolicDragonText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineSymbo.en:
Dragon #MON are symbolic of our clan.
You have shown that you can be
entrusted with one.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineSymbo.et:
Draakon-#MONid on meie klanni sümbol.
Oled näidanud, et sulle võib
ühe usaldada.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.label: DragonShrineClairsGrandfatherText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.en:
CLAIR appears to have learned an
invaluable lesson from you.
I thank you as her grandfather.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.et:
CLAIR näib olevat sinult
õppinud hindamatu õppetunni.
Tänan sind kui tema vanaisa.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRival.label: DragonShrineRivalIsInTrainingText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRival.en:
A boy close to your age is in training here.
He is much like CLAIR when she was
younger. It is a little worrisome…
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRival.et:
Siin treenib sinuvanune poiss.
Ta on väga sarnane noorele
CLAIRile. See on pisut murettekitav…

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineWrong.label: DragonShrineWrongAnswerText1
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineWrong.en: Hah? I didn't quite catch that…
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineWrong.et: Häh? Ma ei saanud päris hästi aru…

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.label: DragonShrineElder2Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.en:
It's been quite some time since a
trainer has gained our MASTER's rare approval.
In fact, not since Master LANCE.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.et:
Ammu pole treener saanud meie
MEISTRI haruldast heakskiitu.
Tegelikult mitte alates Meister LANCE'ist.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.label: DragonShrineElder3Text
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.en:
You know young Master LANCE?
He looks so much like our MASTER did in his youth.
It's in their blood.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineElder.et:
Sa tunned noort Meister LANCE'i?
Ta näeb välja täpselt nagu meie MEISTER nooruses.
See on nende veres.

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.label: DragonShrineClairYouPassedText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.en:
So how did it go?
I guess there's no point in asking.
You did fail?
<……><……><……><……><……><……>
…What? You passed?
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.et:
Niisiis, kuidas läks?
Vist pole mõtet küsida.
Sa kukkusid läbi?
<……><……><……><……><……><……>
…Mida? Sa läbisid?

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.label: DragonShrineClairYoureLyingText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.en:
You're lying!
Even I haven't been approved!
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineClair.et:
Sa valetad!
Isegi mind pole heaks kiidetud!

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineHereR.label: DragonShrineHereRisingBadgeText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineHereR.en:
Here, this is the RISINGBADGE…
Hurry up! Take it!
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineHereR.et:
Siin, see on RISINGBADGE…
Kiirusta! Võta see!

maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRisin.label: DragonShrineRisingBadgeExplanationText
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRisin.en:
RISINGBADGE will enable your
#MON to use the move for climbing waterfalls.
Also, all #MON will recognize you
as a trainer and obey your every
command without question.
maps/DragonShrine.asm::DragonShrineRisin.et:
RISINGBADGE võimaldab su
#MONil kasutada kosest ronimise rünnakut.
Samuti tunnistavad kõik #MONid sind
treeneriks ja täidavad iga su
käsku küsimusteta.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_GiveDr.label: ClairText_GiveDragonbreathDragonDen
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_GiveDr.en:
CLAIR: I'm sorry about this.
Here, take this as my apology.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_GiveDr.et:
CLAIR: Mul on selle pärast kahju.
Siin, võta see mu vabanduseks.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_Descri.label: ClairText_DescribeDragonbreathDragonDen
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_Descri.en:
That contains DRAGONBREATH.
No, it doesn't have anything to do with my breath.
If you don't want it, you don't have to take it.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_Descri.et:
See sisaldab DRAGONBREATHi.
Ei, sel pole minu hingeõhuga midagi pistmist.
Kui sa seda ei taha, ei pea sa seda võtma.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_NoRoom.label: ClairText_NoRoom
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_NoRoom.en:
Oh? You don't have any room for this.
I'm going back to the GYM, so make
room, then come see me there.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_NoRoom.et:
Oh? Sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.
Lähen tagasi SAALI, seega tee
ruumi ja tule siis mind sinna vaatama.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_WhatsT.label: ClairText_WhatsTheMatterDragonDen
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_WhatsT.en:
CLAIR: What's the matter? Aren't you
going on to the #MON LEAGUE?
Do you know how to get there?
From here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.
Then SURF east to #MON LEAGUE.
The route there is very tough.
Don't you dare lose at the #MON LEAGUE!
If you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!
Give it everything you've got.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::ClairText_WhatsT.et:
CLAIR: Mis lahti? Kas sa ei
lähe edasi #MON LIIGASSE?
Kas tead, kuidas sinna saada?
Siit mine NEW BARK TOWNI.
Seejärel SURFA itta #MON LIIGASSE.
See tee on väga raske.
Sa ei tohi #MON LIIGAS kaotada!
Kui kaotad, tunnen end veelgi halvemini,
et sulle kaotasin!
Anna endast kõik.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::DragonShrineSign.label: DragonShrineSignpostText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::DragonShrineSign.en:
DRAGON SHRINE
A shrine honoring the dragon #MON
said to have lived in DRAGON'S DEN.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::DragonShrineSign.et:
DRAGON SHRINE
Pühamu draakon-#MONide auks,
kes olevat elanud DRAGON'S DENIS.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.label: RivalText_Training1
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.en:
… What? <PLAYER>?
…No, I won't battle you now…
My #MON aren't ready to beat you.
I can't push them too hard now.
I have to be disciplined to become
the greatest #MON trainer…
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.et:
… Mida? <PLAYER>?
…Ei, ma ei võitle sinuga praegu…
Mu #MONid pole valmis sind alistama.
Ma ei saa neid praegu liialt suruda.
Pean olema distsiplineeritud, et saada
suurimaks #MON-treeneriks…

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.label: RivalText_Training2
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.en:
…
Whew…
Learn to stay out of my way…
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::RivalText_Traini.et:
…
Uhh…
Õpi mu teelt eemale hoidma…

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.label: CooltrainermDarinSeenText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.en: You! How dare you enter uninvited!
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.et: Sina! Kuidas sa julged kutsumata siseneda!

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.label: CooltrainermDarinAfterBattleText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.en:
The SHRINE ahead is home to the
MASTER of our dragon-user clan.
You're not allowed to just go in!
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainermDari.et:
Eespool olev PÜHAMU on kodu meie
draakonikasutajate klanni MEISTRILE.
Sul pole lubatud lihtsalt sisse minna!

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainerfCara.label: CooltrainerfCaraAfterBattleText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainerfCara.en:
Soon I'm going to get permission
from our MASTER to use dragons.
When I do, I'm going to become an
admirable dragon trainer and gain
our MASTER's approval.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::CooltrainerfCara.et:
Peagi saan oma MEISTRILT loa
draakoneid kasutada.
Kui saan, saab minust imetlusväärne
draakonitreener ja pälvin
oma MEISTRI heakskiidu.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia1S.label: TwinsLeaandpia1SeenText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia1S.en: It's a stranger we don't know.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia1S.et: See on võõras, keda me ei tunne.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia1A.label: TwinsLeaandpia1AfterBattleText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia1A.en: It was like having to battle LANCE.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia2A.label: TwinsLeaandpia2AfterBattleText
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia2A.en:
We'll tell on you.
MASTER will be angry with you.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::TwinsLeaandpia2A.et:
Me kaebame su peale.
MEISTER saab sinu peale vihaseks.

maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::Text_NoRoomForDr.label: Text_NoRoomForDragonFang
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::Text_NoRoomForDr.en: But <PLAYER> can't carry any more items.
maps/DragonsDenB1F.asm::Text_NoRoomForDr.et: Aga <PLAYER> ei saa rohkem esemeid kaasas kanda.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.label: AcademyEarlIntroText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.en:
EARL, I am!
Wonderful are #MON, yes!
Teach you I will to be a better trainer!
What you want to know? Want to be a winner is you?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.et:
EARL, olen mina!
Imelised on #MONid, jah!
Õpetan sind ma paremaks treeneriks!
Mida teada tahad? Võitja olla tahad sina?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.label: AcademyEarlTeachHowToWinText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.en:
Good! Teach you, I will!
In battle, #MON top on list jump out first!
Change order in list, make battle easy, maybe!
More from me you want to hear?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.et:
Hea! Õpetan sind, teen ma!
Lahingus #MON nimekirja tipus hüppab esimesena välja!
Muuda järjekord, tee lahing kergeks, ehk!
Rohkem minult kuulda tahad?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.label: AcademyEarlTeachMoreText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.en: So, want to know how to raise #MON well?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.et: Nii, teada tahad, kuidas #MONe hästi kasvatada?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.label: AcademyEarlTeachHowToRaiseWellText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.en:
Fine! Teach you, I will!
If #MON come out in battle even
briefly, some EXP. Points it gets.
At top of list put weak #MON.
Switch in battle quick!
This way, weak #MON strong become!
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.et:
Hea! Õpetan sind, teen ma!
Kui #MON lahingusse tuleb kasvõi
korraks, saab ta veidi EXP-punkte.
Nimekirja tippu pane nõrk #MON.
Vaheta lahingus kiiresti!
Nii nõrk #MON tugevaks saab!

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.label: AcademyEarlNoMoreToTeachText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.en:
Oh! Smart student you are! Nothing more do I teach!
Good to #MON you must be!
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyEar.et:
Oh! Tark õpilane sa oled! Rohkem ei õpeta ma!
Hea #MONidele olema pead sa!

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster1Text
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.en:
I'm taking notes of the teacher's lecture.
I'd better copy the stuff on the blackboard too.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.et:
Teen õpetaja loengust märkmeid.
Kopeerin parem ka tahvlil oleva.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid1Text
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.en: I traded my best #MON to the guy beside me.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid2Text
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.en: Huh? The #MON I just got is holding something!
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.et: Häh? #MON, kelle just sain, hoiab midagi!

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster2Text
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.en:
A #MON holding a BERRY will heal itself in battle.
Many other items can be held by #MON…
It sure is tough taking notes…
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::EarlsPokem.et:
BERRYt hoidev #MON ravib end lahingus.
Palju muid esemeid saab #MON hoida…
Märkmete tegemine on ikka raske…

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBla.label: AcademyBlackboardText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBla.en:
The blackboard describes #MON
status changes in battle.
Read which topic?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBla.et:
Tahvel kirjeldab #MONide
seisundimuutusi lahingus.
Millist teemat lugeda?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPoi.label: AcademyPoisonText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPoi.en:
If poisoned, a #MON steadily loses HP.
Poison lingers after the battle,
and HP is lost as you walk.
To cure it, use an ANTIDOTE.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPoi.et:
Mürgitatuna kaotab #MON pidevalt HP-d.
