Mürk püsib pärast lahingut
ja HP-d kaob käies.
Ravimiseks kasuta ANTIDOTE.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPar.label: AcademyParalysisText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPar.en:
Paralysis reduces speed and may prevent movement.
It remains after battle, so use a PARLYZ HEAL.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyPar.et:
Halvatus vähendab kiirust ja võib takistada liikumist.
See püsib pärast lahingut, seega kasuta PARLYZ HEAL.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySle.label: AcademySleepText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySle.en:
If asleep, your #MON can't make a move.
A sleeping #MON doesn't wake up after battle.
Wake it up with an AWAKENING.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySle.et:
Magades ei saa su #MON rünnata.
Magav #MON ei ärka pärast lahingut.
Ärata see AWAKENINGiga.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBur.label: AcademyBurnText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBur.en:
A burn steadily consumes HP.
It also reduces attack power.
A burn lingers after battle.
Use a BURN HEAL as the cure.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyBur.et:
Põletus kulutab pidevalt HP-d.
See vähendab ka ründejõudu.
Põletus püsib pärast lahingut.
Raviks kasuta BURN HEAL.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyFre.label: AcademyFreezeText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyFre.en:
If your #MON is frozen, it can't do a thing.
It remains frozen after battle.
Thaw it out with an ICE HEAL.
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyFre.et:
Kui su #MON on külmunud, ei saa ta midagi teha.
See jääb pärast lahingut külmunuks.
Sula see üles ICE HEALiga.

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.label: AcademyNotebookText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.en:
It's this kid's notebook…
Catch #MON using # BALLS.
Up to six can be in your party.
Keep reading?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.et:
See on selle lapse märkmik…
Püüa #MONe # BALLIDEGA.
Seltskonnas võib olla kuni kuus.
Lugeda edasi?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.label: AcademyNotebookText1
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.en:
Before throwing a # BALL, weaken the target first.
A poisoned or burned #MON is easier to catch.
Keep reading?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.et:
Enne # BALLI viskamist nõrgesta esmalt sihtmärki.
Mürgitatud või põlenud #MONi on kergem püüda.
Lugeda edasi?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.label: AcademyNotebookText2
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.en:
Some moves may cause confusion.
Confusion may make a #MON attack itself.
Leaving battle clears up any confusion.
Keep reading?
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.et:
Mõned rünnakud võivad segadust tekitada.
Segaduses võib #MON iseennast rünnata.
Lahingust lahkumine kaotab segaduse.
Lugeda edasi?

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.label: AcademyNotebookText3
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.en:
People who catch and use #MON
in battle are #MON trainers.
They are expected to visit #MON
GYMS and defeat other trainers.
The next page is… Blank!
Boy: E-he-he…
I haven't written anymore…
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademyNot.et:
Inimesed, kes püüavad ja kasutavad #MONe
lahingus, on #MON-treenerid.
Neilt oodatakse #MON
SAALIDE külastamist ja teiste treenerite alistamist.
Järgmine lehekülg on… Tühi!
Poiss: E-he-he…
Ma pole rohkem kirjutanud…

maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySti.label: AcademyStickerMachineText
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySti.en:
This super machine prints data out as
stickers!
maps/EarlsPokemonAcademy.asm::AcademySti.et:
See supermasin prindib andmed välja
kleepsudena!

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityHidde.label: EcruteakCityHiddenHyperPotion
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityHidde.en:
Oh, no. Oh, no…
My daughter is missing.
No… She couldn't have gone to the BURNED TOWER.
I told her not to go near it…
People seem to disappear there…
Oh, what should I do…?
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityHidde.et:
Oh ei. Oh ei…
Mu tütar on kadunud.
Ei… ta ei saanud BURNED TOWERISSE minna.
Ma keelasin tal sinna minna…
Sinna tunduvad inimesed kaduvat…
Oh, mida ma peaksin tegema…?

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.label: EcruteakCityGramps1Text
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.en:
ECRUTEAK used to have two towers:
one each in the east and west.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.et:
ECRUTEAKIS oli kunagi kaks torni:
üks idas, teine läänes.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.label: EcruteakCityGramps2Text
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.en:
Ah, child. Have you learned
to dance like the KIMONO GIRLS?
If you go to their DANCE THEATER, an
odd old man will give you something nice, I hear.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.et:
Ah, laps. Kas oled õppinud
tantsima nagu KIMONOTÜDRUKUD?
Kui lähed nende TANTSUTEATRISSE,
annab üks veider vanamees midagi toredat.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass1.label: EcruteakCityLass1Text
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass1.en:
I'm going to practice at the DANCE
THEATER. Care to join me?
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass1.et:
Lähen TANTSUTEATRISSE harjutama.
Kas tuled kaasa?

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.label: EcruteakCityLass2Text
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.en:
The tower that used to be here…
My grandma told me it used to be much taller.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.et:
Torn, mis kunagi siin oli…
Vanaema järgi oli see palju kõrgem.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.label: EcruteakCityLass2Text_ReleasedBeasts
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.en: Three big #MON ran off in different directions. What were they?
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityLass2.et: Kolm suurt #MONi jooksid eri suundades laiali. Kes need olid?

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.label: EcruteakCityFisherText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.en:
I heard a rumor about OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE.
The #MON that serves as the
beacon fell ill. Sounds like they are in trouble.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.et:
Kuulsin kuuldust OLIVINE TULETORNIST.
Majakana toimiv #MON
jäi haigeks. Neil on vist häda käes.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.label: EcruteakCityFisherText_JasmineReturned
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.en:
The #MON at OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE has been cured.
Boats can safely sail out to sea at night again.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityFishe.et:
OLIVINE TULETORNI #MON on terveks ravitud.
Paadid saavad öösel taas ohutult merele.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityYoung.label: EcruteakCityYoungsterText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityYoung.en:
I hear #MON are rampaging at the
LAKE OF RAGE. I'd like to see that.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityYoung.et:
Kuuldavasti märatsevad #MONid
RAEVUJÄRVEL. Tahaks seda näha.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.label: EcruteakCityGramps3Text
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.en:
In the distant past…
This tower burned in a fire. Three
nameless #MON perished in it.
A rainbow-colored #MON descended
from the sky and resurrected them…
It's a legend that has been passed
down by ECRUTEAK GYM LEADERS.
Me?
I was a trainer way back when. Hohoho!
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCityGramp.et:
Ammusel ajal…
See torn põles maha. Kolm
nimetut #MONi hukkus selles.
Vikerkaarevärvi #MON laskus
taevast ja äratas nad ellu…
Seda legendi on edasi andnud
ECRUTEAKI SAALIJUHID.
Mina?
Olin kunagi ammu treener. Hohoo!

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCitySignT.label: EcruteakCitySignText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCitySignT.en:
ECRUTEAK CITY A Historical City
Where the Past Meets the Present
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakCitySignT.et:
ECRUTEAK CITY — ajalooline linn,
kus minevik kohtub olevikuga

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::TinTowerSignText.label: TinTowerSignText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::TinTowerSignText.en:
TIN TOWER
A legendary #MON is said to roost here.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::TinTowerSignText.et:
TIN TOWER
Räägitakse, et siin pesitseb legendaarne #MON.

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakGymSignTe.label: EcruteakGymSignText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakGymSignTe.en:
ECRUTEAK CITY #MON GYM LEADER: MORTY
The Mystic Seer of the Future
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::EcruteakGymSignTe.et:
ECRUTEAK CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: MORTY
Tuleviku müstiline selgeltnägija

maps/EcruteakCity.asm::BurnedTowerSignTe.label: BurnedTowerSignText
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::BurnedTowerSignTe.en:
BURNED TOWER
It was destroyed by a mysterious fire.
Please stay away, as it is unsafe.
maps/EcruteakCity.asm::BurnedTowerSignTe.et:
BURNED TOWER
Selle hävitas salapärane tuli.
Palun hoia eemale, siin on ohtlik.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyIntroText.label: MortyIntroText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyIntroText.en:
Good of you to have come.
Here in ECRUTEAK, #MON have been revered.
It's said that a rainbow-colored
#MON will come down to appear
before a truly powerful trainer.
I believed that tale, so I have
secretly trained here all my life.
As a result, I can now see what others cannot.
Just a bit more…
With a little more, I could see
a future in which I meet the #MON of rainbow colors.
You're going to help me reach that level!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyIntroText.et:
Hea, et tulid.
Siin ECRUTEAKIS on #MONe alati austatud.
Räägitakse, et vikerkaarevärvi #MON laskub alla tõeliselt võimeka treeneri ette.
Uskusin seda lugu ja olen kogu elu siin salaja treeninud.
Nüüd näen seda, mida teised ei näe.
Veel pisut…
Veel veidi ja näeksin tulevikku, kus kohtan vikerkaarevärvi #MONi.
Sina aitad mul selle tasemeni jõuda!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyWinLossText.label: MortyWinLossText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyWinLossText.en:
I'm not good enough yet…
All right. This BADGE is yours.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyWinLossText.et:
Ma pole veel piisavalt hea…
Olgu. See MÄRK on sinu.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_FogBadge.label: MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_FogBadge.en:
By having FOGBADGE, #MON up
to L50 will obey you.
Also, #MON that know SURF will be
able to use that move anytime.
I want you to have this too.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_FogBadge.et:
FOGBADGE'ga kuuletuvad sulle #MONid kuni L50.
Samuti saavad SURF-i oskavad #MONid seda alati kasutada.
Tahan sulle ka selle anda.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_ShadowBa.label: MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_ShadowBa.en:
It's SHADOW BALL. It causes damage
and may reduce SPCL.DEF.
Use it if it appeals to you.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyText_ShadowBa.et:
See on SHADOW BALL. See tekitab kahju ja võib vähendada SPCL.DEF.
Kasuta, kui see sulle meeldib.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyFightDoneText.label: MortyFightDoneText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyFightDoneText.en:
I see…
Your journey has taken you to faraway places.
And you have witnessed much more than I.
I envy you for that…
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MortyFightDoneText.et:
Näen…
Su teekond on viinud sind kaugetesse paikadesse.
Sa oled näinud palju rohkem kui mina.
Kadestan sind selle pärast…

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SageJeffreySeenTex.label: SageJeffreySeenText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SageJeffreySeenTex.en:
I spent the spring with my #MON.
Then summer, fall and winter…
Then spring came again. We have
lived together for a long time.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SageJeffreySeenTex.et:
Veetsin kevade oma #MONiga.
Siis suvi, sügis ja talv…
Siis tuli taas kevad. Oleme kaua koos elanud.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SageJeffreyBeatenT.label: SageJeffreyBeatenText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SageJeffreyBeatenT.en: Wins and losses, I experienced both.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingSeenText.label: SagePingSeenText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingSeenText.en: Can you inflict any damage on our #MON?
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingSeenText.et: Kas suudad meie #MONidele üldse kahju teha?

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingAfterBattl.label: SagePingAfterBattleText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingAfterBattl.en:
We use only ghosttype #MON.
No normal-type attack can harm them!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::SagePingAfterBattl.et:
Kasutame ainult tont-tüüpi #MONe.
Ükski tava-tüüpi rünnak neile ei mõju!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumMarthaAfterB.label: MediumMarthaAfterBattleText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumMarthaAfterB.en: The one who wants to win most--will!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumMarthaAfterB.et: Võidab see, kes kõige rohkem võita tahab!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceSeenTex.label: MediumGraceSeenText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceSeenTex.en:
Stumped by our invisible floor?
Defeat me if you want a hint!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceSeenTex.et:
Kas nähtamatu põrand ajas sind segadusse?
Võida mind, kui tahad vihjet!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceAfterBa.label: MediumGraceAfterBattleText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceAfterBa.en:
Fine. I shall tell you the secret of
the invisible floor.
The path is right before our eyes!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::MediumGraceAfterBa.et:
Olgu. Räägin sulle nähtamatu põranda saladuse.
Tee on otse meie silme ees!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideTe.label: EcruteakGymGuideText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideTe.en:
The trainers here have secret motives.
If you win, they may tell you some
deep secrets about ECRUTEAK.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideTe.et:
Siinsetel treeneritel on salajased kavatsused.
Kui võidad, ehk räägivad nad ECRUTEAKI sügavaid saladusi.

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideWi.label: EcruteakGymGuideWinText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideWi.en:
Whew, <PLAYER>. You did great!
I was cowering in the corner out of pure terror!
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymGuideWi.et:
Ohoo, <PLAYER>. Tegid suurepärast tööd!
Mina kössitasin nurgas puhtast hirmust!

maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymClosedT.label: EcruteakGymClosedText
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymClosedT.en:
MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is absent.
Sorry, but you'll have to leave.
Hohohoho.
maps/EcruteakGym.asm::EcruteakGymClosedT.et:
SAALI JUHT MORTY on ära.
Vabandust, aga pead lahkuma.
Hohohoo.

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakItemfinderAdventureText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en:
Ah. You're on an adventure with your #MON?
Well, what's an adventure without treasure hunting?
Am I right, or am I right?
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.et:
Ah. Oled oma #MONiga seiklusel?
Mis on seiklus ilma aardejahita?
Kas pole nii?

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakItemfinderTrueSpiritText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en:
Good! You understand the true
spirit of adventure.
I like that! Take this with you.
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.et:
Hästi! Sa mõistad seikluse tõelist vaimu.
Meeldib! Võta see kaasa.

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Itemfi.label: ItemfinderExplanationText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Itemfi.en:
There are many items lying about
that aren't obvious.
Use ITEMFINDER to check if there is
an item on the ground near you.
It doesn't show the exact spot,
so you'll have to look yourself.
Oh yeah--I heard there are items
in ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER.
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Itemfi.et:
Ringi vedeleb palju esemeid, mis pole silmaga nähtavad.
Kasuta ITEMFINDERit, et kontrollida, kas su lähedal maas on ese.
Täpset kohta see ei näita, nii et pead ise otsima.
Ahjaa — kuulsin, et ECRUTEAKI BURNED TOWERIS on esemeid.

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakItemfinderToEachHisOwnText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en: Oh… To each his own, I suppose…

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakHistoryBookText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en:
HISTORY OF ECRUTEAK
Want to read it?

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakTwoTowersText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en:
In ECRUTEAK, there were two towers.
Each tower was the roost of powerful flying #MON.
But one of the towers burned to the ground.
The two #MON haven't been seen since…
Keep reading?
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.et:
ECRUTEAKIS oli kaks torni.
Mõlemad tornid olid võimsate lendavate #MONide pesapaik.
Aga üks torn põles maani maha.
Kahte #MONi pole sellest ajast nähtud…
Kas loed edasi?

maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.label: EcruteakThreeMonText
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.en:
ECRUTEAK was also home to three
#MON that raced around the town.
They were said to have been born of
water, lightning and fire.
But they could not contain their excessive power.
So they say the three ran like the
wind off into the grassland.
maps/EcruteakItemfinderHouse.asm::Ecrute.et:
ECRUTEAKIS elas ka kolm #MONi, kes linnas ringi kihutasid.
Nad olevat sündinud veest, välgust ja tulest.
Aga nad ei suutnud oma ülemäärast väge ohjata.
Nii jooksid nad kolmekesi kui tuul rohtlasse.

maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseGrampsText
maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.en:
This happened when I was young.
The sky suddenly turned black. A
giant flying #MON was blocking out the sun.
I wonder what that #MON was?
It was like a bird and a dragon.
maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.et:
See juhtus, kui olin noor.
Taevas muutus äkki mustaks. Hiiglaslik
lendav #MON varjas päikest.
Huvitav, mis #MON see oli?
See oli nagu lind ja draakon.

maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseYoungsterText
maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.en:
Is there really a #MON that big?
If it exists, it must be powerful.
maps/EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse.asm::Ecrut.et:
Kas tõesti on nii suur #MON?
Kui see on olemas, peab see olema võimas.

maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartSuper.label: EcruteakMartSuperNerdText
maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartSuper.en:
My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON.
But my friend's EEVEE turned into an UMBREON.
I wonder why? We both were raising
our EEVEE in the same way…
maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartSuper.et:
Mu EEVEE arenes ESPEONiks.
Aga mu sõbra EEVEEST sai UMBREON.
Huvitav, miks? Me mõlemad kasvatasime
oma EEVEE samamoodi…

maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartGrann.label: EcruteakMartGrannyText
maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartGrann.en:
If you use REVIVE, a #MON that's
fainted will wake right up.
maps/EcruteakMart.asm::EcruteakMartGrann.et:
Kui kasutad REVIVE, ärkab
minestanud #MON kohe üles.

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText1
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
Hi, I'm BILL. And who are you?
Hmm, <PLAYER>, huh? You've come at the right time.
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et:
Tere, olen BILL. Ja kes sina oled?
Hmm, <PLAYER>? Tulid just õigel ajal.

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText2
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
I just finished adjustments on my TIME CAPSULE.
You know that #MON can be traded, right?
My TIME CAPSULE was developed to
enable trades with the past.
But you can't send anything that
didn't exist in the past.
If you did, the PC in the past would have a breakdown.
So you have to remove anything
that wasn't around in the past.
Put simply, no sending new moves
or new #MON in the TIME CAPSULE.
Don't you worry. I'm done with the adjustments.
Tomorrow, TIME CAPSULES will be
running at all #MON CENTERS.
I have to hurry on back to GOLDENROD and see my folks.
Buh-bye!
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et:
Lõpetasin just oma TIME CAPSULE seadistamise.
Tead ju, et #MONe saab vahetada?
Minu TIME CAPSULE loodi selleks, et vahetada minevikuga.
Aga saata ei saa midagi, mida minevikus polnud.
Muidu läheks mineviku PC rikki.
Nii et eemalda kõik, mida vanasti polnud.
Lühidalt: TIME CAPSULE'ga ei saa saata uusi rünnakuid ega uusi #MONe.
Ära muretse. Seadistamise sain valmis.
Homme hakkavad TIME CAPSULE'd tööle kõigis #MON KESKUSTES.
Pean kiirustama tagasi GOLDENRODI oma pere juurde.
Nägemist!

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMText
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
The way the KIMONO GIRLS dance is
marvelous. Just like the way they use their #MON.
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et: KIMONOTÜDRUKUTE tants on imeline. Just nagu see, kuidas nad oma #MONe kasutavad.

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMTextMobile
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
You must be hoping to battle more
people, right? There's apparently
some place where trainers gather.
Where, you ask?
It's a little past OLIVINE CITY.
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et:
Sa vist tahaksid rohkemate inimestega võidelda? On olemas koht, kuhu treenerid kogunevad.
Kus, sa küsid?
Veidi maad OLIVINE CITYst edasi.

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is soooo cool.
His #MON are really tough too.
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et:
SAALI JUHT MORTY on nii lahe.
Ta #MONid on ka väga kõvad.

maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FGymGuideText
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.en:
LAKE OF RAGE…
The appearance of a GYARADOS swarm…
I smell a conspiracy. I know it!
maps/EcruteakPokecenter1F.asm::EcruteakP.et:
RAEVUJÄRV…
GYARADOSTE sülem ilmus…
Haistan vandenõu. Ma tean seda!

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
TIN TOWER is off limits to anyone
without ECRUTEAK GYM's BADGE.
Sorry, but you'll have to leave.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
TIN TOWERISSE ei pääse keegi ilma ECRUTEAKI SAALI MÄRGITA.
Vabandust, aga pead lahkuma.

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_GotFogBadge
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
TIN TOWER is off limits to anyone
without ECRUTEAK GYM's BADGE.
Ah!
ECRUTEAK's GYM BADGE! Please, go right through.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
TIN TOWERISSE ei pääse keegi ilma ECRUTEAKI SAALI MÄRGITA.
Ah!
ECRUTEAKI SAALI MÄRK! Palun, astu sisse.

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_NoClearBell
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
A momentous event has occurred.
I beg your pardon, but I must ask you to leave.
…What soothes the soul…
The WISE TRIO say things that are so
very difficult to understand…
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
Aset on leidnud tähtis sündmus.
Vabandust, aga pean paluma sul lahkuda.
…Mis hinge rahustab…
TARK KOLMIK räägib asju, mida on väga raske mõista…

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HearsClearBell
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
A momentous event has occurred.
I beg your pardon, but I must ask you to leave.
<……><……><……>
Ah!
The sound of that CLEAR BELL!
It… It's sublime!
I've never heard so beautiful a sound before!
That bell's chime is indicative of the bearer's soul.
You…
You may be able to make it through TIN TOWER.
Please, do go on.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
Aset on leidnud tähtis sündmus.
Vabandust, aga pean paluma sul lahkuda.
<……><……><……>
Ah!
Tolle CLEAR BELLI heli!
See… see on ülev!
Pole kunagi kuulnud nii kaunist heli!
Selle kella kõla peegeldab kandja hinge.
Sina…
Sina võid TIN TOWERIST läbi pääseda.
Palun, mine edasi.

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HeardClearBell
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
That bell's chime is indicative of the bearer's soul.
You…
You may be able to make it through TIN TOWER.
Please, do go on.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
Selle kella kõla peegeldab kandja hinge.
Sina…
Sina võid TIN TOWERIST läbi pääseda.
Palun, mine edasi.

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceWanderingSageText
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
The TIN TOWER ahead is a nine-
tier tower of divine beauty.
It soothes the soul of all who see it.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
Ees olev TIN TOWER on jumaliku iluga üheksakorruseline torn.
See rahustab kõigi hinge, kes seda näevad.

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceWanderingSageText_GotClearBell
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
The TIN TOWER shook! A #MON
must have returned to the top!
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et: TIN TOWER värises! Üks #MON on vist tippu naasnud!

maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceGrampsText
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.en:
Two towers… Two #MON…
But when one burned down, both
#MON flew away, never to return.
maps/EcruteakTinTowerEntrance.asm::Ecrut.et:
Kaks torni… Kaks #MONi…
Aga kui üks maha põles, lendasid mõlemad #MONid minema ega naasnud iial.

maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsWifeText.label: ElmsWifeText
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsWifeText.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>! My husband's always
so busy--I hope he's OK.
When he's caught up in his #MON
research, he even forgets to eat.
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsWifeText.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>! Mu abikaasa on alati
nii hõivatud – loodan, et temaga on kõik hästi.
Kui ta süveneb oma #MONi
uuringutesse, unustab ta isegi süüa.

maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsSonText.label: ElmsSonText
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsSonText.en:
When I grow up, I'm going to help my dad!
I'm going to be a great #MON professor!
There's some food here. It must be for the LAB.
There's some food here. This must be for #MON.
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsSonText.et:
Kui suureks saan, siis lähen isale appi!
Minust saab suurepärane #MONi professor!
Siin on toitu. See on vist LABORI jaoks.
Siin on toitu. See on vist #MONide jaoks.

maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsHousePCText.label: ElmsHousePCText
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsHousePCText.en:
#MON. Where do they come from?
Where are they going?
Why has no one ever witnessed a #MON's birth?
I want to know! I will dedicate my
life to the study of #MON!
…
It's a part of PROF.ELM's research papers.
maps/ElmsHouse.asm::ElmsHousePCText.et:
#MON. Kust nad tulevad?
Kuhu nad lähevad?
Miks pole keegi näinud #MONi sündi?
Ma tahan teada! Pühendan oma
elu #MONide uurimisele!
…
See on osa PROF.ELMi uurimustöödest.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Intro.label: ElmText_Intro
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Intro.en:
ELM: <PLAY_G>! There you are!
I needed to ask you a favor.
I'm conducting new #MON research
right now. I was wondering if you
could help me with it, <PLAY_G>.
You see…
I'm writing a paper that I want
to present at a conference.
But there are some things I don't
quite understand yet.
So!
I'd like you to raise a #MON
that I recently caught.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Intro.et:
ELM: <PLAY_G>! Seal sa oledki!
Tahtsin sinult üht teenet paluda.
Teen praegu uut #MONi
uuringut. Mõtlesin, kas sa saaksid
mind selles aidata, <PLAY_G>.
Näed…
Kirjutan uurimust, mida tahan
esitleda konverentsil.
Aga on mõned asjad, millest ma
veel päris aru ei saa.
Nii et!
Tahaksin, et kasvatad #MONi,
kelle hiljuti püüdsin.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Refused.label: ElmText_Refused
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Refused.en: But… Please, I need your help!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_Refused.et: Aga… Palun, ma vajan sinu abi!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ResearchAmbiti.label: ElmText_ResearchAmbitions
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ResearchAmbiti.en:
When I announce my findings, I'm sure
we'll delve a bit deeper into the
many mysteries of #MON.
You can count on it!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ResearchAmbiti.et:
Kui oma leiud avaldan, olen kindel, et
sukeldume veidi sügavamale
#MONide paljudesse mõistatustesse.
Selle peale võid kindel olla!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_GotAnEmail.label: ElmText_GotAnEmail
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_GotAnEmail.en:
Oh, hey! I got an e-mail!
<……><……><……> Hm… Uh-huh…
Okay…
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_GotAnEmail.et:
Oh, kuule! Sain e-kirja!
<……><……><……> Hmm… Ahaa…
Olgu…

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_MissionFromMrP.label: ElmText_MissionFromMrPokemon
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_MissionFromMrP.en:
Hey, listen.
I have an acquaintance called MR. #MON.
He keeps finding weird things and
raving about his discoveries.
Anyway, I just got an e-mail from him
saying that this time it's real.
It is intriguing, but we're busy
with our #MON research…
Wait!
I know!
<PLAY_G>, can you go in our place?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_MissionFromMrP.et:
Kuule.
Mul on tuttav nimega MR. #MON.
Ta leiab pidevalt veidraid asju ja
kiidab oma avastusi taevani.
Igatahes sain temalt just e-kirja,
et seekord on asi tõsine.
See on põnev, aga meil on käsil
oma #MONi-uuringud…
Oota!
Ma tean!
<PLAY_G>, kas saaksid meie asemel minna?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ChooseAPokemon.label: ElmText_ChooseAPokemon
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ChooseAPokemon.en:
I want you to raise one of the
#MON contained in these BALLS.
You'll be that #MON's first partner, <PLAY_G>!
Go on. Pick one!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_ChooseAPokemon.et:
Tahan, et kasvataksid üht
nendes PALLIDES olevat #MONi.
Sinust saab selle #MONi esimene partner, <PLAY_G>!
Aga võta. Vali üks!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_LetYourMonBatt.label: ElmText_LetYourMonBattleIt
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_LetYourMonBatt.en: If a wild #MON appears, let your #MON battle it!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_LetYourMonBatt.et: Kui ilmub metsik #MON, lase oma #MONil sellega võidelda!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::LabWhereGoingText.label: LabWhereGoingText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::LabWhereGoingText.en: ELM: Wait! Where are you going?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeCyndaquilText.label: TakeCyndaquilText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeCyndaquilText.en: ELM: You'll take CYNDAQUIL, the fire #MON?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeTotodileText.label: TakeTotodileText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeTotodileText.en: ELM: Do you want TOTODILE, the water #MON?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeChikoritaText.label: TakeChikoritaText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeChikoritaText.en: ELM: So, you like CHIKORITA, the grass #MON?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::TakeChikoritaText.et: ELM: Niisiis meeldib sulle CHIKORITA, rohu #MON?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::DidntChooseStarterText.label: DidntChooseStarterText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::DidntChooseStarterText.en:
ELM: Think it over carefully.
Your partner is important.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::DidntChooseStarterText.et:
ELM: Mõtle hoolikalt järele.
Sinu partner on tähtis.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ChoseStarterText.label: ChoseStarterText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ChoseStarterText.en: ELM: I think that's a great #MON too!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ChoseStarterText.et: ELM: Minu arust on seegi suurepärane #MON!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText1.label: ElmDirectionsText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText1.en:
MR.#MON lives a little bit beyond
CHERRYGROVE, the next city over.
It's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.
But just in case, here's my phone
number. Call me if anything comes up!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText1.et:
MR.#MON elab veidi kaugemal,
järgmise linna CHERRYGROVE taga.
Sinna viib peaaegu otsetee,
nii et mööda ei eksi.
Aga igaks juhuks, siin on mu
telefoninumber. Helista, kui midagi juhtub!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText2.label: ElmDirectionsText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText2.en:
If your #MON is hurt, you should
heal it with this machine.
Feel free to use it anytime.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDirectionsText2.et:
Kui su #MON on viga saanud,
ravi ta selle masinaga terveks.
Kasuta seda julgelt igal ajal.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDescribesMrPokemonT.label: ElmDescribesMrPokemonText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDescribesMrPokemonT.en:
MR.#MON goes everywhere and finds rarities.
Too bad they're just rare and not very useful…
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmDescribesMrPokemonT.et:
MR.#MON käib igal pool ja leiab haruldusi.
Kahju vaid, et need on haruldased, kuid vähe kasu…

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmPokeBallText.label: ElmPokeBallText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmPokeBallText.en: It contains a #MON caught by PROF.ELM.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabHealingMachineT.label: ElmsLabHealingMachineText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabHealingMachineT.en: Would you like to heal your #MON?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText1.label: ElmAfterTheftText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText1.en:
ELM: <PLAY_G>, this is terrible…
Oh, yes, what was MR.#MON's big discovery?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText1.et:
ELM: <PLAY_G>, see on kohutav…
Ahjaa, mis oli MR.#MONi suur avastus?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText2.label: ElmAfterTheftText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText2.en: <PLAYER> handed the MYSTERY EGG to PROF.ELM.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText4.label: ElmAfterTheftText4
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText4.en:
But… Is it a #MON EGG?
If it is, it is a great discovery!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText4.et:
Aga… kas see on #MON EGG?
Kui on, siis on see suur avastus!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText5.label: ElmAfterTheftText5
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText5.en:
ELM: What?!?
PROF.OAK gave you a #DEX?
<PLAY_G>, is that true? Th-that's incredible!
He is superb at seeing the potential of people as trainers.
Wow, <PLAY_G>. You may have what it
takes to become the CHAMPION.
You seem to be getting on great with #MON too.
You should take the #MON GYM challenge.
The closest GYM would be the one in VIOLET CITY.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText5.et:
ELM: Mida?!?
PROF.OAK andis sulle #DEXi?
<PLAY_G>, kas tõesti? S-see on uskumatu!
Ta oskab suurepäraselt näha inimeste kui treenerite võimekust.
Vau, <PLAY_G>. Sinus võib olla
seda, mis teeb TŠEMPIONIKS.
Tundub, et saad #MONidega väga hästi läbi.
Peaksid vastu võtma #MON SAALI väljakutse.
Lähim SAAL asub VIOLET CITYs.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText6.label: ElmAfterTheftText6
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText6.en:
…<PLAY_G>. The road to the
championship will be a long one.
Before you leave, make sure that you talk to your mom.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAfterTheftText6.et:
…<PLAY_G>. Tee tšempionitiitlini
on pikk.
Enne lahkumist räägi kindlasti emaga.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmStudyingEggText.label: ElmStudyingEggText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmStudyingEggText.en:
ELM: Don't give up! I'll call if
I learn anything about that EGG!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmStudyingEggText.et:
ELM: Ära anna alla! Helistan,
kui selle EGG kohta midagi teada saan!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAideHasEggText.label: ElmAideHasEggText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAideHasEggText.en:
ELM: <PLAY_G>? Didn't you meet my assistant?
He should have met you with the EGG
at VIOLET CITY's #MON CENTER.
You must have just missed him. Try to catch him there.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmAideHasEggText.et:
ELM: <PLAY_G>? Kas sa ei kohtunud mu abilisega?
Ta pidi sind EGGiga vastu võtma
VIOLET CITY #MON KESKUSES.
Sa vist jäid temast napilt maha. Ürita ta sealt kätte saada.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmWaitingEggHatchText.label: ElmWaitingEggHatchText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmWaitingEggHatchText.en: ELM: Hey, has that EGG changed any?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmWaitingEggHatchText.et: ELM: Kuule, kas see EGG on muutunud?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmThoughtEggHatchedTe.label: ElmThoughtEggHatchedText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmThoughtEggHatchedTe.en:
<PLAY_G>? I thought the EGG hatched.
Where is the #MON?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmThoughtEggHatchedTe.et:
<PLAY_G>? Arvasin, et EGG koorus.
Kus on #MON?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ShowElmTogepiText3.label: ShowElmTogepiText3
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ShowElmTogepiText3.en:
The EGG hatched! So, #MON are born from EGGS…
No, perhaps not all #MON are.
Wow, there's still a lot of research to be done.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ShowElmTogepiText3.et:
EGG koorus! Niisiis, #MONid sünnivad EGGidest…
Ei, ehk mitte kõik #MONid.
Vau, uurida on veel palju.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText1.label: ElmGiveEverstoneText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText1.en:
Thanks, <PLAY_G>! You're helping
unravel #MON mysteries for us!
I want you to have this as a token of our appreciation.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText1.et:
Aitäh, <PLAY_G>! Sa aitad meil
#MONide mõistatusi lahti harutada!
Tänutäheks tahan sulle selle kinkida.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText2.label: ElmGiveEverstoneText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText2.en:
That's an EVERSTONE.
Some species of #MON evolve
when they grow to certain levels.
A #MON holding the EVERSTONE won't evolve.
Give it to a #MON you don't want to evolve.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveEverstoneText2.et:
See on EVERSTONE.
Mõned #MONi liigid arenevad,
kui nad teatud tasemeni kasvavad.
EVERSTONEt hoidev #MON ei arene.
Anna see #MONile, keda ei taha arendada.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_CallYou.label: ElmText_CallYou
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmText_CallYou.en: ELM: <PLAY_G>, I'll call you if anything comes up.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AfterTheft.label: AideText_AfterTheft
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AfterTheft.en:
…sigh… That stolen #MON.
I wonder how it's doing.
They say a #MON raised by a bad
person turns bad itself.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AfterTheft.et:
…ohh… See varastatud #MON.
Huvitav, kuidas tal läheb.
Öeldakse, et halva inimese
kasvatatud #MON läheb ise halvaks.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText1.label: ElmGiveMasterBallText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText1.en:
ELM: Hi, <PLAY_G>! Thanks to you, my
research is going great!
Take this as a token of my appreciation.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText1.et:
ELM: Tere, <PLAY_G>! Tänu sinule
läheb mu uurimistöö suurepäraselt!
Võta see minu tänutäheks.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText2.label: ElmGiveMasterBallText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText2.en:
The MASTER BALL is the best!
It's the ultimate BALL! It'll catch
any #MON without fail.
It's given only to recognized #MON researchers.
I think you can make much better
use of it than I can, <PLAY_G>!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveMasterBallText2.et:
MASTER BALL on parim!
See on ülim PALL! See püüab
iga #MONi eksimatult.
Seda antakse vaid tunnustatud #MONi uurijatele.
Arvan, et sina oskad seda palju
paremini kasutada kui mina, <PLAY_G>!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText1.label: ElmGiveTicketText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText1.en:
ELM: <PLAY_G>! There you are!
I called because I have something for you.
See? It's an S.S.TICKET.
Now you can catch #MON in KANTO.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText1.et:
ELM: <PLAY_G>! Seal sa oledki!
Helistasin, sest mul on sulle midagi.
Näed? See on S.S.TICKET.
Nüüd saad püüda #MONe KANTOs.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText2.label: ElmGiveTicketText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText2.en:
The ship departs from OLIVINE CITY.
But you knew that already, <PLAY_G>.
After all, you've traveled all over with your #MON.
Give my regards to PROF.OAK in KANTO!
It's the #MON EGG being studied by PROF.ELM.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmGiveTicketText2.et:
Laev väljub OLIVINE CITYst.
Aga seda sa juba teadsid, <PLAY_G>.
Sa oled ju oma #MONidega kõikjal rännanud.
Tervita KANTOs PROF.OAKi!
See on #MON EGG, mida uurib PROF.ELM.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_GiveYouPotion.label: AideText_GiveYouPotion
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_GiveYouPotion.en: <PLAY_G>, I want you to have this for your errand.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AlwaysBusy.label: AideText_AlwaysBusy
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AlwaysBusy.en: There are only two of us, so we're always busy.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_AlwaysBusy.et: Meid on ainult kaks, seega on alati kiire.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_TheftTestimon.label: AideText_TheftTestimony
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_TheftTestimon.en:
There was a loud noise outside…
When we went to look, someone stole a #MON.
It's unbelievable that anyone would do that!
…sigh… That stolen #MON.
I wonder how it's doing.
They say a #MON raised by a bad
person turns bad itself.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_TheftTestimon.et:
Väljas kostis kõva müra…
Kui vaatama läksime, varastas keegi #MONi.
Uskumatu, et keegi midagi sellist teeb!
…ohh… See varastatud #MON.
Huvitav, kuidas tal läheb.
Öeldakse, et halva inimese
kasvatatud #MON läheb ise halvaks.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_ExplainBalls.label: AideText_ExplainBalls
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_ExplainBalls.en:
To add to your #DEX, you have to catch #MON.
Throw # BALLS at wild #MON to get them.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::AideText_ExplainBalls.et:
#DEXi täiendamiseks pead #MONe püüdma.
Viska metsikutele #MONidele # PALLE, et neid püüda.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText1.label: ElmsLabOfficerText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText1.en:
I heard a #MON was stolen here…
I was just getting some information from PROF.ELM.
Apparently, it was a young male with long, red hair…
What?
You battled a trainer like that?
Did you happen to get his name?
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText1.et:
Kuulsin, et siit varastati #MON…
Sain just PROF.ELMilt veidi teavet.
Ilmselt oli see pikkade punaste juustega noormees…
Mida?
Sa võitlesid sellise treeneriga?
Kas juhtusid tema nime teada saama?

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText2.label: ElmsLabOfficerText2
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText2.en:
OK! So <RIVAL> was his name.
Thanks for helping my investigation!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabOfficerText2.et:
Selge! Tema nimi oli siis <RIVAL>.
Aitäh, et mu juurdlust aitasid!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabWindowText1.label: ElmsLabWindowText1
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabWindowText1.en:
The window's open.
A pleasant breeze is blowing in.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabWindowText1.et:
Aken on lahti.
Sisse puhub mõnus tuul.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip1Text.label: ElmsLabTravelTip1Text
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip1Text.en:
<PLAYER> opened a book.
Travel Tip 1:
Press START to open the MENU.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip1Text.et:
<PLAYER> avas raamatu.
Reisinipp 1:
Vajuta START, et avada MENU.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip2Text.label: ElmsLabTravelTip2Text
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip2Text.en:
<PLAYER> opened a book.
Travel Tip 2:
Record your trip with SAVE!
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip2Text.et:
<PLAYER> avas raamatu.
Reisinipp 2:
Salvesta oma reis käsuga SAVE!

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip3Text.label: ElmsLabTravelTip3Text
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip3Text.en:
<PLAYER> opened a book.
Travel Tip 3:
Open your PACK and press SELECT to move items.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip3Text.et:
<PLAYER> avas raamatu.
Reisinipp 3:
Ava oma PACK ja vajuta esemete liigutamiseks SELECT.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip4Text.label: ElmsLabTravelTip4Text
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip4Text.en:
<PLAYER> opened a book.
Travel Tip 4:
Check your #MON moves. Press the
A Button to switch moves.
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTravelTip4Text.et:
<PLAYER> avas raamatu.
Reisinipp 4:
Vaata oma #MONi rünnakuid. Vajuta
A-nuppu, et rünnakuid vahetada.

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTrashcanText.label: ElmsLabTrashcanText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTrashcanText.en: The wrapper from the snack PROF.ELM ate is in there…
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabTrashcanText.et: Seal on PROF.ELMi söödud suupiste paber…

maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabPCText.label: ElmsLabPCText
maps/ElmsLab.asm::ElmsLabPCText.en:
OBSERVATIONS ON #MON EVOLUTION
…It says on the screen…

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToVermilion
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.en:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to VERMILION CITY.
We will make an announcement when we arrive.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.et:
KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on teel VERMILIONi linna.
Teatame, kui kohale jõuame.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToOlivine
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.en:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to OLIVINE CITY.
We will make an announcement when we arrive.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.et:
KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on teel OLIVINEi linna.
Teatame, kui kohale jõuame.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.label: FastShip1FSailor2Text_FirstTime
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.en:
Here's your cabin.
If your #MON are hurt, take a nap in the bed.
That will heal them.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.et:
Siin on sinu kajut.
Kui su #MON on viga saanud, tee voodis uinak.
See ravib nad terveks.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.label: FastShip1FSailor2Text
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.en:
Here's your cabin.
You can heal your #MON by taking a nap in the bed.
The ship will arrive while you're sleeping.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor2Te.et:
Siin on sinu kajut.
Voodis magades saad oma #MONid terveks ravida.
Laev jõuab pärale, kui sa magad.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor3Te.label: FastShip1FSailor3Text
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor3Te.en:
The passengers are all trainers.
They're all itching to battle in their cabins.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor3Te.et:
Reisijad on kõik treenerid.
Nad kõik kibelevad oma kajutites võitlema.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FGrandpaTe.label: FastShip1FGrandpaText
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FGrandpaTe.en:
Whoa! Excuse me. I was in a hurry!
My granddaughter is missing!
She's just a wee girl. If you see
her, please let me know!
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FGrandpaTe.et:
Oih! Vabandust. Mul oli kiire!
Mu lapselaps on kadunud!
Ta on alles pisike tüdruk. Kui sa teda
näed, siis anna mulle teada!

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_InOlivine
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.en: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in OLIVINE CITY.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.et: KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on jõudnud OLIVINEi linna.

maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_InVermilion
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.en: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in VERMILION CITY.
maps/FastShip1F.asm::FastShip1FSailor1Te.et: KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on jõudnud VERMILIONi linna.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.en:
Hey, kid. Could I get you to look for my buddy?
He's goofing off somewhere, that lazy bum!
I want to go find him, but I'm on duty right now.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.et:
Kuule, laps. Kas otsiksid üles mu semu?
Ta looderdab kuskil, see laisk logard!
Tahaksin ta üles otsida, aga olen praegu valves.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorRefusedText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.en:
Oh, gee…
The CAPTAIN will be furious…

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorThanksText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.en:
Thanks, kid! I chewed him out
good so he'll quit slacking off!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.et:
Aitäh, laps! Sõimasin ta
korralikult läbi, et looderdamine lõpeks!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorSawLittleGirlText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.en:
A little girl?
I may have seen her go by here.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.et:
Väike tüdruk?
Võib-olla nägin teda siit mööda minemas.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorDirectionsText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.en:
The dining room is up ahead.
The stairs at the end lead to the CAPTAIN's cabin.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FastShipB1FOnDutyS.et:
Söögisaal on eespool.
Tagumine trepp viib KAPTENI kajutini.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffSeenText.label: SailorJeffSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffSeenText.en: Nothing beats a battle when I'm on my break.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffSeenText.et: Puhkepausil pole miski parem kui lahing.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffBeatenTe.label: SailorJeffBeatenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffBeatenTe.en: Win or lose, my break's over!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffBeatenTe.et: Võit või kaotus, mu paus on läbi!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffAfterBat.label: SailorJeffAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffAfterBat.en: I guess I can't win if I don't get serious.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorJeffAfterBat.et: Vist ei võida, kui ma asja tõsiselt ei võta.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraSeen.label: PicnickerDebraSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraSeen.en: I'm so bored. Want to battle?
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraSeen.et: Mul on nii igav. Tahad võidelda?

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraAfte.label: PicnickerDebraAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraAfte.en:
SAFFRON, CELADON… I hear there are
many big cities in KANTO.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::PicnickerDebraAfte.et:
SAFFRON, CELADON… kuulda on, et
KANTOs on palju suuri linnu.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::JugglerFritzAfterB.label: JugglerFritzAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::JugglerFritzAfterB.en:
No more ships for me. Next time,
I'm taking the MAGNET TRAIN.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::JugglerFritzAfterB.et:
Ei mingeid laevu enam. Järgmine kord
sõidan MAGNETRONGIGA.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettSeenT.label: SailorGarrettSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettSeenT.en: This is where we sailors work!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettBeate.label: SailorGarrettBeatenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettBeate.en: I lost on my home field…

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettAfter.label: SailorGarrettAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettAfter.en:
We get different passengers from
VERMILION CITY to OLIVINE CITY.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorGarrettAfter.et:
Meil käib eri reisijaid
VERMILIONist OLIVINEsse.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahSeenTex.label: FisherJonahSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahSeenTex.en:
Even though we're out on the sea, I can't fish!
This is boring! Let's battle!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahSeenTex.et:
Kuigi oleme merel, ei saa ma kala püüda!
See on igav! Võitleme!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahAfterBa.label: FisherJonahAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahAfterBa.en: I plan to fish off VERMILION's pier.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::FisherJonahAfterBa.et: Plaanin VERMILIONi kai pealt kala püüda.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiSeenTe.label: BlackbeltWaiSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiSeenTe.en:
I'm building up my legs by bracing
against the ship's rocking!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiSeenTe.et:
Tugevdan jalgu, seistes vastu
laeva õõtsumisele!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiAfterB.label: BlackbeltWaiAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiAfterB.en:
I couldn't find the KARATE KING in JOHTO.
He's supposed to be training in a cave somewhere.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::BlackbeltWaiAfterB.et:
Ma ei leidnud JOHTOst KARATEKUNNI.
Ta pidavat kuskil koopas treenima.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethSeenT.label: SailorKennethSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethSeenT.en:
I'm a sailor man!
But I'm training #MON, so I can become the CHAMP!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethSeenT.et:
Ma olen meremees!
Aga treenin #MONe, et saada TŠEMPIONIKS!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethBeate.label: SailorKennethBeatenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethBeate.en: My lack of training is obvious…

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethAfter.label: SailorKennethAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethAfter.en:
Eight BADGES! They must prove
that you've beaten GYM LEADERS.
No wonder you're so good!
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SailorKennethAfter.et:
Kaheksa MÄRKI! Need tõestavad,
et oled SAALI JUHTE alistanud.
Pole ime, et sa nii tubli oled!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::TeacherShirleySeen.label: TeacherShirleySeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::TeacherShirleySeen.en: Don't lay a finger on my students!

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::TeacherShirleyAfte.label: TeacherShirleyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::TeacherShirleyAfte.en: We're on a field trip to the RUINS outside VIOLET.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyNateSeenT.label: SchoolboyNateSeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyNateSeenT.en: Do you know the RUINS OF ALPH?

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyNateAfter.label: SchoolboyNateAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyNateAfter.en: Radios pick up strange signals inside the RUINS.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyRickySeen.label: SchoolboyRickySeenText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyRickySeen.en: There are some odd stone panels in the RUINS OF ALPH.

maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyRickyAfte.label: SchoolboyRickyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyRickyAfte.en: I read that there are four of those stone panels.
maps/FastShipB1F.asm::SchoolboyRickyAfte.et: Lugesin, et neid kivipaneele on neli.

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.label: CooltrainermSeanSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.en: I'm going to KANTO to test my skills.
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.et: Lähen KANTOsse oma oskusi proovile panema.

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.label: CooltrainermSeanAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.en:
Trainers from JOHTO can battle
with KANTO GYM LEADERS.
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.et:
JOHTO treenerid saavad võidelda
KANTO saalijuhtidega.

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.label: CooltrainerfCarolSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.en: I'm training to become the CHAMP!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.label: CooltrainerfCarolBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.et: Mis meie vahel nii erinevat on?

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.label: CooltrainerfCarolAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Cool.en: I'm going to beat you someday!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.label: PokemaniacEthanSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.en: Do you know LILY? She's a hot DJ in KANTO.
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.et: Kas tunned LILYt? Ta on kuum DJ KANTOs.

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.label: PokemaniacEthanAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.en:
LILY's nice, but MARY's the best!
I want to check out JOHTO's radio programs!
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Poke.et:
LILY on tore, aga MARY on parim!
Tahan kuulata JOHTO raadiosaateid!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.label: HikerNolandSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.en: Are you alone? Then let's battle!
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.et: Kas sa oled üksi? Siis võitleme!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.label: HikerNolandBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.et: Seda on liiga palju, et hakkama saada!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.label: HikerNolandAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.en:
I wonder if there are any mountains
worth climbing in KANTO?
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Hike.et:
Huvitav, kas KANTOs leidub mägesid,
mida tasuks ronida?

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.label: SailorStanlySeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.en:
Yeah, I'm a sailor, all right.
I wasn't goofing off!
This cabin was vacant, so I just took a quick nap!
Ah, forget it! Let's battle!
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.et:
Jah, meremees olen küll.
Ma ei looderdanud!
See kajut oli tühi, nii et tegin kiire uinaku!
Ah, unusta ära! Võitleme!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.label: SailorStanlyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.en: Being a sailor, I have to do physical labor. It's exhausting!
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Sail.et: Meremehena pean tegema füüsilist tööd. See on kurnav!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.label: GentlemanEdwardSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.en: Oh, no. I've lost something that's very important.
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.et: Oh ei. Olen kaotanud midagi väga tähtsat.

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.label: GentlemanEdwardAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.en:
I give up. You don't have to
look. Just forget about it!
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Gent.et:
Annan alla. Sa ei pea
otsima. Lihtsalt unusta see!

maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Burg.label: BurglarCoreyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Burg.en:
I found a pretty coin here.
Someone must have lost it…
maps/FastShipCabins_NNW_NNE_NE.asm::Burg.et:
Leidsin siit ühe ilusa mündi.
Keegi on selle vist kaotanud…

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaCaptainExhaustingText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
Whew! Thanks for coming along.
Keeping that little girl amused was exhausting.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Huuh! Aitäh, et kaasa tulid.
Selle väikese tüdruku lõbustamine oli kurnav.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaCaptainHowDoYouLikeText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
How do you like S.S.AQUA's ride?
She practically skates across the waves.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Kuidas meeldib sõit S.S.AQUAga?
Ta lausa libiseb üle lainete.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaCantFindGranddaughterText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
Oh, hello…
I still can't find my granddaughter.
If she's on the ship, that's OK.
She's an energetic child, so she may
be bugging someone. I'm worried…
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Oh, tere…
Oma lapselast ma ikka ei leia.
Kui ta on laeval, siis on kõik hästi.
Ta on energiline laps, nii et ta võib
kedagi tüütada. Olen mures…

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaEntertainedGranddaughterText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
<PLAY_G>, was it? I heard you entertained my granddaughter.
I want to thank you for that.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
<PLAY_G>, eks? Kuulsin, et lõbustasid mu lapselast.
Tahan sind selle eest tänada.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGrandpaHaveThisText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: I know! I'd like you to have this!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Tead mida! Võta see endale!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGrandpaTravellingText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: We're traveling around the world.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Me reisime mööda maailma ringi.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMeText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
CAPTAIN, play with me, please?
I'm bored! I want to play more!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
KAPTEN, mängi minuga, palun?
Mul on igav! Tahan rohkem mängida!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGranddaughterHasToFindGrandpaText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
Hi! Will you play with me?
…Oh!
Grandpa's worried about me?
I have to go!
I have to go find Grandpa!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Tere! Kas sa mängid minuga?
…Oh!
Vanaisa on minu pärast mures?
Ma pean minema!
Ma pean vanaisa otsima minema!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingMText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
Grandpa, here I am! I was playing
with the CAPTAIN and this guy!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Vanaisa, siin ma olen! Mängisin
KAPTENI ja selle tüübiga!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingFText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
Grandpa, here I am! I was playing
with the CAPTAIN and this big girl!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Vanaisa, siin ma olen! Mängisin
KAPTENI ja selle suure tüdrukuga!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaGranddaughterHadFunText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: I had lots of fun playing!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Mängimine oli väga lõbus!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmColinSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Hey, kid! Want to battle with me?
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Hei, laps! Tahad minuga võidelda?

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmColinBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: You're strong!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Sa oled tugev!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmColinAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
You're traveling all alone?
Isn't your mom worried?
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Reisid täiesti üksi?
Kas su ema ei muretse?

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg1SeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: You think I'm a baby? That's not fair!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Arvad, et olen beebi? See pole aus!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg1BeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Oh! We lost!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Oh! Kaotasime!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg1AfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Baby is a rude name to call us girls!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Meid tüdrukuid beebiks kutsuda on ebaviisakas!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg2SeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en:
I'm not a baby!
That's not nice to say to a lady!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et:
Ma ei ole beebi!
Nii pole ilus daamile öelda!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg2BeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Oh! We lost!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Oh! Kaotasime!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: TwinsMegandpeg2AfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Sometimes, kids are smarter than grown-ups!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Mõnikord on lapsed targemad kui täiskasvanud!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PsychicRodneySeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Ssh! My brain is picking up radio signals!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Tss! Mu aju püüab raadiosignaale!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PsychicRodneyBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: …I hear something!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: …kuulen midagi!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PsychicRodneyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: I get it. You can hear JOHTO's radio on the FAST SHIP.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Selge. JOHTO raadiot saab kuulata KIIRLAEVAL.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmJeremySeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: What do you think? My #MON are beautiful, yes?
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Mis sa arvad? Kas mu #MONid pole ilusad?

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmJeremyBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Oh, no! My beautiful #MON!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Oh ei! Mu ilusad #MONid!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanmJeremyAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: I must go to the #MON SALON and fix them up nice!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Pean minema #MON SALONGI ja nad kenaks tegema!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanfGeorgiaSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: I'm going to shop at the DEPT.STORE and then…
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Lähen KAUBAMAJJA ostlema ja siis…

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanfGeorgiaBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: What was I going to do?
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Mida ma kavatsesin teha?

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: PokefanfGeorgiaAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Oh, yes! I have to get my #MON out of DAY-CARE!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Ahjaa! Pean oma #MONi PÄEVAHOIUST kätte saama!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SupernerdShawnSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: What kinds of # BALLS do you have with you?
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Mis sorti # PALLE sul kaasas on?

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SupernerdShawnBeatenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: Wait! Stop! Don't! Please!
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Oota! Peatu! Ära tee! Palun!

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SupernerdShawnAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: You should use the right BALLS to fit the situation.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: Olukorrale sobivalt tasub valida õiged PALLID.

maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.label: SSAquaHasArrivedVermilionText
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.en: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in VERMILION CITY.
maps/FastShipCabins_SE_SSE_CaptainsCabin.et: KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on jõudnud VERMILIONi linna.

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Fireb.label: FirebreatherLyleSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Fireb.en: I'm going to KANTO to put on firebreathing shows!

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Fireb.label: FirebreatherLyleAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Fireb.en:
I guess fire is weak on the sea.
It doesn't matter? Really?
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Fireb.et:
Ilmselt on tuli merel nõrk.
Vahet pole? Tõesti?

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::BugCa.label: BugCatcherKenSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::BugCa.en: I'm visiting my grandma to catch me some bugs!

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::BugCa.label: BugCatcherKenAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::BugCa.en: You can find lots of #MON in the trees of JOHTO!

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Beaut.label: BeautyCassieSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Beaut.en: I'm trying to forget my woes. Let's battle!

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Beaut.label: BeautyCassieAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Beaut.en:
A voyage is best for getting over a broken heart.
But a FAST SHIP trip is too short for grieving.
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Beaut.et:
Merereis on parim rohi murtud südamele.
Aga KIIRLAEVA reis on leinamiseks liiga lühike.

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.label: GuitaristClydeSeenText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.en:
I'm going to audition my songs at
GOLDENROD's RADIO STATION.
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.et:
Lähen oma laule esitama
GOLDENRODi RAADIOJAAMA.

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.label: GuitaristClydeAfterBattleMobileText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.en:
I was going to make my debut at the BATTLE TOWER…
I should go back to VERMILION and redo my training…
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.et:
Kavatsesin teha debüüdi LAHINGUTORNIS…
Peaksin naasma VERMILIONi ja treeningu uuesti tegema…

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.label: GuitaristClydeAfterBattleText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.en:
Speaking of the RADIO STATION,
what's this week's lucky number?
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::Guita.et:
RAADIOJAAMAST rääkides,
mis on selle nädala õnnenumber?

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.label: FastShipBedText1
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.en: A comfy bed! Time to sleep…

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.label: FastShipArrivedOlivineText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.en: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in OLIVINE CITY.
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.et: KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on jõudnud OLIVINEi linna.

maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.label: FastShipArrivedVermilionText
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.en: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in VERMILION CITY.
maps/FastShipCabins_SW_SSW_NW.asm::FastS.et: KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA on jõudnud VERMILIONi linna.

maps/FightingDojo.asm::FightingDojoBlack.label: FightingDojoBlackBeltText
maps/FightingDojo.asm::FightingDojoBlack.en:
Hello!
KARATE KING, the FIGHTING DOJO's
master, is in a cave in JOHTO for training.
maps/FightingDojo.asm::FightingDojoBlack.et:
Tere!
KARATEKUNN, VÕITLUSDOJO
meister, on treeninguks JOHTO koopas.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityYoungst.label: FuchsiaCityYoungsterText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityYoungst.en:
One of the ELITE FOUR used to be
the LEADER of FUCHSIA's GYM.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityYoungst.et: Üks ELIITNELIKUST oli kunagi FUCHSIA SAALI JUHT.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityPokefan.label: FuchsiaCityPokefanMText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityPokefan.en:
KOGA's daughter succeeded him as
the GYM LEADER after he joined the ELITE FOUR.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityPokefan.et: KOGA tütar sai pärast tema ELIITNELIKKU liitumist SAALI JUHIKS.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityTeacher.label: FuchsiaCityTeacherText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityTeacher.en:
The SAFARI ZONE is closed… It's sad,
considering it's FUCHSIA's main attraction.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCityTeacher.et: SAFARIALA on suletud… Kurb, arvestades, et see on FUCHSIA peamine vaatamisväärsus.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCitySignTex.label: FuchsiaCitySignText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCitySignTex.en:
FUCHSIA CITY
Behold! It's Passion Pink!
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaCitySignTex.et:
FUCHSIA CITY
Näe! See on kirglik roosa!

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaGymSignText.label: FuchsiaGymSignText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaGymSignText.en:
FUCHSIA CITY #MON GYM LEADER: JANINE
The Poisonous Ninja Master
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::FuchsiaGymSignText.et:
FUCHSIA CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: JANINE
Mürgine nindžameister

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneOfficeSi.label: SafariZoneOfficeSignText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneOfficeSi.en:
There's a notice here…
SAFARI ZONE OFFICE is closed until further notice.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneOfficeSi.et:
Siin on teade…
SAFARIALA KONTOR on kuni edasise teateni suletud.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneClosedSi.label: SafariZoneClosedSignText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneClosedSi.en:
The WARDEN is traveling abroad.
Therefore, the SAFARI ZONE is closed.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::SafariZoneClosedSi.et:
VALVUR reisib välismaal.
Seetõttu on SAFARIALA suletud.

maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::NoLitteringSignTex.label: NoLitteringSignText
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::NoLitteringSignTex.en:
No littering.
Please take your waste with you.
maps/FuchsiaCity.asm::NoLitteringSignTex.et:
Ära prügista.
Palun võta oma jäätmed kaasa.

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_Disappoi.label: JanineText_DisappointYou
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_Disappoi.en:
Fufufufu…
I'm sorry to disappoint you…
I'm only joking!
I'm the real deal!
JANINE of FUCHSIA GYM, that's me!
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_Disappoi.et:
Fufufuu…
Vabandust, et pean sind pettuma…
Tegin lihtsalt nalja!
Mina olen ehtne!
JANINE FUCHSIA SAALIST, see olen mina!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToughOne.label: JanineText_ToughOne
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToughOne.en:
JANINE: You're a tough one. You definitely won…
Here's SOULBADGE. Take it.
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToughOne.et:
JANINE: Sa oled kõva. Kindlalt võitsid…
Säh SOULBADGE. Võta.

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToxicSpe.label: JanineText_ToxicSpeech
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToxicSpe.en:
JANINE: You're so tough! I have a special gift!
It's TOXIC, a powerful poison that
steadily saps the victim's HP.
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ToxicSpe.et:
JANINE: Sa oled nii kõva! Mul on eriline kink!
See on TOXIC, võimas mürk, mis vähendab pidevalt ohvri HP-d.

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ApplyMys.label: JanineText_ApplyMyself
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ApplyMys.en:
JANINE: I'm going to really apply
myself and improve my skills.
I want to become better than both Father and you!
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::JanineText_ApplyMys.et:
JANINE: Hakkan tõsiselt pingutama ja oma oskusi lihvima.
Tahan saada paremaks kui isa ja sina!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceBeforeText.label: LassAliceBeforeText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceBeforeText.en:
Fufufu!
I'm JANINE, the GYM LEADER!
No, I'm not! Gotcha, sucker!
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceBeforeText.et:
Fufufuu!
Olen JANINE, SAALI JUHT!
Ei, ei ole! Said sisse, lollpea!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceAfterText.label: LassAliceAfterText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceAfterText.en: How will you distinguish our real LEADER?
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassAliceAfterText.et: Kuidas sa meie päris JUHI ära tunned?

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassLindaBeatenText.label: LassLindaBeatenText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassLindaBeatenText.en: Ooh… I lost… You're not weak…

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassLindaAfterText.label: LassLindaAfterText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::LassLindaAfterText.et: Noh? Kas mu maskeering polnud täiuslik?

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::PicnickerCindyBefor.label: PicnickerCindyBeforeText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::PicnickerCindyBefor.en:
I'm JANINE!
How did you know I was real?
Let's battle!
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::PicnickerCindyBefor.et:
Olen JANINE!
Kuidas sa teadsid, et olen ehtne?
Võitleme!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::PicnickerCindyBeate.label: PicnickerCindyBeatenText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::PicnickerCindyBeate.en: Darn it! I wanted to win!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::CamperBarryBeatenTe.label: CamperBarryBeatenText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::CamperBarryBeatenTe.en: My disguise was right on! Dang!

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::CamperBarryAfterTex.label: CamperBarryAfterText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::CamperBarryAfterTex.en: Hey, you. Was my disguise cute or what, huh?
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::CamperBarryAfterTex.et: Hei, sina. Kas mu maskeering polnud nunnu või mis, mis?

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideText.label: FuchsiaGymGuideText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideText.en:
Yo, CHAMP in making!
Whoops! Take a good look around
you. The trainers all look like the LEADER, JANINE.
Which of them is the real JANINE?
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideText.et:
Hei, tulevane TŠEMPION!
Uups! Vaata enda ümber hoolega. Kõik treenerid näevad välja nagu JUHT JANINE.
Kumb neist on päris JANINE?

maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideWinT.label: FuchsiaGymGuideWinText
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideWinT.en: That was a great battle, trainer from JOHTO!
maps/FuchsiaGym.asm::FuchsiaGymGuideWinT.et: See oli vägev lahing, treener JOHTOST!

maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartFisherT.label: FuchsiaMartFisherText
maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartFisherT.en:
I was hoping to buy some SAFARI
ZONE souvenirs, but it's closed…
maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartFisherT.et:
Lootsin osta SAFARI
ZONE suveniire, aga see on suletud…

maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartCooltra.label: FuchsiaMartCooltrainerFText
maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartCooltra.en: The SAFARI ZONE WARDEN's granddaughter lives in town.
maps/FuchsiaMart.asm::FuchsiaMartCooltra.et: SAFARI ZONE VALVURI lapselaps elab linnas.

maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.en:
Hey! You have a brand new kind of #DEX.
Did PROF.OAK give that to you?
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.et:
Hei! Sul on uhiuus #DEX.
Kas PROF.OAK andis selle sulle?

maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.en:
I got quite a shock at the GYM.
There were all these girls who looked identical.
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.et:
Sain SAALIS päris šoki.
Seal olid kõik need ühesugused tüdrukud.

maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FJanineImpersonatorText2
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.en: See? I look just like her now!
maps/FuchsiaPokecenter1F.asm::FuchsiaPok.et: Näed? Näen nüüd täpselt nagu tema välja!

maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkIntroText
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.en:
…sigh… I moved here, but I can't
sell my BICYCLES. Why is that?
Could you ride a BICYCLE and advertise for me?
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.et:
…ohh… Kolisin siia, aga ei suuda
oma RATTAID müüa. Miks küll?
Kas sõidaksid RATTAGA ja teeksid mulle reklaami?

maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkAgreedText
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.en:
Really? Great!
Give me your name and phone number,
and I'll loan you a BICYCLE.
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.et:
Tõesti? Suurepärane!
Anna oma nimi ja telefoninumber,
ja ma laenan sulle RATTA.

maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkFirstRateBikesText
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.en:
My BICYCLES are first-rate! You
can ride them anywhere.
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.et:
Mu RATTAD on esmaklassilised! Nendega
saab sõita igal pool.

maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkRefusedText
maps/GoldenrodBikeShop.asm::GoldenrodBik.en: …sigh… Oh, for the kindness of people…

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityPok.label: GoldenrodCityPokefanMText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityPok.en:
They built the new RADIO TOWER to
replace the old, creaky one.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityPok.et:
Uus RAADIOTORN ehitati vana,
krigiseva asemele.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.label: GoldenrodCityYoungster1Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.en:
I know there's a new BIKE SHOP, but
I can't find it anywhere.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.et:
Tean, et on uus JALGRATTAPOOD, aga
ma ei leia seda kuskilt.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.en:
Is that man in black dressed up
like a TEAM ROCKET member? How silly!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.et:
Kas see mustas mees on riides
nagu RAKETI KAMBA liige? Kui totter!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text_ClearedRadioTower
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.en:
Was that man in black really part
of TEAM ROCKET? I can't believe it!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.et:
Kas see mustas mees oli tõesti
RAKETI KAMBAST? Uskumatu!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.en:
The RADIO TOWER in GOLDENROD CITY is a landmark.
They're running a promotional cam- paign right now.
They'll modify your #GEAR,
so it can also serve as a radio.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.et:
GOLDENROD CITY RAADIOTORN on tuntud tähis.
Praegu käib seal reklaamikampaania.
Nad täiendavad su #GEARi,
et see töötaks ka raadiona.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text_GotRadioCard
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityCoo.en: Oh, your #GEAR works as a radio!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.label: GoldenrodCityYoungster2Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.en:
E-he-he-he…
I got in trouble for playing in the
basement of the DEPT.STORE.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityYou.et:
E-he-he-he…
Sain pahandada, et mängisin
KAUBAMAJA keldris.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityLas.label: GoldenrodCityLassText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityLas.en:
The man at that house rates your #MON names.
He can even rename your #MON.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityLas.et:
Mees selles majas hindab su #MONide nimesid.
Ta võib su #MONi isegi ümber nimetada.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityGra.label: GoldenrodCityGrampsText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityGra.en:
Whew! This is one big town. I don't
know where anything is.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityGra.et:
Ohoo! Küll on suur linn. Ma ei tea,
kus miski asub.

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText1
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en: So this is the RADIO TOWER…

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText2
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en: What do you want, you pest? Scram!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket1Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en: Stay out of the way! Beat it!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket2Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en:
Take over the RADIO TOWER…
What? It's none of your business!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.et:
Vallutada RAADIOTORN…
Mida? See pole sinu asi!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket3Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en:
#MON? They're nothing more than
tools for making money!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.et:
#MONid? Nad pole midagi muud kui
raha teenimise vahendid!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket4Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en:
Our dream will soon come true…
It was such a long struggle…
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.et:
Meie unistus täitub peagi…
See oli nii pikk võitlus…
