maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket5Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en: Hey, brat! You don't belong here! Get lost!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.et: Hei, jõmpsikas! Sa ei kuulu siia! Kao!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.label: GoldenrodCityRocket6Text
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.en: Come taste the true terror of TEAM ROCKET!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityRoc.et: Tule maitse RAKETI KAMBA tõelist õudust!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodDeptSto.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreSignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodDeptSto.en:
Full Selection of #MON Goods!
GOLDENROD CITY DEPT.STORE

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodGymSign.label: GoldenrodGymSignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodGymSign.en:
GOLDENROD CITY #MON GYM LEADER: WHITNEY
The Incredibly Pretty Girl!
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodGymSign.et:
GOLDENROD CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: WHITNEY
Uskumatult kena tüdruk!

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCitySig.label: GoldenrodCitySignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCitySig.en:
GOLDENROD CITY
The Festive City of Opulent Charm
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCitySig.et:
GOLDENROD CITY
Uhke sarmi pidulik linn

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityBik.label: GoldenrodCityBikeShopSignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityBik.en: The World is a Cycle Path! BIKE SHOP

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityGam.label: GoldenrodCityGameCornerSignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityGam.en:
Your Playground!
GOLDENROD CITY GAME CORNER

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityNam.label: GoldenrodCityNameRaterSignText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityNam.en:
NAME RATER
Get Your #MON Nicknames Rated

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityUnd.label: GoldenrodCityUndergroundSignSouthText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityUnd.en:
UNDERGROUND ENTRANCE
For Mobile Tips! #COM CENTER

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAskTeachAMoveText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.en:
I can teach your #MON amazing
moves if you'd like.
Should I teach a new move?
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.et:
Oskan õpetada su #MONile
hämmastavaid rünnakuid.
Kas õpetan uue rünnaku?

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAsk4000CoinsOkayText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.en: It will cost you 4000 coins. Okay?

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorWhichMoveShouldITeachText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.en:
Wahahah! You won't regret it!
Which move should I teach?
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.et:
Vahahaa! Sa ei kahetse!
Millist rünnakut õpetan?

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorHmTooBadText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.en: Hm, too bad. I'll have to get some cash from home…
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.et: Hm, kahju. Pean kodust raha tooma…

maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorIfYouUnderstandYouveMadeItText
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.en:
If you understand what's so amazing
about this move, you've made it as a trainer.
maps/GoldenrodCity.asm::GoldenrodCityMov.et:
Kui mõistad, mis selle rünnaku
juures nii vahva on, oled tõeline treener.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FGentlemanText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
The DEPT.STORE has a decent selection.
But some items are only available
as GAME CORNER prizes.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
KAUBAMAJAS on korralik valik.
Aga mõned esemed on saadaval vaid
MÄNGUNURGA auhindadena.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FPokefanFText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.en: I'm raring to shop again today!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FBugCatcherText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Mom's good at bargain hunting.
She always buys stuff at lower prices.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Ema on soodsate ostude meister.
Ta ostab alati odavamalt.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FDirectoryText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
1F SERVICE COUNTER
2F TRAINER'S MARKET
3F BATTLE COLLECTION
4F MEDICINE BOX
5F TM CORNER
6F TRANQUIL SQUARE
ROOFTOP LOOKOUT
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore1F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
1K TEENINDUSLETT
2K TREENERITE TURG
3K LAHINGUVARUSTUS
4K RAVIMIKAPP
5K TM-NURK
6K RAHUNURK
KATUSEVAADE

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FElevatorButton
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
We intend to sell items for #MON to hold.
This is a free gift. Have a #MON hold it.
By giving #MON items to hold, I
bet trainers will develop new battle techniques.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Kavatseme müüa #MONidele hoidmiseks esemeid.
See on tasuta kingitus. Lase #MONil seda hoida.
Andes #MONidele esemeid hoida,
usun, et treenerid arendavad uusi lahingutehnikaid.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FYoungsterText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
#GEAR can store up to ten phone numbers.
It's hard to decide which numbers to keep.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
#GEAR mahutab kuni kümme telefoninumbrit.
Raske on otsustada, millised numbrid alles hoida.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FCooltrainerFText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
I got my ABRA at the GAME CORNER.
Now it's my best partner.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Sain oma ABRA MÄNGUNURGAST.
Nüüd on see mu parim kaaslane.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FGentlemanText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
This DEPT.STORE makes me realize
that GOLDENROD is a big city.
The selection here is unmatched anywhere else.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore2F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
See KAUBAMAJA paneb mind mõistma,
et GOLDENROD on suur linn.
Siinne valik on võrreldamatu mujal.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore3FSuperNerdText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
I, I, I'm really impatient!
I use X SPEED in battle to speed up my #MON.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Ma, ma, ma olen tõesti kannatamatu!
Kasutan lahingus X SPEEDi, et oma #MONi kiirendada.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore3FRockerText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Hey! When you battle, do you use X SPECIAL?
It's awesome. It really jacks up SPECIAL ATTACK!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore3F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Hei! Kas kasutad lahingus X SPECIALit?
See on vägev. See kruvib korralikult ERIRÜNNAKUT!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FCooltrainerMText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Hey. I love strong #MON.
I feed them PROTEIN to crank up their ATTACK.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Hei. Armastan tugevaid #MONe.
Söödan neile PROTEINi, et RÜNNAKUT tõsta.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FGameboyKidText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Some #MON evolve only by
being traded via a Game Link cable.
I know of four: MACHOKE, KADABRA,
HAUNTER and, um, GRAVELER.
I heard there are others too.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Mõned #MONid arenevad ainult
Game Link kaabli teel vahetades.
Tean nelja: MACHOKE, KADABRA,
HAUNTER ja, öö, GRAVELER.
Kuulsin, et on ka teisi.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FDirectoryText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore4F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Let Us Pump Up Your #MON!
4F MEDICINE BOX

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThisMoveShouldBePerfectText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
It's very attached to you.
This move should be perfect for a pair like you.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Ta on sinusse väga kiindunud.
See rünnak sobib teie paarile ideaalselt.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItsAdorableText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
It's adorable!
You should teach it good TM moves.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Ta on armas!
Õpeta talle häid TM-rünnakuid.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItLooksEvilHowAboutThisTMText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en: It looks evil. How about this TM for it?
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et: Ta näeb kuri välja. Kuidas oleks selle TM-iga?

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThereAreTMsPerfectForMonText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
There are sure to be TMs that are
just perfect for your #MON.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Kindlasti leidub TM-e, mis su
#MONile ideaalselt sobivad.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftExplanationText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
MYSTERY GIFT.
With just a little beep, you get a gift.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
MYSTERY GIFT.
Väikese piiksuga saad kingituse.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftRequiresGBCText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en: The MYSTERY GIFT option requires a Game Boy Color.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et: MYSTERY GIFT nõuab Game Boy Colorit.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FLassText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
On Sundays, a lady comes to check out #MON.
She even gives away TMs!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Pühapäeviti tuleb üks daam #MONe vaatama.
Ta jagab isegi TM-e!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FPokefanMText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
You can't rename a #MON you get in a trade.
The name is a reflection of the
original trainer's feelings for it.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore5F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Vahetuses saadud #MONi ei saa ümber nimetada.
Nimi peegeldab algse treeneri
tundeid tema vastu.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodVendingText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en: A vending machine! Here's the menu.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodClangText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en: Clang! A can of {RAM} popped out!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodVendingNoSpaceText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en: There's no more room for stuff.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FLassText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Do you listen to LUCKY CHANNEL?
If you want to win, trade #MON
with as many people as possible to
get different ID numbers.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Kas kuulad LUCKY CHANNELit?
Kui tahad võita, vaheta #MONe
võimalikult paljude inimestega,
et saada erinevaid ID-numbreid.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FSuperNerdText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
If you're tired, try the vending machine's drinks.
Your #MON will love them too.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Kui oled väsinud, proovi automaadi jooke.
Ka su #MONidele maitsevad need.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FDirectoryText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStore6F.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Take a Break from Shopping!
6F TRANQUIL SQUARE

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt1Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Hey, kid! You're holding us up!
Our policy is to work behind the
scenes where no one can see us!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Hei, laps! Sa segad meid!
Meie komme on töötada kulisside
taga, kus keegi meid ei näe!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt2Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
I lose my passion for work if someone's watching.
Come on, kid, scoot!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Kaotan töökire, kui keegi vaatab.
Aitab, laps, jalga!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt3Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Oohah! Oohah!
The stuff on the ground's junk.
Take it if you want it!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreB1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Oohah! Oohah!
Maas vedelev kraam on rämps.
Võta, kui tahad!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanFText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en:
Whew, I'm tired.
I sometimes come up to the rooftop
to take a break from shopping.
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.et:
Uhh, olen väsinud.
Tulen vahel katusele
ostlemisest puhkama.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofFisherText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en:
Pardon? Who says an adult can't get into this?
I'm going to be back every day to
collect all the dolls!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.et:
Palun? Kes ütleb, et täiskasvanu ei tohi seda?
Käin siin iga päev tagasi,
et koguda kõik nukud!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTwinText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en: They have bargain sales here every so often.

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanMText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en:
There's something I really want, but
I don't have the necessary cash…
Maybe I'll sell off the BERRIES I've collected…
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.et:
On midagi, mida väga tahan, aga
mul pole vajalikku raha…
Ehk müün oma kogutud BERRYD maha…

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTeacherText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en:
Oh, everything is so cheap!
I bought so much, my PACK's crammed!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.et:
Oh, kõik on nii odav!
Ostsin nii palju, et mu PACK on täis!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofBugCatcherText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.en:
My #MON always get paralyzed or
poisoned when the chips are down…
So I came to buy some FULL HEAL.
I wonder if there's any left?
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Goldenr.et:
Mu #MONid halvatakse või
mürgitatakse alati kõige raskemal hetkel…
Seega tulin ostma FULL HEALi.
Huvitav, kas seda on veel?

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.label: Binoculars1Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.en:
These binoculars let me see far
away. Maybe I can see my own house.
Is it the one with the green roof?
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.et:
Need binoklid lasevad mul kaugele
näha. Ehk näen oma maja.
Kas see on see rohelise katusega?

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.label: Binoculars2Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.en:
Hey! Some trainers are battling on the road!
A #MON fired a flurry of leaves!
That makes me feel like battling right now!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.et:
Hei! Mõned treenerid võitlevad teel!
#MON tulistas lehtede laviini!
See paneb mind kohe võitlema tahtma!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.label: Binoculars3Text
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.en:
A FISHER caught a lot of MAGIKARP…
They're SPLASHing at the same time!
Look at the water going everywhere!
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::Binocul.et:
FISHER püüdis palju MAGIKARPi…
Nad SPLASHivad ühekorraga!
Vaata, kuidas vesi laiali paiskub!

maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::PokeDol.label: PokeDollVendingMachineText
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::PokeDol.en:
A vending machine for #MON dolls?
Insert money, then turn the crank…
But it's almost empty…
maps/GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.asm::PokeDol.et:
Automaat #MON nukkude jaoks?
Sisesta raha, siis keera vänta…
Aga see on peaaegu tühi…

maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherMySisterWentToSeeWigglyTreeRoute36Text
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.en:
Have you seen that wiggly tree that's
growing on ROUTE 36?
My little sister got all excited
and went to see it…
I'm worried… Isn't it dangerous?
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.et:
Kas oled näinud seda väänlevat puud,
mis kasvab ROUTE 36 peal?
Mu väike õde läks põnevil
ja läks seda vaatama…
Ma muretsen… kas pole ohtlik?

maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherAskWantToBorrowWaterBottleText
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.en:
Do you want to borrow the water
bottle too? I don't want you
doing anything dangerous with it.
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.et:
Kas soovid ka veepudelit
laenata? Ma ei taha, et sa
sellega midagi ohtlikku teed.

maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherHeresTheSquirtbottleText
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.en:
Oh, you're better than WHITNEY…
You'll be OK, then. Here's the SQUIRTBOTTLE!
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.et:
Oh, sa oled parem kui WHITNEY…
Küll sa hakkama saad. Siin on SQUIRTBOTTLE!

maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherLalalaHavePlentyOfWaterText
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.en: Lalala lalalala. Have plenty of water, my lovely!
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.et: Lalala lalalala. Joo palju vett, mu kallis!

maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopFloriaWonderIfSisWillLendWaterBottleText
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.en:
When I told my sis about the jiggly
tree, she told me it's dangerous.
If I beat WHITNEY, I wonder if she'll
lend me her water bottle…
maps/GoldenrodFlowerShop.asm::GoldenrodF.et:
Kui rääkisin õele sellest väänlevast
puust, ütles ta, et see on ohtlik.
Kui alistan WHITNEY, ehk siis
laenab ta mulle oma veepudeli…

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorIntroText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
Welcome!
We exchange your game coins for fabulous prizes!
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Tere tulemast!
Vahetame su mängumündid vapustavate auhindade vastu!

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoMoreRoomText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en: Sorry. You can't carry any more.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et: Vabandust. Sa ei saa rohkem kaasas kanda.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorQuitText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en: OK. Please save your coins and come again!
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et: OK. Hoia oma mündid alles ja tule jälle!

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoCoinCaseText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en: Oh? You don't have a COIN CASE.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPharmacistText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
This machine looks the same as the others.
I always play this slot machine. It
pays out more than others, I think.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
See masin näeb välja nagu teised.
Mängin alati seda mänguautomaati. See
maksab vist rohkem välja kui teised.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM1Text
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
These machines seem different
from the ones at CELADON CITY!
I just love this new slot machine.
It's more of a challenge than the ones in CELADON.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Need masinad tunduvad erinevad
CELADON CITY omadest!
Mulle lihtsalt meeldib see uus automaat.
See on suurem väljakutse kui CELADONI omad.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerMText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
Nothing is certain in this area.
Life is a gamble. I'm going to flip cards till I drop!
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Selles kandis pole miski kindel.
Elu on hasart. Keeran kaarte, kuni kokku kukun!

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanFText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
Card flip…
Different from the other machines.
I prefer it over the slots because
it's easier to figure the odds.
But the payout is much lower.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Kaardikeeramine…
Erineb teistest masinatest.
Eelistan seda automaatidele, sest
võimalusi on lihtsam arvutada.
Aga väljamakse on palju väiksem.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerFText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en: I won't quit until I win!

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerGentlemanText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
I taught BLIZZARD to my #MON.
It was hard to get enough coins for
it, but it was worth it.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Õpetasin oma #MONile BLIZZARDi.
Oli raske selle jaoks piisavalt
münte saada, aga see oli seda väärt.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM2Text
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
COIN CASE? I threw it away in the UNDERGROUND.
I couldn't win at the slots, and I
blew it on card flipping…
I got so furious, I tossed out my
COIN CASE in the UNDERGROUND.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
COIN CASE? Viskasin selle UNDERGROUNDI ära.
Ei suutnud automaatidel võita ja
vussasin kaardikeeramisega ära…
Sain nii raevu, et viskasin oma
COIN CASE UNDERGROUNDI.

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::MoveTutorI.label: MoveTutorInsideText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::MoveTutorI.en: Wahahah! The coins keep rolling in!

maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.label: GoldenrodGameCornerLeftTheirDrinkText
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.en:
Someone left their drink.
It smells sweet.
maps/GoldenrodGameCorner.asm::GoldenrodG.et:
Keegi jättis oma joogi.
See lõhnab magusalt.

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyBeforeText.label: WhitneyBeforeText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyBeforeText.en:
Hi! I'm WHITNEY!
Everyone was into #MON, so I got into it too!
#MON are super-cute!
You want to battle? I'm warning you--I'm good!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyBeforeText.et:
Tere! Olen WHITNEY!
Kõik olid #MONidesse kiindunud, nii et minagi!
#MONid on üliarmsad!
Tahad võidelda? Hoiatan – ma olen hea!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyShouldntBe.label: WhitneyShouldntBeSoSeriousText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyShouldntBe.en:
Sob…
…Waaaaaaah! You're mean!
You shouldn't be so serious! You… you child, you!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyShouldntBe.et:
Nuuks…
…Vääääää! Sa oled õel!
Ära ole nii tõsine! Sa… sa laps, sina!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyWhatDoYouW.label: WhitneyWhatDoYouWantText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyWhatDoYouW.en:
…Sniff…
What? What do you want? A BADGE?
Oh, right. I forgot. Here's PLAINBADGE.
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyWhatDoYouW.et:
…Nuuks…
Mida? Mida sa tahad? MÄRKI?
Ah jaa. Unustasin. Siin on PLAINBADGE.

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyPlainBadge.label: WhitneyPlainBadgeText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyPlainBadge.en:
PLAINBADGE lets your #MON use
STRENGTH outside of battle.
It also boosts your #MON's SPEED.
Oh, you can have this too!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyPlainBadge.et:
PLAINBADGE lubab su #MONil kasutada
STRENGTH väljaspool lahingut.
Samuti tõstab see su #MONi KIIRUST.
Oh, võta seegi!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyAttractTex.label: WhitneyAttractText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyAttractTex.en:
It's ATTRACT! It makes full use
of a #MON's charm.
Isn't it just perfect for a cutie like me?
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyAttractTex.et:
See on ATTRACT! See kasutab ära
#MONi võlu.
Kas pole minusuguse nunnu jaoks ideaalne?

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyGoodCryTex.label: WhitneyGoodCryText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyGoodCryTex.en:
Ah, that was a good cry!
Come for a visit again! Bye-bye!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::WhitneyGoodCryTex.et:
Ah, see oli hea nutt!
Tule veel külla! Pa-pa!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassCarrieSeenTex.label: LassCarrieSeenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassCarrieSeenTex.en:
Don't let my #MON's cute
looks fool you. They can whip you!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassCarrieSeenTex.et:
Ära lase mu #MONide nunnul
välimusel end petta. Nad annavad valu!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassCarrieBeatenT.label: LassCarrieBeatenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassCarrieBeatenT.en: Darn… I thought you were weak…

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetSeenTe.label: LassBridgetSeenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetSeenTe.en:
I like cute #MON better than strong #MON.
But I have strong and cute #MON!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetSeenTe.et:
Armsad #MONid meeldivad mulle rohkem kui tugevad.
Aga minu #MONid on tugevad JA armsad!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetAfterB.label: LassBridgetAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetAfterB.en:
I'm trying to beat WHITNEY, but… It's depressing.
I'm okay! If I lose, I'll just
try harder next time!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::LassBridgetAfterB.et:
Üritan WHITNEYT võita, aga… see on masendav.
Küll saan hakkama! Kui kaotan,
pingutan järgmisel korral rohkem!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BridgetWhitneyCri.label: BridgetWhitneyCriesText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BridgetWhitneyCri.en:
Oh, no. You made WHITNEY cry.
It's OK. She'll stop soon. She
always cries when she loses.
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BridgetWhitneyCri.et:
Oh ei. Panid WHITNEY nutma.
Pole hullu. Ta rahuneb varsti. Ta
nutab alati, kui kaotab.

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaSee.label: BeautyVictoriaSeenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaSee.en:
Oh, you are a cute little trainer!
I like you, but I won't hold back!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaSee.et:
Oh, sa oled armas väike treener!
Sa meeldid mulle, aga end tagasi ei hoia!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaAft.label: BeautyVictoriaAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaAft.en: Wow, you must be good to beat me! Keep it up!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautyVictoriaAft.et: Vau, pead kõva olema, et mind võita! Jätka!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaSee.label: BeautySamanthaSeenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaSee.en: Give it your best shot, or I'll take you down!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaSee.et: Anna endast parim, muidu võtan su maha!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaBea.label: BeautySamanthaBeatenText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaBea.en: No! Oh, MEOWTH, I'm so sorry!
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaBea.et: Ei! Oh, MEOWTH, mul on nii kahju!

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaAft.label: BeautySamanthaAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaAft.en: I taught MEOWTH moves for taking on any type…
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::BeautySamanthaAft.et: Õpetasin MEOWTHile rünnakud iga tüübi vastu…

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.label: GoldenrodGymGuideText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making!
This GYM is home to normal-type #MON trainers.
I recommend you use fighting-type #MON.
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION!
Selles SAALIS on tava-tüüpi #MONide treenerid.
Soovitan kasutada kaklus-tüüpi #MONe.

maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.label: GoldenrodGymGuideWinText
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.en: You won? Great! I was busy admiring the ladies here.
maps/GoldenrodGym.asm::GoldenrodGymGuide.et: Võitsid? Vahva! Ma imetlesin siinseid daame.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterTeacherText
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en:
If you treat your #MON nicely,
they will love you in return.
Oh? Let me see your {RAM}…
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et:
Kui kohtled oma #MONe kenasti,
armastavad nad sind vastu.
Oh? Näita oma {RAM}…

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LovesYouALot
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: It looks really happy! It must love you a lot.
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Näeb väga õnnelik välja! Ta armastab sind väga.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_ReallyTrustsYou
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: I get the feeling that it really trusts you.
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Mulle tundub, et ta usaldab sind väga.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_SortOfHappy
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: It's friendly toward you. It looks sort of happy.
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Ta on sinuga sõbralik. Näeb üsna õnnelik välja.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_NotUsedToYou
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: You should treat it better. It's not used to you.
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Kohtle teda paremini. Ta pole sinuga harjunud.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LooksMean
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: It doesn't seem to like you at all. It looks mean.
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Tundub, et sa ei meeldi talle üldse. Näeb pahur.

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterPokefanMText
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en:
I keep losing in battles, and my
#MON end up fainting…
Maybe that's why my #MON don't like me much…
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et:
Kaotan pidevalt lahingutes ja mu
#MONid minestavad…
Ehk sellepärast ma neile ei meeldigi…

maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterTwinText
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.en: When I use an item on my #MON, it acts really glad!
maps/GoldenrodHappinessRater.asm::Golden.et: Kui kasutan #MONil eset, on ta väga rõõmus!

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerTheTrainHasntComeInText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en:
The train hasn't come in…
I know! I'll carry the passengers on my back!
That won't work.
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.et:
Rong pole tulnud…
Tean! Kannan reisijad seljas!
See ei toimi.

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYouComingAboardText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en:
We'll soon depart for SAFFRON.
Are you coming aboard?
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.et:
Lahkume peagi SAFFRONI.
Kas tuled pardale?

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightThisWayText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en:
May I see your rail PASS, please?
OK. Right this way, please.
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.et:
Kas tohin näha su rongi-PASSi?
OK. Siiapoole, palun.

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDontHaveARailPassText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en: Sorry. You don't have a rail PASS.

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeToSeeYouAgainText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en: We hope to see you again!

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrivedInGoldenrodText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en:
We have arrived in GOLDENROD.
We hope to see you again.
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.et:
Saabusime GOLDENRODI.
Loodame sind jälle näha.

maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationGentlemanText
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.en:
I'm the PRESIDENT.
My dream was to build a train that
is faster than any #MON.
It really brings JOHTO much closer to KANTO.
maps/GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation.asm::Go.et:
Olen PRESIDENT.
Mu unistus oli ehitada rong, mis
on kiirem kui ükski #MON.
See toob JOHTO KANTOle palju lähemale.

maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseFisherText
maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.en:
Once while I was battling, my
#MON couldn't make any moves.
The POWER POINTS, or PP, of its
moves were all gone.
maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.et:
Kord lahingu ajal ei suutnud mu
#MON ühtki rünnakut teha.
Selle rünnakute POWER POINTS
ehk PP olid otsas.

maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseLassText
maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.en:
Sometimes, a healthy #MON
may be unable to use its moves.
If that happens, heal it at a #MON CENTER or use an item.
maps/GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse.asm::Goldenr.et:
Vahel ei suuda terve #MON
oma rünnakuid kasutada.
Siis ravi teda #MON KESKUSES või kasuta eset.

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistWalkToStairsFromRightDoorwayTileMovement
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Hello! Welcome to #COM CENTER TRADE CORNER.
You can trade #MON with other people far away.
To make a trade, we must hold your #MON.
Would you like to trade?
What kind of #MON do you want in return?
Fine. We will try to trade your
{RAM} for {RAM}.
We'll have to hold your #MON during the trade.
Please wait while we prepare the room for it.
Fine. We will try to trade your
{RAM} for a #MON that you have never seen.
We'll have to hold your #MON during the trade.
Please wait while we prepare the room for it.
Your trade #MON has been received.
It will take time to find a trade
partner. Please come back later.
Oh? You have only one #MON in your party.
Please come back once you've increased the size of your party.
We hope to see you again.
Communication error…
If we accept that #MON, what will you battle with?
Sorry. We can't accept an EGG.
Sorry, but your #MON appears to
be abnormal. We can't accept it.
Oh? Aren't we already holding a #MON of yours?
We'll check the rooms.
Please wait.
Thank you for your patience.
A trade partner has been found.
It's your new partner.
Please take care of it with love.
We hope to see you again.
Uh-oh. Your party is already full.
Please come back when you have room in your party.
It's unfortunate, but no one has
come forward as a trade partner.
Would you like your #MON back?
We have returned your #MON.
It's unfortunate, but no one has
come forward as a trade partner.
We've held your #MON for a long
time. As a result, it is very lonely.
Sorry, but we must return it to you.
We hope to see you again.
Fine. We will continue to hold your #MON.
Oh? You left your #MON with us only recently.
Please come back later.
We'll SAVE before connecting to the CENTER.
Which #MON do you want to trade?
Sorry, but we must cancel the trade.
Oh!
I see you have an EGG TICKET!
It's a coupon that special people can
redeem for a special #MON!
Let me give you a quick briefing.
Trades held at the TRADE CORNER are
between two trainers who don't
know each other's identity.
As a result, it may take time.
However, an ODD EGG is available just for you.
It will be sent to you right away.
Please choose one of the rooms in
the CENTER. An ODD EGG will be
sent from the chosen room.
Please wait a moment.
Thank you for waiting.
We received your ODD EGG.
Here it is!
Please raise it with loving care.
I'm awfully sorry.
The EGG TICKET exchange service isn't running now.
It's a #MON NEWS MACHINE.
What would you like to do?
#MON NEWS is news compiled from
the SAVE files of #MON trainers.
When reading the NEWS, your SAVE
file may be sent out.
The SAVE file data will contain your
adventure log and mobile profile.
Your phone number will not be sent.
The contents of the NEWS will vary
depending on the SAVE files sent by
you and the other #MON trainers.
You might even be in the NEWS!
Would you like to get the NEWS?
Reading the latest NEWS… Please wait.
There is no old NEWS…
The NEWS data is corrupted.
Please download the NEWS again.
We're making preparations.
Please come back later.
We will SAVE your progress before
starting the NEWS MACHINE.
Whoa, this #MON CENTER is huge.
They just built this place. They
installed lots of new machines too.
I thought up a fun new thing for the TRADE CORNER!
I make a PIDGEY hold MAIL, then
put it up for trade for another one!
If everyone did that, MAIL could
be traded with all sorts of people!
I call it PIDGEY MAIL!
If it becomes popular, I might
make lots of new friends!
They said you can trade #MON with
total strangers up here.
But they're still adjusting things.
Some girl I don't know sent me her
HOPPIP. You should trade
for a #MON that you want.
I received a female HOPPIP, but its named STANLEY!
That's my dad's name!
What is the NEWS MACHINE?
Does it get news from a wider area than the radio?
The #COM CENTER will link with all
#MON CENTERS in a wireless net.
That must mean I'll be able to
link with all sorts of people.
The machines here can't be used yet.
Still, it's nice coming to a trendy
place before other people.
My friend was in the NEWS a while
back. I was really surprised!
I get anxious if I don't check out the latest NEWS!
If I get in the NEWS and become
famous, I bet I'll be adored.
I wonder how I could get in the NEWS?
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Tere! Tere tulemast #COM KESKUSE VAHETUSNURKA.
Saad #MONe vahetada kaugete inimestega.
Vahetuseks peame su #MONi enda kätte võtma.
Kas soovid vahetada?
Millist #MONi tahad vastu?
Hea küll. Püüame vahetada su
{RAM} {RAM} vastu.
Vahetuse ajal peame su #MONi hoidma.
Palun oota, kuni ruumi ette valmistame.
Hea küll. Püüame vahetada su
{RAM} #MONi vastu, keda pole näinud.
Vahetuse ajal peame su #MONi hoidma.
Palun oota, kuni ruumi ette valmistame.
Su vahetus-#MON on vastu võetud.
Vahetuspartneri leidmine võtab
aega. Tule hiljem tagasi.
Oh? Sul on seltskonnas vaid üks #MON.
Tule tagasi, kui seltskond on suurem.
Loodame sind veel näha.
Sideviga…
Kui selle #MONi võtame, millega sa võitled?
Vabandust. EGG me vastu ei võta.
Vabandust, aga su #MON tundub
ebanormaalne. Me ei võta seda.
Oh? Kas su #MON pole juba meil hoiul?
Kontrollime toad üle.
Üks hetk.
Aitäh kannatlikkuse eest.
Vahetuspartner on leitud.
See on su uus partner.
Hoolitse tema eest armastusega.
Loodame sind veel näha.
Oih. Su seltskond on juba täis.
Tule tagasi, kui seltskonnas on ruumi.
Kahjuks pole keegi end
vahetuspartnerina pakkunud.
Kas soovid oma #MONi tagasi?
Tagastasime su #MONi.
Kahjuks pole keegi end
vahetuspartnerina pakkunud.
Oleme su #MONi kaua
hoidnud. Ta on väga üksildane.
Vabandust, peame ta sulle tagastama.
Loodame sind veel näha.
Hea küll. Jätkame su #MONi hoidmist.
Oh? Jätsid #MONi meile alles hiljuti.
Tule hiljem tagasi.
Salvestame enne KESKUSEGA ühendumist.
Millist #MONi soovid vahetada?
Vabandust, peame vahetuse tühistama.
Oh!
Näen, et sul on EGG TICKET!
See on kupong, mille erilised inimesed
saavad erilise #MONi vastu vahetada!
Annan sulle kiire ülevaate.
VAHETUSNURGA vahetused toimuvad
kahe treeneri vahel, kes ei
tunne teineteist.
Seetõttu võib see aega võtta.
Kuid ODD EGG on saadaval just sulle.
See saadetakse sulle kohe.
Palun vali üks KESKUSE
tubadest. ODD EGG saadetakse
valitud toast.
Palun oota hetk.
Aitäh ootamast.
Saime su ODD EGG kätte.
Siin see on!
Kasvata teda armastava hoolega.
Mul on kohutavalt kahju.
EGG TICKET vahetusteenus praegu ei tööta.
See on #MON UUDISTEMASIN.
Mida soovid teha?
#MON UUDISED koostatakse #MONi
treenerite salvestustest.
UUDISTE lugemisel võidakse su
salvestusfail välja saata.
Salvestusfail sisaldab su
seikluslogi ja mobiiliprofiili.
Su telefoninumbrit ei saadeta.
UUDISTE sisu erineb sõltuvalt
sinu ja teiste #MONi treenerite
saadetud salvestustest.
Sa võid isegi UUDISTESSE sattuda!
Kas soovid UUDISEID?
Loen uusimaid UUDISEID… Palun oota.
Vanu UUDISEID pole…
UUDISTE andmed on rikutud.
Palun laadi UUDISED uuesti alla.
Teeme ettevalmistusi.
Tule hiljem tagasi.
Salvestame su edenemise enne
UUDISTEMASINA käivitamist.
Ohoo, see #MON KESKUS on hiigelsuur.
See koht ehitati just. Nad
paigaldasid ka palju uusi masinaid.
Mõtlesin VAHETUSNURGA jaoks lõbusa idee!
Panen PIDGEY MAILi hoidma ja
panen ta teise vastu vahetusse!
Kui kõik nii teeks, saaks MAILi
vahetada kõikvõimalike inimestega!
Nimetan seda PIDGEY MAILiks!
Kui see läheb moodi, võin
leida palju uusi sõpru!
Öeldi, et siin saab #MONe
vahetada täiesti võõrastega.
Aga nad alles timmivad asju.
Üks võõras tüdruk saatis mulle
oma HOPPIP. Vaheta sinagi
endale sobiva #MONi vastu.
Sain emase HOPPIP, aga nimi on STANLEY!
See on mu isa nimi!
Mis on UUDISTEMASIN?
Kas see toob uudiseid laiemalt kui raadio?
#COM KESKUS ühendub juhtmevabas
võrgus kõigi #MON KESKUSTEGA.
See vist tähendab, et saan
ühenduda igasugu inimestega.
Siinseid masinaid veel kasutada ei saa.
Ikkagi on tore tulla trendikasse
kohta enne teisi.
Mu sõber oli hiljuti UUDISTES.
Olin tõesti üllatunud!
Muutun ärevaks, kui uusimaid UUDISEID ei loe!
Kui satun UUDISTESSE ja saan
kuulsaks, siis mind kindlasti jumaldatakse.
Kuidas küll UUDISTESSE saaks?

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FGameboyKidText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
The COLOSSEUM upstairs is for link battles.
Battle records are posted on the
wall, so I can't afford to lose.
I came over here when I got word
that GOLDENROD's #MON CENTER has
new machines that no one's ever seen before.
But it looks like they're still busy
with all their preparations…
Just seeing all these new things
here makes me feel younger!
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Ülakorruse COLOSSEUM on lingilahinguteks.
Lahingurekordid on seinal,
nii et kaotada ei tohi.
Tulin siia, kui kuulsin,
et GOLDENRODI #MON KESKUSES on
uued, seninägematud masinad.
Aga tundub, et neil on veel
ettevalmistustega tegemist…
Kõiki neid uusi asju nähes
tunnen end lausa nooremana!

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FLassText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
A higher level #MON doesn't always win.
After all, it may have a type disadvantage.
I don't think there is a single
#MON that is the toughest.
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Kõrgema tasemega #MON ei võida alati.
Sel võib ju olla tüübi-nõrkus.
Ma ei usu, et on olemas
üht kõige kõvemat #MONi.

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPleaseAcceptGSBallText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
<PLAYER>, isn't it?
Congratulations!
As a special deal, a GS BALL has been sent just for you!
Please accept it!
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
<PLAYER>, eks?
Palju õnne!
Eripakkumisena on GS BALL saadetud just sulle!
Palun võta vastu!

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPleaseDoComeAgainText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Please do come again!
#COM CENTER 1F INFORMATION
Left: ADMINISTRATION
Center: TRADE CORNER
Right: #MON NEWS
It's a #MON NEWS MACHINE!
It's not in operation yet…
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Tule kindlasti veel!
#COM KESKUS 1K INFO
Vasakul: ADMINISTRATSIOON
Keskel: VAHETUSNURK
Paremal: #MON UUDISED
See on #MON UUDISTEMASIN!
See ei tööta veel…

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFDoYouHaveEonMailText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Oh my, your pack looks so heavy!
Oh! Do you happen to have something named EON MAIL?
My daughter is after one.
You can part with one, can't you?
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Oi, su kott näeb nii raske välja!
Oh! Kas sul juhtub olema EON MAIL?
Mu tütar tahab üht.
Sa võid ju ühest loobuda?

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFThisIsForYouText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en:
Oh, that's great! Thank you, honey!
Here, this is for you in return!
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et:
Oi, tore! Aitäh, kullake!
Säh, see on sulle vastutasuks!

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFTooBadText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.en: Oh? You don't have one? Too bad.

maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFAnotherTimeThenText
maps/GoldenrodPokecenter1F.asm::Goldenro.et: Oh… Noh, siis mõni teine kord.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.label: SupernerdEricSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.en:
I got booted out of the GAME CORNER.
I was trying to cheat using my #MON…
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.et:
Mind visati MÄNGUNURGAST välja.
Üritasin oma #MONiga sohki teha…

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.label: SupernerdEricAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.en: I guess I have to do things fair and square…

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.label: SupernerdTeruSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.en:
Do you consider type alignments in battle?
If you know your type advantages,
you'll do better in battle.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.et:
Kas arvestad lahingus tüübisobivust?
Kui tunned oma tüübi eeliseid, läheb lahingus paremini.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.label: SupernerdTeruAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.en:
I know my #MON type alignments.
But I only use one type of #MON.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Supernerd.et:
Ma tean oma #MONi tüübisobivusi.
Aga kasutan vaid üht tüüpi #MONe.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.label: PokemaniacIssacSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.en:
My #MON just got a haircut!
I'll show you how strong it is!
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.et:
Mu #MON käis just juuksuris!
Näitan, kui tugev ta on!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.label: PokemaniacIssacAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.en:
Your #MON will like you more if
you give them haircuts.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.et: Su #MONid armastavad sind rohkem, kui lased neid pügada.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.label: PokemaniacDonaldSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.en:
I think you have some rare #MON with you.
Let me see them!
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.et:
Arvan, et sul on haruldasi #MONe kaasas.
Las ma näen neid!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.label: PokemaniacDonaldBeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.en: Gaah! I lost! That makes me mad!
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.et: Gaah! Kaotasin! See ajab mind vihale!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.label: PokemaniacDonaldAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.en:
Are you making a #DEX? Here's a hot tip.
The HIKER on ROUTE 33, ANTHONY, is a good guy.
He'll phone you if he sees any rare #MON.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Pokemania.et:
Kas koostad #DEXi? Siin on kuum vihje.
ROUTE 33 MATKAJA ANTHONY on tore mees.
Ta helistab sulle, kui näeb haruldasi #MONe.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundBasementKeyOpenedDoorText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: The BASEMENT KEY opened the door.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherOfferHaircutText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Welcome!
I run the #MON SALON!
I'm the older and better of the two HAIRCUT BROTHERS.
I can make your #MON beautiful for just ¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_OLDER_HAIRCUT_PRICE}.
Would you like me to do that?
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Tere tulemast!
Pean #MON SALONGI!
Olen kahest JUUKSURVENNAST vanem ja parem.
Teen su #MONi ilusaks vaid ¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_OLDER_HAIRCUT_PRICE} eest.
Kas soovid?

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherWatchItBecomeBeautifulText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et: Olgu! Vaata, kuidas ta ilusaks muutub!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherThatsAShameText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: Is that right? That's a shame!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherYoullNeedMoreMoneyText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: You'll need more money than that.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et: Sul on selleks liiga vähe raha.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherOneHaircutADayText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: I do only one haircut a day. I'm done for today.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et: Teen vaid ühe soengu päevas. Tänaseks olen valmis.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherOfferHaircutText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en:
Welcome to the #MON SALON!
I'm the younger and less expensive of the two HAIRCUT BROTHERS.
I'll spiff up your #MON for just ¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_YOUNGER_HAIRCUT_PRICE}.
So? How about it?
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Tere tulemast #MON SALONGI!
Olen kahest JUUKSURVENNAST noorem ja odavam.
Turgutan su #MONi vaid ¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_YOUNGER_HAIRCUT_PRICE} eest.
Noh? Kuidas oleks?

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherIllMakeItLookCoolText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: OK! I'll make it look cool!

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherShortOnFundsText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en: You're a little short on funds.

maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherOneHaircutADayText
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.en:
I can do only one haircut a day.
Sorry, but I'm all done for today.
maps/GoldenrodUnderground.asm::Goldenrod.et:
Teen vaid ühe soengu päevas.
Vabandust, aga tänaseks olen valmis.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: UndergroundRivalBeforeText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
Hold it!
I saw you, so I tailed you.
I don't need you underfoot while I
take care of TEAM ROCKET.
…Wait a second. You beat me before, didn't you?
That was just a fluke.
But I repay my debts!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Seis!
Nägin sind, nii et jälitasin.
Ma ei vaja sind jalus, kui RAKETI KAMBAGA tegelen.
…Oota hetk. Sa võitsid mind varem, eks?
See oli lihtsalt juhus.
Aga mina maksan võlad tagasi!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: UndergroundRivalWinText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
…Why… Why do I lose?
I've assembled the toughest #MON.
I didn't ease up on the gas.
So why do I lose?
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
…Miks… Miks ma kaotan?
Olen kokku pannud kõige kõvemad #MONid.
Ma ei võtnud gaasi maha.
Nii et miks ma kaotan?

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: UndergroundRivalAfterText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
…I don't understand…
Is what that LANCE guy said true?
That I don't treat #MON properly?
Love…
Trust…
Are they really what I lack?
Are they keeping me from winning?
I… I just don't understand.
But it's not going to end here.
Not now. Not because of this.
I won't give up my dream of becoming
the world's best #MON trainer!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
…Ma ei mõista…
Kas see, mida see LANCE ütles, on tõsi?
Et ma ei kohtle #MONe õigesti?
Armastus…
Usaldus…
Kas need ongi see, millest mul puudu jääb?
Kas need hoiavad mind võitmast?
Ma… ma lihtsalt ei mõista.
Aga see ei lõpe siin.
Mitte nüüd. Mitte selle pärast.
Ma ei loobu oma unistusest saada maailma parimaks #MONi treeneriks!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: UndergroundRivalLossText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
Humph. This is my real power, wimp.
I'll make TEAM ROCKET history.
And I'm going to grind that LANCE under my heels.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Hmph. See on mu tõeline vägi, nõrguke.
Teen RAKETI KAMBALE lõpu peale.
Ja jahvatan selle LANCE'i oma kandade all.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_SuperNerdText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
I was challenged to a battle downstairs.
It's rough down there. You'd better be careful.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Mind kutsuti allkorrusel lahingusse.
Seal all on karm. Parem ole ettevaatlik.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_TeacherText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
There are some shops downstairs…
But there are also trainers.
I'm scared to go down there.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
All on mõned poed…
Aga seal on ka treenereid.
Kardan sinna alla minna.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM11SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
Open one shutter, another closes.
Bet you can't get where you want!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Ava üks ruloo, teine sulgub.
Vean kihla, et sa ei jõua sinna, kuhu tahad!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM11BeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Drat! I was sunk by indecision!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Pagan! Uputas mind otsustamatus!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM11AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
I'm confused too… The switch on the
end is the one to press first, but…
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Mina olen ka segaduses… Otsas olev lüliti tuleb esimesena vajutada, aga…

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM25SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
Kwahaha!
Confounded by the shutters, are we?
I'll let you in on a secret if you can beat me!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Kwahahaa!
Rulood ajasid segadusse, mis?
Räägin sulle saladuse, kui suudad mind võita!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM25BeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Uwww… I blew it.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Uwww… Vedasin alt.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM25AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
All right. A hint!
Change the order of switching.
That'll change the ways the shutters open and close.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Hea küll. Vihje!
Muuda lülitamise järjekorda.
See muudab, kuidas rulood avanevad ja sulguvad.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarDuncanSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Fork over your goodies!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Anna oma kraam välja!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarDuncanBeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Mercy!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Halasta!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarDuncanAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Steal and sell! That's basic in crime, kid!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Varasta ja müü! See on kuritöös põhitõde, laps!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarEddieSeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
They ditched this project before they finished.
I'm searching for leftover loot.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Nad jätsid selle projekti pooleli.
Otsin ülejäänud saaki.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarEddieBeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Over the top!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Üle mõistuse!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: BurglarEddieAfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE?
What do you want to go there for?
There's nothing down there.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
MAA-ALUNE LADU?
Mis sa sinna minna tahad?
Seal all pole midagi.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM13SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
I don't care if you're lost.
You show up here, you're nothing but a victim!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Mul on ükskõik, kas oled eksinud.
Siia ilmudes oled sa vaid ohver!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM13BeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Urk! Yeah, think you're cool, huh?
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Urk! Jah, arvad end lahe olevat, mis?

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntM13AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: You must have ice in your veins to dis TEAM ROCKET.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Sul peab jää soontes olema, et RAKETI KAMBALE vastu hakata.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch1
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's labeled SWITCH 1.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Sellel on kiri LÜLITI 1.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntF3SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en:
Are you lost? No, you can't be.
You don't have that scared look.
I'll give you something to be scared about!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et:
Kas oled eksinud? Ei, ei saa olla.
Sul pole seda hirmunud ilmet.
Annan sulle põhjust kartmiseks!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntF3BeatenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: How could you?
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Kuidas sa võisid?

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: GruntF3AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: Go wherever you'd like! Get lost! See if I care!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Mine kuhu tahad! Kao! Mind ei koti!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_OffTurnOn
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's OFF. Turn it ON?
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: See on VÄLJAS. Panna SISSE?

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_OnTurnOff
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's ON. Turn it OFF?
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: See on SEES. Panna VÄLJA?

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch2
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's labeled SWITCH 2.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Sellel on kiri LÜLITI 2.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch3
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's labeled SWITCH 3.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Sellel on kiri LÜLITI 3.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.label: SwitchRoomText_Emergency
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.en: It's labeled EMERGENCY.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntra.et: Sellel on kiri HÄDAOLUKORD.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM24SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
How did you get this far?
I guess it can't be helped. I'll dispose of you.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
Kuidas sa nii kaugele jõudsid?
Vist pole midagi teha. Kõrvaldan su.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM24AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
TEAM ROCKET will keep going, waiting for the return of GIOVANNI.
We'll do whatever it takes.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
RAKETI KAMP jätkab, oodates GIOVANNI naasmist.
Teeme, mis vaja.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM14SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
You're not going any farther!
I don't show mercy to my enemies, not even brats!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
Sa ei lähe edasi!
Ma ei halasta vaenlastele, isegi mitte jõmpsikatele!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM14AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
I lost…
Please forgive me, GIOVANNI!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM15SeenText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! I remember you!
You got me good at our hideout!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
Hjukk-hjukk-hjukk! Mäletan sind!
Andsid mulle meie peidikus korralikult!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: GruntM15AfterBattleText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! That was a blast! I'll remember you!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et: Hjukk-hjukk-hjukk! See oli lõbus! Ma mäletan sind!

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: DirectorIntroText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
DIRECTOR: Who? What? You came to rescue me?
Thank you!
The RADIO TOWER!
What's happening there?
Taken over by TEAM ROCKET?
Here. Take this CARD KEY.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
DIREKTOR: Kes? Mis? Tulid mind päästma?
Aitäh!
RAADIOTORN!
Mis seal toimub?
RAKETI KAMP võttis üle?
Säh. Võta see CARD KEY.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: DirectorCardKeyText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en: DIRECTOR: Use that to open the shutters on 3F.
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et: DIREKTOR: Kasuta seda, et avada 3. korruse rulood.

maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.label: DirectorAfterText
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.en:
I'm begging you to help.
There's no telling what they'll do if
they control the transmitter.
They may even be able to control
#MON using a special signal!
You're the only one I can call on.
Please save the RADIO TOWER…
And all the #MON nationwide!
maps/GoldenrodUndergroundWarehouse.asm::.et:
Anun sind, aita.
Pole teada, mida nad teevad, kui saatja nende kontrolli all on.
Nad võivad isegi #MONe erisignaaliga juhtida!
Ainult sinu peale saan loota.
Palun päästa RAADIOTORN…
Ja kõik #MONid üle riigi!

maps/GuideGentsHouse.asm::GuideGentsHous.label: GuideGentsHouseGuideGentText
maps/GuideGentsHouse.asm::GuideGentsHous.en:
When I was a wee lad, I was a hotshot trainer!
Here's a word of advice: Catch lots of #MON!
Treat them all with kindness!
maps/GuideGentsHouse.asm::GuideGentsHous.et:
Kui olin poisike, olin tipptreener!
Siin on nõuanne: Püüa palju #MONe!
Kohtle neid kõiki lahkelt!

maps/HallOfFame.asm::HallOfFame_LanceTex.label: HallOfFame_LanceText
maps/HallOfFame.asm::HallOfFame_LanceTex.en:
LANCE: It's been a long time since I last came here.
This is where we honor the LEAGUE
CHAMPIONS for all eternity.
Their courageous #MON are also inducted.
Here today, we witnessed the rise
of a new LEAGUE CHAMPION--a
trainer who feels compassion for,
and trust toward, all #MON.
A trainer who succeeded through
perseverance and determination.
The new LEAGUE CHAMPION who has
all the makings of greatness!
<PLAY_G>, allow me to register you
and your partners as CHAMPIONS!
maps/HallOfFame.asm::HallOfFame_LanceTex.et:
LANCE: Palju aega on möödas, kui viimati siin käisin.
Siin austame LIIGA TŠEMPIONE igavesti.
Ka nende vaprad #MONid pühitsetakse.
Täna nägime uue LIIGA TŠEMPIONI tõusu — treeneri, kes tunneb kõigi #MONide vastu kaastunnet ja usaldust.
Treeneri, kes saavutas edu visaduse ja sihikindlusega.
Uus LIIGA TŠEMPION, kellel on kõik suuruse eeldused!
<PLAY_G>, lubage registreerida sina ja su partnerid TŠEMPIONITENA!

maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.label: IlexForestApprenticeIntroText
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.en:
Oh, man… My boss is going to be steaming…
The FARFETCH'D that CUTS trees
for charcoal took off on me.
I can't go looking for it here in the ILEX FOREST.
It's too big, dark and scary for me…
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.et:
Oh ei… Mu ülemus läheb marru…
FARFETCH'D, kes lõikab söe jaoks
puid, jooksis mu käest minema.
Ma ei julge teda siit ILEX FORESTIST otsida.
See on liiga suur, pime ja hirmus…

maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.label: IlexForestApprenticeAfterText
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.en:
Wow! Thanks a whole bunch!
My boss's #MON won't obey me because I don't have a BADGE.
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestApprentic.et:
Vau! Suur-suur tänu!
Ülemuse #MON ei kuula mind, sest mul pole MÄRKI.

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.label: Text_CharcoalMasterIntro
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.en:
Ah! My FARFETCH'D!
You found it for us, kid?
Without it, we wouldn't be able
to CUT trees for charcoal.
Thanks, kid!
Now, how can I thank you…
I know! Here, take this.
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.et:
Ah! Minu FARFETCH'D!
Leidsid ta meile üles, laps?
Ilma temata ei saaks me
söe jaoks puid CUT-iga langetada.
Aitäh, laps!
Kuidas ma sind tänada saaksin…
Tean! Säh, võta see.

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.label: Text_CharcoalMasterOutro
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.en:
That's the CUT HM. Teach that to a
#MON to clear small trees.
Of course, you have to have the
GYM BADGE from AZALEA to use it.
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.et:
See on CUT HM. Õpeta see #MONile,
et väikseid puid raadata.
Muidugi vajad selle kasutamiseks
AZALEA SAALI MÄRKI.

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.label: Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.en:
Do you want to apprentice as a
charcoal maker with me?
You'll be firstrate in ten years!
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_CharcoalMaster.et:
Kas tahaksid minu juures
söepõletajaks õppida?
Kümne aastaga saad meistriks!

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttIntro.label: Text_HeadbuttIntro
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttIntro.en:
What am I doing?
I'm shaking trees using HEADBUTT.
It's fun. Here, you try it too!
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttIntro.et:
Mida ma teen?
Raputan puid HEADBUTT-iga.
See on lõbus. Säh, proovi sina ka!

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttOutro.label: Text_HeadbuttOutro
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttOutro.en: Rattle trees with HEADBUTT. Sometimes, sleeping #MON fall out.
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_HeadbuttOutro.et: Raputa puid HEADBUTT-iga. Vahel kukub magav #MON välja.

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_IlexForestLass.label: Text_IlexForestLass
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_IlexForestLass.en: Did something happen to the forest's guardian?

maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestSignpostT.label: IlexForestSignpostText
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestSignpostT.en:
ILEX FOREST is so overgrown with
trees that you can't see the sky.
Please watch out for items that may have been dropped.
maps/IlexForest.asm::IlexForestSignpostT.et:
ILEX FOREST on nii puid täis
kasvanud, et taevast ei paista.
Pane tähele maha pudenenud esemeid.

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_IlexForestShri.label: Text_IlexForestShrine
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_IlexForestShri.en:
ILEX FOREST SHRINE…
It's in honor of the forest's protector…
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_IlexForestShri.et:
ILEX FORESTI PÜHAMU…
See on metsa kaitsja auks…

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_ShrineCelebiEv.label: Text_ShrineCelebiEvent
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_ShrineCelebiEv.en:
ILEX FOREST SHRINE…
It's in honor of the forest's protector…
Oh? What is this?
It's a hole. It looks like the
GS BALL would fit inside it.
Want to put the GS BALL here?
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_ShrineCelebiEv.et:
ILEX FORESTI PÜHAMU…
See on metsa kaitsja auks…
Oh? Mis see on?
See on auk. Näib, et
GS BALL mahuks sinna.
Panna GS BALL siia?

maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_KurtCaughtCele.label: Text_KurtCaughtCelebi
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_KurtCaughtCele.en:
Whew, wasn't that something!
<PLAYER>, that was fantastic. Thanks!
The legends about that SHRINE were real after all.
I feel inspired by what I just saw.
It motivates me to make better BALLS!
I'm going!
maps/IlexForest.asm::Text_KurtCaughtCele.et:
Ohoo, oli see alles vaatemäng!
<PLAYER>, see oli fantastiline. Aitäh!
Legendid selle PÜHAMU kohta olid ju tõesed.
See, mida just nägin, andis mulle indu.
See innustab mind paremaid PALLE tegema!
Ma lähen!

maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneSeen.label: BugCatcherWayneSeenText
maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneSeen.en:
Don't sneak up on me like that!
You frightened a #MON away!
maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneSeen.et:
Ära hiili mulle niimoodi ligi!
Sa peletasid #MONi minema!

maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneAfte.label: BugCatcherWayneAfterBattleText
maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneAfte.en:
A #MON I've never seen before
fell out of the tree when I used HEADBUTT.
I ought to use HEADBUTT in other places too.
maps/IlexForest.asm::BugCatcherWayneAfte.et:
Kui kasutasin HEADBUTT-i, kukkus
puust välja #MON, keda polnud varem näinud.
Peaksin HEADBUTT-i ka mujal kasutama.

maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.label: IlexForestAzaleaGateOfficerText
maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.en: ILEX FOREST is big. Be careful! Don't get lost.
maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.et: ILEX FOREST on suur. Ole ettevaatlik! Ära eksi ära.

maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.label: IlexForestAzaleaGateGrannyText
maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.en:
The FOREST is watched over by its protector.
Stay out of mischief!
maps/IlexForestAzaleaGate.asm::IlexFores.et:
METSA valvab selle kaitsja.
Hoidu vallatustest!

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Indi.label: IndigoPlateauPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Indi.en:
At the #MON LEAGUE, you'll get
tested by the ELITE FOUR.
You have to beat them all. If you
lose, you have to start all over!
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Indi.et:
#MON LIIGAS paneb sind
proovile ELITE FOUR.
Sa pead nad kõik alistama. Kui
kaotad, pead kõik otsast alustama!

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.label: PlateauRivalText1
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.en:
Hold it.
You're going to take the #MON
LEAGUE challenge now?
That's not going to happen.
My super-welltrained #MON
are going to pound you.
<PLAYER>! I challenge you!
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.et:
Pea kinni.
Sa lähed nüüd #MON
LIIGA väljakutsele?
Seda ei juhtu.
Mu ülihästi treenitud #MONid
virutavad sulle.
<PLAYER>! Kutsun sind välja!

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.label: PlateauRivalText2
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.en:
…Darn… I still can't win…
I… I have to think more about my #MON…
Humph! Try not to lose!
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.et:
…Pagan… Ma ikka ei võida…
Ma… pean oma #MONidele rohkem mõtlema…
Hmph! Ürita mitte kaotada!

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.label: PlateauRivalLoseText
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.en:
…
Whew… With my partners,
I'm going to be the CHAMPION!
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Plat.et:
…
Uhh… Oma kaaslastega
saab minust TŠEMPION!

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.label: TeleportGuyText1
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.en:
Ah! You're challenging the ELITE
FOUR? Are you sure you're ready?
If you need to train some more,
my ABRA can help you.
It can TELEPORT you home.
Would you like to go home now?
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.et:
Ah! Kutsud ELITE
FOUR väljakutsele? Oled kindel, et oled valmis?
Kui pead veel treenima,
saab mu ABRA sind aidata.
See saab su koju TELEPORTIDA.
Kas tahad nüüd koju minna?

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.label: TeleportGuyYesText
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.en: OK, OK. Picture your house in your mind…
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.et: OK, OK. Kujuta oma maja mõttes ette…

maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.label: TeleportGuyNoText
maps/IndigoPlateauPokecenter1F.asm::Tele.en: OK, OK. The best of luck to you!

maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.label: KarenScript_KarenBeforeText
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.en:
I am KAREN of the ELITE FOUR.
You're <PLAYER>? How amusing.
I love dark-type #MON.
I find their wild, tough image to be
so appealing. And they're so strong.
Think you can take them? Just try to entertain me.
Let's go.
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.et:
Olen KAREN ELIITNELIKUST.
Sa oled <PLAYER>? Kui lõbus.
Mulle meeldivad pime-tüüpi #MONid.
Nende metsik, karm kuvand on nii ahvatlev. Ja nad on nii tugevad.
Arvad, et saad neile jagu? Proovi mind lõbustada.
Lähme.

maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.label: KarenScript_KarenBeatenText
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.en: Well, aren't you good. I like that in a trainer.
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenBe.et: No oled sa alles hea. See meeldib mulle treeneri juures.

maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenDe.label: KarenScript_KarenDefeatText
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenDe.en:
Strong #MON.
Weak #MON.
That is only the selfish perception of people.
Truly skilled trainers should
try to win with their favorites.
I like your style. You understand what's important.
Go on--the CHAMPION is waiting.
maps/KarensRoom.asm::KarenScript_KarenDe.et:
Tugevad #MONid.
Nõrgad #MONid.
See on vaid inimeste isekas arusaam.
Tõeliselt osavad treenerid peaksid püüdma võita oma lemmikutega.
Mulle meeldib su stiil. Sa mõistad, mis on tähtis.
Mine edasi — TŠEMPION ootab.

maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBefor.label: KogaScript_KogaBeforeText
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBefor.en:
Fwahahahaha!
I am KOGA of the ELITE FOUR.
I live in shadows, a ninja!
My intricate style will confound and destroy you!
Confusion, sleep, poison…
Prepare to be the victim of my sinister technique!
Fwahahahaha!
#MON is not merely about brute
force--you shall see soon enough!
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBefor.et:
Fwahahahaa!
Olen KOGA ELIITNELIKUST.
Elan varjudes, olen nindža!
Minu keerukas stiil ajab sind segadusse ja hävitab sind!
Segadus, uni, mürk…
Valmistu saama minu kurja tehnika ohvriks!
Fwahahahaa!
#MONides ei loe vaid toores jõud — küll sa varsti näed!

maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBeate.label: KogaScript_KogaBeatenText
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBeate.en: Ah! You have proven your worth!
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaBeate.et: Ah! Sa oled oma väärtust tõestanud!

maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaDefea.label: KogaScript_KogaDefeatText
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaDefea.en:
I subjected you to everything I could muster.
But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills.
Go on to the next room, and put your abilities to test!
maps/KogasRoom.asm::KogaScript_KogaDefea.et:
Panin sind kõigele vastu, mida vähegi suutsin.
Aga mu pingutused nurjusid. Pean oma oskusi lihvima.
Mine järgmisse tuppa ja pane oma võimed proovile!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtMakin.label: KurtsHouseKurtMakingBallsMustWaitText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtMakin.en:
Hm? Who are you?
<PLAYER>, eh? You want me to make some BALLS?
Sorry, but that'll have to wait.
Do you know TEAM ROCKET? Ah, don't
worry. I'll tell you anyhow.
TEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses #MON for their dirty work.
They're supposed to have disbanded three years ago.
Anyway, they're at the WELL, cutting
off SLOWPOKETAILS for sale!
So I'm going to go give them a lesson in pain!
Hang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT is on his way!
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtMakin.et:
Hm? Kes sina oled?
<PLAYER>, ah? Tahad, et teeksin PALLE?
Vabandust, aga see peab ootama.
Kas tead RAKETI KAMPA? Ah, ära
muretse. Räägin niikuinii.
RAKETI KAMP on kuri jõuk, kes
kasutab #MONe räpaseks tööks.
Nad pidid kolm aastat tagasi laiali minema.
Igatahes on nad kaevu juures ja
lõikavad müügiks SLOWPOKETAILe!
Nii et lähen annan neile valuõppetunni!
Pea vastu, SLOWPOKE! Vana KURT tuleb appi!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtHonor.label: KurtsHouseKurtHonoredToMakeBallsText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtHonor.en:
KURT: Hi, <PLAYER>!
You handled yourself like a real hero at the WELL.
I like your style!
I would be honored to make BALLS for
a trainer like you.
This is all I have now, but take it.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtHonor.et:
KURT: Tere, <PLAYER>!
Kaevus käitusid nagu tõeline kangelane.
Mulle meeldib su stiil!
Mul oleks au teha PALLE
sinusugusele treenerile.
See on kõik, mis mul on, aga võta.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtBalls.label: KurtsHouseKurtBallsFromApricornsText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtBalls.en:
KURT: I make BALLS from APRICORNS.
Collect them from trees and bring 'em to me.
I'll make BALLS out of them.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtBalls.et:
KURT: Teen PALLE APRICORNIDEST.
Kogu neid puudelt ja too mulle.
Teen neist PALLE.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtAskYo.label: KurtsHouseKurtAskYouHaveAnApricornText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtAskYo.en:
KURT: You have an APRICORN for me?
Fine! I'll turn it into a BALL.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtAskYo.et:
KURT: Kas sul on mulle APRICORN?
Hea küll! Teen sellest PALLI.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtItWil.label: KurtsHouseKurtItWillTakeADayText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtItWil.en:
KURT: It'll take a day to make you a
BALL. Come back for it later.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtItWil.et:
KURT: PALLI valmistamiseks kulub
päev. Tule hiljem järele.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtDontB.label: KurtsHouseKurtDontBotherMeText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtDontB.en: KURT: I'm working! Don't bother me!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtJustF.label: KurtsHouseKurtJustFinishedYourBallText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtJustF.en: KURT: Ah, <PLAYER>! I just finished your BALL. Here!
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtJustF.et: KURT: Ah, <PLAYER>! Su PALL sai valmis. Säh!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtTurne.label: KurtsHouseKurtTurnedOutGreatText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtTurne.en:
KURT: That turned out great.
Try catching #MON with it.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtTurne.et:
KURT: See tuli kenasti välja.
Proovi sellega #MONi püüda.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtGrand.label: KurtsHouseKurtGranddaughterHelpingWorkFasterText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtGrand.en:
KURT: Now that my granddaughter is
helping me, I can work much faster.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtGrand.et:
KURT: Nüüd, kui lapselaps mind
aitab, saan palju kiiremini töötada.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtWhatI.label: KurtsHouseKurtWhatIsThatText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtWhatI.en:
Wh-what is that?
I've never seen one before.
It looks a lot like a # BALL,
but it appears to be something else.
Let me check it for you.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtWhatI.et:
M-mis see on?
Pole varem sellist näinud.
See sarnaneb väga # PALLIGA,
aga näib olevat midagi muud.
Las ma uurin seda.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtThisB.label: KurtsHouseKurtThisBallStartedToShakeText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtThisB.en:
<PLAYER>!
This BALL started to shake while I was checking it.
There must be something to this!
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseKurtThisB.et:
<PLAYER>!
See PALL hakkas uurides värisema.
Selles peab midagi olema!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.label: KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeGoneText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.en:
The SLOWPOKE are gone… Were they
taken away by bad people?
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.et:
SLOWPOKE'd on kadunud… Kas halvad
inimesed viisid nad ära?

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterL.label: KurtsGranddaughterLonelyText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterL.et: Vanaisa on läinud… mul on nii üksik…

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.label: KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeBackText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.en:
The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came
back! Its TAIL is growing back too!
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterS.et:
SLOWPOKE, kelle isa mulle andis,
tuli tagasi! Saba kasvab ka tagasi!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterD.label: KurtsGranddaughterDadText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterD.en:
Dad works at SILPH where he studies # BALLS.
I have to stay home with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterD.et:
Isa töötab SILPHis ja uurib # PALLE.
Mina jään koju vanaisa ja SLOWPOKE'ga.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterH.label: KurtsGranddaughterHelpText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterH.en:
I get to help Grandpa now!
We'll make good BALLS for you, so please wait!
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterH.et:
Nüüd saan vanaisa aidata!
Teeme sulle head PALLE, palun oota!

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterG.label: KurtsGranddaughterGSBallText
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterG.en:
Grandpa's checking a BALL right now.
So I'm waiting till he's done.
maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsGranddaughterG.et:
Vanaisa uurib praegu üht PALLI.
Ootan, kuni ta lõpetab.

maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseCelebiSta.label: KurtsHouseCelebiStatueText
