maps/KurtsHouse.asm::KurtsHouseCelebiSta.en: It's a statue of the forest's protector.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceForc.label: LakeOfRageLanceForcedToEvolveText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceForc.en:
This lake is full of GYARADOS but nothing else…
So the MAGIKARP are being forced to evolve…
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceForc.et:
See järv on GYARADOSE täis, aga muud pole…
Nii et MAGIKARPid on sunnitud arenema…

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceIntr.label: LakeOfRageLanceIntroText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceIntr.en:
Did you come here because of the rumors?
You're <PLAYER>? I'm LANCE, a trainer like you.
I heard some rumors, so I came to investigate…
I saw the way you battled earlier, <PLAY_G>.
I can tell that you're a trainer
with considerable skill.
If you don't mind, could you help me investigate?
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceIntr.et:
Kas tulid siia kuulujuttude pärast?
Sa oled <PLAYER>? Mina olen LANCE, sinusugune treener.
Kuulsin kuuldusi, nii et tulin uurima…
Nägin, kuidas sa enne võitlesid, <PLAY_G>.
Näen, et oled märkimisväärse oskusega treener.
Kui sa ei pahanda, kas aitaksid mul uurida?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRadi.label: LakeOfRageLanceRadioSignalText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRadi.en:
LANCE: Excellent!
It seems that the LAKE's MAGIKARP
are being forced to evolve.
A mysterious radio broadcast coming
from MAHOGANY is the cause.
I'll be waiting for you, <PLAY_G>.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRadi.et:
LANCE: Suurepärane!
Näib, et JÄRVE MAGIKARPe sunnitakse arenema.
Põhjuseks on müstiline raadiosaade, mis tuleb MAHOGANYST.
Ootan sind, <PLAY_G>.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRefu.label: LakeOfRageLanceRefusedText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRefu.en: Oh… Well, if you change your mind, please help me.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceRefu.et: Oh… Noh, kui ümber mõtled, palun aita mind.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceAskH.label: LakeOfRageLanceAskHelpText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageLanceAskH.en: LANCE: Hm? Are you going to help me?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageGrampsTex.label: LakeOfRageGrampsText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageGrampsTex.en:
The GYARADOS are angry!
It's a bad omen!
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageGrampsTex.et:
GYARADOSED on vihased!
See on halb enne!

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSuperNerd.label: LakeOfRageSuperNerdText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSuperNerd.en:
I heard this lake was made by rampaging GYARADOS.
I wonder if there is any connection
to their mass outbreak now?
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSuperNerd.et:
Kuulsin, et selle järve tegid märatsevad GYARADOSED.
Huvitav, kas on mingi seos nende praeguse massilise puhanguga?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageCooltrain.label: LakeOfRageCooltrainerFText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageCooltrain.en:
Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a
red GYARADOS in the LAKE…
But I thought GYARADOS were usually blue?
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageCooltrain.et:
Kas mu silmad petsid mind? Nägin järves punast GYARADOST…
Aga arvasin, et GYARADOSED on tavaliselt sinised?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreSeenText.label: FisherAndreSeenText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreSeenText.en: Let me battle with the #MON I just caught!

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreBeatenTe.label: FisherAndreBeatenText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreBeatenTe.en:
I might be an expert angler, but
I stink as a #MON trainer…
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreBeatenTe.et: Olen ehk osav õngitseja, aga #MONi treenerina olen vilets…

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreAfterBat.label: FisherAndreAfterBattleText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreAfterBat.en: I won't lose as an angler! I catch #MON all day.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherAndreAfterBat.et: Õngitsejana ma ei kaota! Püüan #MONe terve päeva.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherRaymondSeenTe.label: FisherRaymondSeenText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherRaymondSeenTe.en:
No matter what I do, all I catch
are the same #MON…
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherRaymondSeenTe.et: Mida ma ka ei tee, püüan aina samu #MONe…

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherRaymondAfterB.label: FisherRaymondAfterBattleText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::FisherRaymondAfterB.en: Why can't I catch any good #MON?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronSe.label: CooltrainermAaronSeenText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronSe.en:
If a trainer spots another trainer,
he has to make a challenge.
That is our destiny.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronSe.et:
Kui treener märkab teist treenerit, peab ta väljakutse esitama.
See on meie saatus.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronAf.label: CooltrainermAaronAfterBattleText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronAf.en:
#MON and their trainer become
powerful through constant battling.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainermAaronAf.et: #MON ja tema treener saavad pideva võitlemisega võimsaks.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisSee.label: CooltrainerfLoisSeenText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisSee.en:
What happened to the red GYARADOS?
It's gone?
Oh, darn. I came here for nothing?
I know--let's battle!
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisSee.et:
Mis punasest GYARADOSEST sai?
See on kadunud?
Oh pagan. Tulin siia asjata?
Tean — võitleme!

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisAft.label: CooltrainerfLoisAfterBattleText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisAft.en: Come to think of it, I've seen a pink BUTTERFREE.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::CooltrainerfLoisAft.et: Kui järele mõelda, olen näinud roosat BUTTERFREE-d.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::MeetWesleyText.label: MeetWesleyText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::MeetWesleyText.en:
WESLEY: Well, how do you do?
Seeing as how it's Wednesday today,
I'm WESLEY of Wednesday.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::MeetWesleyText.et:
WESLEY: Noh, kuidas läheb?
Kuna täna on kolmapäev, olen WESLEY kolmapäevast.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyGivesGiftText.label: WesleyGivesGiftText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyGivesGiftText.en: Pleased to meet you. Please take a souvenir.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyGaveGiftText.label: WesleyGaveGiftText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyGaveGiftText.en: WESLEY: BLACKBELT beefs up the power of fighting moves.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyWednesdayText.label: WesleyWednesdayText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyWednesdayText.en:
WESLEY: Since you found me, you must
have met my brothers and sisters.
Or did you just get lucky?
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyWednesdayText.et:
WESLEY: Kuna leidsid mind, oled vist kohanud mu õdesid-vendi.
Või lihtsalt vedas?

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyNotWednesdayT.label: WesleyNotWednesdayText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyNotWednesdayT.en: WESLEY: Today's not Wednesday. That's too bad.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::WesleyNotWednesdayT.et: WESLEY: Täna pole kolmapäev. Kahju küll.

maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSignText.label: LakeOfRageSignText
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSignText.en: LAKE OF RAGE, also known as GYARADOS LAKE.
maps/LakeOfRage.asm::LakeOfRageSignText.et: RAEVUJÄRV, tuntud ka kui GYARADOSE JÄRV.

maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.label: HiddenPowerGuyText1
maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.en:
…You have strayed far…
Here I have meditated. Inside me,
a new power has been awakened.
Let me share my power with your
#MON. Take this, child.
maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.et:
…Sa oled kaugele eksinud…
Siin olen mediteerinud. Minus
on ärganud uus jõud.
Lubage mul jagada oma jõudu su
#MONiga. Võta see, laps.

maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.label: HiddenPowerGuyText2
maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.en:
Do you see it? It is HIDDEN POWER!
It draws out the power of #MON for attacking.
Remember this: its type and power depend on the #MON using it.
maps/LakeOfRageHiddenPowerHouse.asm::Hid.et:
Kas näed seda? See on HIDDEN POWER!
See tõmbab välja #MONi jõu ründamiseks.
Pea meeles: selle tüüp ja jõud sõltuvad seda kasutavast #MONist.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_LakeOfRageHistory
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
LAKE OF RAGE is actually a crater
made by rampaging GYARADOS.
The crater filled up with rainwater
and the LAKE was formed.
That's the story passed on from my
Grandpa's greatgreat-grandpa.
It used to be that you could catch
lively MAGIKARP there, but…
I don't understand what's happening.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
LAKE OF RAGE on tegelikult kraater,
mille tegid möllavad GYARADOSED.
Kraater täitus vihmaveega
ja nii tekkis JÄRV.
See on lugu, mille pärandas mu
vanaisa vana-vanavanaisa.
Vanasti sai sealt püüda
elavaid MAGIKARPe, aga…
Ma ei mõista, mis toimub.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_MenInBlack
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
The LAKE hasn't been normal since
those men wearing black arrived.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
JÄRV pole normaalne olnud, sellest
kui saabusid need mustas mehed.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_WorldsLargestMagikarp
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
LAKE OF RAGE is back to normal.
The MAGIKARP have returned.
I may yet realize my dream of seeing the world's largest MAGIKARP.
Do you have a ROD? Please help me if you do.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
LAKE OF RAGE on taas normaalne.
MAGIKARPid on tagasi.
Ehk täitub veel mu unistus näha maailma suurimat MAGIKARPi.
Kas sul on ROD? Palun aita mind, kui on.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_YouHaveAMagikarp
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
Ah, you have a MAGIKARP! Let's
see how big that baby is.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
Ah, sul on MAGIKARP! Vaatame,
kui suur see mürakas on.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Memento
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
Wow! This one is outstanding!
I tip my hat to you!
Take this as a memento!
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
Vau! See on silmapaistev!
Kergitan sinu ees mütsi!
Võta see mälestuseks!

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Bonus
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
The record is the important thing.
Think of that as a bonus!
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
Rekord on see tähtis asi.
Mõtle sellest kui boonusest!

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_TooShort
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
Wow! This one is outstanding!
…I wish I could say that, but I've
seen a bigger one before.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
Vau! See on silmapaistev!
…Sooviksin nii öelda, aga olen
näinud varem suuremat.

maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Refused
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.en:
Oh… So you didn't get one good
enough to show me? Maybe next time.
maps/LakeOfRageMagikarpHouse.asm::Magika.et:
Oh… Nii et sa ei saanud piisavalt
head mulle näidata? Ehk järgmine kord.

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleIntroTex.label: LanceBattleIntroText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleIntroTex.en:
LANCE: I've been waiting for you.
<PLAY_G>!
I knew that you, with your skills,
would eventually reach me here.
There's no need for words now.
We will battle to determine who is
the stronger of the two of us.
As the most powerful trainer and as
the #MON LEAGUE CHAMPION…
I, LANCE the dragon master, accept your challenge!
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleIntroTex.et:
LANCE: Olen sind oodanud.
<PLAY_G>!
Teadsin, et sina oma oskustega jõuad lõpuks minuni.
Sõnu pole enam vaja.
Võitleme, et selgitada, kumb meist on tugevam.
Kui kõige võimsam treener ja #MON LIIGA TŠEMPION…
võtan mina, draakonimeister LANCE, su väljakutse vastu!

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleWinText.label: LanceBattleWinText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleWinText.en:
…It's over.
But it's an odd feeling.
I'm not angry that I lost. In fact, I feel happy.
Happy that I witnessed the rise
of a great new CHAMPION!
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleWinText.et:
…See on läbi.
Aga imelik tunne.
Ma ei ole vihane, et kaotasin. Tegelikult tunnen rõõmu.
Rõõmu, et nägin suure uue TŠEMPIONI tõusu!

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleAfterTex.label: LanceBattleAfterText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleAfterTex.en:
…Whew.
You have become truly powerful, <PLAY_G>.
Your #MON have responded to your
strong and upstanding nature.
As a trainer, you will continue to
grow strong with your #MON.
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LanceBattleAfterTex.et:
…Ohh.
Sa oled tõeliselt võimsaks saanud, <PLAY_G>.
Su #MONid on vastanud su tugevale ja ausale olemusele.
Treenerina kasvad koos oma #MONidega üha tugevamaks.

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryOhNoO.label: LancesRoomMaryOhNoOakText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryOhNoO.en:
MARY: Oh, no! It's all over!
PROF.OAK, if you weren't so slow…
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryOhNoO.et:
MARY: Oh ei! Kõik on läbi!
PROF.OAK, kui sa poleks nii aeglane…

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomOakCongra.label: LancesRoomOakCongratulationsText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomOakCongra.en:
PROF.OAK: Ah, <PLAY_G>!
It's been a long while.
You certainly look more impressive.
Your conquest of the LEAGUE is just fantastic!
Your dedication, trust and love for
your #MON made this happen.
Your #MON were outstanding too.
Because they believed in you as a
trainer, they persevered.
Congratulations, <PLAY_G>!
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomOakCongra.et:
PROF.OAK: Ah, <PLAY_G>!
Palju aega on möödas.
Sa näed kindlasti muljetavaldavam välja.
Sinu LIIGA vallutamine on lihtsalt fantastiline!
Sinu pühendumus, usaldus ja armastus #MONide vastu tegi selle võimalikuks.
Ka su #MONid olid suurepärased.
Kuna nad uskusid sinusse kui treenerisse, pidasid nad vastu.
Palju õnne, <PLAY_G>!

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryInter.label: LancesRoomMaryInterviewText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryInter.en: MARY: Let's interview the brand new CHAMPION!

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomNoisyText.label: LancesRoomNoisyText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomNoisyText.en:
LANCE: This is getting to be a bit too noisy…
<PLAY_G>, could you come with me?
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomNoisyText.et:
LANCE: Läheb veidi liiga lärmakaks…
<PLAY_G>, kas tuleksid minuga kaasa?

maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryNoInt.label: LancesRoomMaryNoInterviewText
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryNoInt.en: MARY: Oh, wait! We haven't done the interview!
maps/LancesRoom.asm::LancesRoomMaryNoInt.et: MARY: Oh, oota! Me pole intervjuud teinud!

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FReceptionistText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Welcome! Feel free to look
around anywhere on this floor.
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et: Tere tulemast! Uuri sellel korrusel julgelt ringi.

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FOfficerText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Sorry, but you can only tour the ground floor.
Ever since JOHTO's RADIO TOWER was
taken over by a criminal gang, we
have had to step up our security.
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Vabandust, aga tuurida saab vaid esimest korrust.
Sellest ajast, kui JOHTO RAADIOTORNI kurjategijate kamp üle võttis, oleme turvalisust tõhustanud.

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd1Text
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Many people are hard at work here
in the RADIO TOWER.
They must be doing their best to put on good shows.
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Siin RAADIOTORNIS töötab palju inimesi.
Nad annavad kindlasti endast parima, et head saated teha.

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Oh, no, no, no!
We've been off the air ever since the
POWER PLANT shut down.
All my efforts to start this station
would be wasted if I can't broadcast.
I'll be ruined!
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Oh, ei, ei, ei!
Oleme eetrist väljas, sest ELEKTRIJAAM seiskus.
Kõik mu pingutused selle jaama käivitamiseks lähevad raisku, kui ei saa eetrisse.
Olen laostunud!

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Ah! So you're the <PLAY_G> who solved
the POWER PLANT's problem?
Thanks to you, I never lost my job.
I tell you, you're a real lifesaver!
Please take this as my thanks.
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Ah! Nii et sina oled see <PLAY_G>, kes ELEKTRIJAAMA probleemi lahendas?
Tänu sinule ei kaotanud ma tööd.
Sa oled tõeline päästja!
Palun võta see tänuks.

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_GotExpnCard
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
With that thing, you can tune into
the radio programs here in KANTO.
Gahahahaha!
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Selle asjaga saad häälestuda KANTO raadiosaadetele.
Gahahahaa!

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Hey there!
I am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!
Huh? Your #GEAR can't tune into my
music programs. How unfortunate!
If you get an EXPN CARD upgrade, you
can tune in. You'd better get one!
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Tere!
Olen super MUUSIKAJUHT!
Hä? Su #GEAR ei saa mu muusikasaateid kätte. Kui kahju!
Kui hangid EXPN CARD täienduse, saad häälestuda. Parem hangi see!

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text_GotExpnCard
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Hey there!
I am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!
I'm responsible for the gorgeous
melodies that go out over the air.
Don't be square. Grab your music off the air!
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Tere!
Olen super MUUSIKAJUHT!
Mina vastutan nende toredate viiside eest, mis eetrisse lähevad.
Ära ole igav. Püüa oma muusika eetrist!

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FDirectoryText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
1F RECEPTION 2F SALES
3F PERSONNEL 4F PRODUCTION
5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
1K VASTUVÕTT 2K MÜÜK
3K PERSONAL 4K TOOTMINE
5K DIREKTORI KABINET

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FPokeFluteSignText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Perk Up #MON with Mellow Sounds
of the # FLUTE on CHANNEL 20

maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.label: LavRadioTower1FReferenceLibraryText
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.en:
Wow! A full rack of #MON CDs and videos.
This must be the reference library.
maps/LavRadioTower1F.asm::LavRadioTower1.et:
Vau! Täis riiul #MONi CD-sid ja videoid.
See peab olema teabekogu.

maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartPokef.label: LavenderMartPokefanMText
maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartPokef.en:
REPEL is a necessity if you are
going to explore a cave.
Even though I like exploring, I still
haven't made it to all the caves.
maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartPokef.et:
REPEL on hädavajalik, kui
kavatsed koobast uurida.
Kuigi mulle meeldib uurida, pole ma
ikka kõiki koopaid külastanud.

maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartRocke.label: LavenderMartRockerText
maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartRocke.en:
I heard about a craftsman who
makes custom BALLS in the JOHTO town
of AZALEA. I wish I had some.
maps/LavenderMart.asm::LavenderMartRocke.et:
Kuulsin käsitöölisest, kes
teeb eri-BALLE JOHTO linnas
AZALEAS. Sooviksin, et mul oleks neid.

maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.label: LavenderPokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.en:
To the north of LAVENDER is ROCK
TUNNEL. Go through it to get to the POWER PLANT.
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.et:
LAVENDERIST põhja pool on ROCK
TUNNEL. Mine sealt läbi POWER PLANTI.

maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.label: LavenderPokecenter1FTeacherText
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.en:
There's a radio program that plays # FLUTE music.
Oh? Ah, your radio needs an EXPN CARD to tune into it.
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.et:
On raadiosaade, mis mängib # FLUTE muusikat.
Oh? Ah, su raadio vajab selle kuulamiseks EXPN CARDi.

maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.label: LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.en:
If the POWER PLANT isn't running, the
MAGNET TRAIN won't run either…
It also means the RADIO STATION can't broadcast…
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.et:
Kui POWER PLANT ei tööta, ei
sõida ka MAGNETRONG…
See tähendab ka, et RAADIOJAAM ei saa edastada…

maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.label: LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.en:
The DIRECTOR of the RADIO STATION sure was happy.
He said they're back on the air
because the POWER PLANT is running smoothly again.
maps/LavenderPokecenter1F.asm::LavenderP.et:
RAADIOJAAMA DIREKTOR oli tõesti õnnelik.
Ta ütles, et nad on taas eetris,
sest POWER PLANT töötab jälle sujuvalt.

maps/LavenderSpeechHouse.asm::LavenderSp.label: LavenderSpeechHousePokefanFText
maps/LavenderSpeechHouse.asm::LavenderSp.en:
LAVENDER is a tiny, quiet town
at the foot of the mountains.
It's gotten a bit busier since the
RADIO TOWER was built.
maps/LavenderSpeechHouse.asm::LavenderSp.et:
LAVENDER on väike, vaikne linn
mägede jalamil.
See on muutunud pisut elavamaks, sestpeale
kui RAADIOTORN ehitati.

maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownPokef.label: LavenderTownPokefanMText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownPokef.en:
That's quite some building, eh?
It's KANTO's RADIO TOWER.
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownPokef.et:
Päris hoone, mis?
See on KANTO RAADIOTORN.

maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownTeach.label: LavenderTownTeacherText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownTeach.en: KANTO has many good radio shows.

maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownGramp.label: LavenderTownGrampsText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownGramp.en:
People come from all over to pay
their respects to the departed souls of #MON.
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownGramp.et: Inimesed tulevad kõikjalt, et avaldada austust lahkunud #MONide hingedele.

maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownYoung.label: LavenderTownYoungsterText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownYoung.en:
You need a # FLUTE to wake sleeping #MON.
Every trainer has to know that!
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownYoung.et:
Magavate #MONide äratamiseks on vaja # FLUTE.
Seda peab iga treener teadma!

maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownSignT.label: LavenderTownSignText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::LavenderTownSignT.en:
LAVENDER TOWN
The Noble Purple Town

maps/LavenderTown.asm::KantoRadioStation.label: KantoRadioStationSignText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::KantoRadioStation.en:
KANTO RADIO STATION
Your Favorite Programs On-Air Around the Clock!
maps/LavenderTown.asm::KantoRadioStation.et:
KANTO RAADIOJAAM
Sinu lemmiksaated eetris ööpäev läbi!

maps/LavenderTown.asm::SoulHouseSignText.label: SoulHouseSignText
maps/LavenderTown.asm::SoulHouseSignText.en:
SOUL HOUSE
May the Souls of #MON Rest Easy

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Intro.label: PryceText_Intro
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Intro.en:
#MON have many experiences in
their lives, just like we do.
I, too, have seen and suffered much in my life.
Since I am your elder, let me show you what I mean.
I have been with #MON since
before you were born.
I do not lose easily.
I, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Intro.et:
#MONidel on elus palju kogemusi, just nagu meil.
Ka mina olen elus palju näinud ja kannatanud.
Kuna olen sinust vanem, näitan sulle, mida silmas pean.
Olen #MONidega olnud juba enne sinu sündi.
Ma ei kaota kergelt.
Mina, PRYCE — talvetreener — näitan oma väge!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Impresse.label: PryceText_Impressed
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Impresse.en:
Ah, I am impressed by your prowess.
With your strong will, I know you
will overcome all life's obstacles.
You are worthy of this BADGE!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_Impresse.et:
Ah, su osavus avaldab muljet.
Tugeva tahtega ületad kindlasti kõik elu takistused.
Sa oled selle MÄRGI vääriline!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_GlacierB.label: PryceText_GlacierBadgeSpeech
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_GlacierB.en:
That BADGE will raise the SPECIAL stats of #MON.
It also lets your #MON use WHIRLPOOL to get across real whirlpools.
And this… This is a gift from me!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_GlacierB.et:
See MÄRK tõstab #MONi ERILISI näitajaid.
Samuti saavad su #MONid WHIRLPOOLiga üle päris veekeeriste.
Ja see… See on minu kingitus!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_IcyWindS.label: PryceText_IcyWindSpeech
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_IcyWindS.en:
That TM contains ICY WIND.
It inflicts damage and lowers speed.
It demonstrates the harshness of winter.
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_IcyWindS.et:
See TM sisaldab ICY WIND.
See tekitab kahju ja langetab kiirust.
See näitab talve karmust.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_CherishY.label: PryceText_CherishYourPokemon
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_CherishY.en:
When the ice and snow melt, spring arrives.
You and your #MON will be to-
gether for many years to come.
Cherish your time together!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::PryceText_CherishY.et:
Kui jää ja lumi sulavad, saabub kevad.
Sina ja su #MONid olete koos veel palju aastaid.
Hoia oma ühist aega!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldSeenT.label: BoarderRonaldSeenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldSeenT.en: I'll freeze your #MON, so you can't do a thing!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldSeenT.et: Külmutan su #MONid, nii et sa ei saa midagi teha!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldBeate.label: BoarderRonaldBeatenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldBeate.en: Darn. I couldn't do a thing.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldAfter.label: BoarderRonaldAfterBattleText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldAfter.en:
I think there's a move a #MON
can use while it's frozen.
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderRonaldAfter.et: Vist on üks rünnak, mida #MON saab külmununa kasutada.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradSeenTex.label: BoarderBradSeenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradSeenTex.en:
This GYM has a slippery floor.
It's fun, isn't it?
But hey--we're not playing games here!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradSeenTex.et:
Sellel SAALIL on libe põrand.
Lõbus, mis?
Aga hei — me ei mängi siin mänge!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradBeatenT.label: BoarderBradBeatenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradBeatenT.en: Do you see how serious we are?
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradBeatenT.et: Kas näed, kui tõsised me oleme?

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradAfterBa.label: BoarderBradAfterBattleText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradAfterBa.en: This GYM is great. I love boarding with my #MON!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderBradAfterBa.et: See SAAL on suurepärane. Mulle meeldib #MONidega lauaga sõita!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderDouglasBeat.label: BoarderDouglasBeatenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderDouglasBeat.en: OK. I'll tell you PRYCE's secret.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderDouglasAfte.label: BoarderDouglasAfterBattleText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderDouglasAfte.en:
The secret behind PRYCE's power…
He meditates under a waterfall daily
to strengthen his mind and body.
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::BoarderDouglasAfte.et:
PRYCE'i väe saladus…
Ta mediteerib iga päev joa all, et tugevdada oma meelt ja keha.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneSeenTe.label: SkierRoxanneSeenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneSeenTe.en:
To get to PRYCE, our GYM LEADER,
you need to think before you skate.
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneSeenTe.et: Et jõuda meie SAALI JUHI PRYCE'ini, pead enne uisutamist mõtlema.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneBeaten.label: SkierRoxanneBeatenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneBeaten.en: I wouldn't lose to you in skiing!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneAfterB.label: SkierRoxanneAfterBattleText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneAfterB.en:
If you don't skate with precision,
you won't get far in this GYM.
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierRoxanneAfterB.et: Kui täpselt ei uisuta, ei jõua selles SAALIS kaugele.

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierClarissaBeate.label: SkierClarissaBeatenText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierClarissaBeate.en: No! You made me wipe out!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierClarissaAfter.label: SkierClarissaAfterBattleText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierClarissaAfter.en: I shouldn't have been bragging about my skiing…
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::SkierClarissaAfter.et: Ma poleks pidanud oma suusatamisega hooplema…

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideTe.label: MahoganyGymGuideText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideTe.en:
PRYCE is a veteran who has trained
#MON for some 50 years.
He's said to be good at freezing
opponents with ice-type moves.
That means you should melt him
with your burning ambition!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideTe.et:
PRYCE on veteran, kes on #MONe treeninud umbes 50 aastat.
Olevat osav vastaste külmutamises jää-tüüpi rünnakutega.
Seega peaksid ta sulatama oma põleva auahnusega!

maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideWi.label: MahoganyGymGuideWinText
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideWi.en:
PRYCE is something, but you're something else!
That was a hot battle that
bridged the generation gap!
maps/MahoganyGym.asm::MahoganyGymGuideWi.et:
PRYCE on tubli, aga sina oled midagi enamat!
See oli tuline lahing, mis ületas põlvkondade lõhe!

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceGoDownStairsMovement
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.en:
Hello, kiddo!
How would you like some RAGECANDYBAR?
It's the thing to eat in MAHOGANY!
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.et:
Tere, semu!
Kuidas oleks RAGECANDYBARiga?
Seda süüakse MAHOGANYS!

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FP.label: MahoganyMart1FPharmacistText_LanceEntered
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FP.en: Arrgh… You found the secret stairway…

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.label: MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.en:
Heheh! The experiment worked like a charm.
MAGIKARP are just worthless, but
GYARADOS are big moneymakers.
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.et:
Heheh! Katse õnnestus suurepäraselt.
MAGIKARPid on lihtsalt väärtusetud, aga
GYARADOSED toovad suurt raha.

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.label: MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText_LanceEntered
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.en:
Urrgh…
That guy's dragon #MON are tough…
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FB.et:
Urrgh…
Selle tüübi draakon-#MONid on kõvad…

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceRadioText
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.en:
What took you, <PLAY_G>?
Just as I thought, that strange radio
signal is coming from here.
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.et:
Mis sind kinni pidas, <PLAY_G>?
Just nagu arvasin, see imelik raadio-
signaal tuleb siit.

maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceSplitUpText
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.en:
LANCE: <PLAY_G>, we should split up to
check this place. I'll go first.
maps/MahoganyMart1F.asm::MahoganyMart1FL.et:
LANCE: <PLAY_G>, peaksime lahku minema,
et seda kohta uurida. Lähen esimesena.

maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FPokefanMText
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.en:
What's this? TEAM ROCKET has come back?
I saw some men in black at LAKE OF RAGE…
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.et:
Mis see on? RAKETI KAMP on tagasi?
Nägin LAKE OF RAGE juures mustades mehi…

maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FYoungsterText
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.en:
I stop my #MON from evolving too early.
I make them learn certain moves before I let them evolve.
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.et:
Takistan oma #MONide liiga varajast arenemist.
Lasen neil enne arenemist õppida kindlaid rünnakuid.

maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.en:
#MON do become stronger when they
evolve, but they also learn moves more slowly.
maps/MahoganyPokecenter1F.asm::MahoganyP.et:
#MONid muutuvad arenedes tugevamaks,
aga õpivad ka rünnakuid aeglasemalt.

maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseBlackBeltText
maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.en:
I heard that a red GYARADOS appeared at the LAKE.
That's odd, since even ordinary
GYARADOS are rare in that lake…
maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.et:
Kuulsin, et JÄRVES ilmus punane GYARADOS.
See on veider, sest isegi tavalised
GYARADOSED on selles järves haruldased…

maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseTeacherText
maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.en: My favorite radio program? I'd say #MON MUSIC.

maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseTeacherText_RocketsInRadioTower
maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.en:
I've been hearing laughter on the
radio… It's creepy.
maps/MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouse.asm:.et:
Olen raadiost naeru
kuulnud… See on jube.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.label: RageCandyBarMerchantTryOneText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.en:
Hiya, kid!
I see you're new in MAHOGANY TOWN.
Since you're new, you should try a
yummy RAGECANDYBAR!
Right now, it can be yours for just ¥{d:MAHOGANYTOWN_RAGECANDYBAR_PRICE}! Want one?
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.et:
Tsau, laps!
Näen, et oled MAHOGANY TOWNIS uus.
Uuena peaksid proovima maitsvat RAGECANDYBARi!
Praegu saad selle vaid ¥{d:MAHOGANYTOWN_RAGECANDYBAR_PRICE} eest! Kas soovid?

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.label: RageCandyBarMerchantNoRoomText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.en: You don't have room for this.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.label: RageCandyBarMerchantSoldOutText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.en:
RAGECANDYBAR's sold out.
I'm packing up. Don't bother me, kiddo.
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::RageCandyBarMerch.et:
RAGECANDYBAR on otsas.
Pakin kokku. Ära sega, kutt.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.label: MahoganyTownGrampsText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.en: Are you off to see the GYARADOS rampage at the LAKE?
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.et: Kas lähed JÄRVELE GYARADOSTE märatsemist vaatama?

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.label: MahoganyTownGrampsText_ClearedRocketHideout
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.en:
MAGIKARP have returned to LAKE OF RAGE.
That should be good news for the anglers there.
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownGramp.et:
MAGIKARPid on RAEVUJÄRVELE tagasi tulnud.
See on sealsetele õngitsejatele hea uudis.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownFishe.label: MahoganyTownFisherText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownFishe.en:
Since you came this far, take the
time to do some sightseeing.
You should head north and check
out LAKE OF RAGE right now.
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownFishe.et:
Kuna nii kaugele jõudsid, võta aega ka ringi vaadata.
Mine kohe põhja poole ja vaata RAEVUJÄRVE.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownLassT.label: MahoganyTownLassText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownLassT.en:
Visit Grandma's shop. She sells
stuff that nobody else has.
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownLassT.et: Külasta vanaema poodi. Ta müüb kraami, mida kellelgi teisel pole.

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownSignT.label: MahoganyTownSignText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownSignT.en:
MAHOGANY TOWN
Welcome to the Home of the Ninja
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownSignT.et:
MAHOGANY TOWN
Tere tulemast nindžade koju

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownRagec.label: MahoganyTownRagecandybarSignText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyTownRagec.en: While visiting MAHOGANY TOWN, try a RAGECANDYBAR!

maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyGymSignTe.label: MahoganyGymSignText
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyGymSignTe.en:
MAHOGANY TOWN #MON GYM LEADER: PRYCE
The Teacher of Winter's Harshness
maps/MahoganyTown.asm::MahoganyGymSignTe.et:
MAHOGANY TOWN #MON SAALI JUHT: PRYCE
Talve karmuse õpetaja

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_AskLookA.label: ManiaText_AskLookAfterShuckle
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_AskLookA.en:
I, I'm in shock!
A guy about your age with piercing
eyes and long hair came in.
He scared me into giving him my prized #MON!
I still have one left, but what if he comes back?
You look strong. Could you look
after my #MON for a while?
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_AskLookA.et:
M-ma olen šokis!
Sisse tuli sinuvanune tüüp
läbitungiva pilgu ja pikkade juustega.
Ta hirmutas mind, et andsin talle oma hinnalise #MONi!
Mul on veel üks alles, aga mis siis, kui ta naaseb?
Sa näed tugev välja. Kas hoiaksid
mu #MONi mõnda aega?

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_TakeCare.label: ManiaText_TakeCareOfShuckle
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_TakeCare.en:
Oh, thank you!
Take good care of it, please!
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_TakeCare.et:
Oh, aitäh!
Hoolitse selle eest hästi, palun!

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_IfHeCome.label: ManiaText_IfHeComesBack
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_IfHeCome.en: Oh, no… What'll I do if he comes back?
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_IfHeCome.et: Oh ei… Mida ma teen, kui ta naaseb?

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_CanIHave.label: ManiaText_CanIHaveMyMonBack
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_CanIHave.en:
Hi! How's my #MON?
I think I'm safe now, so may I have it back?
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_CanIHave.et:
Tere! Kuidas mu #MONil läheb?
Arvan, et olen nüüd ohutu, kas saan selle tagasi?

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleN.label: ManiaText_ShuckleNotThere
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleN.en: Hey, you don't have my #MON with you.

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleL.label: ManiaText_ShuckleLikesYou
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleL.en:
My #MON has come to like you.
All right, you should keep it.
But promise to be good to it!
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleL.et:
Mu #MON on sinusse kiindunud.
Hästi, hoia see endale.
Aga luba, et oled sellega hea!

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_SameAsBe.label: ManiaText_SameAsBeingRobbed
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_SameAsBe.en: Oh, no, no… That's the same as being robbed.
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_SameAsBe.et: Oh ei, ei… See on sama kui röövitud saada.

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_Happines.label: ManiaText_HappinessSpeech
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_Happines.en:
For #MON, happiness is being
with a person who treats them well.
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_Happines.et:
#MONidele on õnn olla
inimesega, kes neid hästi kohtleb.

maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleI.label: ManiaText_ShuckleIsYourLastMon
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleI.en:
If I take my #MON back, what are
you going to use in battle?
maps/ManiasHouse.asm::ManiaText_ShuckleI.et:
Kui võtan oma #MONi tagasi, mida
sa siis lahingus kasutad?

maps/MobileBattleRoom.asm::MobileBattleR.label: MobileBattleRoom_HealText
maps/MobileBattleRoom.asm::MobileBattleR.en: Your #MON will be fully healed before battle.
maps/MobileBattleRoom.asm::MobileBattleR.et: Su #MONid ravitakse enne lahingut täielikult terveks.

maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextBe.label: MountMoonRivalTextBefore
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextBe.en:
<……> <……> <……>
It's been a while, <PLAYER>.
…Since I lost to you, I thought
about what I was lacking with my #MON…
And we came up with an answer.
<PLAYER>, now we'll show you!
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextBe.et:
<……> <……> <……>
On tükk aega möödas, <PLAYER>.
…Sestpeale kui sulle kaotasin, mõtlesin,
mis mul oma #MONidega puudu oli…
Ja leidsime vastuse.
<PLAYER>, nüüd näitame sulle!

maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextWi.label: MountMoonRivalTextWin
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextWi.en:
<……> <……> <……>
I thought I raised my #MON to be
the best they could be…
…But it still wasn't enough…
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextWi.et:
<……> <……> <……>
Arvasin, et kasvatasin oma #MONid
nii heaks kui võimalik…
…Aga sellest ikka ei piisanud…

maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextAf.label: MountMoonRivalTextAfter
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextAf.en:
<……> <……> <……>
…You won, fair and square.
I admit it. But this isn't the end.
I'm going to be the greatest #MON trainer ever.
Because these guys are behind me.
…Listen, <PLAYER>.
One of these days I'm going to prove
how good I am by beating you.
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextAf.et:
<……> <……> <……>
…Sa võitsid ausalt ja õiglaselt.
Tunnistan seda. Aga see pole lõpp.
Minust saab suurim #MON-treener eales.
Sest need semud on mu selja taga.
…Kuula, <PLAYER>.
Ühel päeval tõestan,
kui hea ma olen, alistades sind.

maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextLo.label: MountMoonRivalTextLoss
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextLo.en:
<……> <……> <……>
I've repaid my debt to you.
With my #MON, I'm going to beat
the CHAMPION and become the world's greatest trainer.
maps/MountMoon.asm::MountMoonRivalTextLo.et:
<……> <……> <……>
Maksin oma võla sulle tagasi.
Oma #MONidega alistan
TŠEMPIONI ja saan maailma suurimaks treeneriks.

maps/MountMoonGiftShop.asm::MountMoonGif.label: MountMoonGiftShopLassText
maps/MountMoonGiftShop.asm::MountMoonGif.en: When the sun goes down, CLEFAIRY come out to play.
maps/MountMoonGiftShop.asm::MountMoonGif.et: Kui päike loojub, tulevad CLEFAIRYd mängima.

maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::Pokemaniac.label: PokemaniacMillerAfterBattleText
maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::Pokemaniac.en:
A while back, this karate dude wanted
to battle. He was ridiculously good.
He just thrashed us silly.
He went in deeper saying it was for
his training. I wonder how he is?
maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::Pokemaniac.et:
Mõni aeg tagasi tahtis üks karate-
tüüp võidelda. Ta oli naeruväärselt hea.
Ta lihtsalt peksis meid puruks.
Ta läks sügavamale, öeldes, et see on
ta treening. Huvitav, kuidas tal läheb?

maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::SupernerdM.label: SupernerdMarkusBeatenText
maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::SupernerdM.en: I mistook you for someone else…

maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::SupernerdM.label: SupernerdMarkusAfterBattleText
maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::SupernerdM.en:
I came to explore MT.MORTAR, but I
got separated from my partner…
Did you run into a trainer who uses a
SEADRA that knows WATERFALL?
maps/MountMortar1FInside.asm::SupernerdM.et:
Tulin MT.MORTARit uurima, aga
läksin oma partnerist lahku…
Kas kohtasid treenerit, kes kasutab
SEADRAt, kes oskab WATERFALLi?

maps/MountMortar2FInside.asm::SupernerdH.label: SupernerdHughAfterBattleText
maps/MountMortar2FInside.asm::SupernerdH.en:
I'm investigating MT.MORTAR, but my pal's gone AWOL.
Have you seen a trainer who has a
SLOWPOKE that can use STRENGTH?
maps/MountMortar2FInside.asm::SupernerdH.et:
Uurin MT.MORTARit, aga mu semu on kadunud.
Kas oled näinud treenerit, kellel on
SLOWPOKE, kes oskab STRENGTHi?

maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoIntroText
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.en:
Hey!
I am the KARATE KING!
I train alone here in the dark!
You! Battle with me!
Hwaaarggh!
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.et:
Hei!
Mina olen KARATEKUNN!
Treenin siin pimeduses üksi!
Sina! Võitle minuga!
Hvaaargh!

maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FT.label: MountMortarB1FTyrogueRewardText
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FT.en:
I… I'm crushed…
My training is still not enough…
But a loss is a loss. I admit it.
As proof that you defeated me, I'll
give you a rare fighting #MON.
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FT.et:
Ma… olen purustatud…
Mu treening pole veel piisav…
Aga kaotus on kaotus. Tunnistan seda.
Tõestuseks, et alistasid mind, annan
sulle haruldase kaklus-#MONi.

maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoGotTyrogueText
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.en:
TYROGUE is a fighting-type.
It evolves into a tougher #MON.
Keep up the hard work. I'll keep training too.
Farewell!
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.et:
TYROGUE on kaklus-tüüpi.
See areneb tugevamaks #MONiks.
Püsi tubli. Ka mina treenin edasi.
Hüvasti!

maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoFullPartyText
maps/MountMortarB1F.asm::MountMortarB1FK.en: You have no room in your party!

maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseSuper.label: MrFujisHouseSuperNerdText
maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseSuper.en:
MR.FUJI does live here, but he's not
home now.
He should be at the SOUL HOUSE.
maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseSuper.et:
MR.FUJI elab siin, aga ta pole
praegu kodus.
Ta peaks olema HINGEDEMAJAS.

maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseLassT.label: MrFujisHouseLassText
maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseLassT.en:
Some cold-hearted people stop caring for their #MON.
Grandpa takes in the poor homeless
#MON and takes care of them.
maps/MrFujisHouse.asm::MrFujisHouseLassT.et:
Mõned kalgid inimesed lakkavad oma #MONidest hoolimast.
Vanaisa võtab vaesed kodutud
#MONid enda juurde ja hoolitseb nende eest.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.label: MrPokemonIntroText1
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.en:
Hello, hello! You must be <PLAY_G>.
PROF.ELM said that you would visit.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.et:
Tere, tere! Sina oled kindlasti <PLAY_G>.
PROF.ELM ütles, et sa tuled külla.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.label: MrPokemonIntroText2
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.en: This is what I want PROF.ELM to examine.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.label: MrPokemonIntroText3
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.en:
I know a couple who run a #MON DAY-CARE service.
They gave me that EGG.
I was intrigued, so I sent mail to PROF.ELM.
For #MON evolution, PROF.ELM is the authority.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.et:
Tean üht paari, kes peab #MON PÄEVAHOIU teenust.
Nad andsid mulle selle EGGi.
Olin uudishimulik, seega saatsin PROF.ELMile kirja.
#MONide arengu osas on PROF.ELM autoriteet.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.label: MrPokemonIntroText5
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.en: If my assumption is correct, PROF. ELM will know it.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonIntro.et: Kui mu oletus on õige, PROF. ELM teab seda.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_MrPokemonHealText
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en:
You are returning to PROF.ELM?
Here. Your #MON should have some rest.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et:
Naased PROF.ELMi juurde?
Siin. Su #MONid peaksid veidi puhkama.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.label: MrPokemonText_AlwaysNewDiscoveries
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.en:
Life is delightful! Always, new
discoveries to be made!
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.et:
Elu on imeline! Alati saab teha
uusi avastusi!

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_OakText1
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en:
OAK: Aha! So you're <PLAY_G>!
I'm OAK! A #MON researcher.
I was just visiting my old friend MR.#MON.
I heard you were running an errand
for PROF.ELM, so I waited here.
Oh! What's this? A rare #MON!
Let's see…
Hm, I see!
I understand why PROF.ELM gave you
a #MON for this errand.
To researchers like PROF.ELM and
I, #MON are our friends.
He saw that you would treat your
#MON with love and care.
…Ah!
You seem to be dependable.
How would you like to help me out?
See? This is the latest version of #DEX.
It automatically records data on
#MON you've seen or caught.
It's a hi-tech encyclopedia!
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et:
OAK: Ahaa! Nii et sina oledki <PLAY_G>!
Olen OAK! #MONide uurija.
Külastasin just oma vana sõpra MR.#MONi.
Kuulsin, et täidad PROF.ELMile
üht ülesannet, seega ootasin siin.
Oh! Mis see on? Haruldane #MON!
Vaatame…
Hm, ma näen!
Saan aru, miks PROF.ELM sulle
selle ülesande jaoks #MONi andis.
Sellistele uurijatele nagu PROF.ELM ja
mina on #MONid meie sõbrad.
Ta nägi, et sa kohtled oma
#MONe armastuse ja hoolega.
…Ah!
Sa tundud usaldusväärne.
Kuidas oleks, kui mind aitaksid?
Näed? See on #DEXi uusim versioon.
See salvestab automaatselt andmed
#MONidest, keda oled näinud või püüdnud.
See on kõrgtehnoloogiline entsüklopeedia!

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_OakText2
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en:
Go meet many kinds of #MON and
complete that #DEX!
But I've stayed too long.
I have to get to GOLDENROD for my usual radio show.
<PLAY_G>, I'm counting on you!
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et:
Kohtu paljude #MONidega ja
täida see #DEX!
Aga olen liiga kauaks jäänud.
Pean jõudma GOLDENRODI oma tavalisse raadiosaatesse.
<PLAY_G>, loodan sinu peale!

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.label: MrPokemonText_GimmeTheScale
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.en:
Hm? That SCALE! What's that? A red GYARADOS?
That's rare! I, I want it…
<PLAY_G>, would you care to trade it?
I can offer this EXP.SHARE I got from PROF.OAK.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.et:
Hm? See SCALE! Mis see on? Punane GYARADOS?
See on haruldane! M-ma tahan seda…
<PLAY_G>, kas sooviksid seda vahetada?
Saan pakkuda selle EXP.SHARE, mille sain PROF.OAKilt.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.label: MrPokemonText_Disappointed
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.en: That's disappointing. That happens to be very rare.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonText_.et: See on kahju. See juhtub olema väga haruldane.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_ForeignMagazinesText
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en:
It's packed with foreign magazines.
Can't even read their titles…
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et:
See on täis välismaiseid ajakirju.
Ei suuda isegi pealkirju lugeda…

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_BrokenComputerText
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en: It's a big computer. Hmm. It's broken.
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et: See on suur arvuti. Hmm. See on katki.

maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.label: MrPokemonsHouse_StrangeCoinsText
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.en:
A whole pile of strange coins!
Maybe they're from another country…
maps/MrPokemonsHouse.asm::MrPokemonsHous.et:
Terve hunnik imelikke münte!
Ehk on need teisest riigist…

maps/MrPsychicsHouse.asm::MrPsychicText2.label: MrPsychicText2
maps/MrPsychicsHouse.asm::MrPsychicText2.en:
TM29 is PSYCHIC.
It may lower the target's SPCL.DEF.
maps/MrPsychicsHouse.asm::MrPsychicText2.et:
TM29 on PSYCHIC.
See võib langetada sihtmärgi SPCL.DEF-i.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkLassT.label: NationalParkLassText
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkLassT.en:
Look! Check out my bag!
I printed out my favorites from my
#DEX and stuck them on my bag.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkLassT.et:
Vaata! Uuri mu kotti!
Printisin oma lemmikud #DEXist
ja kleepisin need kotile.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkPokef.label: NationalParkPokefanFText
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkPokef.en: This is MAIL I got from my daughter. It cheers me up.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkPokef.et: See on MAIL, mille sain tütrelt. See rõõmustab mind.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.label: NationalParkTeacher1Text
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.en:
Pay attention, please!
…Oops, I have to quit thinking like
a teacher all the time.
You must be a #MON trainer.
Since you're working so hard, I
want you to have this.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.et:
Palun pane tähele!
…Oih, pean lõpetama pidevalt
õpetaja kombel mõtlemise.
Sa oled kindlasti #MON-treener.
Kuna sa nii kõvasti pingutad,
tahan, et sa selle saaksid.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.label: NationalParkTeacher1Text_GotQuickClaw
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.en:
Let a #MON hold that QUICK CLAW.
Sometimes it will strike first during battle.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.et:
Lase #MONil hoida seda QUICK CLAWi.
Mõnikord lööb ta lahingus esimesena.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkYoung.label: NationalParkYoungster1Text
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkYoung.en: I'm playing with stickers I printed from my #DEX.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkYoung.label: NationalParkYoungster2Text
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkYoung.en: I get the other guy's #DEX sticker if I win.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkYoung.et: Kui võidan, saan teise mängija #DEXi kleepsu.

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.label: NationalParkTeacher2Text
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.en:
I take walks in the PARK, but I
never go into the grass.
Trainers always want to battle…
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTeach.et:
Jalutan PARGIS, aga ei lähe
kunagi rohtu.
Treenerid tahavad alati võidelda…

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkGameb.label: NationalParkGameboyKidText
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkGameb.en:
I'm printing out my #DEX.
You can also print out stuff like
MAIL and your PC BOXES.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkGameb.et:
Prindin oma #DEXi.
Saad printida ka asju nagu
MAIL ja oma PC BOXid.

maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJack1See.label: SchoolboyJack1SeenText
maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJack1See.en:
The world of #MON is deep.
There are still lots of things we don't know.
But I know more than you do!
maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJack1See.et:
#MONide maailm on sügav.
On veel palju asju, mida me ei tea.
Aga mina tean rohkem kui sina!

maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJackTrad.label: SchoolboyJackTradeMonText
maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJackTrad.en:
There is a lot to learn.
For example…
There are {d:NUM_TMS} kinds of TMs.
Traded #MON level up faster.
maps/NationalPark.asm::SchoolboyJackTrad.et:
Palju on õppida.
Näiteks…
TMe on {d:NUM_TMS} liiki.
Vahetatud #MONid arenevad kiiremini.

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanfBeverly1S.label: PokefanfBeverly1SeenText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanfBeverly1S.en:
My #MON are simply darling.
Let me tell you how proud my darlings make me.
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanfBeverly1S.et:
Mu #MONid on lihtsalt armsad.
Lase mul rääkida, kui uhked mu kallimad mind teevad.

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanfBeverly1B.label: PokefanfBeverly1BeatenText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanfBeverly1B.en: I can beat you in pride, but…

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanBeverlyCut.label: PokefanBeverlyCuteMonText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanBeverlyCut.en: I must say, your #MON are quite cute, too.
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanBeverlyCut.et: Pean ütlema, et ka su #MONid on üsna nunnud.

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamSe.label: PokefanmWilliamSeenText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamSe.en:
We adore our #MON, even if they dislike us.
That's what being a FAN is about.
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamSe.et:
Jumaldame oma #MONe, isegi kui nad meid ei salli.
Selles ongi FÄNNIKS olemine.

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamAf.label: PokefanmWilliamAfterBattleText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamAf.en:
I lost the battle, but my #MON win
the prize for being most lovely.
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanmWilliamAf.et:
Kaotasin lahingu, aga mu #MONid võidavad
auhinna kõige armsama olemise eest.

maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanFBeverlyMa.label: PokefanFBeverlyMarillFriendText
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanFBeverlyMa.en:
My friend keeps a MARILL!
I find them very endearing.
Oh, I wish for a MARILL of my own…
maps/NationalPark.asm::PokefanFBeverlyMa.et:
Mu sõbral on MARILL!
Pean neid väga südamlikeks.
Oh, sooviksin endale oma MARILLi…

maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseSeenText.label: LassKriseSeenText
maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseSeenText.en:
Hello? Why are you staring at me?
Oh, a battle?
maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseSeenText.et:
Halloo? Miks sa mind põrnitsed?
Oh, lahing?

maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseAfterBat.label: LassKriseAfterBattleText
maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseAfterBat.en: I thought you were staring at me because I'm cute!
maps/NationalPark.asm::LassKriseAfterBat.et: Arvasin, et põrnitsed mind, sest olen nunnu!

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkBattl.label: NationalParkBattleNoticeText
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkBattl.en:
What is this notice?
Please battle only in the grass.
NATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkBattl.et:
Mis teade see on?
Võitle palun ainult rohus.
NATIONAL PARKI VALVURI KONTOR

maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTrain.label: NationalParkTrainerTipsText
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTrain.en:
TRAINER TIPS
Print out MAIL by opening it then pressing START.
maps/NationalPark.asm::NationalParkTrain.et:
TREENERI NÕUANDED
Prindi MAIL, avades selle ja seejärel vajutades START.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant1AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en: DON: I'm going to win! Don't bother me.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et: DON: Ma võidan! Ära tülita mind.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant2AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en: ED: My PARASECT puts #MON to sleep with SPORE.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et: ED: Mu PARASECT paneb #MONid magama SPORE'iga.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant3AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en: NICK: I'm raising fast #MON for battles.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant4AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
WILLIAM: I'm not concerned about winning.
I'm just looking for rare #MON.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
WILLIAM: Ma ei muretse võitmise pärast.
Otsin lihtsalt haruldasi #MONe.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant5AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
BENNY: Ssh! You'll scare off SCYTHER.
I'll talk to you later.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
BENNY: Tsss! Sa peletad SCYTHERI ära.
Räägin sinuga hiljem.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant6AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
BARRY: You should weaken bug #MON
first, then throw a BALL.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
BARRY: Peaksid putuk-#MONid
esmalt nõrgestama, siis viskama BALLi.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant7AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
CINDY: I love bug #MON.
I guess you must like them too.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
CINDY: Armastan putuk-#MONe.
Vist meeldivad ka sulle.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant8AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
JOSH: I've been collecting bug
#MON since I was just a baby.
There's no way I'm going to lose!
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
JOSH: Olen putuk-#MONe kogunud
maast madalast peale.
Ma ei kaota mingil juhul!

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant9AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
SAMUEL: If you've got the time to
chat, go find some bug #MON.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
SAMUEL: Kui sul on aega
lobiseda, mine leia putuk-#MONe.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.label: BugCatchingContestant10AText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.en:
KIPP: I've studied about bug #MON a lot.
I'm going to win for sure.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::BugCatc.et:
KIPP: Olen putuk-#MONe palju uurinud.
Ma võidan kindlasti.

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.label: NationalParkBugContestBattleNoticeText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.en:
What is this notice?
Please battle only in the grass.
NATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.et:
Mis teade see on?
Võitle palun ainult rohus.
NATIONAL PARKI VALVURI KONTOR

maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.label: NationalParkBugContestTrainerTipsText
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.en:
TRAINER TIPS
Print out MAIL by opening it then pressing START.
maps/NationalParkBugContest.asm::Nationa.et:
TREENERI NÕUANDED
Prindi MAIL, avades selle ja seejärel vajutades START.

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_GearIsImpress.label: Text_GearIsImpressive
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_GearIsImpress.en:
Wow, your #GEAR is impressive!
Did your mom get it for you?
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_GearIsImpress.et:
Vau, sinu #GEAR on muljetavaldav!
Kas ema muretses selle sulle?

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_WhatDoYouThin.label: Text_WhatDoYouThinkYoureDoing
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_WhatDoYouThin.en: What do you think you're doing?

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ItsDangerousT.label: Text_ItsDangerousToGoAlone
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ItsDangerousT.en:
It's dangerous to go out without a #MON!
Wild #MON jump out of the
grass on the way to the next town.
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ItsDangerousT.et:
Ilma #MONita on ohtlik välja minna!
Metsikud #MONid hüppavad
rohust välja teel järgmisse linna.

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_YourMonIsAdor.label: Text_YourMonIsAdorable
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_YourMonIsAdor.en: Oh! Your #MON is adorable! I wish I had one!
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_YourMonIsAdor.et: Oh! Sinu #MON on nunnu! Sooviksin ka üht!

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_TellMomIfLeav.label: Text_TellMomIfLeaving
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_TellMomIfLeav.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>! Leaving again?
You should tell your mom if you are leaving.
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_TellMomIfLeav.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>! Kas lähed jälle?
Sa peaksid emale ütlema, kui ära lähed.

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_CallMomOnGear.label: Text_CallMomOnGear
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_CallMomOnGear.en:
Call your mom on your #GEAR to
let her know how you're doing.
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_CallMomOnGear.et:
Helista #GEARIGA emale,
et anda teada, kuidas sul läheb.

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ElmDiscovered.label: Text_ElmDiscoveredNewMon
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ElmDiscovered.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>!
I hear PROF.ELM discovered some new #MON.
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::Text_ElmDiscovered.et:
Hei, <PLAYER>!
Kuulsin, et PROF.ELM avastas mõne uue #MONi.

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownRivalTe.label: NewBarkTownRivalText1
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownRivalTe.en:
<……>
So this is the famous ELM #MON LAB…
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownRivalTe.et:
<……>
Nii et see on kuulus ELMI #MON LABOR…

maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownSignTex.label: NewBarkTownSignText
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownSignTex.en:
NEW BARK TOWN
The Town Where the Winds of a New Beginning Blow
maps/NewBarkTown.asm::NewBarkTownSignTex.et:
NEW BARK TOWN
Linn, kus puhuvad uue alguse tuuled

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakWelcomeKantoText.label: OakWelcomeKantoText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakWelcomeKantoText.en:
OAK: Ah, <PLAY_G>! It's good of you
to come all this way to KANTO.
What do you think of the trainers
out here? Pretty tough, huh?
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakWelcomeKantoText.et:
OAK: Ah, <PLAY_G>! Tore, et
tulid nii kaugele KANTOSSE.
Mida arvad siinsetest treeneritest?
Päris kõvad, mis?

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakLabDexCheckText.label: OakLabDexCheckText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakLabDexCheckText.en:
How is your #DEX coming?
Let's see…

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakLabGoodbyeText.label: OakLabGoodbyeText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakLabGoodbyeText.en: If you're in the area, I hope you come visit again.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakLabGoodbyeText.et: Kui oled kandis, loodan, et tuled jälle külla.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakOpenMtSilverText.label: OakOpenMtSilverText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakOpenMtSilverText.en:
OAK: Wow! That's excellent!
You collected the BADGES of GYMS in KANTO. Well done!
I was right in my assessment of you.
Tell you what, <PLAY_G>. I'll make
arrangements so that you can go to MT.SILVER.
MT.SILVER is a big mountain that is
home to many wild #MON.
It's too dangerous for your average
trainer, so it's off limits. But
we can make an exception in your case, <PLAY_G>.
Go up to INDIGO PLATEAU. You can
reach MT.SILVER from there.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakOpenMtSilverText.et:
OAK: Vau! See on suurepärane!
Kogusid KANTO SAALIDE MÄRGID. Tubli!
Mu hinnang sinu kohta oli õige.
Tead mis, <PLAY_G>. Korraldan nii,
et sa saaksid minna MT.SILVERISSE.
MT.SILVER on suur mägi, mis on
kodu paljudele metsikutele #MONidele.
See on tavatreenerile liiga
ohtlik, seega on see suletud. Aga
sinu puhul saame teha erandi, <PLAY_G>.
Mine üles INDIGO PLATEAULE. Sealt
jõuad MT.SILVERISSE.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakNoKantoBadgesText.label: OakNoKantoBadgesText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakNoKantoBadgesText.en:
OAK: Hmm? You're not collecting KANTO GYM BADGES?
The GYM LEADERS in KANTO are as tough
as any you battled in JOHTO.
I recommend that you challenge them.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakNoKantoBadgesText.et:
OAK: Hmm? Sa ei kogu KANTO SAALI MÄRKE?
KANTO SAALI JUHID on sama kõvad
kui need, kellega JOHTOS võitlesid.
Soovitan sul neile väljakutse esitada.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OakYesKantoBadgesText.label: OakYesKantoBadgesText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakYesKantoBadgesText.en:
OAK: Ah, you're collecting KANTO GYM BADGES.
I imagine that it's hard, but the
experience is sure to help you.
Come see me when you get them all.
I'll have a gift for you.
Keep trying hard, <PLAY_G>!
maps/OaksLab.asm::OakYesKantoBadgesText.et:
OAK: Ah, sa kogud KANTO SAALI MÄRKE.
Arvan, et see on raske, aga
kogemus aitab sind kindlasti.
Tule mind vaatama, kui saad need kõik.
Mul on sulle kingitus.
Püsi tubli, <PLAY_G>!

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant1Text.label: OaksAssistant1Text
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant1Text.en:
The PROF's #MON TALK radio program
isn't aired here in KANTO.
It's a shame--I'd like to hear it.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant1Text.et:
PROFI #MON JUTU raadiosaadet
ei näidata siin KANTOS.
Kahju - tahaksin seda kuulata.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant2Text.label: OaksAssistant2Text
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant2Text.en:
Thanks to your work on the #DEX, the PROF's
research is coming along great.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant2Text.et:
Tänu su tööle #DEXiga läheb PROFI
uurimistöö suurepäraselt.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant3Text.label: OaksAssistant3Text
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant3Text.en:
Don't tell anyone, but PROF.OAK'S
#MON TALK isn't a live broadcast.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksAssistant3Text.et:
Ära räägi kellelegi, aga PROF.OAKI
#MON JUTT pole otseülekanne.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPoster1Text.label: OaksLabPoster1Text
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPoster1Text.en: Press START to open the MENU.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPoster2Text.label: OaksLabPoster2Text
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPoster2Text.en:
The SAVE option is on the MENU.
Use it in a timely manner.
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPoster2Text.et:
SAVE-valik on MENÜÜS.
Kasuta seda õigel ajal.

maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPCText.label: OaksLabPCText
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPCText.en:
There's an e-mail message on the PC.
…
PROF.OAK, how is your research coming along?
I'm still plugging away.
I heard rumors that <PLAY_G> is
getting quite a reputation.
I'm delighted to hear that.
ELM in NEW BARK TOWN 8-)
maps/OaksLab.asm::OaksLabPCText.et:
Arvutis on e-kiri.
…
PROF.OAK, kuidas su uurimistöö edeneb?
Mina nokitsen ikka edasi.
Kuulsin kuuldusi, et <PLAY_G>
kogub päris kõva mainet.
Mul on rõõm seda kuulda.
ELM NEW BARK TOWNIST 8-)

maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.label: OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.en:
Hah! Your #MON sure look like lightweights!
They don't have the power to move boulders aside.
Here, use this and teach them STRENGTH!
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.et:
Hah! Su #MONid näevad välja nagu kärbsekaalud!
Neil pole jõudu rahne kõrvale lükata.
Säh, kasuta seda ja õpeta neile STRENGTH!

maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.label: OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText_GotStrength
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.en:
On the sea, the only thing you can
count on is your own good self!
I'm so proud of my buff bod!
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeStrengt.et:
Merel saad loota ainult iseendale!
Olen oma kõva keha üle nii uhke!

maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeFishing.label: OlivineCafeFishingGuruText
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeFishing.en:
OLIVINE CAFE's menu is chock full
of hearty fare for beefy SAILORS!
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeFishing.et: OLIVINE KOHVIKU menüü on tulvil toekat kraami kõvadele MEREMEESTELE!

maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeSailorT.label: OlivineCafeSailorText
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeSailorT.en:
Whenever I roll into this town, I
always visit the OLIVINE CAFE.
Everything on the menu makes me feel
stronger. I can't stop eating!
maps/OlivineCafe.asm::OlivineCafeSailorT.et:
Iga kord siia linna sattudes külastan OLIVINE KOHVIKUT.
Kõik menüüs teeb mind tugevamaks. Ma ei suuda süüa lõpetada!

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityRivalTe.label: OlivineCityRivalText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityRivalTe.en:
…
You again?
There's no need to panic. I don't
bother with wimps like you.
Speaking of weaklings, the city's
GYM LEADER isn't here.
Supposedly taking care of a sick
#MON at the LIGHTHOUSE.
Humph! Boo-hoo! Just let sick #MON go!
A #MON that can't battle is worthless!
Why don't you go train at the LIGHTHOUSE?
Who knows. It may make you a bit less weak!
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityRivalTe.et:
…
Jälle sina?
Pole vaja paanitseda. Sinusuguste nõrkudega ma ei tegele.
Nõrkadest rääkides — selle linna SAALI JUHT pole siin.
Olevat TULETORNIS haige #MONi eest hoolitsemas.
Hmph! Ää-ää! Lase haiged #MONid lihtsalt lahti!
#MON, kes ei suuda võidelda, on väärtusetu!
Mine ise TULETORNIS treenima.
Kes teab. Ehk teeb see sind pisut vähem nõrgaks!

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor1.label: OlivineCitySailor1Text
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor1.en:
Dark roads are dangerous at night.
But in the pitchblack of night,
the sea is even more treacherous!
Without the beacon of the LIGHTHOUSE
to guide it, no ship can sail.
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor1.et:
Pimedad teed on öösel ohtlikud.
Aga pilkases öös on meri veelgi salakavalam!
Ilma TULETORNI teejuhtiva tuleta ei saa ükski laev sõita.

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.label: OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokegearText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.en: That thing you have--it's a #GEAR, right? Wow, that's cool.
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.et: See asi, mis sul on — see on #GEAR, eks? Vau, lahe.

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.label: OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokedexText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.en:
Wow, you have a #DEX!
That is just so awesome.
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityStandin.et:
Vau, sul on #DEX!
See on lihtsalt vägev.

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor2.label: OlivineCitySailor2Text
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor2.en:
The sea is sweet!
Sunsets on the sea are marvelous!
Sing with me! Yo-ho! Blow the man down!…
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySailor2.et:
Meri on mõnus!
Päikeseloojangud merel on imelised!
Laula minuga! Jo-hoo! Puhu meremees pikali!…

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySignTex.label: OlivineCitySignText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCitySignTex.en:
OLIVINE CITY
The Port Closest to Foreign Lands

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineGymSignText.label: OlivineGymSignText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineGymSignText.en:
OLIVINE CITY #MON GYM LEADER: JASMINE
The Steel-Clad Defense Girl
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineGymSignText.et:
OLIVINE CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: JASMINE
Terasrüüs kaitsetüdruk

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineLighthouseS.label: OlivineLighthouseSignText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineLighthouseS.en: OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE Also known as the GLITTER LIGHTHOUSE
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineLighthouseS.et: OLIVINE TULETORN, tuntud ka kui SÄRAV TULETORN

maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityBattleT.label: OlivineCityBattleTowerSignText
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityBattleT.en:
BATTLE TOWER AHEAD Opening Now!
BATTLE TOWER AHEAD
maps/OlivineCity.asm::OlivineCityBattleT.et:
LAHINGUTORN EES — nüüd avatud!
LAHINGUTORN EES

maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::OfferGoodR.label: OfferGoodRodText
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::OfferGoodR.en:
OLIVINE is on the sea!
And if it's on the sea, there are bound to be fish!
I've fished here for 30 years.
Would you like to face the sea and fish?
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::OfferGoodR.et:
OLIVINE on mere ääres!
Ja kui on meri, siis on kindlasti kalu!
Olen siin 30 aastat kala püüdnud.
Kas soovid mere poole pöörduda ja kala püüda?

maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GiveGoodRo.label: GiveGoodRodText
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GiveGoodRo.en: Ah, hahah! We have ourselves a new angler!
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GiveGoodRo.et: Ah, hahaa! Meil on uus õngitseja!

maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GaveGoodRo.label: GaveGoodRodText
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GaveGoodRo.en:
Fish aren't found in the sea alone.
They go wherever there is water.
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::GaveGoodRo.et:
Kalu ei leidu ainult meres.
Nad on kõikjal, kus on vett.

maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::DontWantGo.label: DontWantGoodRodText
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::DontWantGo.en: Whaaat? You don't like to fish!? Incomprehensible!
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::DontWantGo.et: Miiis? Sulle ei meeldi kala püüda!? Arusaamatu!

maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::HaveGoodRo.label: HaveGoodRodText
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::HaveGoodRo.en: How are things? Land the big one?
maps/OlivineGoodRodHouse.asm::HaveGoodRo.et: Kuidas läheb? Kas said suure kala kätte?

maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_SteelTypeIn.label: Jasmine_SteelTypeIntro
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_SteelTypeIn.en:
…Thank you for your help at the LIGHTHOUSE…
But this is different. Please
allow me to introduce myself.
I am JASMINE, a GYM LEADER. I use the steel-type.
…Do you know about the steel-type?
It's a type that was only recently discovered.
…Um… May I begin?
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_SteelTypeIn.et:
…Aitäh abi eest TULETORNIS…
Aga see on midagi muud. Lubage end tutvustada.
Olen JASMINE, SAALI JUHT. Kasutan teras-tüüpi.
…Kas tead teras-tüüpi?
See on tüüp, mis avastati alles hiljuti.
…Ee… Kas võin alustada?

maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BetterTrain.label: Jasmine_BetterTrainer
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BetterTrain.en:
…You are a better trainer than me,
in both skill and kindness.
In accordance with LEAGUE rules, I
confer upon you this BADGE.
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BetterTrain.et:
…Sa oled minust parem treener — nii oskuselt kui headuselt.
LIIGA reeglite kohaselt annan sulle selle MÄRGI.

maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BadgeSpeech.label: Jasmine_BadgeSpeech
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BadgeSpeech.en:
MINERALBADGE raises #MON's DEFENSE.
…Um… Please take this too…
<PLAYER> received TM09.
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_BadgeSpeech.et:
MINERALBADGE tõstab #MONi KAITSET.
…Ee… Palun võta seegi…
<PLAYER> sai TM09.

maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_IronTailSpe.label: Jasmine_IronTailSpeech
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_IronTailSpe.en: …You could use that TM to teach IRON TAIL.

maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_GoodLuck.label: Jasmine_GoodLuck
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_GoodLuck.en: Um… I don't know how to say this, but good luck…
maps/OlivineGym.asm::Jasmine_GoodLuck.et: Ee… ma ei oska seda öelda, aga edu…

maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideText.label: OlivineGymGuideText
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideText.en:
JASMINE uses the newly discovered steel-type.
I don't know very much about it.
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideText.et:
JASMINE kasutab äsja avastatud teras-tüüpi.
Ma ei tea sellest eriti midagi.

maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideWinT.label: OlivineGymGuideWinText
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideWinT.en:
That was awesome.
The steel-type, huh?
That was a close encounter of an unknown kind!
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuideWinT.et:
See oli vägev.
Teras-tüüp, ah?
See oli lähikohtumine tundmatut liiki!

maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuidePreT.label: OlivineGymGuidePreText
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuidePreT.en:
JASMINE, the GYM LEADER, is at the LIGHTHOUSE.
She's been tending to a sick #MON.
A strong trainer has to be compassionate.
maps/OlivineGym.asm::OlivineGymGuidePreT.et:
SAALI JUHT JASMINE on TULETORNIS.
Ta hoolitseb haige #MONi eest.
Tugev treener peab olema kaastundlik.

maps/OlivineHouseBeta.asm::OlivineHouseB.label: OlivineHouseBetaTeacherText
maps/OlivineHouseBeta.asm::OlivineHouseB.en:
When my #MON got sick, the
PHARMACIST in ECRUTEAK made some medicine for me.
maps/OlivineHouseBeta.asm::OlivineHouseB.et:
Kui mu #MON haigeks jäi, tegi
ECRUTEAKI FARMATSEUT mulle ravimit.

maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.label: OlivineLighthouse1FSailorText
maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.en:
People train at this LIGHTHOUSE.
It's not easy to climb because of all the trainers.
maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.et:
Selles TULETORNIS treenitakse.
Sinna on treenerite tõttu raske ronida.

maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.label: OlivineLighthouse1FPokefanFText
maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.en:
In the past, #MON used to light
the sea around OLIVINE at night.
The LIGHTHOUSE was made in honor of those #MON.
maps/OlivineLighthouse1F.asm::OlivineLig.et:
Vanasti valgustasid #MONid
öösel OLIVINE ümbrust merel.
TULETORN ehitati nende #MONide auks.

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.label: SailorHueySeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.en: Men of the sea are always spoiling for a good fight!
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.et: Meremehed on alati hea kakluse peale väljas!

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.label: SailorHueyBeatenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.en:
Urf! I lose!
What power! How would you like
to sail the seas with me?
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.et:
Urf! Kaotan!
Küll on jõudu! Kuidas oleks, kui sõidaksid minuga merele?

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.label: GentlemanAlfredSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.en: Hm? This is no place for playing.

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.label: GentlemanAlfredBeatenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.en: Ah! I can see that you're serious.
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.et: Ah! Näen, et sa oled tõsine.

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.label: GentlemanAlfredAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.en:
Up top is a #MON that keeps the LIGHTHOUSE lit.
But I hear that it's sick now and
can't be cured by ordinary medicine.
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::GentlemanA.et:
Üleval on #MON, kes hoiab TULETORNI põlemas.
Aga kuulen, et ta on nüüd haige ega parane tavalise rohuga.

maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.label: SailorHueyGiveProteinText
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.en:
Man! You're as tough as ever!
Anyway, here's that medicine from before.
maps/OlivineLighthouse2F.asm::SailorHuey.et:
Vau! Sa oled endiselt kõva!
Igatahes, siin on see rohi, mida enne lubasin.

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.label: BirdKeeperTheoSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.en:
Why are you here? Are you just going
to gawk? I suggest that you leave!
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.et: Miks sa siin oled? Kas tulid lihtsalt jõllitama? Soovitan sul lahkuda!

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.label: BirdKeeperTheoAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.en:
How the heck do you go up?
I want to visit the sick #MON,
but I can't get up there…
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::BirdKeeper.et:
Kuidas kuradi moodi üles saab?
Tahan haiget #MONi vaatama minna, aga ei pääse sinna…

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.label: SailorTerrellSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.en: Sailors are both kind and strong. How about you?
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.et: Meremehed on nii lahked kui tugevad. Aga sina?

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.label: SailorTerrellBeatenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.en: You are both kind and strong…
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.et: Sa oled nii lahke kui tugev…

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.label: SailorTerrellAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.en:
Every time I come back to OLIVINE, I visit the GYM.
The GYM LEADER's #MON type has
changed without me noticing.
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::SailorTerr.et:
Iga kord OLIVINESSE naastes külastan SAALI.
SAALI JUHI #MONi tüüp on märkamatult muutunud.
