maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.label: GentlemanPrestonSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.en: I travel the world to train my #MON. I wish to battle with you.
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.et: Rändan mööda maailma, et oma #MONe treenida. Soovin sinuga võidelda.

maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.label: GentlemanPrestonAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.en: JASMINE used to use rock #MON like ONIX.
maps/OlivineLighthouse3F.asm::GentlemanP.et: JASMINE kasutas vanasti kivi-#MONe nagu ONIX.

maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.label: SailorKentSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.en:
JASMINE must be worried sick about the #MON here.
She won't even smile these days.
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.et:
JASMINE muretseb kindlasti siinse #MONi pärast surmani.
Ta ei naerata neil päevil isegi.

maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.label: SailorKentBeatenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.en: I can't manage a smile either…

maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.label: SailorKentAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.en:
Speaking of sick, I've heard there's
a good PHARMACY in CIANWOOD.
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::SailorKent.et: Haigusest rääkides — kuulsin, et CIANWOODIS on hea APTEEK.

maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.label: LassConnie1SeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.en:
JASMINE is this city's GYM LEADER.
I mean to bring her back with me.
Nobody had better get in my way!
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.et:
JASMINE on selle linna SAALI JUHT.
Kavatsen ta endaga tagasi tuua.
Ärgu keegi mind takistagu!

maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.label: LassConnie1AfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.en:
Right. Anybody would be worried if his or her own #MON were hurt.
I'll pray for the #MON here, so
JASMINE can come back to the GYM.
maps/OlivineLighthouse4F.asm::LassConnie.et:
Õigus. Igaüks muretseks, kui ta enda #MON oleks haige.
Palvetan siinse #MONi eest, et JASMINE saaks SAALI tagasi.

maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.label: SailorErnestSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.en:
I wanted to battle JASMINE, but she's
not up to it now. So, how about you?
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.et: Tahtsin JASMINEGA võidelda, aga ta pole praegu võimeline. Kuidas oleks sinuga?

maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.label: SailorErnestAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.en:
A GYM LEADER isn't just about being
strong. A LEADER also needs to be compassionate.
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::SailorErne.et: SAALI JUHT ei pea olema ainult tugev. Juht peab olema ka kaastundlik.

maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.label: BirdKeeperDenisSeenText
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.en:
We're pretty high up here. My bird
#MON are in prime form.
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.et: Oleme siin päris kõrgel. Mu linnu-#MONid on tippvormis.

maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.label: BirdKeeperDenisAfterBattleText
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.en:
My #MON learned how to use FLY in CIANWOOD.
Well, since I'm a loser, I'll FLY across the sea…
maps/OlivineLighthouse5F.asm::BirdKeeper.et:
Mu #MON õppis CIANWOODIS FLY-d kasutama.
Noh, kuna olen luuser, lendan üle mere minema…

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineCia.label: JasmineCianwoodPharmacyText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineCia.en:
JASMINE: … This #MON always
kept the sea lit at night.
…But it suddenly got sick… It's gasping for air…
…I understand that there is a
wonderful PHARMACY in CIANWOOD…
But that's across the sea…
And I can't leave AMPHY unattended…
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineCia.et:
JASMINE: …See #MON hoidis alati merd öösel valgena.
…Aga järsku jäi ta haigeks… Ta ahmib õhku…
…Kuulen, et CIANWOODIS on suurepärane APTEEK…
Aga see on üle mere…
Ja ma ei saa AMPHYT järelevalveta jätta…

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineGet.label: JasmineGetSomeMedicineText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineGet.en: …May I ask you to get some medicine for me? Please?
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineGet.et: …Kas tohin paluda sul mulle rohtu tuua? Palun?

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineCur.label: JasmineCureAmphyText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineCur.et: JASMINE: …Kas see rohi ravib AMPHY terveks?

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineDon.label: JasmineDontBeOffendedText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineDon.en:
JASMINE: …Um, please don't be offended…
…AMPHY will not take anything from anyone but me…
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineDon.et:
JASMINE: …Ee, palun ära solvu…
…AMPHY ei võta midagi vastu kelleltki peale minu…

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineAmp.label: JasmineAmphyHowAreYouFeelingText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineAmp.en:
JASMINE: …
AMPHY, how are you feeling?

maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineTha.label: JasmineThankYouText
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineTha.en:
JASMINE: …Oh, I'm so relieved…
This is just so wonderful…
Thank you so very, very much.
…I will return to the GYM…
maps/OlivineLighthouse6F.asm::JasmineTha.et:
JASMINE: …Oh, mul on nii kergem…
See on lihtsalt imeline…
Suur-suur tänu sulle.
…Naasen nüüd SAALI…

maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartCooltra.label: OlivineMartCooltrainerFText
maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartCooltra.en:
Do your #MON already know the
move for carrying people on water?
maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartCooltra.et:
Kas su #MONid juba oskavad
rünnakut inimeste vee peal kandmiseks?

maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartLassTex.label: OlivineMartLassText
maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartLassTex.en:
My BUTTERFREE came from my boyfriend overseas.
It carried some MAIL from him.
Want to know what it says?
Let's see… Nope! It's a secret!
maps/OlivineMart.asm::OlivineMartLassTex.et:
Mu BUTTERFREE tuli mu välismaiselt poiss-sõbralt.
See kandis temalt MAILi.
Tahad teada, mida seal öeldakse?
Vaatame… Ei! See on saladus!

maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.label: OlivinePokecenter1FFisherText
maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.en:
The SAILOR in the OLIVINE CAFE next
door is really generous.
He taught my #MON STRENGTH.
Now it can move big boulders.
maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.et:
Kõrvaltoas OLIVINE CAFES
on MADRUS tõesti helde.
Ta õpetas mu #MONile STRENGTHi.
Nüüd saab see suuri rahne liigutada.

maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.label: OlivinePokecenter1FTeacherText
maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.en:
There's a person in CIANWOOD CITY across the sea.
I heard him bragging about his rare #MON.
maps/OlivinePokecenter1F.asm::OlivinePok.et:
Mere taga CIANWOOD CITYS on üks inimene.
Kuulsin teda oma haruldase #MONiga kiitlemas.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortSailorG.label: OlivinePortSailorGetOnBoardText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortSailorG.en: We're departing soon. Please get on board.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortCantBoa.label: OlivinePortCantBoardText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortCantBoa.et: Vabandust. Sa ei saa praegu pardale.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortAskBoar.label: OlivinePortAskBoardText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortAskBoar.en:
Welcome to FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA.
Will you be boarding today?
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortAskBoar.et:
Tere tulemast KIIRLAEVA S.S.AQUA.
Kas lähed täna pardale?

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortComeAga.label: OlivinePortComeAgainText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortComeAga.en: We hope to see you again!

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFlashTi.label: OlivinePortFlashTicketText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFlashTi.en:
<PLAYER> flashed the S.S.TICKET.
That's it. Thank you!

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortNoTicke.label: OlivinePortNoTicketText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortNoTicke.en:
<PLAYER> tried to show the S.S. TICKET…
…But no TICKET!
Sorry! You may board only
if you have an S.S.TICKET.
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortNoTicke.et:
<PLAYER> üritas näidata S.S. TICKETit…
…Aga TICKETit pole!
Vabandust! Pardale saad ainult siis,
kui sul on S.S.TICKET.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortMondayS.label: OlivinePortMondayShipText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortMondayS.en: The FAST SHIP will sail next Monday.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFridayS.label: OlivinePortFridayShipText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFridayS.en: The FAST SHIP will sail next Friday.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.label: OlivinePortFishingGuru1Text
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.en:
SHELLDER are easy to catch here.
They're kind of rare elsewhere.
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.et:
SHELLDERit on siin lihtne püüda.
Mujal on nad üsna haruldased.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.label: OlivinePortFishingGuru2Text
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.en:
How many RODS do you have?
Different RODS catch different #MON.
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortFishing.et:
Mitu RODi sul on?
Erinevad RODid püüavad erinevaid #MONe.

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortYoungst.label: OlivinePortYoungsterText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortYoungst.en: S.S.AQUA uses jets to skim over the waves!
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortYoungst.et: S.S.AQUA kasutab laineist üle libisemiseks jugasid!

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortCooltra.label: OlivinePortCooltrainerFText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortCooltra.en:
There are lots of #MON in KANTO.
I wish I could go…
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortCooltra.et:
KANTOS on palju #MONe.
Sooviksin, et saaksin minna…

maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortSailorB.label: OlivinePortSailorBeforeHOFText
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortSailorB.en:
We don't want you to fall into the
sea, so you're not allowed in.
maps/OlivinePort.asm::OlivinePortSailorB.et:
Me ei taha, et sa merre
kukuksid, seega sind sisse ei lubata.

maps/OlivinePortPassage.asm::OlivinePort.label: OlivinePortPassagePokefanMText
maps/OlivinePortPassage.asm::OlivinePort.en:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA sails to KANTO on
Mondays and Fridays.
maps/OlivinePortPassage.asm::OlivinePort.et:
KIIRLAEV S.S.AQUA sõidab KANTOSSE
esmaspäeviti ja reedeti.

maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.label: OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDadText
maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.en:
Along the way to CIANWOOD, there
are four deserted islands.
Bad kids are taken to the islands as punishment!
maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.et:
Teel CIANWOODI on
neli mahajäetud saart.
Halvad lapsed viiakse karistuseks saartele!

maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.label: OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDaughterText
maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.en: Whenever I get in trouble, Daddy always scares me.
maps/OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouse.asm::O.et: Kui satun pahandusse, hirmutab issi mind alati.

maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownTeacherTe.label: PalletTownTeacherText
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownTeacherTe.en:
I'm raising #MON too.
They serve as my private guards.
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownTeacherTe.et:
Ka mina kasvatan #MONe.
Nad on mu isiklikud valvurid.

maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownFisherTex.label: PalletTownFisherText
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownFisherTex.en:
Technology is incredible!
You can now trade #MON across time like e-mail.
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownFisherTex.et:
Tehnoloogia on uskumatu!
Nüüd saab #MONe vahetada üle aja nagu e-kirju.

maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownSignText.label: PalletTownSignText
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownSignText.en:
PALLET TOWN
A Tranquil Setting of Peace & Purity
maps/PalletTown.asm::PalletTownSignText.et:
PALLET TOWN
Rahu ja puhtuse vaikne paik

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityCooltrain.label: PewterCityCooltrainerFText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityCooltrain.en:
Have you visited PEWTER GYM?
The LEADER uses rock-type #MON.
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityCooltrain.et:
Kas oled külastanud PEWTERI SAALI?
JUHT kasutab kivi-tüüpi #MONe.

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityBugCatche.label: PewterCityBugCatcherText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityBugCatche.en:
At night, CLEFAIRY come out to play at MT.MOON.
But not every night.
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityBugCatche.et:
Öösel tulevad CLEFAIRYd MT.MOONILE mängima.
Aga mitte igal ööl.

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.label: PewterCityGrampsText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.en:
Ah, you came all the way out here from JOHTO?
That brings back memories. When I
was young, I went to JOHTO to train.
You remind me so much of what I was
like as a young man.
Here. I want you to have this item I found in JOHTO.
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.et:
Ah, tulid siia välja JOHTOST?
See toob mälestusi. Kui olin noor, käisin JOHTOS treenimas.
Sa meenutad mulle nii väga mind ennast noore mehena.
Säh. Tahan sulle anda selle eseme, mille JOHTOST leidsin.

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.label: PewterCityGrampsText_GotSilverWing
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.en:
Going to new, unknown places and seeing new people…
Those are the joys of travel.
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityGrampsTex.et:
Uutesse, tundmatutesse paikadesse minna ja uusi inimesi näha…
Need on reisimise rõõmud.

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCitySignText.label: PewterCitySignText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCitySignText.en: PEWTER CITY A Stone Gray City

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterGymSignText.label: PewterGymSignText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterGymSignText.en:
PEWTER CITY #MON GYM LEADER: BROCK
The Rock Solid #MON Trainer
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterGymSignText.et:
PEWTER CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: BROCK
Kaljukindel #MONi treener

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterMuseumSignTex.label: PewterMuseumSignText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterMuseumSignTex.en:
There's a notice here…
PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE is closed for renovations…
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterMuseumSignTex.et:
Siin on teade…
PEWTERI TEADUSMUUSEUM on remondi tõttu suletud…

maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityMtMoonGif.label: PewterCityMtMoonGiftShopSignText
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityMtMoonGif.en:
There's a notice here…
MT.MOON GIFT SHOP NOW OPEN!
maps/PewterCity.asm::PewterCityMtMoonGif.et:
Siin on teade…
MT.MOON KINGIPOOD NÜÜD AVATUD!

maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockIntroText.label: BrockIntroText
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockIntroText.en:
BROCK: Wow, it's not often that we
get a challenger from JOHTO.
I'm BROCK, the PEWTER GYM LEADER.
I'm an expert on rock-type #MON.
My #MON are impervious to most
physical attacks. You'll have a hard
time inflicting any damage.
Come on!
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockIntroText.et:
BROCK: Vau, pole just tihti, et saame väljakutsuja JOHTOST.
Olen BROCK, PEWTERI SAALI JUHT.
Olen kivi-tüüpi #MONide asjatundja.
Mu #MONid on enamiku füüsiliste rünnakute suhtes tundetud. Sul on raske neile kahju teha.
Tule!

maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockWinLossText.label: BrockWinLossText
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockWinLossText.en:
BROCK: Your #MON's powerful attacks overcame my rock-hard defense…
You're stronger than I expected…
Go ahead--take this BADGE.
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockWinLossText.et:
BROCK: Su #MONi võimsad rünnakud ületasid mu kaljukõva kaitse…
Sa oled tugevam kui arvasin…
Aga võta — see MÄRK.

maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockBoulderBadgeTex.label: BrockBoulderBadgeText
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockBoulderBadgeTex.en:
BROCK: <PLAY_G>, thanks. I enjoyed
battling you, even though I am a bit upset.
That BOULDERBADGE will make your
#MON even more powerful.
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockBoulderBadgeTex.et:
BROCK: <PLAY_G>, aitäh. Nautisin sinuga võitlemist, kuigi olen veidi endast väljas.
See BOULDERBADGE teeb su #MONid veelgi võimsamaks.

maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockFightDoneText.label: BrockFightDoneText
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockFightDoneText.en:
BROCK: The world is huge. There are
still many strong trainers like you.
Just wait and see. I'm going to become a lot stronger too.
maps/PewterGym.asm::BrockFightDoneText.et:
BROCK: Maailm on suur. On veel palju tugevaid treenereid nagu sina.
Oota ja vaata. Ka mina saan palju tugevamaks.

maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerrySeenText.label: CamperJerrySeenText
maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerrySeenText.en:
The trainers of this GYM use rocktype #MON.
The rock-type has high DEFENSE.
Battles could end up going a long
time. Are you ready for this?
maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerrySeenText.et:
Selle SAALI treenerid kasutavad kivi-tüüpi #MONe.
Kivi-tüübil on kõrge KAITSE.
Lahingud võivad kaua kesta. Kas oled selleks valmis?

maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerryBeatenTex.label: CamperJerryBeatenText
maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerryBeatenTex.en: I have to win these battles…

maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerryAfterBatt.label: CamperJerryAfterBattleText
maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerryAfterBatt.en:
Hey, you! Trainer from JOHTO! BROCK
is tough. He'll punish you if you
don't take him seriously.
maps/PewterGym.asm::CamperJerryAfterBatt.et: Hei, sina! Treener JOHTOST! BROCK on kõva. Ta karistab sind, kui teda tõsiselt ei võta.

maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideText.label: PewterGymGuideText
maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideText.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making! You're
really rocking. Are you battling
the GYM LEADERS of KANTO?
They're strong and dedicated people,
just like JOHTO's GYM LEADERS.
maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideText.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION! Sa tõesti rokid.
Kas võitled KANTO SAALI JUHTIDEGA?
Nad on tugevad ja pühendunud inimesed, nagu JOHTO SAALI JUHIDki.

maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideWinTex.label: PewterGymGuideWinText
maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideWinTex.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making! That GYM
didn't give you much trouble.
The way you took charge was really
inspiring. I mean that seriously.
maps/PewterGym.asm::PewterGymGuideWinTex.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION! See SAAL ei valmistanud sulle suurt tüli.
See, kuidas sa ohjad haarasid, oli tõeliselt innustav. Ma mõtlen seda tõsiselt.

maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartYoungster.label: PewterMartYoungsterText
maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartYoungster.en:
Hi! Check out my GYARADOS!
I raised it from a MAGIKARP. I can't
believe how strong it has become.
maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartYoungster.et:
Tere! Vaata mu GYARADOST!
Kasvatasin selle MAGIKARPist. Ma ei
usu, kui tugevaks see on saanud.

maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartSuperNerd.label: PewterMartSuperNerdText
maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartSuperNerd.en:
There once was a weird old man who sold MAGIKARP.
He was saying the MAGIKARP from the
LAKE OF RAGE were excellent.
maps/PewterMart.asm::PewterMartSuperNerd.et:
Kunagi oli imelik vanamees, kes müüs MAGIKARPi.
Ta ütles, et LAKE OF RAGE
MAGIKARPid on suurepärased.

maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.label: PewterPokecenter1FTeacherText
maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.en:
…Yeah, and the GYM in CINNABAR's
gone. I was really amazed.
…Yes? I'm on the phone. Go away!
maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.et:
…Jah, ja SAAL CINNABARIS on
kadunud. Olin tõesti hämmastunud.
…Jah? Ma räägin telefoniga. Mine ära!

maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.label: PewterPokecenter1FBugCatcherText
maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.en:
Most #MON get drowsy if they
hear a JIGGLYPUFF singing.
There are several moves that can be
used only while a #MON is asleep.
maps/PewterPokecenter1F.asm::PewterPokec.et:
Enamik #MONe jääb uniseks, kui
kuuleb JIGGLYPUFFi laulmas.
On mitu rünnakut, mida saab
kasutada ainult siis, kui #MON magab.

maps/PewterSnoozeSpeechHouse.asm::Pewter.label: PewterSnoozeSpeechHouseGrampsText
maps/PewterSnoozeSpeechHouse.asm::Pewter.en: I like snoozing with the radio on… …Zzzz…

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ElmsLookingForY.label: ElmsLookingForYouText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ElmsLookingForY.en:
Oh, <PLAYER>…! Our neighbor, PROF.
ELM, was looking for you.
He said he wanted you to do something for him.
Oh! I almost forgot! Your #MON
GEAR is back from the repair shop.
Here you go!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ElmsLookingForY.et:
Oh, <PLAYER>…! Meie naaber, PROF.
ELM, otsis sind.
Ta ütles, et soovib sinult abi.
Oh! Peaaegu unustasin! Sinu #MON
GEAR tuli parandusest tagasi.
Säh, palun!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::MomGivesPokegea.label: MomGivesPokegearText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::MomGivesPokegea.en:
#MON GEAR, or just #GEAR.
It's essential if you want to be a good trainer.
Oh, the day of the week isn't set.
You mustn't forget that!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::MomGivesPokegea.et:
#MON GEAR ehk lihtsalt #GEAR.
See on hädavajalik, kui tahad olla hea treener.
Oh, nädalapäev pole paika pandud.
Sa ei tohi seda unustada!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::IsItDSTText.label: IsItDSTText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::IsItDSTText.en: Is it Daylight Saving Time now?

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ComeHomeForDSTT.label: ComeHomeForDSTText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ComeHomeForDSTT.en:
Come home to adjust your clock
for Daylight Saving Time.
By the way, do you know how to use the PHONE?
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ComeHomeForDSTT.et:
Tule koju kella reguleerima
suveaja jaoks.
Muide, kas oskad TELEFONI kasutada?

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::KnowTheInstruct.label: KnowTheInstructionsText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::KnowTheInstruct.en:
Don't you just turn the #GEAR
on and select the PHONE icon?
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::KnowTheInstruct.et:
Kas ei tule lihtsalt #GEAR
sisse lülitada ja valida TELEFONI ikoon?

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::DontKnowTheInst.label: DontKnowTheInstructionsText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::DontKnowTheInst.en:
I'll read the instructions.
Turn the #GEAR on and select the PHONE icon.
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::DontKnowTheInst.et:
Loen juhendi ette.
Lülita #GEAR sisse ja vali TELEFONI ikoon.

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::InstructionsNex.label: InstructionsNextText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::InstructionsNex.en:
Phone numbers are stored in memory.
Just choose a name you want to call.
Gee, isn't that convenient?
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::InstructionsNex.et:
Telefoninumbrid salvestatakse mällu.
Vali lihtsalt nimi, kellele helistada.
Kas pole mugav?

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::HurryUpElmIsWai.label: HurryUpElmIsWaitingText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::HurryUpElmIsWai.en:
PROF.ELM is waiting for you.
Hurry up, baby!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::SoWhatWasProfEl.label: SoWhatWasProfElmsErrandText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::SoWhatWasProfEl.en:
So, what was PROF. ELM's errand?
…
That does sound challenging.
But, you should be proud that people rely on you.
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::SoWhatWasProfEl.et:
Niisiis, mis asja PROF. ELM sult tahtis?
…
See kõlab tõesti keeruliselt.
Aga ole uhke, et inimesed sinu peale loodavad.

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ImBehindYouText.label: ImBehindYouText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ImBehindYouText.en:
<PLAYER>, do it!
I'm behind you all the way!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::ImBehindYouText.et:
<PLAYER>, tee ära!
Ma toetan sind kogu südamest!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::NeighborText.label: NeighborText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::NeighborText.en:
<PLAY_G>, have you heard?
My daughter is adamant about
becoming PROF. ELM's assistant.
She really loves #MON!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::NeighborText.et:
<PLAY_G>, oled kuulnud?
Mu tütar tahab kindlalt
saada PROF. ELMi assistendiks.
Ta armastab #MONe tõesti!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FS.label: PlayersHouse1FStoveText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FS.et:
Ema kuulus roog!
CINNABAR VOLCANO BURGER!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FS.label: PlayersHouse1FSinkText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FS.en: The sink is spotless. Mom likes it clean.
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FS.et: Kraanikauss on plekitu. Ema armastab puhtust.

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FF.label: PlayersHouse1FFridgeText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FF.en:
Let's see what's in the fridge…
FRESH WATER and tasty LEMONADE!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FF.et:
Vaatame, mis külmkapis on…
FRESH WATER ja maitsev LEMONADE!

maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FT.label: PlayersHouse1FTVText
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FT.en:
There's a movie on TV: Stars dot the
sky as two boys ride on a train…
I'd better get rolling too!
maps/PlayersHouse1F.asm::PlayersHouse1FT.et:
Telekas käib film: tähed täpivad
taevast, kui kaks poissi rongiga sõidavad…
Peaksin minagi teele asuma!

maps/PlayersHouse2F.asm::PlayersRadioTex.label: PlayersRadioText1
maps/PlayersHouse2F.asm::PlayersRadioTex.en: PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK! Please tune in next time!

maps/PlayersHouse2F.asm::PlayersRadioTex.label: PlayersRadioText3
maps/PlayersHouse2F.asm::PlayersRadioTex.en: This is DJ MARY, your co-host!

maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.label: PlayersNeighborsDaughterText
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.en:
PIKACHU is an evolved #MON.
I was amazed by PROF.ELM's findings.
He's so famous for his research on #MON evolution.
…sigh…
I wish I could be a researcher like him…
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.et:
PIKACHU on arenenud #MON.
Mind hämmastasid PROF.ELMi leiud.
Ta on kuulus oma #MONi evolutsiooni uuringute poolest.
…ohh…
Sooviksin olla temasugune uurija…

maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.label: PlayersNeighborText
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.en:
My daughter is adamant about
becoming PROF. ELM's assistant.
She really loves #MON!
But then, so do I!
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayersN.et:
Mu tütar tahab kindlalt
saada PROF. ELMi assistendiks.
Ta armastab #MONe tõesti!
Aga eks minagi armasta!

maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayerNe.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText1
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayerNe.en: PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK! Please tune in next time!

maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayerNe.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText3
maps/PlayersNeighborsHouse.asm::PlayerNe.en: This is DJ MARY, your co-host!

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.label: Text_BattleReceptionistMobile
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.en:
Would you like to battle over a GAME
LINK cable or by mobile phone?
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.et:
Kas soovid võidelda GAME LINK
kaabli või mobiiltelefoni kaudu?

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.label: Text_TradeReceptionistMobile
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.en:
Would you like to trade over a GAME
LINK cable or by mobile phone?
This way to the MOBILE ROOM.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.et:
Kas soovid vahetada GAME LINK
kaabli või mobiiltelefoni kaudu?
Siiapoole MOBILE ROOMI.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.label: Text_BattleReceptionistIntro
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.en:
Welcome to CABLE CLUB COLOSSEUM.
You may battle a friend here.
Would you like to battle?
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRecept.et:
Tere tulemast CABLE CLUB COLOSSEUMISSE.
Siin võid sõbraga võidelda.
Kas soovid võidelda?

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.label: Text_TradeReceptionistIntro
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.en:
Welcome to CABLE TRADE CENTER.
You may trade your #MON here with a friend.
Would you like to trade?
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRecepti.et:
Tere tulemast CABLE TRADE CENTERISSE.
Siin võid sõbraga #MONe vahetada.
Kas soovid vahetada?

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TimeCapsuleR.label: Text_TimeCapsuleReceptionistIntro
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TimeCapsuleR.en:
Welcome to CABLE CLUB TIME CAPSULE.
You can travel to the past and trade your #MON.
Would you like to trade across time?
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TimeCapsuleR.et:
Tere tulemast CABLE CLUB TIME CAPSULESSE.
Võid reisida minevikku ja #MONe vahetada.
Kas soovid ajas vahetada?

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MustSaveGame.label: Text_MustSaveGame
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MustSaveGame.en: Before opening the link, you must save your game.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MustSaveGame.et: Enne ühenduse avamist pead mängu salvestama.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_LinkTimedOut.label: Text_LinkTimedOut
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_LinkTimedOut.en:
The link has been closed because of inactivity.
Please contact your friend and come again.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_LinkTimedOut.et:
Ühendus suleti tegevusetuse tõttu.
Võta sõbraga ühendust ja tule jälle.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_PleaseComeAg.label: Text_PleaseComeAgain
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_PleaseComeAg.en:
Please come again.
Please come in.
We'll put you in the link room for the time being.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_PleaseComeAg.et:
Tule palun jälle.
Tule palun sisse.
Paneme su esialgu ühendustuppa.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_CantLinkToTh.label: Text_CantLinkToThePast
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_CantLinkToTh.en: You can't link to the past here.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.label: Text_RejectMonWithNewMove
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.en: You can't take the {RAM} with a {RAM}.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.et: Sa ei saa kaasa võtta {RAM}, kellel on {RAM}.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.label: Text_RejectMonWithMail
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.en: You can't take the {RAM} that has MAIL with you.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_RejectMonWit.et: Sa ei saa kaasa võtta {RAM}, kellel on MAIL.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TimeCapsuleC.label: Text_TimeCapsuleClosed
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TimeCapsuleC.en: I'm sorry--the TIME CAPSULE is being adjusted.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRoomClo.label: Text_TradeRoomClosed
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_TradeRoomClo.en: I'm sorry--the TRADE MACHINE is being adjusted.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRoomCl.label: Text_BattleRoomClosed
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BattleRoomCl.en: I'm sorry--the BATTLE MACHINE is being adjusted.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Intro
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.en:
Hello! You're <PLAYER>, right?
I have something for you.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.et:
Tere! Sina oled <PLAYER>, eks?
Mul on sulle midagi.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Outro
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.en: We hope to serve you again.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_NoRoom
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.en:
Oh, you have no space for this.
Stop in at any #MON CENTER
across the country to pick it up.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_MysteryGiftD.et:
Oh, sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.
Astu läbi ükskõik millisest #MON KESKUSEST
üle riigi, et see kätte saada.

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_ChangeTheLoo.label: Text_ChangeTheLook
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_ChangeTheLoo.en: We need to change the look here…

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_LikeTheLook.label: Text_LikeTheLook
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_LikeTheLook.en: How does this style look to you?

maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BrokeStadium.label: Text_BrokeStadiumRules
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BrokeStadium.en:
Excuse me!
For STADIUM rules, please bring six
different #MON, excluding EGGS.
The six #MON must be different.
Also, they must not be holding identical items.
Please come back when you're ready.
maps/Pokecenter2F.asm::Text_BrokeStadium.et:
Vabandage!
STADIUMi reeglite järgi too palun kuus
erinevat #MONi, välja arvatud EGGid.
Kõik kuus #MONi peavad erinema.
Samuti ei tohi neil olla ühesuguseid esemeid.
Tule palun tagasi, kui oled valmis.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist1Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
#COM CENTER and MOBILE CENTER were
built to satisfy demands for trades
and battles with trainers far away
and with total strangers.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
#COM KESKUS ja MOBILE CENTER ehitati,
et rahuldada nõudlust vahetuste
ja lahingute järele kaugete treeneritega
ning täiesti võõrastega.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist2Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
When you linked with someone by
mobile phone for the first time,
weren't you impressed?
When my first try worked, I was so
impressed that I got the shakes!
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
Kui esimest korda kellegagi
mobiiltelefoni teel ühendusid,
kas sa polnud vaimustatud?
Kui mu esimene katse õnnestus, olin nii
vaimustatud, et sain värinad!

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist3Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
They were able to build this huge
facility thanks to advances in wireless technology.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
Nad suutsid selle tohutu rajatise
ehitada tänu juhtmevaba tehnoloogia arengule.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
It's a notice about where MOBILE
ADAPTERS are to be used…
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
See on teade selle kohta, kus MOBILE
ADAPTEReid tuleb kasutada…

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text_PokeComClub
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
There's a #COM CLUB upstairs in
any #MON CENTER.
There, you can battle or trade
with a friend far away by using a MOBILE ADAPTER.
To link up, your friend must have
the same kind of MOBILE ADAPTER as you.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
Igas #MON KESKUSES on üleval
#COM KLUBI.
Seal saad võidelda või vahetada
kaugel oleva sõbraga MOBILE ADAPTERiga.
Ühenduse jaoks peab su sõbral olema
samasugune MOBILE ADAPTER kui sul.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text_MobileCenter
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
To use the TRADE CORNER or read the
#MON NEWS, you need to phone the MOBILE CENTER.
You must register at the MOBILE
CENTER before connecting there.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
VAHETUSNURGA kasutamiseks või #MON
UUDISTE lugemiseks pead helistama MOBILE CENTERISSE.
Enne sinna ühendumist pead
MOBILE CENTERIS registreeruma.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en: It's a notice about using the phone…
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et: See on teade telefoni kasutamise kohta…

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text_UsePhone
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
Please ensure that your phone and
MOBILE ADAPTER are properly linked.
Please make sure the wireless phone signal is strong.
Don't touch or hang up the phone while linking.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
Veendu palun, et su telefon ja
MOBILE ADAPTER on korralikult ühendatud.
Veendu, et juhtmevaba telefoni signaal on tugev.
Ära puuduta ega pane telefoni ühenduse ajal hargile.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text_DontUsePhone
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
If the server is busy, it may not
be possible to log on.
If so, please call back later.
If you are unable to log on or don't
understand the error messages,
call a support center or read the instructions.
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
Kui server on hõivatud, ei pruugi
sisselogimine võimalik olla.
Sel juhul helista palun hiljem tagasi.
Kui sa ei saa sisse logida või ei
mõista veateateid,
helista tugikeskusesse või loe juhendit.

maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer3Text
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.en:
The ADMINISTRATION OFFICE received an e-mail. It says…
<……> <……> <……>
To the #COM CENTER staff…
Wireless communication has enabled
#MON trainers to interact across
the nation. Let's keep working for
the day when all the trainers in
the world can link without barriers!
<……> <……> <……>
maps/PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobile.asm:.et:
HALDUSKONTOR sai e-kirja. Selles öeldakse…
<……> <……> <……>
#COM KESKUSE personalile…
Juhtmevaba side on võimaldanud
#MON-treeneritel suhelda üle
kogu riigi. Töötagem edasi selle
päeva nimel, mil kõik maailma
treenerid saavad ühenduda ilma tõketeta!
<……> <……> <……>

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanDidYouVisitToHearAboutMyMonText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
I'm the CHAIRMAN of the #MON FAN CLUB.
I've raised over 150 #MON.
I'm very fussy when it comes to #MON.
Did you visit just to hear about my #MON?
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Olen #MON FÄNNIKLUBI ESIMEES.
Olen kasvatanud üle 150 #MONi.
Olen #MONide osas väga nõudlik.
Kas tulid lihtsalt mu #MONidest kuulama?

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanRapidashText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
Good! Then listen up!
So… my favorite RAPIDASH…
It… cute… lovely… smart… unbearably… plus… amazing… oh… you think so?… Too much… wild… beautiful… kindly… love it!
Hug it… when… sleeping… warm and cuddly… Oh, and… spectacular… ravishing… simply divine… Oops! Look at the time! I've kept you too long!
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Hea! Siis kuula!
Niisiis… mu lemmik RAPIDASH…
See… nunnu… armas… tark… talumatult… pluss… hämmastav… oh… arvad ka?… Liig… metsik… kaunis… lahkelt… armastan seda!
Kallista seda… kui… magab… soe ja nunnu… Ah, ja… vapustav… lummav… lihtsalt jumalik… Oih! Vaata aega! Pidasin sind liiga kaua!

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanIWantYouToHaveThisText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en: Thanks for hearing me out. I want you to have this!
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et: Aitäh, et kuulasid. Tahan, et sa selle saaksid!

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanItsARareCandyText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
It's a RARE CANDY that makes #MON stronger.
I prefer making my #MON stronger
by battling, so you can have it.
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
See on RARE CANDY, mis teeb #MONid tugevamaks.
Eelistan oma #MONe tugevamaks teha
võideldes, seega võid selle võtta.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanMoreTalesToTellText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>!
Did you come see me about my #MON again?
No? Oh… I had more tales to tell…
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Kas tulid mu #MONide pärast jälle?
Ei? Oh… Mul oli veel lugusid rääkida…

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanHowDisappointingText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
How disappointing…
Come back if you want to listen.
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Kui kahju…
Tule tagasi, kui tahad kuulata.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubR.label: PokemonFanClubReceptionistText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubR.en: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal when it comes to #MON…
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubR.et: Meie ESIMEES on #MONide osas väga jutukas…

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyClefairyIsSoAdorableText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
I love the way CLEFAIRY waggles
its finger when it's trying to use
METRONOME. It's so adorable!
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Mulle meeldib, kuidas CLEFAIRY viputab
sõrme, kui üritab kasutada
METRONOME. See on nii armas!

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyMakingDoWithADollIFoundText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
I love CLEFAIRY, but I could never
catch one. So I'm making do with a
# DOLL that I found.
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Armastan CLEFAIRYt, aga ei suudaks
kunagi üht püüda. Nii et lepin
# DOLLiga, mille leidsin.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyTakeThisDollBackToGirlText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
Oh, I see now. The girl who lost this
# DOLL is sad…
OK. Could you take this # DOLL
back to that poor little girl?
I'll befriend a real CLEFAIRY on
my own one day. No worries!
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Oh, nüüd saan aru. Tüdruk, kes selle
# DOLLi kaotas, on kurb…
OK. Kas viiksid selle # DOLLi
tagasi sellele vaesele tüdrukule?
Sõbrunen ühel päeval päris CLEFAIRYga
ise. Pole muret!

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyGoingToGetARealClefairyText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
You watch. I'm going to get a
real CLEFAIRY as my friend.
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
Sa vaata. Ma hangin endale
päris CLEFAIRY sõbraks.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubT.label: PokemonFanClubTeacherText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubT.en:
Look at my darling BAYLEEF!
The leaf on its head is so cute!
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubT.et:
Vaata mu armsat BAYLEEFi!
Leht ta peas on nii nunnu!

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyDollText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.en:
It's a CLEFAIRY! Huh?
Oh, right. It's a CLEFAIRY # DOLL.
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubC.et:
See on CLEFAIRY! Häh?
Ah jaa. See on CLEFAIRY # DOLL.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubL.label: PokemonFanClubListenSignText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubL.en: Let's all listen politely to other trainers.

maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubB.label: PokemonFanClubBraggingSignText
maps/PokemonFanClub.asm::PokemonFanClubB.en: If someone brags, brag right back!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1A.label: PowerPlantOfficer1AThiefBrokeInText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1A.en:
A thief broke into the POWER PLANT…
What is the world coming to?
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1A.et:
Varas murdis POWER PLANTI sisse…
Kuhu maailm küll läheb?

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1C.label: PowerPlantOfficer1CeruleanShadyCharacterText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1C.en:
I just got word from CERULEAN.
It appears that a shady character
has been loitering around.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1C.et:
Sain just CERULEANIST teate.
Tundub, et üks kahtlane tüüp
on seal ringi hulkunud.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1C.label: PowerPlantOfficer1CouldIAskForYourCooperationText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1C.en: Could I ask for your cooperation?

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1H.label: PowerPlantOfficer1HaveToBeefUpSecurityText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer1H.en: We'll have to beef up our security presence.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.label: PowerPlantGymGuide1SomeoneStoleAPartText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.en:
Someone made off with a part that's
essential for the generator.
Without it, the new generator's useless!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.et:
Keegi näppas osa, mis on
generaatori jaoks hädavajalik.
Selleta on uus generaator kasutu!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.label: PowerPlantGymGuide1GeneratorUpAndRunningText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.en:
The generator's up and running. It's
making electricity to spare.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide1.et:
Generaator töötab. See
toodab elektrit ülegi.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide2.label: PowerPlantGymGuide2PowerPlantUpAndRunningText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide2.en:
This POWER PLANT had been abandoned in the past.
We got it back up and running to
provide power to the MAGNET TRAIN.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide2.et:
See POWER PLANT oli minevikus maha jäetud.
Saime selle taas käima, et
varustada MAGNETRONGI vooluga.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.label: PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenSadAndFuriousText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.en:
The POWER PLANT's MANAGER is up ahead.
But since someone wrecked the generator, he's been both sad and furious…
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.et:
POWER PLANTI JUHATAJA on eespool.
Aga kuna keegi lõhkus generaatori, on ta olnud nii kurb kui raevukas…

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.label: PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenCheerfulText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.en:
Since the generator's been fixed,
the MANAGER has been cheerful.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantOfficer2M.et:
Kuna generaator on parandatud,
on JUHATAJA olnud rõõmus.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.label: PowerPlantGymGuide4MagnetTrainConsumesElectricityText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.en:
The MAGNET TRAIN consumes a lot of electricity.
It can't move if the new generator isn't operating.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.et:
MAGNETRONG tarbib palju elektrit.
See ei saa liikuda, kui uus generaator ei tööta.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.label: PowerPlantGymGuide4WeCanGetMagnetTrainRunningText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.en:
All right! We can finally get the
MAGNET TRAIN running again.
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantGymGuide4.et:
Hästi! Saame lõpuks
MAGNETRONGI taas käima.

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerWh.label: PowerPlantManagerWhoWouldRuinMyGeneratorText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerWh.en:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm ready to blast someone!
Who would dare ruin my generator?
I spent so much time on it!
If I catch him, he's going to get
a taste of my ZAP CANNON!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerWh.et:
JUHATAJA: Ma, ma, ma olen valmis kellelegi keretäie andma!
Kes julges mu generaatori rikkuda?
Kulutasin sellele nii palju aega!
Kui ta kätte saan, saab ta
maitsta mu ZAP CANNONit!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerIW.label: PowerPlantManagerIWontForgiveCulpritText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerIW.en:
MANAGER: I won't forgive him!
The culprit can cry and apologize,
but I'll still hammer him!
Gahahahah!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerIW.et:
JUHATAJA: Ma ei andesta talle!
Süüdlane võib nutta ja vabandada,
aga ma ikka virutan talle!
Gahahahah!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTh.label: PowerPlantManagerThatsThePartText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTh.en:
MANAGER: Ah! Yeah!
That's the missing PART from my beloved generator! You found it?
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTh.et:
JUHATAJA: Ah! Jah!
See on mu armastatud generaatori puuduv OSA! Sa leidsid selle?

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTa.label: PowerPlantManagerTakeThisTMText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTa.en:
Wahah! Thanks!
Here! Take this TM as a reward!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTa.et:
Vahah! Aitäh!
Siin! Võta see TM tasuks!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTM.label: PowerPlantManagerTM07IsZapCannonText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTM.en:
MANAGER: TM07 is my ZAP CANNON.
It's a powerful technique!
It's not what anyone would consider
accurate, but it packs a wallop!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerTM.et:
JUHATAJA: TM07 on mu ZAP CANNON.
See on võimas tehnika!
See pole miski, mida keegi täpseks
peaks, aga see paneb korralikult!

maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerMy.label: PowerPlantManagerMyBelovedGeneratorText
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerMy.en:
MANAGER: My beloved generator!
Keep pumping the electricity out!
maps/PowerPlant.asm::PowerPlantManagerMy.et:
JUHATAJA: Mu armastatud generaator!
Pumpa elektrit edasi!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRecep.label: RadioTower1FReceptionistNoToursText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRecep.en: Hello. I'm sorry, but we're not offering any tours today.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRecep.et: Tere. Vabandust, aga täna me tuure ei paku.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManAskToPlayText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
Hi, are you here for the LUCKY NUMBER SHOW?
Want me to check the ID numbers of your #MON?
If you get lucky, you win a prize.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
Tere, kas tulid ÕNNENUMBRI SAATESSE?
Kas kontrollin su #MONide ID-numbrid üle?
Kui veab, võidad auhinna.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManCheckIfMatchText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en: Let's see if you have a match.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManComeAgainText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en: Please come back next week for the next LUCKY NUMBER.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et: Palun tule järgmisel nädalal järgmise ÕNNENUMBRI järele.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManPerfectMatchText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
Wow! You have a perfect match of all five numbers!
We have a grand prize winner!
You have won a MASTER BALL!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
Vau! Sul klapib kõik viis numbrit!
Meil on peaauhinna võitja!
Võitsid MASTER BALLi!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManOkayMatchText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
Hey! You've matched the last three numbers!
You've won second prize, an EXP. SHARE!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
Hei! Sul klappisid viimased kolm numbrit!
Võitsid teise auhinna, EXP. SHARE!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManWeakMatchText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
Ooh, you've matched the last two numbers.
You've won third prize, a PP UP.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
Ohoo, sul klappisid viimased kaks numbrit.
Võitsid kolmanda auhinna, PP UP.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoneOfYourIDNumbersMatchText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en: Nope, none of your ID numbers match.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et: Ei, ükski su ID-number ei klapi.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoRoomForYourPrizeText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
You've got no room for your prize.
Make room and come back right away.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
Sul pole auhinna jaoks ruumi.
Tee ruumi ja tule kohe tagasi.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanOfferQuizText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
We have a special quiz campaign on right now.
Answer five questions correctly to win a RADIO CARD.
Slide it into your #GEAR to play
the radio anytime, anywhere.
Would you like to take the quiz?
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Meil käib praegu eriline viktoriinikampaania.
Vasta viiele küsimusele õigesti ja võida RADIO CARD.
Lükka see #GEARi ja kuula raadiot igal ajal, igal pool.
Kas soovid viktoriini teha?

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion1Text
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Question 1:
Is there a #MON that appears only in the morning?
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
1. küsimus:
Kas on olemas #MON, kes ilmub ainult hommikul?

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion2Text
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Correct! Question 2:
Is this statement correct?
You can't buy a BERRY at a MART.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Õige! 2. küsimus:
Kas see väide on õige?
MARTist ei saa MARJA osta.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion3Text
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Bull's-eye! Question 3:
Does HM01 contain the move FLASH?
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Kümnesse! 3. küsimus:
Kas HM01 sisaldab rünnakut FLASH?

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion4Text
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
So far so good! Question 4:
Is FALKNER the VIOLET GYM LEADER
who uses bird #MON?
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Seni hästi! 4. küsimus:
Kas FALKNER on VIOLETI SAALI JUHT, kes kasutab linnu-#MONe?

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion5Text
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Wow! Right again! Here's the final question:
Do GOLDENROD GAME CORNER's slots
have CHARMANDER on their reels?
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Vau! Jälle õige! Viimane küsimus:
Kas GOLDENRODI MÄNGUNURGA mänguautomaatidel on rullidel CHARMANDER?

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanYouWinText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Bingo! You got it! Congratulations!
Here's your prize, a RADIO CARD!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et:
Bingo! Said pihta! Palju õnne!
Siin on su auhind, RADIO CARD!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FPokeg.label: RadioTower1FPokegearIsARadioText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FPokeg.en: <PLAYER>'s #GEAR can now double as a radio!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanTuneInText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en: Please tune in to our radio shows.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanWrongAnswerText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en:
Oh, dear. Sorry, but you
got it wrong. Please try again!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et: Oh sa. Vabandust, aga eksisid. Palun proovi uuesti!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanNotTakingQuizText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.en: Oh. I see. Please see me if you change your mind.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FRadio.et: Oh. Selge. Tule minu juurde, kui ümber mõtled.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLassT.label: RadioTower1FLassText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLassT.en:
BEN is a fabulous DJ.
His sweet voice makes me melt!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLassT.et:
BEN on suurepärane DJ.
Tema mahe hääl paneb mind sulama!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FYoung.label: RadioTower1FYoungsterText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FYoung.en:
I love MARY, from #MON TALK.
I only know what she sounds like, though.
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FYoung.et:
Ma armastan MARYT saatest #MON TALK.
Kuigi tunnen teda vaid häälest.

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3SeenText.label: GruntM3SeenText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3SeenText.en:
We've finally taken over the RADIO TOWER!
Now everyone will get to experience
the true terror of TEAM ROCKET!
We'll show you how scary we are!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3SeenText.et:
Lõpuks võtsime RAADIOTORNI üle!
Nüüd saavad kõik kogeda RAKETI KAMBA tõelist õudust!
Näitame sulle, kui hirmsad me oleme!

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3BeatenText.label: GruntM3BeatenText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3BeatenText.en: Too strong! We must watch you…

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3AfterBattl.label: GruntM3AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3AfterBattl.en:
You're too strong.
Our plan could be ruined. I must warn the others…
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::GruntM3AfterBattl.et:
Sa oled liiga tugev.
Meie plaan võib untsu minna. Pean teisi hoiatama…

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FDirec.label: RadioTower1FDirectoryText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FDirec.en:
1F RECEPTION 2F SALES
3F PERSONNEL 4F PRODUCTION
5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FDirec.et:
1K VASTUVÕTT 2K MÜÜK
3K PERSONAL 4K TOOTMINE
5K DIREKTORI KABINET

maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.label: RadioTower1FLuckyChannelSignText
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.en:
LUCKY CHANNEL!
Win with #MON ID numbers!
Trade your #MON to collect different ID numbers!
maps/RadioTower1F.asm::RadioTower1FLucky.et:
LUCKY CHANNEL!
Võida #MONi ID-numbritega!
Vaheta #MONe, et koguda erinevaid ID-numbreid!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FSuper.label: RadioTower2FSuperNerdText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FSuper.en: You can listen to the radio anywhere. Tune in!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FSuper.et: Raadiot saab kuulata igal pool. Häälestu!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FTeach.label: RadioTower2FTeacherText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FTeach.en: Lullabies on the radio may make #MON sleep.

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FTeach.label: RadioTower2FTeacherText_Rockets
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FTeach.en: Why would they want to take over the RADIO TOWER?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FTeach.et: Miks nad küll RAADIOTORNI üle võtta tahaksid?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.label: RadioTower2FBlackBelt1Text
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.en:
Sorry. Authorized personnel only beyond this point.
It wasn't that way before.
There's something wrong with the DIRECTOR…
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.et:
Vabandust. Edasi ainult volitatud personalile.
Enne polnud nii.
DIREKTORIGA on midagi valesti…

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.label: RadioTower2FBlackBelt2Text
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.en:
Feel free to look around anywhere.
The DIRECTOR is nice again, just as he was before.
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBlack.et:
Uuri julgelt ringi.
DIREKTOR on jälle kena, nagu varem.

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4SeenText.label: GruntM4SeenText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4SeenText.en:
Three years ago, TEAM ROCKET was forced to disband.
But we're making a comeback here!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4SeenText.et:
Kolm aastat tagasi sunniti RAKETI KAMP laiali.
Aga siin teeme tagasituleku!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4AfterBattl.label: GruntM4AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4AfterBattl.en: We won't let you ruin our plans for our comeback!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM4AfterBattl.et: Me ei lase sul oma tagasituleku plaane rikkuda!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5SeenText.label: GruntM5SeenText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5SeenText.en:
We're TEAM ROCKET, the exploiters of #MON!
We love being evil! Scared?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5SeenText.et:
Oleme RAKETI KAMP, #MONide ärakasutajad!
Meile meeldib olla kuri! Hirmul?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5AfterBattl.label: GruntM5AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5AfterBattl.en: We're not always evil. We just do whatever we like.
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM5AfterBattl.et: Me pole alati kurjad. Teeme lihtsalt, mis tahame.

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6SeenText.label: GruntM6SeenText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6SeenText.en: Hey, hey! Keep out of our way!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6SeenText.et: Hei, hei! Hoia meie teelt eemale!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6AfterBattl.label: GruntM6AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6AfterBattl.en:
Our EXECUTIVES are trying to take this place over.
They have some big plan. I wonder what that is?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntM6AfterBattl.et:
Meie EXECUTIVEd üritavad seda paika üle võtta.
Neil on suur plaan. Huvitav, mis see on?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2SeenText.label: GruntF2SeenText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2SeenText.en:
Hahaha!
How boring. It was far too
easy to take over this place!
Come on, keep me amused!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2SeenText.et:
Hahaa!
Küll on igav. Selle paiga ülevõtmine oli liiga lihtne!
Tule, lõbusta mind!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2AfterBattl.label: GruntF2AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2AfterBattl.en: You beat me, and I won't forget it!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::GruntF2AfterBattl.et: Sa võitsid mind ja ma ei unusta seda!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaShowIntroductionText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Hi! I'm BUENA!
Do you know about a radio program called PASSWORD?
If you can tell me the password from
the program, you will earn points.
Save up those points and trade
them to that sweet young lady over
there for some choice prizes!
Here you go!
It's your very own point card!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Tere! Olen BUENA!
Kas tead raadiosaadet nimega PASSWORD?
Kui ütled mulle saatest kuuldud parooli, teenid punkte.
Kogu punkte ja vaheta need seal magusa noore daami käest tore auhinna vastu!
Säh!
See on sinu enda punktikaart!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInToMyShowText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en: BUENA: Tune in to my PASSWORD SHOW!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: Häälestu mu PASSWORD SHOW'le!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaDoYouKnowPasswordText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Hi! Did you tune in to my radio show?
Do you remember today's password?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Tere! Kas kuulasid mu raadiosaadet?
Kas mäletad tänast parooli?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaJoinTheShowText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Oh, wow! Thank you!
What was your name again?
…<PLAY_G>, OK!
Come on, <PLAY_G>. Join the show.
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Oh, vau! Aitäh!
Mis su nimi oligi?
…<PLAY_G>, OK!
Tule, <PLAY_G>. Ühine saatega.

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaEveryoneSayPasswordText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Everyone ready?
I want to hear you shout out today's
password for <PLAY_G>!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Kõik valmis?
Tahan kuulda, kuidas hõikate <PLAY_G> jaoks tänase parooli!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaComeBackAfterListeningText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Come back after you listen
to my show, OK? Catch ya later!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: Tule tagasi, kui oled mu saadet kuulanud, eks? Näeme!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaAlreadyPlayedText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Sorry…
You get just one chance each day.
Come back tomorrow for another try!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Vabandust…
Saad iga päev vaid ühe võimaluse.
Tule homme uuesti proovima!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCorrectAnswerText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: YIPPEE! That's right!
You did tune in! I'm so happy!
You earned one point! Congrats!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: JIPPII! See on õige!
Sa kuulasid! Olen nii õnnelik!
Teenisid ühe punkti! Palju õnne!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaDidYouForgetText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Aww… That's not it…
Did you forget the password?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Ohh… See pole see…
Kas unustasid parooli?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaThanksForComingText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Yup! Our contestant was
<PLAY_G>. Thanks for coming!
I hope all you listeners will
come too! I'll be waiting!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Jah! Meie osaleja oli <PLAY_G>. Aitäh, et tulid!
Loodan, et ka kõik kuulajad tulevad! Ma ootan!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaPasswordIsHelpText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Huh? Today's password?
HELP, of course!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Häh? Tänane parool?
HELP, muidugi!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCardIsFullText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Your BLUE CARD's full.
Trade it in for a fabulous prize!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Su BLUE CARD on täis.
Vaheta see vapustava auhinna vastu!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInAfterSixText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Tune in to PASSWORD every
night from six to midnight!
Tune in, then drop in for a visit!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Häälestu PASSWORDile igal õhtul kuuest keskööni!
Häälestu ja astu siis läbi!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaNoBlueCardText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Oh? You forgot to bring your BLUE CARD?
I can't give you points if you don't have it.
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Oh? Unustasid oma BLUE CARD kaasa võtta?
Ilma selleta ma punkte anda ei saa.

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaOfferPhoneNumberText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: Oh! Your BLUE CARD reached
{d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points today! That's so wild!
Hmm… There isn't a prize for hitting {d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points, but…
You came by so often, <PLAY_G>.
I'll make you a special deal!
How would you like my phone number?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
BUENA: Oh! Su BLUE CARD jõudis täna {d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} punktini! See on nii pöörane!
Hmm… {d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} punkti eest auhinda pole, aga…
Sa käisid nii tihti, <PLAY_G>.
Teen sulle erilise pakkumise!
Kuidas oleks mu telefoninumbriga?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaOfferNumberAgainText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: <PLAY_G>, do you want to
register my phone number?
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: <PLAY_G>, kas soovid mu telefoninumbrit salvestada?

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCallMeText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en: BUENA: I look forward to hearing from you!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: Ootan sinult kõnet!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaSadRejectedText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en: BUENA: Aww… It's a special prize…
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: Ohh… See on ju eriline auhind…

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaYourPhoneIsFullText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
BUENA: <PLAY_G>, your phone list
has no room left for me…
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: BUENA: <PLAY_G>, su telefoninimekirjas pole minu jaoks ruumi…

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistPointsForPrizesText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
You can cash in your saved points
for a lovely prize of your choice!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et: Kogutud punkte saad vahetada oma valitud toreda auhinna vastu!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.label: RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistNoCardText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.en:
You can't trade in points without your BLUE CARD.
Don't forget your BLUE CARD!
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FBuena.et:
Ilma BLUE CARDita ei saa punkte vahetada.
Ära unusta oma BLUE CARD!

maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FOaksP.label: RadioTower2FOaksPKMNTalkSignText
maps/RadioTower2F.asm::RadioTower2FOaksP.en:
PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK
The Hottest Show on the Air!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FSuper.label: RadioTower3FSuperNerdText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FSuper.en:
We have recordings of the cries of
all #MON that have been found.
We must have about 200 kinds.
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FSuper.et:
Meil on salvestised kõigi leitud #MONide häältest.
Meil on vist umbes 200 liiki.

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.label: RadioTower3FGymGuideText_Rockets
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.en:
To trainers, #MON are their beloved partners.
It's terrible how TEAM ROCKET is
trying to control #MON.
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.et:
Treeneritele on #MONid armsad partnerid.
On kohutav, kuidas RAKETI KAMP #MONe kontrollida üritab.

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.label: RadioTower3FGymGuideText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.en:
We run 24 hours a day to broadcast
entertaining programs.
I'll do my best to run around the clock too!
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FGymGu.et:
Töötame ööpäev läbi, et meelelahutuslikke saateid edastada.
Annan endast parima, et ka ööpäev läbi ringi joosta!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFPleaseSaveDirectorText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.en:
The TEAM ROCKET boss has locked himself in.
But the DIRECTOR can open it.
He's up on the fifth floor.
Please save him!
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.et:
RAKETI KAMBA boss on end sisse lukustanud.
Aga DIREKTOR saab selle avada.
Ta on viiendal korrusel.
Palun päästa ta!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFYoureMyHeroText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.en:
Thank you! You're my hero!
This is a token of my appreciation.
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.et:
Aitäh! Sa oled mu kangelane!
See on minu tänu märk.

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFItsSunnyDayText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.en: It's SUNNY DAY. It powers up firetype moves for a while.
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::RadioTower3FCoolt.et: See on SUNNY DAY. See võimendab mõneks ajaks tule-tüüpi rünnakuid.

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7SeenText.label: GruntM7SeenText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7SeenText.en:
I've been given strict orders.
I'm to crush anyone who challenges TEAM ROCKET!
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7SeenText.et:
Mulle on antud rangeid käske.
Pean purustama igaühe, kes RAKETI KAMBALE vastu astub!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7AfterBattl.label: GruntM7AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7AfterBattl.en:
I failed in my duties…
I'll be docked pay for this…
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM7AfterBattl.et:
Ma ei täitnud oma kohust…
Selle eest kärbitakse mu palka…

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM8SeenText.label: GruntM8SeenText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM8SeenText.en: It feels great ordering #MON to commit crimes.

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM8AfterBattl.label: GruntM8AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM8AfterBattl.en:
I feel lousy over losing!
Darn it! I hate useless #MON!
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM8AfterBattl.et:
Tunnen end kaotuse pärast vilets!
Pagan võtaks! Ma vihkan kasutuid #MONe!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9SeenText.label: GruntM9SeenText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9SeenText.en:
Why did the shutter open? Did you
have something to do with this?
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9SeenText.et: Miks ruloo avanes? Kas sul oli sellega midagi pistmist?

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9AfterBattl.label: GruntM9AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9AfterBattl.en:
What?! You made it past our men in the UNDERGROUND?
How could you?
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::GruntM9AfterBattl.et:
Mis?! Pääsesid meie meestest MAA-ALUSES mööda?
Kuidas sa võisid?

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcSeen.label: ScientistMarcSeenText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcSeen.en:
An unknown child wandering here?
Who are you?
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcSeen.et:
Tundmatu laps siin hulkumas?
Kes sa oled?

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcBeat.label: ScientistMarcBeatenText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcBeat.en: Tch! I took you too lightly!

maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcAfte.label: ScientistMarcAfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcAfte.en:
Bwahahaha…
I can transmit as strong a signal as I need from here.
maps/RadioTower3F.asm::ScientistMarcAfte.et:
Bwahahaa…
Saan siit edastada nii tugevat signaali kui vaja.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FFishe.label: RadioTower4FFisherText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FFishe.en:
I listened to the radio while I was at the RUINS.
I heard a strange broadcast there.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FFishe.et:
Kuulasin VAREMETES raadiot.
Kuulsin seal imelikku saadet.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.en:
MARY: Why? Why do I have to suffer through this?
MEOWTH, help me!
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.et:
MARY: Miks? Miks pean ma seda taluma?
MEOWTH, aita mind!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_ClearedRockets
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.en:
MARY: Oh! You're my little savior!
Will you take this as my thanks?
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.et:
MARY: Oh! Sa oled mu väike päästja!
Kas võtad selle tänuks vastu?

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_GivePinkBow
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.en:
MARY: It's just right for #MON
that know normaltype moves.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.et: MARY: See sobib just tava-tüüpi rünnakuid oskavatele #MONidele.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_After
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.en:
MARY: Please tune into me on PROF.
OAK'S #MON TALK show.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::RadioTower4FDJMar.et: MARY: Palun häälestu minule PROF. OAKI #MON TALK saates.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntM10SeenText.label: GruntM10SeenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntM10SeenText.en:
You plan to rescue the DIRECTOR?
That won't be possible because I'm going to beat you!
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntM10SeenText.et:
Kavatsed DIREKTORIT päästa?
See pole võimalik, sest ma võidan su ära!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntM10AfterBatt.label: GruntM10AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntM10AfterBatt.en: I don't believe it! I was beaten!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2SeenTe.label: Executivem2SeenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2SeenTe.en:
Stop! I'm known as the TEAM ROCKET fortress!
You're not taking another step!
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2SeenTe.et:
Seis! Mind tuntakse kui RAKETI KAMBA kindlust!
Sa ei astu enam sammugi!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2AfterB.label: Executivem2AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2AfterB.en:
You've earned my respect, so here's some advice.
It's not too late. You can still turn back.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::Executivem2AfterB.et:
Oled mu lugupidamise võitnud, seega üks nõuanne.
Pole veel hilja. Võid veel pöörduda.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4SeenText.label: GruntF4SeenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4SeenText.en:
Don't I think #MON are cute?
I'll think my #MON are cute--
after they beat yours!
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4SeenText.et:
Kas ma ei pea #MONe nunnuks?
Pean oma #MONe nunnuks — pärast seda, kui nad sinu omad võidavad!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4BeatenText.label: GruntF4BeatenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4BeatenText.et: Oh ei! Nad on nii kasutud!

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4AfterBattl.label: GruntF4AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4AfterBattl.en:
I love my beautiful self!
Who cares about #MON?
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::GruntF4AfterBattl.et:
Ma armastan oma ilusat mina!
Keda huvitavad #MONid?

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichSeen.label: ScientistRichSeenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichSeen.en:
Most excellent.
This RADIO TOWER will fulfill our grand design.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichSeen.et:
Suurepärane.
See RAADIOTORN täidab meie suurejoonelise plaani.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichBeat.label: ScientistRichBeatenText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichBeat.en:
Hmmm…
All grand plans come with snags.
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichBeat.et:
Hmmm…
Kõigil suurtel plaanidel on takistusi.

maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichAfte.label: ScientistRichAfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichAfte.en: Do you honestly believe you can stop TEAM ROCKET?
maps/RadioTower4F.asm::ScientistRichAfte.et: Kas sa tõesti usud, et suudad RAKETI KAMBA peatada?

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextB.label: FakeDirectorTextBefore1
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextB.en: Y-you! You came to rescue me?

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextB.label: FakeDirectorTextBefore2
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextB.en:
Is that what you were expecting?
Wrong! I'm an imposter!
I pretended to be the real thing to
prepare for our takeover.
Do you want to know where we hid the real DIRECTOR?
Sure, I'll tell you. But only if you can beat me!
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextB.et:
Kas seda sa ootasid?
Vale! Ma olen petis!
Teesklesin päris DIREKTORIT, et ülevõtmiseks valmistuda.
Tahad teada, kuhu me päris DIREKTORI peitsime?
Muidugi, ma ütlen. Aga ainult siis, kui suudad mind võita!

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorWinTe.label: FakeDirectorWinText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorWinTe.en: OK, OK. I'll tell you where he is.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorWinTe.et: Olgu, olgu. Ma ütlen, kus ta on.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextA.label: FakeDirectorTextAfter
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextA.en:
We stashed the real DIRECTOR in
the UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE.
It's at the far end of the UNDERGROUND.
But I doubt you'll get that far.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::FakeDirectorTextA.et:
Peitsime päris DIREKTORI MAA-ALUSESSE LATTU.
See on MAA-ALUSE kauges otsas.
Aga kahtlen, kas sa nii kaugele jõuad.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1SeenTe.label: Executivef1SeenText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1SeenTe.en:
Remember me from the HIDEOUT in MAHOGANY TOWN?
I lost then, but I won't this time.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1SeenTe.et:
Kas mäletad mind MAHOGANY TOWNI PEIDIKUST?
Kaotasin siis, aga seekord mitte.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1Beaten.label: Executivef1BeatenText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1Beaten.en:
This can't be happening!
I fought hard, but I still lost…
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1Beaten.et:
See ei saa juhtuda!
Võitlesin kõvasti, aga kaotasin ikkagi…

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1AfterB.label: Executivef1AfterBattleText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1AfterB.en:
<PLAYER>, isn't it?
A brat like you won't appreciate
the magnificence of TEAM ROCKET.
That's too bad. I really admire your power.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::Executivef1AfterB.et:
<PLAYER>, eks?
Sinusugune jõmpsikas ei mõista RAKETI KAMBA suurust.
Kahju küll. Imetlen tõesti su väge.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.label: RadioTower5FRocketBossBeforeText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.en:
Oh? You managed to get this far?
You must be quite the trainer.
We intend to take over this RADIO
STATION and announce our comeback.
That should bring our boss GIOVANNI
back from his solo training.
We are going to regain our former glory.
I won't allow you to interfere with our plans.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.et:
Oh? Sul õnnestus nii kaugele jõuda?
Sa pead olema päris hea treener.
Kavatseme selle RAADIOJAAMA üle võtta ja oma tagasituleku välja kuulutada.
See peaks meie bossi GIOVANNI tema üksiktreeningult tagasi tooma.
Taastame oma endise hiilguse.
Ma ei luba sul meie plaane segada.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.label: RadioTower5FRocketBossAfterText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.en:
How could this be?
Our dreams have come to naught.
I wasn't up to the task after all.
Like GIOVANNI did before me, I will
disband TEAM ROCKET here today.
Farewell.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FRocke.et:
Kuidas see võimalik on?
Meie unistused on tühja jooksnud.
Ma ei olnud ülesande vääriline.
Nagu GIOVANNI enne mind, saadan RAKETI KAMBA täna siin laiali.
Hüvasti.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.label: RadioTower5FDirectorThankYouText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.en:
DIRECTOR: <PLAY_G>, thank you!
Your courageous actions have saved
#MON nationwide.
I know it's not much, but please take this.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.et:
DIREKTOR: <PLAY_G>, aitäh!
Sinu vaprad teod on päästnud #MONe üle riigi.
Tean, et sellest pole palju, aga palun võta see.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.label: RadioTower5FDirectorDescribeClearBellText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.en:
There used to be a tower right here in GOLDENROD CITY.
But it was old and creaky.
So we replaced it with our RADIO TOWER.
We dug up that bell during construction.
I heard that all sorts of #MON
lived in GOLDENROD in the past.
Perhaps…
That bell has some connection to the
TIN TOWER in ECRUTEAK CITY…
Ah!
That reminds me…
I overheard TEAM ROCKET whispering.
Apparently, something is going on at the TIN TOWER.
I have no idea what is happening,
but you might look into it.
OK, I better go to my OFFICE.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.et:
Just siin GOLDENROD CITYS oli kunagi torn.
Aga see oli vana ja krigisev.
Nii asendasime selle oma RAADIOTORNIGA.
Ehituse ajal kaevasime välja selle kella.
Kuulsin, et vanasti elas GOLDENRODIS igasuguseid #MONe.
Ehk…
Sellel kellal on mingi seos ECRUTEAK CITY TIN TOWERIGA…
Ah!
See tuletab meelde…
Kuulsin pealt RAKETI KAMBA sosinat.
Näib, et TIN TOWERIS toimub midagi.
Ma ei tea, mis toimub, aga sa võiksid seda uurida.
Hea küll, parem lähen oma KABINETTI.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.label: RadioTower5FDirectorText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.en:
DIRECTOR: Hello, <PLAY_G>!
You know, I love #MON.
I built this RADIO TOWER so I could
