express my love of #MON.
It would be nice if people enjoyed our programs.
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::RadioTower5FDirec.et:
DIREKTOR: Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Tead, ma armastan #MONe.
Ehitasin selle RAADIOTORNI, et väljendada oma armastust #MONide vastu.
Oleks tore, kui inimestele meeldiksid meie saated.

maps/RadioTower5F.asm::BenText.label: BenText
maps/RadioTower5F.asm::BenText.en: BEN: Do you listen to our music?

maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText1.label: RedsMomText1
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText1.en:
Hi!
RED's been away for a long time.
He hasn't called either, so I have
no idea where he is or what he's been doing.
They say that no word is proof that
he's doing fine, but I do worry about him.
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText1.et:
Tere!
RED on kaua ära olnud.
Ta pole ka helistanud, seega mul pole
aimugi, kus ta on või mida ta teeb.
Öeldakse, et sõnumita on tõestus,
et tal läheb hästi, aga ma muretsen ta pärast.

maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText2.label: RedsMomText2
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText2.en:
I worry about RED getting hurt or
sick, but he's a boy. I'm proud
that he is doing what he wants to
do.
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsMomText2.et:
Muretsen, et RED saab viga või
jääb haigeks, aga ta on poiss. Olen uhke,
et ta teeb seda, mida
tahab.

maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsHouse1FTVText.label: RedsHouse1FTVText
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsHouse1FTVText.en: They have programs that aren't shown in JOHTO…
maps/RedsHouse1F.asm::RedsHouse1FTVText.et: Neil on saateid, mida JOHTOS ei näidata…

maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FN64Text.label: RedsHouse2FN64Text
maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FN64Text.en:
<PLAYER> played the N64.
Better get going-no time to lose!
maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FN64Text.et:
<PLAYER> mängis N64.
Parem lähen -- pole aega raisata!

maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FPCText.label: RedsHouse2FPCText
maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FPCText.en: It looks like it hasn't been used in a long time…
maps/RedsHouse2F.asm::RedsHouse2FPCText.et: Tundub, et seda pole ammu kasutatud…

maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannySeenText.label: SchoolboyDannySeenText
maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannySeenText.en: If trainers meet, the first thing to do is battle.
maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannySeenText.et: Kui treenerid kohtuvad, on esimene asi võidelda.

maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannyBeatenTex.label: SchoolboyDannyBeatenText
maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannyBeatenTex.en: Awww… I've got a losing record…

maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannyAfterBatt.label: SchoolboyDannyAfterBattleText
maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannyAfterBatt.en:
For trainers, it's a given that we'll
battle whenever we meet.
maps/Route1.asm::SchoolboyDannyAfterBatt.et:
Treenerite jaoks on iseenesestmõistetav,
et võitleme, kui kohtume.

maps/Route1.asm::CooltrainerfQuinnAfterB.label: CooltrainerfQuinnAfterBattleText
maps/Route1.asm::CooltrainerfQuinnAfterB.en:
You're strong.
You obviously must have trained hard.
maps/Route1.asm::CooltrainerfQuinnAfterB.et:
Sa oled tugev.
Oled ilmselgelt kõvasti treeninud.

maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.en:
A #MON CENTER near a cave?
That's mighty convenient.
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.et:
#MON KESKUS koopa lähedal?
See on ülimugav.

maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.en:
The POWER PLANT's MANAGER is looking
for a strong #MON trainer.
He needs help getting back
something that was stolen.
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.et:
POWER PLANTI JUHATAJA otsib
tugevat #MON-treenerit.
Ta vajab abi millegi
varastatu tagasisaamiseks.

maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.en:
I hear TEAM ROCKET got back together
in JOHTO but fell apart right away.
I didn't know anything about that.
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.et:
Kuulen, et RAKETI KAMP kogunes taas
JOHTOS, aga lagunes kohe.
Ma ei teadnud sellest midagi.

maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.label: Route10Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.en:
When you go outside, you can see
the roof of a big building.
That's the POWER PLANT.
maps/Route10Pokecenter1F.asm::Route10Pok.et:
Kui lähed välja, näed
suure hoone katust.
See on POWER PLANT.

maps/Route10South.asm::HikerJimAfterBatt.label: HikerJimAfterBattleText
maps/Route10South.asm::HikerJimAfterBatt.en: Hay fever is making me sneeze! Ahahah-CHOO!

maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertSee.label: PokefanmRobertSeenText
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertSee.en:
You like #MON, don't you?
Me too!
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertSee.et:
Sulle meeldivad #MONid, kas pole?
Ka mulle!

maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertBea.label: PokefanmRobertBeatenText
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertBea.en: I'd have to say that's my loss.
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertBea.et: Pean ütlema, et see on minu kaotus.

maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertAft.label: PokefanmRobertAfterBattleText
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertAft.en:
Look what you did to my #MON…
I won't forget this…
maps/Route10South.asm::PokefanmRobertAft.et:
Vaata, mida sa mu #MONile tegid…
Ma ei unusta seda…

maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenSeenText.label: YoungsterOwenSeenText
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenSeenText.en:
There's no cheating in #MON.
Let's keep it fair and square!
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenSeenText.et:
#MONides ei ole sohki tegemist.
Hoiame ausalt ja õiglaselt!

maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenAfterBatt.label: YoungsterOwenAfterBattleText
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenAfterBatt.en:
I fought fair and square with honor.
I don't regret this at all.
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterOwenAfterBatt.et:
Võitlesin ausalt ja õiglaselt, auga.
Ma ei kahetse seda üldse.

maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterJasonSeenText.label: YoungsterJasonSeenText
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterJasonSeenText.en:
It itches and tickles a bit when
I wear shorts in the grass.
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterJasonSeenText.et:
Sügeleb ja kõditab pisut, kui
kannan rohus lühikesi pükse.

maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterJasonAfterBat.label: YoungsterJasonAfterBattleText
maps/Route11.asm::YoungsterJasonAfterBat.en: I'm going to catch more #MON in the grass.

maps/Route11.asm::PsychicHermanAfterBatt.label: PsychicHermanAfterBattleText
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicHermanAfterBatt.en:
…
I lost while I had my eyes closed…

maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelSeenText.label: PsychicFidelSeenText
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelSeenText.en:
I can see it…
Everything to see about you…
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelSeenText.et:
Ma näen seda…
Kõike, mis sinu kohta on näha…

maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelBeatenText.label: PsychicFidelBeatenText
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelBeatenText.et: Ma ei suutnud su jõudu ette näha…

maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelAfterBattl.label: PsychicFidelAfterBattleText
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelAfterBattl.en:
Strength in conviction…
You're strong because you believe in your #MON.
maps/Route11.asm::PsychicFidelAfterBattl.et:
Jõud veendumuses…
Oled tugev, sest usud oma #MONe.

maps/Route12.asm::FisherMartinSeenText.label: FisherMartinSeenText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherMartinSeenText.en: Patience is the key to both fishing and #MON.
maps/Route12.asm::FisherMartinSeenText.et: Kannatlikkus on nii kalapüügi kui #MONide võti.

maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenSeenText.label: FisherStephenSeenText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenSeenText.en: I feel so content, fishing while listening to some tunes on my radio.
maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenSeenText.et: Tunnen end nii rahulolevalt, püüdes kala ja kuulates raadiost muusikat.

maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenAfterBatt.label: FisherStephenAfterBattleText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenAfterBatt.en:
Have you checked out KANTO's radio
programs? We get a good variety here.
maps/Route12.asm::FisherStephenAfterBatt.et:
Kas oled KANTO raadiosaateid
kuulanud? Siin on hea valik.

maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneySeenText.label: FisherBarneySeenText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneySeenText.en: What's most important in our everyday lives?
maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneySeenText.et: Mis on meie igapäevaelus kõige tähtsam?

maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneyBeatenText.label: FisherBarneyBeatenText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneyBeatenText.en: The answer is coming up next!

maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneyAfterBattl.label: FisherBarneyAfterBattleText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneyAfterBattl.en:
I think electricity is the most
important thing in our daily lives.
If it weren't, people wouldn't
have made such a fuss when the
POWER PLANT went out of commission.
maps/Route12.asm::FisherBarneyAfterBattl.et:
Arvan, et elekter on meie igapäevaelus
kõige tähtsam.
Kui poleks, poleks inimesed
nii suurt kära teinud, kui
POWER PLANT rivist välja läks.

maps/Route12.asm::FisherKyleAfterBattleT.label: FisherKyleAfterBattleText
maps/Route12.asm::FisherKyleAfterBattleT.en:
The tug you feel on the ROD when
you hook a #MON…
That's the best feeling ever for an angler like me.
maps/Route12.asm::FisherKyleAfterBattleT.et:
Sikutus, mida tunned RODil, kui
püüad #MONi…
See on parim tunne sellisele õngitsejale nagu mina.

maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::OfferSupe.label: OfferSuperRodText
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::OfferSupe.en:
I'm the FISHING GURU's younger brother.
I can see that you like fishing.
There's no doubt in my mind at all!
So? I know I'm right.
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::OfferSupe.et:
Olen KALAPÜÜGIGURU noorem vend.
Näen, et sulle meeldib kalapüük.
Mul pole selles üldse kahtlust!
Noh? Tean, et mul on õigus.

maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GiveSuper.label: GiveSuperRodText
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GiveSuper.en:
Yes, yes. Just as I thought!
Here, fishing fan! Take this--it's a SUPER ROD.
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GiveSuper.et:
Jah, jah. Just nagu arvasin!
Siin, kalafänn! Võta see -- SUPER ROD.

maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GaveSuper.label: GaveSuperRodText
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GaveSuper.en:
Try your hand at fishing wherever there is water.
Remember--you can catch different
#MON using different RODS.
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::GaveSuper.et:
Proovi kala püüda kõikjal, kus on vett.
Pea meeles -- saad püüda erinevaid
#MONe erinevate RODidega.

maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::DontWantS.label: DontWantSuperRodText
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::DontWantS.en: Huh? My own eyes deceived me?
maps/Route12SuperRodHouse.asm::DontWantS.et: Häh? Mu enda silmad petsid mind?

maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexBeatenText.label: PokefanmAlexBeatenText
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexBeatenText.en: How… How dare you mock royalty!
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexBeatenText.et: Kuidas… Kuidas sa julged kuninglikkust pilgata!

maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexAfterBattl.label: PokefanmAlexAfterBattleText
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexAfterBattl.en: Doesn't everyone wish to someday be a king?
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmAlexAfterBattl.et: Kas mitte igaüks ei soovi kunagi kuningaks saada?

maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaSeenText.label: PokefanmJoshuaSeenText
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaSeenText.en: Nihihi! Would you like to battle my PIKACHU gang?
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaSeenText.et: Nihihi! Kas tahad võidelda mu PIKACHU jõuguga?

maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaAfterBat.label: PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattleText
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaAfterBat.en:
You look like you have many #MON,
but PIKACHU is still the best.
maps/Route13.asm::PokefanmJoshuaAfterBat.et:
Tundub, et sul on palju #MONe,
aga PIKACHU on ikka parim.

maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperPerrySeenTex.label: BirdKeeperPerrySeenText
maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperPerrySeenTex.en: Agility is the key attribute of bird #MON.

maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperPerryBeatenT.label: BirdKeeperPerryBeatenText
maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperPerryBeatenT.en: You beat me with your speed…

maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperBretSeenText.label: BirdKeeperBretSeenText
maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperBretSeenText.en:
Check out my #MON. Just look at
their coloring and their plumage.
maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperBretSeenText.et:
Vaata mu #MONe. Vaata vaid
nende värvi ja sulestikku.

maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperBretAfterBat.label: BirdKeeperBretAfterBattleText
maps/Route13.asm::BirdKeeperBretAfterBat.en: If you groom them, #MON get happy.

maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennySeenText.label: HikerKennySeenText
maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennySeenText.en: I should go to ROCK TUNNEL to get myself an ONIX.
maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennySeenText.et: Peaksin minema ROCK TUNNELISSE, et endale ONIX hankida.

maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennyAfterBattleT.label: HikerKennyAfterBattleText
maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennyAfterBattleT.en:
Geological features don't appear to change.
But they actually change, little by little.
maps/Route13.asm::HikerKennyAfterBattleT.et:
Näib, et maastik ei muutu.
Aga tegelikult see muutub, tasapisi.

maps/Route13.asm::Route13TrainerTipsText.label: Route13TrainerTipsText
maps/Route13.asm::Route13TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
Look! Right there, at the left side of the post.
maps/Route13.asm::Route13TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NÕUANDED
Vaata! Just seal, posti vasakul küljel.

maps/Route13.asm::Route13DirectionsSignT.label: Route13DirectionsSignText
maps/Route13.asm::Route13DirectionsSignT.en:
NORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN
WEST TO FUCHSIA CITY
maps/Route13.asm::Route13DirectionsSignT.et:
PÕHJA POOLE LAVENDER TOWN
LÄÄNE POOLE FUCHSIA CITY

maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterSeenText.label: PokefanmCarterSeenText
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterSeenText.en:
Let me tell you, I had a hard time
catching my prized #MON.
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterSeenText.et:
Usu mind, mul oli raske
oma hinnalist #MONi püüda.

maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterAfterBat.label: PokefanmCarterAfterBattleText
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterAfterBat.en:
SQUIRTLE, CHARMANDER and BULBASAUR…
I think that's a well-balanced mix.
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmCarterAfterBat.et:
SQUIRTLE, CHARMANDER ja BULBASAUR…
Arvan, et see on hästi tasakaalus segu.

maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoySeenText.label: BirdKeeperRoySeenText
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoySeenText.en: My dream is to fly with my beloved bird #MON.
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoySeenText.et: Mu unistus on lennata oma armsa linnu-#MONiga.

maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyBeatenTex.label: BirdKeeperRoyBeatenText
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyBeatenTex.en: I can dream, but I can't ever fly…
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyBeatenTex.et: Võin unistada, aga ei saa kunagi lennata…

maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyAfterBatt.label: BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattleText
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyAfterBatt.en:
You have #MON that know the HM
move FLY, don't you? I envy you.
maps/Route14.asm::BirdKeeperRoyAfterBatt.et:
Sul on #MONid, kes oskavad HM-
rünnakut FLY, kas pole? Kadestan sind.

maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorSeenText.label: PokefanmTrevorSeenText
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorSeenText.en:
Hi. Did you know…?
#MON get more friendly if you
train them in a place that they remember.
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorSeenText.et:
Tere. Kas teadsid…?
#MONid muutuvad sõbralikumaks, kui
treenid neid kohas, mida nad mäletavad.

maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorBeatenTe.label: PokefanmTrevorBeatenText
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorBeatenTe.en: Where did I meet this PSYDUCK?

maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorAfterBat.label: PokefanmTrevorAfterBattleText
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorAfterBat.en:
If only there were an easy way to
identify where I got my #MON…
maps/Route14.asm::PokefanmTrevorAfterBat.et:
Kui vaid oleks lihtne viis
tuvastada, kust oma #MONi sain…

maps/Route15.asm::TeacherColetteAfterBat.label: TeacherColetteAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherColetteAfterBat.en:
Before I became a teacher, I used to
forget a lot of things.
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherColetteAfterBat.et:
Enne õpetajaks saamist unustasin
ma palju asju.

maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillarySeenText.label: TeacherHillarySeenText
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillarySeenText.en:
On sunny days, I think that the
kids would rather be playing in the
schoolyard than studying in class.
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillarySeenText.et:
Päikeselistel päevadel mõtlen, et
lapsed tahaksid pigem kooliõues
mängida kui tunnis õppida.

maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillaryAfterBat.label: TeacherHillaryAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillaryAfterBat.en: Studying is important, but exercise is just as vital.
maps/Route15.asm::TeacherHillaryAfterBat.et: Õppimine on tähtis, aga liikumine on sama oluline.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyKippSeenText.label: SchoolboyKippSeenText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyKippSeenText.en: Hang on. I have to phone my mom.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyKippAfterBatt.label: SchoolboyKippAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyKippAfterBatt.en:
My mom worries so much about me, I
have to phone her all the time.
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyKippAfterBatt.et:
Ema muretseb mu pärast nii palju, et
pean talle kogu aeg helistama.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyTommyBeatenTe.label: SchoolboyTommyBeatenText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyTommyBeatenTe.en: I forgot to do my homework!

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyTommyAfterBat.label: SchoolboyTommyAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyTommyAfterBat.en: Sayonara! I just learned that in my Japanese class.
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyTommyAfterBat.et: Sayonara! Õppisin selle just jaapani keele tunnis.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyJohnnySeenTex.label: SchoolboyJohnnySeenText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyJohnnySeenTex.en:
We're on a field trip to LAVENDER
RADIO TOWER for social studies.
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyJohnnySeenTex.et:
Oleme õppekäigul LAVENDERI
RADIO TOWERISSE ühiskonnaõpetuse jaoks.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBa.label: SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBa.en: I'm tired of walking. I need to take a break.

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyBeatenTe.label: SchoolboyBillyBeatenText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyBeatenTe.en: Oh, no! How could I lose?
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyBeatenTe.et: Oh ei! Kuidas ma kaotada sain?

maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyAfterBat.label: SchoolboyBillyAfterBattleText
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyAfterBat.en: If #MON were a subject at school, I'd be the best!
maps/Route15.asm::SchoolboyBillyAfterBat.et: Kui #MONid oleksid koolis aine, oleksin parim!

maps/Route15FuchsiaGate.asm::Route15Fuch.label: Route15FuchsiaGateOfficerText
maps/Route15FuchsiaGate.asm::Route15Fuch.en:
You're working on a #DEX? That's
really something. Don't give up!
maps/Route15FuchsiaGate.asm::Route15Fuch.et:
Sa teed #DEXi? See on
tõesti midagi. Ära anna alla!

maps/Route16.asm::CyclingRoadSignText.label: CyclingRoadSignText
maps/Route16.asm::CyclingRoadSignText.en:
CYCLING ROAD
DOWNHILL COASTING ALL THE WAY!
maps/Route16.asm::CyclingRoadSignText.et:
CYCLING ROAD
ALLAMÄGE VABAKS KOGU TEE!

maps/Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse.asm::Rout.label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouseSuperNerdText
maps/Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse.asm::Rout.en:
If you cruise down CYCLING ROAD, you
will end up in FUCHSIA CITY.
maps/Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse.asm::Rout.et:
Kui kihutad mööda CYCLING ROADi alla,
jõuad FUCHSIA CITYSSE.

maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateOfficer.label: Route16GateOfficerText
maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateOfficer.en:
CYCLING ROAD starts here.
It's all downhill, so it's totally exhilarating.
It's a great sort of feeling that
you can't get from a ship or train.
maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateOfficer.et:
CYCLING ROAD algab siit.
See on täiesti allamäge, seega ülimalt vahva.
See on suurepärane tunne,
mida laevast ega rongist ei saa.

maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateCannotP.label: Route16GateCannotPassText
maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateCannotP.en:
Hey! Whoa! Stop!
You can't go out on the CYCLING
ROAD without a BICYCLE.
maps/Route16Gate.asm::Route16GateCannotP.et:
Hei! Oot! Peatu!
Sa ei saa minna CYCLING
ROADILE ilma BICYCLEta.

maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileySeenText.label: BikerRileySeenText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileySeenText.en: Hey, you! You're from JOHTO, huh?
maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileySeenText.et: Hei, sina! Sa oled JOHTOST, mis?

maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileyAfterBattleT.label: BikerRileyAfterBattleText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileyAfterBattleT.en: Don't get cocky, you JOHTO punk!
maps/Route17.asm::BikerRileyAfterBattleT.et: Ära muutu ülbeks, sa JOHTO jõmpsikas!

maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelBeatenText.label: BikerJoelBeatenText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelBeatenText.en: But you don't just look cool…
maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelBeatenText.et: Aga sa ei näe ainult lahe välja…

maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelAfterBattleTe.label: BikerJoelAfterBattleText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelAfterBattleTe.en:
I look cool, but I'm weak, so I'm not really cool.
I have to train harder…
maps/Route17.asm::BikerJoelAfterBattleTe.et:
Näen lahe välja, aga olen nõrk, seega pole päris lahe.
Pean kõvemini treenima…

maps/Route17.asm::BikerGlennSeenText.label: BikerGlennSeenText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerGlennSeenText.en: Hey! Want to have a speed battle?

maps/Route17.asm::BikerGlennAfterBattleT.label: BikerGlennAfterBattleText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerGlennAfterBattleT.en: Hands-free riding is considered cool on CYCLING ROAD.
maps/Route17.asm::BikerGlennAfterBattleT.et: Käevaba sõit on CYCLING ROADIL lahe.

maps/Route17.asm::BikerCharlesAfterBattl.label: BikerCharlesAfterBattleText
maps/Route17.asm::BikerCharlesAfterBattl.en: Reckless driving causes accidents! Take it easy!
maps/Route17.asm::BikerCharlesAfterBattl.et: Hoolimatu sõit põhjustab õnnetusi! Võta rahulikult!

maps/Route17Route18Gate.asm::Route17Rout.label: Route17Route18GateCannotPassText
maps/Route17Route18Gate.asm::Route17Rout.en:
Hang on! Don't you have a BICYCLE?
The CYCLING ROAD is beyond here.
You have to have a BICYCLE to go on.
maps/Route17Route18Gate.asm::Route17Rout.et:
Oota! Kas sul pole BICYCLEt?
CYCLING ROAD on siit edasi.
Edasiminekuks pead omama BICYCLEt.

maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisSeenTex.label: BirdKeeperBorisSeenText
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisSeenTex.en:
If you're looking for #MON, you
have to look in the tall grass.
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisSeenTex.et:
Kui otsid #MONe, pead
vaatama pikas rohus.

maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisAfterBa.label: BirdKeeperBorisAfterBattleText
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisAfterBa.en: Since you're so strong, it must be fun to battle.
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBorisAfterBa.et: Kuna oled nii tugev, peab sinuga võitlemine lõbus olema.

maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobSeenText.label: BirdKeeperBobSeenText
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobSeenText.en: CYCLING ROAD is a quick shortcut to CELADON.
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobSeenText.et: CYCLING ROAD on kiire otsetee CELADONI.

maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobAfterBatt.label: BirdKeeperBobAfterBattleText
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobAfterBatt.en:
If you don't have a BICYCLE, you're
not allowed to use the shortcut.
maps/Route18.asm::BirdKeeperBobAfterBatt.et:
Kui sul pole BICYCLEt, ei tohi
sa otseteed kasutada.

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldSeenText.label: SwimmermHaroldSeenText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldSeenText.en: Have you ever gone swimming in the sea at night?
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldSeenText.et: Kas oled kunagi öösel meres ujunud?

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldAfterBat.label: SwimmermHaroldAfterBattleText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldAfterBat.en:
At night, the sea turns black. It
feels like it will swallow you up.
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermHaroldAfterBat.et:
Öösel muutub meri mustaks. Tundub,
nagu see neelaks su alla.

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerSeenText.label: SwimmermTuckerSeenText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerSeenText.en:
Pant, pant… Just… a little…
farther… to… FUCHSIA…
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerSeenText.et:
Ähh, ähh… Veel… natuke…
kaugemale… FUCHSIASSE…

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerAfterBat.label: SwimmermTuckerAfterBattleText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerAfterBat.en: I… asked my girlfriend to swim to FUCHSIA… Gasp…
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermTuckerAfterBat.et: Ma… palusin tüdruksõbral ujuda FUCHSIASSE… Ähh…

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmerfDawnBeatenText.label: SwimmerfDawnBeatenText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmerfDawnBeatenText.en: I could beat you at swimming…

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmerfDawnAfterBattl.label: SwimmerfDawnAfterBattleText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmerfDawnAfterBattl.en:
It's a quick swim between FUCHSIA
and SEAFOAM ISLANDS…
Sheesh, some big man my boyfriend
is! What a wimp!
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmerfDawnAfterBattl.et:
FUCHSIA ja SEAFOAM ISLANDSI vahel
on kiire uju…
Uhh, mingi suur mees mu poiss-sõber
on! Milline nõrguke!

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeSeenText.label: SwimmermJeromeSeenText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeSeenText.en:
Swimming? I'm lousy at it.
I'm just splashing around in these shallow waters.
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeSeenText.et:
Ujumine? Olen selles vilets.
Lihtsalt plätserdan neis madalates vetes.

maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeAfterBat.label: SwimmermJeromeAfterBattleText
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeAfterBat.en: I might be bad at swimming, but I love the sea.
maps/Route19.asm::SwimmermJeromeAfterBat.et: Ehk olen ujumises kehv, aga armastan merd.

maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text.label: Route19Fisher1Text
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text.en:
Sorry. This road is closed for construction.
If you want to get to CINNABAR, you'd
better go south from PALLET TOWN.
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text.et:
Vabandust. See tee on ehituse tõttu suletud.
Kui tahad CINNABARISSE, mine
parem lõunasse PALLET TOWNIST.

maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text_Roc.label: Route19Fisher1Text_RocksCleared
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text_Roc.en: I'm all sweaty. Time for a swim!
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher1Text_Roc.et: Olen üleni higine. Aeg ujuma minna!

maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text.label: Route19Fisher2Text
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text.en: Who knows how long it would take to move this boulder…
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text.et: Kes teab, kui kaua kuluks selle rahnu liigutamiseks…

maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text_Roc.label: Route19Fisher2Text_RocksCleared
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text_Roc.en:
The roadwork is finally finished.
Now I can go fishing again.
maps/Route19.asm::Route19Fisher2Text_Roc.et:
Teetööd on lõpuks valmis.
Nüüd saan jälle kalale minna.

maps/Route19.asm::CarefulSwimmingSignTex.label: CarefulSwimmingSignText
maps/Route19.asm::CarefulSwimmingSignTex.en:
Please be careful if you are swimming to SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
FUCHSIA POLICE
maps/Route19.asm::CarefulSwimmingSignTex.et:
Ole palun ettevaatlik, kui ujud SEAFOAM ISLANDSILE.
FUCHSIA POLITSEI

maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.label: Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText
maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.en:
CINNABAR's volcano erupted.
It hurled boulders that cut off ROUTE 19 indefinitely.
I wonder if the people of CINNABAR are safe…
maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.et:
CINNABARI vulkaan purskas.
See paiskas rahne, mis lõikasid ROUTE 19 määramata ajaks ära.
Huvitav, kas CINNABARI inimesed on turvalised…

maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.label: Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText_RocksCleared
maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.en:
No CINNABAR citizens were injured
by the eruption. That's great!
maps/Route19FuchsiaGate.asm::Route19Fuch.et:
Ükski CINNABARI kodanik ei saanud
purske käigus viga. See on suurepärane!

maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherRobSeenText.label: BugCatcherRobSeenText
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherRobSeenText.en: My bug #MON are tough. Prepare to lose!
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherRobSeenText.et: Mu putuk-#MONid on kõvad. Valmistu kaotuseks!

maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherRobAfterBattl.label: BugCatcherRobAfterBattleText
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherRobAfterBattl.en: I'm going to look for stronger bug #MON.

maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdSeenText.label: BugCatcherEdSeenText
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdSeenText.en:
If you walk in tall grass wearing
shorts, do you get nicks and cuts?
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdSeenText.et:
Kui kõnnid pikas rohus lühikestes
pükstes, kas saad kriimustusi?

maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdAfterBattle.label: BugCatcherEdAfterBattleText
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdAfterBattle.en: They'll really sting when you take a bath.
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherEdAfterBattle.et: Need kipitavad korralikult, kui vanni lähed.

maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherDougAfterBatt.label: BugCatcherDougAfterBattleText
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherDougAfterBatt.en:
Bug #MON squish like plush toys
when you squeeze their bellies.
I love how they feel!
maps/Route2.asm::BugCatcherDougAfterBatt.et:
Putuk-#MONid on pehmed nagu
kaisuloomad, kui pigistad nende kõhtu.
Mulle meeldib, kuidas nad tunduvad!

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfNicoleSeenText.label: SwimmerfNicoleSeenText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfNicoleSeenText.en: I feel so much lighter in water.

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfNicoleAfterBat.label: SwimmerfNicoleAfterBattleText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfNicoleAfterBat.en:
Swimming exercises your full body.
It's really good for you.
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfNicoleAfterBat.et:
Ujumine treenib kogu keha.
See on sulle tõesti kasulik.

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriSeenText.label: SwimmerfLoriSeenText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriSeenText.en:
What an impressive collection of GYM
BADGES. We should battle!
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriSeenText.et:
Milline muljetavaldav SAALI
MÄRKIDE kogu. Peaksime võitlema!

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriAfterBattl.label: SwimmerfLoriAfterBattleText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriAfterBattl.en: SURF is no longer the only HM move you use in water.
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmerfLoriAfterBattl.et: SURF pole enam ainus HM-rünnak, mida vees kasutad.

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronSeenTex.label: SwimmermCameronSeenText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronSeenTex.en:
I guess it's impossible to swim
all the way to JOHTO.
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronSeenTex.et:
Vist on võimatu ujuda
kogu tee JOHTOSSE.

maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronAfterBa.label: SwimmermCameronAfterBattleText
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronAfterBa.en: Besides the sea, I can also swim in ponds and rivers.
maps/Route20.asm::SwimmermCameronAfterBa.et: Peale mere saan ujuda ka tiikides ja jõgedes.

maps/Route20.asm::CinnabarGymSignText.label: CinnabarGymSignText
maps/Route20.asm::CinnabarGymSignText.en:
What does this sign say?
CINNABAR GYM LEADER: BLAINE
maps/Route20.asm::CinnabarGymSignText.et:
Mida see silt ütleb?
CINNABARI SAALI JUHT: BLAINE

maps/Route21.asm::SwimmermSethAfterBattl.label: SwimmermSethAfterBattleText
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmermSethAfterBattl.en: This arrogant guy was at CINNABAR's volcano.
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmermSethAfterBattl.et: See ülbe tüüp oli CINNABARI vulkaanil.

maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiSeenText.label: SwimmerfNikkiSeenText
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiSeenText.en: If I win, you have to help me with my suntan lotion!
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiSeenText.et: Kui võidan, pead aitama mind päikesekreemiga!

maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiAfterBatt.label: SwimmerfNikkiAfterBattleText
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiAfterBatt.en: I have to watch out for blemishes caused by the sun.
maps/Route21.asm::SwimmerfNikkiAfterBatt.et: Pean silmas pidama päikesest tekkivaid plekke.

maps/Route21.asm::FisherArnoldSeenText.label: FisherArnoldSeenText
maps/Route21.asm::FisherArnoldSeenText.en: I'm bored by fishing. Let's battle!

maps/Route21.asm::FisherArnoldAfterBattl.label: FisherArnoldAfterBattleText
maps/Route21.asm::FisherArnoldAfterBattl.en: I'll just go back to fishing…

maps/Route23.asm::IndigoPlateauSignText.label: IndigoPlateauSignText
maps/Route23.asm::IndigoPlateauSignText.en:
INDIGO PLATEAU
The Ultimate Goal for Trainers!
#MON LEAGUE HQ
maps/Route23.asm::IndigoPlateauSignText.et:
INDIGO PLATEAU
Treenerite ülim eesmärk!
#MON LIIGA PEAKORTER

maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketSeenText.label: Route24RocketSeenText
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketSeenText.en:
Hey, kid! Me am a TEAM ROCKET member kind of guy!
Come from another country, a trainer number one, me!
Think I did, if stop the energy,
be big panic for here people!
Secret it is my mission, so tell you I not!
But! If win you do versus me, a man I
be and mine secret to you I tell.
Hey, kid! Battle begin we do!
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketSeenText.et:
Hei, laps! Mina olen RAKETI KAMBA liige tüüp!
Teisest riigist tulnud, treener number üks, mina!
Mõtlesin ma, kui energia peatub,
suur paanika siinsetele inimestele!
Saladus on mu missioon, seega ütle sulle ei ma!
Aga! Kui võidad sa minu vastu, mees mina
olen ja oma saladuse sulle ütlen.
Hei, laps! Lahing alustame me!

maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketBeatenTex.label: Route24RocketBeatenText
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketBeatenTex.en:
Ayieeeh! No, no, no, believe it I can't!
Strong very much be you! Match I am not to you!
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketBeatenTex.et:
Aijeeeh! Ei, ei, ei, uskuda seda ei suuda ma!
Tugev väga oled sina! Sulle vastane ma pole!

maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketAfterBatt.label: Route24RocketAfterBattleText
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketAfterBatt.en:
OK. Tell you mine secret will I.
MACHINE PART steal by me, hide it I
did in GYM of the CERULEAN.
Inside water put it I did. Look for
in water center of GYM at.
But you forget me not!
Beat you for sure will TEAM ROCKET.
Come from JOHTO will they, mine
friends, yes. Will revenge they are.
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketAfterBatt.et:
OK. Ütlen sulle oma saladuse ma.
MASINAOSA varastas mina, peitsin selle
ma CERULEANI SAALIS.
Vette panin selle ma. Otsi
vees SAALI keskel.
Aga sina unusta mind ei!
Alistab sind kindlasti RAKETI KAMP.
Tulevad JOHTOST nad, mu
sõbrad, jah. Kättemaksu nad on.

maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketDisappear.label: Route24RocketDisappearsText
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketDisappear.en:
…
You say what? TEAM ROCKET bye-bye a
go-go? Broken it is says you?
Oh, no! Should I do what now on from, me?
maps/Route24.asm::Route24RocketDisappear.et:
…
Mida ütled sina? RAKETI KAMP head-aega
läinud-läinud? Katki on ütlevad sina?
Oh, ei! Mida peaksin tegema nüüdsest, mina?

maps/Route25.asm::Route25MistyDateText.label: Route25MistyDateText
maps/Route25.asm::Route25MistyDateText.en:
MISTY: Aww! Why did you have to
show up and bug us now?
Do you know what they call people like you?
Pests! You heard me right, pest!
…
…Oh? Those BADGES you have… Are they JOHTO GYM BADGES?
If you have eight, you must be good.
OK, then. Come to CERULEAN GYM.
I'll be happy to take you on.
I'm MISTY, the GYM LEADER in CERULEAN.
maps/Route25.asm::Route25MistyDateText.et:
MISTY: Ohh! Miks sa pidid just nüüd
kohale ilmuma ja meid tülitama?
Kas tead, kuidas selliseid nagu sina kutsutakse?
Tüütused! Kuulsid õigesti, tüütus!
…
…Oh? Need MÄRGID… Kas need on JOHTO SAALI MÄRGID?
Kui sul on kaheksa, pead olema hea.
Hästi siis. Tule CERULEANI SAALI.
Mul on hea meel sinuga võistelda.
Olen MISTY, CERULEANI SAALI JUHT.

maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleySeenTex.label: SchoolboyDudleySeenText
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleySeenTex.en:
Beat the six of us trainers to win a fabulous prize!
Think you've got what it takes?
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleySeenTex.et:
Alista meid kuut treenerit ja võida vapustav auhind!
Arvad, et sul on selleks võimeid?

maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleyAfterBa.label: SchoolboyDudleyAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleyAfterBa.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyDudleyAfterBa.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::LassEllenAfterBattleTe.label: LassEllenAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::LassEllenAfterBattleTe.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::LassEllenAfterBattleTe.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeSeenText.label: SchoolboyJoeSeenText
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeSeenText.en: Here's No. 3! I won't be easy.
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeSeenText.et: Siin on nr 3! Ma ei ole kerge.

maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeAfterBattl.label: SchoolboyJoeAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeAfterBattl.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::SchoolboyJoeAfterBattl.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::LassLauraAfterBattleTe.label: LassLauraAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::LassLauraAfterBattleTe.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::LassLauraAfterBattleTe.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydSeenText.label: CamperLloydSeenText
maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydSeenText.en: OK! I'm No. 5. I'll stomp you!
maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydSeenText.et: OK! Olen nr 5. Trambin su lapikuks!

maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydAfterBattle.label: CamperLloydAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydAfterBattle.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::CamperLloydAfterBattle.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonSeenText.label: LassShannonSeenText
maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonSeenText.en: I'm the last in line, but I tell you, I'm tough!
maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonSeenText.et: Olen viimane reas, aga usu mind, olen kõva!

maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonAfterBattle.label: LassShannonAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonAfterBattle.en: I did my best. I have no regrets.
maps/Route25.asm::LassShannonAfterBattle.et: Andsin endast parima. Ma ei kahetse midagi.

maps/Route25.asm::SupernerdPatSeenText.label: SupernerdPatSeenText
maps/Route25.asm::SupernerdPatSeenText.en:
Mufufufu…
I have nothing to do with the sixpack trainers.
I waited here to beat you when you
were tired out by all the battles.
maps/Route25.asm::SupernerdPatSeenText.et:
Mufufuu…
Mul pole nende kuue treeneriga midagi pistmist.
Ootasin siin, et alistada sind, kui
oled kõigist lahingutest väsinud.

maps/Route25.asm::SupernerdPatAfterBattl.label: SupernerdPatAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::SupernerdPatAfterBattl.en: I'm sorry… I won't cheat anymore…

maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinNugge.label: CooltrainermKevinNuggetText
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinNugge.en:
You took on one more battle than
you expected, but you won anyway.
As promised, you win a prize.
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinNugge.et:
Sa pidasid ühe lahingu rohkem kui
ootasid, aga võitsid ikkagi.
Nagu lubatud, võidad auhinna.

maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinSeenT.label: CooltrainermKevinSeenText
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinSeenT.en:
But after seeing how you battle, I
want to see how I'll fare.
How about it? Let me take you on.
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinSeenT.et:
Aga nähes, kuidas sa võitled,
tahan näha, kuidas mul läheb.
Mis arvad? Lase mul sinuga võistelda.

maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinBeate.label: CooltrainermKevinBeatenText
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinBeate.en: I've never had a battle this good!
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinBeate.et: Nii head lahingut pole mul kunagi olnud!

maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinAfter.label: CooltrainermKevinAfterBattleText
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinAfter.en:
That was a great battle!
You and your #MON are truly outstanding!
maps/Route25.asm::CooltrainermKevinAfter.et:
See oli suurepärane lahing!
Sina ja su #MONid olete tõeliselt silmapaistvad!

maps/Route25.asm::BillsHouseSignText.label: BillsHouseSignText
maps/Route25.asm::BillsHouseSignText.en:
SEA COTTAGE BILL'S HOUSE
BILL'S HOUSE
maps/Route25.asm::BillsHouseSignText.et:
SEA COTTAGE BILL'S HOUSE
BILL'S HOUSE

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermJakeSeenTe.label: CooltrainermJakeSeenText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermJakeSeenTe.en:
I'm making my final preparations
for the #MON LEAGUE.

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermJakeAfterB.label: CooltrainermJakeAfterBattleText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermJakeAfterB.en:
It's going to be tough to win at the LEAGUE.
I need to do some more training.
I hear that the LEAGUE's ELITE
FOUR are tougher than GYM LEADERS.
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermJakeAfterB.et:
LIIGAS võitmine tuleb raske.
Pean veel treenima.
Kuulen, et LIIGA ELITE
FOUR on kõvemad kui SAALI JUHID.

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermGaven3Seen.label: CooltrainermGaven3SeenText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermGaven3Seen.en: By experiencing tough battles, you gain power.

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermGavenAfter.label: CooltrainermGavenAfterText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermGavenAfter.en:
To get to #MON LEAGUE, you have
to get through VICTORY ROAD.
But VICTORY ROAD is tough.
Practically nobody goes there!
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainermGavenAfter.et:
#MON LIIGASSE jõudmiseks pead
läbima VICTORY ROADi.
Aga VICTORY ROAD on raske.
Praktiliselt keegi ei lähe sinna!

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceSeenT.label: CooltrainerfJoyceSeenText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceSeenT.en:
Since you've come this far, you must be good.
I'm going to give this battle everything I've got!
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceSeenT.et:
Kuna oled nii kaugele jõudnud, pead olema hea.
Annan sellele lahingule endast kõik!

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceAfter.label: CooltrainerfJoyceAfterBattleText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceAfter.en:
I've defeated eight GYM LEADERS,
so I was feeling confident.
I'll have to try harder next time.
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfJoyceAfter.et:
Olen alistanud kaheksa SAALI JUHTI,
seega tundsin end enesekindlalt.
Pean järgmisel korral rohkem pingutama.

maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfBeth1SeenT.label: CooltrainerfBeth1SeenText
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfBeth1SeenT.en:
I lost to a trainer named <RIVAL>.
He was really strong, but…
It was as if he absolutely had to win at any cost.
I felt sorry for his #MON.
maps/Route26.asm::CooltrainerfBeth1SeenT.et:
Kaotasin treenerile nimega <RIVAL>.
Ta oli tõesti tugev, aga…
Oli, nagu ta peaks iga hinna eest võitma.
Mul oli ta #MONidest kahju.

maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardSeenText.label: PsychicRichardSeenText
maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardSeenText.en:
Wow, look at all those BADGES! I'm impressed.
But you're not satisfied by just
collecting them, right?
maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardSeenText.et:
Vau, vaata kõiki neid MÄRKE! Olen muljet avaldatud.
Aga sa ei rahuldu ainult
nende kogumisega, eks?

maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardAfterBat.label: PsychicRichardAfterBattleText
maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardAfterBat.en:
People and #MON grow from their experiences.
Don't get lazy and complacent.
maps/Route26.asm::PsychicRichardAfterBat.et:
Inimesed ja #MONid kasvavad oma kogemustest.
Ära muutu laisaks ja rahulolevaks.

maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottSeenText.label: FisherScottSeenText
maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottSeenText.en:
I'm feeling great today!
I feel like I could boot even the LEAGUE CHAMP!
maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottSeenText.et:
Tunnen end täna suurepäraselt!
Tunnen, et võiksin alistada isegi LIIGA TŠEMPIONI!

maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottAfterBattle.label: FisherScottAfterBattleText
maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottAfterBattle.en:
Just like in fishing, it's all over
in #MON if you give up.
maps/Route26.asm::FisherScottAfterBattle.et:
Nagu kalapüügis, on ka #MONides
kõik läbi, kui alla annad.

maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.label: Route26HealHouseRestAWhileText
maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.en:
Your #MON look a little tired.
You should rest them a while.
maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.et:
Su #MONid näevad pisut väsinud välja.
Peaksid neid veidi puhkama laskma.

maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.label: Route26HealHouseKeepAtItText
maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.en:
There!
Your #MON are looking good!
Keep at it!
maps/Route26HealHouse.asm::Route26HealHo.et:
Nii!
Su #MONid näevad head välja!
Püsi tublina!

maps/Route27.asm::Route27FisherText.label: Route27FisherText
maps/Route27.asm::Route27FisherText.en:
Do you know what you just did?
You've taken your first step into KANTO.
Check your #GEAR MAP and see.
maps/Route27.asm::Route27FisherText.et:
Kas tead, mida sa just tegid?
Astusid oma esimese sammu KANTOSSE.
Vaata oma #GEAR KAARTi ja näe.

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeSeenT.label: CooltrainermBlakeSeenText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeSeenT.en: You look pretty strong. Let me battle you!
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeSeenT.et: Näed üsna tugev välja. Lase mul sinuga võidelda!

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeAfter.label: CooltrainermBlakeAfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeAfter.en:
If you prevail on this harsh trek,
the truth will be revealed!
Heh, sorry, I just wanted to say something cool.
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBlakeAfter.et:
Kui tuled sellest karmist rännakust võitjana,
siis paljastub tõde!
Heh, vabandust, tahtsin lihtsalt midagi lahedat öelda.

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBrianAfter.label: CooltrainermBrianAfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBrianAfter.en: A good trainer can recognize other good trainers.
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainermBrianAfter.et: Hea treener tunneb ära teised head treenerid.

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaSeenT.label: CooltrainerfReenaSeenText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaSeenT.en:
You shouldn't underestimate the
wild #MON in these parts.
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaSeenT.et:
Sa ei tohiks alahinnata
nende kandi metsikuid #MONe.

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaBeate.label: CooltrainerfReenaBeatenText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaBeate.et: Oh! Sa oled palju liiga tugev!

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaAfter.label: CooltrainerfReenaAfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaAfter.en:
You're just a kid, but you're not to
be underestimated either.
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfReenaAfter.et:
Oled vaid laps, aga ka sind
ei tasu alahinnata.

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganSeenT.label: CooltrainerfMeganSeenText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganSeenT.en:
It's rare to see anyone come here.
Are you training on your own?
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganSeenT.et:
Harva näeb kedagi siia tulemas.
Kas treenid omal käel?

maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganAfter.label: CooltrainerfMeganAfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganAfter.en:
I'm checking out pre- and postevolution #MON.
Evolution really does make #MON stronger.
But evolved forms also learn moves later on.
maps/Route27.asm::CooltrainerfMeganAfter.et:
Uurin arengueelseid ja -järgseid #MONe.
Areng teeb #MONid tõesti tugevamaks.
Aga arenenud vormid õpivad rünnakuid hiljem.

maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertSeenText.label: PsychicGilbertSeenText
maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertSeenText.en:
Don't say a thing!
Let me guess what you're thinking.
Mmmmmmm…
I got it! You're on the #MON LEAGUE challenge!
maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertSeenText.et:
Ära ütle midagi!
Lase mul arvata, mida sa mõtled.
Mmmmmmm…
Sain aru! Oled #MON LIIGA väljakutsel!

maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertAfterBat.label: PsychicGilbertAfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertAfterBat.en:
With your skills, you'll do well at the LEAGUE.
That's what my premonition says.
maps/Route27.asm::PsychicGilbertAfterBat.et:
Su oskustega läheb sul LIIGAS hästi.
Nii ütleb mu eelaimdus.

maps/Route27.asm::BirdKeeperJose2AfterBa.label: BirdKeeperJose2AfterBattleText
maps/Route27.asm::BirdKeeperJose2AfterBa.en:
BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird
whistles to command #MON.
maps/Route27.asm::BirdKeeperJose2AfterBa.et:
Sellised LINNUHOIDJAD nagu mina matkivad
linnuvilet, et #MONe juhtida.

maps/Route27.asm::TohjoFallsSignText.label: TohjoFallsSignText
maps/Route27.asm::TohjoFallsSignText.en:
TOHJO FALLS
THE LINK BETWEEN KANTO AND JOHTO
maps/Route27.asm::TohjoFallsSignText.et:
TOHJO FALLS
SILD KANTO JA JOHTO VAHEL

maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.label: SandstormHouseWomanText1
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.en:
Where are you off to with #MON?
#MON LEAGUE?
Are your #MON loyal enough for you to win?
Let me see…
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.et:
Kuhu sa #MONidega suundud?
#MON LIIGASSE?
Kas su #MONid on piisavalt lojaalsed, et võidaksid?
Lase mul vaadata…

maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.label: SandstormHouseWomanLoyalText
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.en:
Ah! Your #MON trusts you very much.
It's nice to see a good trainer.
Here. A gift for your journey.
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.et:
Ah! Su #MON usaldab sind väga.
Tore näha head treenerit.
Siin. Kingitus su teekonnaks.

maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.label: SandstormHouseSandstormDescription
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.en:
TM37 happens to be SANDSTORM.
It's a move that inflicts damage on both battlers.
It's for advanced trainers only.
Use it if you dare. Good luck!
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.et:
TM37 juhtub olema SANDSTORM.
See on rünnak, mis teeb kahju mõlemale võitlejale.
See on ainult edasijõudnud treeneritele.
Kasuta, kui julged. Edu!

maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.label: SandstormHouseWomanDisloyalText
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.en:
If it doesn't come to trust you some
more, it could be tough going.
Trust is the tie that binds #MON and trainers.
maps/Route27SandstormHouse.asm::Sandstor.et:
Kui see ei hakka sind rohkem
usaldama, võib olla raske.
Usaldus on side, mis seob #MONid ja treenerid.

maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.label: CelebrityText1
maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.en:
Oh, dear. You've found me.
Please don't tell anyone about me.
I'll give you this for keeping my secret. Please?
maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.et:
Oh, sa leidsid mind.
Ära palun kellelegi minust räägi.
Annan sulle selle mu saladuse hoidmise eest. Palun?

maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.label: CelebrityText2
maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.en:
It's tough being a top celebrity.
Everywhere I go, people chase me.
I just want to be left alone…
maps/Route28SteelWingHouse.asm::Celebrit.et:
Tippkuulsus olla on raske.
Kõikjal, kuhu lähen, jälitavad mind inimesed.
Tahan lihtsalt rahule jääda…

maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialBoxFul.label: CatchingTutorialBoxFullText
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialBoxFul.en:
#MON hide in the grass. Who
knows when they'll pop out…
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialBoxFul.et:
#MONid peidavad end rohus. Kes
teab, millal nad välja hüppavad…

maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialIntroT.label: CatchingTutorialIntroText
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialIntroT.en:
I've seen you a couple times. How
many #MON have you caught?
Would you like me to show you how to catch #MON?
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialIntroT.et:
Olen sind paar korda näinud. Mitu
#MONi oled püüdnud?
Kas näitan sulle, kuidas #MONe püüda?

maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDebrie.label: CatchingTutorialDebriefText
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDebrie.en:
That's how you do it.
If you weaken them first, #MON are easier to catch.
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDebrie.et:
Nii seda tehaksegi.
Kui neid enne nõrgestada, on #MONe kergem püüda.

maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDeclin.label: CatchingTutorialDeclinedText
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDeclin.en:
Oh. Fine, then.
Anyway, if you want to catch
#MON, you have to walk a lot.
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialDeclin.et:
Oh. Hea küll siis.
Igatahes, kui tahad #MONe
püüda, tuleb palju kõndida.

maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialRepeat.label: CatchingTutorialRepeatText
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialRepeat.en: Huh? You want me to show you how to catch #MON?
maps/Route29.asm::CatchingTutorialRepeat.et: Ah? Tahad, et näitan, kuidas #MONe püüda?

maps/Route29.asm::Route29YoungsterText.label: Route29YoungsterText
maps/Route29.asm::Route29YoungsterText.en:
Yo. How are your #MON?
If they're weak and not ready for
battle, keep out of the grass.
maps/Route29.asm::Route29YoungsterText.et:
Hei. Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Kui nad on nõrgad ega ole
lahinguks valmis, hoia rohust eemale.

maps/Route29.asm::Route29TeacherText.label: Route29TeacherText
maps/Route29.asm::Route29TeacherText.en:
See those ledges? It's scary to jump off them.
But you can go to NEW BARK without
walking through the grass.
maps/Route29.asm::Route29TeacherText.et:
Näed neid astanguid? Neilt on hirmus alla hüpata.
Aga NEW BARKI saab minna
läbi rohu kõndimata.

maps/Route29.asm::Route29FisherText.label: Route29FisherText
maps/Route29.asm::Route29FisherText.en:
I wanted to take a break, so I saved
to record my progress.
I'm waiting for #MON that
appear only in the daytime.
maps/Route29.asm::Route29FisherText.et:
Tahtsin pausi teha, nii et salvestasin
oma edenemise.
Ootan #MONe, kes
ilmuvad ainult päeval.

maps/Route29.asm::Route29CooltrainerMTex.label: Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForNight
maps/Route29.asm::Route29CooltrainerMTex.en:
I'm waiting for #MON that
appear only at night.

maps/Route29.asm::Route29CooltrainerMTex.label: Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForMorning
maps/Route29.asm::Route29CooltrainerMTex.en:
I'm waiting for #MON that
appear only in the morning.

maps/Route29.asm::MeetTuscanyText.label: MeetTuscanyText
maps/Route29.asm::MeetTuscanyText.en:
TUSCANY: I do believe that this is
the first time we've met?
Please allow me to introduce myself.
I am TUSCANY of Tuesday.
maps/Route29.asm::MeetTuscanyText.et:
TUSCANY: Usun küll, et see on
meie esimene kohtumine?
Lubage end tutvustada.
Olen TUSCANY teisipäevast.

maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGivesGiftText.label: TuscanyGivesGiftText
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGivesGiftText.en:
By way of introduction, please
accept this gift, a PINK BOW.
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGivesGiftText.et:
Tutvumise puhul palun
võta see kingitus, PINK BOW.

maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGaveGiftText.label: TuscanyGaveGiftText
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGaveGiftText.en:
TUSCANY: Wouldn't you agree that it is most adorable?
It strengthens normal-type moves.
I am certain it will be of use.
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyGaveGiftText.et:
TUSCANY: Kas pole ta lausa võluv?
See tugevdab tava-tüüpi rünnakuid.
Kindlasti tuleb sellest kasu.

maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyTuesdayText.label: TuscanyTuesdayText
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyTuesdayText.en:
TUSCANY: Have you met MONICA, my older sister?
Or my younger brother, WESLEY?
I am the second of seven children.
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyTuesdayText.et:
TUSCANY: Kas oled kohanud MONICAt, mu vanemat õde?
Või mu nooremat venda WESLEYt?
Olen seitsmest lapsest teine.

maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyNotTuesdayText.label: TuscanyNotTuesdayText
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyNotTuesdayText.en: TUSCANY: Today is not Tuesday. That is unfortunate…
maps/Route29.asm::TuscanyNotTuesdayText.et: TUSCANY: Täna pole teisipäev. Kahju küll…

maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign1Text.label: Route29Sign1Text
maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign1Text.en:
ROUTE 29
CHERRYGROVE CITY NEW BARK TOWN
maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign1Text.et:
ROUTE 29
CHERRYGROVE CITY NEW BARK TOWN

maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign2Text.label: Route29Sign2Text
maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign2Text.en:
ROUTE 29
CHERRYGROVE CITY NEW BARK TOWN
maps/Route29.asm::Route29Sign2Text.et:
ROUTE 29
CHERRYGROVE CITY NEW BARK TOWN

maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.label: Route29Route46GateOfficerText
maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.en:
You can't climb ledges.
But you can jump down from them to take a shortcut.
maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.et:
Sa ei saa astangutele ronida.
Aga saad neilt alla hüpata, et otseteed teha.

maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.label: Route29Route46GateYoungsterText
maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.en:
Different kinds of #MON appear past here.
If you want to catch them all,
you have to look everywhere.
maps/Route29Route46Gate.asm::Route29Rout.et:
Siit edasi ilmuvad teistsugused #MONid.
Kui tahad need kõik püüda,
pead kõikjalt otsima.

maps/Route2Gate.asm::Route2GateScientist.label: Route2GateScientistText
maps/Route2Gate.asm::Route2GateScientist.en:
Are you <PLAY_G>?
I work as PROF. OAK's AIDE.
I had no idea that you were out here.
PROF.OAK's LAB is nearby in PALLET TOWN.
maps/Route2Gate.asm::Route2GateScientist.et:
Kas sina oled <PLAY_G>?
Töötan PROF. OAKI ABILISENA.
Mul polnud aimugi, et sa siin oled.
PROF.OAKI LABOR on lähedal PALLET TOWNIS.

maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.label: Route2NuggetHouseFisherText
maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.en:
Hi! Wow, I'm glad to see you.
You're the first visitor I've had in a long time.
I'm super-happy! Let me give you a little present.
maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.et:
Tere! Vau, mul on hea meel sind näha.
Oled esimene külaline pika aja jooksul.
Olen ülimalt õnnelik! Lubage teha sulle väike kingitus.

maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.label: Route2NuggetHouseFisherText_GotNugget
maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.en:
That's a NUGGET.
I can't give you any nuggets of
wisdom, so that'll have to do!
maps/Route2NuggetHouse.asm::Route2Nugget.et:
See on NUGGET.
Mul pole sulle anda tarkuseteri,
seega peab see hakkama saama!

maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisSeenTex.label: FirebreatherOtisSeenText
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisSeenTex.en: Ah! The weather's as fine as ever.
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisSeenTex.et: Ah! Ilm on nii kena kui alati.

maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisBeatenT.label: FirebreatherOtisBeatenText
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisBeatenT.en: It's sunny, but I'm all wet…
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisBeatenT.et: Päike paistab, aga olen üleni märg…

maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisAfterBa.label: FirebreatherOtisAfterBattleText
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisAfterBa.en: When it rains, it's hard to get ignition…
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherOtisAfterBa.et: Kui sajab, on raske süüdet saada…

maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenSeenText.label: YoungsterWarrenSeenText
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenSeenText.en: Hmmm… I don't know what to do…
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenSeenText.et: Hmmm… Ma ei tea, mida teha…

maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenAfterBat.label: YoungsterWarrenAfterBattleText
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenAfterBat.en:
You looked strong.
I was afraid to take you on…
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterWarrenAfterBat.et:
Sa nägid tugev välja.
Kartsin sinuga võistelda…

maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterJimmySeenText.label: YoungsterJimmySeenText
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterJimmySeenText.en: I can run like the wind!

maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterJimmyAfterBatt.label: YoungsterJimmyAfterBattleText
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterJimmyAfterBatt.en:
I wear shorts the whole year round.
That's my fashion policy.
maps/Route3.asm::YoungsterJimmyAfterBatt.et:
Kannan lühikesi pükse aasta läbi.
See on mu moepõhimõte.

maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherBurtSeenTex.label: FirebreatherBurtSeenText
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherBurtSeenTex.en: Step right up and take a look!

maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherBurtAfterBa.label: FirebreatherBurtAfterBattleText
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherBurtAfterBa.en:
The greatest firebreather in KANTO, that's me.
But not the best trainer…
maps/Route3.asm::FirebreatherBurtAfterBa.et:
KANTO suurim tulepurskaja, see olen mina.
Aga mitte parim treener…

maps/Route3.asm::Route3MtMoonSquareSignT.label: Route3MtMoonSquareSignText
maps/Route3.asm::Route3MtMoonSquareSignT.en:
MT.MOON SQUARE
Just go up the stairs.
maps/Route3.asm::Route3MtMoonSquareSignT.et:
MT.MOON SQUARE
Mine lihtsalt trepist üles.

maps/Route30.asm::Text_ThisIsABigBattle.label: Text_ThisIsABigBattle
maps/Route30.asm::Text_ThisIsABigBattle.en: What? This is a big battle! Leave me alone!
maps/Route30.asm::Text_ThisIsABigBattle.et: Mida? See on tähtis lahing! Jäta mind rahule!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1SeenText.label: YoungsterJoey1SeenText
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1SeenText.en:
I just lost, so I'm trying to find more #MON.
Wait! You look weak! Come on, let's battle!
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1SeenText.et:
Kaotasin just, seega otsin veel #MONe.
Oota! Sa näed nõrk välja! Tule, võitleme!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1BeatenTe.label: YoungsterJoey1BeatenText
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1BeatenTe.en: Ack! I lost again! Doggone it!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1AfterTex.label: YoungsterJoey1AfterText
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1AfterTex.en:
Do I have to have more #MON in
order to battle better?
No! I'm sticking with this one no matter what!
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoey1AfterTex.et:
Kas pean paremini võitlemiseks
hankima rohkem #MONe?
Ei! Jään selle ühe juurde, mis ka ei juhtuks!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeySeenText.label: YoungsterMikeySeenText
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeySeenText.en:
You're a #MON trainer, right?
Then you have to battle!
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeySeenText.et:
Sa oled #MONi treener, eks?
Siis pead võitlema!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeyAfterTex.label: YoungsterMikeyAfterText
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeyAfterTex.en:
Becoming a good trainer is really tough.
I'm going to battle other people to get better.
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterMikeyAfterTex.et:
Heaks treeneriks saada on tõesti raske.
Lähen teistega võitlema, et paremaks saada.

maps/Route30.asm::BugCatcherDonSeenText.label: BugCatcherDonSeenText
maps/Route30.asm::BugCatcherDonSeenText.en: Instead of a bug #MON, I found a trainer!

maps/Route30.asm::BugCatcherDonAfterText.label: BugCatcherDonAfterText
maps/Route30.asm::BugCatcherDonAfterText.en:
I ran out of # BALLS while I was catching #MON.
I should've bought some more…
maps/Route30.asm::BugCatcherDonAfterText.et:
#MONe püüdes sai mul # PALLE otsa.
Oleks pidanud rohkem ostma…

maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_D.label: Route30YoungsterText_DirectionsToMrPokemonsHouse
maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_D.en: MR.#MON's house? It's a bit farther ahead.
maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_D.et: MR.#MONi maja? See on veidi eespool.

maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_E.label: Route30YoungsterText_EveryoneIsBattling
maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_E.en: Everyone's having fun battling! You should too!
maps/Route30.asm::Route30YoungsterText_E.et: Kõigil on võideldes lõbus! Sina ka peaksid!

maps/Route30.asm::Route30CooltrainerFTex.label: Route30CooltrainerFText
maps/Route30.asm::Route30CooltrainerFTex.en:
I'm not a trainer.
But if you look one in the eyes, prepare to battle.
maps/Route30.asm::Route30CooltrainerFTex.et:
Ma pole treener.
Aga kui vaatad kellelegi silma, valmistu lahinguks.

maps/Route30.asm::Route30TrainerTipsText.label: Route30TrainerTipsText
maps/Route30.asm::Route30TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
No stealing other people's #MON!
# BALLS are to be thrown only at wild #MON!
maps/Route30.asm::Route30TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NIPID
Ära varasta teiste #MONe!
# PALLE tohib visata ainult metsikutele #MONidele!

maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoeyText_Give.label: YoungsterJoeyText_GiveHPUpAfterBattle
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoeyText_Give.en:
I lost again… Gee, you're tough!
Oh yeah, I almost forgot that I had to give you this.
Use it to get even tougher, OK?
I'm going to get tougher too.
maps/Route30.asm::YoungsterJoeyText_Give.et:
Kaotasin jälle… Oi, sa oled kõva!
Ahjaa, unustasin peaaegu, et pean sulle selle andma.
Kasuta seda, et veelgi kõvemaks saada, eks?
Ka mina lähen kõvemaks.

maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.label: Route30BerrySpeechHouseMonEatBerriesText
maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.en:
You know, #MON eat BERRIES.
Well, my #MON got healthier by eating a BERRY.
Here. I'll share one with you!
maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.et:
Tead, #MONid söövad MARJU.
Minu #MON sai MARJA süües tervemaks.
Säh. Jagan sulle ühe!

maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.label: Route30BerrySpeechHouseCheckTreesText
maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.en: Check trees for BERRIES. They just drop right off.
maps/Route30BerryHouse.asm::Route30Berry.et: Otsi puudelt MARJU. Need lihtsalt kukuvad alla.

maps/Route31.asm::Route31CooltrainerMTex.label: Route31CooltrainerMText
maps/Route31.asm::Route31CooltrainerMTex.en:
DARK CAVE…
If #MON could light it up, I'd explore it.
maps/Route31.asm::Route31CooltrainerMTex.et:
DARK CAVE…
Kui #MON suudaks selle valgustada, uuriksin seda.

maps/Route31.asm::BugCatcherWade1SeenTex.label: BugCatcherWade1SeenText
maps/Route31.asm::BugCatcherWade1SeenTex.en: I caught a bunch of #MON. Let me battle with you!

maps/Route31.asm::BugCatcherWade1AfterTe.label: BugCatcherWade1AfterText
maps/Route31.asm::BugCatcherWade1AfterTe.en:
You can catch #MON even if
you have six with you.
If you catch one, it'll go to your BOX automatically.
maps/Route31.asm::BugCatcherWade1AfterTe.et:
#MONe saad püüda ka siis,
kui sul on kuus kaasas.
Püütu läheb automaatselt su BOXi.

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyMan.label: Text_Route31SleepyMan
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyMan.en:
… Hnuurg… Huh?
I walked too far today looking for #MON.
My feet hurt and I'm sleepy…
If I were a wild #MON, I'd be easy to catch…
…Zzzz…
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyMan.et:
…Nurr… Ah?
Kõndisin täna #MONe otsides liiga kaugele.
Jalad valutavad ja olen unine…
Kui oleksin metsik #MON, oleks mind lihtne püüda…
…Zzzz…

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyManG.label: Text_Route31SleepyManGotMail
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyManG.en:
…Zzzz… Huh?
What's that? You have MAIL for me?
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31SleepyManG.et:
…Zzzz… Ah?
Mis see on? Sul on mulle MAIL?

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31HandOverMa.label: Text_Route31HandOverMailMon
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31HandOverMa.en: <PLAYER> handed over the #MON holding the MAIL.

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31ReadingMai.label: Text_Route31ReadingMail
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31ReadingMai.en:
Let's see…
…DARK CAVE leads to another road…
That's good to know.
Thanks for bringing this to me.
My friend's a good guy, and you're swell too!
I'd like to do something good in return too!
I know! I want you to have this!
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31ReadingMai.et:
Vaatame…
…DARK CAVE viib teisele teele…
Seda on hea teada.
Aitäh, et selle mulle tõid.
Mu sõber on tore ja sina samuti!
Tahaksin vastu ka midagi head teha!
Tead mida! Võta see endale!

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31DescribeNi.label: Text_Route31DescribeNightmare
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31DescribeNi.en:
TM50 is NIGHTMARE.
It's a wicked move that steadily cuts
the HP of a sleeping enemy.
Ooooh… That's scary…
I don't want to have bad dreams.
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31DescribeNi.et:
TM50 on NIGHTMARE.
See on õel rünnak, mis järk-järgult
vähendab magava vaenlase HPd.
Ohhh… see on hirmus…
Ma ei taha halbu unenägusid näha.

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31MissingMai.label: Text_Route31MissingMail
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31MissingMai.en:
Why is this #MON so special?
It doesn't have any MAIL.
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31MissingMai.et:
Miks see #MON nii eriline on?
Sellel pole mingit MAILi.

maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31CantTakeLa.label: Text_Route31CantTakeLastMon
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31CantTakeLa.en:
If I take that #MON from you,
what are you going to use in battle?
maps/Route31.asm::Text_Route31CantTakeLa.et:
Kui võtan sinult selle #MONi,
mida sa siis lahingus kasutad?

maps/Route31.asm::Route31YoungsterText.label: Route31YoungsterText
maps/Route31.asm::Route31YoungsterText.en:
I found a good #MON in DARK CAVE.
I'm going to raise it to take on FALKNER.
He's the leader of VIOLET CITY's GYM.
maps/Route31.asm::Route31YoungsterText.et:
Leidsin DARK CAVEst hea #MONi.
Kasvatan ta üles, et FALKNERI vastu astuda.
Ta on VIOLET CITY SAALI juht.

maps/Route31VioletGate.asm::Route31Viole.label: Route31VioletGateOfficerText
maps/Route31VioletGate.asm::Route31Viole.en: Hi there! Did you visit SPROUT TOWER?

maps/Route31VioletGate.asm::Route31Viole.label: Route31VioletGateCooltrainerFText
maps/Route31VioletGate.asm::Route31Viole.en: I came too far out. I'd better phone home!
maps/Route31VioletGate.asm::Route31Viole.et: Läksin liiga kaugele. Parem helistan koju!

maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_AideIsWaiting
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.en:
<PLAYER>, right? Some guy wearing
glasses was looking for you.
See for yourself. He's waiting for
you at the #MON CENTER.
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.et:
<PLAYER>, eks? Üks prillidega
mees otsis sind.
Vaata ise. Ta ootab sind
#MON KESKUSES.

maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_UnusedSproutTower
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.en:
Have you gone to SPROUT TOWER?
If you ever visit VIOLET CITY,
they'll expect you to train there.
That's basic for trainers. Go to SPROUT TOWER!
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.et:
Kas oled käinud SPROUT TOWERIS?
Kui satud kunagi VIOLET CITYsse,
oodatakse, et seal treeniksid.
Treeneri aabits. Mine SPROUT TOWERISSE!

maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_VioletGym
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.en:
Have you gone to the #MON GYM?
You can test your #MON and yourself there.
It's a rite of passage for all trainers!
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.et:
Kas oled käinud #MON SAALIS?
Seal saad end ja oma #MONe proovile panna.
See on kõigi treenerite katsumus!

maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_HaveThisSeed
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.en:
You have some good #MON there.
It must be from the training you
gave them around VIOLET CITY.
The training at the GYM must have
been especially helpful.
As a souvenir of VIOLET CITY, take this.
It increases the power of grasstype moves.
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.et:
Sul on seal mõned head #MONid.
Küllap tänu treeningule, mille
neile VIOLET CITY kandis andsid.
SAALIS treenimine oli
vist eriti kasulik.
Võta see VIOLET CITY mälestuseks.
See võimendab rohu-tüüpi rünnakuid.

maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_ExperiencesShouldBeUseful
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.en:
Your experiences in VIOLET CITY
should be useful for your journey.
maps/Route32.asm::Route32CooltrainerMTex.et:
Sinu kogemused VIOLET CITYs
tulevad teekonnal kasuks.

maps/Route32.asm::Text_MillionDollarSlow.label: Text_MillionDollarSlowpokeTail
maps/Route32.asm::Text_MillionDollarSlow.en:
How would you like to have this
tasty, nutritious SLOWPOKETAIL?
For you right now, just ¥1,000,000!
You'll want this!
maps/Route32.asm::Text_MillionDollarSlow.et:
Kas ei tahaks endale seda
maitsvat, toitvat SLOWPOKETAILi?
Praegu sinu jaoks vaid ¥1 000 000!
Sa tahad seda kindlasti!

maps/Route32.asm::Text_ThoughtKidsWereLo.label: Text_ThoughtKidsWereLoaded
maps/Route32.asm::Text_ThoughtKidsWereLo.en: Tch! I thought kids these days were loaded…
maps/Route32.asm::Text_ThoughtKidsWereLo.et: Tsah! Arvasin, et tänapäeva lapsed on rikkad…

maps/Route32.asm::Text_RefusedToBuySlowp.label: Text_RefusedToBuySlowpokeTail
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RefusedToBuySlowp.en: You don't want it? Then scram. Shoo!
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RefusedToBuySlowp.et: Ei taha? Siis kao. Käi minema!

maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinSeenText.label: FisherJustinSeenText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinSeenText.en:
Whoa!
You made me lose that fish!
maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinSeenText.et:
Oih!
Sinu pärast läks see kala käest!

maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinAfterText.label: FisherJustinAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinAfterText.en:
Calm, collected… The essence of
fishing and #MON is the same.
maps/Route32.asm::FisherJustinAfterText.et:
Rahulik, keskendunud… Kalapüügi
ja #MONide olemus on sama.

maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalph1SeenText.label: FisherRalph1SeenText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalph1SeenText.en:
I'm really good at both fishing and #MON.
I'm not about to lose to any kid!
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalph1SeenText.et:
Olen osav nii kalapüügis kui #MONides.
Ma ei kavatse ühelegi lapsele kaotada!

maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalph1BeatenText.label: FisherRalph1BeatenText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalph1BeatenText.en: Tch! I tried to rush things…

maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphAfterText.label: FisherRalphAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphAfterText.en:
Fishing is a lifelong passion.
#MON are lifelong friends!
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphAfterText.et:
Kalapüük on eluaegne kirg.
#MONid on eluaegsed sõbrad!

maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphSwarmText.label: FisherRalphSwarmText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphSwarmText.en:
One, two, three… Muahahaha, what a
great haul! I'm done! Go ahead
and catch as many as you can, kid!
I keep catching the same #MON…
Maybe a battle will turn things around for me.
Nothing ever goes right for me now…
How come the guy next to me catches good #MON?
Heh, I'm on a roll today. How about a battle, kid?
Oof. I wasn't lucky that time.
You have to have a good ROD if you
want to catch good #MON.
maps/Route32.asm::FisherRalphSwarmText.et:
Üks, kaks, kolm… Muahahaa, milline
saak! Mina lõpetasin! Püüa aga
ise nii palju kui jõuad, laps!
Püüan aina sama #MONi…
Ehk lahing pöörab mu õnne.
Praegu ei lähe mul miski õnneks…
Miks mees mu kõrval püüab häid #MONe?
Hehee, täna vean. Kuidas oleks lahinguga, laps?
Ohh. Seekord ei vedanud.
Heade #MONide püüdmiseks on
vaja head ROD.

maps/Route32.asm::FisherHenryAfterText.label: FisherHenryAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::FisherHenryAfterText.en:
Freshly caught #MON are no
match for properly raised ones.
maps/Route32.asm::FisherHenryAfterText.et:
Värskelt püütud #MONid ei
võistle korralikult kasvatatutega.

maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertSeenTex.label: YoungsterAlbertSeenText
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertSeenTex.en:
I haven't seen you around before.
So you think you are pretty tough?
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertSeenTex.et:
Pole sind varem siin näinud.
Nii et arvad end päris kõva olevat?

maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertAfterTe.label: YoungsterAlbertAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertAfterTe.en:
I'm going to try to be the best with my favorites.
I'm not using the same tough #MON as everyone else.
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterAlbertAfterTe.et:
Püüan oma lemmikutega parimaks saada.
Ma ei kasuta samu kõvasid #MONe kui kõik teised.

maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonSeenTex.label: YoungsterGordonSeenText
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonSeenTex.en:
I found some good #MON in the grass!
I think they'll do it for me!
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonSeenTex.et:
Leidsin rohust mõned head #MONid!
Usun, et nendega saan hakkama!

maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonBeatenT.label: YoungsterGordonBeatenText
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonBeatenT.en: Darn. I thought I could win.

maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonAfterTe.label: YoungsterGordonAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::YoungsterGordonAfterTe.en: The grass is full of clingy things.

maps/Route32.asm::CamperRolandAfterText.label: CamperRolandAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::CamperRolandAfterText.en: If you don't want to battle, just avoid eye contact.
maps/Route32.asm::CamperRolandAfterText.et: Kui ei taha võidelda, väldi silmsidet.

maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1SeenText.label: PicnickerLiz1SeenText
maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1SeenText.en:
Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…
Pardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.
Oh, all right. But make it fast.
maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1SeenText.et:
Ahaa. Jah, ja tead…
Kuidas palun? Lahing? Ma räägin telefoniga.
Oh, olgu. Aga tee ruttu.

maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1BeatenTex.label: PicnickerLiz1BeatenText
maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1BeatenTex.en: Oh! I've got to relieve my anger!

maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1AfterText.label: PicnickerLiz1AfterText
maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1AfterText.en: I was having a nice chat too.
maps/Route32.asm::PicnickerLiz1AfterText.et: Mul oli nii tore vestlus pooleli.

maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterSeenTex.label: BirdKeeperPeterSeenText
maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterSeenTex.en:
That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY!
You beat FALKNER?
maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterSeenTex.et:
See MÄRK! See on VIOLET CITYst!
Sa alistasid FALKNERI?

maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterBeatenT.label: BirdKeeperPeterBeatenText
maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterBeatenT.en: I know what my weaknesses are.

maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterAfterTe.label: BirdKeeperPeterAfterText
maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterAfterTe.en:
I should train again at the GYM in VIOLET CITY.
The fishermen yelled at me for bugging them…
maps/Route32.asm::BirdKeeperPeterAfterTe.et:
Peaksin VIOLET CITY SAALIS uuesti treenima.
Kalurid karjusid mu peale, et neid tülitasin…

maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarIntro.label: Text_RoarIntro
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarIntro.en:
WROOOOAR! PEOPLE RUN WHEN I
ROAR! BUT YOU CAME LOOKING!
THAT PLEASES ME! NOW TAKE THIS!
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarIntro.et:
WROOOOAR! INIMESED PÕGENEVAD, KUI
MA MÖIRGAN! AGA SINA TULID KOHALE!
SEE MEELDIB MULLE! NÜÜD SAAD SELLE!

maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarOutro.label: Text_RoarOutro
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarOutro.en:
WROOOAR! IT'S ROAR!
EVEN #MON RUN FROM A GOOD ROAR!
maps/Route32.asm::Text_RoarOutro.et:
WROOOAR! SEE ON MÖIRE!
ISEGI #MONID PÕGENEVAD HEA MÖIRE EEST!

maps/Route32.asm::MeetFriedaText.label: MeetFriedaText
maps/Route32.asm::MeetFriedaText.en:
FRIEDA: Yahoo! It's Friday!
I'm FRIEDA of Friday!
Nice to meet you!
maps/Route32.asm::MeetFriedaText.et:
FRIEDA: Jipii! Käes on reede!
Olen FRIEDA reedest!
Meeldiv tutvuda!

maps/Route32.asm::FriedaGivesGiftText.label: FriedaGivesGiftText
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaGivesGiftText.en: Here's a POISON BARB for you!

maps/Route32.asm::FriedaGaveGiftText.label: FriedaGaveGiftText
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaGaveGiftText.en:
FRIEDA: Give it to a #MON that has poison-type moves.
Oh!
It's wicked!
You'll be shocked how good it makes poison moves!
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaGaveGiftText.et:
FRIEDA: Anna see mürgi-tüüpi rünnakutega #MONile.
Oh!
See on vägev!
Üllatud, kui võimsaks see mürgirünnakud teeb!

maps/Route32.asm::FriedaFridayText.label: FriedaFridayText
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaFridayText.en:
FRIEDA: Hiya! What day do you like?
I love Friday. No doubt about it!
Don't you think it's great too?
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaFridayText.et:
FRIEDA: Tervist! Mis päev sulle meeldib?
Mulle meeldib reede. Selles pole kahtlust!
Kas sinugi meelest pole see tore?

maps/Route32.asm::FriedaNotFridayText.label: FriedaNotFridayText
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaNotFridayText.en:
FRIEDA: Isn't it Friday today?
It's so boring when it's not!
maps/Route32.asm::FriedaNotFridayText.et:
FRIEDA: Kas täna pole reede?
Kui pole, on nii igav!

maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Question
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.en:
This is a great fishing spot.
You saw people fishing? How about you?
Would you like one of my RODS?
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.et:
See on suurepärane püügikoht.
Nägid inimesi kalastamas? Aga sina?
Kas sooviksid üht mu ROD?

maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Yes
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.en:
Heh, that's good to hear.
Now you're an angler too!
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.et:
Hehe, seda on hea kuulda.
Nüüd oled ka sina õngitseja!

maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_GiveOldRod
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.en:
Fishing is great!
If there's water, be it the sea or a
stream, try out your ROD.
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.et:
Kalapüük on tore!
Kus on vett — olgu meri või
oja — proovi oma ROD.

maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_After
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.en: Yo, kid. How are they biting?

maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.label: Route32Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.en:
What should I make my #MON hold?
Maybe an item that increases ATTACK power…
maps/Route32Pokecenter1F.asm::Route32Pok.et:
Mida peaksin oma #MONil hoida laskma?
Ehk ese, mis suurendab RÜNNAKU jõudu…

maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.en:
RUINS OF ALPH
A Look-and-Touch Tourist Site
Try the sliding stone panels!
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.et:
ALPHI VAREMED
Vaata-ja-katsu turismikoht
Proovi nihutatavaid kivipaneele!

maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGatePokefanMText
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.en:
You're studying the RUINS?
I see a scientist in the making.
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.et:
Sa uurid VAREMEID?
