Näen tulevast teadlast.

maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGateYoungsterText
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.en:
There are drawings on stone panels.
I tried moving them. I wonder what they are.
maps/Route32RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route32.et:
Kivipaneelidel on joonistused.
Proovisin neid liigutada. Huvitav, mis need on.

maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2SeenText.label: HikerAnthony2SeenText
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2SeenText.en:
I came through the tunnel, but I
still have plenty of energy left.
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2SeenText.et:
Tulin tunnelist läbi, aga
energiat on veel küllaga.

maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2BeatenTex.label: HikerAnthony2BeatenText
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2BeatenTex.en: Whoa! You've got more zip than me!
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2BeatenTex.et: Oih! Sul on minust rohkem hoogu!

maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2AfterText.label: HikerAnthony2AfterText
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2AfterText.en: We HIKERS are at our best in the mountains.
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthony2AfterText.et: Meie matkajad oleme mägedes kõige tugevamad.

maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthonyDunsparceT.label: HikerAnthonyDunsparceText
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthonyDunsparceT.en:
Hey, did you get a DUNSPARCE?
I caught one too.
Take a look at it in the light. It's got a funny face!
maps/Route33.asm::HikerAnthonyDunsparceT.et:
Hei, kas said DUNSPARCE?
Mina püüdsin ka ühe.
Vaata seda valguse käes. Naljakas nägu!

maps/Route33.asm::Route33LassText.label: Route33LassText
maps/Route33.asm::Route33LassText.en:
Pant, pant…
I finally got through that cave.
It was much bigger than I'd expected.
I got too tired to explore the whole
thing, so I came outside.
maps/Route33.asm::Route33LassText.et:
Puhh, puhh…
Sain lõpuks sellest koopast läbi.
See oli palju suurem kui arvasin.
Väsisin liiga ära, et kogu koobast
läbi uurida, nii et tulin välja.

maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelSeenTex.label: YoungsterSamuelSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelSeenTex.en: This is where I do my training!

maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelBeatenT.label: YoungsterSamuelBeatenText
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelBeatenT.en:
Beaten by a passing stranger!
Have you been to GOLDENROD CITY?
Weren't you amazed by how they've
changed the #MON CENTER?
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelBeatenT.et:
Sain mööduvalt võõralt lüüa!
Kas oled käinud GOLDENROD CITYs?
Kas ei üllatanud sind, kuidas nad
#MON KESKUST muutsid?

maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelAfterTe.label: YoungsterSamuelAfterText
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelAfterTe.en:
I'm going to train even harder.
After all, I'm trying to become a GYM LEADER.
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterSamuelAfterTe.et:
Treenin veel kõvemini.
Tahan ju saada SAALI JUHIKS.

maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterIanSeenText.label: YoungsterIanSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterIanSeenText.en: I'm the best in my class at #MON.

maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterIanAfterText.label: YoungsterIanAfterText
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterIanAfterText.en: I'm trying hard so I can be the star in my class.
maps/Route34.asm::YoungsterIanAfterText.et: Pingutan, et olla oma klassi täht.

maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1SeenText.label: CamperTodd1SeenText
maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1SeenText.en:
I'm confident in my ability to raise #MON.
Want to see?
maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1SeenText.et:
Olen kindel oma #MONide kasvatamise oskuses.
Tahad näha?

maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1BeatenText.label: CamperTodd1BeatenText
maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1BeatenText.en: Did I screw up my training?

maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1AfterText.label: CamperTodd1AfterText
maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1AfterText.en:
Maybe I should take one to a DAY-
CARE. Or maybe use some items…
maps/Route34.asm::CamperTodd1AfterText.et:
Ehk peaksin ühe viima
PÄEVAHOIDU. Või kasutama esemeid…

maps/Route34.asm::CamperToddSaleText.label: CamperToddSaleText
maps/Route34.asm::CamperToddSaleText.en:
Shopping under the sky!
It feels so nice up on a rooftop.
maps/Route34.asm::CamperToddSaleText.et:
Ostlemine lageda taeva all!
Katusel on nii mõnus.

maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1SeenText.label: PicnickerGina1SeenText
maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1SeenText.en:
Are you a trainer?
Let's have a practice battle.

maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1BeatenTe.label: PicnickerGina1BeatenText
maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1BeatenTe.en: Oh, no! I just can't win…
maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1BeatenTe.et: Oh ei! Ma lihtsalt ei suuda võita…

maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1AfterTex.label: PicnickerGina1AfterText
maps/Route34.asm::PicnickerGina1AfterTex.en: You're too strong to be a practice partner.

maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithSeenText.label: OfficerKeithSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithSeenText.en: Who goes there? What are you up to?
maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithSeenText.et: Kes seal käib? Mis sul plaanis on?

maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithAfterText.label: OfficerKeithAfterText
maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithAfterText.en:
Yep, I see nothing wrong today. You
be good and stay out of trouble.
maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithAfterText.et:
Jah, täna pole midagi valesti. Ole
tubli ja hoia pahandusest eemale.

maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithDaytimeTex.label: OfficerKeithDaytimeText
maps/Route34.asm::OfficerKeithDaytimeTex.en: I'm on patrol for suspicious individuals.

maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonSeenTex.label: PokefanmBrandonSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonSeenTex.en:
I just got my #MON back from DAY-CARE.
Let's see how much stronger it got!
maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonSeenTex.et:
Sain just #MONi PÄEVAHOIUST tagasi.
Vaatame, kui palju tugevamaks ta sai!

maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonBeatenT.label: PokefanmBrandonBeatenText
maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonBeatenT.en: Why does it end this way?

maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonAfterTe.label: PokefanmBrandonAfterText
maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonAfterTe.en:
My #MON knew moves I didn't know it had.
That confounded me to no end!
maps/Route34.asm::PokefanmBrandonAfterTe.et:
Mu #MON oskas rünnakuid, millest ma ei teadnudki.
See ajas mind täiesti segadusse!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneSeenT.label: CooltrainerfIreneSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneSeenT.et: IRENE: Kjaaah! Keegi leidis meid üles!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.label: CooltrainerfIreneAfterText1
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.en: IRENE: My sister KATE will get you for this!
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.et: IRENE: Mu õde KATE maksab sulle selle eest kätte!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.label: CooltrainerfIreneAfterText2
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.en:
IRENE: Isn't this beach great?
It's our secret little getaway!
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfIreneAfter.et:
IRENE: Kas see rand pole tore?
See on meie salajane peidupaik!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennSeenTe.label: CooltrainerfJennSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennSeenTe.en: JENN: You can't beat IRENE and go unpunished!
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennSeenTe.et: JENN: Sa ei võida IRENEt karistamatult!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennAfterT.label: CooltrainerfJennAfterText1
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennAfterT.en: JENN: Don't get cocky! My sister KATE is tough!
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennAfterT.et: JENN: Ära hõiska! Mu õde KATE on kõva!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennAfterT.label: CooltrainerfJennAfterText2
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfJennAfterT.en: JENN: Sunlight makes your body stronger.

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateSeenTe.label: CooltrainerfKateSeenText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateSeenTe.en: KATE: You sure were mean to my little sisters!
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateSeenTe.et: KATE: Sa olid mu väikeste õdede vastu õel!

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateBeaten.label: CooltrainerfKateBeatenText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateBeaten.en: KATE: No! I can't believe I lost.

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateOfferS.label: CooltrainerfKateOfferSoftSandText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateOfferS.en:
KATE: You're too strong. I didn't stand a chance.
Here. You deserve this.
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateOfferS.et:
KATE: Sa oled liiga tugev. Mul polnud lootustki.
Säh. Sa väärid seda.

maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateAfterT.label: CooltrainerfKateAfterText
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateAfterT.en:
KATE: I'm sorry we jumped you.
We never expected anyone to find us
here. You sure startled us.
maps/Route34.asm::CooltrainerfKateAfterT.et:
KATE: Vabandust, et sulle kallale tormasime.
Me ei osanud arvata, et keegi meid
siit leiab. Sa ehmatasid meid ära.

maps/Route34.asm::Route34SignText.label: Route34SignText
maps/Route34.asm::Route34SignText.en:
ROUTE 34
GOLDENROD CITY AZALEA TOWN
ILEX FOREST SOMEWHERE BETWEEN
maps/Route34.asm::Route34SignText.et:
ROUTE 34
GOLDENROD CITY AZALEA TOWN
ILEX FOREST KUSKIL VAHEL

maps/Route34.asm::Route34TrainerTipsText.label: Route34TrainerTipsText
maps/Route34.asm::Route34TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
BERRY trees grow new BERRIES every day.
Make a note of which trees bear which BERRIES.
maps/Route34.asm::Route34TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NIPID
MARJAPUUD kasvatavad iga päev uusi MARJU.
Pane tähele, mis puu mis MARJU kannab.

maps/Route34.asm::DayCareSignText.label: DayCareSignText
maps/Route34.asm::DayCareSignText.en:
DAY-CARE
LET US RAISE YOUR #MON FOR YOU!

maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacherText
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.en:
Oh, honey. You're making a #DEX?
It must be hard if #MON won't
appear. Try using this TM.
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.et:
Oh, kullake. Sa koostad #DEXi?
Küllap on raske, kui #MONe ei
ilmu. Proovi seda TM-i.

maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_GotSweetScent
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.en:
It's SWEET SCENT.
Use it wherever #MON appear.
#MON will be enticed by it.
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.et:
See on SWEET SCENT.
Kasuta seda seal, kus #MONe ilmub.
See meelitab #MONe ligi.

maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_ForestIsRestless
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.en:
Something's wrong in ILEX FOREST…
You should stay away right now.
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.et:
ILEX FORESTIS on midagi valesti…
Praegu tasub sinna mitte minna.

maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.label: Route34IlexForestGateLassText
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.en:
Did you see the shrine honoring the protector?
It watches over the FOREST from across time.
I think that it must be a grasstype #MON.
maps/Route34IlexForestGate.asm::Route34I.et:
Kas nägid kaitsja auks püstitatud pühamut?
See valvab metsa üle aegade.
Arvan, et see on rohu-tüüpi #MON.

maps/Route35.asm::CamperIvanSeenText.label: CamperIvanSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::CamperIvanSeenText.en:
I've been getting #MON data off
my radio. I think I'm good.
maps/Route35.asm::CamperIvanSeenText.et:
Olen saanud #MONi andmeid oma
raadiost. Arvan, et olen hea.

maps/Route35.asm::CamperIvanAfterBattleT.label: CamperIvanAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::CamperIvanAfterBattleT.en: Music on the radio changes the moods of wild #MON.

maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotSeenText.label: CamperElliotSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotSeenText.en: I'm gonna show my girlfriend I'm hot stuff!
maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotSeenText.et: Näitan tüdruksõbrale, et olen kõva mees!

maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotBeatenText.label: CamperElliotBeatenText
maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotBeatenText.en: I wish you would have lost for me…

maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotAfterBattl.label: CamperElliotAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::CamperElliotAfterBattl.en: I was humiliated in front of my girlfriend…

maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeSeenTex.label: PicnickerBrookeSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeSeenTex.en: My boyfriend's weak, so I can't rely on him.
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeSeenTex.et: Mu poiss-sõber on nõrk, ma ei saa tema peale loota.

maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeAfterBa.label: PicnickerBrookeAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeAfterBa.en: I can count on my #MON more than my boyfriend.
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerBrookeAfterBa.et: Oma #MONidele saan loota rohkem kui poiss-sõbrale.

maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerKimSeenText.label: PicnickerKimSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerKimSeenText.en: Are you going to the GYM? Me too!

maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerKimAfterBattl.label: PicnickerKimAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerKimAfterBattl.en: The GYM BADGES are pretty. I collect them.
maps/Route35.asm::PicnickerKimAfterBattl.et: SAALIMÄRGID on ilusad. Ma kogun neid.

maps/Route35.asm::BirdKeeperBryanSeenTex.label: BirdKeeperBryanSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::BirdKeeperBryanSeenTex.en: What kinds of BALLS do you use?

maps/Route35.asm::BirdKeeperBryanAfterBa.label: BirdKeeperBryanAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::BirdKeeperBryanAfterBa.en:
Some #MON flee right away.
Try catching them with KURT's FAST BALL.
Whenever I find a WHT APRICORN, I take it to KURT.
He turns it into a custom BALL.
maps/Route35.asm::BirdKeeperBryanAfterBa.et:
Mõned #MONid põgenevad kohe.
Püüa neid KURDI FAST BALLiga.
Iga WHT APRICORNi viin KURDILE.
Ta teeb sellest eri-PALLI.

maps/Route35.asm::JugglerIrwinAfterBattl.label: JugglerIrwinAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::JugglerIrwinAfterBattl.en:
I was going to dazzle you with my prize #MON.
But your prowess electrified me!
maps/Route35.asm::JugglerIrwinAfterBattl.et:
Kavatsesin sind oma auhinna-#MONiga pimestada.
Aga su osavus lõi mind pahviks!

maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieSeenTex.label: BugCatcherArnieSeenText
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieSeenTex.en: I'll go anywhere if bug #MON appear there.
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieSeenTex.et: Lähen kuhu tahes, kus putuk-#MONe leidub.

maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieBeatenT.label: BugCatcherArnieBeatenText
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieBeatenT.en: Huh? I shouldn't have lost that…

maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieAfterBa.label: BugCatcherArnieAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieAfterBa.en:
My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching
Contest at the NATIONAL PARK.
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieAfterBa.et:
Mu VENONAT võitis mulle putukapüügi-
võistluse RAHVUSPARGIS.

maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieYanmaTe.label: BugCatcherArnieYanmaText
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieYanmaTe.en:
Wow… Look at all those YANMA!
I'm so blown away, I can't move.
maps/Route35.asm::BugCatcherArnieYanmaTe.et:
Vau… Vaata kõiki neid YANMA!
Olen nii vaimustatud, et ei saa liikuda.

maps/Route35.asm::FirebreatherWaltBeaten.label: FirebreatherWaltBeatenText
maps/Route35.asm::FirebreatherWaltBeaten.en: Ow! I scorched the tip of my nose!

maps/Route35.asm::FirebreatherWaltAfterB.label: FirebreatherWaltAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::FirebreatherWaltAfterB.en: The #MON March on the radio lures wild #MON.

maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkAfterBattle.label: OfficerDirkAfterBattleText
maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkAfterBattle.en:
You know, nighttime is fun in its own ways.
But don't overdo it, OK?
maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkAfterBattle.et:
Tead, öö on omamoodi lõbus.
Aga ära liialda, eks?

maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkPrettyTough.label: OfficerDirkPrettyToughText
maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkPrettyTough.en:
Your #MON look pretty tough.
You could go anywhere safely.
maps/Route35.asm::OfficerDirkPrettyTough.et:
Su #MONid näevad päris kõvad välja.
Võid ohutult kuhu tahes minna.

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyAskTakeThisMonToMyFriendText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
Excuse me, kid! Can you do a guy a favor?
Can you take this #MON with MAIL to my friend?
He's on ROUTE 31.
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Vabandust, poiss! Kas teed mehele teene?
Kas viiksid selle MAILiga #MONi mu sõbrale?
Ta on ROUTE 31.

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyThanksText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
You will? Perfect! Thanks, kid!
My pal's a chubby guy who snoozes all the time.
You'll recognize him right away!
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Viid? Suurepärane! Aitäh, poiss!
Mu sõber on tüse mees, kes tukub kogu aeg.
Sa tunned ta kohe ära!

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyWeirdTreeBlockingRoadText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
You can read it, but don't lose it! ROUTE 31!
Oh, yeah. There was a weird tree blocking the road.
I wonder if it's been cleared?
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Saad seda lugeda, aga ära kaota! ROUTE 31!
Ah jaa. Teed sulges imelik puu.
Huvitav, kas see on eemaldatud?

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyCantCarryAnotherMonText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et: Sa ei saa veel üht #MONi kaasas kanda…

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandySomethingForYourTroubleText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
Thanks, kid! You made the delivery for me!
Here's something for your trouble!
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Aitäh, poiss! Toimetasid selle mulle kohale!
Siin on midagi su vaeva eest!

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyMyPalWasSnoozingRightText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en: My pal was snoozing, right? Heh, what'd I say?
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et: Mu sõber tukkus, eks? Heh, mis ma ütlesin?

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
A strange tree is blocking the road.
It wriggles around if you talk to it.
I heard it became wild when someone
watered it with a SQUIRTBOTTLE.
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Imelik puu sulgeb teed.
See vingerdab, kui sellega räägid.
Kuulsin, et see läks metsikuks, kui keegi
kastis seda SQUIRTBOTTLEga.

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText_FoughtSudowoodo
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en: I like the #MON Lullaby they play on the radio.
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et: Mulle meeldib #MON Hällilaul, mida raadios mängitakse.

maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.label: Route35GoldenrodGateFisherText
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.en:
I wonder how many kinds of #MON
there are in the world.
Three years ago, PROF.OAK said that
there were 150 different kinds.
maps/Route35GoldenrodGate.asm::Route35Go.et:
Huvitav, mitut liiki #MONe
maailmas on.
Kolm aastat tagasi ütles PROF.OAK,
et neid on 150 erinevat liiki.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToParticipateText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Today's {RAM}. That means the
Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
The rules are simple.
Using one of your #MON, catch a
bug #MON to be judged.
Would you like to give it a try?
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Täna on {RAM}. See tähendab, et
täna toimub putukapüügivõistlus.
Reeglid on lihtsad.
Püüa ühe oma #MONiga kinni
hinnatav putuk-#MON.
Kas soovid proovida?

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkBallsText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: Here are the PARK BALLS for the Contest.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ExplainsRulesText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
The person who gets the strongest bug #MON is the winner.
You have {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES} minutes.
If you run out of PARK BALLS, you're done.
You can keep the last #MON you catch as your own.
Go out and catch the strongest bug
#MON you can find!
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Võidab see, kes püüab tugevaima putuk-#MONi.
Sul on {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES} minutit.
Kui PARK BALLS otsa saab, oledki lõpetanud.
Viimase püütud #MONi saad endale jätta.
Mine ja püüa tugevaim putuk-#MON,
keda leiad!

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToUseFirstMonText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh…
You have more than one #MON.
You'll have to use {RAM}, the
first #MON in your party.
Is that OK with you?
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih…
Sul on rohkem kui üks #MON.
Pead kasutama {RAM}, oma seltskonna
esimest #MONi.
Kas sobib?

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldYourMonText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: Fine, we'll hold your other #MON while you compete.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGatePlayersMonLeftWithHelperText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: <PLAYER>'s #MON were left with the CONTEST HELPER.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ChooseMonAndComeBackText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Please choose the #MON to be used
in the Contest, then come see me.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Vali võistlusel kasutatav #MON
ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1TakePartInFutureText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: OK. We hope you'll take part in the future.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1FirstMonCantBattleText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… The first #MON
in your party can't battle.
Please switch it with the #MON
you want to use, then come see me.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Su seltskonna esimene
#MON ei saa võidelda.
Vaheta see #MONiga, keda
kasutada tahad, ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1MakeRoomText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… Both your party
and your PC BOX are full.
You have no room to put the bug #MON you catch.
Please make room in your party or
your PC BOX, then come see me.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Nii su seltskond
kui PC BOX on täis.
Püütud putuk-#MONi jaoks pole ruumi.
Tee ruumi seltskonnas või PC BOXis
ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1EggAsFirstMonText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… You have an EGG as
the first #MON in your party.
Please switch it with the #MON
you want to use, then come see me.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Su seltskonna esimene
on EGG.
Vaheta see #MONiga, keda
kasutada tahad, ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WantToFinishText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
You still have {RAM} minute(s) left.
Do you want to finish now?
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Sul on veel {RAM} minutit.
Kas soovid nüüd lõpetada?

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WaitAtNorthGateText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
OK. Please wait at the North Gate for
the announcement of the winners.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1OkGoFinishText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: OK. Please get back outside and finish up.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et: Olgu. Mine õue tagasi ja lõpeta.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ContestIsOverText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Today's Contest is over. We hope you
will participate in the future.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Tänane võistlus on läbi. Loodame,
et osaled tulevikus.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WeHoldContestsText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
We hold Contests regularly in the
PARK. You should give it a shot.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Korraldame RAHVUSPARGIS regulaarselt
võistlusi. Proovi kindlasti.

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route35NationalParkGateYoungsterText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: When is the next Bug-Catching Contest going to be?

maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestExplanationText
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
The Bug-Catching Contest is held on
Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Not only do you earn a prize just
for participating, you also get to
keep the bug #MON you may
have at the end of the contest.
maps/Route35NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
Putukapüügivõistlus toimub
teisipäeval, neljapäeval ja laupäeval.
Osalemise eest saad mitte ainult
auhinna, vaid võid ka
endale jätta putuk-#MONi, kelle
võistluse lõpus omad.

maps/Route36.asm::UseSquirtbottleText.label: UseSquirtbottleText
maps/Route36.asm::UseSquirtbottleText.en: It's a weird tree. Use SQUIRTBOTTLE?

maps/Route36.asm::SudowoodoAttackedText.label: SudowoodoAttackedText
maps/Route36.asm::SudowoodoAttackedText.en:
The weird tree doesn't like the SQUIRTBOTTLE!
The weird tree attacked!
maps/Route36.asm::SudowoodoAttackedText.et:
Imelikule puule ei meeldi SQUIRTBOTTLE!
Imelik puu ründas!

maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText1.label: FloriaText1
maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText1.en:
I'm the FLOWER SHOP's FLORIA!
Listen, listen!
When I sprinkled water on that
wiggly tree, it jumped right up!
It just has to be a #MON.
I bet it would be shocked out of its
disguise if you soaked it!
I know! I'll tell my sis and borrow her water bottle!
maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText1.et:
Olen LILLEPOE FLORIA!
Kuula, kuula!
Kui ma sellele väänlevale puule
vett puistasin, hüppas ta püsti!
See peab olema #MON.
Vean kihla, et kui teda kastad,
hüppab ta oma maskeeringust välja!
Tean! Räägin õele ja laenan ta veepudeli!

maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText2.label: FloriaText2
maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText2.en:
When I told my sis about the jiggly
tree, she said it's dangerous.
If I beat WHITNEY, I wonder if she'll
lend me her water bottle…
maps/Route36.asm::FloriaText2.et:
Kui rääkisin õele sellest väänlevast
puust, ütles ta, et see on ohtlik.
Kui alistan WHITNEY, ehk siis
laenab ta mulle oma veepudeli…

maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText1.label: RockSmashGuyText1
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText1.en:
Wa-hey!
I was going to snap that tree
with my straightarm punch.
But I couldn't! I'm a failure!
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText1.et:
Vau-hei!
Kavatsesin selle puu
sirge käelöögiga murda.
Aga ei suutnud! Olen luuser!

maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText2.label: RockSmashGuyText2
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText2.en:
Did you clear that wretched tree?
I'm impressed! I want you to have this.
<PLAYER> received TM08.
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText2.et:
Kas said selle armetu puu kõrvale?
Muljetavaldav! Tahan sulle selle anda.
<PLAYER> sai TM08.

maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText3.label: RockSmashGuyText3
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText3.en:
That happens to be ROCK SMASH.
You can shatter rocks with just a
single well-aimed smack.
If any rocks are in your way, just smash 'em up!
An odd tree is blocking the way to GOLDENROD CITY.
I wanted to go see the huge #MON
CENTER they just opened…
maps/Route36.asm::RockSmashGuyText3.et:
See on ROCK SMASH.
Kive saab purustada ühe
täpselt sihitud löögiga.
Kui kivid on ees, löö need puruks!
Imelik puu tõkestab tee GOLDENROD CITYsse.
Tahtsin näha nende hiiglaslikku
uut #MON KESKUST…

maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText.label: Route36LassText
maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText.en:
An odd tree is blocking the way to GOLDENROD CITY.
It's preventing me from shopping.
Something should be done about it.
maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText.et:
Imelik puu tõkestab tee GOLDENROD CITYsse.
See takistab mind ostlemast.
Sellega tuleks midagi ette võtta.

maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText_Cleare.label: Route36LassText_ClearedSudowoodo
maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText_Cleare.en:
That odd tree disappeared without a trace.
Oh! That tree was really a #MON?
maps/Route36.asm::Route36LassText_Cleare.et:
See imelik puu kadus jäljetult.
Oh! Kas see puu oli tõesti #MON?

maps/Route36.asm::PsychicMarkSeenText.label: PsychicMarkSeenText
maps/Route36.asm::PsychicMarkSeenText.en: I'm going to read your thoughts!

maps/Route36.asm::PsychicMarkAfterBattle.label: PsychicMarkAfterBattleText
maps/Route36.asm::PsychicMarkAfterBattle.en:
I'd be strong if only I could tell
what my opponent was thinking.
maps/Route36.asm::PsychicMarkAfterBattle.et:
Oleksin tugev, kui vaid teaksin,
mida mu vastane mõtleb.

maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlan1SeenText.label: SchoolboyAlan1SeenText
maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlan1SeenText.en: Thanks to my studies, I'm ready for any #MON!
maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlan1SeenText.et: Tänu õpingutele olen valmis iga #MONi vastu!

maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlanBooksText.label: SchoolboyAlanBooksText
maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlanBooksText.en:
Darn. I study five hours a day too.
There's more to learning than just reading books.
maps/Route36.asm::SchoolboyAlanBooksText.et:
Pagan. Õpin ka viis tundi päevas.
Õppimine on enamat kui raamatute lugemine.

maps/Route36.asm::MeetArthurText.label: MeetArthurText
maps/Route36.asm::MeetArthurText.en:
ARTHUR: Who are you?
I'm ARTHUR of Thursday.
maps/Route36.asm::MeetArthurText.et:
ARTHUR: Kes sina oled?
Olen ARTHUR neljapäevast.

maps/Route36.asm::ArthurGaveGiftText.label: ArthurGaveGiftText
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurGaveGiftText.en:
ARTHUR: A #MON that uses rock-
type moves should hold on to that.
It pumps up rocktype attacks.
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurGaveGiftText.et:
ARTHUR: Kivi-tüüpi rünnakutega
#MON võiks seda hoida.
See võimendab kivi-tüüpi rünnakuid.

maps/Route36.asm::ArthurThursdayText.label: ArthurThursdayText
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurThursdayText.en:
ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR of Thursday. I'm
the second son out of seven children.
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurThursdayText.et:
ARTHUR: Olen ARTHUR neljapäevast. Olen
seitsmest lapsest teine poeg.

maps/Route36.asm::ArthurNotThursdayText.label: ArthurNotThursdayText
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurNotThursdayText.en: ARTHUR: Today's not Thursday. How disappointing.
maps/Route36.asm::ArthurNotThursdayText.et: ARTHUR: Täna pole neljapäev. Kui kahju.

maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips1Tex.label: Route36TrainerTips1Text
maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips1Tex.en:
TRAINER TIPS
#MON stats vary--even within the same species.
Their stats may be similar at first.
However, differences will become
pronounced as the #MON grow.
maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips1Tex.et:
TREENERI NIPID
#MONide näitajad erinevad – isegi samas liigis.
Alguses võivad näitajad sarnased olla.
Kuid #MONi kasvades muutuvad
erinevused selgemaks.

maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips2Tex.label: Route36TrainerTips2Text
maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips2Tex.en:
TRAINER TIPS
Use DIG to return to the entrance of any place.
It is convenient for exploring
caves and other landmarks.
maps/Route36.asm::Route36TrainerTips2Tex.et:
TREENERI NIPID
Kasuta DIG, et naasta koha sissepääsu.
See on mugav koobaste ja
muude paikade uurimiseks.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToParticipateText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Today's {RAM}. That means the
Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
The rules are simple.
Using one of your #MON, catch a
bug #MON to be judged.
Would you like to give it a try?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Täna on {RAM}. See tähendab, et
täna toimub putukapüügivõistlus.
Reeglid on lihtsad.
Püüa ühe oma #MONiga kinni
hinnatav putuk-#MON.
Kas soovid proovida?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkBallsText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: Here are the PARK BALLS for the Contest.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ExplainsRulesText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
The person who gets the strongest bug #MON is the winner.
You have {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES} minutes.
If you run out of PARK BALLS, you're done.
You can keep the last #MON you catch as your own.
Go out and catch the strongest bug
#MON you can find!
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Võidab see, kes püüab tugevaima putuk-#MONi.
Sul on {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES} minutit.
Kui PARK BALLS otsa saab, oledki lõpetanud.
Viimase püütud #MONi saad endale jätta.
Mine ja püüa tugevaim putuk-#MON,
keda leiad!

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToUseFirstMonText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh…
You have more than one #MON.
You'll have to use {RAM}, the
first #MON in your party.
Is that OK with you?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih…
Sul on rohkem kui üks #MON.
Pead kasutama {RAM}, oma seltskonna
esimest #MONi.
Kas sobib?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldYourMonText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: Fine, we'll hold your other #MON while you compete.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGatePlayersMonLeftWithHelperText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: <PLAYER>'s #MON were left with the CONTEST HELPER.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ChooseMonAndComeBackText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Please choose the #MON to be used
in the Contest, then come see me.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Vali võistlusel kasutatav #MON
ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1TakePartInFutureText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: OK. We hope you'll take part in the future.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1FirstMonCantBattleText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… The first #MON
in your party can't battle.
Please switch it with the #MON
you want to use, then come see me.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Su seltskonna esimene
#MON ei saa võidelda.
Vaheta see #MONiga, keda
kasutada tahad, ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1MakeRoomText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… Both your party
and your PC BOX are full.
You have no room to put the bug #MON you catch.
Please make room in your party or
your PC BOX, then come see me.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Nii su seltskond
kui PC BOX on täis.
Püütud putuk-#MONi jaoks pole ruumi.
Tee ruumi seltskonnas või PC BOXis
ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1EggAsFirstMonText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… You have an EGG as
the first #MON in your party.
Please switch it with the #MON
you want to use, then come see me.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Su seltskonna esimene
on EGG.
Vaheta see #MONiga, keda
kasutada tahad, ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WantToFinishText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
You still have {RAM} minute(s) left.
Do you want to finish now?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Sul on veel {RAM} minutit.
Kas soovid nüüd lõpetada?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WaitHereForAnnouncementText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
OK. Please wait here for the
announcement of the winners.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1OkGoFinishText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: OK. Please go back outside and finish up.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et: Olgu. Mine õue tagasi ja lõpeta.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ContestIsOverText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Today's Contest is over. We hope you
will participate in the future.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Tänane võistlus on läbi. Loodame,
et osaled tulevikus.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1SomeMonOnlySeenInParkText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en: Some #MON can only be seen in the PARK.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant1BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: DON: Wow, you beat me. You're pretty good.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: DON: Vau, sa võitsid mind. Oled päris hea.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant1BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
DON: Luck plays a big part in this.
You never know what #MON will appear.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
DON: Õnnel on siin suur roll.
Kunagi ei tea, milline #MON ilmub.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant2BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: ED: I envy you. I just couldn't do it this time.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: ED: Kadestan sind. Seekord ei õnnestunud.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant2BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: ED: Maybe you win with big #MON?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: ED: Ehk võidad suure #MONiga?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant3BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: NICK: Well done! I'm going to raise my #MON better.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: NICK: Tubli! Kasvatan oma #MONe paremini.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant3BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
NICK: Maybe you get a higher score
for a #MON of an unusual color.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
NICK: Ehk saab kõrgema hinde
ebatavalist värvi #MONi eest.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant4BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: WILLIAM: You're the winner? What did you catch?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: WILLIAM: Sina võitsid? Mida püüdsid?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant4BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
WILLIAM: Well, I'm satisfied because
I caught a #MON that I wanted.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
WILLIAM: No mina olen rahul, sest
püüdsin #MONi, keda tahtsin.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant5BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: BENNY: Congrats! You have earned my respect!
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: BENNY: Palju õnne! Oled mu lugupidamise võitnud!

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant5BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: BENNY: I caught a SCYTHER before, but I didn't win.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: BENNY: Püüdsin varem SCYTHER, aga ei võitnud.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant6BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: BARRY: That #MON you caught… it's awesome!
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: BARRY: See #MON, kelle püüdsid… on äge!

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant6BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
BARRY: It's easier to win if you get
a high-level bug #MON.
But I think they also consider some other points.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
BARRY: Kergem on võita, kui saad
kõrge tasemega putuk-#MONi.
Aga vist arvestatakse ka muid asju.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant7BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
CINDY: You won? That's great!
Do you feel like looking for bug #MON with me?
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
CINDY: Sa võitsid? Vahva!
Kas otsiksid koos minuga putuk-#MONe?

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant7BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: CINDY: I really love bug #MON!
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: CINDY: Ma armastan putuk-#MONe!

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant8BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: JOSH: I… I can't believe I lost at bug-catching…
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: JOSH: Ma… uskumatu, et putukapüügis kaotasin…

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant8BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: JOSH: I heard that somebody won with a CATERPIE!
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: JOSH: Kuulsin, et keegi võitis CATERPIEga!

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant9BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: SAMUEL: Next time, I'm going to win.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: SAMUEL: Järgmine kord võidan mina.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant9BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en: SAMUEL: Darn. I thought I would score higher…
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et: SAMUEL: Pagan. Arvasin, et saan kõrgema hinde…

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant10BText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
KIPP: Could you give me some tips?
I want to study your style.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
KIPP: Kas annaksid mulle näpunäiteid?
Tahan su stiili õppida.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.label: BugCatchingContestant10BStillCompetingText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.en:
KIPP: I study a lot, but that's
not good enough to win.
I hear there's a #MON that looks just like a tree.
You can reveal its identity using a SILPHSCOPE 2.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::BugCat.et:
KIPP: Õpin palju, aga sellest
ei piisa võitmiseks.
Kuuldavasti on #MON, kes näeb välja nagu puu.
Ta paljastab SILPHSCOPE 2 abil.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Unused.label: UnusedBugCatchingContestExplanationText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Unused.en:
The Bug-Catching Contest is held on
Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Not only do you earn a prize just
for participating, you also get to
keep the bug #MON you may
have at the end of the contest.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Unused.et:
Putukapüügivõistlus toimub
teisipäeval, neljapäeval ja laupäeval.
Osalemise eest saad mitte ainult
auhinna, vaid võid ka
endale jätta putuk-#MONi, kelle
võistluse lõpus omad.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldPrizeText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
Uh-oh… Your PACK is full.
We'll hold on to your prize, but only for today.
Please make room, then come see me.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
Oih… Su PACK on täis.
Hoiame su auhinda, aga vaid täna.
Tee ruumi ja tule siis minu juurde.

maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1HeresThePrizeText
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.en:
<PLAYER>?
Here's the prize we were holding for you.
maps/Route36NationalParkGate.asm::Route3.et:
<PLAYER>?
Siin on auhind, mida sulle hoidsime.

maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.label: Route36RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText
maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.en: Don't you wonder who'd make something like this? And why?
maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.et: Kas ei mõtle, kes ja miks midagi sellist teeks?

maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.label: Route36RuinsOfAlphGateGrampsText
maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.en:
Did you see that strange tree in the road?
That may explain why fewer people
are visiting the RUINS OF ALPH.
maps/Route36RuinsOfAlphGate.asm::Route36.et:
Kas nägid teel seda imelikku puud?
See võib seletada, miks ALPHI
VAREMEID vähem külastatakse.

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1SeenTe.label: TwinsAnnandanne1SeenText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1SeenTe.en: ANN: ANNE and I are in this together!
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1SeenTe.et: ANN: ANNE ja mina oleme koos!

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1Beaten.label: TwinsAnnandanne1BeatenText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1Beaten.en: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too strong.
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1Beaten.et: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… veidi liiga tugev.

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1AfterB.label: TwinsAnnandanne1AfterBattleText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1AfterB.en:
ANN: I can tell what my sister and
my #MON are thinking.
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne1AfterB.et:
ANN: Tean, mida mu õde ja
mu #MON mõtlevad.

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2SeenTe.label: TwinsAnnandanne2SeenText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2SeenTe.en: ANNE: ANN and I are in this together!
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2SeenTe.et: ANNE: ANN ja mina oleme koos!

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2Beaten.label: TwinsAnnandanne2BeatenText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2Beaten.en: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too strong.
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2Beaten.et: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… veidi liiga tugev.

maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2AfterB.label: TwinsAnnandanne2AfterBattleText
maps/Route37.asm::TwinsAnnandanne2AfterB.en: ANNE: We share the same feelings as our #MON.

maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregSeenText.label: PsychicGregSeenText
maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregSeenText.en:
#MON can't do a thing if they are asleep.
I'll show you how scary that is!
maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregSeenText.et:
Magav #MON ei saa midagi teha.
Näitan, kui hirmus see on!

maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregAfterBattle.label: PsychicGregAfterBattleText
maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregAfterBattle.en: Putting #MON to sleep or paralyzing them are good battle techniques.
maps/Route37.asm::PsychicGregAfterBattle.et: #MONi uinutamine või halvamine on head võtted.

maps/Route37.asm::MeetSunnyText.label: MeetSunnyText
maps/Route37.asm::MeetSunnyText.en:
SUNNY: Hi!
I'm SUNNY of Sunday, meaning it's Sunday today!
maps/Route37.asm::MeetSunnyText.et:
SUNNY: Tere!
Olen SUNNY pühapäevast — täna ongi pühapäev!

maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText1.label: SunnyGivesGiftText1
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText1.en: I was told to give you this if I saw you!
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText1.et: Mul kästi see sulle anda, kui sind näen!

maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText2.label: SunnyGivesGiftText2
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText2.en: I was told to give you this if I saw you!
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGivesGiftText2.et: Mul kästi see sulle anda, kui sind näen!

maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGaveGiftText.label: SunnyGaveGiftText
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGaveGiftText.en:
SUNNY: That thing…
Um…
… What was it now…
…
Oh! I remember now!
A #MON that knows electric
moves should hold it.
My sis MONICA said it powers up electric moves!
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyGaveGiftText.et:
SUNNY: See asi…
Ee…
… Mis see nüüd oligi…
…
Oh! Nüüd meenus!
Elektrirünnakuid oskav #MON
võiks seda hoida.
Mu õde MONICA ütles, et see võimendab elektrirünnakuid!

maps/Route37.asm::SunnySundayText.label: SunnySundayText
maps/Route37.asm::SunnySundayText.en:
SUNNY: My sisters and brothers are MONICA, TUSCANY, WESLEY, ARTHUR, FRIEDA and SANTOS.
They're all older than me!
maps/Route37.asm::SunnySundayText.et:
SUNNY: Mu õed-vennad on MONICA, TUSCANY, WESLEY, ARTHUR, FRIEDA ja SANTOS.
Nad kõik on minust vanemad!

maps/Route37.asm::SunnyNotSundayText.label: SunnyNotSundayText
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyNotSundayText.en: SUNNY: Isn't today Sunday? Um… I forgot!
maps/Route37.asm::SunnyNotSundayText.et: SUNNY: Kas täna pole pühapäev? Ee… unustasin!

maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobySeenText.label: BirdKeeperTobySeenText
maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobySeenText.en: Fly high into the sky, my beloved bird #MON!
maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobySeenText.et: Lenda kõrgele taevasse, mu armas linnu-#MON!

maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobyBeatenTe.label: BirdKeeperTobyBeatenText
maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobyBeatenTe.en: I feel like just flying away now.

maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobyAfterBat.label: BirdKeeperTobyAfterBattleText
maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobyAfterBat.en:
I plan to train in CIANWOOD CITY to
teach my #MON how to FLY.
maps/Route38.asm::BirdKeeperTobyAfterBat.et:
Plaanin CIANWOOD CITYs treenida,
et õpetada #MONile FLY.

maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChad1SeenText.label: SchoolboyChad1SeenText
maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChad1SeenText.en: Let me try something I learned today.

maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChad1BeatenTe.label: SchoolboyChad1BeatenText
maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChad1BeatenTe.en: I didn't study enough, I guess.

maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChadSoManyTes.label: SchoolboyChadSoManyTestsText
maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChadSoManyTes.en:
I have to take so many tests, I
don't have much time for #MON.
So when I do get to play, I really concentrate.
maps/Route38.asm::SchoolboyChadSoManyTes.et:
Pean tegema nii palju teste, et
#MONide jaoks jääb vähe aega.
Nii et mängides keskendun täiega.

maps/Route38.asm::LassDana1SeenText.label: LassDana1SeenText
maps/Route38.asm::LassDana1SeenText.en:
You seem to be good at #MON.
If you are, how about giving me some advice?
maps/Route38.asm::LassDana1SeenText.et:
Tundud #MONides osav olevat.
Kui oled, ehk annaksid nõu?

maps/Route38.asm::LassDana1BeatenText.label: LassDana1BeatenText
maps/Route38.asm::LassDana1BeatenText.en: I see. So you can battle that way.

maps/Route38.asm::LassDanaMoomooMilkText.label: LassDanaMoomooMilkText
maps/Route38.asm::LassDanaMoomooMilkText.en:
I know something good!
MOOMOO FARM's milk is famous for its flavor.
maps/Route38.asm::LassDanaMoomooMilkText.et:
Tean üht head asja!
MOOMOO FARMi piim on maitse poolest kuulus.

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieSeenText.label: BeautyValerieSeenText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieSeenText.en:
Hi! Aren't you a cute trainer!
May I see your #MON?
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieSeenText.et:
Tere! Küll oled armas treener!
Kas tohin su #MONe näha?

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieBeatenTex.label: BeautyValerieBeatenText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieBeatenTex.en: I'm glad I got to see your #MON!

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieAfterBatt.label: BeautyValerieAfterBattleText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyValerieAfterBatt.en: When I see #MON, it seems to soothe my nerves.

maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarrySeenText.label: SailorHarrySeenText
maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarrySeenText.en:
I've been overseas, so I know
about all sorts of #MON!
maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarrySeenText.et:
Olen välismaal käinud, seega tean
igasugu #MONidest!

maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarryAfterBattle.label: SailorHarryAfterBattleText
maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarryAfterBattle.en:
All kinds of people around the
world live happily with #MON.
maps/Route38.asm::SailorHarryAfterBattle.et:
Igasugused inimesed üle
maailma elavad õnnelikult #MONidega.

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaSeenText.label: BeautyOliviaSeenText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaSeenText.en: Don't you think my #MON and I are beautiful?
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaSeenText.et: Kas mina ja mu #MONid pole ilusad?

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaBeatenText.label: BeautyOliviaBeatenText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaBeatenText.en: We drink MOOMOO MILK every day.

maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaAfterBattl.label: BeautyOliviaAfterBattleText
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaAfterBattl.en:
MOOMOO MILK is good for beauty
and health, but inconveniently,
they only sell a bottle at a time.
maps/Route38.asm::BeautyOliviaAfterBattl.et:
MOOMOO MILK on hea nii ilule
kui tervisele, aga kahjuks
müüakse korraga vaid üks pudel.

maps/Route38.asm::Route38TrainerTipsText.label: Route38TrainerTipsText
maps/Route38.asm::Route38TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
If a #MON is trying to evolve, you can stop it.
Press the B Button during evolution.
That startles the #MON and stops its evolution.
maps/Route38.asm::Route38TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NIPID
Areneva #MONi saab peatada.
Vajuta arenemise ajal B-nuppu.
See ehmatab #MONi ja peatab arengu.

maps/Route38EcruteakGate.asm::Route38Ecr.label: Route38EcruteakGateOfficerText
maps/Route38EcruteakGate.asm::Route38Ecr.en:
Where did you say you're from?
NEW BARK TOWN?
PROF.ELM lives over there, right?
You've come a long way to get here.
maps/Route38EcruteakGate.asm::Route38Ecr.et:
Kust sa ütlesid, et pärit oled?
NEW BARK TOWN?
PROF.ELM elab seal, eks?
Oled kaugelt siia tulnud.

maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneSeenText.label: SailorEugeneSeenText
maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneSeenText.en:
I just got back to OLIVINE.
So how about a #MON battle?
maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneSeenText.et:
Jõudsin just OLIVINESSE tagasi.
Kuidas oleks #MON-lahinguga?

maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneAfterBattl.label: SailorEugeneAfterBattleText
maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneAfterBattl.en:
My #MON were caught and raised overseas.
They're my companions on those long voyages.
maps/Route39.asm::SailorEugeneAfterBattl.et:
Mu #MONid on püütud ja kasvatatud välismaal.
Nad on mu kaaslased pikkadel merereisidel.

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanmDerekSeenText.label: PokefanmDerekSeenText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanmDerekSeenText.en: This is a good time to brag about my PIKACHU!

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanmDerekBeatenTex.label: PokefanmDerekBeatenText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanmDerekBeatenTex.en: I had no time to show off PIKACHU…

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekText_NotB.label: PokefanMDerekText_NotBragging
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekText_NotB.en:
I'm not listening to your bragging!
We # FANS have a policy of not
listening to other people brag!
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekText_NotB.et:
Ma ei kuula su hooplemist!
Meie, # FÄNNID, ei kuula
teiste hooplemist!

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfRuthSeenText.label: PokefanfRuthSeenText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfRuthSeenText.en:
Such darling #MON.
Let's show our #MON together at the same time.

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfRuthAfterBattl.label: PokefanfRuthAfterBattleText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfRuthAfterBattl.en:
Do you know about baby #MON?
I bet they're just adorable!
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfRuthAfterBattl.et:
Kas tead beebi-#MONe?
Kindlasti on nad imearmsad!

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekPikachuIs.label: PokefanMDerekPikachuIsItText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekPikachuIs.en: PIKACHU is it! Don't you agree?
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanMDerekPikachuIs.et: PIKACHU on parim! Kas pole nõus?

maps/Route39.asm::PsychicNormanSeenText.label: PsychicNormanSeenText
maps/Route39.asm::PsychicNormanSeenText.en: Let me see what your #MON are capable of.

maps/Route39.asm::PsychicNormanAfterBatt.label: PsychicNormanAfterBattleText
maps/Route39.asm::PsychicNormanAfterBatt.en:
You know how #MON have different abilities?
People are like that too. Everyone has different potential.
maps/Route39.asm::PsychicNormanAfterBatt.et:
Tead ju, et #MONidel on eri võimed?
Ka inimestel. Igaühel on eri potentsiaal.

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeHopeItGet.label: PokefanfJaimeHopeItGetsDarkText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeHopeItGet.en: Ufufufu… I hope it gets dark soon.
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeHopeItGet.et: Ufufuu… loodan, et varsti läheb pimedaks.

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeSeenText.label: PokefanfJaimeSeenText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeSeenText.en:
You came at just the right time.
Let's battle.
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeSeenText.et:
Sa tulid just õigel ajal.
Võitleme.

maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeAfterBatt.label: PokefanfJaimeAfterBattleText
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeAfterBatt.en:
I met my MEOWTH at night, right here on ROUTE 39.
I'm not sure why, but it seems to
like it when I train here.
It seems to become friendlier by
training here than anywhere else.
maps/Route39.asm::PokefanfJaimeAfterBatt.et:
Kohtusin oma MEOWTHiga öösel, siinsamas ROUTE 39 peal.
Ei tea miks, aga talle tundub
meeldivat, kui siin treenin.
Siin treenides muutub ta
sõbralikumaks kui mujal.

maps/Route39.asm::MoomooFarmSignText.label: MoomooFarmSignText
maps/Route39.asm::MoomooFarmSignText.en:
MOOMOO FARM
Enjoy Our Fresh and Tasty Milk
maps/Route39.asm::MoomooFarmSignText.et:
MOOMOO FARM
Naudi meie värsket ja maitsvat piima

maps/Route39.asm::Route39TrainerTipsText.label: Route39TrainerTipsText
maps/Route39.asm::Route39TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
Use HEADBUTT on trees to shake #MON out.
Different kinds of #MON drop out of trees.
Use HEADBUTT on any tree you see!
maps/Route39.asm::Route39TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NIPID
Raputa HEADBUTT-iga puudest #MONe välja.
Puudest kukub eri #MONe.
Kasuta HEADBUTT-i igal puul!

maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnTwinMoo.label: Route39BarnTwinMoomooIsSickText
maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnTwinMoo.en:
MOOMOO is sick…
She needs lots of BERRIES.
maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnTwinMoo.et:
MOOMOO on haige…
Ta vajab palju BERRYsid.

maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnRefused.label: Route39BarnRefusedBerryText
maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnRefused.en:
<PLAYER> wouldn't give a BERRY.
MILTANK looks sad.
maps/Route39Barn.asm::Route39BarnRefused.et:
<PLAYER> ei andnud BERRYt.
MILTANK näeb kurb välja.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_S.label: FarmerMText_SickCow
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_S.en:
My MILTANK ain't givin' me milk n'more.
This here FARM's got famous milk.
Most everyone wants a drink.
It'll give me lots o' milk if'n I
feed it lots o' BERRIES, I reckon.
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_S.et:
Mu MILTANK ei anna mulle enam piima.
Selle TALU piim on kuulus.
Peaaegu kõik tahavad lonksu.
See annab mulle palju piima, kui
söödan sellele palju BERRYsid, arvan ma.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_B.label: FarmerMText_BuyMilk
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_B.en:
How'd you like my MOOMOO MILK?
It's my pride and joy, there.
Give it to #MON to restore HP!
I'll give it to ya fer just ¥{d:ROUTE39FARMHOUSE_MILK_PRICE}.
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_B.et:
Kuidas maitseks mu MOOMOO MILK?
See on mu uhkus ja rõõm.
Anna seda #MONile HP taastamiseks!
Annan selle sulle vaid ¥{d:ROUTE39FARMHOUSE_MILK_PRICE} eest.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_G.label: FarmerMText_GotMilk
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_G.en: Here ya go! Drink up'n enjoy!

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_N.label: FarmerMText_NoMoney
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_N.en: Sorry, there. No cash, no sale!

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_N.label: FarmerMText_NoSale
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_N.en: You don't want it? Come again, hear?
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_N.et: Sa ei taha? Tule jälle, kuuled?

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_M.label: FarmerMText_Milking
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerMText_M.en: I best go do my milkin'.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_I.label: FarmerFText_InTrouble
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_I.en:
Our milk even goes out to KANTO.
So if our own MILTANK won't give
us any milk, we're in trouble.
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_I.et:
Meie piim jõuab isegi KANTOSSE.
Seega kui meie oma MILTANK ei anna
meile piima, oleme hädas.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_H.label: FarmerFText_HealedMiltank
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_H.en:
You fixed our MILTANK, hon. Now
it gives MOOMOO MILK again.
Here's somethin' fer your trouble.
<PLAYER> received TM13.
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_H.et:
Sa parandasid meie MILTANKi, kullake. Nüüd
annab see taas MOOMOO MILKi.
Siin on midagi su vaeva eest.
<PLAYER> sai TM13.

maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_S.label: FarmerFText_SnoreSpeech
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_S.en:
That there's SNORE.
It's a rare move that only works
while the #MON is asleep.
You best think how you ought to use it, hon.
maps/Route39Farmhouse.asm::FarmerFText_S.et:
See on SNORE.
See on haruldane rünnak, mis toimib
ainult siis, kui #MON magab.
Mõtle hästi, kuidas seda kasutada, kullake.

maps/Route4.asm::BirdKeeperHankSeenText.label: BirdKeeperHankSeenText
maps/Route4.asm::BirdKeeperHankSeenText.en: I'm raising my #MON. Want to battle with me?

maps/Route4.asm::BirdKeeperHankAfterBatt.label: BirdKeeperHankAfterBattleText
maps/Route4.asm::BirdKeeperHankAfterBatt.en:
If you have a specific #MON
that you want to raise, put it out
first, then switch it right away.
That's how to do it.
maps/Route4.asm::BirdKeeperHankAfterBatt.et:
Kui sul on kindel #MON,
keda tahad kasvatada, saada see
esimesena välja, siis vaheta kohe.
Nii seda tehakse.

maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeSeenText.label: PicnickerHopeSeenText
maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeSeenText.en:
I have a feeling that I can win.
Let's see if I'm right!
maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeSeenText.et:
Mul on tunne, et võin võita.
Vaatame, kas mul on õigus!

maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeAfterBattl.label: PicnickerHopeAfterBattleText
maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeAfterBattl.en:
I heard CLEFAIRY appear at MT.MOON.
But where could they be?
maps/Route4.asm::PicnickerHopeAfterBattl.et:
Kuulsin, et CLEFAIRY ilmub MT.MOONIL.
Aga kus nad küll olla võiksid?

maps/Route4.asm::MtMoonSquareSignText.label: MtMoonSquareSignText
maps/Route4.asm::MtMoonSquareSignText.en:
MT.MOON SQUARE
Just go up the stairs.
maps/Route4.asm::MtMoonSquareSignText.et:
MT.MOON SQUARE
Mine lihtsalt trepist üles.

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonSeenText.label: SwimmermSimonSeenText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonSeenText.en:
You have to warm up before going into the water.
That's basic.
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonSeenText.et:
Enne vette minekut tuleb soojendada.
See on elementaarne.

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonAfterBatt.label: SwimmermSimonAfterBattleText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonAfterBatt.en: CIANWOOD CITY is a good distance away from here.
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermSimonAfterBatt.et: CIANWOOD CITY on siit korralik maa eemal.

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallSeenTex.label: SwimmermRandallSeenText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallSeenTex.en:
Hey, you're young and fit!
Don't ride your #MON! Swim!
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallSeenTex.et:
Hei, sa oled noor ja tugev!
Ära oma #MONiga sõida! Uju!

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallAfterBa.label: SwimmermRandallAfterBattleText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallAfterBa.en: Swimming exercises your entire body. It's healthy.
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmermRandallAfterBa.et: Ujumine paneb terve keha tööle. See on tervislik.

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineSeenText.label: SwimmerfElaineSeenText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineSeenText.en:
Are you going to CIANWOOD?
How about a quick battle first?
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineSeenText.et:
Kas lähed CIANWOODI?
Kuidas oleks enne kiire lahinguga?

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineAfterBat.label: SwimmerfElaineAfterBattleText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineAfterBat.en: I'd say I'm a better swimmer than you. Yeah!
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfElaineAfterBat.et: Ütleksin, et olen sinust parem ujuja. Jah!

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaSeenText.label: SwimmerfPaulaSeenText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaSeenText.en:
No inner tube for me.
I'm hanging on to a sea #MON!
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaSeenText.et:
Mina ei kasuta ujumisrõngast.
Hoian kinni meri-#MONist!

maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaAfterBatt.label: SwimmerfPaulaAfterBattleText
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaAfterBatt.en: While I float like this, the waves carry me along.
maps/Route40.asm::SwimmerfPaulaAfterBatt.et: Sedasi hõljudes kannavad lained mind edasi.

maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass1Text.label: Route40Lass1Text
maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass1Text.en:
Although you can't see it from here,
CIANWOOD is across the sea.
maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass1Text.et: Kuigi siit ei näe, on CIANWOOD üle mere.

maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText.label: Route40PokefanMText
maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText.en:
Hm! There's a big building up ahead!
What is it?
maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText.et:
Hm! Eespool on suur hoone!
Mis see on?

maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText_Mo.label: Route40PokefanMText_Mobile
maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText_Mo.en:
Hm! Look at all those seriouslooking trainers streaming in.
What? What?
maps/Route40.asm::Route40PokefanMText_Mo.et:
Hm! Vaata kõiki neid tõsiseid treenereid sisse voolamas.
Mis? Mis?

maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass2Text.label: Route40Lass2Text
maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass2Text.en:
I came to OLIVINE by ship to see the
sights and soak up the atmosphere.
Being a port, it feels so different from a big city.
maps/Route40.asm::Route40Lass2Text.et:
Tulin OLIVINESSE laevaga vaatamisväärsusi nautima ja atmosfääri tunnetama.
Sadamalinnana tundub see suurlinnast nii erinev.

maps/Route40.asm::Route40StandingYoungst.label: Route40StandingYoungsterText
maps/Route40.asm::Route40StandingYoungst.en:
Have you gone to the BATTLE TOWER?
I think a lot of tough trainers
have gathered there already.
But since you have so many BADGES,
you shouldn't do badly at all.
maps/Route40.asm::Route40StandingYoungst.et:
Kas oled käinud LAHINGUTORNIS?
Arvan, et sinna on juba kogunenud palju kõvasid treenereid.
Aga kuna sul on nii palju MÄRKE, ei tohiks sul halvasti minna.

maps/Route40.asm::MeetMonicaText.label: MeetMonicaText
maps/Route40.asm::MeetMonicaText.en:
MONICA: Glad to meet you. I'm
MONICA of Monday.
maps/Route40.asm::MeetMonicaText.et: MONICA: Meeldiv tutvuda. Olen MONICA esmaspäevast.

maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGivesGiftText.label: MonicaGivesGiftText
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGivesGiftText.en: As a token of our friendship, I have a gift for you!
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGivesGiftText.et: Meie sõpruse märgiks on mul sulle kingitus!

maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGaveGiftText.label: MonicaGaveGiftText
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGaveGiftText.en:
MONICA: It's an item that raises
the power of flying-type moves.
You should equip a bird #MON with that item.
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaGaveGiftText.et:
MONICA: See ese võimendab lendav-tüüpi rünnakuid.
Pane see linnu-#MONile.

maps/Route40.asm::MonicaMondayText.label: MonicaMondayText
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaMondayText.en:
MONICA: My brothers and sisters
are all over the place.
See if you could find them all!
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaMondayText.et:
MONICA: Mu õed-vennad on igal pool laiali.
Vaata, kas leiad nad kõik üles!

maps/Route40.asm::MonicaNotMondayText.label: MonicaNotMondayText
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaNotMondayText.en: MONICA: I don't think today is Monday. How sad…
maps/Route40.asm::MonicaNotMondayText.et: MONICA: Vist pole täna esmaspäev. Kui kurb…

maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.label: Route40BattleTowerGateTwinScript
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.en:
Did you come to see the BATTLE TOWER too?
But I guess you can't go in yet.
BATTLE TOWER has opened.
I want to go, but I haven't thought
up a cool line for when I win.
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.et:
Kas tulid ka LAHINGUTORNI vaatama?
Aga sa vist ei saa veel sisse minna.
LAHINGUTORN on avatud.
Tahan minna, aga pole veel
mõelnud lahedat lauset võiduks.

maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.label: Route40BattleTowerGateRockerText
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.en:
Are you going to the BATTLE TOWER?
This is a secret, but if you win a
whole lot, you can win special gifts.
I'm going to train my #MON so I'll
be all ready for the BATTLE TOWER.
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.et:
Kas lähed LAHINGUTORNI?
See on saladus, aga kui võidad
palju, saad võita eriauhindu.
Treenin oma #MONe, et olla
LAHINGUTORNIKS täiesti valmis.

maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.label: Route40BattleTowerGateTwinText
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.en:
The levels of the #MON I want to
use are all different.
I have to go train them now!
maps/Route40BattleTowerGate.asm::Route40.et:
#MONide tasemed, keda tahan
kasutada, on kõik erinevad.
Pean nüüd neid treenima minema!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieSeenTex.label: SwimmermCharlieSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieSeenTex.en:
The water's warm here. I'm loose and limber.
Sure, I'll take you on!
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieSeenTex.et:
Vesi on siin soe. Olen lõtv ja nõtke.
Muidugi võtan sinuga mõõtu!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieBeatenT.label: SwimmermCharlieBeatenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieBeatenT.et: Uih! Mu nahk on kortsus nagu ploom!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieAfterBa.label: SwimmermCharlieAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieAfterBa.en: Isn't it relaxing just floating like this?
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermCharlieAfterBa.et: Kas pole lõõgastav lihtsalt niimoodi hõljuda?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeSeenText.label: SwimmermGeorgeSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeSeenText.en: I'm a bit tired. If I win, lend me your #MON.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeSeenText.et: Olen veidi väsinud. Kui võidan, laena mulle oma #MON.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeAfterBat.label: SwimmermGeorgeAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeAfterBat.en:
It's so far to CIANWOOD.
But it's no easy return trip to OLIVINE either.
What should I do?
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermGeorgeAfterBat.et:
CIANWOODI on nii kaugele.
Aga OLIVINESSE tagasi pole ka kerge tee.
Mida ma peaksin tegema?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeSeenText.label: SwimmermBerkeSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeSeenText.en:
See those islands that are blocked by whirlpools?
There just has to be a secret!
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeSeenText.et:
Näed neid saari, mida veekeerised ümbritsevad?
Seal peab lihtsalt saladus olema!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeBeatenTex.label: SwimmermBerkeBeatenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeBeatenTex.en: What's the secret to your strength?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeAfterBatt.label: SwimmermBerkeAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeAfterBatt.en:
It was a dark and stormy night…
I saw this giant #MON flying from the islands.
It was scattering feathers from its silver wings.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermBerkeAfterBatt.et:
Oli pime ja tormine öö…
Nägin seda hiiglaslikku #MONi saartelt lendamas.
Ta pillutas oma hõbedastelt tiibadelt sulgi.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkSeenText.label: SwimmermKirkSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkSeenText.en:
The waves are wild here.
They tire you out while you swim.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkSeenText.et:
Lained on siin metsikud.
Nad väsitavad sind ujudes ära.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkAfterBattl.label: SwimmermKirkAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkAfterBattl.en: The currents keep me from reaching that island.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermKirkAfterBattl.et: Hoovused ei lase mul seda saart saavutada.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermMathewSeenText.label: SwimmermMathewSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermMathewSeenText.en: Are you seeking the secrets of WHIRL ISLANDS?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermMathewAfterBat.label: SwimmermMathewAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermMathewAfterBat.en:
A secret about WHIRL ISLANDS…
It's pitch-black inside!
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmermMathewAfterBat.et:
Saladus KEERISESAARTE kohta…
Sees on pilkane pimedus!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeSeenText.label: SwimmerfKayleeSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeSeenText.en:
I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS.
I'm going exploring with friends.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeSeenText.et:
Olen teel KEERISESAARTELE.
Lähen sõpradega uurima.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeBeatenTe.label: SwimmerfKayleeBeatenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeBeatenTe.en: Is that how you do it?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeAfterBat.label: SwimmerfKayleeAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeAfterBat.en:
There's supposed to be a big #MON deep beneath WHIRL ISLANDS.
I wonder what it could be?
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKayleeAfterBat.et:
KEERISESAARTE sügavuses olevat suur #MON.
Huvitav, mis see olla võiks?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieSeenText.label: SwimmerfSusieSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieSeenText.en: You look so elegant, riding your #MON.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieSeenText.et: Näed nii graatsiline välja, oma #MONil ratsutades.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieAfterBatt.label: SwimmerfSusieAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieAfterBatt.en: Wasn't there a hit song about a boy riding a LAPRAS?
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfSusieAfterBatt.et: Kas polnud üks hitt-laul poisist, kes LAPRASel ratsutas?

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseSeenText.label: SwimmerfDeniseSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseSeenText.en: The weather is so beautiful, I'm in a daze!
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseSeenText.et: Ilm on nii ilus, et olen lausa uimane!

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseAfterBat.label: SwimmerfDeniseAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseAfterBat.en:
A sunburn is the worst for skin.
But I don't use a sunblock.
I won't pollute the water.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfDeniseAfterBat.et:
Päikesepõletus on nahale kõige hullem.
Aga ma ei kasuta päikesekaitset.
Ma ei reosta vett.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraSeenText.label: SwimmerfKaraSeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraSeenText.en:
If you need to rest, just tread water.
You'll get your wind back, so you
can keep on going strong.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraSeenText.et:
Kui vajad puhkust, sõtku lihtsalt vett.
Saad hinge tagasi ja jaksad edasi.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraBeatenText.label: SwimmerfKaraBeatenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraBeatenText.en: Oh! You have more energy than I do.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraBeatenText.et: Oh! Sul on rohkem energiat kui minul.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraAfterBattl.label: SwimmerfKaraAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfKaraAfterBattl.en: I heard roars from deep inside the ISLANDS.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendySeenText.label: SwimmerfWendySeenText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendySeenText.en: At night, STARYU gather near the water's surface.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendySeenText.et: Öösel kogunevad STARYUd vee pinna lähedale.

maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendyAfterBatt.label: SwimmerfWendyAfterBattleText
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendyAfterBatt.en:
The clusters of STARYU light up at the same time.
It's so beautiful, it's scary.
maps/Route41.asm::SwimmerfWendyAfterBatt.et:
STARYUde parved süttivad korraga.
Nii ilus, et lausa hirmus.

maps/Route42.asm::FisherTullySeenText.label: FisherTullySeenText
maps/Route42.asm::FisherTullySeenText.en: Let me demonstrate the power of the #MON I caught!

maps/Route42.asm::FisherTullyAfterBattle.label: FisherTullyAfterBattleText
maps/Route42.asm::FisherTullyAfterBattle.en:
I want to become the trainer CHAMP
using the #MON I caught.
That's the best part of fishing!
maps/Route42.asm::FisherTullyAfterBattle.et:
Tahan püütud #MONidega treeneri-TŠEMPIONIKS saada.
See on kalapüügi parim osa!

maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminSeenText.label: HikerBenjaminSeenText
maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminSeenText.en: Ah, it's good to be outside! I feel so free!
maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminSeenText.et: Ah, õues on hea olla! Tunnen end nii vabana!

maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminAfterBatt.label: HikerBenjaminAfterBattleText
maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminAfterBatt.en:
Losing feels insignificant if you
look up at the big sky!
maps/Route42.asm::HikerBenjaminAfterBatt.et: Kaotus tundub tähtsusetu, kui vaatad üles suurde taevasse!

maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneSeenTex.label: PokemaniacShaneSeenText
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneSeenTex.en:
HEY!
This is my secret place! Get lost, you outsider!
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneSeenTex.et:
HEI!
See on minu salajane paik! Kao, sissetungija!

maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneBeatenT.label: PokemaniacShaneBeatenText
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneBeatenT.en: I should have used my MOON STONE…
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneBeatenT.et: Oleks pidanud oma MOON STONE kasutama…

maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneAfterBa.label: PokemaniacShaneAfterBattleText
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneAfterBa.en:
You're working on a #DEX?
Wow, you must know some pretty rare #MON!
May I please see it. Please?
maps/Route42.asm::PokemaniacShaneAfterBa.et:
Sa koostad #DEXi?
Vau, sa tunned vist päris haruldasi #MONe!
Kas tohin näha? Palun?

maps/Route42EcruteakGate.asm::Route42Ecr.label: Route42EcruteakGateOfficerText
maps/Route42EcruteakGate.asm::Route42Ecr.en:
MT.MORTAR is like a maze inside.
Be careful. Don't get lost in there.
maps/Route42EcruteakGate.asm::Route42Ecr.et:
MT.MORTAR on seest nagu labürint.
Ole ettevaatlik. Ära seal ära eksi.

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenSeenText.label: PokemaniacBenSeenText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenSeenText.en:
I love #MON!
That's why I started--and why
I'll keep on collecting #MON!
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenSeenText.et:
Ma armastan #MONe!
Sellepärast alustasingi — ja sellepärast kogun #MONe edasi!

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenBeatenTex.label: PokemaniacBenBeatenText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenBeatenTex.en: How could you do this to me?

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenAfterBatt.label: PokemaniacBenAfterBattleText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenAfterBatt.en:
What else do I like besides #MON?
MARY on the radio. I bet she's cute!
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBenAfterBatt.et:
Mis mulle peale #MONide veel meeldib?
MARY raadios. Vean kihla, et ta on nunnu!

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBrentSeenTex.label: PokemaniacBrentSeenText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBrentSeenTex.en: Hey! Do you have any rare #MON?

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBrentAfterBa.label: PokemaniacBrentAfterBattleText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBrentAfterBa.en: I'd be happy just to own a single rare #MON.
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacBrentAfterBa.et: Oleksin õnnelik juba üht ainsat haruldast #MONi omades.

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonSeenText.label: PokemaniacRonSeenText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonSeenText.en:
Would you get this?
Some <RIVAL> guy made fun of my #MON!
Darn it! My #MON's great!
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonSeenText.et:
Kas kuulad seda?
Mingi <RIVAL> pilkas mu #MONi!
Pagan võtaks! Mu #MON on suurepärane!

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonBeatenTex.label: PokemaniacRonBeatenText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonBeatenTex.en: My NIDOKING did pretty right on!
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonBeatenTex.et: Mu NIDOKING sai päris hästi hakkama!

maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonAfterBatt.label: PokemaniacRonAfterBattleText
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonAfterBatt.en:
It's okay for people to like
different types of #MON.
#MON isn't just about having the most powerful one.
maps/Route43.asm::PokemaniacRonAfterBatt.et:
On normaalne, et inimestele meeldivad eri #MONid.
#MONides ei loe vaid kõige võimsam.

maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinSeenText.label: FisherMarvinSeenText
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinSeenText.en:
I'm in a slump.
Maybe it's the gear I'm using.
Let's battle for a change of pace!
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinSeenText.et:
Olen mõõnas.
Ehk on asi mu varustuses.
Võitleme vahelduseks!

maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinBeatenText.label: FisherMarvinBeatenText
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinBeatenText.en: I lost, but I feel better anyway.
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinBeatenText.et: Kaotasin, aga tunnen end ikkagi paremini.

maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinAfterBattl.label: FisherMarvinAfterBattleText
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinAfterBattl.en:
KURT's LURE BALL is the best for
catching hooked #MON.
It's much more effective than a ULTRA BALL.
maps/Route43.asm::FisherMarvinAfterBattl.et:
KURDI LURE BALL on parim õnge otsa jäänud #MONide püüdmiseks.
See on palju tõhusam kui ULTRA BALL.

maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerSeenText.label: CamperSpencerSeenText
maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerSeenText.en: I can do so much with my #MON-it's super-fun!
maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerSeenText.et: Oma #MONidega saan nii palju teha — see on ülilõbus!

maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerAfterBatt.label: CamperSpencerAfterBattleText
maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerAfterBatt.en:
What is going on at LAKE OF RAGE?
We were planning to camp there.
maps/Route43.asm::CamperSpencerAfterBatt.et:
Mis toimub RAEVUJÄRVEL?
Plaanisime seal telkida.

maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanySeenTe.label: PicnickerTiffanySeenText
maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanySeenTe.en:
Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too?
Let's play for a little while!
maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanySeenTe.et:
Kas sinagi lähed RAEVUJÄRVELE?
Mängime hetkeks!
