maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanyWantsP.label: PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnicText
maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanyWantsP.en:
I'm having a picnic with #MON.
Won't you join us?

maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanyClefai.label: PicnickerTiffanyClefairyText
maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanyClefai.en: Isn't my CLEFAIRY just the most adorable thing?
maps/Route43.asm::PicnickerTiffanyClefai.et: Kas mu CLEFAIRY pole kõige nunnum asi?

maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign1Text.label: Route43Sign1Text
maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign1Text.en:
ROUTE 43
LAKE OF RAGE MAHOGANY TOWN
maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign1Text.et:
ROUTE 43
LAKE OF RAGE MAHOGANY TOWN

maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign2Text.label: Route43Sign2Text
maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign2Text.en:
ROUTE 43
LAKE OF RAGE MAHOGANY TOWN
maps/Route43.asm::Route43Sign2Text.et:
ROUTE 43
LAKE OF RAGE MAHOGANY TOWN

maps/Route43.asm::Route43TrainerTipsText.label: Route43TrainerTipsText
maps/Route43.asm::Route43TrainerTipsText.en:
TRAINER TIPS
All #MON have pros and cons
depending on their types.
If their types differ, a higher-
level #MON may lose in battle.
Learn which types are strong and
weak against your #MON's type.
maps/Route43.asm::Route43TrainerTipsText.et:
TREENERI NIPID
Kõigil #MONidel on tüübist sõltuvalt eelised ja puudused.
Kui tüübid erinevad, võib kõrgema tasemega #MON lahingu kaotada.
Õpi, millised tüübid on su #MONi tüübi vastu tugevad ja nõrgad.

maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_TollFee.label: RocketText_TollFee
maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_TollFee.en:
Hold it there, kiddo!
The toll is ¥{d:ROUTE43GATE_TOLL} to go through.

maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_AllYouG.label: RocketText_AllYouGot
maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_AllYouG.en: Then pay what you have, please.
maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_AllYouG.et: Siis maksa, mis sul on, palun.

maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_MakingA.label: RocketText_MakingABundle
maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_MakingA.en:
He-he-he. We're making a bundle.
Everyone wants to see what's going
on up at LAKE OF RAGE.
maps/Route43Gate.asm::RocketText_MakingA.et:
He-he-he. Teenime hunniku raha.
Kõik tahavad näha, mis toimub
üleval LAKE OF RAGE juures.

maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_FoundT.label: OfficerText_FoundTM
maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_FoundT.en:
I got chased from my post by these thugs in black.
They left this behind.
It makes me uncomfortable. Could you take it away?
<PLAYER> received TM30.
maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_FoundT.et:
Need mustades kaabakad kihutasid mind mu postilt.
Nad jätsid selle maha.
See teeb mind rahutuks. Kas viiksid selle ära?
<PLAYER> sai TM30.

maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_AvoidG.label: OfficerText_AvoidGrass
maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_AvoidG.en: Use this gate to avoid walking in the grass.
maps/Route43Gate.asm::OfficerText_AvoidG.et: Kasuta seda väravat, et vältida rohus kõndimist.

maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.label: Route43MahoganyGateOfficerText
maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.en:
Only people headed up to LAKE OF RAGE
have been through here lately.
maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.et:
Ainult LAKE OF RAGE poole suundujad
on viimasel ajal siit läbi käinud.

maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.label: Route43MahoganyGateOfficerRocketsClearedText
maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.en: Nobody goes up to LAKE OF RAGE these days.
maps/Route43MahoganyGate.asm::Route43Mah.et: Tänapäeval keegi LAKE OF RAGE poole ei lähe.

maps/Route44.asm::FisherWilton1SeenText.label: FisherWilton1SeenText
maps/Route44.asm::FisherWilton1SeenText.en:
Aack! You made me lose a POLIWAG!
What are you going to do about it?
maps/Route44.asm::FisherWilton1SeenText.et:
Aak! Sinu pärast läks POLIWAG käest!
Mida sa selle heaks teed?

maps/Route44.asm::FisherWiltonHugePoliwa.label: FisherWiltonHugePoliwagText
maps/Route44.asm::FisherWiltonHugePoliwa.en:
That POLIWAG that got away… It was huge.
I swear it must've been 16 feet long!
maps/Route44.asm::FisherWiltonHugePoliwa.et:
See POLIWAG, kes käest läks… ta oli hiiglaslik.
Vannun, et pidi olema 5 meetrit pikk!

maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarSeenText.label: FisherEdgarSeenText
maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarSeenText.en:
I fish until I can't anymore.
I also battle until I drop.
That's my relationship with my #MON.
maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarSeenText.et:
Püüan kala, kuni enam ei jaksa.
Võitlen ka kuni kokkukukkumiseni.
Selline on mu suhe #MONidega.

maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarAfterBattle.label: FisherEdgarAfterBattleText
maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarAfterBattle.en:
That's 100 wins to 101 losses.
I won't battle again for a while.
maps/Route44.asm::FisherEdgarAfterBattle.et:
See teeb 100 võitu 101 kaotuse vastu.
Mõnda aega ma enam ei võitle.

maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVance1SeenTe.label: BirdKeeperVance1SeenText
maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVance1SeenTe.en: Do you know about the legendary bird #MON?

maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVanceLegenda.label: BirdKeeperVanceLegendaryBirdsText
maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVanceLegenda.en:
ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are
the three legendary bird #MON.
I heard there are other legendary birds, though.
maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVanceLegenda.et:
ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS ja MOLTRES on kolm legendaarset linnu-#MONi.
Kuulsin, et on ka teisi legendaarseid linde.

maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVance2Beaten.label: BirdKeeperVance2BeatenText
maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVance2Beaten.en:
Why can't I ever beat you?
Oh yeah, here you go. It's that gift
I couldn't give you last time.
maps/Route44.asm::BirdKeeperVance2Beaten.et:
Miks ma ei suuda sind kunagi võita?
Ahjaa, säh. See on see kingitus, mille sulle eelmine kord anda ei saanud.

maps/Route44.asm::PsychicPhilAfterBattle.label: PsychicPhilAfterBattleText
maps/Route44.asm::PsychicPhilAfterBattle.en: It's important to have conviction on your side.
maps/Route44.asm::PsychicPhilAfterBattle.et: Tähtis on, et sul oleks veendumus.

maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachSeenText.label: PokemaniacZachSeenText
maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachSeenText.en: I'll do anything to get my hands on rare #MON!
maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachSeenText.et: Teen kõike, et haruldasi #MONe kätte saada!

maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachAfterBat.label: PokemaniacZachAfterBattleText
maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachAfterBat.en:
If a #MON has different colors
from usual, it's more valuable.
What? You mean that's not true?
maps/Route44.asm::PokemaniacZachAfterBat.et:
Kui #MONil on tavapärasest erinevad värvid, on ta väärtuslikum.
Mis? Kas see pole tõsi?

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenSeenT.label: CooltrainermAllenSeenText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenSeenT.en:
I can tell you're a good trainer by looking at you.
I'm good at #MON, and I can see that you are too.
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenSeenT.et:
Sind vaadates näen, et oled hea treener.
Mina olen #MONides hea ja näen, et sina ka.

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenBeate.label: CooltrainermAllenBeatenText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenBeate.en: Tch! It's a total loss on my part.

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenAfter.label: CooltrainermAllenAfterBattleText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenAfter.en:
Wow. You have a lot of BADGES.
No wonder you're so tough.
I wonder if ECRUTEAK GYM's
MORTY is still in training?
He really hammered me.
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainermAllenAfter.et:
Vau. Sul on palju MÄRKE.
Pole ime, et oled nii kõva.
Huvitav, kas ECRUTEAKI SAALI MORTY veel treenib?
Ta andis mulle korralikult vastu.

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilSeenT.label: CooltrainerfCybilSeenText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilSeenT.en:
You look strong.
Good trainers seek tough opponents instinctively.
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilSeenT.et:
Näed tugev välja.
Head treenerid otsivad instinktiivselt kõvasid vastaseid.

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilBeate.label: CooltrainerfCybilBeatenText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilBeate.en: Nope! This won't do at all.

maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilAfter.label: CooltrainerfCybilAfterBattleText
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilAfter.en:
We all get better by experiencing many battles.
I battled a lot to become what I am today--an elite.
maps/Route44.asm::CooltrainerfCybilAfter.et:
Me kõik läheme paremaks paljusid lahinguid kogedes.
Võitlesin palju, et saada selleks, kes täna olen — eliidiks.

maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikSeenText.label: HikerErikSeenText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikSeenText.en:
Be prepared for anything!
Let me see if your #MON have been raised properly!
maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikSeenText.et:
Ole valmis kõigeks!
Vaatan, kas su #MONe on korralikult kasvatatud!

maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikAfterBattleTe.label: HikerErikAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikAfterBattleTe.en:
I'll head back to BLACKTHORN's ICE
PATH and train some more.
maps/Route45.asm::HikerErikAfterBattleTe.et: Lähen tagasi BLACKTHORNI JÄÄRAJALE veel treenima.

maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelSeenText.label: HikerMichaelSeenText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelSeenText.en:
Yo! You're spunky! But you know what?
When it comes to sheer spunkiness, I'm the man!
maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelSeenText.et:
Hei! Sa oled südi! Aga tead mis?
Kui jutt on puhtast südikusest, olen mina see mees!

maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelAfterBattl.label: HikerMichaelAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelAfterBattl.en:
Boy, do I love HP UP! Mmmm, yum!
I keep drinking my #MON's!
I can't help it!
maps/Route45.asm::HikerMichaelAfterBattl.et:
Poiss, kuidas ma armastan HP UPi! Mmmm, nämma!
Joon aina oma #MONi omi!
Ma ei saa sinna midagi parata!

maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryAfterBattleT.label: HikerParryAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryAfterBattleT.en:
I'm not much good at thinking, see?
So, I just plow ahead with power!
maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryAfterBattleT.et:
Mõtlemises pole ma eriti hea, näed?
Nii et lihtsalt murran väega edasi!

maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothySeenText.label: HikerTimothySeenText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothySeenText.en:
Why do I climb mountains?
Because they're there.
Why do I train #MON?
Because they're there!
maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothySeenText.et:
Miks ma mägesid ronin?
Sest need on olemas.
Miks ma #MONe treenin?
Sest need on olemas!

maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothyAfterBattl.label: HikerTimothyAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothyAfterBattl.en:
The best thing to ever happen to me
was discovering #MON.
maps/Route45.asm::HikerTimothyAfterBattl.et: Parim asi, mis minuga juhtunud on, oli #MONide avastamine.

maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryGivesIronTex.label: HikerParryGivesIronText
maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryGivesIronTex.en:
I just can't find a way to win!
Keep it up!
Oh, and take this --it's the gift
you couldn't take when we last met.
maps/Route45.asm::HikerParryGivesIronTex.et:
Ma lihtsalt ei leia võiduteed!
Jätka samas vaimus!
Ahjaa, võta see — kingitus, mille eelmine kord kätte ei saanud.

maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenji3SeenTex.label: BlackbeltKenji3SeenText
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenji3SeenTex.en:
I was training here alone.
Behold the fruits of my labor!
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenji3SeenTex.et:
Treenisin siin üksi.
Vaata mu töö vilju!

maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiAfterBat.label: BlackbeltKenjiAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiAfterBat.en:
This calls for extreme measures.
I must take to the hills and train in solitude.
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiAfterBat.et:
See nõuab äärmuslikke meetmeid.
Pean mägedesse minema ja üksinduses treenima.

maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiMorningT.label: BlackbeltKenjiMorningText
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiMorningT.en: I'm going to train a bit more before I break for lunch.

maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiNightTex.label: BlackbeltKenjiNightText
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiNightTex.en:
We had plenty of rest at lunch, so
now we're all ready to go again!
We're going to train again!
maps/Route45.asm::BlackbeltKenjiNightTex.et:
Puhkasime lõunal korralikult, nüüd oleme taas valmis!
Hakkame jälle treenima!

maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainermRyanSeenTe.label: CooltrainermRyanSeenText
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainermRyanSeenTe.en: What are your thoughts on raising #MON?

maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainermRyanAfterB.label: CooltrainermRyanAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainermRyanAfterB.en:
I see you're raising your #MON with care.
The bond you build will save you in tough situations.
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainermRyanAfterB.et:
Näen, et kasvatad oma #MONe hoolega.
Tekkinud side päästab sind rasketes olukordades.

maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellySeenT.label: CooltrainerfKellySeenText
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellySeenT.en:
What is your battle strategy?
It is foolish to use strong moves indiscriminately.
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellySeenT.et:
Mis on su lahingustrateegia?
Rumal on tugevaid rünnakuid valimatult kasutada.

maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellyAfter.label: CooltrainerfKellyAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellyAfter.en:
I'm not in favor of overly powerful moves.
I want to win, but I also don't want to harm #MON.
maps/Route45.asm::CooltrainerfKellyAfter.et:
Ma ei poolda liiga võimsaid rünnakuid.
Tahan võita, aga ei taha ka #MONe kahjustada.

maps/Route45.asm::Route45DummyText.label: Route45DummyText
maps/Route45.asm::Route45DummyText.en:
I'm really, really tough!
Is there anywhere I can prove how tough I really am?
maps/Route45.asm::Route45DummyText.et:
Olen tõesti, tõesti kõva!
Kas kuskil saab tõestada, kui kõva ma tegelikult olen?

maps/Route45.asm::CamperQuentinBeatenTex.label: CamperQuentinBeatenText
maps/Route45.asm::CamperQuentinBeatenTex.en: I was tough at the BATTLE TOWER…

maps/Route45.asm::CamperQuentinAfterBatt.label: CamperQuentinAfterBattleText
maps/Route45.asm::CamperQuentinAfterBatt.en:
Have you been to the BATTLE TOWER?
I never, ever lose there, but…
maps/Route45.asm::CamperQuentinAfterBatt.et:
Kas oled käinud LAHINGUTORNIS?
Mina ei kaota seal iial, aga…

maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileySeenText.label: HikerBaileySeenText
maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileySeenText.en: Awright! I'll show you the power of mountain #MON!

maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileyBeatenText.label: HikerBaileyBeatenText
maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileyBeatenText.en: Mercy! You showed me your power!

maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileyAfterBattle.label: HikerBaileyAfterBattleText
maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileyAfterBattle.en: It's over. I don't mind. We HIKERS are like that.
maps/Route46.asm::HikerBaileyAfterBattle.et: Läbi. Pole viga. Meie, matkajad, oleme sellised.

maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedSeenText.label: CamperTedSeenText
maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedSeenText.en:
I'm raising #MON too!
Will you battle with me?
maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedSeenText.et:
Ka mina kasvatan #MONe!
Kas võitled minuga?

maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedAfterBattleTe.label: CamperTedAfterBattleText
maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedAfterBattleTe.en:
I did my best but came up short.
No excuses--I admit I lost.
maps/Route46.asm::CamperTedAfterBattleTe.et:
Andsin endast parima, aga jäin alla.
Ei mingeid vabandusi — tunnistan, et kaotasin.

maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin1SeenText.label: PicnickerErin1SeenText
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin1SeenText.en:
I raise #MON too!
Will you battle with me?
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin1SeenText.et:
Ka mina kasvatan #MONe!
Kas võitled minuga?

maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErinAfterBatt.label: PicnickerErinAfterBattleText
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErinAfterBatt.en:
I've been to many GYMS, but the GYM
in GOLDENROD is my favorite.
It's filled with pretty flowers!
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErinAfterBatt.et:
Olen käinud paljudes SAALIDES, aga GOLDENRODI SAAL on mu lemmik.
See on täis ilusaid lilli!

maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin2BeatenTe.label: PicnickerErin2BeatenText
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin2BeatenTe.en:
Aww… I keep losing all the time!
I'll just have to try harder!
Anyway, thanks for battling me again
and again. Here's that present from the other time.
maps/Route46.asm::PicnickerErin2BeatenTe.et:
Ohh… Ma kaotan aina!
Pean lihtsalt rohkem pingutama!
Igatahes, aitäh, et minuga ikka ja jälle võitlesid. Säh, see kink eelmisest korrast.

maps/Route5.asm::Route5PokefanMText.label: Route5PokefanMText
maps/Route5.asm::Route5PokefanMText.en:
The road is closed until the problem
at the POWER PLANT is solved.
maps/Route5.asm::Route5PokefanMText.et:
Tee on suletud, kuni POWER PLANTI
probleem on lahendatud.

maps/Route5.asm::Route5UndergroundPathSi.label: Route5UndergroundPathSignText
maps/Route5.asm::Route5UndergroundPathSi.en:
UNDERGROUND PATH
CERULEAN CITY VERMILION CITY
maps/Route5.asm::Route5UndergroundPathSi.et:
UNDERGROUND PATH
CERULEAN CITY VERMILION CITY

maps/Route5.asm::HouseForSaleSignText.label: HouseForSaleSignText
maps/Route5.asm::HouseForSaleSignText.en:
What's this?
House for Sale… Nobody lives here.
maps/Route5.asm::HouseForSaleSignText.et:
Mis see on?
Maja müügiks… Siin ei ela keegi.

maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText1
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.en:
Eeyaaaah!
I sense a sinister shadow hovering over you.
Take this to ward it off!
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.et:
Iiijaaaah!
Tunnen su kohal hõljumas kurjakuulutavat varju.
Võta see, et see eemale peletada!

maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText2
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.en: You were in mortal danger, but you are protected now.
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.et: Olid surmaohus, aga nüüd oled kaitstud.

maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseTeacherText
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.en:
My grandma is into warding off what
she believes to be evil spirits.
I'm sorry that she startled you.
maps/Route5CleanseTagHouse.asm::Route5Cl.et:
Mu vanaema tegeleb sellega, mida ta
peab kurjadeks vaimudeks, eemale peletamisega.
Vabandust, et ta sind ehmatas.

maps/Route5SaffronGate.asm::Route5Saffro.label: Route5SaffronGateOfficerText
maps/Route5SaffronGate.asm::Route5Saffro.en:
You're from JOHTO, aren't you?
How do you like KANTO? It's nice, don't you agree?
maps/Route5SaffronGate.asm::Route5Saffro.et:
Sa oled JOHTOST, kas pole?
Kuidas KANTO sulle meeldib? Kena, kas pole nõus?

maps/Route5UndergroundPathEntrance.asm::.label: Route5UndergroundPathEntranceTeacherText
maps/Route5UndergroundPathEntrance.asm::.en:
Many cities in JOHTO have long
histories. I'd love to visit!
maps/Route5UndergroundPathEntrance.asm::.et:
Paljudel JOHTO linnadel on pikk
ajalugu. Tahaksin väga külastada!

maps/Route6.asm::Route6PokefanMText.label: Route6PokefanMText
maps/Route6.asm::Route6PokefanMText.en:
The road is closed until the problem
at the POWER PLANT is solved.
maps/Route6.asm::Route6PokefanMText.et:
Tee on suletud, kuni POWER PLANTI
probleem on lahendatud.

maps/Route6.asm::Route6UndergroundPathSi.label: Route6UndergroundPathSignText
maps/Route6.asm::Route6UndergroundPathSi.en:
UNDERGROUND PATH
CERULEAN CITY VERMILION CITY
maps/Route6.asm::Route6UndergroundPathSi.et:
UNDERGROUND PATH
CERULEAN CITY VERMILION CITY

maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmRexSeenText.label: PokefanmRexSeenText
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmRexSeenText.en: My PHANPY is the cutest in the world.

maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmRexAfterBattleT.label: PokefanmRexAfterBattleText
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmRexAfterBattleT.en:
Look how adorable my PHANPY acts!
Isn't it cute enough to make your heart melt?
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmRexAfterBattleT.et:
Vaata, kui armsalt mu PHANPY käitub!
Kas pole piisavalt nunnu, et süda sulaks?

maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmAllanSeenText.label: PokefanmAllanSeenText
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmAllanSeenText.en: My TEDDIURSA is the cutest in the world.

maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmAllanAfterBattl.label: PokefanmAllanAfterBattleText
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmAllanAfterBattl.en:
Look how adorable my TEDDIURSA acts!
Isn't it cute enough to make your heart melt?
maps/Route6.asm::PokefanmAllanAfterBattl.et:
Vaata, kui armsalt mu TEDDIURSA käitub!
Kas pole piisavalt nunnu, et süda sulaks?

maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.label: Route6SaffronGuardWelcomeText
maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.en:
Welcome to SAFFRON CITY, home of the MAGNET TRAIN!
…That's what I'd normally say, but
the MAGNET TRAIN isn't running now.
It's not getting any electricity
because there's something wrong
with the POWER PLANT.
maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.et:
Tere tulemast SAFFRON CITYSSE, MAGNETRONGI kodulinna!
…Nii ütleksin tavaliselt, aga
MAGNETRONG praegu ei sõida.
See ei saa elektrit,
sest POWER PLANTIGA
on midagi valesti.

maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.label: Route6SaffronGuardMagnetTrainText
maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.en:
The MAGNET TRAIN is the most famous
thing about SAFFRON.
maps/Route6SaffronGate.asm::Route6Saffro.et:
MAGNETRONG on SAFFRONI
kõige kuulsam asi.

maps/Route7.asm::Route7UndergroundPathSi.label: Route7UndergroundPathSignText
maps/Route7.asm::Route7UndergroundPathSi.en:
What's this flyer?
… Uncouth trainers have been holding
battles in the UNDERGROUND PATH.
Because of rising complaints by local residents, the UNDERGROUND PATH has been sealed indefinitely.
CELADON POLICE
maps/Route7.asm::Route7UndergroundPathSi.et:
Mis lendleht see on?
… Kombetud treenerid on pidanud
lahinguid UNDERGROUND PATHIS.
Kohalike elanike kasvavate kaebuste tõttu on UNDERGROUND PATH määramata ajaks suletud.
CELADONI POLITSEI

maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.label: Route7SaffronGuardPowerPlantText
maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.en:
Did you hear about the accident at the POWER PLANT?
It's located in the East, close to LAVENDER TOWN.
maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.et:
Kas kuulsid õnnetusest POWER PLANTIS?
See asub idas, LAVENDER TOWNI lähedal.

maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.label: Route7SaffronGuardSeriousText
maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.en:
I take my GUARD job seriously.
Hey! You have a #DEX.
OK. You can go through.
maps/Route7SaffronGate.asm::Route7Saffro.et:
Võtan oma VALVURI tööd tõsiselt.
Hei! Sul on #DEX.
OK. Sa võid läbi minna.

maps/Route8.asm::BikerDwayneSeenText.label: BikerDwayneSeenText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerDwayneSeenText.en:
We're the KANTO #MON FEDERATION trainer group.
We'll drive you under our wheels!
maps/Route8.asm::BikerDwayneSeenText.et:
Oleme KANTO #MON FÖDERATSIOONI treenerite rühm.
Sõidame su oma rataste alla!

maps/Route8.asm::BikerDwayneAfterBattleT.label: BikerDwayneAfterBattleText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerDwayneAfterBattleT.en: The KANTO #MON FEDERATION will never fall!

maps/Route8.asm::BikerHarrisSeenText.label: BikerHarrisSeenText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerHarrisSeenText.en:
The cops shut down our UNDERGROUND
PATH! That really fries me!
maps/Route8.asm::BikerHarrisSeenText.et:
Võmmid panid meie UNDERGROUND
PATHI kinni! See ajab mind marru!

maps/Route8.asm::BikerHarrisAfterBattleT.label: BikerHarrisAfterBattleText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerHarrisAfterBattleT.en: Wiped out by some punk from JOHTO…

maps/Route8.asm::BikerZekeSeenText.label: BikerZekeSeenText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerZekeSeenText.en: We're the KANTO #MON FEDERATION! Right on!

maps/Route8.asm::BikerZekeAfterBattleTex.label: BikerZekeAfterBattleText
maps/Route8.asm::BikerZekeAfterBattleTex.en: We'll try not to disturb anyone from now on…

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamSeenText.label: SupernerdSamSeenText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamSeenText.en: How does the MAGNET TRAIN work?

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamBeatenText.label: SupernerdSamBeatenText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamBeatenText.en: I just want to see the MAGNET TRAIN…

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamAfterBattle.label: SupernerdSamAfterBattleText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdSamAfterBattle.en: The power of magnets is awesome!

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomSeenText.label: SupernerdTomSeenText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomSeenText.en: Hm… You've got many GYM BADGES.
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomSeenText.et: Hm… Sul on palju SAALI MÄRKE.

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomBeatenText.label: SupernerdTomBeatenText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomBeatenText.en: Just as I thought… You're tough!
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomBeatenText.et: Just nagu arvasin… Sa oled kõva!

maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomAfterBattle.label: SupernerdTomAfterBattleText
maps/Route8.asm::SupernerdTomAfterBattle.en: GYM BADGES give you advantages in battles.

maps/Route8.asm::Route8UndergroundPathSi.label: Route8UndergroundPathSignText
maps/Route8.asm::Route8UndergroundPathSi.en:
The flyer's torn.
It's impossible to read…
maps/Route8.asm::Route8UndergroundPathSi.et:
Lendleht on rebenenud.
Seda on võimatu lugeda…

maps/Route8SaffronGate.asm::Route8Saffro.label: Route8SaffronGateOfficerText
maps/Route8SaffronGate.asm::Route8Saffro.en:
Have you been to LAVENDER TOWN?
There's a tall RADIO TOWER there.
maps/Route8SaffronGate.asm::Route8Saffro.et:
Kas oled käinud LAVENDER TOWNIS?
Seal on kõrge RAADIOTORN.

maps/Route9.asm::CamperDeanSeenText.label: CamperDeanSeenText
maps/Route9.asm::CamperDeanSeenText.en: I came to explore ROCK TUNNEL.

maps/Route9.asm::CamperDeanAfterBattleTe.label: CamperDeanAfterBattleText
maps/Route9.asm::CamperDeanAfterBattleTe.en:
My #MON were hurt before even
entering ROCK TUNNEL.
I'd better take them to a #MON CENTER right away.
maps/Route9.asm::CamperDeanAfterBattleTe.et:
Mu #MONid said viga juba enne
ROCK TUNNELISSE sisenemist.
Parem viin nad kohe #MON KESKUSESSE.

maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiSeenText.label: PicnickerHeidiSeenText
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiSeenText.en:
Have you ever been to a picnic?
They're so much fun!
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiSeenText.et:
Kas oled kunagi piknikul käinud?
Need on nii lõbusad!

maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiAfterBatt.label: PicnickerHeidiAfterBattleText
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiAfterBatt.en:
We bake lots of goodies and share
them all around. They're delicious!
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerHeidiAfterBatt.et:
Küpsetame palju maiuseid ja jagame
neid kõigile. Need on maitsvad!

maps/Route9.asm::CamperSidSeenText.label: CamperSidSeenText
maps/Route9.asm::CamperSidSeenText.et: Hei, sina! Ära prügi maha viska!

maps/Route9.asm::CamperSidAfterBattleTex.label: CamperSidAfterBattleText
maps/Route9.asm::CamperSidAfterBattleTex.en: Sorry. You weren't littering. It was my mistake.
maps/Route9.asm::CamperSidAfterBattleTex.et: Vabandust. Sa ei prahtinud. See oli minu viga.

maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaSeenText.label: PicnickerEdnaSeenText
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaSeenText.en: People shouldn't leave any litter behind.
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaSeenText.et: Inimesed ei tohiks prügi maha jätta.

maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaAfterBattl.label: PicnickerEdnaAfterBattleText
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaAfterBattl.en:
Conserving energy is important, but
the environment is even more vital.
maps/Route9.asm::PicnickerEdnaAfterBattl.et:
Energia säästmine on tähtis, aga
keskkond on veelgi olulisem.

maps/Route9.asm::HikerTimSeenText.label: HikerTimSeenText
maps/Route9.asm::HikerTimSeenText.en:
She'll be coming 'round MT.SILVER when she comes…
MT.SILVER is in JOHTO, right?
maps/Route9.asm::HikerTimSeenText.et:
Ta tuleb ümber MT.SILVERI, kui ta tuleb…
MT.SILVER on JOHTOS, eks?

maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneySeenText.label: HikerSidneySeenText
maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneySeenText.en:
I'll tell you a secret.
But first, we battle!
maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneySeenText.et:
Räägin sulle saladuse.
Aga esmalt võitleme!

maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneyAfterBattleT.label: HikerSidneyAfterBattleText
maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneyAfterBattleT.en: The POWER PLANT is across a small river.
maps/Route9.asm::HikerSidneyAfterBattleT.et: POWER PLANT on üle väikese jõe.

maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.label: RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberWallPatternLeftText
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.en:
Patterns appeared on the walls…
It's UNOWN text!
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.et:
Seintele ilmusid mustrid…
See on UNOWN-kiri!

maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.label: RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberWallHoleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.en: There's a big hole in the wall!

maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.label: RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.label: RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberDescriptionText
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.en:
This flying #MON attacked its
prey with saw-like fangs.
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamber.asm::R.et:
See lendav #MON ründas oma
saaki saagjate kihvadega.

maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylItemRoom.asm::.label: RuinsOfAlphAerodactylItemRoomAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphAerodactylItemRoom.asm::.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.label: RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberWallPatternLeftText
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.en:
Patterns appeared on the walls…
It's UNOWN text!
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.et:
Seintele ilmusid mustrid…
See on UNOWN-kiri!

maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.label: RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberWallHoleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.en: There's a big hole in the wall!

maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.label: RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.label: RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberDescriptionText
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamber.asm::RuinsOf.en:
A #MON that flew gracefully on
rainbow-colored wings.

maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhItemRoom.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphHoOhItemRoomAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphHoOhItemRoom.asm::RuinsO.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphStrangePresenceText
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.en: There is a strange presence here…

maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberFisherText
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.en: This is a big room, but there's nothing here.
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.et: See on suur tuba, aga siin pole midagi.

maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberTeacherText
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.en:
This place has a mystical quality to it.
It feels sort of ethereal even.
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.et:
Sel kohal on müstiline kvaliteet.
See tundub isegi mõneti eeterlik.

maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberGrampsText
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.en:
Ancient buildings are often tombs of kings.
Like the pyramids, for instance.
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.et:
Iidsed ehitised on tihti kuningate hauad.
Nagu näiteks püramiidid.

maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberStatueText
maps/RuinsOfAlphInnerChamber.asm::RuinsO.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberReceptionistText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
Welcome to this chamber.
There are sliding panels that depict
a #MON drawn by the ancients.
Slide the panels around to form the picture.
To the right is a description of the #MON.
Scientists in the back are examining
some newly found patterns.
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
Tere tulemast sellesse kambrisse.
Siin on nihutatavad paneelid, mis kujutavad
iidsete joonistatud #MONi.
Nihuta paneele, et moodustada pilt.
Paremal on #MONi kirjeldus.
Teadlased taga uurivad
mõningaid äsja leitud mustreid.

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistCrypticText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
Recently, strange, cryptic patterns have appeared.
It's odd. They weren't here a little while ago…
You should take a look at the walls.
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
Hiljuti on ilmunud imelikke, krüptilisi mustreid.
Veider. Neid polnud siin veel hetk tagasi…
Peaksid seinu vaatama.

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistHoleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
Ah! Here's another huge hole!
It's big enough to go through!
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
Ah! Siin on veel üks tohutu auk!
See on piisavalt suur, et läbi minna!

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistTremorText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
That tremor was pretty scary!
But I'm more concerned about this wall here…
The patterns on the wall appear to be words!
And those sliding stone panels seem
to be signals of some kind.
I think they make #MON appear,
but it's not clear yet…
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
See värin oli päris hirmus!
Aga rohkem muretsen selle seina pärast…
Seina mustrid näivad olevat sõnad!
Ja need nihutatavad kivipaneelid näivad
olevat mingisugused signaalid.
Arvan, et need panevad #MONid ilmuma,
aga see pole veel selge…

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberWallPatternLeftText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
Patterns appeared on the walls…
It's UNOWN text!
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
Seintele ilmusid mustrid…
See on UNOWN-kiri!

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberWallHoleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en: There's a big hole in the wall!

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberDescriptionText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.en:
A #MON that hid on the sea floor.
Eyes on its back scanned the area.
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber.asm::Ruins.et:
#MON, kes peitis end merepõhjas.
Selja silmad skännisid ümbrust.

maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoItemRoom.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoItemRoomAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphKabutoItemRoom.asm::Ruin.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberWallPatternLeftText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.en:
Patterns appeared on the walls…
It's UNOWN text!
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.et:
Seintele ilmusid mustrid…
See on UNOWN-kiri!

maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberWallHoleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.en: There's a big hole in the wall!

maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberDescriptionText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.en:
This #MON drifted in the
sea by twisting its ten tentacles.
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamber.asm::Ruin.et:
See #MON triivis meres,
keerutades oma kümmet kombitsat.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteItemRoom.asm::Rui.label: RuinsOfAlphOmanyteItemRoomAncientReplicaText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOmanyteItemRoom.asm::Rui.en: It's a replica of an ancient #MON.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideScientistText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
Hm? That's a #DEX, isn't it? May I see it?
There are so many kinds of #MON.
Hm? What's this?
What is this #MON?
It looks like the strange writing on
the walls of the RUINS.
If those drawings are really #MON, there should be many more.
I know! Let me upgrade your #DEX. Follow me.
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.et:
Hm? See on #DEX, kas pole? Kas tohin seda näha?
On nii palju #MONi liike.
Hm? Mis see on?
Mis #MON see on?
See näeb välja nagu imelik kiri
VAREMETE seintel.
Kui need joonistused on tõesti #MONid, peaks neid olema palju rohkem.
Tean! Lase mul su #DEX täiendada. Järgne mulle.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.label: SuperNerdStanSeenText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.en: What do you want? I'm studying-don't disturb me!
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.et: Mida sa tahad? Ma õpin - ära sega mind!

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.label: SuperNerdStanBeatenText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.en:
Sorry… I'm frustrated by
our lack of real understanding…
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.et:
Vabandust… Olen frustreeritud
meie tõelise mõistmise puudumisest…

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.label: SuperNerdStanAfterBattleText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.en:
The RUINS are from about 1500 years ago.
Nobody knows who built them.
It's also not known if the #MON statues have any meaning.
It's all one big mystery…
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::SuperNerdSt.et:
VAREMED on umbes 1500 aasta tagant.
Keegi ei tea, kes need ehitas.
Samuti pole teada, kas #MON-kujudel on mingi tähendus.
See kõik on üks suur mõistatus…

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::PsychicNath.label: PsychicNathanSeenText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::PsychicNath.en: Hmmm… This is a strange place.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterSignText
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
RUINS OF ALPH RESEARCH CENTER
THE AUTHORITY ON THE RUINS OF ALPH
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.et:
ALPHI VAREMETE UURIMISKESKUS
ALPHI VAREMETE AUTORITEET

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText1
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
While exploring the RUINS, we
suddenly noticed an odd presence.
We all got scared and ran away.
You should be careful too.
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.et:
VAREMEID uurides märkasime
ootamatult imelikku kohalolu.
Me kõik ehmusime ja jooksime minema.
Sa peaksid ka ettevaatlik olema.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText2
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
The RUINS hide a huge secret!
…I think…

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster1Text
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
There are many kinds of UNOWN, so
we use them for our secret codes.
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.et:
UNOWNe on palju liike, seega
kasutame neid oma salakoodideks.

maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster2Text
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.en:
A… H… E… A… D… Hmm…
What?
I'm decoding this message!
maps/RuinsOfAlphOutside.asm::RuinsOfAlph.et:
A… H… E… A… D… Hmm…
Mida?
Dekodeerin seda sõnumit!

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterModifiedDexText
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
Done!
I modified your #DEX.
I added an optional #DEX
to store UNOWN data.
It records them in the sequence that they were caught.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Valmis!
Muutsin su #DEXi.
Lisasin valikulise #DEXi
UNOWN andmete talletamiseks.
See salvestab need püügijärjekorras.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3Text
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
The UNOWN you catch will all be recorded.
Check to see how many kinds exist.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Kõik püütud UNOWNid salvestatakse.
Vaata, mitu liiki on olemas.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3_PrinterAvailable
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
You caught all the UNOWN variations?
That's a great achievement!
I've set up the printer here for handling UNOWN.
Feel free to use it anytime.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Püüdsid kõik UNOWNi variatsioonid?
See on suur saavutus!
Seadsin siia UNOWNide jaoks printeri üles.
Kasuta seda vabalt igal ajal.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
The RUINS are about 1500 years old.
But it's not known why they were built--or by whom.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
VAREMED on umbes 1500 aastat vanad.
Aga pole teada, miks või kelle poolt need ehitati.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_GotUnownDex
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en: I wonder how many kinds of #MON are in the RUINS?

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_UnownAppeared
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
#MON appeared in the RUINS?
That's incredible news!
We'll need to investigate this.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
#MONe ilmus VAREMETESSE?
See on uskumatu uudis!
Peame seda uurima.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_GotAllUnown
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
Our investigation, with your help, is
giving us insight into the RUINS.
The RUINS appear to have been built
as a habitat for #MON.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Meie uurimine, sinu abiga,
annab meile VAREMETE kohta teadmisi.
VAREMED näivad olevat ehitatud
#MONide elupaigaks.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
There are odd patterns drawn on the
walls of the RUINS.
They must be the keys for unraveling the mystery of the RUINS.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
VAREMETE seintele on joonistatud
imelikke mustreid.
Need peavad olema võtmed VAREMETE saladuse lahendamiseks.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_UnownAppeared
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
The strange #MON you saw in the RUINS?
They appear to be very much like the
drawings on the walls there.
Hmm…
That must mean there are many kinds of them…
We think something caused the cryptic
patterns to appear in the RUINS.
We've focused our studies on that.
According to my research…
Those mysterious patterns appeared
when the #COM CENTER was built.
It must mean that radio waves have
some sort of a link…
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Need imelikud #MONid, keda VAREMETES nägid?
Nad näivad väga sarnased
sealsete seinajoonistustega.
Hmm…
See peab tähendama, et neid on palju liike…
Arvame, et miski põhjustas nende
krüptiliste mustrite ilmumise VAREMETESSE.
Oleme keskendunud selle uurimisele.
Minu uuringute kohaselt…
Need salapärased mustrid ilmusid,
kui #COM KESKUS ehitati.
See peab tähendama, et raadiolainetel
on mingi seos…

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_GotAllUnown
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
Why did those ancient patterns
appear on the wall now?
The mystery deepens…
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Miks need iidsed mustrid
nüüd seinale ilmusid?
Mõistatus süveneb…

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterComputerText_GotAllUnown
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
Mystery #MON Name: UNOWN
A total of {d:NUM_UNOWN} kinds found.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Salapärane #MON, nimi: UNOWN
Kokku leitud {d:NUM_UNOWN} liiki.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterPrinterText_DoesntWork
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en: This doesn't seem to work yet.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterProfSilktreePhotoText
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
It's a photo of the RESEARCH
CENTER'S founder, PROF.SILKTREE.
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
See on foto UURIMIS
KESKUSE asutajast, PROF.SILKTREEST.

maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterAcademicBooksText
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.en:
There are many academic books.
Ancient Ruins… Mysteries of the Ancients…
maps/RuinsOfAlphResearchCenter.asm::Ruin.et:
Siin on palju teadusraamatuid.
Iidsed varemed… Muistsete saladused…

maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.label: WardensGranddaughterText1
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.en:
My grandpa is the SAFARI ZONE WARDEN.
At least he was…
He decided to go on a vacation and
took off overseas all by himself.
He quit running SAFARI ZONE just like that.
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.et:
Mu vanaisa on SAFARI ZONE VALVUR.
Vähemalt oli…
Ta otsustas puhkusele minna ja
sõitis üksi välismaale.
Ta lõpetas SAFARI ZONE juhtimise lihtsalt niisama.

maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.label: WardensGranddaughterText2
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.en:
Many people were disappointed that
SAFARI ZONE closed down, but Grandpa is so stubborn…
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardensG.et:
Paljud olid pettunud, et
SAFARI ZONE suleti, aga vanaisa on nii kangekaelne…

maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardenPh.label: WardenPhotoText
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardenPh.en:
It's a photo of a grinning old man
who's surrounded by #MON.
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::WardenPh.et:
See on foto irvitavast vanamehest,
keda ümbritsevad #MONid.

maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::SafariZo.label: SafariZonePhotoText
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::SafariZo.en:
It's a photo of a huge grassy plain
with rare #MON frolicking in it.
maps/SafariZoneWardensHome.asm::SafariZo.et:
See on foto tohutust rohtusest tasandikust,
kus haruldased #MONid hullavad.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.label: SaffronCityLass1Text
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.en:
A little girl who is an expert at
mimicking people lives here.
She even mimics the people she's
conversing with. It's confusing.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.et:
Siin elab väike tüdruk, kes on inimeste matkimises meister.
Ta matkib isegi neid, kellega vestleb. See on segadusseajav.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.label: SaffronCityLass1Text_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.en:
The COPYCAT girl looked unhappy.
She said she lost her favorite # DOLL--CLEFAIRY.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass1Te.et:
MATKIJA-tüdruk nägi õnnetu välja.
Ta ütles, et kaotas oma lemmik-# NUKU — CLEFAIRY.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.label: SaffronCityPokefanMText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.en:
You came out from JOHTO?
You can zip back home if the MAGNET TRAIN's running.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.et:
Tulid välja JOHTOST?
Saad kähku koju, kui MAGNETRONG sõidab.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.label: SaffronCityPokefanMText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.en:
You came out from JOHTO?
You can zip back home by hopping on the MAGNET TRAIN.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityPokefan.et:
Tulid välja JOHTOST?
Saad kähku koju, hüpates MAGNETRONGILE.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.label: SaffronCityCooltrainerMText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.en:
I went to the GYM, raring for battles against trainers…
It turns out, I stumbled into the
unused GYM next door.
Boy, I was pretty embarrassed.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.et:
Läksin SAALI, ihates treeneritega võidelda…
Selgus, et komberdasin kõrvalasuvasse kasutusse SAALI.
Poiss, mul oli päris piinlik.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.label: SaffronCityCooltrainerFText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.en:
This is SILPH CO., famous for #MON merchandise.
In the past, TEAM ROCKET wanted the
company because of that.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityCooltra.et:
See on SILPH CO., kuulus #MONi kaubandusest.
Vanasti tahtis RAKETI KAMP seda firmat just seetõttu.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.label: SaffronCityFisherText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.en:
Chew… Chew…
I hear there's big trouble brewing at the POWER PLANT.
Chew… Chew…
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.et:
Näts… Näts…
Kuulen, et ELEKTRIJAAMAS on suur pahandus tulekul.
Näts… Näts…

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.label: SaffronCityFisherText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.en:
Chew… Chew…
I hear there was big trouble at the POWER PLANT.
Chew… Chew… Haaah, I'm full!
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityFisherT.et:
Näts… Näts…
Kuulen, et ELEKTRIJAAMAS oli suur pahandus.
Näts… Näts… Haaah, olen täis!

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.label: SaffronCityYoungster1Text
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.en:
Going into an alley for the
first time makes me sorta anxious.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.et: Esimest korda tänavavahele minek teeb mind kuidagi ärevaks.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.label: SaffronCityYoungster2Text
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.en:
There's a place called TRAINER
HOUSE in VIRIDIAN where trainers
gather from all over the place.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityYoungst.et: VIRIDIANIS on paik nimega TREENERIMAJA, kuhu koguneb treenereid kõikjalt.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass2Te.label: SaffronCityLass2Text
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass2Te.en:
Our city was featured on a radio program.
It's nice to hear praise for your
city, but it's a bit embarrassing too.
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCityLass2Te.et:
Meie linnast tehti raadiosaade.
On tore kuulda oma linna kiitust, aga ka veidi piinlik.

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCitySignTex.label: SaffronCitySignText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronCitySignTex.en:
SAFFRON CITY
Shining, Golden Land of Commerce

maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronGymSignText.label: SaffronGymSignText
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronGymSignText.en:
SAFFRON CITY #MON GYM LEADER: SABRINA
The Master of Psychic #MON!
maps/SaffronCity.asm::SaffronGymSignText.et:
SAFFRON CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: SABRINA
Vaimsete #MONide meister!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaIntroText.label: SabrinaIntroText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaIntroText.en:
SABRINA: I knew you were coming…
Three years ago I had a vision of your arrival.
You're after my BADGE.
I don't enjoy battling, but it's my
duty as a LEADER to confer BADGES
on anyone who has proven him- or herself worthy.
Since you wish it, I will show you my psychic powers!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaIntroText.et:
SABRINA: Teadsin, et sa tuled…
Kolm aastat tagasi nägin sinu saabumist nägemuses.
Sa oled mu MÄRGI järel.
Mulle ei meeldi võidelda, aga JUHINA on mu kohus anda MÄRKE igaühele, kes on end väärivaks tõestanud.
Kuna sa seda soovid, näitan sulle oma vaimseid võimeid!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaWinLossText.label: SabrinaWinLossText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaWinLossText.en:
SABRINA: Your power…
It far exceeds what I foresaw…
Maybe it isn't possible to fully
predict what the future holds…
OK, you win. You earned yourself MARSHBADGE.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaWinLossText.et:
SABRINA: Sinu vägi…
See ületab kaugelt selle, mida ette nägin…
Ehk polegi võimalik tulevikku täielikult ennustada…
Olgu, sa võidad. Teenisid endale MARSHBADGE.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaMarshBadgeTe.label: SabrinaMarshBadgeText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaMarshBadgeTe.en:
SABRINA: MARSHBADGE draws out
your subliminal powers…
Although I failed to accurately predict your power, this much I know to be true.
You will become a celebrated and beloved CHAMPION!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaMarshBadgeTe.et:
SABRINA: MARSHBADGE toob esile su alateadlikud jõud…
Kuigi ma ei suutnud su väge täpselt ennustada, seda tean kindlalt.
Sinust saab tunnustatud ja armastatud TŠEMPION!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaFightDoneTex.label: SabrinaFightDoneText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaFightDoneTex.en:
SABRINA: Your love for your #MON
overwhelmed my psychic power…
The power of love, I think, is also a
kind of psychic power…
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SabrinaFightDoneTex.et:
SABRINA: Sinu armastus oma #MONide vastu ületas mu vaimse väe…
Armastuse vägi on vist samuti üks vaimne vägi…

maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumRebeccaSeenTe.label: MediumRebeccaSeenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumRebeccaSeenTe.en: The power of all those you defeated comes to me!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumRebeccaSeenTe.et: Kõigi nende vägi, keda alistasid, tuleb minu kätte!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumRebeccaAfterB.label: MediumRebeccaAfterBattleText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumRebeccaAfterB.en: What is the source of your power?

maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinSeen.label: PsychicFranklinSeenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinSeen.en: Psychic power is the power of your soul.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinSeen.et: Vaimne vägi on sinu hinge vägi.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinBeat.label: PsychicFranklinBeatenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinBeat.en: Your soul has more power than mine!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinBeat.et: Sinu hingel on rohkem väge kui minu omal!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinAfte.label: PsychicFranklinAfterBattleText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinAfte.en: You made your soul stronger, not just your abilities.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicFranklinAfte.et: Sa tegid oma hinge tugevamaks, mitte ainult oma võimed.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisSeenText.label: MediumDorisSeenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisSeenText.en:
Fufufufu… I see it clearly.
I can see into your soul!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisSeenText.et:
Fufufuu… Näen seda selgelt.
Näen sinu hinge sisse!

maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisBeatenTe.label: MediumDorisBeatenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisBeatenTe.en: Though I read you, I still lost…

maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisAfterBat.label: MediumDorisAfterBattleText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisAfterBat.en: Darn! I forgot that I predicted I would lose to you.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::MediumDorisAfterBat.et: Pagan! Unustasin, et ennustasin, et sulle kaotan.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredSeenTex.label: PsychicJaredSeenText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredSeenTex.en: The FIGHTING DOJO next door was once this city's GYM.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredSeenTex.et: Kõrvalasuv VÕITLUSDOJO oli kunagi selle linna SAAL.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredAfterBa.label: PsychicJaredAfterBattleText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredAfterBa.en:
KARATE KING, the master of the
FIGHTING DOJO, was just destroyed by SABRINA.
maps/SaffronGym.asm::PsychicJaredAfterBa.et: KARATEKUNN, VÕITLUSDOJO meister, sai just SABRINALT hävitatud.

maps/SaffronGym.asm::SaffronGymGuideText.label: SaffronGymGuideText
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SaffronGymGuideText.en:
Yo, CHAMP in making!
A trainer as skilled as you
doesn't need to be told how to deal
with psychic-type #MON, right?
I expect great things from you!
Good luck!
maps/SaffronGym.asm::SaffronGymGuideText.et:
Hei, tulevane TŠEMPION!
Sinusugusele osavale treenerile pole vaja öelda, kuidas vaimse-tüüpi #MONidega toime tulla, eks?
Ootan sinult suuri asju! Edu!

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerTrainIsntOperatingText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en: I'm sorry, but the MAGNET TRAIN isn't operating now.
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et: Vabandust, aga MAGNETRONG praegu ei sõida.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYouComingOnBoardText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
We'll soon depart for GOLDENROD.
Are you coming on board?
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Lahkume peagi GOLDENRODI.
Kas tuled pardale?

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightThisWayText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
May I see your rail PASS, please?
OK. Right this way, please.
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Kas tohin näha su rongi-PASSi?
OK. Siiapoole, palun.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDontHaveAPassText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en: Sorry, but you don't have a PASS.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeToSeeYouAgainText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en: We hope to see you again.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrivedInSaffronText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
We have arrived in SAFFRON.
We hope to see you again.
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Saabusime SAFFRONI.
Loodame sind jälle näha.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
The MAGNET TRAIN is a super-modern
rail liner that uses electricity
and magnets to attain incredible speed.
However, if there isn't any electricity…
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
MAGNETRONG on ülimoodne
rongiliin, mis kasutab elektrit
ja magneteid uskumatu kiiruse saavutamiseks.
Kuid kui elektrit pole…

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText_ReturnedMachinePart
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
Whew…
How many times have I gone back
and forth between KANTO and JOHTO?
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Uhh…
Mitu korda olen käinud
edasi-tagasi KANTO ja JOHTO vahet?

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationTeacherText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
Before the MAGNET TRAIN STATION was
built, there was a house there.
A little girl named COPYCAT used to live there.
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Enne MAGNETRONGI JAAMA
ehitamist oli seal maja.
Seal elas väike tüdruk nimega COPYCAT.

maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationLassText
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.en:
Hi. Do you have a rail PASS? I have
one. All the people in SAFFRON who
ride the MAGNET TRAIN have PASSES.
maps/SaffronMagnetTrainStation.asm::Saff.et:
Tere. Kas sul on rongi-PASS? Mul
on. Kõigil SAFFRONI inimestel, kes
MAGNETRONGIGA sõidavad, on PASSid.

maps/SaffronMart.asm::SaffronMartCooltra.label: SaffronMartCooltrainerMText
maps/SaffronMart.asm::SaffronMartCooltra.en: There's a big RADIO TOWER in LAVENDER.

maps/SaffronMart.asm::SaffronMartCooltra.label: SaffronMartCooltrainerFText
maps/SaffronMart.asm::SaffronMartCooltra.en:
I want to become stronger, but I'm not good yet…
Could you show me how sometime?
maps/SaffronMart.asm::SaffronMartCooltra.et:
Tahan saada tugevamaks, aga pole veel hea…
Kas näitaksid mulle millalgi, kuidas?

maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.label: SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherText
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.en:
What are JOHTO's #MON CENTERS like?
…Oh, I see. So they're not much
different from the ones in KANTO.
I can go to JOHTO without worrying, then!
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.et:
Millised on JOHTO #MON KESKUSED?
…Oh, ma näen. Nii et need ei erine
kuigi palju KANTO omadest.
Siis saan JOHTOSSE minna muretult!

maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.label: SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherMobileText
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.en:
What are JOHTO's #MON CENTERS like?
…Oh, I see. So they let you
link with people far away?
Then I'll get my friend in JOHTO to
catch a MARILL and trade it to me!
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.et:
Millised on JOHTO #MON KESKUSED?
…Oh, ma näen. Nii et need lasevad
sind kaugete inimestega ühenduda?
Siis palun oma JOHTO sõbral
püüda MARILL ja mulle vahetada!

maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.label: SaffronPokecenter1FFisherText
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.en:
I just happened to come through ROCK
TUNNEL. There was some commotion at the POWER PLANT.
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.et:
Sattusin just läbi ROCK
TUNNELI. POWER PLANTIS oli mingi sagimine.

maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.label: SaffronPokecenter1FFisherReturnedMachinePartText
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.en:
Caves collapse easily.
Several caves have disappeared in the
past few years, like the one outside CERULEAN.
As a pro HIKER, that's common knowledge.
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.et:
Koopad varisevad kergesti.
Mitu koobast on viimastel aastatel
kadunud, nagu see CERULEANI juures.
Profina HIKERina on see üldteadmine.

maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.label: SaffronPokecenter1FYoungsterText
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.en:
SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE and the
MAGNET TRAIN STATION--they're the
places to see in SAFFRON.
maps/SaffronPokecenter1F.asm::SaffronPok.et:
SILPH CO. PEAKONTOR ja
MAGNETRONGI JAAM - need on
SAFFRONI vaatamisväärsused.

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineIntroText.label: BlaineIntroText
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineIntroText.en:
BLAINE: Waaah!
My GYM in CINNABAR burned down.
My fire-breathing #MON and I are
homeless because of the volcano.
Waaah!
But I'm back in business as a GYM
LEADER here in this cave.
If you can beat me, I'll give you a BADGE.
Ha! You'd better have BURN HEAL!
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineIntroText.et:
BLAINE: Vaaah!
Mu SAAL CINNABARIS põles maha.
Mina ja mu tuldpurskavad #MONid oleme
vulkaani tõttu kodutud.
Vaaah!
Aga olen tagasi äris SAALI
JUHINA siin selles koopas.
Kui suudad mind alistada, annan sulle MÄRGI.
Ha! Sul oleks parem BURN HEAL olla!

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineWinLossText.label: BlaineWinLossText
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineWinLossText.en:
BLAINE: Awesome. I've burned out…
You've earned VOLCANOBADGE!
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineWinLossText.et:
BLAINE: Vägev. Olen läbi põlenud…
Teenisid VOLCANOBADGE!

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineAfterBattleTe.label: BlaineAfterBattleText
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineAfterBattleTe.en:
BLAINE: I did lose this time, but I'm
going to win the next time.
When I rebuild my CINNABAR GYM,
we'll have to have a rematch.
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineAfterBattleTe.et:
BLAINE: Kaotasin seekord, aga
järgmisel korral võidan.
Kui ehitan oma CINNABARI SAALI uuesti,
peame korraldama tagasimatši.

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineFightDoneText.label: BlaineFightDoneText
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineFightDoneText.en:
BLAINE: My fire #MON will be
even stronger. Just you watch!
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::BlaineFightDoneText.et:
BLAINE: Mu tule-#MONid saavad
veelgi tugevamaks. Sa vaata vaid!

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.label: SeafoamGymGuideWinText
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.en:
Yo!
… Huh? It's over already?
Sorry, sorry!
CINNABAR GYM was gone, so I didn't
know where to find you.
But, hey, you're plenty strong even
without my advice. I knew you'd win!
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.et:
Jou!
… Häh? Kas juba läbi?
Vabandust, vabandust!
CINNABARI SAAL oli kadunud, seega ma
ei teadnud, kust sind leida.
Aga hei, sa oled ka ilma
mu nõuandeta kõva. Teadsin, et võidad!

maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.label: SeafoamGymGuideWinText2
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.en:
A #MON GYM can be anywhere as
long as the GYM LEADER is there.
There's no need for a building.
maps/SeafoamGym.asm::SeafoamGymGuideWinT.et:
#MON SAAL võib olla kõikjal, kuni
SAALI JUHT on kohal.
Hoonet pole vaja.

maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoReceptionistT.label: SilphCoReceptionistText
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoReceptionistT.en: Welcome. This is SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE BUILDING.
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoReceptionistT.et: Tere tulemast. See on SILPH CO. PEAKONTORIHOONE.

maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText.label: SilphCoOfficerText
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText.en:
Only employees are permitted to go upstairs.
But since you came such a long way,
have this neat little souvenir.
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText.et:
Üles tohivad minna ainult töötajad.
Aga kuna tulid nii kaugelt,
võta see kena väike suveniir.

maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText_G.label: SilphCoOfficerText_GotUpGrade
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText_G.en:
It's SILPH CO.'s latest product.
It's not for sale anywhere yet.
maps/SilphCo1F.asm::SilphCoOfficerText_G.et:
See on SILPH CO. uusim toode.
Seda pole veel kusagil müügil.

maps/SilverCavePokecenter1F.asm::SilverC.label: SilverCavePokecenter1FGrannyText
maps/SilverCavePokecenter1F.asm::SilverC.en:
Trainers who seek power climb MT.
SILVER despite its many dangers…
With their trusted #MON, they must
feel they can go anywhere…
maps/SilverCavePokecenter1F.asm::SilverC.et:
Jõudu otsivad treenerid ronivad MT.
SILVERILE hoolimata selle paljudest ohtudest…
Oma usaldusväärsete #MONidega tunnevad nad,
et saavad minna kõikjale…

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.label: SlowpokeWellB1FKurtText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.en:
KURT: Hey there, <PLAYER>!
The guard up top took off when I shouted at him.
But then I took a tumble down the WELL.
I slammed down hard on my back, so I can't move.
Rats! If I were fit, my #MON
would've punished them…
Ah, it can't be helped.
<PLAYER>, show them how gutsy you are in my place!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.et:
KURT: Tervist, <PLAYER>!
Ülemine valvur jooksis minema, kui talle karjusin.
Aga siis kukkusin kaevu.
Prõmmisin selili maha, nüüd ei saa liikuda.
Pagan! Kui oleksin terve, oleks mu
#MONid neid karistanud…
Ah, midagi pole teha.
<PLAYER>, näita neile minu eest, kui vapper oled!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::KurtLeaveSlowp.label: KurtLeaveSlowpokeWellText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::KurtLeaveSlowp.en:
KURT: Way to go, <PLAYER>!
TEAM ROCKET has taken off.
My back's better too. Let's get out of here.
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::KurtLeaveSlowp.et:
KURT: Tubli töö, <PLAYER>!
RAKETI KAMP on jalga lasknud.
Selg on ka parem. Lähme siit minema.

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29SeenTe.label: GruntM29SeenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29SeenTe.en:
Darn! I was standing guard up top
when some old coot yelled at me.
He startled me so much that I fell down here.
I think I'll vent my anger by taking it out on you!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29SeenTe.et:
Pagan! Seisin üleval valvel,
kui üks vana krõbi mu peale karjus.
Ehmatasin nii ära, et kukkusin siia alla.
Maandan oma viha sinu peal!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29Beaten.label: GruntM29BeatenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29Beaten.en: Arrgh! This is NOT my day!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29Beaten.et: Arrgh! See EI OLE minu päev!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29AfterB.label: GruntM29AfterBattleText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29AfterB.en:
Sure, we've been hacking the tails
off SLOWPOKE and selling them.
Everything we do is for profit.
That's right! We're TEAM ROCKET,
and we'll do anything for money!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM29AfterB.et:
Jah, oleme SLOWPOKE'delt sabu
maha lõiganud ja müünud.
Kõik, mida teeme, on kasu nimel.
Just nii! Oleme RAKETI KAMP
ja teeme raha eest kõike!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1SeenTex.label: GruntM1SeenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1SeenTex.en:
What do you want?
If you interrupt our work, don't expect any mercy!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1SeenTex.et:
Mida sa tahad?
Kui meie tööd segad, halastust ära oota!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1BeatenT.label: GruntM1BeatenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1BeatenT.en: You did OK today, but wait till next time!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM1BeatenT.et: Täna läks sul hästi, aga oota järgmist korda!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::TrainerGruntM1.label: TrainerGruntM1WhenTalkText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::TrainerGruntM1.en:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET was broken up three years ago.
But we continued our activities underground.
Now you can have fun watching us stir up trouble!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::TrainerGruntM1.et:
Jah, RAKETI KAMP saadeti kolm aastat tagasi laiali.
Aga jätkasime tegevust põranda all.
Nüüd võid vaadata, kuidas me pahandust teeme!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2SeenTex.label: GruntM2SeenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2SeenTex.en:
Quit taking SLOWPOKETAILS?
If we obeyed you, TEAM ROCKET's rep would be ruined!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2SeenTex.et:
Lõpetada SLOWPOKETAILide võtmine?
Kui kuuletuksime, oleks RAKETI KAMBA maine rikutud!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2AfterBa.label: GruntM2AfterBattleText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2AfterBa.en:
We need the money, but selling SLOWPOKETAILS?
It's tough being a ROCKET GRUNT!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntM2AfterBa.et:
Raha vajame, aga SLOWPOKETAILide müük?
Raske on olla RAKETI TÜÜP!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1SeenTex.label: GruntF1SeenText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1SeenTex.en:
Stop taking TAILS?
Yeah, just try to defeat all of us!
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1SeenTex.et:
Lõpetada sabade võtmine?
Jah, proovi meid kõiki alistada!

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1AfterBa.label: GruntF1AfterBattleText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1AfterBa.en:
SLOWPOKETAILS grow back fast!
What's wrong with selling them?
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::GruntF1AfterBa.et:
SLOWPOKETAILid kasvavad kiiresti tagasi!
Mis nende müümises viga on?

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.label: SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeWithMailText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.en:
A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…
Huh? It has MAIL. Read it?
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.et:
SLOWPOKE, kellel saba maha lõigatud…
Ah? Sellel on MAIL. Lugeda?

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.label: SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeMailText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.en:
<PLAYER> read the MAIL.
Be good and look after the house
with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.
Love, Dad
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.et:
<PLAYER> luges MAILi.
Ole tubli ja hoia maja
koos vanaisa ja SLOWPOKE'ga.
Armastusega, isa

maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.label: SlowpokeWellB1FTaillessSlowpokeText
maps/SlowpokeWellB1F.asm::SlowpokeWellB1.en: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…

maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.label: SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText
maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.en:
I'm waiting to see SLOWPOKE's moment of evolution.
Through observation, I made a new discovery.
A SLOWPOKE with a KING'S ROCK often
gets bitten by a SHELLDER.
Here, I'll share a KING'S ROCK with you.
maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.et:
Ootan, et näha SLOWPOKE arenemise hetke.
Vaatluse teel tegin uue avastuse.
KING'S ROCKiga SLOWPOKEt
hammustab tihti SHELLDER.
Siin, jagan sinuga KING'S ROCKi.

maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.label: SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText_GotKingsRock
maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.en:
I'm going to be like SLOWPOKE.
I'll wait patiently, so I can see one evolve.
maps/SlowpokeWellB2F.asm::SlowpokeWellB2.et:
Hakkan olema nagu SLOWPOKE.
Ootan kannatlikult, et näha üht arenemas.

maps/SoulHouse.asm::MrFujiText.label: MrFujiText
maps/SoulHouse.asm::MrFujiText.en:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.
Hmm… You appear to be raising your
#MON in a kind and loving manner.
#MON lovers come here to pay
their respects to departed #MON.
Please offer condolences for the
souls of the departed #MON.
I'm sure that will make them happy.
maps/SoulHouse.asm::MrFujiText.et:
MR.FUJI: Tere tulemast.
Hmm… Tundub, et kasvatad oma
#MONe lahkelt ja armastavalt.
#MONide armastajad tulevad siia
avaldama austust lahkunud #MONidele.
Avalda palun kaastunnet
lahkunud #MONide hingedele.
Olen kindel, et see teeb nad õnnelikuks.

maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseTeacherText.label: SoulHouseTeacherText
maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseTeacherText.en:
There are other graves of #MON here, I think.
There are many chambers that only MR.FUJI may enter.
maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseTeacherText.et:
Siin on vist veel teisi #MONide haudu.
On palju kambreid, kuhu ainult MR.FUJI võib siseneda.

maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseLassText.label: SoulHouseLassText
maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseLassText.en: I came with my mom to visit #MON graves…

maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseGrannyText.label: SoulHouseGrannyText
maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseGrannyText.en:
The #MON that lived with me…
I loved them like my grandchildren…
maps/SoulHouse.asm::SoulHouseGrannyText.et:
#MONid, kes minuga elasid…
Armastasin neid nagu oma lapselapsi…

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowSeenText.label: SageChowSeenText
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowSeenText.en:
We stand guard in this tower.
Here, we express our gratitude to honor all #MON.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowSeenText.et:
Me valvame selles tornis.
Siin avaldame tänu, austades kõiki #MONe.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowAfterBat.label: SageChowAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowAfterBat.en:
All living beings coexist through cooperation.
We must always be thankful for this.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SageChowAfterBat.et:
Kõik elusolendid elavad koos tänu koostööle.
Selle eest peame alati tänulikud olema.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.label: SproutTower1FSage1Text
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.en: Only if you reach the top will you obtain an HM.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.et: HMi saad vaid siis, kui jõuad tippu.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.label: SproutTower1FSage2Text
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.en:
SPROUT TOWER was built long ago
as a place for #MON training.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSag.et:
SPROUT TOWER ehitati ammu
#MONide treenimise paigana.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FGra.label: SproutTower1FGrannyText
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FGra.en:
A BELLSPROUT over 100 feet tall…
People say that it became the center pillar here.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FGra.et:
Üle 30 meetri pikkune BELLSPROUT…
Räägitakse, et sellest sai siin kesksammas.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FTea.label: SproutTower1FTeacherText
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FTea.en:
See the pillar shaking?
People are training upstairs.

maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSta.label: SproutTower1FStatueText
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSta.en:
A #MON statue…
It looks very distinguished.
maps/SproutTower1F.asm::SproutTower1FSta.et:
#MONi kuju…
See näeb väga väärikas välja.

maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoSeenText.label: SageNicoSeenText
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoSeenText.en: However hard we battle, the TOWER will stand strong.
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoSeenText.et: Ükskõik kui kõvasti võitleme, torn püsib tugev.

maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoBeatenTe.label: SageNicoBeatenText
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoBeatenTe.en: I fought hard but I'm too weak.
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoBeatenTe.et: Võitlesin kõvasti, kuid olen liiga nõrk.

maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoAfterBat.label: SageNicoAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoAfterBat.en:
The flexible pillar protects the
TOWER, even from earthquakes.
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageNicoAfterBat.et:
Paindlik sammas kaitseb torni
isegi maavärinate eest.

maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageEdmondAfterB.label: SageEdmondAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageEdmondAfterB.en:
I tried to copy BELLSPROUT's
gentle movements for battle…
But I didn't train well enough.
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SageEdmondAfterB.et:
Püüdsin lahingus järele teha
BELLSPROUTI õrnu liigutusi…
Aga ei treeninud piisavalt hästi.

maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SproutTower2FSta.label: SproutTower2FStatueText
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SproutTower2FSta.en:
A #MON statue…
It looks very distinguished.
maps/SproutTower2F.asm::SproutTower2FSta.et:
#MONi kuju…
See näeb väga väärikas välja.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerElder.label: SproutTowerElderLecturesRivalText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerElder.en:
ELDER: You are indeed skilled as a trainer.
As promised, here is your HM.
But let me say this: You should
treat your #MON better.
The way you battle is far too harsh.
#MON are not tools of war…
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerElder.et:
VANEM: Oled treenerina tõesti osav.
Nagu lubatud, siin on su HM.
Kuid ütlen nõnda: sa peaksid
oma #MONe paremini kohtlema.
Sinu võitlusviis on liiga karm.
#MONid pole sõjariistad…

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerRival.label: SproutTowerRivalOnlyCareAboutStrongText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerRival.en:
… …Humph!
He claims to be the ELDER but he's weak.
It stands to reason.
I'd never lose to fools who babble
about being nice to #MON.
I only care about strong #MON that can win.
I really couldn't care less about weak #MON.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTowerRival.et:
… …Hmph!
Ta väidab end VANEM olevat, aga on nõrk.
See on ju loogiline.
Ma ei kaotaks iial lollidele, kes lobisevad
#MONide vastu kena olemisest.
Mind huvitavad vaid tugevad, võidukad #MONid.
Nõrgad #MONid ei koti mind sugugi.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiSeenText.label: SageLiSeenText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiSeenText.en:
So good of you to come here!
SPROUT TOWER is a place of training.
People and #MON test their bonds
to build a bright future together.
I am the final test.
Allow me to check the ties between
your #MON and you!
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiSeenText.et:
Kui tore, et siia tulid!
SPROUT TOWER on väljaõppe paik.
Inimesed ja #MONid panevad oma sideme
proovile, et ehitada helge tulevik.
Mina olen viimane katsumus.
Lubage kontrollida sidet sinu
ja su #MONide vahel!

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiTakeThisFl.label: SageLiTakeThisFlashText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiTakeThisFl.en:
You and your #MON should have
no problem using this move.
Take this FLASH HM.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiTakeThisFl.et:
Sina ja su #MONid ei tohiks
selle rünnaku kasutamisega hätta jääda.
Võta see FLASH HM.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiFlashExpla.label: SageLiFlashExplanationText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiFlashExpla.en:
FLASH illuminates even the darkest of all places.
But to use it out of battle, you
need the BADGE from VIOLET's GYM.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiFlashExpla.et:
FLASH valgustab isegi kõige pimedamaid paiku.
Aga et seda väljaspool lahingut kasutada,
vajad VIOLETI SAALI MÄRKI.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiAfterBattl.label: SageLiAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiAfterBattl.en: I hope you learn and grow from your journey.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageLiAfterBattl.et: Loodan, et teekond õpetab ja kasvatab sind.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageJinSeenText.label: SageJinSeenText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageJinSeenText.en: I train to find enlightenment in #MON!

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageJinAfterBatt.label: SageJinAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageJinAfterBatt.en:
As #MON grow stronger, so does the trainer.
No, wait. As the trainer grows
stronger, so do the #MON.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageJinAfterBatt.et:
Kui #MON tugevneb, tugevneb ka treener.
Ei, oota. Kui treener tugevneb,
tugevnevad ka #MONid.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageTroySeenText.label: SageTroySeenText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageTroySeenText.en: Let me see how much you trust your #MON.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageTroySeenText.et: Vaatan, kui palju sa oma #MONe usaldad.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageTroyAfterBat.label: SageTroyAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageTroyAfterBat.en: It is not far to the ELDER.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealSeenText.label: SageNealSeenText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealSeenText.en: The ELDER's HM lights even pitchblack darkness.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealSeenText.et: VANEMA HM valgustab kas või pilkast pimedust.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealBeatenTe.label: SageNealBeatenText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealBeatenTe.en: It is my head that is bright!

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealAfterBat.label: SageNealAfterBattleText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SageNealAfterBat.en: Let there be light on your journey.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTower3FPai.label: SproutTower3FPaintingText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTower3FPai.en: It's a powerful painting of a BELLSPROUT.

maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTower3FSta.label: SproutTower3FStatueText
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTower3FSta.en:
A #MON statue…
It looks very distinguished.
maps/SproutTower3F.asm::SproutTower3FSta.et:
#MONi kuju…
See näeb väga väärikas välja.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::CameraGrunt2.label: CameraGrunt2SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::CameraGrunt2.en: It's my turn! There's no escape!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::CameraGrunt2.label: CameraGrunt2BeatenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::CameraGrunt2.en:
Surveillance cams are in the #MON statues.
We'll keep appearing until you trip a secret switch.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::CameraGrunt2.et:
Valvekaamerad on #MONi kujudes.
Ilmume aina uuesti, kuni vajutad salalülitit.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.label: ScientistJedSeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.en:
This was once a ninja hideout.
There are traps to confound intruders like you.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.et:
