See oli kunagi nindžade peidik.
Siin on lõkse, et sinusuguseid sissetungijaid segadusse ajada.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.label: ScientistJedAfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.en:
All right. I'll divulge a secret about our hideout.
That thing on the floor up ahead is a warp panel.
If you step on it, you'll be warped
back to the entrance.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::ScientistJed.et:
Hea küll. Reedan ühe peidiku saladuse.
See asi eespool põrandal on teleportipaneel.
Sellele astudes teleporditakse sind tagasi sissepääsu juurde.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Seen.label: GruntM16SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Seen.en:
Heheh. Feeling lucky, punk?
Go ahead, take another step.
We've got traps set in the floor!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Seen.et:
Hehee. Tunned end õnnelikuna, nolk?
Astu aga järgmine samm.
Põrandas on lõksud!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Afte.label: GruntM16AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Afte.en:
I don't even know where the traps are planted.
You'll just have to collect your courage and walk.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::GruntM16Afte.et:
Ma isegi ei tea, kus lõksud on.
Pead lihtsalt julguse koguma ja kõndima.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::TeamRocketBa.label: TeamRocketBaseB1FSecurityCameraText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::TeamRocketBa.en:
It's a PERSIAN statue…
Its eyes are oddly shiny.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::TeamRocketBa.et:
See on PERSIANi kuju…
Ta silmad on imelikult läikivad.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::TeamRocketBa.label: TeamRocketBaseB1FSecretSwitchText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB1F.asm::TeamRocketBa.en: A secret switch! Better press it.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.label: RocketBaseBossFThrashText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.en:
We can't have a brat like you on the loose.
It's harmful to TEAM ROCKET's pride, you see.
However strong you may be, you can't
take both of us at the same time.
Sorry, baby. Now get ready to be thrashed.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.et:
Me ei saa lasta sinusugusel jõmpsikal vabalt ringi liikuda.
See kahjustab RAKETI KAMBA uhkust.
Oled ehk tugev, aga meid mõlemat korraga sa ei võida.
Vabandust, kullake. Nüüd valmistu peksa saama.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLanceShareFunText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en: Hey! Don't be so selfish. Spread the fun around.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et: Hei! Ära ole nii isekas. Jaga lõbu ka teistega.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.label: RocketBaseBossDontMeddleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.en:
What? You had an accomplice?
Where is your sense of honor?
As the interim boss in place of
GIOVANNI, I'll show you how wrong
it is to meddle with TEAM ROCKET!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.et:
Mis? Sul oli kaasosaline?
Kus on su aumeel?
GIOVANNI asemel ajutise bossina näitan sulle, kui vale on RAKETI KAMBA asjadesse sekkuda!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.label: RocketBaseBossWinText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.en:
Tch, you really are strong.
It's too bad.
If you were to join TEAM ROCKET,
you could become an EXECUTIVE.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.et:
Tsah, sa tõesti oled tugev.
Kahju küll.
Kui liituksid RAKETI KAMBAGA, võiksid saada EXECUTIVEks.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.label: RocketBaseBossRetreatText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.en:
…This hideout is done for…
But that's fine. The broadcast experiment was a total success.
It doesn't matter what happens to this hideout now.
We have much bigger plans.
You'll come to appreciate TEAM
ROCKET's true power soon enough.
Enjoy yourself while you can…
Fufufufu…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseBo.et:
…See peidik on läbi…
Aga pole viga. Ülekande katse õnnestus täielikult.
Pole vahet, mis selle peidikuga nüüd juhtub.
Meil on palju suuremad plaanid.
Varsti mõistad RAKETI KAMBA tõelist väge.
Naudi, kuni saad…
Fufufuu…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLancePostBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en:
LANCE: That did it. We defeated
all the ROCKETS here.
But I'm concerned about the young
guy I battled in the process…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et:
LANCE: See tegi asja ära. Alistasime kõik siinsed RAKETID.
Aga mind teeb murelikuks see noormees, kellega vahepeal võitlesin…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLancePowerOffText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en:
Sorry, <PLAY_G>. I saw how well you
were doing, so I just hung back.
Now all there is left to do is to
turn off that odd radio signal.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et:
Vabandust, <PLAY_G>. Nägin, kui hästi sul läks, nii et jäin tahaplaanile.
Nüüd on jäänud vaid see imelik raadiosignaal välja lülitada.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RockerBaseLa.label: RockerBaseLanceElectrodeFaintText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RockerBaseLa.en:
It's this machine that's causing all the problems.
I don't see a switch on it…
We have no choice. We have to make
all the ELECTRODE faint.
That should stop this machine from
transmitting that strange signal.
It's no fault of the #MON, so it
makes me feel guilty.
<PLAY_G>, let's split the job.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RockerBaseLa.et:
Just see masin tekitab kõik probleemid.
Ma ei näe sellel lülitit…
Meil pole valikut. Peame kõik ELECTRODEd minestama panema.
See peaks masinal seda imelikku signaali edastada takistama.
See pole #MONide süü, nii et süütunne kummitab.
<PLAY_G>, jagame töö ära.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLancesSideText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en: LANCE: Leave this side to me.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et: LANCE: Jäta see pool minu hooleks.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLanceElectrodeDoneText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en:
LANCE: That odd signal has finally stopped.
The LAKE should be back to normal.
You're the hero! Let me thank you
on behalf of all the #MON.
Oh, yes. You should take this.
I found it here, but I don't have any need for it.
<PLAYER> received HM06.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et:
LANCE: See imelik signaal on lõpuks lakanud.
JÄRV peaks taas normaalne olema.
Sina oled kangelane! Lubage tänada sind kõigi #MONide nimel.
Ahjaa. Võta see.
Leidsin selle siit, aga mul pole seda vaja.
<PLAYER> sai HM06.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLanceWhirlpoolText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en:
That's WHIRLPOOL. Teach it to a
#MON to get across wild water.
But keep this in mind.
You can use that out of battle only
with the BADGE from MAHOGANY GYM.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et:
See on WHIRLPOOL. Õpeta see #MONile, et ületada metsikut vett.
Aga pea meeles.
Seda saad väljaspool lahingut kasutada vaid MAHOGANY SAALI MÄRGIGA.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.label: RocketBaseLanceMonMasterText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.en:
<PLAY_G>…
The journey to becoming the #MON
MASTER is long and difficult.
Knowing that, will you keep going?
…
I see. No, you're right.
If you would give up that easily,
you would have never chased that
dream in the first place.
I look forward to seeing you again!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseLa.et:
<PLAY_G>…
Teekond #MON MEISTRIKS saamiseni on pikk ja raske.
Seda teades — kas jätkad?
…
Selge. Ei, sul on õigus.
Kui loobuksid nii kergelt, poleks sa seda unistust üldse taga ajanud.
Ootan meie taaskohtumist!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::LanceHealsTe.label: LanceHealsText1
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::LanceHealsTe.en:
LANCE: Are you all right?
Your #MON are hurt and tired.
Here, give them some of my medicine.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::LanceHealsTe.et:
LANCE: Kas oled kombes?
Su #MONid on vigastatud ja väsinud.
Säh, anna neile minu rohtu.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::LanceHealsTe.label: LanceHealsText2
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::LanceHealsTe.en: LANCE: <PLAY_G>, let's give it our best for #MON.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Seen.label: GruntM17SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Seen.en:
The door won't open?
Well, duh. It has to have a
password that only TEAM ROCKET knows.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Seen.et:
Uks ei avane?
No muidugi. Sellel on parool, mida teab vaid RAKETI KAMP.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Afte.label: GruntM17AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Afte.en:
Heh, I'm just a GRUNT.
I don't know the password. Too bad for you.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM17Afte.et:
Heh, olen lihtsalt RAKETI TÜÜP.
Ma ei tea parooli. Sinu õnnetus.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Seen.label: GruntM18SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Seen.en:
Oh, a kid? I don't really like this,
but eliminate you I must.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Seen.et: Oh, laps? Mulle see ei meeldi, aga pean su kõrvaldama.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Afte.label: GruntM18AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Afte.en:
I got wiped out on the last mission by a kid too.
When we were abducting #MON,
this kid with long red hair and mean-
looking eyes just creamed me…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM18Afte.et:
Sain viimasel missioonil ka ühelt lapselt lüüa.
Kui #MONe röövisime, tegi mind pikkade punaste juuste ja õela pilguga laps lihtsalt maatasa…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM19Afte.label: GruntM19AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM19Afte.en:
Heh, only the boss knows the password for that door.
Where's the boss? Who knows? Go look for yourself.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::GruntM19Afte.et:
Heh, ainult boss teab selle ukse parooli.
Kus boss on? Kes teab? Mine ise otsi.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.label: RocketBaseDoorNoPasswordText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.en:
The door's closed…
It needs a password to open.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.et:
Uks on suletud…
Avamiseks vajab parooli.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.label: RocketBaseDoorKnowPasswordText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.en:
The door's closed…
<PLAYER> entered the password.
The door opened!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseDo.et:
Uks on suletud…
<PLAYER> sisestas parooli.
Uks avanes!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.label: RocketBaseB2FTransmitterText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.en:
It's the radio transmitter that's
sending the sinister signal.
It's working at full capacity.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.et:
See on raadiosaatja, mis kurja signaali saadab.
See töötab täisvõimsusel.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.label: RocketBaseB2FDeactivateTransmitterText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.en:
The radio transmitter has finally
stopped its evil broadcast.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB2F.asm::RocketBaseB2.et: Raadiosaatja on lõpuks oma kurja ülekande lõpetanud.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::LanceGetPass.label: LanceGetPasswordText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::LanceGetPass.en:
LANCE: It takes two passwords to
get into the boss's quarters.
Those passwords are known only to a few ROCKETS.
That ROCKET there very graciously told me so.
<PLAY_G>, let's go get the passwords.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::LanceGetPass.et:
LANCE: Bossi ruumi pääsemiseks on vaja kahte parooli.
Neid paroole teavad vaid vähesed RAKETID.
Tolle RAKETI oli nii lahke, et rääkis selle mulle.
<PLAY_G>, lähme paroole hankima.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FRocketText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.en: Urrggh… The guy in the cape is incredibly tough…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.et: Urrggh… See keebis mees on uskumatult kõva…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::RocketBaseRi.label: RocketBaseRivalText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::RocketBaseRi.en:
…
Didn't I tell you that I was going
to destroy TEAM ROCKET?
…Tell me, who was the guy in the
cape who used dragon #MON?
My #MON were no match at all.
I don't care that I lost. I can beat
him by getting stronger #MON.
It's what he said that bothers me…
He told me that I don't love and
trust my #MON enough.
I'm furious that I lost to a bleeding heart like him.
…Humph! I don't have the time for the likes of you!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::RocketBaseRi.et:
…
Kas ma ei öelnud, et hävitan RAKETI KAMBA?
…Ütle, kes oli see keebis mees, kes kasutas draakon-#MONe?
Mu #MONid ei olnud talle vastast.
Mul on ükskõik, et kaotasin. Tugevamate #MONidega võidan ta ära.
Mind häirib see, mida ta ütles…
Ta ütles, et ma ei armasta ega usalda oma #MONe piisavalt.
Olen raevus, et kaotasin sellisele nutupallile.
…Hmph! Mul pole sinusuguste jaoks aega!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.label: ExecutiveM4BeforeText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.en:
What? Who are you? This is the office
of our leader, GIOVANNI.
Since disbanding TEAM ROCKET three
years ago, he has been in training.
But we're certain he will be back
some day to assume command again.
That's why we're standing guard.
I won't let anyone disturb this place!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.et:
Mis? Kes sa oled? See on meie liidri GIOVANNI kabinet.
Pärast RAKETI KAMBA laialisaatmist kolm aastat tagasi on ta treeninud.
Aga oleme kindlad, et ta naaseb kunagi juhtimist üle võtma.
Seepärast me valvame.
Ma ei lase kellelgi seda paika häirida!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.label: ExecutiveM4BeatenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.en:
I… I couldn't do a thing…
GIOVANNI, please forgive me…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4B.et:
Ma… ma ei saanud midagi teha…
GIOVANNI, palun andesta mulle…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4A.label: ExecutiveM4AfterText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4A.en:
No, I can't let this affect me.
I have to inform the others…
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ExecutiveM4A.et:
Ei, ma ei tohi lasta sel end mõjutada.
Pean teisi teavitama…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::RocketBaseMu.label: RocketBaseMurkrowText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::RocketBaseMu.en:
MURKROW: The password is…
HAIL GIOVANNI.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5SeenT.label: GruntF5SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5SeenT.en:
Do I know the password?
Maybe.
But no weakling's going to get it!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5SeenT.et:
Kas ma tean parooli?
Võib-olla.
Aga ükski nõrk ei saa seda kätte!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5Beate.label: GruntF5BeatenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5Beate.en: All right. Stop. I'll tell you.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5After.label: GruntF5AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5After.en:
The password to the boss's room is
SLOWPOKETAIL.
But it's useless unless you have two passwords.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntF5After.et:
Bossi toa parool on SLOWPOKETAIL.
Aga sellest pole kasu, kui sul pole kahte parooli.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Seen.label: GruntM28SeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Seen.en:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
You're challenging me to a battle?
Hah! You're nuts, but you have guts!
I like that!
If you can beat me, I'll tell you
a password to the boss's room!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Seen.et:
Hjukk-hjukk-hjukk!
Sa kutsud mind lahingusse?
Hah! Oled hull, aga sul on julgust!
Meeldib!
Kui suudad mind võita, ütlen sulle bossi toa parooli!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Afte.label: GruntM28AfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Afte.en:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
The password to the boss's room…
Uh…, I think it is RATICATE TAIL.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::GruntM28Afte.et:
Hjukk-hjukk-hjukk!
Bossi toa parool…
Öö… vist on see RATICATE TAIL.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.label: ScientistRossSeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.en:
I used to work for SILPH, but now I
run research for TEAM ROCKET.
A meddlesome child like you needs to be punished.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.et:
Töötasin kunagi SILPHIS, aga nüüd juhin RAKETI KAMBA uurimistööd.
Sinusugune tüütu laps tuleb ära karistada.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.label: ScientistRossBeatenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.en: A mere tactical error cost me…

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.label: ScientistRossAfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.en:
A radio signal that drives #MON mad…
My experiment is a complete success.
My promotion is assured. This loss
means absolutely nothing.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistRos.et:
Raadiosignaal, mis ajab #MONid hulluks…
Minu katse on täielik edu.
Mu edutamine on kindel. See kaotus ei tähenda mitte midagi.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.label: ScientistMitchSeenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.en: I don't care that #MON are hurt by our experiment.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.et: Mul on ükskõik, et meie katse #MONe kahjustab.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.label: ScientistMitchBeatenText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.en: Thinking is my strong suit, not battling.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.et: Mõtlemine on mu tugevus, mitte võitlemine.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.label: ScientistMitchAfterBattleText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.en:
If we turn up the power of our radio
signal for broadcast nationwide…
The very thought excites me!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::ScientistMit.et:
Kui suurendame raadiosignaali võimsust üleriigiliseks ülekandeks…
Mõte üksi erutab mind!

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorNeedsPasswordText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.en:
The door's closed…
It needs two passwords to open.
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.et:
Uks on suletud…
Avamiseks vajab kahte parooli.

maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorOpenSesameText
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.en:
The door's closed…
<PLAYER> entered the two passwords.
The door opened!
maps/TeamRocketBaseB3F.asm::TeamRocketBa.et:
Uks on suletud…
<PLAYER> sisestas kaks parooli.
Uks avanes!

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineSui.label: TinTower1FEusineSuicuneText
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineSui.en:
EUSINE: Awesome! Too awesome, even!
I've never seen a battle that great.
That was truly inspiring to see.
SUICUNE was tough, but you were even
more incredible, <PLAYER>.
I heard SUICUNE's mystic power
summons a rainbowcolored #MON.
Maybe, just maybe, what went on today
will cause that #MON to appear.
I'm going to study the legends more.
Thanks for showing me that fantastic battle.
Later, <PLAYER>!
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineSui.et:
EUSINE: Vägev! Lausa liiga vägev!
Pole kunagi näinud nii suurepärast lahingut.
See oli tõeliselt innustav.
SUICUNE oli kõva, aga sina olid veelgi uskumatum, <PLAYER>.
Kuulsin, et SUICUNE müstiline vägi kutsub esile vikerkaarevärvi #MONi.
Ehk just see, mis täna juhtus, paneb tolle #MONi ilmuma.
Hakkan legende rohkem uurima.
Aitäh, et selle fantastilise lahingu näitasid.
Näeme, <PLAYER>!

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage1Text.label: TinTower1FSage1Text
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage1Text.en:
According to legend…
When the souls of #MON and humans
commune, from the heavens descends a
#MON of rainbow colors…
Could it mean the legendary #MON
are testing us humans?
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage1Text.et:
Legendi järgi…
Kui #MONide ja inimeste hinged ühinevad, laskub taevast vikerkaarevärvi #MON…
Ehk tähendab see, et legendaarsed #MONid panevad meid, inimesi, proovile?

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage2Text.label: TinTower1FSage2Text
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage2Text.en:
When the BRASS TOWER burned down,
three nameless #MON were said
to have perished. It was tragic.
However…
A rainbow-colored #MON…
In other words…
HO-OH descended from the sky and
gave new life to the three #MON.
They are…
SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.
That is what they say.
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage2Text.et:
Kui BRASS TOWER maha põles, hukkus väidetavalt kolm nimetut #MONi. See oli traagiline.
Kuid…
Vikerkaarevärvi #MON…
Teisisõnu…
HO-OH laskus taevast ja andis kolmele #MONile uue elu.
Nad on…
SUICUNE, ENTEI ja RAIKOU.
Nii räägitakse.

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage3Text.label: TinTower1FSage3Text
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage3Text.en:
The two TOWERS are said to have been
built to foster friendship and
hope between #MON and people.
That was 700 years ago, but the ideal
still remains important today.
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage3Text.et:
Räägitakse, et kaks torni ehitati #MONide ja inimeste sõpruse ning lootuse toetuseks.
See oli 700 aastat tagasi, kuid see ideaal on tähtis tänini.

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.label: TinTower1FSage4Text1
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.en:
HO-OH appears to have descended
upon this, the TIN TOWER!
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.et: Näib, et HO-OH on laskunud siia, TIN TOWERISSE!

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage5Text.label: TinTower1FSage5Text1
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage5Text.en: This will protect you. Take it.

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.label: TinTower1FSage6Text1
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.en:
I believe you are being tested.
Free your mind from uncertainty, and advance.
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.et:
Usun, et sind pannakse proovile.
Vabasta oma meel kahtlustest ja mine edasi.

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineHoO.label: TinTower1FEusineHoOhText
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineHoO.en:
I knew it.
I knew you'd get to see the #MON
of rainbow colors, <PLAYER>.
It happened just as I envisioned.
My research isn't bad, I might say.
I'm going to keep studying #MON
to become a famous #MANIAC!
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FEusineHoO.et:
Ma teadsin.
Teadsin, et sina saad näha vikerkaarevärvi #MONi, <PLAYER>.
Kõik läks just nii, nagu ette kujutasin.
Minu uurimistöö polegi paha.
Jätkan #MONide uurimist, et saada kuulsaks #MANIAKUKS!

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.label: TinTower1FSage4Text2
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.en:
The legendary #MON are said
to embody three powers…
The lightning that struck the TOWER.
The fire that burned the TOWER.
And the rain that put out the fire…
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage4Text.et:
Legendaarsed #MONid kehastavad kolme väge…
Välk, mis tabas torni.
Tuli, mis torni põletas.
Ja vihm, mis tule kustutas…

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage5Text.label: TinTower1FSage5Text3
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage5Text.en:
When the legendary #MON appeared…
They struck terror in those who saw their rise.
And…
Some even took to futile attacks.
The legendary #MON, knowing
their own power, fled, ignoring the frightened people.
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage5Text.et:
Kui legendaarsed #MONid ilmusid…
nad lõid õudust neisse, kes nende tõusu nägid.
Ja…
Mõned isegi ründasid neid asjatult.
Oma väge teades põgenesid legendaarsed #MONid, hoolimata hirmunud inimestest.

maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.label: TinTower1FSage6Text2
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.en:
Of the legendary #MON, SUICUNE
is said to be the closest to HO-OH.
I hear there may also be a link to
#MON known as UNOWN.
The #MON UNOWN must be sharing a
cooperative bond with SUICUNE.
maps/TinTower1F.asm::TinTower1FSage6Text.et:
Legendaarsetest #MONidest on SUICUNE HO-OHile kõige lähemal.
Võib olla ka seos #MONidega, keda tuntakse UNOWNina.
#MON UNOWN peab jagama SUICUNEga koostöösidet.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FR.label: TrainerHouse1FReceptionistText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FR.en:
Welcome to TRAINER HOUSE, the newest
and most happening place in VIRIDIAN.
We're open to trainers only.
You can battle against the best
of the best right downstairs.
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FR.et:
Tere tulemast TRAINER HOUSE'i, VIRIDIANI
uusimasse ja vahvamasse paika.
Oleme avatud ainult treeneritele.
Saad võidelda parimate
parimatega just all korrusel.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.label: TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerMText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.en:
VIRIDIAN is the town closest to INDIGO PLATEAU.
They built this place because so
many trainers pass through on their
way up to INDIGO PLATEAU.
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.et:
VIRIDIAN on INDIGO PLATEAULE lähim linn.
See koht ehitati, sest nii
palju treenereid käib siit läbi
teel üles INDIGO PLATEAULE.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.label: TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerFText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.en:
They hold practice battles downstairs here.
I would love to see how well a
trainer from JOHTO battles.
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FC.et:
Siin all peetakse harjutuslahinguid.
Tahaksin väga näha, kui hästi
treener JOHTOST võitleb.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FY.label: TrainerHouse1FYoungsterText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FY.en:
I guess you can't become the CHAMP
unless you go all over the place and
battle all kinds of people.
The CHAMPION from PALLET traveled to
all the cities and towns in KANTO.
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FY.et:
Vist ei saa sinust TŠEMPIONI,
kui sa ei käi kõikjal ja
ei võitle igasuguste inimestega.
TŠEMPION PALLETIST reisis
kõikidesse KANTO linnadesse.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FG.label: TrainerHouse1FGentlemanText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouse1FG.en: Whew… I'm taking a rest from #MON battles.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.label: TrainerHouseSign1Text
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.en:
Practice battles are held in the
TRAINING HALL downstairs.
Skilled trainers are invited to participate.
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.et:
Harjutuslahinguid peetakse
TREENINGUSAALIS all korrusel.
Osalema on oodatud osavad treenerid.

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.label: TrainerHouseSign2Text
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.en:
There are no rules or regulations for
practice matches. Just like in field
battles, anything goes!
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseSig.et:
Harjutusmatšidel pole reegleid ega
määrusi. Nagu välilahingutes,
kõik on lubatud!

maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseIll.label: TrainerHouseIllegibleText
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseIll.en:
…What's this? A strategy memo?
This writing looks like ONIX tracks…
It's completely illegible…
maps/TrainerHouse1F.asm::TrainerHouseIll.et:
…Mis see on? Strateegiamemo?
See kiri näeb välja nagu ONIXi jäljed…
See on täiesti loetamatu…

maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.label: TrainerHouseB1FIntroText
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.en:
Hi. Welcome to our TRAINING HALL.
You may battle a trainer once per day.
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.et:
Tere. Tere tulemast meie TREENINGUSAALI.
Võid võidelda treeneriga kord päevas.

maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.label: TrainerHouseB1FGoRightInText
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.en:
Please go right through.
You may begin right away.
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.et:
Mine palun otse sisse.
Võid kohe alustada.

maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.label: TrainerHouseB1FPleaseComeAgainText
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.en:
Sorry. Only those trainers who will
be battling are allowed to go in.
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.et:
Vabandust. Sisse tohivad ainult need
treenerid, kes hakkavad võitlema.

maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.label: TrainerHouseB1FSecondChallengeDeniedText
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.en:
I'm sorry. This would be your
second time today. You're permitted
to enter just once a day.
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.et:
Vabandust. See oleks su teine
kord täna. Sul on lubatud
siseneda vaid korra päevas.

maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.label: TrainerHouseB1FCalBeforeText
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.en: I traveled out here just so I could battle you.
maps/TrainerHouseB1F.asm::TrainerHouseB1.et: Reisisin siia välja lihtsalt selleks, et sinuga võidelda.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellSeenTe.label: HikerRussellSeenText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellSeenTe.en:
You're headed to AZALEA, are you?
Let my #MON see if you are good enough to battle.
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellSeenTe.et:
Suundud AZALEASSE, eks?
Las mu #MON näeb, kas oled võitluseks küps.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellAfterB.label: HikerRussellAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellAfterB.en:
All right, then! I've decided.
I'm not leaving until my #MON get tougher!
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerRussellAfterB.et:
Olgu siis! Olen otsustanud.
Ma ei lahku enne, kui mu #MONid kõvemaks saavad!

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarrySee.label: PokemaniacLarrySeenText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarrySee.en:
I roam far and wide in search of #MON.
Are you looking for #MON too?
Then you're my collecting rival!
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarrySee.et:
Hulgun laias laastus #MONe otsides.
Kas sinagi otsid #MONe?
Siis oled mu kogumisrivaal!

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarryAft.label: PokemaniacLarryAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarryAft.en:
Every Friday, you can hear #MON
roars from deep inside the cave.
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::PokemaniacLarryAft.et:
Igal reedel kostab koopa sügavusest
#MONide möirgeid.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielSeenTex.label: HikerDanielSeenText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielSeenTex.en:
Whoa! What a surprise!
I didn't expect to see anyone here!
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielSeenTex.et:
Oih! Milline üllatus!
Ma ei oodanud siin kedagi näha!

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielAfterBa.label: HikerDanielAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielAfterBa.en:
I was conned into buying a SLOWPOKETAIL.
I feel sorry for the poor #MON.
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::HikerDanielAfterBa.et:
Mind meelitati ostma SLOWPOKETAIL.
Mul on vaestest #MONidest kahju.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillSe.label: FirebreatherBillSeenText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillSe.en:
ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC keeps confusing my #MON.
I'm seriously upset about that!
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillSe.et:
ZUBATI SUPERSONIC ajab mu #MONi segadusse.
See ajab mind tõsiselt endast välja!

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillAf.label: FirebreatherBillAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillAf.en:
On weekends, you can hear strange
roars from deep in the cave.
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherBillAf.et:
Nädalavahetustel kostab koopa sügavusest
kummalisi möirgeid.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherRaySee.label: FirebreatherRaySeenText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherRaySee.en:
If it's light, a cave isn't scary.
If you're strong, #MON aren't scary.
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherRaySee.et:
Kui on valge, pole koobas hirmus.
Kui oled tugev, pole #MONid hirmsad.

maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherRayAft.label: FirebreatherRayAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCave1F.asm::FirebreatherRayAft.en: It's my #MON's fire that lights up this cave.

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipSeenT.label: HikerPhillipSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipSeenT.en:
It's been a while since I last saw another person.
Don't be shy. Let's battle!
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipSeenT.et:
Pole ammu enam ühtki teist inimest näinud.
Ära ole häbelik. Võitleme!

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipAfter.label: HikerPhillipAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipAfter.en:
I've been lost for a long time…
I don't mind it here, but I am soooo hungry!
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerPhillipAfter.et:
Olen juba kaua ära eksinud…
Siin pole viga, aga mul on nii kohutav kõht tühi!

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerLeonardSeenT.label: HikerLeonardSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerLeonardSeenT.en: What do you know! A visitor!

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerLeonardAfter.label: HikerLeonardAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerLeonardAfter.en:
I live down here.
You can, too, if you'd like.
There's plenty of room, you see.
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::HikerLeonardAfter.et:
Ma elan siinsamas all.
Sina ka võid, kui tahad.
Ruumi on siin küllaga.

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewS.label: PokemaniacAndrewSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewS.en:
Who's there?
Leave me and my #MON alone!
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewS.et:
Kes seal on?
Jäta mind ja mu #MONid rahule!

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewA.label: PokemaniacAndrewAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewA.en: Just me and my #MON. I'm delirious with joy.
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacAndrewA.et: Vaid mina ja mu #MONid. Olen õnnest joovastuses.

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinS.label: PokemaniacCalvinSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinS.en:
I came all the way here to conduct my #MON research.
Let me demonstrate my findings in a real battle!
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinS.et:
Tulin siia oma #MONi-uuringuid tegema.
Näitan oma leide ehtsas lahingus!

maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinA.label: PokemaniacCalvinAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinA.en:
I should compile and announce my study findings.
I might even become famous like PROF.ELM.
maps/UnionCaveB1F.asm::PokemaniacCalvinA.et:
Peaksin oma tulemused kokku panema ja avaldama.
Võib-olla saan kuulsaks nagu PROF.ELM.

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickS.label: CooltrainermNickSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickS.en:
There are two kinds of people.
Those who have style, and those who don't.
What kind of person are you?
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickS.et:
Inimesi on kahte sorti.
Need, kellel on stiili, ja need, kellel pole.
Kumb sina oled?

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickA.label: CooltrainermNickAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickA.en:
Your #MON style is stunning and colorful, I admit.
You'll just keep getting better!
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainermNickA.et:
Su #MONi stiil on vapustav ja värvikas, tunnistan.
Sa lähed aina paremaks!

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenS.label: CooltrainerfGwenSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenS.en: I'm in training. Care for a round?

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenB.label: CooltrainerfGwenBeatenText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenB.en: Aww, no! You're too good for me.
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenB.et: Ohh, ei! Sa oled minust üle.

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenA.label: CooltrainerfGwenAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfGwenA.en: I'm going to train by myself until I improve.

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaS.label: CooltrainerfEmmaSeenText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaS.en:
If the #MON I liked were there, I'd go anywhere.
That's what a real trainer does.
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaS.et:
Endale meeldiva #MONi nimel läheksin kuhu tahes.
Nii teeb tõeline treener.

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaB.label: CooltrainerfEmmaBeatenText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaB.en: I'd rather pet my babies than this!
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaB.et: Parem silitaksin oma pisikesi kui seda!

maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaA.label: CooltrainerfEmmaAfterBattleText
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaA.en:
Just once a week, a #MON comes to the water's edge.
I wanted to see that #MON…
maps/UnionCaveB2F.asm::CooltrainerfEmmaA.et:
Vaid kord nädalas tuleb vee äärde üks #MON.
Tahtsin seda #MONi näha…

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityTea.label: VermilionCityTeacherText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityTea.en:
VERMILION PORT is KANTO's seaside gateway.
Luxury liners from around the world dock here.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityTea.et:
VERMILION SADAM on KANTO mereäärne värav.
Siin dokivad luksuslaevad üle maailma.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionMachopO.label: VermilionMachopOwnerText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionMachopO.en:
My #MON is preparing the land for construction.
But I have no money to start the project…
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionMachopO.et:
Mu #MON valmistab maad ehituseks ette.
Aga mul pole raha, et projekti alustada…

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionMachopT.label: VermilionMachopText2
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionMachopT.en: A MACHOP is growling while stomping the ground flat.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCitySup.label: VermilionCitySuperNerdText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCitySup.en:
There are eight GYMS in KANTO.
That big building is VERMILION's #MON GYM.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCitySup.et:
KANTOS on kaheksa SAALI.
See suur hoone on VERMILIONI #MON SAAL.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityRad.label: VermilionCityRadioNearSnorlaxText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityRad.en:
The #GEAR was placed near the sleeping SNORLAX…
…
SNORLAX woke up!
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityRad.et:
#GEAR asetati magava SNORLAXi lähedale…
…
SNORLAX ärkas!

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyTrainerText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.en:
Skilled trainers gather in KANTO.
GYM LEADERS are especially strong.
They won't be easy to defeat.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.et:
KANTOSSE koguneb osavaid treenereid.
SAALI JUHID on eriti tugevad.
Neid pole kerge alistada.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuySomeBadgesText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.en:
You've started to collect KANTO GYM BADGES?
Don't you agree that the trainers here are tough?
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.et:
Oled hakanud KANTO SAALIMÄRKE koguma?
Kas pole nõus, et siinsed treenerid on kõvad?

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyMostBadgesText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.en:
I guess you'll be finished with your
conquest of KANTO GYMS soon.
Let me know if you get all eight BADGES.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.et:
Vist lõpetad varsti KANTO SAALIDE vallutamise.
Anna teada, kui saad kõik kaheksa MÄRKI.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyAllBadgesText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.en:
Congratulations!
You got all the KANTO GYM BADGES.
I've got a reward for your efforts.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.et:
Palju õnne!
Said kõik KANTO SAALIMÄRGID.
Mul on su vaeva eest tasu.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyBattleEdgeText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.en:
Having a variety of #MON types
should give you an edge in battle.
I'm sure the KANTO GYM BADGES will help you.
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCityBad.et:
Mitmekesised #MONi tüübid annavad lahingus eelise.
KANTO SAALIMÄRGID kindlasti aitavad.

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCitySig.label: VermilionCitySignText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionCitySig.en:
VERMILION CITY
The Port of Exquisite Sunsets

maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionGymSign.label: VermilionGymSignText
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionGymSign.en:
VERMILION CITY #MON GYM LEADER: LT.SURGE
The Lightning American
maps/VermilionCity.asm::VermilionGymSign.et:
VERMILION CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: LT.SURGE
Elektriline ameeriklane

maps/VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouse.as.label: VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouseGentlemanText
maps/VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouse.as.en:
Over many years, DIGLETT dug a large tunnel.
That tunnel goes to a distant town.
maps/VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouse.as.et:
Paljude aastate jooksul kaevas DIGLETT suure tunneli.
See tunnel viib kaugesse linna.

maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.label: FishingDudeText
maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.en:
I am the FISHING DUDE, the elder of the FISHING BROS.
Have you met the FISHING GURU at LAKE OF RAGE?
He dreams about seeing the world's greatest MAGIKARP.
If you don't mind, could you show him
any MAGIKARP you catch?
Who knows, you may catch the MAGIKARP of his dreams.
maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.et:
Olen FISHING DUDE, FISHING BROSI vanim.
Kas oled kohanud KALAPÜÜGIGURUT LAKE OF RAGE juures?
Ta unistab maailma suurima MAGIKARPI nägemisest.
Kui sa ei pahanda, kas näitaksid talle
iga MAGIKARPi, mille püüad?
Kes teab, ehk püüad ta unistuste MAGIKARPI.

maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.label: FishingDudesHousePhotoText
maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.en:
It's a photo of people fishing…
They're having a great time…
maps/VermilionFishingSpeechHouse.asm::Fi.et:
See on foto kalapüüdvatest inimestest…
Neil on väga tore…

maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeIntroText.label: LtSurgeIntroText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeIntroText.en:
SURGE: Hey, you little tyke!
I have to hand it to you. It may not
be very smart to challenge me, but it takes guts!
When it comes to electric #MON, I'm number one!
I've never lost on the battlefield.
I'll zap you just like I did my enemies in war!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeIntroText.et:
SURGE: Hei, sa väike jõmpsikas!
Pean sulle au andma. Ehk pole tark mind välja kutsuda, aga see nõuab julgust!
Elektri-#MONides olen mina number üks!
Pole lahinguväljal kunagi kaotanud.
Virutan sulle nagu oma vaenlastele sõjas!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeWinLossTex.label: LtSurgeWinLossText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeWinLossTex.en:
SURGE: Arrrgh! You are strong!
OK, kid. You get THUNDERBADGE!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeWinLossTex.et:
SURGE: Arrrgh! Sa oled tugev!
Olgu, laps. Saad THUNDERBADGE!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeThunderBad.label: LtSurgeThunderBadgeText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeThunderBad.en:
SURGE: THUNDERBADGE increases #MON's speed.
Consider it proof that you defeated
me. You wear it proudly, hear?
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeThunderBad.et:
SURGE: THUNDERBADGE tõstab #MONi kiirust.
Pea seda tõenduseks, et mind võitsid. Kanna seda uhkusega, kuuled?

maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeFightDoneT.label: LtSurgeFightDoneText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeFightDoneT.en:
SURGE: Hey, kid! Still slugging and chugging away?
My #MON and I are still at it!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::LtSurgeFightDoneT.et:
SURGE: Hei, laps! Ikka veel rassid?
Minul ja mu #MONidel on ka jama pooleli!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryS.label: GentlemanGregorySeenText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryS.en:
You're here to defeat LT.SURGE?
Not if I can help it!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryS.et:
Tulid LT.SURGE'i alistama?
Mitte siis, kui minust oleneb!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryB.label: GentlemanGregoryBeatenText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryB.en: Sorry I failed you, LT.SURGE, sir!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryB.et: Vabandust, et vedasin alt, LT.SURGE, härra!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryA.label: GentlemanGregoryAfterBattleText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryA.en:
When I was still in the army, LT.
SURGE saved my life.
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GentlemanGregoryA.et: Kui olin veel sõjaväes, päästis LT.SURGE mu elu.

maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentS.label: GuitaristVincentSeenText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentS.en:
LT.SURGE recognized my potential
with electric #MON.
Think you can beat me?
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentS.et:
LT.SURGE märkas mu annet elektri #MONidega.
Arvad, et suudad mind võita?

maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentA.label: GuitaristVincentAfterBattleText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentA.en:
If the GYM's traps were working, you
would have been toast…
maps/VermilionGym.asm::GuitaristVincentA.et: Kui SAALI lõksud töötaksid, oleksid sa läbi küpsenud…

maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonSeen.label: JugglerHortonSeenText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonSeen.en: I'm going to take you down! Prepare to be shocked!
maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonSeen.et: Võtan su maha! Valmistu saama elektrilööki!

maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonAfte.label: JugglerHortonAfterBattleText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonAfte.en:
Don't get too comfortable about
beating me… LT.SURGE is tough.
maps/VermilionGym.asm::JugglerHortonAfte.et: Ära muutu mu võitmise pärast liiga rahulikuks… LT.SURGE on kõva.

maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.label: VermilionGymGuideText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.en:
Yo! CHAMP in making!
You lucked out this time.
LT.SURGE is very cautious. He has
traps set all over the GYM.
But--he-heh--the traps aren't active right now.
You'll have no problem getting to LT.SURGE.
maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.et:
Hei! Tulevane TŠEMPION!
Seekord vedas sul.
LT.SURGE on väga ettevaatlik. Tal on üle SAALI lõkse seatud.
Aga — hee-hee — praegu pole lõksud aktiivsed.
Jõuad LT.SURGE'ini ilma probleemideta.

maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.label: VermilionGymGuideWinText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.en:
Whew! That was an electrifying bout!
It sure made me nervous.
maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymGuide.et:
Ohoo! See oli elektriseeriv matš!
Ajas mind tõesti närvi.

maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymTrash.label: VermilionGymTrashCanText
maps/VermilionGym.asm::VermilionGymTrash.et: Ei! Siin pole muud kui prügi.

maps/VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouse.asm.label: VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHousePokefanFText
maps/VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouse.asm.en:
Do you know about the MAGNET TRAIN?
It's a railway that goes to GOLDENROD in JOHTO.
maps/VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouse.asm.et:
Kas tead MAGNETRONGIST?
See on raudtee, mis viib GOLDENRODI JOHTOS.

maps/VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouse.asm.label: VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouseYoungsterText
maps/VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouse.asm.en: I want to go to SAFFRON to see the MAGNET TRAIN.

maps/VermilionMart.asm::VermilionMartSup.label: VermilionMartSuperNerdText
maps/VermilionMart.asm::VermilionMartSup.en:
TEAM ROCKET is no longer in KANTO.
That alone makes me happy.
maps/VermilionMart.asm::VermilionMartSup.et:
RAKETI KAMPA pole enam KANTOS.
Juba ainuüksi see teeb mind õnnelikuks.

maps/VermilionMart.asm::VermilionMartBea.label: VermilionMartBeautyText
maps/VermilionMart.asm::VermilionMartBea.en: I'm thinking about going shopping in SAFFRON.

maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.label: VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.en:
A sleeping #MON is lying in front of DIGLETT'S CAVE.
It's a fantastic opportunity to get
it, but how do you wake it up?
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.et:
Magav #MON lamab DIGLETT'S CAVE ees.
Selle saamiseks on suurepärane
võimalus, aga kuidas seda üles äratada?

maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.label: VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText_FoughtSnorlax
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.en:
There used to be a sleeping #MON
lying in front of DIGLETT'S CAVE.
But it seems to have disappeared.
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.et:
DIGLETT'S CAVE ees lamas
varem magav #MON.
Aga tundub, et see on kadunud.

maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.label: VermilionPokecenter1FSailorText
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.en:
The FAST SHIP is a great place to
meet and battle trainers.
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.et:
KIIRLAEV on suurepärane koht
treeneritega kohtumiseks ja võitlemiseks.

maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.label: VermilionPokecenter1FBugCatcherText
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.en:
Oh? You have some BADGES I've never seen before.
Oh, I get it. You got them in JOHTO.
maps/VermilionPokecenter1F.asm::Vermilio.et:
Oh? Sul on MÄRKE, mida ma pole varem näinud.
Ah, saan aru. Said need JOHTOST.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortDep.label: VermilionPortDepartingText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortDep.en: We're departing soon. Please get on board.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortCan.label: VermilionPortCantBoardText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortCan.et: Vabandust. Sa ei saa praegu pardale.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortAsk.label: VermilionPortAskBoardingText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortAsk.en:
Welcome to FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA.
Will you be boarding today?
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortAsk.et:
Tere tulemast KIIRLAEVA S.S.AQUA.
Kas lähed täna pardale?

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortCom.label: VermilionPortComeAgainText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortCom.en: We hope to see you again!

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSST.label: VermilionPortSSTicketText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSST.en:
<PLAYER> flashed the S.S.TICKET.
That's it. Thank you!

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortNoT.label: VermilionPortNoTicketText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortNoT.en:
<PLAYER> tried to show the S.S. TICKET…
…But no TICKET!
Sorry! You may board only
if you have an S.S.TICKET.
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortNoT.et:
<PLAYER> üritas näidata S.S. TICKETit…
…Aga TICKETit pole!
Vabandust! Pardale saad ainult siis,
kui sul on S.S.TICKET.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSai.label: VermilionPortSailWednesdayText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSai.en: The FAST SHIP will sail on Wednesday.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSai.label: VermilionPortSailSundayText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSai.en: The FAST SHIP will sail next Sunday.

maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSup.label: VermilionPortSuperNerdText
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSup.en:
You came from JOHTO?
I hear many rare #MON live over there.
maps/VermilionPort.asm::VermilionPortSup.et:
Sa tulid JOHTOST?
Kuulen, et seal elab palju haruldasi #MONe.

maps/VermilionPortPassage.asm::Vermilion.label: VermilionPortPassageTeacherText
maps/VermilionPortPassage.asm::Vermilion.en: The FAST SHIP sails on Wednesdays and Sundays every week.
maps/VermilionPortPassage.asm::Vermilion.et: KIIRLAEV sõidab iga nädal kolmapäeviti ja pühapäeviti.

maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalBe.label: VictoryRoadRivalBeforeText
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalBe.en:
Hold it.
…Are you going to take the #MON LEAGUE challenge?
…Don't make me laugh.
You're so much weaker than I am.
I'm not like I was before.
I now have the best and strongest
#MON with me. I'm invincible!
<PLAYER>! I challenge you!
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalBe.et:
Pea kinni.
…Kas lähed #MON LIIGA väljakutsele?
…Ära aja mind naerma.
Sa oled minust palju nõrgem.
Ma pole enam nagu varem.
Mul on nüüd parim ja tugevaim
#MON. Olen võitmatu!
<PLAYER>! Kutsun sind välja!

maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalDe.label: VictoryRoadRivalDefeatText
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalDe.en:
…I couldn't win…
I gave it everything I had…
What you possess, and what I lack…
I'm beginning to understand what
that dragon master said to me…
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalDe.et:
…Ma ei suutnud võita…
Andsin endast kõik…
See, mis sul on, ja mis mul puudub…
Hakkan mõistma, mida
see draakonimeister mulle ütles…

maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalAf.label: VictoryRoadRivalAfterText
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalAf.en:
…I haven't given up on becoming the greatest trainer…
I'm going to find out why I can't
win and become stronger…
When I do, I will challenge you.
And I'll beat you down with all my power.
…Humph! You keep at it until then.
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalAf.et:
…Ma pole loobunud suurimaks treeneriks saamisest…
Saan teada, miks ma ei suuda
võita, ja saan tugevamaks…
Kui saan, kutsun sind välja.
Ja peksan su kogu oma jõuga maha.
…Hmph! Sina jätka seni.

maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalVi.label: VictoryRoadRivalVictoryText
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalVi.en:
…Humph!
When it comes down to it, nothing can beat power.
I don't need anything else.
maps/VictoryRoad.asm::VictoryRoadRivalVi.et:
…Hmph!
Kui asi selleni jõuab, ei suuda miski jõudu võita.
Mul pole midagi muud vaja.

maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.label: VictoryRoadGateOfficerText
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.en: Only trainers who have proven themselves may pass.
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.et: Läbi pääsevad ainult treenerid, kes on end tõestanud.

maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.label: VictoryRoadGateNotEnoughBadgesText
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.en:
You don't have all the GYM BADGES of JOHTO.
I'm sorry, but I can't let you go through.
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.et:
Sul pole kõiki JOHTO SAALI MÄRKE.
Vabandust, aga ma ei saa sind läbi lasta.

maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.label: VictoryRoadGateEightBadgesText
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.en:
Oh! The eight BADGES of JOHTO!
Please, go right on through!
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.et:
Oh! Kaheksa JOHTO MÄRKI!
Palun, mine otse läbi!

maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.label: VictoryRoadGateLeftBlackBeltText
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.en:
This way leads to MT.SILVER.
You'll see scarystrong #MON out there.
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.et:
See tee viib MT.SILVERISSE.
Seal näed hirmutavalt tugevaid #MONe.

maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.label: VictoryRoadGateRightBlackBeltText
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.en:
Off to the #MON LEAGUE, are you?
The ELITE FOUR are so strong it's
scary, and they're ready for you!
maps/VictoryRoadGate.asm::VictoryRoadGat.et:
Suundud #MON LIIGASSE, eks?
ELITE FOUR on nii tugevad, et
hirmus, ja nad on sinuks valmis!

maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_EarlAsksIfYouB.label: Text_EarlAsksIfYouBeatFalkner
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_EarlAsksIfYouB.en:
Hello! You are trainer?
Battle GYM LEADER, win you did?
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_EarlAsksIfYouB.et:
Tere! Sina treener oled?
SAALI JUHT võitlesid, võitsid sina?

maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_VeryNiceIndeed.label: Text_VeryNiceIndeed
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_VeryNiceIndeed.en: Ooh, la la! Very indeed nice!

maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_FollowEarl.label: Text_FollowEarl
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_FollowEarl.en: Is that so? Then study shall you! Follow me!
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_FollowEarl.et: Nii on või? Siis õppima sina! Järgne mulle!

maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_HereTeacherIAm.label: Text_HereTeacherIAm
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_HereTeacherIAm.en: Here, teacher I am. Good it is you study here!
maps/VioletCity.asm::Text_HereTeacherIAm.et: Siin, õpetaja mina olen. Hea on, et sina siin õpid!

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityLassText.label: VioletCityLassText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityLassText.en:
Ghosts are rumored to appear in SPROUT TOWER.
They said normaltype #MON moves
had no effect on ghosts.
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityLassText.et:
Kuuldavasti ilmuvad SPROUT TOWERISSE kummitused.
Öeldi, et tavatüüpi #MONi rünnakud
kummitustele ei mõju.

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCitySuperNerd.label: VioletCitySuperNerdText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCitySuperNerd.en:
Hey, you're a #MON trainer?
If you beat the GYM LEADER here,
you'll be ready for prime time!
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCitySuperNerd.et:
Hei, sa oled #MONi treener?
Kui alistad siin SAALI JUHI,
oled tõelisteks tegudeks valmis!

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityGrampsTex.label: VioletCityGrampsText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityGrampsTex.en:
FALKNER, from the VIOLET #MON
GYM, is a fine trainer!
He inherited his father's gym and
has done a great job with it.
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityGrampsTex.et:
FALKNER VIOLETI #MON
SAALIST on tore treener!
Ta päris oma isa saali ja
on sellega suurepärast tööd teinud.

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityYoungster.label: VioletCityYoungsterText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityYoungster.en:
I saw a wiggly tree up ahead!
If you touch it, it squirms and dances! Cool!
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCityYoungster.et:
Nägin eespool väänlevat puud!
Kui seda puudutad, see väänleb ja tantsib! Lahe!

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCitySignText.label: VioletCitySignText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletCitySignText.en:
VIOLET CITY
The City of Nostalgic Scents

maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletGymSignText.label: VioletGymSignText
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletGymSignText.en:
VIOLET CITY #MON GYM LEADER: FALKNER
The Elegant Master of Flying #MON
maps/VioletCity.asm::VioletGymSignText.et:
VIOLET CITY #MON SAALI JUHT: FALKNER
Lendavate #MONide elegantne meister

maps/VioletCity.asm::SproutTowerSignText.label: SproutTowerSignText
maps/VioletCity.asm::SproutTowerSignText.en:
SPROUT TOWER
Experience the Way of #MON

maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerIntroText.label: FalknerIntroText
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerIntroText.en:
I'm FALKNER, the VIOLET #MON GYM leader!
People say you can clip flying-type
#MON's wings with a jolt of electricity…
I won't allow such insults to bird #MON!
I'll show you the real power of the
magnificent bird #MON!
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerIntroText.et:
Olen FALKNER, VIOLETI #MON SAALI juht!
Räägitakse, et lendav-tüüpi #MONi tiibu
saab elektrilöögiga kärpida…
Ma ei salli selliseid solvanguid linnu-#MONide pihta!
Näitan sulle võrratute linnu-#MONide
tõelist väge!

maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerWinLossText.label: FalknerWinLossText
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerWinLossText.en:
…Darn! My dad's cherished bird #MON…
All right. Take this.
It's the official #MON LEAGUE ZEPHYRBADGE.
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerWinLossText.et:
…Pagan! Mu isa hinnaline linnu-#MON…
Hea küll. Võta see.
See on ametlik #MON LIIGA ZEPHYRBADGE.

maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerZephyrBadgeTe.label: FalknerZephyrBadgeText
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerZephyrBadgeTe.en:
ZEPHYRBADGE raises the attack power of #MON.
It also enables #MON to use
FLASH, if they have it, anytime.
Here--take this too.
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerZephyrBadgeTe.et:
ZEPHYRBADGE tõstab #MONide ründejõudu.
See võimaldab #MONil kasutada
FLASHi igal ajal, kui see neil on.
Säh – võta seegi.

maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerTMMudSlapText.label: FalknerTMMudSlapText
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerTMMudSlapText.en:
By using a TM, a #MON will
instantly learn a new move.
Think before you act--a TM can be used only once.
TM31 contains MUD-SLAP.
It reduces the enemy's accuracy
while it causes damage.
In other words, it is both defensive and offensive.
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerTMMudSlapText.et:
TMi kasutades õpib #MON
kohe uue rünnaku.
Mõtle enne tegutsemist – TMi saab kasutada vaid korra.
TM31 sisaldab MUD-SLAPi.
See vähendab vaenlase täpsust
ja tekitab samal ajal kahju.
Teisisõnu, see on nii kaitse kui rünnak.

maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerFightDoneText.label: FalknerFightDoneText
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerFightDoneText.en:
There are #MON GYMS in cities and towns ahead.
You should test your skills at these GYMS.
I'm going to train harder to become
the greatest bird master!
maps/VioletGym.asm::FalknerFightDoneText.et:
Ees ootavad linnades #MON SAALID.
Pane nendes SAALIDES oma oskused proovile.
Treenin kõvemini, et saada
suurimaks linnumeistriks!

maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodSeenTex.label: BirdKeeperRodSeenText
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodSeenTex.en:
The keyword is guts!
Those here are training night and
day to become bird #MON masters.
Come on!
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodSeenTex.et:
Märksõna on vaprus!
Siinsed treenivad ööd ja
päevad, et saada linnu-#MONi meistriks.
Tule aga!

maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodAfterBa.label: BirdKeeperRodAfterBattleText
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodAfterBa.en:
FALKNER's skills are for real!
Don't get cocky just because you beat me!
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperRodAfterBa.et:
FALKNERI oskused on ehtsad!
Ära muutu upsakaks vaid sellepärast, et mind võitsid!

maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeSeenTex.label: BirdKeeperAbeSeenText
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeSeenTex.en: Let me see if you are good enough to face FALKNER!
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeSeenTex.et: Vaatan, kas oled FALKNERI vastu piisavalt hea!

maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeAfterBa.label: BirdKeeperAbeAfterBattleText
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeAfterBa.en: This is pathetic, losing to some rookie trainer…
maps/VioletGym.asm::BirdKeeperAbeAfterBa.et: See on hale — kaotada mõnele algajale treenerile…

maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideText.label: VioletGymGuideText
maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideText.en:
Hey! I'm no trainer but I can give some advice!
Believe me! If you believe, a
championship dream can come true.
You believe? Then listen.
The grass-type is weak against the
flying-type. Keep this in mind.
maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideText.et:
Hei! Treener ma pole, aga nõu oskan anda!
Usu mind! Kui usud, võib
meistritiitli unistus täituda.
Usud? Siis kuula.
Rohu-tüüp on nõrk
lendav-tüübi vastu. Pea seda meeles.

maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideWinTex.label: VioletGymGuideWinText
maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideWinTex.en:
Nice battle! Keep it up, and you'll
be the CHAMP in no time at all!
maps/VioletGym.asm::VioletGymGuideWinTex.et:
Tubli lahing! Jätka samas vaimus ja
oled varsti TŠEMPION!

maps/VioletKylesHouse.asm::VioletKylesHo.label: VioletKylesHousePokefanMText
maps/VioletKylesHouse.asm::VioletKylesHo.en:
A #MON you get in a trade grows quickly.
But if you don't have the right GYM
BADGE, they may disobey you.
maps/VioletKylesHouse.asm::VioletKylesHo.et:
#MON, kelle saad vahetuse teel, kasvab kiiresti.
Aga kui sul pole õiget SAALI
MÄRKI, võib see sulle mitte kuuletuda.

maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartGrannyTex.label: VioletMartGrannyText
maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartGrannyTex.en:
When you first catch a #MON, it may be weak.
But it will eventually grow to be strong.
It's important to treat #MON with love.
maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartGrannyTex.et:
Kui #MONi esimest korda püüad, võib see olla nõrk.
Aga lõpuks kasvab see tugevaks.
Oluline on kohelda #MONe armastusega.

maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartCooltrain.label: VioletMartCooltrainerMText
maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartCooltrain.en:
#MON can hold items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
But they don't appear to know how
to use manmade items.
maps/VioletMart.asm::VioletMartCooltrain.et:
#MONid saavad hoida esemeid nagu POTION ja ANTIDOTE.
Aga nad ei tundu teadvat, kuidas
inimtehtud esemeid kasutada.

maps/VioletNicknameSpeechHouse.asm::Viol.label: VioletNicknameSpeechHouseTeacherText
maps/VioletNicknameSpeechHouse.asm::Viol.en:
She uses the names of her favorite things to eat.
For the nicknames she gives to her #MON, I mean.
maps/VioletNicknameSpeechHouse.asm::Viol.et:
Ta kasutab oma lemmiktoitude nimesid.
Mõtlen hüüdnimesid, mis ta oma #MONidele annab.

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideFavorText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en:
<PLAY_G>, long time, no see.
PROF.ELM asked me to find you.
He has another favor to ask.
Would you take the #MON EGG?
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et:
<PLAY_G>, ammu pole näinud.
PROF.ELM palus mul sind leida.
Tal on veel üks palve.
Kas võtaksid #MON EGGi?

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideGiveEggText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en:
We discovered that a #MON will not
hatch until it grows in the EGG.
It also has to be with other active #MON to hatch.
<PLAY_G>, you're the only person we can rely on.
Please call PROF. ELM when that EGG hatches!
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et:
Avastasime, et #MON ei
koore, enne kui see EGGis kasvab.
Samuti peab see koorumiseks olema teiste aktiivsete #MONidega.
<PLAY_G>, sa oled ainus, kelle peale võime loota.
Helista PROF. ELMile, kui see EGG koorub!

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletCityE.label: VioletCityElmsAideFullPartyText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletCityE.en:
Oh, no. You can't carry any more #MON with you.
I'll wait here while you make room for the EGG.
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletCityE.et:
Oh ei. Sa ei saa rohkem #MONe kaasas kanda.
Ootan siin, kuni teed EGGile ruumi.

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideAskEggText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en:
<PLAY_G>, will you take the EGG?
I've been thinking it'd be great to
be able to link up and battle with my
friends who live far away.
I just battled a friend in CIANWOOD over a link.
If you connect a MOBILE ADAPTER,
you can link with a friend far away.
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et:
<PLAY_G>, kas võtad EGGi?
Olen mõelnud, et oleks tore
saada ühenduda ja võidelda oma
kaugete sõpradega.
Võitlesin just ühenduse teel sõbraga CIANWOODIST.
Kui ühendad MOBILE ADAPTERi,
saad ühenduda kauge sõbraga.

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenter1FGameboyKidText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en: A guy named BILL made the #MON PC storage system.
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et: Tüüp nimega BILL tegi #MON PC hoiusüsteemi.

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenter1FGentlemanText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en:
It was around three years ago.
TEAM ROCKET was up to no good with #MON.
But justice prevailed--a young kid broke 'em up.
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et:
See oli umbes kolm aastat tagasi.
RAKETI KAMP tegi #MONidega pahandust.
Aga õiglus võitis - noor jõmpsikas lõhkus nad laiali.

maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.label: VioletPokecenter1FYoungsterText
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.en:
#MON are smart. They won't obey a
trainer they don't respect.
Without the right GYM BADGES, they
will just do as they please.
maps/VioletPokecenter1F.asm::VioletPokec.et:
#MONid on targad. Nad ei kuuletu
treenerile, keda nad ei austa.
Ilma õigete SAALI MÄRKIDETA teevad
nad lihtsalt oma tahtmist.

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsQuestionText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.en:
Hey, kid! I just had a double shot
of espresso, and I am wired!
I need to talk to someone, so you'll have to do!
I might not look like much now, but
I was an expert at catching #MON.
Do you believe me?
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.et:
Hei, laps! Jõin just topelt espresso ja olen elektrit täis!
Pean kellegagi rääkima, nii et sa pead sobima!
Ehk ma praegu ei paista, aga olin #MONide püüdmise ekspert.
Kas usud mind?

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsBelievedText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.en:
Good, good. Yes, I was something out
of the ordinary, let me tell you!
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.et: Hea, hea. Jah, ma olin midagi tavatut, ütlen sulle!

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsDoubtedText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.en:
What? You little whelp!
If I were just a bit younger, I'd
show you a thing or two. Humph!
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityCoffe.et:
Mis? Sa väike jõmpsikas!
Kui oleksin pisut noorem, näitaksin sulle üht-teist. Hmph!

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.label: ViridianCityGrampsNearGymText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.en:
This GYM didn't have a LEADER until recently.
A young man from PALLET became the
LEADER, but he's often away.
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.et:
Sellel SAALIL polnud kuni hiljutini JUHTI.
Üks noormees PALLETIST sai JUHIKS, aga ta on tihti ära.

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.label: ViridianCityGrampsNearGymBlueReturnedText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.en:
Are you going to battle the LEADER?
Good luck to you. You'll need it.
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityGramp.et:
Kas kavatsed JUHIGA võidelda?
Edu sulle. Sul läheb seda vaja.

maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityDream.label: ViridianCityDreamEaterFisherText
maps/ViridianCity.asm::ViridianCityDream.en:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.
…I had this dream about a DROWZEE
eating my dream. Weird, huh?
Huh? What's this?
Where did this TM come from?

Hä? Mis see on?
Kust see TM tuli?

maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueBeforeTe.label: LeaderBlueBeforeText
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueBeforeTe.en:
BLUE: Yo! Finally got here, huh?
I wasn't in the mood at CINNABAR,
but now I'm ready to battle you.
…
You're telling me you conquered all the GYMS in JOHTO?
Heh! JOHTO's GYMS must be pretty pathetic then.
Hey, don't worry about it.
I'll know if you are good or not by
battling you right now.
Ready, JOHTO CHAMP?
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueBeforeTe.et:
BLUE: Hei! Lõpuks jõudsid, mis?
CINNABARIS polnud mul tuju, aga nüüd olen valmis sinuga võitlema.
…
Sa ütled, et vallutasid kõik JOHTO SAALID?
Heh! Siis peavad JOHTO SAALID päris haledad olema.
Hei, ära muretse.
Ma saan kohe võideldes teada, kas oled hea või mitte.
Valmis, JOHTO TŠEMPION?

maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueWinText.label: LeaderBlueWinText
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueWinText.en:
BLUE: What?
How the heck did I lose to you?
…
Tch, all right… Here, take this-it's EARTHBADGE.
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueWinText.et:
BLUE: Mis?
Kuidas kuradi moodi ma sulle kaotasin?
…
Tsah, hea küll… Säh, võta see — EARTHBADGE.

maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueAfterTex.label: LeaderBlueAfterText
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueAfterTex.en:
BLUE: …
All right, I was wrong. You're the
real deal. You are a good trainer.
But I'm going to beat you someday.
Don't you forget it!
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueAfterTex.et:
BLUE: …
Hea küll, ma eksisin. Sa oled ehtne. Oled hea treener.
Aga ma võidan sind kunagi. Ära seda unusta!

maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueEpilogue.label: LeaderBlueEpilogueText
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueEpilogue.en:
BLUE: Listen, you.
You'd better not lose until I beat you. Got it?
maps/ViridianGym.asm::LeaderBlueEpilogue.et:
BLUE: Kuule, sina.
Ära kaota enne, kui mina sind võidan. Selge?

maps/ViridianGym.asm::ViridianGymGuideTe.label: ViridianGymGuideText
maps/ViridianGym.asm::ViridianGymGuideTe.en:
Yo, CHAMP in making!
How's it going? Looks like you're on a roll.
The GYM LEADER is a guy who battled
the CHAMPION three years ago.
He's no pushover.
Give it everything you've got!
maps/ViridianGym.asm::ViridianGymGuideTe.et:

Kuidas läheb? Tundub, et sul veab.
SAALI JUHT on mees, kes võitles kolm aastat tagasi TŠEMPIONIGA.
Ta pole mingi tühiasi.
Anna endast kõik!

maps/ViridianGym.asm::ViridianGymGuideWi.label: ViridianGymGuideWinText

maps/ViridianGym.asm::ViridianGymGuideWi.et:

maps/ViridianPokecenter1F.asm::ViridianP.label: ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText

maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillBefor.label: WillScript_WillBeforeText
maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillBefor.en:
Welcome to #MON LEAGUE, <PLAYER>.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am WILL.
I have trained all around the world,
making my psychic #MON powerful.
And, at last, I've been accepted into the ELITE FOUR.
I can only keep getting better!
Losing is not an option!
maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillBefor.et:
Tere tulemast #MON LIIGASSE, <PLAYER>.
Lubage end tutvustada. Olen WILL.
Olen treeninud üle maailma, tehes oma vaimsed #MONid võimsaks.
Ja lõpuks võeti mind ELIITNELIKKU.
Saan aina paremaks!
Kaotamine pole valik!

maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillDefea.label: WillScript_WillDefeatText
maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillDefea.en:
Even though I was defeated, I won't change my course.
I will continue battling until I
stand above all trainers!
Now, <PLAYER>, move on and experience
the true ferocity of the ELITE FOUR.
maps/WillsRoom.asm::WillScript_WillDefea.et:
Kuigi mind võideti, ma oma kurssi ei muuda.
Jätkan võitlemist, kuni seisan kõigist treeneritest kõrgemal!
Nüüd, <PLAYER>, mine edasi ja koge ELIITNELIKU tõelist ägedust.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.label: WiseTriosRoomSage1Text
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.en:
Astounding…
SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU have arisen from their sleep…
Is the legend coming true?
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.et:
Hämmastav…
SUICUNE, ENTEI ja RAIKOU on unest ärganud…
Kas legend läheb täide?

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.label: WiseTriosRoomSage2Text
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.en:
We train at the BURNED TOWER, but
we've never heard of a hole opening
up there before. It must have been
deliberately made by someone.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.et:
Treenime BURNED TOWERIS, aga
pole kunagi kuulnud, et sinna oleks
varem auk avanenud. Selle pidi
keegi meelega tegema.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.label: WiseTriosRoomSage3BlocksExitText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.en:
TIN TOWER may be entered by those
bearing ECRUTEAK's GYM BADGE.
However, now that SUICUNE, RAIKOU
and ENTEI have arisen, I ask you
to refrain from entering!
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.et:
TIN TOWERISSE võivad siseneda need,
kellel on ECRUTEAKI SAALI MÄRK.
Kuid nüüd, kui SUICUNE, RAIKOU
ja ENTEI on ärganud, palun sul
sisenemisest hoiduda!

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.label: WiseTriosRoomSage3Text
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.en:
We, the WISE TRIO, are the protectors
of the legendary #MON.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::WiseTriosRoomSag.et:
Meie, TARGA KOLMIK, oleme
legendaarsete #MONide kaitsjad.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuSeenText.label: SageGakuSeenText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuSeenText.en:
Legend has it that upon the emergence
of a trainer who has the ability to
touch the souls of #MON, a #MON
will come forth to put that trainer
to test at the TIN TOWER.
The legend has come true!
The legendary #MON SUICUNE has arrived!
We, the WISE TRIO, shall test your
worthiness to go inside!
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuSeenText.et:
Legend räägib, et kui ilmub
treener, kellel on võime
puudutada #MONide hingi, tuleb #MON
seda treenerit TIN TOWERIS
proovile panema.
Legend on täide läinud!
Legendaarne #MON SUICUNE on saabunud!
Meie, TARGA KOLMIK, paneme proovile su
väärikuse sisse minna!

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuAfterBat.label: SageGakuAfterBattleText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuAfterBat.en:
Ah, so it is you who claim to have
seen SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU while they slept?
Unbelievable!
Legend has it that they can't be seen while they sleep…
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageGakuAfterBat.et:
Ah, nii et sina väidad, et oled
näinud SUICUNET, ENTEID ja RAIKOUD nende unes?
Uskumatu!
Legendi järgi ei saa neid magades näha…

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaSeenText.label: SageMasaSeenText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaSeenText.en:
Can you be trusted with the truth?
I must ascertain your worthiness.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaSeenText.et:
Kas sind võib tõega usaldada?
Pean su väärikust kindlaks tegema.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaAfterBat.label: SageMasaAfterBattleText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaAfterBat.en:
In the past, there were two nine-tier towers here.
The BRASS TOWER, which was said to
awaken #MON, and the TIN TOWER,
where #MON were said to rest.
The view from the tops of the TOWERS
must have been magnificent.
At the time, an immense, silver-
colored #MON was said to make
its roost atop the BRASS TOWER.
However…
About 150 years ago, a lightning
bolt struck one of the TOWERS.
It was engulfed in flames that raged for three days.
A sudden downpour finally put out the blaze.
And that is how the BURNED TOWER came to be.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageMasaAfterBat.et:
Vanasti oli siin kaks üheksakordset torni.
BRASS TOWER, mis olevat
äratanud #MONe, ja TIN TOWER,
kus #MONid olevat puhanud.
Vaade TORNIDE tippudest
pidi olema suurejooneline.
Tol ajal olevat tohutu, hõbedast
värvi #MON teinud
oma pesa BRASS TOWERI tippu.
Kuid…
Umbes 150 aastat tagasi tabas
üht TORNI välgunool.
See mattus leekidesse, mis möllasid kolm päeva.
Äkiline paduvihm kustutas lõpuks tule.
Ja nii sündis BURNED TOWER.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.label: SageKojiAfterBattleQuestionText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.en:
You… Are you the trainer who is
awaited by the legendary #MON?
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.et:
Sina… Kas sina oled treener,
keda legendaarne #MON ootab?

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.label: SageKojiAfterBattleSpeechText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.en:
I see…
We, the WISE TRIO, have been given
the responsibility of protecting the
legendary #MON. We are to allow
passage only to those people who
possess the power and soul of truth.
Please, do go on and enter the TIN TOWER ahead.
SUICUNE will put you to the test.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.et:
Ma näen…
Meie, TARGA KOLMIK, oleme saanud
vastutuse kaitsta
legendaarseid #MONe. Me lubame
sisse ainult neid inimesi, kellel
on tõe jõud ja hing.
Palun, mine edasi ja sisene eesolevasse TIN TOWERISSE.
SUICUNE paneb su proovile.

maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.label: SageKojiAfterBattleFinalText
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.en:
Please, do go on.
SUICUNE will put you to the test.
maps/WiseTriosRoom.asm::SageKojiAfterBat.et:
Palun, mine edasi.
SUICUNE paneb su proovile.

Hello! Sorry to keep you waiting!
Welcome to the world of #MON!
My name is OAK.
People call me the #MON PROF.

Tere tulemast #MONide maailma!

data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText2.en: This world is inhabited by creatures that we call #MON.
data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText2.et: Seda maailma asustavad olendid, keda me #MONideks kutsume.

data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText4.label: _OakText4

People and #MON live together by
supporting each other.
Some people play with #MON, some battle with them.
data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText4.et:
Inimesed ja #MONid elavad koos,
üksteist toetades.
Mõni mängib #MONidega, mõni võitleb nendega.

data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText5.en:
But we don't know everything about #MON yet.
There are still many mysteries to solve.
That's why I study #MON every day.
data/text/common_2.asm::_OakText5.et:
Aga me ei tea veel #MONide kohta kõike.
Lahendamata on veel palju mõistatusi.
Seepärast uurin ma #MONe iga päev.

Your very own #MON story is about to unfold.
You'll face fun times and tough challenges.
A world of dreams and adventures
with #MON awaits! Let's go!
I'll be seeing you later!
data/text/common_3.asm::_OakText7.et:
<PLAYER>, kas oled valmis?
Su enda #MON-lugu on kohe algamas.
Sind ootavad lõbusad hetked ja rasked väljakutsed.
Unistuste ja seikluste maailm
koos #MONidega ootab! Lähme!
Näeme hiljem!
