Miiida? Ma ei suuda midagi öelda!
Kuidas ma seda ei tea?

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerNameLocatio.label: _SeerNameLocationText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerNameLocatio.en: Hm… I see you met {RAM} here: {RAM}!

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTimeLevelTe.label: _SeerTimeLevelText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTimeLevelTe.en:
The time was {RAM}!
Its level was {RAM}!
Am I good or what?
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTimeLevelTe.et:
Aeg oli {RAM}!
Selle tase oli {RAM}!
Kas ma olen hea või mis?

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTradeText.label: _SeerTradeText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTradeText.en:
Hm… {RAM} came from {RAM} in a trade?
{RAM} was where {RAM} met {RAM}!
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerTradeText.et:
Hmm… {RAM} tuli {RAM}lt vahetuse teel?
{RAM} oli seal, kus {RAM} kohtas {RAM}!

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerNoLocationT.label: _SeerNoLocationText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerNoLocationT.en:
What!? Incredible!
I don't understand how, but it is
incredible! You are special.
I can't tell where you met it, but it was at level {RAM}.
Am I good or what?
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerNoLocationT.et:
Mida!? Uskumatu!
Ma ei mõista kuidas, aga see on
uskumatu! Sa oled eriline.
Ma ei oska öelda, kus sa selle kohtasid, aga see oli tasemel {RAM}.
Kas ma olen hea või mis?

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerEggText.label: _SeerEggText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerEggText.en:
Hey!
That's an EGG!
You can't say that you've met it yet…
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerEggText.et:
Hei!
See on EGG!
Ei saa öelda, et oleksid seda juba kohanud…

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerDoNothingTe.label: _SeerDoNothingText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerDoNothingTe.en: Fufufu! I saw that you'd do nothing!
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerDoNothingTe.et: Fufufu! Nägin, et sa ei tee midagi!

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreCareTex.label: _SeerMoreCareText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreCareTex.en:
Incidentally…
It would be wise to raise your
#MON with a little more care.
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreCareTex.et:
Muuseas…
Oleks tark oma
#MONi veidi hoolikamalt kasvatada.

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreConfide.label: _SeerMoreConfidentText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreConfide.en:
Incidentally…
It seems to have grown a little.
{RAM} seems to be becoming more confident.
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMoreConfide.et:
Muuseas…
Tundub, et see on veidi kasvanud.
{RAM} näib muutuvat enesekindlamaks.

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMuchStrengt.label: _SeerMuchStrengthText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMuchStrengt.en:
Incidentally…
{RAM} has grown. It's gained much strength.
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMuchStrengt.et:
Muuseas…
{RAM} on kasvanud. See on saanud palju jõudu.

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMightyText.label: _SeerMightyText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMightyText.en:
Incidentally…
It certainly has grown mighty!
This {RAM} must have come
through numerous #MON battles.
It looks brimming with confidence.
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerMightyText.et:
Muuseas…
See on kindlasti vägevaks kasvanud!
See {RAM} on kindlasti läbinud
arvukalt #MON-lahinguid.
See näib enesekindlust täis olevat.

data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerImpressedTe.label: _SeerImpressedText
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerImpressedTe.en:
Incidentally…
I'm impressed by your dedication.
It's been a long time since I've
seen a #MON as mighty as this {RAM}.
I'm sure that seeing {RAM}
in battle would excite anyone.
data/text/common_3.asm::_SeerImpressedTe.et:
Muuseas…
Su pühendumus avaldab mulle muljet.
Ammu pole ma näinud
nii vägevat #MONi kui see {RAM}.
Olen kindel, et {RAM} nägemine
lahingus paneks igaühe elevusse.

data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbShopLadyInt.label: _HerbShopLadyIntroText
data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbShopLadyInt.en:
Hello, dear.
I sell inexpensive herbal medicine.
They're good, but a trifle bitter.
Your #MON may not like them.
Hehehehe…
data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbShopLadyInt.et:
Tere, kallis.
Müün odavat taimeravimit.
Need on head, aga pisut mõrud.
Su #MONile ei pruugi need meeldida.
Hehehehe…

data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbalLadyPackF.label: _HerbalLadyPackFullText
data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbalLadyPackF.en: Oh? Your PACK is full, dear.
data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbalLadyPackF.et: Oh? Su PACK on täis, kallis.

data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbalLadyNoMon.label: _HerbalLadyNoMoneyText
data/text/common_3.asm::_HerbalLadyNoMon.en: Hehehe… You don't have the money.

data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopIntr.label: _BargainShopIntroText
data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopIntr.en:
Hiya! Care to see some bargains?
I sell rare items that nobody else
carries--but only one of each item.
data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopIntr.et:
Tere! Tahad soodushindu vaadata?
Müün haruldasi esemeid, mida keegi teine
ei müü -- aga igaüht vaid ühe.

data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopPack.label: _BargainShopPackFullText
data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopPack.et: Oih, su PACK on puupüsti täis.

data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopSold.label: _BargainShopSoldOutText
data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopSold.en: You bought that already. I'm all sold out of it.
data/text/common_3.asm::_BargainShopSold.et: Ostsid selle juba. See on mul otsas.

data/text/common_3.asm::_PharmacyPackFul.en: You don't have any more space.

data/text/common_3.asm::_NothingToSellTe.label: _NothingToSellText
data/text/common_3.asm::_NothingToSellTe.en: You don't have anything to sell.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MartSellPriceTe.label: _MartSellPriceText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartSellPriceTe.en:
I can pay you ¥{NUM}.
Is that OK?
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartSellPriceTe.et:
Saan sulle maksta ¥{NUM}.
Kas nii on hea?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MartWelcomeText.label: _MartWelcomeText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartWelcomeText.en: Welcome! How may I help you?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MartPackFullTex.label: _MartPackFullText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartPackFullTex.en: You can't carry any more items.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartPackFullTex.et: Sa ei saa rohkem esemeid kaasas kanda.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MartCantBuyText.label: _MartCantBuyText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartCantBuyText.en: Sorry, I can't buy that from you.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartCantBuyText.et: Vabandust, seda ma sinult osta ei saa.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MartAskMoreText.label: _MartAskMoreText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MartAskMoreText.en: Can I do anything else for you?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumEn.label: _MobileStadiumEntryText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumEn.en:
Data for use in the MOBILE STADIUM
of the N64 #MON STADIUM 2 can be read here.
Read the data?
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumEn.et:
MOBILE STADIUMis kasutamiseks mõeldud
andmeid N64 #MON STADIUM 2-st saab siit lugeda.
Lugeda andmed?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumSu.label: _MobileStadiumSuccessText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumSu.en:
Data transfer is complete.
We hope you enjoy MOBILE STADIUM
battles in the N64 #MON STADIUM 2.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileStadiumSu.et:
Andmeülekanne on lõpetatud.
Loodame, et naudid MOBILE STADIUMi
lahinguid N64 #MON STADIUM 2-s.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro1Text
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
The CARD FOLDER stores your and
your friends' CARDS.
A CARD contains information like
the person's name, phone number and profile.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
CARD FOLDER hoiab sinu ja
su sõprade CARDe.
CARD sisaldab teavet nagu
inimese nimi, telefoninumber ja profiil.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro2Text
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
This is your CARD.
Once you've entered your phone
number, you can trade CARDS with your friends.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
See on sinu CARD.
Kui oled sisestanud oma telefoni-
numbri, saad sõpradega CARDe vahetada.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro3Text
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
If you have your friend's CARD, you
can use it to make a call from a
mobile phone on the 2nd floor of a #MON CENTER.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
Kui sul on sõbra CARD, saad
seda kasutada, et helistada
mobiililt #MON KESKUSE 2. korrusel.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro4Text
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
To safely store your collection of
CARDS, you must set a PASSCODE for your CARD FOLDER.
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
Oma CARDide kogu turvaliseks
hoidmiseks pead CARD FOLDERile PASSCODE'i seadma.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderAskDeleteText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
If the CARD FOLDER is deleted, all
its CARDS and the PASSCODE will also be deleted.
Beware--a deleted CARD FOLDER can't be restored.
Want to delete your CARD FOLDER?
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
Kui CARD FOLDER kustutatakse, kustuvad ka
kõik selle CARDid ja PASSCODE.
Ettevaatust -- kustutatud CARD FOLDERit ei saa taastada.
Kustutada oma CARD FOLDER?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderDeleteAreYouSureText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en: Are you sure you want to delete it?
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et: Oled kindel, et tahad selle kustutada?

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderDeletedText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en: The CARD FOLDER has been deleted.

data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.label: _MobileCardFolderAskOpenOldText
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.en:
There is an older CARD FOLDER from a previous journey.
Do you want to open it?
data/text/common_3.asm::_MobileCardFolde.et:
Eelmiselt teekonnalt on vanem CARD FOLDER.
Kas tahad selle avada?

data/text/common_3.asm::_TheMonMustNotHo.en: The {RAM} #MON must not hold the same items.

data/text/common_3.asm::_BallDodgedText.en:

See vältis visatud BALLi!
Seda #MONi ei saa püüda!

data/text/common_3.asm::_BallSoCloseText.en: Shoot! It was so close too!

data/text/common_3.asm::_SentTrophyHomeT.et:

{RAM} saatis trofee koju.

data/text/common_3.asm::_ItemCantUseOnEg.en: That can't be used on an EGG.

data/text/common_3.asm::_ItemOakWarningT.label: _ItemOakWarningText

data/text/common_3.asm::_DeleterEggText.en: An EGG doesn't know any moves!

data/text/common_3.asm::_DeleterAskWhich.en: Which move should it forget, then?

Öö… Ah jaa, olen RÜNNAKUKUSTUTAJA.
Saan panna #MONid rünnakuid unustama.

data/text/std_text.asm::NurseNiteText.en:

Welcome to our #MON CENTER.
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseNiteText.et:
Tere õhtust! Oled hilja väljas.
Tere tulemast meie #MON KESKUSESSE.

data/text/std_text.asm::PokeComNurseMorn.en:
Good morning!

Tere hommikust!

data/text/std_text.asm::PokeComNurseDayT.label: PokeComNurseDayText

Hello!
This is the #MON COMMUNICATION
CENTER--or the #COM CENTER.

Tere!
See on #MON SIDEKESKUS

data/text/std_text.asm::PokeComNurseNite.label: PokeComNurseNiteText
data/text/std_text.asm::PokeComNurseNite.en:
Good to see you working so late.
This is the #MON COMMUNICATION
CENTER--or the #COM CENTER.
data/text/std_text.asm::PokeComNurseNite.et:
Tore näha sind nii hilja töötamas.
See on #MON SIDEKESKUS
-- ehk #COM KESKUS.

data/text/std_text.asm::NurseAskHealText.label: NurseAskHealText
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseAskHealText.en:
We can heal your #MON to perfect health.
Shall we heal your #MON?
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseAskHealText.et:
Saame su #MONid täiesti terveks ravida.
Kas ravime su #MONid?

data/text/std_text.asm::NurseReturnPokem.en:
Thank you for waiting.
Your #MON are fully healed.
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseReturnPokem.et:
Aitäh ootamast.
Su #MONid on täiesti terved.

data/text/std_text.asm::NurseGoodbyeText.label: NurseGoodbyeText
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseGoodbyeText.en:
We hope to see you again.
We hope to see you again.
data/text/std_text.asm::NurseGoodbyeText.et:
Loodame sind jälle näha.
Loodame sind jälle näha.

data/text/std_text.asm::NursePokerusText.en:
Your #MON appear to be
infected by tiny life forms.

tillukeste eluvormidega nakatunud.

#MON KESKUSES.

data/text/std_text.asm::TeamRocketOathTe.en:

data/pokemon/dex_entries/abra.asm::abra.label: abra
data/pokemon/dex_entries/abra.asm::abra.en:
PSI
It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away
when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/abra.asm::abra.et:
PSI
See hüpnotiseerib end, et saaks ohtu aistides teleportida, isegi kui ta magab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/aerodactyl.asm:.label: aerodactyl
data/pokemon/dex_entries/aerodactyl.asm:.en:
FOSSIL
In prehistoric times, this #MON flew
freely and fearlessly through the skies.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/aerodactyl.asm:.et:
FOSSIIL
Eelajaloolisel ajal lendas see #MON vabalt ja kartmatult taevas.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/aipom.asm::aipo.label: aipom
data/pokemon/dex_entries/aipom.asm::aipo.en:
LONG TAIL
It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses
its momentum to swing from one branch to another.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/aipom.asm::aipo.et:
PIKK SABA
See kasutab saba, et rippuda puuokstel. Hoo abil kiigub see oksalt oksale.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/alakazam.asm::a.label: alakazam
data/pokemon/dex_entries/alakazam.asm::a.en:
PSI
It has an IQ of 5000. It calculates many things
in order to gain the edge in every battle.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/alakazam.asm::a.et:
PSI
Selle IQ on 5000. See arvutab paljusid asju, et igas lahingus eelis saada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ampharos.asm::a.label: ampharos
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ampharos.asm::a.en:
LIGHT
When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail
can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ampharos.asm::a.et:
VALGUS
Kui pimedaks läheb, on selle särava saba valgust näha kaugelt ookeani pinnal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/arbok.asm::arbo.label: arbok
data/pokemon/dex_entries/arbok.asm::arbo.en:
COBRA
To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and
makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/arbok.asm::arbo.et:
KOBRA
Vaenlaste hirmutamiseks ajab see rinna laiaks ja teeb suust õhku puhudes jubedaid hääli.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/arcanine.asm::a.label: arcanine
data/pokemon/dex_entries/arcanine.asm::a.en:
LEGENDARY
An ancient picture scroll shows that people were
attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/arcanine.asm::a.et:
LEGENDAARNE
Iidne pildirull näitab, et inimesi paelus selle liikumine, kui see üle preeriate jooksis.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ariados.asm::ar.label: ariados
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ariados.asm::ar.en:
LONG LEG
Rather than making a nest in one specific spot, it
wanders in search of food after darkness falls.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ariados.asm::ar.et:
PIKK JALG
Ühte kindlasse kohta pesa tegemata rändab see pärast pimeduse saabumist toitu otsides.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/articuno.asm::a.label: articuno
data/pokemon/dex_entries/articuno.asm::a.en:
FREEZE
Legendary bird #MON. As it flies through the
sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/articuno.asm::a.et:
KÜLM
Legendaarne linnu-#MON. Taevas lennates jahutab see õhku ja paneb lume sadama.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/azumarill.asm::.label: azumarill
data/pokemon/dex_entries/azumarill.asm::.en:
AQUARABBIT
The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it
camouflage itself when it's in the water.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/azumarill.asm::.et:
VEEJÄNES
Kõhul olev mullilaadne muster aitab tal vees end kamufleerida.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/bayleef.asm::ba.label: bayleef
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bayleef.asm::ba.en:
LEAF
The scent that wafts from the leaves on its neck
causes anyone who smells it to become energetic.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bayleef.asm::ba.et:
LEHT
Lõhn, mis levib selle kaelal olevatest lehtedest, muudab iga nuusutaja energiliseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/beedrill.asm::b.label: beedrill
data/pokemon/dex_entries/beedrill.asm::b.en:
POISON BEE
It uses sharp, poisonous stings to defeat prey,
then takes the victim back to its nest for food.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/beedrill.asm::b.et:
MÜRGIMESILANE
See kasutab teravaid mürginõelu, et saak alistada, ja viib ohvri pessa toiduks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellossom.asm::.label: bellossom
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellossom.asm::.en:
FLOWER
When these dance together, their petals rub against
each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellossom.asm::.et:
LILL
Kui need koos tantsivad, hõõruvad õielehed vastastikku, tekitades kauneid, rahustavaid helisid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellsprout.asm:.label: bellsprout
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellsprout.asm:.en:
FLOWER
If it notices anything that moves, it
immediately flings its vine at the object.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bellsprout.asm:.et:
LILL
Kui see märkab midagi liikumas, viskab see kohe oma väädi objekti pihta.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/blastoise.asm::.label: blastoise
data/pokemon/dex_entries/blastoise.asm::.en:
SHELLFISH
It firmly plants its feet on the ground before
shooting water from the jets on its back.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/blastoise.asm::.et:
KARPLOOM
See surub jalad kindlalt maasse, enne kui tulistab vett seljal olevatest düüsidest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/blissey.asm::bl.label: blissey
data/pokemon/dex_entries/blissey.asm::bl.en:
HAPPINESS
Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY
provides will make everyone around smile with joy.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/blissey.asm::bl.et:
ÕNN
Ühe BLISSEY pakutava maitsva muna hammustamine paneb kõik ümberringi rõõmust naeratama.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/bulbasaur.asm::.label: bulbasaur
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bulbasaur.asm::.en:
SEED
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/bulbasaur.asm::.et:
SEEME
Noorena kasutab see kasvamiseks toitaineid, mis on talletatud seljal olevates seemnetes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/butterfree.asm:.label: butterfree
data/pokemon/dex_entries/butterfree.asm:.en:
BUTTERFLY
It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey.
It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/butterfree.asm:.et:
LIBLIKAS
See lipsab lillelt lillele mett kogudes. See suudab tuvastada isegi kaugeid õitsvaid lilli.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/caterpie.asm::c.label: caterpie
data/pokemon/dex_entries/caterpie.asm::c.en:
WORM
It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself
among leaves that are the same color as its body.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/caterpie.asm::c.et:
USS
See roomab lehestikku, kus kamufleerib end lehtede seas, mis on ta kehaga sama värvi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/celebi.asm::cel.label: celebi
data/pokemon/dex_entries/celebi.asm::cel.en:
TIMETRAVEL
Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI
appears wherever beautiful forests exist.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/celebi.asm::cel.et:
AJARÄND
Metsa kaitsjana austatud CELEBI ilmub kõikjale, kus on kauneid metsi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/chansey.asm::ch.label: chansey
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chansey.asm::ch.en:
EGG
People try to catch it for its extremely
nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chansey.asm::ch.et:
MUNA
Inimesed üritavad seda püüda selle ülitoitvate munade pärast, aga seda leidub harva.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/charizard.asm::.label: charizard
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charizard.asm::.en:
FLAME
It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its
fire increases as it gains experience in battle.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charizard.asm::.et:
LEEK
See kasutab tiibu, et kõrgele lennata. Selle tule temperatuur tõuseb lahingukogemusega.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmander.asm:.label: charmander
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmander.asm:.en:
LIZARD
If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail
will burn vigorously, even if it gets a bit wet.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmander.asm:.et:
SISALIK
Kui see on terve, põleb saba otsas olev leek ägedalt, isegi kui see veidi märjaks saab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmeleon.asm:.label: charmeleon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmeleon.asm:.en:
FLAME
If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts
intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/charmeleon.asm:.et:
LEEK
Kui see lahingus ärritub, purskab see intensiivseid leeke, tuhastades ümbruse.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/chikorita.asm::.label: chikorita
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chikorita.asm::.en:
LEAF
It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf
on its head to seek out warm places.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chikorita.asm::.et:
LEHT
See armastab päikese käes peesitada. Peas oleva lehe abil otsib see sooje kohti.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/chinchou.asm::c.label: chinchou
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chinchou.asm::c.en:
ANGLER
Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both po-
sitive and negative charges flowing through them.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/chinchou.asm::c.et:
ÕNGITSEJA
Selle antennides, mis arenesid uimest, voolavad nii positiivsed kui negatiivsed laengud.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefable.asm::c.label: clefable
data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefable.asm::c.en:
FAIRY
Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this
type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefable.asm::c.et:
HALDJAS
Elab väidetavalt vaiksetes, kõrvalistes mägedes ja väldib tugevalt nähtavaks jäämist.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefairy.asm::c.label: clefairy
data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefairy.asm::c.en:
FAIRY
Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot,
for some reason, on the night of a full moon.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/clefairy.asm::c.et:
HALDJAS
Kuigi harva nähtud, on seda millegipärast täiskuuööl kergem märgata.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/cleffa.asm::cle.label: cleffa
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cleffa.asm::cle.en:
STARSHAPE
If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this
#MON is certain to be within the immediate area.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cleffa.asm::cle.et:
TÄHEKUJU
Kui leitakse meteoriidi kukkumiskoht, on see #MON kindlasti läheduses.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/cloyster.asm::c.label: cloyster
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cloyster.asm::c.en:
BIVALVE
Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to
stab opponents. They're even harder than its shell.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cloyster.asm::c.et:
KARP
Isegi rakett ei suuda murda ogasid, millega see vastaseid torkab. Need on kõvemad kui ta koor.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/corsola.asm::co.label: corsola
data/pokemon/dex_entries/corsola.asm::co.en:
CORAL
The points on its head absorb nutrients from
clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/corsola.asm::co.et:
KORALL
Peas olevad tipud imavad puhtast veest toitaineid. Need ei suuda saastunud vees ellu jääda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/crobat.asm::cro.label: crobat
data/pokemon/dex_entries/crobat.asm::cro.en:
BAT
As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent
flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/crobat.asm::cro.et:
NAHKHIIR
Kiirema, kuid vaiksema lennu poole püüdes kasvas selle tagajalgadele uus tiivapaar.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/croconaw.asm::c.label: croconaw
data/pokemon/dex_entries/croconaw.asm::c.en:
BIG JAW
The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once
those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/croconaw.asm::c.et:
SUURLÕUG
Selle kihvade otsad on tahapoole kaldu. Kui need kord kinni klõpsavad, pole saagil pääsu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/cubone.asm::cub.label: cubone
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cubone.asm::cub.en:
LONELY
It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its
mother's skull, never revealing its true face.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cubone.asm::cub.et:
ÜKSILDANE
See kaotas sünni järel oma ema. See kannab ema koljut, paljastamata kunagi oma tõelist nägu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/cyndaquil.asm::.label: cyndaquil
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cyndaquil.asm::.en:
FIRE MOUSE
The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest
when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/cyndaquil.asm::.et:
TULEHIIR
Seljast purskav tuli põleb kõige kuumemalt, kui see on vihane. Lõõmavad leegid hirmutavad vaenlasi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/delibird.asm::d.label: delibird
data/pokemon/dex_entries/delibird.asm::d.en:
DELIVERY
It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes.
If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/delibird.asm::d.et:
KULLER
See kannab oma toitu alati kaasas, kuhu iganes läheb. Rünnatuna viskab see toidu vastasele.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dewgong.asm::de.label: dewgong
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dewgong.asm::de.en:
SEA LION
It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the
day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dewgong.asm::de.et:
MERELÕVI
See magab päeval madalas ookeanivees ja otsib öösel, kui on külm, toitu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/diglett.asm::di.label: diglett
data/pokemon/dex_entries/diglett.asm::di.en:
MOLE
It digs underground and chews on tree roots,
sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/diglett.asm::di.et:
MUTT
See kaevab maa all ja närib puujuuri, pistes pea välja vaid siis, kui päike pole ere.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ditto.asm::ditt.label: ditto
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ditto.asm::ditt.en:
TRANSFORM
When it encounters another DITTO, it will move
faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ditto.asm::ditt.et:
MUUNDUJA
Kui see kohtab teist DITTOt, liigub see tavalisest kiiremini, et vastast täpselt kopeerida.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dodrio.asm::dod.label: dodrio
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dodrio.asm::dod.en:
TRIPLEBIRD
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three
heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dodrio.asm::dod.et:
KOLMIKLIND
Vaenlast, kes pöörab pilgu ühelt kolmest peast kasvõi hetkeks, nokitakse tugevalt.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/doduo.asm::dodu.label: doduo
data/pokemon/dex_entries/doduo.asm::dodu.en:
TWIN BIRD
It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long
way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/doduo.asm::dodu.et:
KAKSIKLIND
See elab rohtsel tasandikul, kus näeb kaugele. Vaenlast nähes jookseb see 60 mph kiirusel minema.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/donphan.asm::do.label: donphan
data/pokemon/dex_entries/donphan.asm::do.en:
ARMOR
Because this #MON's skin is so tough, a normal
attack won't even leave a scratch on it.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/donphan.asm::do.et:
SOOMUS
Kuna selle #MONi nahk on nii kõva, ei jäta tavaline rünnak sellele isegi kriimu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonair.asm::.label: dragonair
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonair.asm::.en:
DRAGON
It is called the divine #MON. When its entire
body brightens slightly, the weather changes.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonair.asm::.et:
DRAAKON
Seda kutsutakse jumalikuks #MONiks. Kui kogu ta keha veidi helendab, muutub ilm.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonite.asm::.label: dragonite
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonite.asm::.en:
DRAGON
It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an
island where these gather. Only they live there.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dragonite.asm::.et:
DRAAKON
Öeldakse, et kusagil ookeanis on saar, kuhu need kogunevad. Ainult nemad elavad seal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dratini.asm::dr.label: dratini
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dratini.asm::dr.en:
DRAGON
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. Dur-
ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dratini.asm::dr.et:
DRAAKON
Kasvades ajab see palju nahakihte maha. Selle protsessi ajal kaitseb seda kärestik.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/drowzee.asm::dr.label: drowzee
data/pokemon/dex_entries/drowzee.asm::dr.en:
HYPNOSIS
When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone
is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/drowzee.asm::dr.et:
HÜPNOOS
Kui see nina tõmbleb, oskab see öelda, kus keegi magab ja millest see inimene und näeb.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dugtrio.asm::du.label: dugtrio
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dugtrio.asm::du.en:
MOLE
These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea
level. No one knows what it's like underground.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dugtrio.asm::du.et:
MUTT
Need DIGLETI kolmikud kaevavad üle 60 miili allpool merepinda. Keegi ei tea, milline on maa all.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/dunsparce.asm::.label: dunsparce
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dunsparce.asm::.en:
LAND SNAKE
It hides deep inside caves where no light ever
reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/dunsparce.asm::.et:
MAAMADU
See peidab end sügaval koobastes, kuhu valgus ei jõua, ja püsib seal peaaegu liikumatult.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/eevee.asm::eeve.label: eevee
data/pokemon/dex_entries/eevee.asm::eeve.en:
EVOLUTION
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/eevee.asm::eeve.et:
ARENG
Selle võime areneda paljudeks vormideks laseb sel sujuvalt ja täiuslikult igasse keskkonda kohaneda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ekans.asm::ekan.label: ekans
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ekans.asm::ekan.en:
SNAKE
It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the
scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ekans.asm::ekan.et:
MADU
See liputab keeleotsa, et otsida saagi lõhna, ja neelab siis saagi tervelt alla.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/electabuzz.asm:.label: electabuzz
data/pokemon/dex_entries/electabuzz.asm:.en:
ELECTRIC
When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the
electric currents to communicate their feelings.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/electabuzz.asm:.et:
ELEKTER
Kui kaks ELECTABUZZi puutuvad kokku, juhivad nad tunnete edastamiseks elektrivoolu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/electrode.asm::.label: electrode
data/pokemon/dex_entries/electrode.asm::.en:
BALL
The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets.
But this also makes it more likely to explode.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/electrode.asm::.et:
PALL
Mida rohkem energiat see laeb, seda kiiremaks see saab. Aga see teeb selle ka plahvatusaltimaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/elekid.asm::ele.label: elekid
data/pokemon/dex_entries/elekid.asm::ele.en:
ELECTRIC
It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns
flickers bluishwhite when it is charging energy.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/elekid.asm::ele.et:
ELEKTER
See armastab ägedat äikest. Sarvede vahe vilgub sinakasvalgelt, kui see energiat laeb.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/entei.asm::ente.label: entei
data/pokemon/dex_entries/entei.asm::ente.en:
VOLCANO
This brawny #MON courses around the earth,
spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/entei.asm::ente.et:
VULKAAN
See jõuline #MON tormab üle maa, purskates leeke, mis on kuumemad kui vulkaani magma.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/espeon.asm::esp.label: espeon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/espeon.asm::esp.en:
SUN
The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is
predicting its opponent's next move.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/espeon.asm::esp.et:
PÄIKE
Selle kaheharulise saba ots väriseb, kui see ennustab vastase järgmist käiku.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggcute.asm::.label: exeggcute
data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggcute.asm::.en:
EGG
If even one is separated from the group, the energy
bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggcute.asm::.et:
MUNA
Kui kasvõi üks grupist eraldub, ühendab kuue energiaside nad kohe uuesti.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggutor.asm::.label: exeggutor
data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggutor.asm::.en:
COCONUT
Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of
heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/exeggutor.asm::.et:
KOOKOS
Heas keskkonnas elamine paneb sellele palju päid kasvama. Mahakukkunud peast saab EXEGGCUTE.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/farfetch_d.asm:.label: farfetch_d
data/pokemon/dex_entries/farfetch_d.asm:.en:
WILD DUCK
In order to prevent their extinction, more
people have made an effort to breed these #MON.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/farfetch_d.asm:.et:
METSPART
Nende väljasuremise ärahoidmiseks on rohkem inimesi püüdnud neid #MONe aretada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/fearow.asm::fea.label: fearow
data/pokemon/dex_entries/fearow.asm::fea.en:
BEAK
It uses its long beak to attack. It has a surprisingly
long reach, so it must be treated with caution.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/fearow.asm::fea.et:
NOKK
See ründab pika nokaga. Sel on üllatavalt pikk ulatus, seega tuleb sellega ettevaatlik olla.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/feraligatr.asm:.label: feraligatr
data/pokemon/dex_entries/feraligatr.asm:.en:
BIG JAW
Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs
enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/feraligatr.asm:.et:
SUURLÕUG
Kuigi sel on massiivne keha, võimaldavad võimsad tagajalad sel kiiresti liikuda, ka maal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/flaaffy.asm::fl.label: flaaffy
data/pokemon/dex_entries/flaaffy.asm::fl.en:
WOOL
Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant
skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/flaaffy.asm::fl.et:
VILL
Tänu kummisele, elektrit taluvale nahale suudab see karvades palju elektrit talletada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/flareon.asm::fl.label: flareon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/flareon.asm::fl.en:
FLAME
Once it has stored up enough heat, this #MON's
body temperature can reach up to 1700 degrees.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/flareon.asm::fl.et:
LEEK
Kui see on kogunud piisavalt kuumust, võib selle #MONi kehatemperatuur ulatuda 1700 kraadini.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/forretress.asm:.label: forretress
data/pokemon/dex_entries/forretress.asm:.en:
BAGWORM
Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It
shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/forretress.asm:.et:
KOTIUSS
Tavaliselt rippumas jämedal puutüvel. See tulistab välja tükke oma koorest, kui näeb tegevust.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/furret.asm::fur.label: furret
data/pokemon/dex_entries/furret.asm::fur.en:
LONG BODY
It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The
deeper the nests go, the more mazelike they become.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/furret.asm::fur.et:
PIKK KEHA
See elab kitsastes urgudes, mis sobivad selle saledale kehale. Mida sügavamale pesad lähevad, seda labürintsemaks need muutuvad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/gastly.asm::gas.label: gastly
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gastly.asm::gas.en:
GAS
It wraps its opponent in its gaslike body, slowly
weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gastly.asm::gas.et:
GAAS
See mähib vastase oma gaasilaadsesse kehasse, nõrgestades saaki aeglaselt läbi naha mürgitades.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/gengar.asm::gen.label: gengar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gengar.asm::gen.en:
SHADOW
Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their
heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gengar.asm::gen.et:
VARI
Öösel inimeste varjudes peites imab see nende soojust. Selle tekitatud külm paneb ohvrid värisema.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/geodude.asm::ge.label: geodude
data/pokemon/dex_entries/geodude.asm::ge.en:
ROCK
Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against
each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/geodude.asm::ge.et:
KIVI
Uhked oma tugevate kehade üle, põrkuvad nad võistluses, et tõestada, kelle oma on kõvem.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/girafarig.asm::.label: girafarig
data/pokemon/dex_entries/girafarig.asm::.en:
LONG NECK
When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of
mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/girafarig.asm::.et:
PIKK KAEL
Kui see on ohus, kasutab selle saba mingeid salapäraseid jõude, et vaenlast eemale peletada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/gligar.asm::gli.label: gligar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gligar.asm::gli.en:
FLYSCORPIO
It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done
gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gligar.asm::gli.et:
LENDSKORPION
See ehitab pesa järsule kaljule. Kui see on liuglemise lõpetanud, hüpleb see mööda maad pessa tagasi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/gloom.asm::gloo.label: gloom
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gloom.asm::gloo.en:
WEED
The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on
its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gloom.asm::gloo.et:
UMBROHI
Selle nire-laadse siirupi ja õielehtede õietolmu lõhn on nii halb, et võib vastaseid minestama panna.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/golbat.asm::gol.label: golbat
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golbat.asm::gol.en:
BAT
When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly
draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golbat.asm::gol.et:
NAHKHIIR
Kui see torkab kihvad saaki, joob ja neelab see kohe alla üle kümne untsi verd.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/goldeen.asm::go.label: goldeen
data/pokemon/dex_entries/goldeen.asm::go.en:
GOLDFISH
During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the
water, searching for their perfect mate.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/goldeen.asm::go.et:
KULDKALA
Kudemisajal ujuvad nad graatsiliselt vees, otsides oma täiuslikku paarilist.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/golduck.asm::go.label: golduck
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golduck.asm::go.en:
DUCK
It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow-moving
rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golduck.asm::go.et:
PART
See ujub graatsiliselt vaiksetel, aeglaselt voolavatel jõgedel ja järvedel, mida see nii armastab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/golem.asm::gole.label: golem
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golem.asm::gole.en:
MEGATON
Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered
dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/golem.asm::gole.et:
MEGATONN
Selle kivilaadne keha on nii vastupidav, et isegi võimsad dünamiidiplahvatused ei suuda selle karedat nahka kriimustada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/granbull.asm::g.label: granbull
data/pokemon/dex_entries/granbull.asm::g.en:
FAIRY
It can make most any #MON run away simply by
opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/granbull.asm::g.et:
HALDJAS
See suudab panna peaaegu iga #MONi põgenema, avades lihtsalt suu pärani, et paljastada oma suured kihvad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/graveler.asm::g.label: graveler
data/pokemon/dex_entries/graveler.asm::g.en:
ROCK
It travels by rolling on mountain paths. If it gains
too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/graveler.asm::g.et:
KIVI
See liigub mägiradadel veeredes. Kui see saab liiga suure kiiruse, peatub see hiigelkividesse joostes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/grimer.asm::gri.label: grimer
data/pokemon/dex_entries/grimer.asm::gri.en:
SLUDGE
When two of these #MON's bodies are combined
together, new poisons are created.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/grimer.asm::gri.et:
MUDA
Kui kaks selle #MONi keha ühendatakse, tekivad uued mürgid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/growlithe.asm::.label: growlithe
data/pokemon/dex_entries/growlithe.asm::.en:
PUPPY
It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown
smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/growlithe.asm::.et:
KUTSIKAS
See valitseb suurt territooriumi. Kui see tuvastab tundmatu lõhna, möirgab see valjult, et sissetungija välja ajada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/gyarados.asm::g.label: gyarados
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gyarados.asm::g.en:
ATROCIOUS
It appears whenever there is world conflict,
burning down any place it travels through.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/gyarados.asm::g.et:
JÕHKER
See ilmub alati, kui maailmas on konflikte, põletades maha iga koha, kust see läbi rändab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/haunter.asm::ha.label: haunter
data/pokemon/dex_entries/haunter.asm::ha.en:
GAS
It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of
the next living thing that wanders close by.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/haunter.asm::ha.et:
GAAS
See peidab end pimeduses, plaanides võtta järgmise lähedale eksleva elusolendi elu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/heracross.asm::.label: heracross
data/pokemon/dex_entries/heracross.asm::.en:
SINGLEHORN
With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou-
nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/heracross.asm::.et:
ÜKSSARV
Oma herakleslike jõududega suudab see kergesti loopida ringi 100 korda enda raskusega objekti.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonchan.asm:.label: hitmonchan
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonchan.asm:.en:
PUNCHING
To increase the strength of all its punch moves,
it spins its arms just before making contact.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonchan.asm:.et:
RUSIKAS
Kõigi oma löökide tugevuse suurendamiseks keerutab see käsi vahetult enne kokkupuudet.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonlee.asm::.label: hitmonlee
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonlee.asm::.en:
KICKING
It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its
elastic legs to execute every known kick.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmonlee.asm::.et:
LÖÖJA
Seda kutsutakse ka Löögimeistriks. See kasutab oma elastseid jalgu iga tuntud löögi sooritamiseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmontop.asm::.label: hitmontop
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmontop.asm::.en:
HANDSTAND
After doing a handstand to throw off the
opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hitmontop.asm::.et:
KÄTELSEIS
Pärast kätelseisu, et vastase ajastus segamini ajada, esitab see oma uhkeid löögikäike.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ho_oh.asm::ho_o.label: ho_oh
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ho_oh.asm::ho_o.en:
RAINBOW
It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted
trainer by shining its bright rainbow-colored wings.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ho_oh.asm::ho_o.et:
VIKERKAAR
See paljastab end puhta südamega treeneri ees, lastes särada oma erksatel vikerkaarevärvi tiibadel.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoothoot.asm::h.label: hoothoot
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoothoot.asm::h.en:
OWL
It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some
trainers use them in place of clocks.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoothoot.asm::h.et:
ÖÖKULL
See hakkab iga päev samal ajal huikama. Mõni treener kasutab neid kellade asemel.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoppip.asm::hop.label: hoppip
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoppip.asm::hop.en:
COTTONWEED
It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze.
It may even float all the way to the next town.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hoppip.asm::hop.et:
VILLTAIM
Isegi õrnem tuuleiil võib selle kaasa kanda. See võib hõljuda kuni järgmise linnani.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/horsea.asm::hor.label: horsea
data/pokemon/dex_entries/horsea.asm::hor.en:
DRAGON
When they're in a safe location, they can be seen
playfully tangling their tails together.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/horsea.asm::hor.et:
DRAAKON
Kui nad on turvalises kohas, võib neid näha mängleval kombel oma sabu kokku põimimas.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndoom.asm::h.label: houndoom
data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndoom.asm::h.en:
DARK
The pungentsmelling flame that shoots from
its mouth results from toxins burning in its body.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndoom.asm::h.et:
PIME
Suust purskav terava lõhnaga leek tuleneb kehas põlevatest mürkidest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndour.asm::h.label: houndour
data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndour.asm::h.en:
DARK
Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the
area to announce that this is its territory.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/houndour.asm::h.et:
PIME
Koidiku paiku kajab selle kurjakuulutav ulg kandis, et teatada, et see on tema territoorium.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/hypno.asm::hypn.label: hypno
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hypno.asm::hypn.en:
HYPNOSIS
The longer it swings its pendulum, the
longer the effects of its hypnosis last.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/hypno.asm::hypn.et:
HÜPNOOS
Mida kauem see oma pendlit kiigutab, seda kauem kestab selle hüpnoosi mõju.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/igglybuff.asm::.label: igglybuff
data/pokemon/dex_entries/igglybuff.asm::.en:
BALLOON
Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves
around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/igglybuff.asm::.et:
ÕHUPALL
Lühikeste jalgade asemel liigub see ringi, põrgates oma pehmel, õrnal kehal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ivysaur.asm::iv.label: ivysaur
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ivysaur.asm::iv.en:
SEED
The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients.
The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ivysaur.asm::iv.et:
SEEME
Seljal olev sibul kasvab, kui see toitaineid imab. Õitsedes eritab sibul meeldivat aroomi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/jigglypuff.asm:.label: jigglypuff
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jigglypuff.asm:.en:
BALLOON
It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby.
Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jigglypuff.asm:.et:
ÕHUPALL
See pööritab oma nunnusid silmi, lauldes rahustavat hällilaulu. Selle laul uinutab iga kuulaja.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/jolteon.asm::jo.label: jolteon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jolteon.asm::jo.en:
LIGHTNING
The negatively charged ions generated in its
fur create a constant sparking noise.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jolteon.asm::jo.et:
VÄLK
Selle karvades tekkivad negatiivselt laetud ioonid tekitavad pideva sädeleva heli.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/jumpluff.asm::j.label: jumpluff
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jumpluff.asm::j.en:
COTTONWEED
Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff
to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jumpluff.asm::j.et:
VILLTAIM
Isegi kõige ägedamas tuules suudab see oma udet juhtida, et jõuda igasse maailma kohta, kuhu tahab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/jynx.asm::jynx.label: jynx
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jynx.asm::jynx.en:
HUMANSHAPE
It has several different cry patterns, each of
which seems to have its own meaning.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/jynx.asm::jynx.et:
INIMKUJU
Sel on mitu erinevat häälitsusmustrit, millest igal näib olevat oma tähendus.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabuto.asm::kab.label: kabuto
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabuto.asm::kab.en:
SHELLFISH
Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea
floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabuto.asm::kab.et:
KARPLOOM
Kolmsada miljonit aastat tagasi peitis see end merepõhjas. Sel on ka seljal helendavad silmad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabutops.asm::k.label: kabutops
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabutops.asm::k.en:
SHELLFISH
It was able to swim quickly through the water by
compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kabutops.asm::k.et:
KARPLOOM
See suutis vees kiiresti ujuda, voltides oma habemenoateravad sirbid kompaktselt kokku.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kadabra.asm::ka.label: kadabra
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kadabra.asm::ka.en:
PSI
When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti-
cles come out of the surface of its body.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kadabra.asm::ka.et:
PSI
Kui see sulgeb silmad, väljub selle kehapinnalt kaks korda rohkem alfaosakesi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kakuna.asm::kak.label: kakuna
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kakuna.asm::kak.en:
COCOON
Nearly incapable of movement, it leans against
stout trees while waiting for its evolution.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kakuna.asm::kak.et:
KOKON
Peaaegu liikumisvõimetuna nõjatub see tugevatele puudele, oodates oma arengut.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kangaskhan.asm:.label: kangaskhan
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kangaskhan.asm:.en:
PARENT
To avoid crushing the baby it carries in
its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kangaskhan.asm:.et:
VANEM
Et vältida taskus kantava poja purustamist, magab see alati püsti seistes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingdra.asm::ki.label: kingdra
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingdra.asm::ki.en:
DRAGON
It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths
at which no other life forms can survive.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingdra.asm::ki.et:
DRAAKON
See talletab energiat, magades veesügavustes, kus ükski teine eluvorm ei suuda ellu jääda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingler.asm::ki.label: kingler
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingler.asm::ki.en:
PINCER
Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not
in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/kingler.asm::ki.et:
SÕRG
Selle ülisuur sõrg on väga võimas, aga kui see pole lahingus, jääb sõrg lihtsalt jalgu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/koffing.asm::ko.label: koffing
data/pokemon/dex_entries/koffing.asm::ko.en:
POISON GAS
If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison-
ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/koffing.asm::ko.et:
MÜRKGAAS
Kui keegi läheneb sellele piisavalt, kui see mürkgaasi välja ajab, on selle sees keerlevat gaasi näha.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/krabby.asm::kra.label: krabby
data/pokemon/dex_entries/krabby.asm::kra.en:
RIVER CRAB
If it is unable to find food, it will absorb
nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/krabby.asm::kra.et:
JÕEVÄHK
Kui see ei leia toitu, imab see toitaineid, neelates suutäie liiva.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/lanturn.asm::la.label: lanturn
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lanturn.asm::la.en:
LIGHT
This #MON uses the bright part of its body, which
changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lanturn.asm::la.et:
VALGUS
See #MON kasutab oma keha heledat osa, mis muutus seljauimest, et saaki peibutada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/lapras.asm::lap.label: lapras
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lapras.asm::lap.en:
TRANSPORT
This gentle #MON loves to give people rides
and provides a very comfortable way to get around.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lapras.asm::lap.et:
TRANSPORT
See leebe #MON armastab inimesi sõidutada ja pakub väga mugavat viisi ringi liikuda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/larvitar.asm::l.label: larvitar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/larvitar.asm::l.en:
ROCK SKIN
Born deep underground, this #MON becomes a
pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/larvitar.asm::l.et:
KIVINAHK
Sügaval maa all sündinud, see #MON muutub nukuks, olles söönud mäejagu mulda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledian.asm::led.label: ledian
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledian.asm::led.en:
FIVE STAR
In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside
a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledian.asm::led.et:
VIISTÄHT
Päeval, kui soojaks läheb, kerib see end suure lehe sisse ja uinub sügavasse unne.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledyba.asm::led.label: ledyba
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledyba.asm::led.en:
FIVE STAR
It is timid and clusters together with others. The
fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ledyba.asm::led.et:
VIISTÄHT
See on arg ja koguneb teistega kokku. Jalgadest erituv vedelik näitab selle asukohta.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/lickitung.asm::.label: lickitung
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lickitung.asm::.en:
LICKING
It has a tongue that is over 6'6'' long. It uses this
long tongue to lick its body clean.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lickitung.asm::.et:
LAKKUJA
Sel on üle 2 meetri pikk keel. Selle pika keelega lakub see oma keha puhtaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/lugia.asm::lugi.label: lugia
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lugia.asm::lugi.en:
DIVING
It has an incredible ability to calm raging sto-
rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/lugia.asm::lugi.et:
SUKELDUJA
Sel on uskumatu võime rahustada möllavaid torme. Öeldakse, et LUGIA ilmub tormide alguses.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/machamp.asm::ma.label: machamp
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machamp.asm::ma.en:
SUPERPOWER
With four arms that react more quickly than it
can think, it can execute many punches at once.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machamp.asm::ma.et:
SUPERJÕUD
Nelja käega, mis reageerivad kiiremini kui see mõelda jõuab, suudab see korraga anda palju lööke.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/machoke.asm::ma.label: machoke
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machoke.asm::ma.en:
SUPERPOWER
This tough #MON always stays in the zone. Its
muscles become thicker after every battle.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machoke.asm::ma.et:
SUPERJÕUD
See kõva #MON püsib alati vormis. Selle lihased muutuvad pärast iga lahingut jämedamaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/machop.asm::mac.label: machop
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machop.asm::mac.en:
SUPERPOWER
It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It
can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/machop.asm::mac.et:
SUPERJÕUD
See treenib mägedes kive tõstes. See suudab kergesti üles tõsta isegi GRAVELERi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magby.asm::magb.label: magby
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magby.asm::magb.en:
LIVE COAL
It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said
when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magby.asm::magb.et:
ELUSSÜSI
See sülitab loomulikult 1100-kraadist leeki. Öeldakse, et kui neid palju ilmub, ennustab see vulkaanipurset.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magcargo.asm::m.label: magcargo
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magcargo.asm::m.en:
LAVA
Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing.
Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magcargo.asm::m.et:
LAAVA
Selle keha on kuum kui laava ja aurab pidevalt. Vahel purskavad koorest leegid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magikarp.asm::m.label: magikarp
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magikarp.asm::m.en:
FISH
This weak and pathetic #MON gets easily pushed
along rivers when there are strong currents.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magikarp.asm::m.et:
KALA
See nõrk ja haletsusväärne #MON kandub kergesti mööda jõgesid, kui vool on tugev.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magmar.asm::mag.label: magmar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magmar.asm::mag.en:
SPITFIRE
It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal
itself by dipping its wound into lava.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magmar.asm::mag.et:
TULEPURSKAJA
See liigub kuumades kohtades sagedamini. See suudab end ravida, kastes haava laavasse.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magnemite.asm::.label: magnemite
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magnemite.asm::.en:
MAGNET
The electricity emitted by the units on each side
of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magnemite.asm::.et:
MAGNET
Kehal mõlemal küljel olevate osade eritatav elekter muudab selle tugevaks magnetiks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/magneton.asm::m.label: magneton
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magneton.asm::m.en:
MAGNET
When many MAGNETON gather together, the
resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/magneton.asm::m.et:
MAGNET
Kui palju MAGNETONe koguneb, häirib tekkiv magnettorm raadiolaineid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mankey.asm::man.label: mankey
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mankey.asm::man.en:
PIG MONKEY
It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight
of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mankey.asm::man.et:
SEAAHV
See elab gruppides puulatvades. Kui see kaotab oma grupi silmist, raevub see üksindusest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mantine.asm::ma.label: mantine
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mantine.asm::ma.en:
KITE
It swims along freely, eating things that swim
into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mantine.asm::ma.et:
TUULELOHE
See ujub vabalt, süües asju, mis ta suhu ujuvad. Kogu selle keha on väga karm.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mareep.asm::mar.label: mareep
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mareep.asm::mar.en:
WOOL
It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it
to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mareep.asm::mar.et:
VILL
See talletab palju õhku oma pehmes karvas, mis laseb sel suvel jahedana ja talvel soojana püsida.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/marill.asm::mar.label: marill
data/pokemon/dex_entries/marill.asm::mar.en:
AQUAMOUSE
The fur on its body naturally repels water. It
can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/marill.asm::mar.et:
VEEHIIR
Selle keha karv tõukab loomulikult vett eemale. See püsib kuivana isegi vees mängides.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/marowak.asm::ma.label: marowak
data/pokemon/dex_entries/marowak.asm::ma.en:
BONEKEEPER
Somewhere in the world is a cemetery just for
MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/marowak.asm::ma.et:
LUUHOIDJA
Kusagil maailmas on kalmistu ainult MAROWAKidele. Sealt haudadelt saab see oma luud.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/meganium.asm::m.label: meganium
data/pokemon/dex_entries/meganium.asm::m.en:
HERB
Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as
if they were relaxing in a sunny forest.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/meganium.asm::m.et:
ROHT
Igaüks, kes selle kõrval seisab, muutub värskeks, nagu puhkaks päikeselises metsas.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/meowth.asm::meo.label: meowth
data/pokemon/dex_entries/meowth.asm::meo.en:
SCRATCHCAT
It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny
object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/meowth.asm::meo.et:
KRIIMKASS
See armastab sädelevaid asju. Kui see näeb läikivat eset, särab ka peas olev kuldmünt.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/metapod.asm::me.label: metapod
data/pokemon/dex_entries/metapod.asm::me.en:
COCOON
This is its preevolved form. At this stage, it can
only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/metapod.asm::me.et:
KOKON
See on selle arengueelne vorm. Sel etapil suudab see vaid kõveneda, seega püsib see rünnaku vältimiseks liikumatult.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mew.asm::mew.label: mew
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mew.asm::mew.en:
NEW SPECIE
Because it can learn any move, some people began
research to see if it is the ancestor of all #MON.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mew.asm::mew.et:
UUS LIIK
Kuna see suudab õppida iga rünnaku, hakkasid mõned uurima, kas see on kõigi #MONide esiisa.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mewtwo.asm::mew.label: mewtwo
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mewtwo.asm::mew.en:
GENETIC
Said to rest quietly in an undiscovered cave,
this #MON was created solely for battling.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mewtwo.asm::mew.et:
GENEETILINE
Öeldakse, et see puhkab vaikselt avastamata koopas. See #MON loodi ainuüksi lahinguks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/miltank.asm::mi.label: miltank
data/pokemon/dex_entries/miltank.asm::mi.en:
MILK COW
In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for
rhythmically pulling up and down on its udders.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/miltank.asm::mi.et:
PIIMALEHM
MILTANKi lüpsmiseks peab olema oskust selle udaraid rütmiliselt üles-alla tõmmata.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/misdreavus.asm:.label: misdreavus
data/pokemon/dex_entries/misdreavus.asm:.en:
SCREECH
It loves to watch people it's scared. It frightens
them by screaming loudly or appearing suddenly.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/misdreavus.asm:.et:
KILJE
See armastab vaadata inimesi, keda ehmatab. See hirmutab neid valjult kilgates või äkitselt ilmudes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/moltres.asm::mo.label: moltres
data/pokemon/dex_entries/moltres.asm::mo.en:
FLAME
Legendary bird #MON. It is said to migrate
from the south along with the spring.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/moltres.asm::mo.et:
LEEK
Legendaarne linnu-#MON. Öeldakse, et see rändab lõunast koos kevadega.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/mr__mime.asm::m.label: mr__mime
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mr__mime.asm::m.en:
BARRIER
It uses the mysterious power it has in
its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/mr__mime.asm::m.et:
BARJÄÄR
See kasutab sõrmedes olevat salapärast jõudu, et tahkestada õhk nähtamatuks seinaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/muk.asm::muk.label: muk
data/pokemon/dex_entries/muk.asm::muk.en:
SLUDGE
As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it,
making the ground there barren for three years.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/muk.asm::muk.et:
MUDA
Liikudes lekib sellest väga tugev mürk, muutes sealse maa kolmeks aastaks viljatuks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/murkrow.asm::mu.label: murkrow
data/pokemon/dex_entries/murkrow.asm::mu.en:
DARKNESS
It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location.
MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/murkrow.asm::mu.et:
PIMEDUS
See peidab iga leitud läikiva eseme salajasse kohta. MURKROW ja MEOWTH rüüstavad teineteise varusid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/natu.asm::natu.label: natu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/natu.asm::natu.en:
LITTLE BIRD
It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and
likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/natu.asm::natu.et:
LINNUKE
See on ülihea puutüvedele ronima ja armastab süüa puude uusi võrseid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoking.asm::n.label: nidoking
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoking.asm::n.en:
DRILL
It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack
forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoking.asm::n.et:
PUUR
See kasutab jõuliseks ründamiseks oma jämedaid käsi, jalgu ja saba. Lähivõitlus on selle eriala.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoqueen.asm::.label: nidoqueen
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoqueen.asm::.en:
DRILL
The hard scales that cover its strong body serve
as excellent protection from any attack.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoqueen.asm::.et:
PUUR
Kõvad soomused, mis katavad selle tugevat keha, kaitsevad suurepäraselt iga rünnaku eest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_f.asm::.label: nidoran_f
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_f.asm::.en:
POISON PIN
Small and very docile, it protects itself with
its small, poisonous horn when attacked.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_f.asm::.et:
MÜRGINÕEL
Väike ja väga taltsas, kaitseb see end rünnatuna oma väikese mürgise sarvega.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_m.asm::.label: nidoran_m
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_m.asm::.en:
POISON PIN
It constantly moves its large ears in many
directions in order to detect danger right away.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidoran_m.asm::.et:
MÜRGINÕEL
See liigutab pidevalt oma suuri kõrvu paljudes suundades, et ohtu kohe tuvastada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorina.asm::n.label: nidorina
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorina.asm::n.en:
POISON PIN
It has a docile nature. If it is threatened with
attack, it raises the barbs that are all over its body.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorina.asm::n.et:
MÜRGINÕEL
Sel on taltsas loomus. Kui seda rünnakuga ähvardatakse, tõstab see üles kogu kehal olevad ogad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorino.asm::n.label: nidorino
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorino.asm::n.en:
POISON PIN
It is easily agitated and uses its horn for
offense as soon as it notices an attacker.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/nidorino.asm::n.et:
MÜRGINÕEL
See ärritub kergesti ja kasutab sarve ründamiseks kohe, kui märkab ründajat.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ninetales.asm::.label: ninetales
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ninetales.asm::.en:
FOX
It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its
tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ninetales.asm::.et:
REBANE
Öeldakse, et see elab tuhat aastat, ja iga selle saba on täis üleloomulikke jõude.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/noctowl.asm::no.label: noctowl
data/pokemon/dex_entries/noctowl.asm::no.en:
OWL
Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight.
It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/noctowl.asm::no.et:
ÖÖKULL
Selle ülipehmed suled ei tee lennates häält. See hiilib vaikselt saagile ligi, jäämata märkamatuks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/octillery.asm::.label: octillery
data/pokemon/dex_entries/octillery.asm::.en:
JET
Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often
steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/octillery.asm::.et:
JUGA
Selle instinkt on end aukudesse matta. See varastab tihti teiste pesaauke, et neis magada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/oddish.asm::odd.label: oddish
data/pokemon/dex_entries/oddish.asm::odd.en:
WEED
During the day, it stays in the cold underground to
avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/oddish.asm::odd.et:
UMBROHI
Päeval püsib see päikese vältimiseks külmas maa all. See kasvab kuuvalguses supeldes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/omanyte.asm::om.label: omanyte
data/pokemon/dex_entries/omanyte.asm::om.en:
SPIRAL
In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor,
eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/omanyte.asm::om.et:
SPIRAAL
Eelajaloolisel ajal ujus see merepõhjas, süües planktonit. Vahel leitakse selle fossiile.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/omastar.asm::om.label: omastar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/omastar.asm::om.en:
SPIRAL
Its heavy shell allowed it to reach only nearby
food. This could be the reason it is extinct.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/omastar.asm::om.et:
SPIRAAL
Selle raske koor lasi sel ulatuda vaid lähedase toiduni. See võib olla selle väljasuremise põhjus.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/onix.asm::onix.label: onix
data/pokemon/dex_entries/onix.asm::onix.en:
ROCK SNAKE
As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard
objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/onix.asm::onix.et:
KIVIMADU
Kaevates end läbi maa, imab see palju kõvasid esemeid. See teebki selle keha nii kõvaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/paras.asm::para.label: paras
data/pokemon/dex_entries/paras.asm::para.en:
MUSHROOM
The tochukaso growing on this #MON's back
orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/paras.asm::para.et:
SEEN
Selle #MONi seljal kasvav tochukaso käsib sel puutüvedest mahla ammutada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/parasect.asm::p.label: parasect
data/pokemon/dex_entries/parasect.asm::p.en:
MUSHROOM
When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the
mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/parasect.asm::p.et:
SEEN
Kui putukast pole enam midagi ammutada, jätavad seljal olevad seened putuka munale eosed.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/persian.asm::pe.label: persian
data/pokemon/dex_entries/persian.asm::pe.en:
CLASSY CAT
Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric
side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/persian.asm::pe.et:
ELEGANTKASS
Selle graatsilise, elegantse välimuse taga peitub barbaarne pool. See rebib saagi lihtsa tuju ajel tükkideks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/phanpy.asm::pha.label: phanpy
data/pokemon/dex_entries/phanpy.asm::pha.en:
LONG NOSE
During the deserted morning hours, it comes ashore
where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/phanpy.asm::pha.et:
PIKK NINA
Inimtühjadel hommikutundidel tuleb see kaldale, kus kasutab osavalt oma londi, et duši all käia.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pichu.asm::pich.label: pichu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pichu.asm::pich.en:
TINY MOUSE
It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of
shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pichu.asm::pich.et:
PISIHIIR
See on elektri talletamises oskamatu. Iga šokk paneb selle spontaanselt energiat vabastama.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeot.asm::pi.label: pidgeot
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeot.asm::pi.en:
BIRD
Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing
MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeot.asm::pi.et:
LIND
Selle suurepärane nägemine laseb sel märgata pläshkivat MAGIKARPi isegi 3300 jala kõrguselt lennates.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeotto.asm::.label: pidgeotto
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeotto.asm::.en:
BIRD
It slowly flies in a circular pattern, all the
while keeping a sharp lookout for prey.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgeotto.asm::.et:
LIND
See lendab aeglaselt ringikujulise mustriga, hoides kogu aeg saaki teraselt silmas.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgey.asm::pid.label: pidgey
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgey.asm::pid.en:
TINY BIRD
It rapidly flaps its wings in the grass, stirring up
a dust cloud that drives insect prey out into the open.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pidgey.asm::pid.et:
PISILIND
See vehib rohus kiiresti tiibu, keerutades tolmupilve, mis ajab putukatest saagi lagedale.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pikachu.asm::pi.label: pikachu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pikachu.asm::pi.en:
MOUSE
When it is angered, it immediately discharges the
energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pikachu.asm::pi.et:
HIIR
Kui see vihastab, vabastab see kohe põskede taskutesse talletatud energia.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/piloswine.asm::.label: piloswine
data/pokemon/dex_entries/piloswine.asm::.en:
SWINE
Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves
prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/piloswine.asm::.et:
SIGA
Kuigi selle jalad on lühikesed, hoiavad karedad sõrad selle libisemast isegi jäisel maal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pineco.asm::pin.label: pineco
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pineco.asm::pin.en:
BAGWORM
It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark
to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pineco.asm::pin.et:
KOTIUSS
See sülitab vedelikku, millega liimib puukoort oma keha külge. Vedelik kõveneb õhku puutudes.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pinsir.asm::pin.label: pinsir
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pinsir.asm::pin.en:
STAGBEETLE
When the temperature drops at night, it sleeps
on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pinsir.asm::pin.et:
PÕDRAPÕRNIKAS
Kui öösel temperatuur langeb, magab see puulatvades või juurte vahel, kus on hästi varjatud.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/politoed.asm::p.label: politoed
data/pokemon/dex_entries/politoed.asm::p.en:
FROG
When it expands its throat to croak out a tune,
nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/politoed.asm::p.et:
KONN
Kui see paisutab kurku, et viisi kväaksuda, kogunevad lähedal olevad POLIWAGid ja POLIWHIRLid kohe.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwag.asm::po.label: poliwag
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwag.asm::po.en:
TADPOLE
The swirl on its belly is its insides showing
through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwag.asm::po.et:
KULLES
Kõhul olev spiraal on selle siseelundid, mis kumavad läbi naha. Pärast söömist paistab see selgemini.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwhirl.asm::.label: poliwhirl
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwhirl.asm::.en:
TADPOLE
Though it is skilled at walking, it prefers to
live underwater where there is less danger.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwhirl.asm::.et:
KULLES
Kuigi see oskab hästi kõndida, eelistab see elada vee all, kus on vähem ohtu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwrath.asm::.label: poliwrath
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwrath.asm::.en:
TADPOLE
It can use its well-developed arms and legs to
run on the surface of the water for a split second.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/poliwrath.asm::.et:
KULLES
See suudab kasutada oma hästiarenenud käsi ja jalgu, et joosta hetkeks vee pinnal.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ponyta.asm::pon.label: ponyta
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ponyta.asm::pon.en:
FIRE HORSE
Training by jumping over grass that grows longer
every day has made it a world-class jumper.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ponyta.asm::pon.et:
TULEHOBUNE
Treenimine üle rohu hüppamisega, mis iga päev pikemaks kasvab, on teinud sellest maailmatasemel hüppaja.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon.asm::po.label: porygon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon.asm::po.en:
VIRTUAL
An artificial #MON created due to extensive
research, it can perform only what is in its program.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon.asm::po.et:
VIRTUAALNE
Ulatusliku uurimistöö tulemusel loodud tehis-#MON, see suudab teha vaid seda, mis on selle programmis.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon2.asm::p.label: porygon2
data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon2.asm::p.en:
VIRTUAL
This manmade #MON evolved from the latest
technology. It may have unprogrammed reactions.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/porygon2.asm::p.et:
VIRTUAALNE
See inimtehtud #MON arenes uusimast tehnoloogiast. Sel võib olla programmeerimata reaktsioone.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/primeape.asm::p.label: primeape
data/pokemon/dex_entries/primeape.asm::p.en:
PIG MONKEY
It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it
has to chase them until the end of the world.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/primeape.asm::p.et:
SEAAHV
See peksab läbi igaühe, kes selle vihaseks ajab, isegi kui peab neid maailma lõpuni taga ajama.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/psyduck.asm::ps.label: psyduck
data/pokemon/dex_entries/psyduck.asm::ps.en:
DUCK
The only time it can use its psychic power is when
its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/psyduck.asm::ps.et:
PART
Ainus kord, mil see saab kasutada oma vaimset jõudu, on siis, kui selle magavad ajurakud juhtuvad ärkama.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/pupitar.asm::pu.label: pupitar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pupitar.asm::pu.en:
HARD SHELL
It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It
already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/pupitar.asm::pu.et:
KÕVAKOOR
See ei püsi paigal isegi nukuna. Sel on tugeva koore all juba käed ja jalad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/quagsire.asm::q.label: quagsire
data/pokemon/dex_entries/quagsire.asm::q.en:
WATER FISH
Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on
the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/quagsire.asm::q.et:
VEEKALA
Selle keha on alati limane. See lööb ujudes tihti pea vastu jõepõhja, aga tundub, et ei hooli.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/quilava.asm::qu.label: quilava
data/pokemon/dex_entries/quilava.asm::qu.en:
VOLCANO
Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to
demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/quilava.asm::qu.et:
VULKAAN
Enne lahingut pöörab see vastasele selja, et näidata, kui ägedalt selle tuli lõõmab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/qwilfish.asm::q.label: qwilfish
data/pokemon/dex_entries/qwilfish.asm::q.en:
BALLOON
When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as
much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/qwilfish.asm::q.et:
ÕHUPALL
Suurema vastasega silmitsi seistes neelab see nii palju vett kui suudab, et vastase suurusega võrduda.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/raichu.asm::rai.label: raichu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raichu.asm::rai.en:
MOUSE
If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail
to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raichu.asm::rai.et:
HIIR
Kui selle elektritaskud tühjaks saavad, tõstab see saba, et koguda õhkkonnast elektrit.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/raikou.asm::rai.label: raikou
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raikou.asm::rai.en:
THUNDER
This rough #MON stores energy inside its body,
then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raikou.asm::rai.et:
KÕU
See karm #MON talletab kehas energiat, siis kihutab üle maa, tulistades elektrit.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/rapidash.asm::r.label: rapidash
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rapidash.asm::r.en:
FIRE HORSE
It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long-
er the swaying flames of its mane will become.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rapidash.asm::r.et:
TULEHOBUNE
See lihtsalt armastab galoppida. Mida kiiremini see läheb, seda pikemaks muutuvad lakas õõtsuvad leegid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/raticate.asm::r.label: raticate
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raticate.asm::r.en:
RAT
The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross
rivers. It searches wide areas for food.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/raticate.asm::r.et:
ROTT
Tagajalgade vöödid võimaldavad sel jõgesid ületada. See otsib toitu laialdastelt aladelt.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/rattata.asm::ra.label: rattata
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rattata.asm::ra.en:
RAT
This #MON's impressive vitality allows it to
live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rattata.asm::ra.et:
ROTT
Selle #MONi muljetavaldav elujõud laseb sel elada kõikjal. See ka paljuneb väga kiiresti.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/remoraid.asm::r.label: remoraid
data/pokemon/dex_entries/remoraid.asm::r.en:
JET
To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of
its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/remoraid.asm::r.et:
JUGA
Ründaja eest põgenemiseks võib see purskata suust vett ja kasutada seda jõudu tagurpidi ujumiseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhydon.asm::rhy.label: rhydon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhydon.asm::rhy.en:
DRILL
By lightly spinning its drilllike horn, it can
easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhydon.asm::rhy.et:
PUUR
Kergelt oma puurilaadset sarve keerutades suudab see kergesti purustada isegi töötlemata teemandi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhyhorn.asm::rh.label: rhyhorn
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhyhorn.asm::rh.en:
SPIKES
It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it
starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/rhyhorn.asm::rh.et:
OGAD
See suudab meeles pidada vaid üht asja korraga. Kui see hakkab tormama, unustab, miks alustas.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandshrew.asm::.label: sandshrew
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandshrew.asm::.en:
MOUSE
It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses
the sand to protect itself when threatened.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandshrew.asm::.et:
HIIR
See eelistab kuivi, liivaseid kohti, sest kasutab ohu korral enda kaitsmiseks liiva.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandslash.asm::.label: sandslash
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandslash.asm::.en:
MOUSE
Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball,
then attacks its enemies from above.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sandslash.asm::.et:
HIIR
Osav puuronija, kerib see end ogaliseks palliks ja ründab siis vaenlasi ülalt.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/scizor.asm::sci.label: scizor
data/pokemon/dex_entries/scizor.asm::sci.en:
SCISSORS
This #MON's pincers, which contain steel, can
crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/scizor.asm::sci.et:
KÄÄRID
Selle #MONi sõrad, mis sisaldavad terast, suudavad purustada tükkideks iga kõva eseme, mille haardesse saavad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/scyther.asm::sc.label: scyther
data/pokemon/dex_entries/scyther.asm::sc.en:
MANTIS
It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that
its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/scyther.asm::sc.et:
PALVETAJA
See on oma kiiruse üle väga uhke. See liigub nii kiiresti, et vastane ei teagi, mis ta pikali lõi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/seadra.asm::sea.label: seadra
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seadra.asm::sea.en:
DRAGON
The male raises the young. If it is approached, it
uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seadra.asm::sea.et:
DRAAKON
Isane kasvatab järglasi. Kui sellele lähenetakse, kasutab see mürgiseid ogasid, et sissetungija eemale peletada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/seaking.asm::se.label: seaking
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seaking.asm::se.en:
GOLDFISH
When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around
their nests in order to protect their offspring.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seaking.asm::se.et:
KULDKALA
Kui saabub sügis, patrullivad isased pesade ümbrust, et kaitsta oma järglasi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/seel.asm::seel.label: seel
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seel.asm::seel.en:
SEA LION
The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected
against the cold. It loves icebergfilled oceans.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/seel.asm::seel.et:
MERELÕVI
Heledsinine karv, mis seda katab, kaitseb seda külma eest. See armastab jäämägedega ookeane.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sentret.asm::se.label: sentret
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sentret.asm::se.en:
SCOUT
When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger
by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sentret.asm::se.et:
LUURAJA
Valvurina hoiatab see teisi ohu eest, kriisates ja lüües sabaga vastu maad.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/shellder.asm::s.label: shellder
data/pokemon/dex_entries/shellder.asm::s.en:
BIVALVE
Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable
parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/shellder.asm::s.et:
KARP
Vastase külge klammerdumine paljastab selle haavatavad kohad, seega kasutab see seda käiku vaid viimase abinõuna.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/shuckle.asm::sh.label: shuckle
data/pokemon/dex_entries/shuckle.asm::sh.en:
MOLD
The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for
nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/shuckle.asm::sh.et:
HALLITUS
Varvastest erituv vedelik uuristab kividesse pesaauke ja seda saab BERRYdega segada, et teha jooki.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/skarmory.asm::s.label: skarmory
