data/pokemon/dex_entries/skarmory.asm::s.en:
ARMOR BIRD
The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said
that people once used the feathers as swords.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/skarmory.asm::s.et:
SOOMUSLIND
Suled, mida see poetab, on väga teravad. Öeldakse, et inimesed kasutasid kunagi neid sulgi mõõkadena.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/skiploom.asm::s.label: skiploom
data/pokemon/dex_entries/skiploom.asm::s.en:
COTTONWEED
As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and
hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/skiploom.asm::s.et:
VILLTAIM
Kohe kui vihma hakkab, sulgeb see oma õie ja peidab end märjaks saamise vältimiseks puu varju.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowbro.asm::sl.label: slowbro
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowbro.asm::sl.en:
HERMITCRAB
An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the
tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowbro.asm::sl.et:
ERAKKVÄHK
Kinnitunud SHELLDER ei lase lahti maitsva maitse tõttu, mis selle sabast immitseb.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowking.asm::s.label: slowking
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowking.asm::s.en:
ROYAL
Every time it yawns, SHELLDER injects more poi-
son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowking.asm::s.et:
KUNINGLIK
Iga kord kui see haigutab, süstib SHELLDER sellesse rohkem mürki. Mürk teeb selle targemaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowpoke.asm::s.label: slowpoke
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowpoke.asm::s.en:
DOPEY
It is always so absent-minded that it won't react,
even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slowpoke.asm::s.et:
JUHM
See on alati nii hajameelne, et ei reageeri, isegi kui selle maitsvat saba hammustatakse.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/slugma.asm::slu.label: slugma
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slugma.asm::slu.en:
LAVA
These group together in areas that are hotter
than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/slugma.asm::slu.et:
LAAVA
Need kogunevad kohtadesse, mis on tavalisest kuumemad. Kui see maha jahtub, kõveneb selle nahk.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/smeargle.asm::s.label: smeargle
data/pokemon/dex_entries/smeargle.asm::s.en:
PAINTER
The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its
tail is predetermined for each SMEARGLE.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/smeargle.asm::s.et:
MAALIJA
Sabast erituva salapärase vedeliku värv on iga SMEARGLE jaoks ette määratud.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/smoochum.asm::s.label: smoochum
data/pokemon/dex_entries/smoochum.asm::s.en:
KISS
The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly.
It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/smoochum.asm::s.et:
SUUDLUS
Selle huulte tundlikkus areneb kõige kiiremini. See kasutab neid tundmatute esemete tuvastamiseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sneasel.asm::sn.label: sneasel
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sneasel.asm::sn.en:
SHARP CLAW
This cunning #MON hides under the cover
of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sneasel.asm::sn.et:
TERAVKÜÜS
See kaval #MON peidab end pimeduse varjus, oodates, et oma saaki rünnata.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/snorlax.asm::sn.label: snorlax
data/pokemon/dex_entries/snorlax.asm::sn.en:
SLEEPING
This #MON's stomach is so strong, even
eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/snorlax.asm::sn.et:
MAGAJA
Selle #MONi kõht on nii tugev, et isegi hallitanud või mädanenud toidu söömine ei mõju sellele.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/snubbull.asm::s.label: snubbull
data/pokemon/dex_entries/snubbull.asm::s.en:
FAIRY
In truth, it is a cowardly #MON. It growls eagerly
in order to hide its fear from its opponent.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/snubbull.asm::s.et:
HALDJAS
Tegelikult on see argpüks-#MON. See uriseb innukalt, et peita hirmu vastase eest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/spearow.asm::sp.label: spearow
data/pokemon/dex_entries/spearow.asm::sp.en:
TINY BIRD
To protect its territory, it flies around
ceaselessly, making highpitched cries.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/spearow.asm::sp.et:
PISILIND
Oma territooriumi kaitsmiseks lendab see lakkamatult ringi, tehes kõrgeid häälitsusi.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/spinarak.asm::s.label: spinarak
data/pokemon/dex_entries/spinarak.asm::s.en:
STRINGSPIT
If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun
string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/spinarak.asm::s.et:
NIIDIPUHUJA
Kui saak takerdub selle kootud niidipessa, ootab see liikumatult, kuni pimedaks läheb.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/squirtle.asm::s.label: squirtle
data/pokemon/dex_entries/squirtle.asm::s.en:
TINYTURTLE
When it feels threatened, it draws its legs
inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/squirtle.asm::s.et:
PISIKILPKONN
Kui see tunneb ohtu, tõmbab jalad koore sisse ja pihustab suust vett.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/stantler.asm::s.label: stantler
data/pokemon/dex_entries/stantler.asm::s.en:
BIG HORN
The round balls found on the fallen antlers can
be ground into a powder that aids in sleeping.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/stantler.asm::s.et:
SUURSARV
Ümmargusi kerakesi mahalangenud sarvedelt saab jahvatada pulbriks, mis aitab magada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/starmie.asm::st.label: starmie
data/pokemon/dex_entries/starmie.asm::st.en:
MYSTERIOUS
It is said that it uses the sevencolored core of
its body to send electric waves into outer space.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/starmie.asm::st.et:
SALAPÄRANE
Öeldakse, et see kasutab oma keha seitsmevärvilist tuuma, et saata elektrilaineid kosmosesse.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/staryu.asm::sta.label: staryu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/staryu.asm::sta.en:
STARSHAPE
When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from
the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/staryu.asm::sta.et:
TÄHEKUJU
Kui tähed öösel sätendavad, hõljub see merepõhjast üles ja selle keha keskne tuum vilgub.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/steelix.asm::st.label: steelix
data/pokemon/dex_entries/steelix.asm::st.en:
IRON SNAKE
The many small metal particles that cover this
#MON's body reflect bright light well.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/steelix.asm::st.et:
RAUDMADU
Paljud väikesed metalliosakesed, mis katavad selle #MONi keha, peegeldavad hästi eredat valgust.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sudowoodo.asm::.label: sudowoodo
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sudowoodo.asm::.en:
IMITATION
If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a
SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sudowoodo.asm::.et:
JÄLJENDUS
Kui puuoks väriseb tuuletul ajal, on see SUDOWOODO, mitte puu. See peidab end vihma eest.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/suicune.asm::su.label: suicune
data/pokemon/dex_entries/suicune.asm::su.en:
AURORA
This divine #MON blows around the world,
always in search of a pure reservoir.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/suicune.asm::su.et:
VIRMALINE
See jumalik #MON tuiskab üle maailma, alati otsides puhast veekogu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunflora.asm::s.label: sunflora
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunflora.asm::s.en:
SUN
As the hot season approaches, the petals on this
#MON's face become more vivid and lively.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunflora.asm::s.et:
PÄIKE
Kuuma aja lähenedes muutuvad selle #MONi näol olevad õielehed erksamaks ja elavamaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunkern.asm::su.label: sunkern
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunkern.asm::su.en:
SEED
It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to
shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/sunkern.asm::su.et:
SEEME
See on väga nõrk. Selle ainus kaitsevahend on meeleheitlikult ründaja poole lehti raputada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/swinub.asm::swi.label: swinub
data/pokemon/dex_entries/swinub.asm::swi.en:
PIG
It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose
is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/swinub.asm::swi.et:
SIGA
See kasutab ninaotsa, et toitu kaevata. Selle nina on nii kõva, et isegi külmunud maapind pole probleem.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tangela.asm::ta.label: tangela
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tangela.asm::ta.en:
VINE
During battle, it constantly moves the vines that
cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tangela.asm::ta.et:
VÄÄT
Lahingu ajal liigutab see pidevalt oma keha katvaid väädte, et vastast ärritada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tauros.asm::tau.label: tauros
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tauros.asm::tau.en:
WILD BULL
These violent #MON fight with other mem-
bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tauros.asm::tau.et:
METSPULL
Need vägivaldsed #MONid võitlevad oma karja teiste liikmetega, et tõestada oma jõudu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/teddiursa.asm::.label: teddiursa
data/pokemon/dex_entries/teddiursa.asm::.en:
LITTLE BEAR
It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet
because of all the honey it has absorbed.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/teddiursa.asm::.et:
KARUPOEG
See lakub alati mett. Selle peopesa maitseb magusalt kogu imendunud mee tõttu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacool.asm::.label: tentacool
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacool.asm::.en:
JELLYFISH
As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic
feelers to stab anything it touches.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacool.asm::.et:
MEDUUS
Lainetel triivides kasutab see oma mürgiseid kombitsaid, et torgata kõike, mida puudutab.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacruel.asm:.label: tentacruel
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacruel.asm:.en:
JELLYFISH
When its 80 feelers absorb water, it stretches to
become like a net to entangle its prey.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tentacruel.asm:.et:
MEDUUS
Kui selle 80 kombitsat vett imavad, venib see nagu võrk, et oma saaki takerdada.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/togepi.asm::tog.label: togepi
data/pokemon/dex_entries/togepi.asm::tog.en:
SPIKE BALL
It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its
shell is said to be filled with happiness.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/togepi.asm::tog.et:
OGAPALL
Seda peetakse õnne sümboliks. Öeldakse, et selle koor on täis õnne.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/togetic.asm::to.label: togetic
data/pokemon/dex_entries/togetic.asm::to.en:
HAPPINESS
Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can
stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/togetic.asm::to.et:
ÕNN
Kuigi see ei vehi eriti tiibu, suudab see püsida õhus, sabas oma treeneri järel.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/totodile.asm::t.label: totodile
data/pokemon/dex_entries/totodile.asm::t.en:
BIG JAW
This rough critter chomps at any moving object it
sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/totodile.asm::t.et:
SUURLÕUG
See jõhker olevus hammustab iga liikuvat eset, mida näeb. Selja pööramist sellele ei soovitata.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/typhlosion.asm:.label: typhlosion
data/pokemon/dex_entries/typhlosion.asm:.en:
VOLCANO
When heat from its body causes the air around it to
shimmer, this is a sign that it is ready to battle.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/typhlosion.asm:.et:
VULKAAN
Kui selle keha kuumus paneb ümbritseva õhu virvendama, on see märk, et see on lahinguks valmis.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyranitar.asm::.label: tyranitar
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyranitar.asm::.en:
ARMOR
In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to
make the ground shake and mountains crumble.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyranitar.asm::.et:
SOOMUS
Vaid ühes oma vägevas käes on sellel jõud panna maa värisema ja mäed murenema.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyrogue.asm::ty.label: tyrogue
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyrogue.asm::ty.en:
SCUFFLE
To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge
anyone. It has a very strong competitive spirit.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/tyrogue.asm::ty.et:
RÜSELUS
Oma võitlusoskuste lihvimiseks kutsub see igaühe välja. Sel on väga tugev võistlusvaim.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/umbreon.asm::um.label: umbreon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/umbreon.asm::um.en:
MOONLIGHT
On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited,
the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/umbreon.asm::um.et:
KUUVALGUS
Täiskuuööl või erutudes helendavad selle kehal olevad rõngasmustrid kollaselt.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/unown.asm::unow.label: unown
data/pokemon/dex_entries/unown.asm::unow.en:
SYMBOL
Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said
that they must have a variety of abilities.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/unown.asm::unow.et:
SÜMBOL
Kuna eksisteerib erinevaid UNOWNi tüüpe, öeldakse, et neil peab olema mitmesuguseid võimeid.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/ursaring.asm::u.label: ursaring
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ursaring.asm::u.en:
HIBERNANT
Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at
climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/ursaring.asm::u.et:
TALVEUINUJA
Kuigi sel on suur keha, on see üsna osav puude otsa ronima. See sööb ja magab puulatvades.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/vaporeon.asm::v.label: vaporeon
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vaporeon.asm::v.en:
BUBBLE JET
As it uses the fins on the tip of its tail to
swim, it blends with the water perfectly.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vaporeon.asm::v.et:
MULLIJUGA
Kasutades sabaotsa uimesid ujumiseks, sulandub see täiuslikult veega.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/venomoth.asm::v.label: venomoth
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venomoth.asm::v.en:
POISONMOTH
The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone
who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venomoth.asm::v.et:
MÜRGIKOI
Soomused, mida see puistab, halvavad igaühe, kes neid puudutab, muutes selle inimese püsti seismisvõimetuks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/venonat.asm::ve.label: venonat
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venonat.asm::ve.en:
INSECT
The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it
sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venonat.asm::ve.et:
PUTUKAS
Väikesed putukad, keda see sööb, ilmuvad ainult öösel, seega magab see puuaugus, kuni öö saabub.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/venusaur.asm::v.label: venusaur
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venusaur.asm::v.en:
SEED
As it warms itself and absorbs the sunlight, its
flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/venusaur.asm::v.et:
SEEME
Kui see end soojendab ja päikesevalgust imab, eritavad selle õielehed meeldivat lõhna.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/victreebel.asm:.label: victreebel
data/pokemon/dex_entries/victreebel.asm:.en:
FLYCATCHER
Once ingested into this #MON's body, even the
hardest object will melt into nothing.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/victreebel.asm:.et:
KÄRBSEPÜÜDJA
Kui see selle #MONi kehasse neelatakse, sulab isegi kõige kõvem ese olematuks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/vileplume.asm::.label: vileplume
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vileplume.asm::.en:
FLOWER
By shaking its big petals, it scatters toxic pollen
into the air, turning the air yellow.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vileplume.asm::.et:
LILL
Suuri õielehti raputades puistab see õhku mürgist õietolmu, muutes õhu kollaseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/voltorb.asm::vo.label: voltorb
data/pokemon/dex_entries/voltorb.asm::vo.en:
BALL
During the study of this #MON, it was discovered
that its components are not found in nature.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/voltorb.asm::vo.et:
PALL
Selle #MONi uurimisel avastati, et selle koostisosi looduses ei leidu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/vulpix.asm::vul.label: vulpix
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vulpix.asm::vul.en:
FOX
As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become
more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/vulpix.asm::vul.et:
REBANE
Kui selle keha suuremaks kasvab, muutuvad selle kuus sooja saba kaunimaks ja karvkate luksuslikumaks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/wartortle.asm::.label: wartortle
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wartortle.asm::.en:
TURTLE
Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity,
making it quite popular among older people.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wartortle.asm::.et:
KILPKONN
Selle pikk, karvane saba on pikaealisuse sümbol, tehes selle vanemate inimeste seas üsna populaarseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/weedle.asm::wee.label: weedle
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weedle.asm::wee.en:
HAIRY BUG
The barb on top of its head secretes a strong poison.
It uses this toxic barb to protect itself.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weedle.asm::wee.et:
KARVAPUTUKAS
Pea otsas olev oga eritab tugevat mürki. See kasutab seda mürgist oga enda kaitsmiseks.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/weepinbell.asm:.label: weepinbell
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weepinbell.asm:.en:
FLYCATCHER
When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp
leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weepinbell.asm:.et:
KÄRBSEPÜÜDJA
Kui sel on nälg, vehib see oma habemenoateravaid lehti, tükeldades toiduks iga õnnetu läheduses oleva eseme.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/weezing.asm::we.label: weezing
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weezing.asm::we.en:
POISON GAS
When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its
body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/weezing.asm::we.et:
MÜRKGAAS
Kui see hingab prügist sisse mürkgaase, paisub selle keha ja selle sisemus lõhnab palju hullemini.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/wigglytuff.asm:.label: wigglytuff
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wigglytuff.asm:.en:
BALLOON
The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so
good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wigglytuff.asm:.et:
ÕHUPALL
Rikkalik, kohev karv, mis selle keha katab, on nii mõnus, et iga puudutaja ei suuda lõpetada selle katsumist.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/wobbuffet.asm::.label: wobbuffet
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wobbuffet.asm::.en:
PATIENT
In order to conceal its black tail, it lives in
a dark cave and only moves about at night.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wobbuffet.asm::.et:
KANNATLIK
Et oma musta saba varjata, elab see pimedas koopas ja liigub ringi ainult öösel.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/wooper.asm::woo.label: wooper
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wooper.asm::woo.en:
WATER FISH
A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching
it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/wooper.asm::woo.et:
VEEKALA
Limakiht katab selle keha. Palja käega puudutamine tekitab teravat valu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/xatu.asm::xatu.label: xatu
data/pokemon/dex_entries/xatu.asm::xatu.en:
MYSTIC
Once it begins to meditate at sunrise, the entire
day will pass before it will move again.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/xatu.asm::xatu.et:
MÜSTILINE
Kui see hakkab päikesetõusul mediteerima, möödub terve päev, enne kui see uuesti liigub.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/yanma.asm::yanm.label: yanma
data/pokemon/dex_entries/yanma.asm::yanm.en:
CLEAR WING
It can see in all directions without moving its big
eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/yanma.asm::yanm.et:
SELGE TIIB
See näeb kõikides suundades ilma oma suuri silmi liigutamata, aidates sel kohe märgata ründajaid ja toitu.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/zapdos.asm::zap.label: zapdos
data/pokemon/dex_entries/zapdos.asm::zap.en:
ELECTRIC
Legendary bird #MON. They say lightning caused
by the flapping of its wings causes summer storms.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/zapdos.asm::zap.et:
ELEKTER
Legendaarne linnu-#MON. Öeldakse, et selle tiibade lehvitamisest tekkiv välk põhjustab suvetorme.

data/pokemon/dex_entries/zubat.asm::zuba.label: zubat
data/pokemon/dex_entries/zubat.asm::zuba.en:
BAT
During the day, it gathers with others and hangs
from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.
data/pokemon/dex_entries/zubat.asm::zuba.et:
NAHKHIIR
Päeval kogunevad nad teistega ja ripuvad vanade hoonete ja koobaste lagedelt.

data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.label: AlanAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.en:
Yup, it's {RAM}!
Is this <PLAY_G>? Good morning!
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.et:
Jah, siin {RAM}!
Kas see on <PLAY_G>? Tere hommikust!

data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.label: AlanAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.en:
Yup, it's {RAM}!
Is that <PLAY_G>? Good evening!
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanAns.et:
Jah, siin {RAM}!
Kas see on <PLAY_G>? Tere õhtust!

data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanGen.label: AlanGenericText
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanGen.en:
<PLAY_G>, are you raising your #MON properly?
I read in a book that you should
raise any #MON you catch with love and care.
data/phone/text/alan_callee.asm::AlanGen.et:
<PLAY_G>, kas kasvatad oma #MONe hästi?
Lugesin raamatust, et iga püütud
#MONi tuleks kasvatada armastuse ja hoolega.

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanGet.label: AlanGettingStrongerText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanGet.en:
My {RAM}'s getting stronger,
exactly as I calculated!
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanGet.et:
Mu {RAM} muutub tugevamaks,
täpselt nagu arvutasin!

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanDef.label: AlanDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanDef.en:
By the way, we knocked out a wild
{RAM} just the other day.
Studying up in advance worked!
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanDef.et:
Muide, alistasime just teisel
päeval metsiku {RAM}.
Eelnev õppimine tasus end ära!

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanLos.label: AlanLostAMonText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanLos.en:
By the way, a wild {RAM} escaped on me yesterday.
A computational error on my part…
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanLos.et:
Muide, metsik {RAM} pääses mul
eile käest. Arvutusviga minu poolt…

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanBat.label: AlanBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanBat.en:
I've studied quite a bit since then,
and I've gotten a lot better!
I'm hanging out on {RAM}.
Can you come down for a battle?
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanBat.et:
Olen sellest ajast palju õppinud
ja muutunud palju paremaks!
Olen {RAM}.
Kas tuled lahingusse?

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanFou.label: AlanFoundItemText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanFou.en:
Hehehe, I picked up something nice!
You can have it! Why don't you come
to {RAM} and pick it up?
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanFou.et:
Hehehe, leidsin midagi toredat!
Võid selle saada! Tule
{RAM} ja võta see!

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanHav.label: AlanHaventPickedUpAnythingText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanHav.en:
I haven't picked up anything yet.
I'll call you if I find something.
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanHav.et:
Ma pole veel midagi leidnud.
Helistan, kui midagi leian.

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanRem.label: AlanReminderText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanRem.en:
If we don't battle soon, I'll forget my strategy!
I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanRem.et:
Kui me varsti ei võitle, unustan oma strateegia!
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanCom.label: AlanComePickUpGiftText
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanCom.en:
I have to do my homework, so can
you come get your gift right away?
I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/alan_caller.asm::AlanCom.et:
Pean kodutööd tegema, kas saad
kohe oma kingituse järele tulla?
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
Reading textbooks is worthwhile every so often.
When I'm reading and walking, I have to look down.
So I notice items on the ground.
Next time I find something, I'll give it to you.
May I have your phone number?
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Õpikute lugemine tasub end aeg-ajalt ära.
Kui loen ja kõnnin, pean alla vaatama.
Seega märkan maas esemeid.
Järgmine kord, kui midagi leian, annan sulle.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
If I find something, it's yours.
So may I have your phone number?
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Kui midagi leian, on see sinu.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
I'll call you as soon as I find
something. You can count on it!
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Helistan kohe, kui midagi
leian. Võid selle peale loota!

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
Oh… I thought it would be a good
break to call you when I'm studying…
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Oh… Arvasin, et helistamine
oleks õppimise ajal hea paus…

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en: There's no room for my number.

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanRematchText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
I waited around for you!
I'm thoroughly prepared today!
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Ootasin sind! Olen täna
täielikult valmis!

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanGiftText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en: This, this! This is yours! Ta-da!
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et: See, see! See on sinu! Taa-daa!

data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.label: AlanPackFullText
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.en:
Whoops!
You can't carry any more items!
I'll hold it until next time.
data/phone/text/alan_overworld.asm::Alan.et:
Uups!
Sa ei saa rohkem esemeid kanda!
Hoian seda järgmise korrani.

data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.en:
Yeah, {RAM} the HIKER here.
Ah, <PLAYER>, right?

data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.en:
Yeah, {RAM} the HIKER here.
Ah, <PLAYER>, isn't it?
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.et:
Jah, siin RÄNDUR {RAM}.
Ah, <PLAYER>, kas pole?

data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyGreetDayText
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.en:
Hey, is this <PLAYER>?
This is {RAM} the HIKER!
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.et:
Hei, kas see on <PLAYER>?
Siin RÄNDUR {RAM}!

data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.en:
<PLAYER>, you still awake?
This is {RAM} the HIKER!
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.et:
<PLAYER>, kas oled veel ärkvel?
Siin RÄNDUR {RAM}!

data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyGenericText
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.en:
Are your #MON as feisty as ever?
My {RAM} and me--we have energy
to burn. We hike up mountains every
day to work out all our energy.
data/phone/text/anthony_callee.asm::Anth.et:
Kas su #MONid on ikka sama tigedad?
Mu {RAM} ja mina - meil on energiat
kuhjaga. Ronime iga päev mägedele,
et kogu energia välja töötada.

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyMonAteSomeBerriesText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
The other day, I was watching my
{RAM} eat some BERRIES.
It looked like it was enjoying its
meal, so I decided to try some.
I'm not sure if people should eat
that stuff, but it was delicious!
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Teisel päeval vaatasin, kuidas mu
{RAM} sõi BERRYsid.
Tundus, et talle maitses,
seega otsustasin ka proovida.
Ei tea, kas inimesed peaksid seda
sööma, aga see oli maitsev!

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Lately, I've been running across
wild {RAM} quite often.
They're easily taken care of.
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Viimasel ajal olen tihti
kohanud metsikuid {RAM}.
Nendega saab kergesti hakkama.

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyLostAMonText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Oh yeah, I was battling this
{RAM} the other day…
It took off when I got distracted by a passing BEAUTY.
Learn from my mistake--always
stay focused on the job at hand!
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Ah jaa, võitlesin teisel päeval
selle {RAM}-ga…
See pages, kui mööduv ILUKANE mind segas.
Õpi mu veast - jää alati
käsiloleva töö juurde keskendunuks!

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Come on--let's battle right now!
{RAM} is where I am.
Come on down if you feel up to it!
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Ole nüüd - võitleme kohe!
Olen {RAM}.
Tule alla, kui julgust jätkub!

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonySwarmText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
<PLAYER>! It's mind-blowing!
I took a hike in {RAM} yesterday, see?
Well, there were tons of {RAM}
around! You have to see it!
I get this feeling that {RAM}
may be timid. I didn't see any
where there are strong #MON.
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
<PLAYER>! See on uskumatu!
Käisin eile {RAM} matkal, näed?
Noh, seal oli hulganisti {RAM}!
Seda pead nägema!
Mul on tunne, et {RAM} on
arglik. Ei näinud neid seal,
kus on tugevaid #MONe.

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyWasntPayingAttentionText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Rare #MON?
Hey, sorry! I was too focused on my
hike, so I wasn't paying attention.
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Haruldasi #MONe?
Hei, vabandust! Olin liiga keskendunud
matkale, ei pannud tähele.

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyReminderText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Hello! You haven't forgotten about
our battle, have you?
{RAM}! I'm waiting!
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Halloo! Sa pole meie lahingut
unustanud, ega ju?
{RAM}! Ma ootan!

data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.label: AnthonyHurryText
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.en:
Hello? What? Where is DUNSPARCE?
DARK CAVE! Hurry!
I know I've said it before, but
DUNSPARCE don't appear when there
are strong #MON around.
data/phone/text/anthony_caller.asm::Anth.et:
Halloo? Mida? Kus on DUNSPARCE?
DARK CAVE! Kiirusta!
Olen seda enne öelnud, aga
DUNSPARCE ei ilmu, kui läheduses
on tugevaid #MONe.

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en:
By the way, I'm a HIKER, so I often
go to mountains and caves.
I occasionally see rare #MON.
I could call you the next time I see one.
Feel like swapping phone numbers?
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.et:
Muide, olen RÄNDUR, seega käin
tihti mägedes ja koobastes.
Vahel näen haruldasi #MONe.
Võiksin helistada, kui järgmise näen.
Tahad numbreid vahetada?

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en:
I could call you when I see some rare #MON.
Feel like swapping phone numbers?
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.et:
Võiksin helistada, kui näen haruldasi #MONe.
Tahad numbreid vahetada?

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en: Be patient. I'll find some rare #MON for you!

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en: You're cold. I may as well head to the mountains…
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.et: Oled külm. Võin sama hästi mägedesse minna…

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en:
Your phone's full.
It can't register my phone number.
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.et:
Su telefon on täis.
See ei saa mu numbrit salvestada.

data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.label: AnthonyRematchText
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.en:
All righty, then!
My #MON and I are raring to go!
data/phone/text/anthony_overworld.asm::A.et:
Hea küll siis!
Mu #MONid ja mina oleme minekuvalmis!

data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.label: ArnieGreetText
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.en:
Yeah, hello? {RAM} calling.
What are you up to, <PLAY_G>?
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.et:
Jah, halloo? {RAM} helistab.
Mis sa teed, <PLAY_G>?

data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.label: ArnieGreetDayText
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.en:
Yeah, hello? {RAM} calling.
Where are you now, <PLAY_G>?
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.et:
Jah, halloo? {RAM} helistab.
Kus sa praegu oled, <PLAY_G>?

data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.label: ArnieGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.en:
Yeah, hello? {RAM} calling.
Are you awake now, <PLAY_G>?
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.et:
Jah, halloo? {RAM} helistab.
Kas oled nüüd ärkvel, <PLAY_G>?

data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.label: ArnieGenericText
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.en: I bet your #MON are a lot stronger than before.
data/phone/text/arnie_callee.asm::ArnieG.et: Vean kihla, et su #MONid on palju tugevamad kui varem.

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieM.label: ArnieMonIsSoCuteText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieM.en:
I'm always with my {RAM}!
It's so cute! I just love it!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieM.et:
Olen alati oma {RAM}-ga!
See on nii nunnu! Ma lihtsalt armastan seda!

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieD.label: ArnieDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieD.en:
Changing the topic here, I saw this
{RAM} for the first time.
It was easy to beat, actually.
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieD.et:
Teemat vahetades, nägin seda
{RAM} esimest korda.
Tegelikult oli seda kerge alistada.

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieL.label: ArnieLostAMonText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieL.en:
I was wondering, do you happen to have {RAM}?
I can't seem to catch one. What is
its weakness, I wonder.
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieL.et:
Mõtlesin, kas sul juhtub olema {RAM}?
Ma ei suuda seda kuidagi püüda. Huvitav,
mis on selle nõrkus.

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieB.label: ArnieBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieB.en:
Hey, let's battle our #MON!
I won't lose to you battling or in
the Bug-Catching Contest!
I'll be here on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieB.et:
Hei, võitleme oma #MONidega!
Ma ei kaota sulle lahingus ega
putukapüügivõistlusel!
Olen siin {RAM}!

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieS.label: ArnieSwarmText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieS.en:
Boy, am I glad I caught you!
A whole bunch of {RAM} have
appeared around {RAM}!
You have to see this!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieS.et:
Poiss, hea, et sind kätte sain!
Terve hulk {RAM} on ilmunud
{RAM} ümber!
Seda pead nägema!

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.label: ArnieHaventSeenRareMonText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.en:
I haven't had any luck seeing rare #MON lately…
But I know they're out there!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.et:
Pole viimasel ajal haruldasi #MONe näinud…
Aga tean, et nad on kusagil olemas!

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieR.label: ArnieReminderText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieR.en:
Hey, where are you now?
Let's battle. I'll be waiting for you on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieR.et:
Hei, kus sa nüüd oled?
Võitleme. Ootan sind {RAM}!

data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.label: ArnieHurryText
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.en:
Hello? Are you coming or what?
You're missing out on seeing YANMA!
Get down to ROUTE 35 right now!
data/phone/text/arnie_caller.asm::ArnieH.et:
Halloo? Kas sa tuled või mitte?
Jääd YANMA nägemisest ilma!
Tule kohe ROUTE 35-le!

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArnieAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en:
Do you get the feeling that there
are more rare #MON around?
I'm positive there are, so I look all the time.
If I find one, I want to share the
good news with everyone I know.
I know! Give me your phone number.
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et:
Kas sul on tunne, et ümberringi
on rohkem haruldasi #MONe?
Olen kindel, et on, seega otsin pidevalt.
Kui ühe leian, tahan head uudist
kõigi tuttavatega jagada.
Tean! Anna mulle oma telefoninumber.

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArnieAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en:
I want to let people know if I see rare #MON.
Please give me your phone number!
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et:
Tahan inimestele teada anda, kui näen haruldasi #MONe.
Anna palun oma telefoninumber!

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArnieNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en:
If I spot any awesome #MON,
I'll be sure to give you a call!
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et:
Kui märkan vägevaid #MONe,
helistan sulle kindlasti!

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArnieNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en: Aww! I want to tell someone about my discoveries!
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et: Ohh! Tahan kellelegi oma avastustest rääkida!

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArniePhoneFullText
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en:
There's no space for my number.
If you make room, register me!
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et:
Mu numbri jaoks pole ruumi.
Kui teed ruumi, registreeri mind!

data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.label: ArnieRematchText
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.en:
It's my turn to win now!
I've turned over a new leaf!
data/phone/text/arnie_overworld.asm::Arn.et:
Nüüd on minu kord võita!
Olen uue lehe keeranud!

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethAns.label: BethAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
Oh, <PLAY_G>. Good morning.

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethAns.label: BethAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
Oh, <PLAY_G>. Good evening.

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.label: BethGreetText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.en:
Good morning, <PLAY_G>!
This is {RAM}. Were you sleeping?

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.label: BethGreetDayText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, hi! This is {RAM}.
Do you have some time?
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere! Siin {RAM}.
Kas sul on veidi aega?

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.label: BethGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>. Good evening.
This is {RAM}.
I hope you were awake.
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGre.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>. Tere õhtust.
Siin {RAM}.
Loodan, et olid ärkvel.

data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGen.label: BethGenericText
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGen.en:
Are you the kind of person who goes
to #MON CENTERS often?
I go every day. Watching out for
the health of your #MON is a basic
part of being a #MON trainer.
data/phone/text/beth_callee.asm::BethGen.et:
Kas oled selline, kes käib tihti
#MON KESKUSTES?
Mina käin iga päev. Oma #MONide
tervise jälgimine on #MON-treeneriks
olemise põhiosa.

data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethExh.label: BethExhilaratingRideText
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethExh.en:
Do you remember my sweet {RAM}?
{RAM} runs very fast.
It's exhilarating to ride on its
back when it really gets going.
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethExh.et:
Kas mäletad mu armsat {RAM}?
{RAM} jookseb väga kiiresti.
Selle seljas sõita, kui see
tõesti hoo sisse saab, on vaimustav.

data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethDef.label: BethDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethDef.en:
Oh, have you ever seen a {RAM} before?
I just battled one…
It was much faster than I expected.
I was a little shocked.
I still won, of course.
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethDef.et:
Oh, kas oled kunagi näinud {RAM}?
Võitlesin just ühega…
See oli palju kiirem, kui ootasin.
Olin veidi šokeeritud.
Muidugi võitsin ikkagi.

data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethLos.label: BethLostAMonText
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethLos.en:
Oh, I just saw a wild {RAM}.
I was trying to catch it when I
noticed that I was all out of # BALLS.
If you don't check your items, you
may run out at the worst time.
I hope you learn from my mistake.
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethLos.et:
Oh, nägin just metsikut {RAM}.
Üritasin seda püüda, kui
märkasin, et # BALLID on otsas.
Kui sa oma esemeid ei kontrolli,
võivad need kõige halvemal hetkel otsa saada.
Loodan, et õpid mu veast.

data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethBat.label: BethBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethBat.en:
Do you want to battle? I'm going to win this time!
I'll be waiting for you around
{RAM}. Look for me, OK?

data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethRem.label: BethReminderText
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethRem.en:
Um… <PLAY_G>? What's wrong?
Did you forget our deal?
{RAM}.
That's where I'm waiting.
data/phone/text/beth_caller.asm::BethRem.et:
Öö… <PLAY_G>? Mis lahti?
Kas unustasid meie kokkuleppe?
{RAM}.
Seal ma ootan.

data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.label: BethAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.en:
It's been a while since I lost…
You're very good at battling.
We should battle again sometime.
By challenging a tough trainer like
you, I think I can get better too.
So how about it?
Would you give me your phone number?
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.et:
Ammu pole kaotanud…
Oled võitlemises väga hea.
Peaksime millalgi jälle võitlema.
Sinusuguse kõva treeneriga võideldes
arvan, et saan ka ise paremaks.
Noh, kuidas oleks?
Kas annaksid mulle oma telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.label: BethAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.en:
By challenging a tough trainer like
you, I think I can get better too.
So how about it?
Would you give me your phone number?
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.et:
Sinusuguse kõva treeneriga võideldes
arvan, et saan ka ise paremaks.
Noh, kuidas oleks?
Kas annaksid mulle oma telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.label: BethNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.en:
That's too bad…
Let me know if you change your mind.
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.et:
Kui kahju…
Anna teada, kui ümber mõtled.

data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.label: BethPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.en: Oh no. Your phone is out of memory.
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.et: Oh ei. Su telefoni mälu on otsas.

data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.label: BethRematchText
data/phone/text/beth_overworld.asm::Beth.en: You sure kept me waiting! Let's go!

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
Oh! Good morning, <PLAYER>.

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
Oh! Good day, <PLAYER>.

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
Oh! Good evening, <PLAYER>.

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyGreetText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hello, <PLAYER>. Good morning.
This is {RAM}. Were you asleep?
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.et:
Tere, <PLAYER>. Tere hommikust.
Siin {RAM}. Kas magasid?

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyGreetDayText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hi, <PLAYER>. This is {RAM}.
How are you doing?

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Hi, <PLAYER>. This is {RAM}.
Were you awake?

data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyGenericText
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.en:
Keeping your #MON happy?
My {RAM} is healthy. It eats a lot every day.
data/phone/text/beverly_callee.asm::Beve.et:
Kas hoiad oma #MONi õnnelikuna?
Mu {RAM} on terve. Sööb iga päev palju.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyMadeMonEvenCuterText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
I fancied up my {RAM} and
made it even cuter than before!
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Ehtisin oma {RAM} ära ja tegin
selle veelgi nunnumaks kui varem!

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
I happened to come across a wild SNUBBULL recently.
My SNUBBULL, I assure you, was
far cuter than the wild one.
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Sattusin hiljuti metsiku SNUBBULLI otsa.
Mu SNUBBULL, kinnitan sulle, oli
kaugelt nunnum kui metsik.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyLostAMonText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
I happened to see a wild MARILL the
other day. Or so I thought.
A closer look showed it was
{RAM}. I was quite miffed.
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Nägin teisel päeval metsikut
MARILLi. Vähemalt arvasin nii.
Lähem pilk näitas, et see oli
{RAM}. Olin päris pahane.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyHangUpText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en: You can expect a call from me.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyFoundItemText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
My husband got some NUGGETS.
If you'd like, you could have one as
thanks for helping me out.
I'll be at {RAM}.
Please come see me when you can.
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Mu mees sai NUGGETe.
Kui soovid, võid ühe saada
tänuks abi eest.
Olen {RAM}.
Tule minu juurde, kui saad.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyLetsChatAboutMonAgainText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
Are your #MON in prime form?
Let's chat about #MON again.
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Kas su #MONid on tippvormis?
Vestleme #MONidest jälle.

data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.label: BeverlyComePickUpText
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.en:
Pardon? Oh, the NUGGET?
There's no need to hurry. Come see me
in {RAM} when you can.
data/phone/text/beverly_caller.asm::Beve.et:
Palun? Oh, see NUGGET?
Pole vaja kiirustada. Tule minu juurde
{RAM}, kui saad.

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en:
Your MARILL is so cute and adorable!
You love #MON just like I do!
Want to trade phone numbers?
Let's chat! It'll be so much fun!
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et:
Su MARILL on nii nunnu ja armas!
Sa armastad #MONe just nagu mina!
Tahad numbreid vahetada?
Vestleme! See on nii lõbus!

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en:
Your MARILL is so cute and adorable!
We should chat, it will be fun.
Can I have your phone number?
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et:
Su MARILL on nii nunnu ja armas!
Peaksime vestlema, see on lõbus.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en:
To be honest, I want a MARILL.
But I make do with my cute SNUBBULL.
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et:
Ausalt öeldes tahan MARILLi.
Aga lepin oma nunnu SNUBBULLIGA.

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en: Oh? Your phone's memory is full.
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et: Oh? Su telefoni mälu on täis.

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyGiftText
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en:
Oh? <PLAYER>? I waited here for
you. I brought you a little gift.
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et:
Oh? <PLAYER>? Ootasin sind siin.
Tõin sulle väikese kingituse.

data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.label: BeverlyPackFullText
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.en:
Oh? You have no room.
Please come back for it later.
data/phone/text/beverly_overworld.asm::B.et:
Oh? Sul pole ruumi.
Tule sellele hiljem tagasi.

data/phone/text/bike_shop.asm::BikeShopP.label: BikeShopPhoneCallerText
data/phone/text/bike_shop.asm::BikeShopP.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>! Our BICYCLE sales
have gone through the roof!
We owe it all to your advertising
by riding around on our BICYCLE.
As our way of saying thanks, please
keep that BICYCLE. Thanks again!
data/phone/text/bike_shop.asm::BikeShopP.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>! Meie JALGRATTA müük
on lakke tõusnud!
Võlgneme selle kõik sinu reklaamile,
kui sõidad ringi meie JALGRATTAGA.
Tänu märgiks jäta see JALGRATAS
endale. Aitäh veel kord!

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneMornG.label: BillPhoneMornGreetingText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneMornG.en:
Good morning!
This is the #MON STORAGE SYSTEM
ADMINISTRATION SERVICE.
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneMornG.et:
Tere hommikust!
See on #MON HOIUSÜSTEEMI
HALDUSTEENUS.

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneDayGr.label: BillPhoneDayGreetingText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneDayGr.en:
Good day!
This is the #MON STORAGE SYSTEM
ADMINISTRATION SERVICE.
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneDayGr.et:
Tere päevast!
See on #MON HOIUSÜSTEEMI
HALDUSTEENUS.

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNiteG.label: BillPhoneNiteGreetingText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNiteG.en:
Good evening!
This is the #MON STORAGE SYSTEM
ADMINISTRATION SERVICE.
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNiteG.et:
Tere õhtust!
See on #MON HOIUSÜSTEEMI
HALDUSTEENUS.

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneGener.label: BillPhoneGenericText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneGener.en:
Who's calling?
<PLAY_G>, is it? Hang on a sec…
<……> <……>

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNotFu.label: BillPhoneNotFullText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNotFu.en:
Thanks for waiting!
<PLAY_G>, your BOX has room for {RAM} more #MON.
Get out there and fill it up!
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNotFu.et:
Aitäh ootamast!
<PLAY_G>, su BOXi mahub veel {RAM} #MONi.
Mine ja täida see ära!

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNearl.label: BillPhoneNearlyFullText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNearl.en:
Thanks for waiting!
<PLAY_G>, your BOX has room for only {RAM} more #MON.
Maybe you should switch your BOX.
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNearl.et:
Aitäh ootamast!
<PLAY_G>, su BOXi mahub veel vaid {RAM} #MONi.
Ehk peaksid BOXi vahetama.

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneFullT.label: BillPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneFullT.en:
Thanks for waiting!
<PLAY_G>, your BOX is full!
You'll have to switch BOXES if
you want to catch more #MON.
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneFullT.et:
Aitäh ootamast!
<PLAY_G>, su BOX on täis!
Pead BOXe vahetama, kui tahad
rohkem #MONe püüda.

data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNewly.label: BillPhoneNewlyFullText
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNewly.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>? It's me, BILL!
Thanks for using my STORAGE SYSTEM.
That last #MON you sent filled your BOX up.
You'll have to switch BOXES if
you want to catch more #MON.
Bye now!
data/phone/text/bill.asm::BillPhoneNewly.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>? See olen mina, BILL!
Aitäh, et kasutad mu HOIUSÜSTEEMI.
See viimane #MON täitis su BOXi.
Pead BOXe vahetama, kui tahad
rohkem #MONe püüda.
Nägemist!

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.label: BrentAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.en:
Yes? {RAM} here…
Ah, <PLAYER>. What can I do for you?
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.et:
Jah? Siin {RAM}…
Ah, <PLAYER>. Kuidas saan aidata?

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.label: BrentAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.en:
Yes? {RAM} here…
Ah, <PLAYER>. What can I do for you?
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.et:
Jah? Siin {RAM}…
Ah, <PLAYER>. Kuidas saan aidata?

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.label: BrentAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.en:
Yes? {RAM} here…
Ah, <PLAYER>. What can I do for you?
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentA.et:
Jah? Siin {RAM}…
Ah, <PLAYER>. Kuidas saan aidata?

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGreetText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.en:
Hiya, <PLAYER>. How are you doing?
Hey! It's me, {RAM}.
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.et:
Tsau, <PLAYER>. Kuidas läheb?
Hei! See olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGreetDayText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.en:
Hiya, <PLAYER>, how are you doing?
Hey, it's me, {RAM}.
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.et:
Tsau, <PLAYER>, kuidas läheb?
Hei, see olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.en:
Hiya, <PLAYER>, how are you doing?
Hey, it's me, {RAM}.
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.et:
Tsau, <PLAYER>, kuidas läheb?
Hei, see olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGenericText
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.en:
Oh yeah, I saw you coming out of a
#MON CENTER the other day.
You heal your #MON regularly,
don't you? I'm impressed.
Heh, my {RAM} is so tough, it
doesn't need to go to #MON CENTERS often. Heheh!
data/phone/text/brent_callee.asm::BrentG.et:
Ah jaa, nägin sind teisel päeval
#MON KESKUSEST väljumas.
Ravid oma #MONe regulaarselt,
eks? Olen muljet avaldatud.
Heh, mu {RAM} on nii kõva, et ei
pea tihti #MON KESKUSTES käima. Heheh!

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.label: BrentRareTradeText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.en:
Oh yeah, I got an extremely rare
#MON in a trade a while back.
Do you want to know what it is?
Hehe, I'm keeping it a secret!
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.et:
Ah jaa, sain mõni aeg tagasi
vahetuse teel üliharuldase #MONi.
Tahad teada, mis see on?
Hehe, hoian seda saladuses!

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentD.label: BrentDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentD.en:
Oh yeah, I took down this wild
{RAM}. It wasn't rare
enough to bother catching.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentD.et:
Ah jaa, alistasin selle metsiku
{RAM}. See polnud piisavalt
haruldane, et püüda.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentL.label: BrentLostAMonText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentL.en:
Oh yeah, I saw a rare #MON about an hour ago.
It was my first sighting. But I
didn't have any # BALLS…
Would BILL laugh at my mistakes?
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentL.et:
Ah jaa, nägin tund aega tagasi haruldast #MONi.
See oli mu esimene nägemine. Aga
mul polnud # BALLE…
Kas BILL naeraks mu vigade üle?

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.label: BrentBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.en:
You've got time like usual, right?
Feel like having a battle?
It'll be a chance to see my rare
#MON. It'll be worth your time!
You know where-{RAM}.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.et:
Sul on nagu tavaliselt aega, eks?
Tahad võidelda?
See oleks võimalus näha mu haruldasi
#MONe. Seda tasub teha!
Tead kus - {RAM}.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.label: BrentFatherGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.en:
Did you know…? BILL's father is
supposed to be a great #MANIAC.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILLi isa
on väidetavalt suur #MANIAKK.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGrandpaGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.en:
Did you know…? Apparently BILL's
grandpa isn't a #MANIAC.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.et:
Kas teadsid…? Ilmselt pole BILLi
vanaisa #MANIAKK.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.label: BrentGoldenrodGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.en: Did you know…? BILL's originally from GOLDENROD.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentG.et: Kas teadsid…? BILL on algselt GOLDENRODIST.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.label: BrentRoute25GossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.en:
Did you know…? BILL evidently
lives on ROUTE 25 in KANTO.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILL elab ilmselt
KANTOS ROUTE 25-l.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentA.label: BrentAbraGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentA.en:
Did you know…? ABRA was the first
#MON that BILL ostensibly caught.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentA.et:
Kas teadsid…? ABRA oli esimene
#MON, kelle BILL väidetavalt püüdis.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.label: BrentSisterGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.en:
Did you know…? BILL's younger
sister apparently can't wink.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILLi noorem õde
ei oska ilmselt silma pilgutada.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentM.label: BrentMilkGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentM.en:
Did you know…? BILL supposedly
hates milk and can't drink it.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentM.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILL väidetavalt
vihkab piima ega saa seda juua.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.label: BrentBattlingGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.en:
Did you know…? Evidently, BILL
isn't very good at battling.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentB.et:
Kas teadsid…? Ilmselt pole BILL
võitlemises kuigi hea.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.label: BrentFlowerShopGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.en:
Did you know…? BILL appears to
like the lady at the FLOWER SHOP.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentF.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILLile näib
meeldivat LILLEPOE daam.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentK.label: BrentKimonoGirlGossipText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentK.en:
Did you know…? BILL's mother is
said to have been a KIMONO GIRL.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentK.et:
Kas teadsid…? BILLi ema on
väidetavalt olnud KIMONOTÜDRUK.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.label: BrentSorryImTooBusyText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.en:
You wanted to hear about BILL?
Sorry, but I'm too busy for you.
I'll call when I have time.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentS.et:
Tahtsid BILList kuulda?
Vabandust, aga olen sinu jaoks liiga hõivatud.
Helistan, kui mul on aega.

data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.label: BrentReminderText
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.en:
You want to see my rare #MON.
Hurry over to {RAM}.
data/phone/text/brent_caller.asm::BrentR.et:
Sa tahad näha mu haruldasi #MONe.
Kiirusta {RAM}.

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
By the way, you're a #MANIAC…
I can tell. Yes, you are.
But your knowledge is shallow still!
Do you know BILL? He's an incredible
#MANIAC. I revere him.
I'll teach you all I know about BILL,
so leave me your phone number.
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.et:
Muide, sa oled #MANIAKK…
Ma näen. Jah, oled küll.
Aga su teadmised on veel pinnapealsed!
Kas tunned BILLi? Ta on uskumatu
#MANIAKK. Ma jumaldan teda.
Õpetan sulle kõik, mida BILList tean,
seega jäta mulle oma telefoninumber.

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
I'll teach you all I know about BILL,
so leave me your phone number.
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.et:
Õpetan sulle kõik, mida BILList tean,
seega jäta mulle oma telefoninumber.

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
BILL--he's more than amazing!
To be a #MANIAC like him someday…
That's my dream.
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.et:
BILL - ta on enam kui hämmastav!
Saada ühel päeval temasuguseks #MANIAKIKS…
See on mu unistus.

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
You're going to regret it…
And I won't care…
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.et:
Sa kahetsed seda…
Ja mina ei hooli…

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
Huh? Your phone list's full.
A #MANIAC has to be more tidy!
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.et:
Häh? Su telefoninimekiri on täis.
#MANIAKK peab korralikum olema!

data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.label: BrentRematchText
data/phone/text/brent_overworld.asm::Bre.en:
I've been waiting.
Look, check out my #MON!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.label: BuenaPhoneMorningAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.en:
Hi, this is BUENA…
Oh! Good morning, <PLAY_G>!
I'm kind of foggy in the morning…
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.et:
Tere, siin BUENA…
Oh! Tere hommikust, <PLAY_G>!
Olen hommikuti veidi udune…

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.label: BuenaPhoneDayAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.en:
Hi, this is BUENA… Oh! Hi, <PLAY_G>!
Do you tune into BUENA's show?
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.et:
Tere, siin BUENA… Oh! Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Kas kuulad BUENA saadet?

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.label: BuenaPhoneMidnightAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.en:
This is BUENA. I can't come to
the phone right now.
If you want to chat, tune into
BUENA's PASSWORD on the radio and
give me a call after midnight!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.et:
Siin BUENA. Ma ei saa
praegu telefonile tulla.
Kui tahad vestelda, kuula
raadiost BUENA PAROOLI ja
helista pärast keskööd!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.label: BuenaPhoneNiteAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.en:
Hi, this is BUENA… Oh! Hi, <PLAY_G>!
I just got off work.
Let me tell you, I'm exhausted!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.et:
Tere, siin BUENA… Oh! Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Sain just töölt.
Usu mind, olen kurnatud!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.label: BuenaPhoneMorningText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.en:
<PLAY_G>! Hi, it's BUENA!
I got up early, so I decided to call!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMor.et:
<PLAY_G>! Tere, siin BUENA!
Ärkasin vara, seega otsustasin helistada!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.label: BuenaPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.en:
<PLAY_G>! Hi, it's BUENA!
I needed someone to chat with!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneDay.et:
<PLAY_G>! Tere, siin BUENA!
Vajasin kellegagi vestlemist!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.label: BuenaPhoneMidnightText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.en:
<PLAY_G>! Hi, it's BUENA!
I'm just on my break.
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneMid.et:
<PLAY_G>! Tere, siin BUENA!
Olen lihtsalt pausil.

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.label: BuenaPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.en:
<PLAY_G>! Hi, it's BUENA!
I couldn't sleep, so I called you.
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneNit.et:
<PLAY_G>! Tere, siin BUENA!
Ei saanud magada, seega helistasin.

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRoc.label: BuenaPhoneRocketText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRoc.en:
Oh. Hi, <PLAY_G>!
You are how?
Aiyee! This isn't the time for me to
be cracking silly gag greetings!
The RADIO TOWER is in deep trouble!
<PLAY_G>, you'd better be careful!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRoc.et:
Oh. Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Kuidas sul on?
Aijee! Pole aeg totraid
naljatervitusi teha!
RADIO TOWER on suures hädas!
<PLAY_G>, ole parem ettevaatlik!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWen.label: BuenaPhoneWentOutWithBenText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWen.en:
The other day, I went out to eat
with DJ BEN! Isn't it great?
Not only that, he said the music on
my program is cool!
Oh, wow! Like, what should I do?
…Oops, I have to get ready for my
show! I'll catch you later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWen.et:
Teisel päeval käisin DJ BENIGA
söömas! Kas pole tore?
Pealegi ütles ta, et muusika
mu saates on lahe!
Oh, vau! Mida ma peaksin tegema?
…Uups, pean oma saateks valmistuma!
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRec.label: BuenaPhoneReceptionistText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRec.en:
You know the receptionist at the RADIO TOWER?
'Welcome,' is all she ever says.
But she's really the chattiest
person at the RADIO TOWER.
So she must be holding back.
Isn't that fun to know?
Catch you later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRec.et:
Kas tunned RADIO TOWERI administraatorit?
'Tere tulemast,' on kõik, mida ta ütleb.
Aga ta on tegelikult kõige jutukam
inimene RADIO TOWERIS.
Seega peab ta end tagasi hoidma.
Kas pole tore seda teada?
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneLuc.label: BuenaPhoneLuckyNumberShowText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneLuc.en:
Tell me, <PLAY_G>. Have you ever won
a prize on the LUCKY NUMBER SHOW?
REED moans that he's never won, so
he vows to keep the show on the air till he does.
Let's chat again!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneLuc.et:
Ütle, <PLAY_G>. Kas oled kunagi
võitnud ÕNNENUMBRI SAATES?
REED viriseb, et pole kunagi võitnud,
seega vannub saadet eetris hoida, kuni võidab.
Vestleme jälle!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneStr.label: BuenaPhoneStressedFromWorkText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneStr.en:
You know, last night…
I was so stressed out from work, I
ate a ton of junk food!
MARY and I have this deal about losing weight…
This won't do…
Huh? What's the weight?
This has to be a total secret!
MARY weighs…
Aiyee! M-MARY!
Uh… Um… I… Sorry, wrong number!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneStr.et:
Tead, eile õhtul…
Olin tööst nii stressis, et
sõin hunniku rämpstoitu!
MARY ja mul on kaalulangetamise kokkulepe…
Nii ei lähe…
Häh? Mis kaal?
See peab olema täielik saladus!
MARY kaalub…
Aijee! M-MARY! Öö… Vabandust, vale number!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePro.label: BuenaPhoneProfessorOakText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePro.en:
Yesterday, PROF. OAK was in the
studio to tape his show.
So I went over and introduced myself.
Get this--he tunes in to my program!
Oh! Here comes PROF.OAK again!
I'm going to chat him up again!
Catch you later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePro.et:
Eile oli PROF. OAK stuudios
oma saadet salvestamas.
Seega läksin ja tutvustasin end.
Kujuta ette - ta kuulab mu saadet!
Oh! Siin tuleb PROF.OAK jälle!
Lähen temaga jälle juttu ajama!
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGot.label: BuenaPhoneGotAColdText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGot.en:
…Cough, cough!
Uhm sorry uh got uh code dite now.
Buh uma pro so uh hav to cover id ub
so no un notice while uhm on air.
Uh fidz muh voice now.
I'll catch you on the fly. This has been BUENA!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGot.et:
…Köhh, köhh!
Öö vabandust ää mul on ää nohu praegu.
Aga püüan seda varjata, et
keegi ei märkaks, kui olen eetris.
Ää leian oma hääle nüüd.
Püüan su lennult. Siin oli BUENA!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.label: BuenaPhoneRadioCardQuestionsText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.en:
Hey, <PLAY_G>. You won that RADIO
CARD by beating the quiz at the
reception desk, didn't you?
Guess what? I made up the questions!
…Were they too easy for you?
Well, let's chat again!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.et:
Hei, <PLAY_G>. Võitsid selle RADIO
CARDI, alistades viktoriini
vastuvõtulauas, eks?
Kujuta ette? Mina koostasin küsimused!
…Kas need olid sulle liiga lihtsad?
Noh, vestleme jälle!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePik.label: BuenaPhonePikachuFanClubText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePik.en:
I'm elated that more people are
taking part in my PASSWORD show.
But when PIKACHU was the password,
it was uh… whew… overwhelming.
FAN CLUB people came in out in
droves, shouting 'PIKACHU!' over
and over. I mean, they were loud.
Anyone tuning in around then must
have been shocked by the racket!
Anyway, back to work for me!
Let's chat again!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePik.et:
Olen elevil, et rohkem inimesi
võtab osa mu PAROOLI-saatest.
Aga kui PIKACHU oli parool,
oli see öö… uhh… ülekaalukas.
FÄNNIKLUBI inimesed tulid kohale
parvedena, hüüdes 'PIKACHU!' aina
uuesti. Nad olid tõesti valjud.
Iga sel hetkel kuulaja pidi
olema lärmist šokeeritud!
Igatahes, tagasi tööle!
Vestleme jälle!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.label: BuenaPhoneRadioTowerDirectorText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.en:
Guess what? The RADIO TOWER's
DIRECTOR is a big fan of TV!
A while ago, a fashion show on TV
said that black suits were in.
Now all he wears are black suits.
But it's a secret that our DIRECTOR
is a TV fan, so if you see him, don't
you dare mention it!
Oh! The DIRECTOR will be here soon!
Later! Tune into my show!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneRad.et:
Kujuta ette? RADIO TOWERI
DIREKTOR on suur TV-fänn!
Mõni aeg tagasi ütles moešõu TVs,
et mustad ülikonnad on moes.
Nüüd kannab ta ainult musti ülikondi.
Aga see on saladus, et meie DIREKTOR
on TV-fänn, seega kui teda näed,
ära julge seda mainida!
Oh! DIREKTOR tuleb varsti siia!
Hiljem! Kuula mu saadet!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWhe.label: BuenaPhoneWhenDoYouRelaxText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWhe.en:
<PLAY_G>, tell me.
When do you relax the most?
For me, it has to be in the studio
right after my show, enjoying a
nice cup of tea. It's so pleasant
that it gradually makes me drowsy…
<……> <……> <……>
<……> <……> <……>Zzz
Oops, I drifted off just thinking
about it! How, uh… embarrassing!
Please forget this happened! Later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneWhe.et:
<PLAY_G>, ütle mulle.
Millal sa kõige rohkem lõõgastud?
Minu jaoks on see stuudios
kohe pärast mu saadet, nautides
tassi teed. See on nii mõnus,
et teeb mind tasapisi uniseks…
<……> <……> <……>
<……> <……> <……>Zzz
Uups, jäin tukkuma lihtsalt sellele
mõeldes! Kui… öö… piinlik!
Unusta palun, et see juhtus! Hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneSta.label: BuenaPhoneStarterPokemonText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneSta.en:
<PLAY_G>, what was the first #MON you ever caught?
…Oh, really?
I've seen lots of #MON around,
but I've never caught one.
I should give it a try sometime.
Did you know that the first #MON
MARY caught was a DROWZEE?
Isn't that so out of character?
But MARY's DROWZEE kept making her
fall asleep on the job, so she traded
with a fan for a MEOWTH.
Let's chat about #MON again!
Bye-bye!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneSta.et:
<PLAY_G>, mis oli su esimene püütud #MON?
…Oh, tõesti?
Olen näinud palju #MONe ringi,
aga pole kunagi ühtki püüdnud.
Peaksin millalgi proovima.
Kas teadsid, et esimene #MON,
kelle MARY püüdis, oli DROWZEE?
Kas pole nii ta moodi?
Aga MARY DROWZEE pani ta pidevalt
tööl magama, seega vahetas ta
fänniga MEOWTHI vastu.
Vestleme #MONidest jälle!
Head-aega!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCom.label: BuenaPhoneCompanyVacationText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCom.en:
Guess what? All of us from the RADIO
TOWER are going on a company vacation
to the RADIO TOWER in LAVENDER.
We're wasting our vacation on a trip
to another RADIO TOWER?
I'd much rather go to the beach!
<PLAY_G>, I hope you have enough
fun for both of us on your journey!
Bye-bye!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCom.et:
Kujuta ette? Kõik meist RADIO
TOWERIST lähevad firmapuhkusele
LAVENDERI RADIO TOWERISSE.
Raiskame puhkuse reisile
teise RADIO TOWERISSE?
Läheksin pigem randa!
<PLAY_G>, loodan, et lõbutsed oma
teekonnal meie mõlema eest!
Head-aega!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneBen.label: BuenaPhoneBenAndFernText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneBen.en:
Did you know…?
BEN and FERN talk on the phone for
hours about what #MON music they
should play on different days of the week.
One time, FERN's rapping style kind
of rubbed off on BEN weirdly.
So we ended up enduring BEN's
silly, chilly, a willy-nilly jivetalking shtick for a while.
Let's chat again!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneBen.et:
Kas teadsid…?
BEN ja FERN räägivad telefonis tunde, millist #MON-muusikat nädalapäevadel mängida.
Ükskord kandus FERNI räppstiil imelikult BENile üle.
Nii pidime mõnda aega taluma BENI totrat, segast jutuvada.
Vestleme jälle!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGoi.label: BuenaPhoneGoingShoppingText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGoi.en:
I'm going shopping with MARY and LILY soon.
It'll be great if GOLDENROD DEPT.
STORE has a sale on when we go…
<PLAY_G>, maybe we can hook up too!
Catch you later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneGoi.et:
Lähen peagi MARY ja LILYGA ostlema.
Oleks tore, kui GOLDENRODI
KAUBAMAJAS oleks soodusmüük…
<PLAY_G>, ehk saame ka kokku!
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneFav.label: BuenaPhoneFavoriteSlotMachineAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneFav.en:
I'm thinking of going to the GAME
CORNER tomorrow. It's been a while.
Some machines pays out a lot.
You see, I have my favorite machine…
It pays out a lot, I kid you not!
Huh? Nuh-uh, it's my secret!
You have to find it yourself!
Catch you later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneFav.et:
Mõtlen homme MÄNGUNURKA minna.
Ammu pole käinud.
Mõned automaadid maksavad palju välja.
Mul on oma lemmikautomaat…
See maksab palju välja, ma ei valeta!
Häh? Ei-ei, see on mu saladus!
Pead selle ise üles leidma!
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePok.label: BuenaPhonePokegearAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePok.en:
Hey, <PLAY_G>. You use your #GEAR
to listen to the radio, right?
I heard that you can even display
town maps with #GEAR.
I have a bad sense of direction, so
#GEAR would be handy…
Anyway, thanks for calling! Later!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhonePok.et:
Hei, <PLAY_G>. Kasutad oma #GEARI
raadio kuulamiseks, eks?
Kuulsin, et #GEARIGA saab isegi
linnakaarte kuvada.
Mul on halb suunataju, seega
#GEAR oleks käepärane…
Igatahes, aitäh helistamast! Hiljem!

data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCoo.label: BuenaPhoneCoopedUpInRadioTowerAnswerText
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCoo.en:
Is it sunny outside today?
When you're cooped up in the RADIO
TOWER as much as I am, you lose touch
with the outside. It can be boring.
Please call again!
data/phone/text/buena.asm::BuenaPhoneCoo.et:
Kas väljas paistab täna päike?
Kui oled RADIO TOWERISSE kinni
jäänud nagu mina, kaotad sideme
välismaailmaga. See võib olla igav.
Helista palun jälle!

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.label: ChadAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Hi, <PLAY_G>! Good morning!

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.label: ChadAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Hi, <PLAY_G>, good day!

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.label: ChadAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Hi, <PLAY_G>, good evening!

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.label: ChadGreetText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>, good morning!
It's {RAM}. How are you?
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>, tere hommikust!
Siin {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.label: ChadGreetDayText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>, good day!
It's {RAM}. How are you?
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>, tere päevast!
Siin {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.label: ChadGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>, good evening!
It's {RAM}. How are you?
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGre.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>, tere õhtust!
Siin {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGen.label: ChadGenericText
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGen.en:
How are your #MON doing?
You know PROF.OAK, so of course your #MON are fine!
My #MON are doing well too.
But then, I am trying to become a
#MON professor, so that shouldn't be a big surprise.
data/phone/text/chad_callee.asm::ChadGen.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Sa tunned PROF.OAKI, seega on su #MONid muidugi korras!
Mu #MONidel läheb ka hästi.
Aga ma ju üritan saada
#MON professoriks, seega pole see üllatus.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadObs.label: ChadObservingWildText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadObs.en:
I recently began observing wild {RAM}.
I've been learning all sorts of new
things through my observations.
I wish I could become a #MON
researcher like PROF.OAK soon.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadObs.et:
Hakkasin hiljuti metsikuid {RAM} uurima.
Olen oma vaatluste kaudu õppinud
igasugu uusi asju.
Sooviksin varsti saada #MON
uurijaks nagu PROF.OAK.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDef.label: ChadDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDef.en:
Oh yes, I managed to knock out a
wild {RAM} a while back.
Well, considering all the studying I
do every day, it was inevitable.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDef.et:
Oh jaa, suutsin mõni aeg tagasi
alistada metsiku {RAM}.
Noh, arvestades kogu õppimist,
mida iga päev teen, oli see paratamatu.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLos.label: ChadLostAMonText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLos.en:
Oh yes, I came close to catching
a wild {RAM}, but it got away.
For the longest time, I've been
wanting to observe {RAM}. Rats…
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLos.et:
Oh jaa, olin lähedal metsiku {RAM}
püüdmisele, aga see pages.
Olen kaua tahtnud
{RAM} vaadelda. Pagan…

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBat.label: ChadBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBat.en:
Want to battle? I have to battle
every so often to avoid rusting out.
I'll be on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBat.et:
Tahad võidelda? Pean aeg-ajalt
võitlema, et mitte roostetada.
Olen {RAM}!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBlu.label: ChadBlueGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBlu.en:
Do you know BLUE?
He's PROF.OAK's grandson and a
former #MON LEAGUE CHAMPION!
He's one super #MON trainer!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadBlu.et:
Kas tunned BLUEd?
Ta on PROF.OAKI pojapoeg ja
endine #MON LIIGA TŠEMPION!
Ta on üks superhea #MON-treener!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.label: ChadDaisyGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.en:
PROF.OAK has a granddaughter named DAISY.
When she's around, even the most
ferocious #MON calm right down.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.et:
PROF.OAKIL on lapselaps nimega DAISY.
Kui ta läheduses on, rahunevad isegi
kõige metsikumad #MONid maha.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.label: ChadProfElmGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.en:
Everyone's talking about PROF.ELM.
He used to be an assistant to the great PROF.OAK!
That is so cool! I envy him!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.et:
Kõik räägivad PROF.ELMIST.
Ta oli kunagi suure PROF.OAKI abiline!
See on nii lahe! Kadestan teda!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.label: ChadProfOaksDreamGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.en:
PROF.OAK's dream is to compile a
comprehensive #DEX.
I envy you for taking part in that project…
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.et:
PROF.OAKI unistus on koostada
põhjalik #DEX.
Kadestan sind selles projektis osalemise pärast…

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadKur.label: ChadKurtGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadKur.en:
Do you know KURT, the BALL creator?
He and PROF.OAK go back a long way.
I guess great people attract one another!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadKur.et:
Kas tunned KURTi, BALLIDE loojat?
Tema ja PROF.OAK tunnevad teineteist ammu.
Vist suured inimesed tõmbavad teineteist ligi!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLea.label: ChadLeagueGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLea.en:
#MON LEAGUE is the great gathering place for all
trainers who wish to become CHAMP.
PROF.OAK acts as an advisor to the
#MON LEAGUE's headquarters.
He really is a great man.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadLea.et:
#MON LIIGA on suur kogunemispaik kõigile
treeneritele, kes tahavad TŠEMPIONIKS saada.
PROF.OAK on #MON LIIGA peakorteri
nõuandja.
Ta on tõesti suurepärane mees.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPok.label: ChadPokemonTalkGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPok.en:
PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK is a popular radio show, right?
Did you know that he was going to
turn down the show at first?
But MARY's energy and persistence wore him down.
So we have MARY to thank for it!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPok.et:
