PROF.OAKI #MON JUTT on populaarne raadiosaade, eks?
Kas teadsid, et ta kavatses
alguses saatest keelduda?
Aga MARY energia ja järjekindlus murdsid ta.
Seega peame MARYT tänama!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.label: ChadProfOakTrainerGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.en:
PROF.OAK used to be a trainer a long time ago.
But rather than battling, he found
#MON themselves to be interesting.
So he abandoned his training to
focus on becoming a researcher.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.et:
PROF.OAK oli ammu treener.
Aga võitlemise asemel leidis ta, et
#MONid ise on huvitavad.
Seega hülgas ta treenimise, et
keskenduda uurijaks saamisele.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.label: ChadDaisyTeaGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.en:
PROF.OAK has a granddaughter named DAISY.
She has tea every day for an hour
from three in the afternoon.
I wish I could join her for tea
and chat about PROF.OAK.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadDai.et:
PROF.OAKIL on lapselaps nimega DAISY.
Ta joob iga päev tund aega teed
kolmest pärastlõunal.
Sooviksin temaga teed juua ja
PROF.OAKIST vestelda.

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.label: ChadProfOakTravelingGossipText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.en:
Did you know? PROF.OAK traveled
all over the world when he was young.
While traveling, he must've learned
about #MON naturally.
I envy him… I'd like to travel
and learn about things too…
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadPro.et:
Kas teadsid? PROF.OAK reisis
noorena üle kogu maailma.
Reisides õppis ta kindlasti
#MONidest loomulikult.
Kadestan teda… Tahaksin ka reisida
ja asjadest õppida…

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadGoi.label: ChadGoingToStudyHardText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadGoi.en:
I'm going to study hard so PROF.OAK
will make me his assistant!
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadGoi.et:
Õpin kõvasti, et PROF.OAK
teeks minust oma abilise!

data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadRem.label: ChadReminderText
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadRem.en:
Do you remember about our battle?
The place is {RAM}.
Hurry over--I'm waiting.
data/phone/text/chad_caller.asm::ChadRem.et:
Kas mäletad meie lahingut?
Koht on {RAM}.
Kiirusta - ma ootan.

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en:
Huh? Is that thing a #DEX? Have you met PROF.OAK?
Huh? You have? That's way cool!
I have a dream of becoming a #MON
researcher like PROF.OAK.
May I please have your phone number?
We should chat about PROF.OAK.
I'm sure it will be loads of fun!
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.et:
Häh? Kas see asi on #DEX? Kas oled kohtunud PROF.OAKIGA?
Häh? Oled? See on ülilahe!
Mul on unistus saada #MON
uurijaks nagu PROF.OAK.
Kas saaksin palun su telefoninumbri?
Peaksime PROF.OAKIST vestlema.
Olen kindel, et see on väga lõbus!

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en:
May I please have your phone number?
We should chat about PROF.OAK.
I'm sure it will be loads of fun!
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.et:
Kas saaksin palun su telefoninumbri?
Peaksime PROF.OAKIST vestlema.
Olen kindel, et see on väga lõbus!

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en: You must listen to PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK, right?
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.et: Sa pead kuulama PROF.OAKI #MON JUTTU, eks?

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en: Oh… I wish I had a chance to meet PROF.OAK…
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.et: Oh… Sooviksin, et mul oleks võimalus PROF.OAKIGA kohtuda…

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en: Your phone list is completely full!

data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.label: ChadRematchText
data/phone/text/chad_overworld.asm::Chad.en: I've been waiting! Let's battle now!

data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.label: DanaAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} on the line.
Hey! It's <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.label: DanaAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} on the line.
I know! It's <PLAY_G>!
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.et:
Tere, {RAM} liinil.
Ma tean! See on <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.label: DanaAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} on the line.
<PLAY_G>? What's up?

data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaGen.label: DanaGenericText
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaGen.en:
My {RAM} is so full of energy,
it's a little scary.
How are your #MON doing?
data/phone/text/dana_callee.asm::DanaGen.et:
Mu {RAM} on nii täis energiat,
et veidi hirmus. Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaTak.label: DanaTakingPhotosText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaTak.en:
My {RAM} is getting prettier!
I've been taking photos galore!
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaTak.et:
Mu {RAM} muutub kaunimaks!
Olen teinud pilte lademes!

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaDef.label: DanaDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaDef.en:
It took only an instant to KO a wild {RAM}.
It must be because you gave me some
battling tips last time.
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaDef.et:
Metsiku {RAM} alistamiseks kulus vaid hetk.
Kindlasti seepärast, et andsid mulle
eelmisel korral lahingunõuandeid.

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaLos.label: DanaLostAMonText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaLos.en:
You know what? A wild {RAM}
got away from me again.
It was so close! Really, just a
little bit more, and I would've…
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaLos.et:
Tead mis? Metsik {RAM}
pages mul jälle käest.
Oli nii lähedal! Tõesti, vaid
natuke rohkem ja oleksin…

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaBat.label: DanaBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaBat.en:
Right now, I'm on {RAM}.
If you're close by, let's battle!
I'll be waiting for you!
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaBat.et:
Praegu olen {RAM}.
Kui oled lähedal, võitleme!
Ma ootan sind!

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaFou.label: DanaFoundItemText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaFou.en:
You know what? I got a good gift!
As I promised, it's yours!
I'm sure you'd like it. Come get
it! I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaFou.et:
Tead mis? Sain hea kingituse!
Nagu lubasin, on see sinu!
Oled kindlasti rahul. Tule võta!
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCan.label: DanaCanYouWaitABitLongerText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCan.en:
Oh! You wanted a gift, right?
I got one, but I want to keep this.
Can you wait a bit longer?
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCan.et:
Oh! Tahtsid kingitust, eks?
Sain ühe, aga tahan selle endale.
Kas saad veel veidi oodata?

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaRem.label: DanaReminderText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaRem.en:
Hi! You haven't forgotten about
your promise to battle me?
I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaRem.et:
Tere! Sa pole oma lubadust
minuga võidelda unustanud?
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCom.label: DanaComePickUpText
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCom.en:
Hello?
If you don't come get your present
soon, I'll give it to someone else.
I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/dana_caller.asm::DanaCom.et:
Halloo?
Kui sa oma kingitust varsti
ei võta, annan selle kellelegi teisele.
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
You're really good at #MON!
Boys give me items after battles, but
sometimes they give me too much.
Next time, I can share some if you
want. Let me get your phone number.
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Oled #MONides tõesti hea!
Poisid annavad mulle pärast lahinguid
esemeid, aga vahel liiga palju.
Järgmine kord võin jagada, kui
tahad. Anna mulle oma number.

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
I'll share my gifts with you.
Let me get your phone number.
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Jagan sinuga oma kingitusi.
Anna mulle oma number.

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
Next time a boy gives me something
after a battle, I'll share some!
Does that make me bad?
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Järgmine kord, kui poiss mulle pärast
lahingut midagi annab, jagan!
Kas see teeb minust halva?

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
Aww, you don't want anything?
But it's all for free…
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Ohh, sa ei taha midagi?
Aga see kõik on tasuta…

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en: But your phone's out of memory!
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et: Aga su telefoni mälu on otsas!

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaRematchText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
You're really late!
I'm eager to get going!
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Sa oled tõesti hilja!
Mul on kange isu alustada!

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaGiftText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
Hi! Are you here for your gift?
This should really make your day!
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Tere! Kas tulid oma kingituse järele?
See peaks su päeva tegema!

data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.label: DanaPackFullText
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.en:
Where are you going to put this?
I'll keep it, so come get it later!
data/phone/text/dana_overworld.asm::Dana.et:
Kuhu sa selle paned?
Hoian seda, tule hiljem võta!

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.label: DerekAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>?
Good morning pika. What's up pika?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Tere hommikust pika. Mis toimub pika?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.label: DerekAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>?
Good day pika, what's up pika?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Tere päevast pika, mis toimub pika?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.label: DerekAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>?
Good evening pika, what's up pika?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekA.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Tere õhtust pika, mis toimub pika?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.label: DerekGreetText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.en:
<PLAY_G> pika, good morning!
It's {RAM}, how pika are you?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.et:
<PLAY_G> pika, tere hommikust!
Siin {RAM}, kuidas pika läheb?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.label: DerekGreetDayText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.en:
<PLAY_G> pika, good pika day!
It's {RAM}, how pika are you?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.et:
<PLAY_G> pika, tere pika päevast!
Siin {RAM}, kuidas pika läheb?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.label: DerekGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.en:
<PLAY_G> pika, good evening!
It's {RAM}. Were you pika awake?
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.et:
<PLAY_G> pika, tere õhtust!
Siin {RAM}. Kas olid pika ärkvel?

data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.label: DerekGenericText
data/phone/text/derek_callee.asm::DerekG.en:
You have to hear this! My lovable
{RAM} looked at me and grinned!
It must be because our hearts beat together as one!

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.label: DerekCheekPinchingText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.en:
Listen to this. My {RAM}
grins happily when I pinch its cheek.
But it never grins for anyone else.
I must be special.
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.et:
Kuula seda. Mu {RAM}
irvitab rõõmsalt, kui ta põske näpistan.
Aga kellelegi teisele ta ei irvita.
Pean olema eriline.

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekD.label: DerekDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekD.en:
Oh, and recently, my PIKACHU beat a wild {RAM}!
A wild {RAM}, I tell you!
Don't you think that's astounding?
My PIKACHU is awesome!
My PIKACHU is the greatest!
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekD.et:
Oh, ja hiljuti alistas mu PIKACHU metsiku {RAM}!
Metsiku {RAM}, ma ütlen sulle!
Kas pole hämmastav?
Mu PIKACHU on vägev!
Mu PIKACHU on parim!

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.label: DerekLostAMonText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.en:
Oh, and I saw a wild {RAM} a little while ago.
But it wasn't very cute, so I left
it… #MON have to be
cute. They're no good otherwise.
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.et:
Oh, ja nägin veidi aega tagasi metsikut {RAM}.
Aga see polnud eriti nunnu, seega jätsin
selle… #MONid peavad olema
nunnud. Muidu pole neist kasu.

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekB.label: DerekBugCatchingContestText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekB.en:
Did you remember? The Bug-Catching Contest is today.
You're going to go, aren't you?
I think I'll participate with
PIKACHU to show off its cuteness.
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekB.et:
Kas mäletasid? Putukapüügivõistlus on täna.
Sa lähed ju, eks?
Arvan, et osalen PIKACHUGA,
et näidata selle nunnust.

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekF.label: DerekFoundItemText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekF.en:
I'd like you to have a NUGGET.
My PIKACHU just loves it.
I'm certain your PIKACHU will love it too!
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekF.et:
Tahaksin, et saaksid NUGGETi.
Mu PIKACHU lihtsalt armastab seda.
Olen kindel, et ka su PIKACHULE meeldib!

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.label: DerekLetsGetTogetherText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.en:
How is your PIKACHU doing?
Let's get together and brag about our PIKACHU!
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekL.et:
Kuidas su PIKACHUL läheb?
Saame kokku ja kiitleme oma PIKACHUDEGA!

data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.label: DerekComePickUpText
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.en:
What's wrong?
I'm waiting on {RAM}.
Come pick this up anytime.
data/phone/text/derek_caller.asm::DerekC.et:
Mis lahti?
Ootan {RAM}.
Tule seda igal ajal võta.

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
Oh, wow! PIKACHU! It's so soft and furry! How cute!
Let's be friends! PIKACHU-lovers are never bad people!
Let's chat about PIKACHU!
Can I get your phone number?
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
Oh, vau! PIKACHU! See on nii pehme ja karvane! Kui nunnu!
Olgem sõbrad! PIKACHU-armastajad pole kunagi halvad!
Vestleme PIKACHUST!
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
Let's chat about PIKACHU!
Can I get your phone number?
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
Vestleme PIKACHUST!
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
PIKACHU is the one! If anything
comes up, I'll give you a jingle.
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
PIKACHU on see õige! Kui midagi
juhtub, helistan sulle.

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
You…
I bet you don't even like PIKACHU…
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
Sina…
Vean kihla, et sulle ei meeldigi PIKACHU…

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en: Wait a sec! Your phone list's full!
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et: Oota hetk! Su telefoninimekiri on täis!

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekGiftText
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
I've been looking for you! Here, see this? This is it!
I'm certain your PIKACHU will love my gift too!
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
Olen sind otsinud! Näe, näed seda? See on see!
Olen kindel, et ka su PIKACHULE meeldib mu kingitus!

data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.label: DerekPackFullText
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.en:
Uh-oh, too bad. You don't have any
room. Be sure to get it later.
data/phone/text/derek_overworld.asm::Der.et:
Oih, kahju. Sul pole ruumi.
Võta see kindlasti hiljem.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHealYou.label: ElmPhoneHealYourMonText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHealYou.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
Try not to overdo it.
Be sure to heal your #MON if they are hurt.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHealYou.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Üritad mitte üle pingutada.
Ravi kindlasti oma #MONe, kui nad viga saavad.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneSawMrPo.label: ElmPhoneSawMrPokemonText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneSawMrPo.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
Did you meet MR. #MON? Great! Come back safely!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneSawMrPo.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Kas kohtasid MR. #MONi? Tore! Tule turvaliselt tagasi!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhonePokemon.label: ElmPhonePokemonStolenText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhonePokemon.en:
<PLAY_G>? I'm very upset now.
We had a #MON stolen from here.
How could anyone do that?
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhonePokemon.et:
<PLAY_G>? Olen nüüd väga endast väljas.
Meilt varastati siit #MON.
Kuidas keegi saab seda teha?

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneCheckin.label: ElmPhoneCheckingTheEggText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneCheckin.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
We're checking the EGG now. It does
appear to be a #MON EGG.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneCheckin.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Kontrollime nüüd EGGi. See tundub
tõesti olevat #MON EGG.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneAssista.label: ElmPhoneAssistantText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneAssista.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
Did you see my assistant? He's at
the #MON CENTER in VIOLET CITY.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneAssista.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Kas nägid mu abilist? Ta on
VIOLET CITY #MON KESKUSES.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHowIsTh.label: ElmPhoneHowIsTheEggText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHowIsTh.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
How's the EGG? Has anything changed?
If anything happens, please call.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneHowIsTh.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Kuidas EGGil läheb? Kas midagi muutus?
Kui midagi juhtub, helista palun.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggHatc.label: ElmPhoneEggHatchedText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggHatc.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>? How is the EGG?
What? It hatched? Wow! What kind of #MON is it?
Please come show me now!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggHatc.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>? Kuidas EGGil läheb?
Mida? See koorus? Vau! Mis #MON see on?
Tule palun kohe näita!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.label: ElmPhoneDiscoveredHatchTimeText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
I just made a new discovery.
The time it takes for an EGG to
hatch depends on the #MON.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Tegin just uue avastuse.
EGGi koorumise aeg
oleneb #MONist.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneInvesti.label: ElmPhoneInvestigatingEggMovesText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneInvesti.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
It's still a mystery what kinds
of moves hatched #MON have.
We're investigating that now.
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneInvesti.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Endiselt on mõistatus, milliseid
rünnakuid koorunud #MONid oskavad.
Uurime seda nüüd.

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.label: ElmPhoneDiscoveredPokerusText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
I discovered an odd thing.
Apparently there's something called
#RUS that infects #MON.
Yes, it's like a virus, so it's called #RUS.
It multiplies fast and infects other
#MON too. But that's all.
It doesn't seem to do anything, and
it goes away over time.
I guess it's nothing to worry about. Bye!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDiscove.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Avastasin imeliku asja.
Ilmselt on midagi nimega #RUS,
mis nakatab #MONe.
Jah, see on nagu viirus, seega #RUS.
See paljuneb kiiresti ja nakatab ka
teisi #MONe. Aga see on kõik.
See ei tundu midagi tegevat ja
kaob aja jooksul.
Vist pole millegi pärast muretseda. Nägemist!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDisaste.label: ElmPhoneDisasterText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDisaste.en:
H-hello? <PLAY_G>? It's a disaster!
Uh, um, it's just terrible!
What should I do? It… Oh, no…
Please get back here now!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneDisaste.et:
T-tere? <PLAY_G>? Katastroof!
Öö, öö, see on lihtsalt kohutav!
Mida ma tegema pean? See… Oh ei…
Tule palun kohe siia tagasi!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggAssi.label: ElmPhoneEggAssistantText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggAssi.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>? We discovered some-
thing about the EGG!
My assistant is at the #MON CENTER
in VIOLET CITY. Could you talk to him?
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneEggAssi.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>? Avastasime EGGi
kohta midagi!
Mu abiline on VIOLET CITY
#MON KESKUSES. Räägiksid temaga?

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneRadioTo.label: ElmPhoneRadioTowerRocketTakeoverText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneRadioTo.en:
<PLAY_G>, how are things going?
I called because something weird is
happening with the radio broadcasts.
They were talking about TEAM ROCKET.
<PLAY_G>, do you know anything about it?
Maybe TEAM ROCKET has returned. No,
that just can't be true.
Sorry to bug you. Take care!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneRadioTo.et:
<PLAY_G>, kuidas asjad on?
Helistasin, sest raadioülekannetega
toimub midagi imelikku.
Nad rääkisid RAKETI KAMBAST.
<PLAY_G>, kas tead sellest midagi?
Ehk on RAKETI KAMP tagasi. Ei,
see lihtsalt ei saa tõsi olla.
Vabandust tülitamise eest. Hoia end!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGiftTex.label: ElmPhoneGiftText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGiftTex.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>?
I have something here for you.
Could you swing by my LAB?
See you later!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGiftTex.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>?
Mul on siin sulle midagi.
Astuksid mu LABORIST läbi?
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGotAhol.label: ElmPhoneGotAholdOfSomethingNeatText
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGotAhol.en:
Hello, <PLAY_G>? How's it going?
I got ahold of something neat.
Swing by my LAB and pick it up!
See you later!
data/phone/text/elm.asm::ElmPhoneGotAhol.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>? Kuidas läheb?
Sain midagi toredat.
Astu mu LABORIST läbi ja võta see!
Näeme hiljem!

data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinAns.label: ErinAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinAns.en:
Yes, this is {RAM}…
Oh. Hi, <PLAY_G>! Good morning!
data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinAns.et:
Jah, siin {RAM}…
Oh. Tere, <PLAY_G>! Tere hommikust!

data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinAns.label: ErinAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinAns.en:
Yes, this is {RAM}…
Oh, hi, <PLAY_G>! Yahoo!

data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinGen.label: ErinGenericText
data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinGen.en:
Are you raising your #MON?
Hey, {RAM}'s {RAM} is looking good!
data/phone/text/erin_callee.asm::ErinGen.et:
Kas kasvatad oma #MONe?
Hei, {RAM} {RAM} näeb hea välja!

data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinDef.label: ErinDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinDef.en:
And, and… I just battled and beat {RAM}!
I've raised my #MON properly!
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinDef.et:
Ja, ja… Võitlesin just ja alistasin {RAM}!
Olen oma #MONe hästi kasvatanud!

data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinLos.label: ErinLostAMonText
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinLos.en:
But, but…
A wild {RAM} got away from me
again. It's just not fair!
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinLos.et:
Aga, aga…
Metsik {RAM} pages mul
jälle käest. See pole aus!

data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinBat.label: ErinBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinBat.en:
I'm ERIN. Want to battle me again?
I won't lose this time!
I'll be waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinBat.et:
Olen ERIN. Tahad minuga uuesti võidelda?
Seekord ma ei kaota!
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinWor.label: ErinWorkingHardText
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinWor.en:
I'm working hard to raise my #MON!
Come back for another battle!
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinWor.et:
Rügan kõvasti oma #MONe kasvatades!
Tule veel üheks lahinguks!

data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinCom.label: ErinComeBattleText
data/phone/text/erin_caller.asm::ErinCom.en:
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Come battle ERIN!
I'll be waiting on {RAM}!

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en:
It really made me angry to lose.
I'll have to train much harder…
Here's my number. I'm ERIN--don't
forget! Want to battle me again?
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et:
Kaotamine ajas mind tõesti vihaseks.
Pean palju kõvemini treenima…
Siin on mu number. Olen ERIN - ära
unusta! Tahad minuga uuesti võidelda?

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en:
I want to battle with you again.
Do you want to exchange numbers?
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et:
Tahan sinuga uuesti võidelda.
Tahad numbreid vahetada?

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en: I'll remember to call when I want to battle again!
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et: Ma helistan, kui tahan uuesti võidelda!

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en:
Oh… I'm sad… If you do want to
battle, come see ERIN--that's me!
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et:
Oh… Olen kurb… Kui tahad
võidelda, tule ERINI juurde - see olen mina!

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en: Oh no. Your phone is all filled up.
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et: Oh ei. Su telefon on täis.

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinRematchText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en: Yay! I waited! Let's start now!

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinPackFullText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en:
That's too bad! You have no room…
I'll give it to you another time.
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et:
Kui kahju! Sul pole ruumi…
Annan selle sulle teinekord.

data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.label: ErinRematchGiftText
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.en:
Aww… I lost again!
I wonder how many times that is…
Thanks for coming! Here's a present!
data/phone/text/erin_overworld.asm::Erin.et:
Ohh… Kaotasin jälle!
Huvitav, mitmes kord see on…
Aitäh, et tulid! Siin on kingitus!

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenA.label: GavenAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM} speaking…
Hi, <PLAY_G>! Good morning!

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenA.label: GavenAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM} speaking…
Hi, <PLAY_G>! Good evening!

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.label: GavenGreetText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.en:
<PLAY_G>, good morning!
It's me, {RAM}. How are you doing?
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere hommikust!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.label: GavenGreetDayText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>!
It's me, {RAM}. How are you doing?
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.label: GavenGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.en:
<PLAY_G>, good evening!
It's me, {RAM}. How are you doing?
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere õhtust!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.label: GavenGenericText
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.en:
How are your #MON doing?
My {RAM}'s doing as great as ever.
Let's keep at it and become #MON CHAMPS!
data/phone/text/gaven_callee.asm::GavenG.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mu {RAM} on sama vägev kui alati.
Jätkame ja saame #MON TŠEMPIONIDEKS!

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenM.label: GavenMonGreaterThanImaginedText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenM.en:
My {RAM} might be greater than I imagined.
I doubt I'll see a {RAM} that's better than mine.
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenM.et:
Mu {RAM} võib olla parem, kui kujutasin.
Kahtlen, kas näen {RAM}, kes on minu omast parem.

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenD.label: GavenDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenD.en:
Oh, and I managed to barely defeat
{RAM} the other day.
I've never seen a {RAM} get that strong…
You shouldn't let your guard down,
even against a #MON you're used to seeing.
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenD.et:
Oh, ja teisel päeval napsasin napilt
võidu {RAM} üle.
Pole näinud {RAM} nii tugevaks saamas…
Sa ei tohiks valvsust kaotada,
isegi tuttava #MONi vastu.

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenL.label: GavenLostAMonText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenL.en:
And a while back, I tried to catch a wild {RAM}.
But it managed to elude me.
One wrong decision could mean total
failure… You ought to be careful too.
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenL.et:
Ja mõni aeg tagasi üritasin püüda metsikut {RAM}.
Aga see suutis mul kõrvale hiilida.
Üks vale otsus võib tähendada täielikku
nurjumist… Sina peaksid ka ettevaatlik olema.

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenB.label: GavenBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenB.en:
Let's battle!
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
Give me a shout when you're close.
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenB.et:
Võitleme!
Ootan {RAM}.
Hõika, kui oled lähedal.

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenH.label: GavenHangUpText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenH.en: OK, I'll talk to you soon!

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenH.label: GavenHangUpNotThursdayText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenH.en: I obsess over how to beat you.
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenH.et: Olen kinnisideeliselt mõtlemas, kuidas sind alistada.

data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenR.label: GavenReminderText
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenR.en:
<PLAY_G>, why aren't you here?
I'll take you down with {RAM}!
data/phone/text/gaven_caller.asm::GavenR.et:
<PLAY_G>, miks sa siin pole?
Alistan su {RAM}!

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
Wow, you're tough. I haven't battled
that seriously in a long time.
Could I get your phone number?
I'd like to battle again when I heal
{RAM} and the rest of my team.
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
Vau, oled kõva. Ammu pole nii
tõsiselt võidelnud.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?
Tahaksin uuesti võidelda, kui olen
{RAM} ja ülejäänud tiimi ravinud.

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
Could I get your phone number?
I'd like to battle again when I heal
{RAM} and the rest of my team.
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?
Tahaksin uuesti võidelda, kui olen
{RAM} ja ülejäänud tiimi ravinud.

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
How should I beat you? I'm tormented
by those thoughts all the time…
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
Kuidas sind alistada? Neid mõtteid
piinlen kogu aeg…

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
OK… I understand… But if you change
your mind, give me a shout anytime.
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
OK… Ma saan aru… Aga kui ümber
mõtled, hõika igal ajal.

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
Your phone's memory is full.
You can't register my number.
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
Su telefoni mälu on täis.
Sa ei saa mu numbrit salvestada.

data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.label: GavenRematchText
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.en:
Hi! I've been waiting for you!
This time, I'm going to win!
data/phone/text/gaven_overworld.asm::Gav.et:
Tere! Ootasin sind!
Seekord ma võidan!

data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.label: GinaAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Good morning!

data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.label: GinaAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Hi, how are you?
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.et:
Halloo? Siin {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Tere, kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.label: GinaAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Good evening!

data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGre.label: GinaGreetDayText
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGre.en:
<PLAY_G>?
It's {RAM}. Is this a bad time?
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGre.et:
<PLAY_G>?
Siin {RAM}. Kas praegu on halb aeg?

data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGen.label: GinaGenericText
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGen.en:
Are your #MON still tough?
I train every day with {RAM}.
data/phone/text/gina_callee.asm::GinaGen.et:
Kas su #MONid on ikka kõvad?
Treenin iga päev {RAM}-ga.

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaGet.label: GinaGettingInSyncWithMonText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaGet.en:
My {RAM} and I are getting more
in sync with each other.
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaGet.et:
Mu {RAM} ja mina saame
üha paremini kokku.

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaDef.label: GinaDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaDef.en:
We battled a wild {RAM} and
managed to drop it in a close match.
We're getting into the groove!
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaDef.et:
Võitlesime metsiku {RAM}-ga ja
suutsime selle tasavõitluses alistada.
Saame hoo sisse!

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaLos.label: GinaLostAMonText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaLos.en:
But, you know?
I still haven't caught {RAM}.
It's getting past frustrating…
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaLos.et:
Aga tead?
Ma pole ikka veel {RAM} püüdnud.
See muutub üle piiri masendavaks…

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaBat.label: GinaBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaBat.en:
Would you be my practice partner again sometime?
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
…Could you take it a little easier on me next time?
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaBat.et:
Kas oleksid millalgi jälle mu harjutuspartner?
Ootan {RAM}.
…Kas võiksid järgmisel korral veidi leebem olla?

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRoc.label: GinaRocketTakeoverRumorText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRoc.en:
Have you heard about TEAM ROCKET?
They've taken over the RADIO TOWER in GOLDENROD.
Are the people inside safe?
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRoc.et:
Kas oled kuulnud RAKETI KAMBAST?
Nad on üle võtnud GOLDENRODI RADIO TOWERI.
Kas sees olevad inimesed on turvalised?

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaFou.label: GinaFoundItemText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaFou.en:
I picked up something nice today.
I want you to have it, so I called!
You will come for it, won't you?
{RAM} is where I am.
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaFou.et:
Leidsin täna midagi toredat.
Tahan, et sa selle saaksid, seega helistasin!
Sa ju tuled selle järele?
{RAM} on koht, kus olen.

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaHav.label: GinaHaventFoundAnythingYetText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaHav.en:
Sorry, I haven't found anything
useful yet… I promise, if I
find anything, you can have it!
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaHav.et:
Vabandust, pole veel midagi
kasulikku leidnud… Luban, et kui
midagi leian, võid selle saada!

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRem.label: GinaReminderText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRem.en:
Oh, <PLAY_G>! How soon can I
expect to see you for our battle?
Don't forget, {RAM}!
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaRem.et:
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Kui varsti võin
oodata sind meie lahinguks?
Ära unusta, {RAM}!

data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaCom.label: GinaComePickUpText
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaCom.en:
I'm getting really impatient, waiting
to give you my present!
Hurry over to {RAM}!
data/phone/text/gina_caller.asm::GinaCom.et:
Muutun tõesti kannatamatuks, oodates,
et saaksin sulle oma kingi anda!
Kiirusta {RAM}!

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en:
Whenever I see a strong trainer, I
want to be their cheerleader.
When I'm on my walk, I sometimes pick up items.
If I get anything, you can have it!
Want to give me your number?
I'll call as soon as I get anything.
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et:
Kui näen tugevat treenerit, tahan
olla ta ergutaja.
Jalutuskäigul korjan vahel esemeid.
Kui midagi saan, võid selle saada!
Tahad anda mulle oma numbri?
Helistan kohe, kui midagi saan.

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en:
If I find an item, you can have it!
Want to give me your number?
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et:
Kui leian eseme, võid selle saada!
Tahad anda mulle oma numbri?

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en: I'll call as soon as I get anything!

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en: Is that so? Well, I'll still be rooting for you!
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et: Ah nii? Noh, ma ikka hoian sulle pöialt!

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en: But your phone is all filled up!

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaRematchText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en:
I've been waiting!
I've gotten a bit better at this!
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et:
Ma ootasin!
Olen selles veidi paremaks saanud!

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaGiftText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en:
So you're finally here!
I think this will make you happy.
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et:
Nii et lõpuks oled siin!
Arvan, et see teeb sind õnnelikuks.

data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.label: GinaPackFullText
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.en:
Your PACK looks completely full.
I'll have to hold on to this.
data/phone/text/gina_overworld.asm::Gina.et:
Su PACK näeb täiesti täis.
Pean seda hoidma.

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.label: HueyAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.en:
Yeah, this is {RAM}.
Huh? What's up, <PLAYER>?

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.label: HueyAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.en:
Yeah, this is {RAM}.
Huh? What's up <PLAYER>?

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.label: HueyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyAns.en:
Yeah, this is {RAM}.
Huh? What's up <PLAYER>?

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.label: HueyGreetText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! You awake?
It's me, {RAM}! How's it going?
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Oled ärkvel?
See olen mina, {RAM}! Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.label: HueyGreetDayText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! You free right now?
It's me, {RAM}! How's it going?
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Oled praegu vaba?
See olen mina, {RAM}! Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.label: HueyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! Were you asleep?
It's me, {RAM}! How's it going?
data/phone/text/huey_callee.asm::HueyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Kas magasid?
See olen mina, {RAM}! Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyBat.label: HueyBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyBat.en:
Hey, I challenge you to a battle!
It won't be like last time!
{RAM}'s where I'm waiting
for you. Hustle over here pronto!
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyBat.et:
Hei, kutsun sind lahingusse!
See ei tule nagu eelmine kord!
{RAM} on koht, kus sind
ootan. Vurista kohe siia!

data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyWeH.label: HueyWeHaveToBattleAgainSometimeText
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyWeH.en:
We have to battle again sometime.
You can bet I'm going to keep
challenging you till I win.
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyWeH.et:
Peame millalgi uuesti võitlema.
Võid kindel olla, et jätkan
sulle väljakutse esitamist, kuni võidan.

data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyRem.label: HueyReminderText
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyRem.en:
Hey, you'd better not have forgotten about our battle!
{RAM}!
Hustle over quick! I'm waiting!
data/phone/text/huey_caller.asm::HueyRem.et:
Hei, sa parem ära unusta meie lahingut!
{RAM}!
Vurista kiiresti! Ma ootan!

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.en:
Cool! That's the first time I've lost in a while!
Hey, give me your phone number.
You'd be fun to battle, so I'll
call you when I get stronger!
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.et:
Lahe! See on esimene kaotus tükil ajal!
Hei, anna mulle oma telefoninumber.
Sinuga oleks lõbus võidelda, seega
helistan, kui tugevamaks saan!

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.en:
Hey, give me your phone number.
You'd be fun to battle, so I'll
call you when I get stronger!
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.et:
Hei, anna mulle oma telefoninumber.
Sinuga oleks lõbus võidelda, seega
helistan, kui tugevamaks saan!

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.et: Hei! Su telefon on juba täis!

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyRematchText
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.en: Hey! I'm tired of waiting for you!

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyPackFullText
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.en: Oh… Your PACK's full. I'll give it to you later.
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.et: Oh… Su PACK on täis. Annan selle hiljem.

data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.label: HueyRematchGiftText
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.en:
Man! You're as tough as ever!
I've battled you over and over, but
<PLAYER>, I haven't won once.
I bought tons of items to toughen
up my #MON, but to no avail…
Items alone aren't the answer.
That must be what it is…
Here, take this, <PLAYER>.
I won't be needing it anymore…
data/phone/text/huey_overworld.asm::Huey.et:
Mees! Oled sama kõva kui alati!
Olen sinuga aina võidelnud, aga
<PLAYER>, pole korragi võitnud.
Ostsin hunniku esemeid, et oma
#MONe kõvendada, aga asjata…
Ainult esemetest ei piisa.
See peab olema see…
Säh, võta see, <PLAYER>.
Mul pole seda enam vaja…

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinH.label: IrwinHangUpText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinH.en:
I hate having to hang up on you!
Call you later!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinH.et:
Vihkan sulle kõne lõpetamist!
Helistan hiljem!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.label: IrwinRocketTakeoverRumorText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.en:
<PLAY_G>, have you heard?
GOLDENROD's RADIO TOWER has been
taken over by TEAM ROCKET!
…Um… What's TEAM ROCKET?
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.et:
<PLAY_G>, kas oled kuulnud?
GOLDENRODI RADIO TOWERI on
üle võtnud RAKETI KAMP!
…Öö… Mis on RAKETI KAMP?

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinP.label: IrwinPlainBadgeGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinP.en:
<PLAY_G>, I heard!
You defeated that WHITNEY?
It makes me proud to be your friend!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinP.et:
<PLAY_G>, kuulsin!
Alistasid selle WHITNEY?
Sind sõbraks pidada teeb mind uhkeks!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinJ.label: IrwinJasmineReturnedGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinJ.en:
Hey, I heard about you!
You saved that #MON at the
LIGHTHOUSE, didn't you?
<PLAY_G>, I wish you'd come see me
when I'm sick in bed with a cold!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinJ.et:
Hei, kuulsin sinust!
Päästsid selle #MONi
TULETORNIS, eks?
<PLAY_G>, sooviksin, et tuleksid mind
vaatama, kui olen nohuga voodis!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.label: IrwinRocketHideoutGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.en:
I heard, I heard, I heard!
You smashed TEAM ROCKET's hideout!
You're like a movie hero, even!
But um… What was TEAM ROCKET?
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.et:
Kuulsin, kuulsin, kuulsin!
Purustasid RAKETI KAMBA peidiku!
Oled nagu filmikangelane!
Aga öö… Mis oli RAKETI KAMP?

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.label: IrwinRadioTowerGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.en:
I heard, I heard, I heard!
About your heroic liberation of the
RADIO TOWER! You rock so hard!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.et:
Kuulsin, kuulsin, kuulsin!
Sinu kangelaslikust RADIO TOWERI
vabastamisest! Sa oled nii vinge!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.label: IrwinRisingBadgeGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.en:
I saw, I saw!
I saw you go into the DRAGON'S DEN!
I'm certain you passed! Aww, no
need to be modest! You can't fail!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinR.et:
Nägin, nägin!
Nägin sind DRAGON'S DENI minemas!
Olen kindel, et läbisid! Ohh, pole
vaja tagasihoidlik olla! Sa ei saa läbi kukkuda!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinE.label: IrwinEliteFourGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinE.en:
Yesterday, I went out to NEW BARK
TOWN. There was a lady who looked a
lot like you, <PLAY_G>.
What? That lady was your mom?
Aww, I should've introduced myself!
I bet your mom's really proud of
all that you've accomplished.
Heh, put it this way. I'd be proud
if I were your mom, believe me!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinE.et:
Eile käisin NEW BARK TOWNIS.
Seal oli daam, kes nägi väga
sinu moodi välja, <PLAY_G>.
Mida? See daam oli su ema?
Ohh, oleksin pidanud end tutvustama!
Vean kihla, et su ema on väga uhke
kõige üle, mis oled saavutanud.
Heh, ütleme nii. Kui oleksin su ema,
oleksin uhke, usu mind!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinV.label: IrwinVermilionCityGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinV.en:
I saw, I saw, I saw!
You striding onto a ship, <PLAY_G>!
I can't get over how good you look
with the sea as your backdrop!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinV.et:
Nägin, nägin, nägin!
Kuidas astusid laevale, <PLAY_G>!
Ei saa üle sellest, kui hea sa
välja näed meri taustal!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinT.label: IrwinTrainPassGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinT.en:
I heard, I heard!
You got a MAGNET TRAIN PASS!
When I saw you departing on the
ship, I felt sad that I wouldn't be
able to see you for a while.
But since you have that PASS, you can
zip back anytime! That's reassuring!
What? You can FLY back anytime?
What do you mean by FLY?
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinT.et:
Kuulsin, kuulsin!
Said MAGNETRONGI PASSI!
Kui nägin sind laevaga lahkumas,
tundsin kurbust, et ei saa sind
mõnda aega näha.
Aga selle PASSIGA saad tagasi
vurada igal ajal! See on rahustav!
Mida? Saad FLYga tagasi igal ajal?
Mida sa mõtled FLY all?

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.label: IrwinSnorlaxGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.en:
I saw, I saw!
You waking up SNORLAX!
I was watching you from afar, so I
couldn't tell what you did exactly.
Did you play a flute to wake it?
Wow! That's like magic!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.et:
Nägin, nägin!
Kuidas SNORLAXi äratasid!
Vaatasin sind kaugelt, seega ei
suutnud öelda, mida täpselt tegid.
Kas mängisid flööti, et see äratada?
Vau! See on nagu maagia!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.label: IrwinMtSilverGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.en:
I hear rumors about you all over the place.
It just makes me sigh, <PLAY_G>.
How did you get so strong?
Go for the world championship now!
I'll always be cheering you on!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.et:
Kuulen sinust kuuldusi kõikjal.
See paneb mind ohkama, <PLAY_G>.
Kuidas sa nii tugevaks said?
Mine nüüd maailmameistriks!
Ma hoian sulle alati pöialt!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinC.label: IrwinCalledRightAwayText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinC.en:
Hehe, I called right away!
I think we can be good friends!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinC.et:
Hehe, helistasin kohe!
Arvan, et meist saavad head sõbrad!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinF.label: IrwinFogBadgeGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinF.en:
I saw, I heard!
You beat MORTY of ECRUTEAK GYM!
Th-that's just incredible!
I actually went to the GYM's entrance
to cheer you on. Did you know that?
But everyone was floating, and
there were ghosts all over! So I
chickened out and took off for home…
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinF.et:
Nägin, kuulsin!
Alistasid ECRUTEAKI SAALI MORTY!
S-see on lihtsalt uskumatu!
Käisin isegi SAALI sissepääsu juures
sind ergutamas. Kas teadsid seda?
Aga kõik hõljusid ja kõikjal
oli kummitusi! Nii et kartsin
ära ja pistsin koju…

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.label: IrwinMarshBadgeGossipText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.en:
<PLAY_G>, I heard!
You're kicking up a mighty ruckus
over in KANTO! What a glorious
rampage it must be!
You so rock!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinM.et:
<PLAY_G>, kuulsin!
Kisud KANTOS kõva kära üles!
Milline suurepärane möll see
olla peab!
Sa oled nii vinge!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinY.label: IrwinYourEscapadesRockText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinY.en:
Hearing about your escapades rocks my
soul! It sure does!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinY.et:
Sinu seiklustest kuulmine paneb mu
hinge rõkkama! Tõesti!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinG.label: IrwinGoodMatchText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinG.en:
I'm so glad you called!
I was just about to call you too!
I guess we must be a good match!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinG.et:
Nii hea, et helistasid!
Kavatsesin ka just sulle helistada!
Vist oleme hea paar!

data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.label: IrwinSoMuchToChatAboutText
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.en:
How are you?
What are you doing?
Where are you?
How many BADGES do you have now?
How much money have you saved?
How's your mom?
Have you got lots of #MON?
Is it going to be sunny tomorrow?
Arrgh, there's so much I want to
chat about! This is going nowhere!
data/phone/text/irwin_caller.asm::IrwinS.et:
Kuidas läheb?
Mida sa teed?
Kus sa oled?
Mitu MÄRKI sul nüüd on?
Kui palju raha oled kogunud?
Kuidas su emal läheb?
Kas sul on palju #MONe?
Kas homme tuleb päikeseline?
Arrgh, on nii palju, millest tahan
vestelda! See ei vii kuhugi!

data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.label: IrwinAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.en:
You're the best I've ever battled!
Huh? You're the one who saved all the SLOWPOKE?
Well, no wonder I couldn't beat you!
Would it be OK to get your number?
I don't want to miss anything you do from now on!
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.et:
Oled parim, kellega olen võidelnud!
Häh? Sina päästsid kõik SLOWPOKED?
Pole ime, et ma sind alistada ei suutnud!
Kas võiksin su numbri saada?
Ei taha midagi, mida teed, mööda lasta!

data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.label: IrwinAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.en: You will tell me your phone number?

data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.label: IrwinNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.en:
Wow! Gee, thanks! Now I can call you
anytime, whether anything's up or
not. You know, just to chat!
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.et:
Vau! Ohh, aitäh! Nüüd saan sulle
helistada igal ajal, olgu midagi
lahti või mitte. Lihtsalt niisama vestlema!

data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.label: IrwinNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.en:
Oh, but… I'm not dangerous!
I just want to call and chat
about everything and nothing!
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.et:
Oh, aga… Ma pole ohtlik!
Tahan lihtsalt helistada ja vestelda
kõigest ja mitte millestki!

data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.label: IrwinPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.en:
Your phone list is already full…
You must be really popular…
data/phone/text/irwin_overworld.asm::Irw.et:
Su telefoninimekiri on juba täis…
Sa pead olema tõesti populaarne…

data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackAns.label: JackAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackAns.en:
Hello. This is {RAM}…
How's it going, <PLAY_G>?

data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.label: JackGreetText
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, good morning!
It's me, {RAM}. How are you doing?
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere hommikust!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kuidas läheb?

data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.label: JackGreetDayText
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, howdy!
It's me, {RAM}. Isn't it nice out?
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tervist!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kas pole väljas kena?

data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.label: JackGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, good evening!
It's me, {RAM}. Got a minute?
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere õhtust!
See olen mina, {RAM}. On sul hetk?

data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGen.label: JackGenericText
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGen.en:
How are your #MON doing?
My {RAM} is so curious, it's a
problem. Maybe it's like me…
data/phone/text/jack_callee.asm::JackGen.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mu {RAM} on nii uudishimulik, et
probleem. Ehk on ta minusarnane…

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackInt.label: JackIntelligenceKeepsRisingText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackInt.en:
My {RAM}'s intelligence keeps
rising. It might be smarter than yours!
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackInt.et:
Mu {RAM} intelligentsus aina
tõuseb. See võib olla targem kui sinu oma!

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackDef.label: JackDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackDef.en:
The other day, I easily defeated a {RAM}.
I think swapping tips with you is starting to help.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackDef.et:
Teisel päeval alistasin kergesti {RAM}.
Arvan, et nõuannete vahetamine sinuga hakkab aitama.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackLos.label: JackLostAMonText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackLos.en:
Oh, and listen. I missed catching
a {RAM} by just a tiny bit.
If I'd been a bit more informed, I'm
sure I would've caught it…
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackLos.et:
Oh, ja kuula. Jäin {RAM}
püüdmisest ilma vaid natukene.
Kui oleksin veidi rohkem teadnud,
oleksin selle kindlasti püüdnud…

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackBat.label: JackBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackBat.en:
Do you want to battle? I'll show
you how to battle logically.
I'll be in {RAM}.
Give me a shout if you're nearby.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackBat.et:
Tahad võidelda? Näitan sulle,
kuidas loogiliselt võidelda.
Olen {RAM}.
Hõika, kui oled lähedal.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackThu.label: JackThunderTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackThu.en:
Did you know?
When it's raining, THUNDER is sure to strike.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackThu.et:
Kas teadsid?
Kui sajab, tabab THUNDER kindlasti.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRol.label: JackRolloutTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRol.en:
Did you know…?
If you use DEFENSE CURL, ROLLOUT's
power goes way up past normal.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRol.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui kasutad DEFENSE CURLi, tõuseb
ROLLOUTI jõud tavalisest palju kõrgemaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSol.label: JackSolarbeamTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSol.en:
Did you know…?
If the sunlight is harsh, SOLARBEAM
doesn't need to be charged up.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSol.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui päike on kõrvetav, ei pea
SOLARBEAMi laadima.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSto.label: JackStompTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSto.en:
Did you know…?
If the opponent uses MINIMIZE,
your STOMP becomes more powerful.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSto.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui vastane kasutab MINIMIZE,
muutub su STOMP võimsamaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackGus.label: JackGustTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackGus.en:
Did you know…?
If your opponent is FLYing, your
GUST becomes much more powerful.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackGus.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui vastane kasutab FLYd, muutub su
GUST palju võimsamaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackTwi.label: JackTwisterTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackTwi.en:
Did you know…?
If your opponent is FLYing, your
TWISTER becomes more powerful.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackTwi.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui vastane kasutab FLYd, muutub su
TWISTER võimsamaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackEar.label: JackEarthquakeTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackEar.en:
Did you know…?
If your opponent uses DIG, your
EARTHQUAKE becomes more powerful.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackEar.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui vastane kasutab DIGi, muutub su
EARTHQUAKE võimsamaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackMag.label: JackMagnitudeTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackMag.en:
Did you know…?
If your opponent uses DIG, your
MAGNITUDE becomes more powerful.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackMag.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui vastane kasutab DIGi, muutub su
MAGNITUDE võimsamaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSan.label: JackSandstormTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSan.en:
Did you know…?
The rock, ground and steel types
can't be hurt by SANDSTORM.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSan.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kivi-, maa- ja teras-tüüpe
ei saa SANDSTORM haavata.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSun.label: JackSunnyDayTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSun.en:
Did you know…?
If the sunlight is harsh, water-type
moves become much weaker.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackSun.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui päike on kõrvetav, muutuvad
vee-rünnakud palju nõrgemaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRai.label: JackRainDanceTriviaText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRai.en:
Did you know…?
When it's raining, fire-type moves
become much weaker than usual.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRai.et:
Kas teadsid…?
Kui sajab, muutuvad tule-rünnakud
tavalisest palju nõrgemaks.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackHea.label: JackHeardSomeGreatTipsText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackHea.en:
My friend heard some great tips.
He's going to let me in on some.
When he tells me, I'll call right away and tell you.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackHea.et:
Mu sõber kuulis suurepäraseid nippe.
Ta jagab mõnda minuga.
Kui ta räägib, helistan kohe ja räägin sulle.

data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRem.label: JackReminderText
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRem.en:
Hey, <PLAY_G>!
Do you remember your promise?
We have to battle soon!
I'll be at {RAM}.
data/phone/text/jack_caller.asm::JackRem.et:
Hei, <PLAY_G>!
Kas mäletad oma lubadust?
Peame varsti võitlema!
Olen {RAM}.

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en:
Your knowledge is impressive!
I like that!
Want to trade battle tips?
I'll phone if I get good info.
Would you tell me your number?
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.et:
Su teadmised on muljetavaldavad!
Mulle meeldib see!
Tahad lahingunippe vahetada?
Helistan, kui saan head infot.
Kas ütleksid mulle oma numbri?

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en:
Want to trade battle tips?
I'll phone if I get good info.
Would you tell me your number?
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.et:
Tahad lahingunippe vahetada?
Helistan, kui saan head infot.
Kas ütleksid mulle oma numbri?

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en: I'll call you if I hear anything!

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en:
Oh, OK. Too bad…
Well, if you ever want my number, come see me, OK?
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.et:
Oh, OK. Kahju…
Noh, kui tahad mu numbrit, tule mind vaatama, eks?

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en:
Oh? Your phone's full.
It can't register my number.
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.et:
Oh? Su telefon on täis.
See ei saa mu numbrit salvestada.

data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.label: JackRematchText
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.en:
Hi, I was waiting for you to show!
Let's get started right away!
data/phone/text/jack_overworld.asm::Jack.et:
Tere, ootasin, et ilmuksid!
Alustame kohe!

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} here!
Oh, <PLAYER>? You doing well?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} here!
Oh, <PLAYER>? You doing well?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyAns.en:
Hi, {RAM} here!
Oh, <PLAYER>? You doing well?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.label: JoeyGreetText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! How're you doing?
This is {RAM}, got a minute?
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Kuidas läheb?
Siin {RAM}, on sul hetk?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.label: JoeyGreetDayText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! How's it going?
This is {RAM}. Got a minute?
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Kuidas läheb?
Siin {RAM}. On sul hetk?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.label: JoeyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.en:
Yo, <PLAYER>! How're you doing?
This is {RAM}, got a minute?
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGre.et:
Jou, <PLAYER>! Kuidas läheb?
Siin {RAM}, on sul hetk?

data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGen.label: JoeyGenericText
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGen.en:
How are your #MON doing?
My {RAM}'s raring to go, just like always.
It's the only one I have. I'm going
to become a great trainer with it!
data/phone/text/joey_callee.asm::JoeyGen.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mu {RAM} on minekuvalmis, nagu alati.
See on mu ainus. Saan sellega
suureks treeneriks!

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyMon.label: JoeyMonLookingSharperText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyMon.en:
My {RAM}'s looking sharper than before!
I doubt there's a #MON as cool as
this guy in your party!
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyMon.et:
Mu {RAM} näeb teravam kui varem!
Kahtlen, kas su seltskonnas on nii
lahedat #MONi kui see semu!

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDef.label: JoeyDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDef.en:
Oh yeah, I took down a {RAM}
in the wild the other day.
It was a cakewalk. Well, I guess it
can't be helped, us being so tough.
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDef.et:
Ah jaa, alistasin teisel päeval
metsiku {RAM}.
Oli käkitegu. Noh, pole midagi
teha, oleme nii kõvad.

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyLos.label: JoeyLostAMonText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyLos.en:
Oh yeah, I saw a wild {RAM}!
I thought about going for it, but
I decided to work with my one-and-
only right to the extreme end.
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyLos.et:
Ah jaa, nägin metsikut {RAM}!
Mõtlesin selle püüdmisele, aga
otsustasin oma ainsa ja
ainukesega lõpuni minna.

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyBat.label: JoeyBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyBat.en:
Let's get together and battle!
I promise things will be different!
{RAM}'s where I'll be.
Give me a shout when you come.
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyBat.et:
Saame kokku ja võitleme!
Luban, et seekord on teisiti!
Olen {RAM}.
Hõika, kui tuled.

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDev.label: JoeyDevisingStrategiesText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDev.en:
I'm checking out {RAM}'s moves
and devising some strategies.
When I come up with a good one, let's battle!
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyDev.et:
Uurin {RAM} rünnakuid ja
mõtlen välja strateegiaid.
Kui hea leian, siis võitleme!

data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyRem.label: JoeyReminderText
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyRem.en:
What's keeping you, <PLAYER>!
Let's get down and battle already!
I'm waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/joey_caller.asm::JoeyRem.et:
Mis sind kinni peab, <PLAYER>!
Hakkame juba võitlema!
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en:
Listen, can I get your phone number?
I'll ring you for some battles.
I'm a rookie too, so I think it'd be a good motivator.
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et:
Kuula, kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?
Helistan mõne lahingu jaoks.
Olen ka algaja, seega arvan, et see oleks hea motivaator.

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en:
Can I get your phone number?
I don't want to lose against you!
We have to battle again, OK?
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et:
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?
Ei taha sulle kaotada!
Peame uuesti võitlema, eks?

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en: I'll ring you whenever I get the urge to battle!
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et: Helistan alati, kui tekib võitlemise isu!

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en:
Oh, all right…
But I won't lose to you again!
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et:
Oh, hea küll…
Aga ma ei kaota sulle enam!

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et: Häh, mida? Su telefon on täis.

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyRematchText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en: I've been waiting! Let's battle now!

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyPackFullText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en:
Hey, wait! Your PACK is stuffed!
Well, we'll leave it till next time.
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et:
Hei, oota! Su PACK on täis!
Noh, jätame järgmise korrani.

data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.label: JoeyRematchGiftText
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.en:
And yet another loss…
No doubt about it--you're tough.
Being beaten this often actually feels good now!
Here, take this. Use it to get even
tougher. That will toughen me up too!
data/phone/text/joey_overworld.asm::Joey.et:
Ja veel üks kaotus…
Pole kahtlust - sa oled kõva.
Nii tihti kaotamine on nüüd päris hea tunne!
Säh, võta see. Kasuta, et saada veel
kõvemaks. See teeb ka minu kõvemaks!

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseAns.label: JoseAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>? Good morning!

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseAns.label: JoseAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseAns.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh, <PLAY_G>? Good evening!

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.label: JoseGreetText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.et:
Oh, <PLAY_G>?
Säuts! Jah, see olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.label: JoseGreetDayText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.et:
Oh, <PLAY_G>?
Säuts! Jah, see olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.label: JoseGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGre.et:
Oh, <PLAY_G>?
Säuts! Jah, see olen mina, {RAM}.

data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGen.label: JoseGenericText
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGen.en:
Are your #MON still cooking?
My {RAM} has too much energy.
Once it takes off, it won't come back for a while.
data/phone/text/jose_callee.asm::JoseGen.et:
Kas su #MONid ikka podisevad?
Mu {RAM} on liiga energiline.
Kui see minema läheb, ei tule mõnda aega tagasi.

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseMon.label: JoseMonsStickHasADeliciousAromaText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseMon.en:
Hey listen, my {RAM}'s stick
has this really delicious aroma.
That aroma gets my appetite going!
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseMon.et:
Hei, kuula, mu {RAM} pulgal
on tõesti maitsev aroom.
See aroom paneb mu isu käima!

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseDef.label: JoseDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseDef.en:
A while ago, my FARFETCH'D KO'd this {RAM}.
You should have seen FARFETCH'D
wield that stick. Amazing stuff!
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseDef.et:
Mõni aeg tagasi alistas mu FARFETCH'D selle {RAM}.
Oleksid pidanud nägema, kuidas FARFETCH'D
seda pulka käsitses. Hämmastav!

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseLos.label: JoseLostAMonText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseLos.en:
I ran into a wild {RAM}…
I was trying to catch it, but it
took off faster than I thought it
would. It was a bit disappointing.
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseLos.et:
Sattusin metsiku {RAM} otsa…
Üritasin seda püüda, aga see
pages kiiremini, kui arvasin.
Oli pisut pettumus.

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseBat.label: JoseBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseBat.en:
Want to battle again?
For some reason, my FARFETCH'D is
all worked up and raring to go.
{RAM}'s where I'm at.
Keep an eye out for me, OK?
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseBat.et:
Tahad uuesti võidelda?
Mingil põhjusel on mu FARFETCH'D
üleni erutatud ja minekuvalmis.
Olen {RAM}.
Hoia mind silmas, eks?

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseFou.label: JoseFoundItemText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseFou.en:
My FARFETCH'D had something pretty in its beak.
Like I promised, you can have it.
Catch up to me on {RAM},
and I'll let you have it.
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseFou.et:
Mu FARFETCH'D-l oli nokas midagi ilusat.
Nagu lubasin, võid selle saada.
Jõua mulle järele {RAM}
ja annan selle sulle.

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseHav.label: JoseHaventGottenItemYetText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseHav.en:
I haven't gotten what I promised you yet.
I'll call you as soon as I get it,
so could you wait a little longer?
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseHav.et:
Pole veel saanud, mida lubasin.
Helistan kohe, kui saan,
seega kas ootaksid veel veidi?

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseRem.label: JoseReminderText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseRem.en:
<PLAY_G>, could you hurry over?
FARFETCH'D is agitated.
If you don't come soon, it might
smack me with its stick!
{RAM}!
Please come as soon as you can!
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseRem.et:
<PLAY_G>, kas saaksid kiirustada?
FARFETCH'D on erutatud.
Kui sa varsti ei tule, võib see
mind pulgaga virutada!
{RAM}!
Tule palun nii ruttu kui saad!

data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseCom.label: JoseComePickUpText
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseCom.en:
What's wrong?
Don't you want this gift?
Catch up to me on {RAM},
and I'll let you have it.
data/phone/text/jose_caller.asm::JoseCom.et:
Mis lahti?
Kas sa ei taha seda kingitust?
Jõua mulle järele {RAM}
ja annan selle sulle.

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en:
If my {RAM} sees anything
pretty, it goes and gets it.
Do you like pretty things?
I could share if it gets some more.
What's your phone number? I'll call.
Don't expect a whole lot, OK?
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et:
Kui mu {RAM} näeb midagi ilusat,
läheb ja võtab selle.
Kas sulle meeldivad ilusad asjad?
Võiksin jagada, kui see rohkem saab.
Mis su telefoninumber on? Helistan.
Ära oota kuigi palju, eks?

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en:
Do you like pretty things?
I could share if FARFETCH'D goes and gets more.
What's your phone number? I'll call.
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et:
Kas sulle meeldivad ilusad asjad?
Võiksin jagada, kui FARFETCH'D rohkem toob.
Mis su telefoninumber on? Helistan.

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en: I'll call you as soon as I get something pretty.
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et: Helistan kohe, kui saan midagi ilusat.

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en: You sure? Well, tell me if you change your mind.
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et: Oled kindel? Noh, ütle, kui ümber mõtled.

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JosePhoneFullText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en: Huh? Your phone list is full.

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseRematchText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en:
Tweet! Tweeeet!
Kept me waiting! Go, FARFETCH'D!
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et:
Säuts! Säuuuts!
Panid mind ootama! Mine, FARFETCH'D!

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JoseGiftText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en:
Kept me waiting! Look, this is it!
See? Isn't it some kind of pretty?
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et:
Panid mind ootama! Näe, see on see!
Näed? Kas pole omamoodi ilus?

data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.label: JosePackFullText
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.en:
Huh? You don't have anywhere to
put this. Better come back for it.
data/phone/text/jose_overworld.asm::Jose.et:
Häh? Sul pole kuhugi seda panna.
Parem tule selle järele tagasi.

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiR.label: KenjiRemainDedicatedText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiR.en:
Are you still on your journey?
I remain dedicated to my training.
Oooooaaarrrgh!
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiR.et:
Kas oled ikka teekonnal?
Mina jään oma treeningule pühendunuks.
Oooooaaarrrgh!

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiC.label: KenjiCallMeBackAnotherTimeText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiC.en:
I'm in training now. I apologize,
but call me back another time.
Oooooaaarrrgh!
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiC.et:
Olen nüüd treeningul. Vabandan,
aga helista mulle teisel korral.
Oooooaaarrrgh!

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiI.label: KenjiIllHaveTimeToChatTomorrowText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiI.en:
I apologize, but I don't have time to
chat while I am in training!
I'll have time to chat tomorrow!
Yiiihah!
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiI.et:
Vabandan, aga mul pole aega
vestelda, kui olen treeningul!
Mul on aega vestelda homme!
Jiiihaa!

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.label: KenjiHangUpMorningText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.en:
I plan to take a lunch break, so
come see me then! Ayiiiyah!
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.et:
Kavatsen lõunapausi teha, seega
tule mind siis vaatama! Aijiiijaa!

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiT.label: KenjiTakingABreakText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiT.en:
I'm taking a break on ROUTE 45!
Why not drop by if you are free?
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiT.et:
Teen pausi ROUTE 45-l!
Astu läbi, kui oled vaba!

data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.label: KenjiHangUpNightText
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.en:
I rested up over my lunch break.
Now it's time to resume training!
Oooryaah!
data/phone/text/kenji_caller.asm::KenjiH.et:
Puhkasin lõunapausil.
Nüüd on aeg treeningut jätkata!
Ooorjaah!

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en:
Our battle was remarkable!
I wish for something to remember you by!
Perhaps your phone number will do?
My training makes it impossible to chat much, but…
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et:
Meie lahing oli tähelepanuväärne!
Sooviksin midagi, mis sind meenutaks!
Ehk sobib su telefoninumber?
Mu treening ei luba palju vestelda, aga…

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en:
My training makes chatting tough,
but will you take down my number?
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et:
Mu treening teeb vestlemise raskeks,
aga kas kirjutaksid mu numbri üles?

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en: I must train harder to become the mightiest!
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et: Pean kõvemini treenima, et saada vägevaimaks!

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en: If you decide you want my number, come see me.
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et: Kui otsustad mu numbri tahta, tule mind vaatama.

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en:
Your phone appears to be full.
Come back later!
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et:
Su telefon näib olevat täis.
Tule hiljem tagasi!

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiGiftText
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en:
I wish to thank you, <PLAYER>!
I've been training all alone…
I was happy that you cared to call…
I want you to have this!
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et:
Tahan sind tänada, <PLAYER>!
Olen treeninud üksinda…
Olin rõõmus, et sa hoolisid ja helistasid…
Tahan, et sa selle saaksid!

data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.label: KenjiPackFullText
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.en:
Your strength will not let you carry
another thing! I will hold this
till you lighten your PACK!
data/phone/text/kenji_overworld.asm::Ken.et:
Su jõud ei luba sul veel üht
asja kanda! Hoian seda, kuni
kergendad oma PACKI!

data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizAnswe.label: LizAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizAnswe.en:
Hello, {RAM} speaking.
Oh, <PLAY_G>. How are you?

data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.label: LizGreetText
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.en:
Good morning, <PLAY_G>.
This is {RAM}. Were you sleeping?

data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.label: LizGreetDayText
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.en:
Hi, <PLAY_G>. This is {RAM}.
How are things going for you?
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.et:
Tere, <PLAY_G>. Siin {RAM}.
Kuidas sul asjad on?

data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.label: LizGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.en:
Good evening, <PLAY_G>.
This is {RAM}. Are you awake?
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGreet.et:
Tere õhtust, <PLAY_G>.
Siin {RAM}. Kas oled ärkvel?

data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGener.label: LizGenericText
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGener.en:
I had some time, so I called you.
