So anyway, how are your #MON?
Me, I take my {RAM} to the
#MON CENTER in VIOLET every day,
so it's doing just fantastic!
I'm friends with the receptionist!
data/phone/text/liz_callee.asm::LizGener.et:
Mul oli aega, seega helistasin.
Igatahes, kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mina viin oma {RAM} iga päev
VIOLETI #MON KESKUSESSE,
seega tal läheb suurepäraselt!
Olen administraatoriga sõber!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMonAl.label: LizMonAlwaysWantsToNuzzleText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMonAl.en:
Oh, you have to hear this.
My {RAM} is so adorable!
It always wants to nuzzle me!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMonAl.et:
Oh, seda pead kuulma.
Mu {RAM} on nii armas!
See tahab alati minu vastu hõõruda!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizDefea.label: LizDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizDefea.en:
And, and! Um…
We beat a wild {RAM} with
just one hit a little while ago.
We felt sorry for it, though.
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizDefea.et:
Ja, ja! Öö…
Alistasime veidi aja eest
metsiku {RAM} ühe löögiga.
Meil oli sellest siiski kahju.

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizLostA.label: LizLostAMonText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizLostA.en:
And, and! Uh…
We just saw a really gorgeous {RAM}.
But I was on the phone, so it got
away. It made us really angry!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizLostA.et:
Ja, ja! Öö…
Nägime just tõeliselt kaunist {RAM}.
Aga olin telefonis, seega see
pages. See ajas meid tõesti vihaseks!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBattl.label: LizBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBattl.en:
Hi! Do you have some free time?
I've got all sorts of time. If you're
free, would you like to battle?
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
Let me know when you get here!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBattl.et:
Tere! On sul vaba aega?
Mul on igasugust aega. Kui oled
vaba, tahaksid võidelda?
Ootan {RAM}.
Anna teada, kui kohale jõuad!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWrong.label: LizWrongNumberText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWrong.en:
Hi, TANIA. How are you? This is LIZ.
I'm fine, but I'm bored silly!
Huh… Wrong number? Oops! Sorry!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWrong.et:
Tere, TANIA. Kuidas läheb? Siin LIZ.
Mul on hästi, aga igav on hulluks minna!
Häh… Vale number? Uups! Vabandust!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRuins.label: LizRuinsOfAlphGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRuins.en:
Listen, listen!
I was listening to the radio in the
RUINS OF ALPH when an odd broadcast
suddenly cut it on the regular show.
I wonder what it was. So strange!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRuins.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kuulasin ALPHI VAREMETES raadiot,
kui imelik ülekanne äkki tavasaate
katkestas.
Huvitav, mis see oli. Nii imelik!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFalkn.label: LizFalknerGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFalkn.en:
Listen, listen!
Don't you think FALKNER of VIOLET
GYM is cool and handsome?
But they say his dad, who's out
training on the road, is even more
cool and handsome than FALKNER.
I wish I could meet him!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFalkn.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kas sa ei arva, et VIOLETI SAALI
FALKNER on lahe ja nägus?
Aga öeldakse, et ta isa, kes on
teel treenimas, on veelgi lahedam
ja nägusam kui FALKNER.
Sooviksin temaga kohtuda!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizEarlG.label: LizEarlGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizEarlG.en:
Listen, listen!
Do you know EARL, the teacher who
runs the #MON ACADEMY in VIOLET?
I saw him doing pirouettes while
he was running. It was wildly funny!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizEarlG.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kas tunned EARLi, õpetajat, kes
peab VIOLETI #MON AKADEEMIAT?
Nägin teda joostes piruette tegemas.
See oli metsikult naljakas!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSurfP.label: LizSurfPikachuGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSurfP.en:
Listen, listen!
I collect #MON plush dolls.
But I can't seem to get a hold of a
SURF PIKACHU DOLL. None of my friends
have it. It must be totally rare!
You could really brag about it if you had one.
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSurfP.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kogun #MON kaisunukke.
Aga ma ei suuda kuidagi saada
SURF PIKACHU NUKKU. Ühelgi sõbral
seda pole. See peab olema üliharuldane!
Saaksid sellega tõesti uhkeldada, kui see oleks.

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMooMo.label: LizMooMooMilkGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMooMo.en:
Listen, listen!
Do you know about MOOMOO MILK?
You can buy it at MOOMOO FARM.
It's supposed to be good for health
and beauty. I really want to
try some. I bet it's delicious!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizMooMo.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kas tead MOOMOO MILKist?
Seda saab osta MOOMOO FARMIST.
See olevat hea tervisele ja
iludusele. Tahan tõesti proovida.
Vean kihla, et see on maitsev!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSalon.label: LizSalonGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSalon.en:
Listen, listen!
There's a #MON SALON in GOLDENROD
that's run by two brothers.
The older brother is good, but the
younger one really isn't.
But sometimes the younger one does a
better job than his brother.
Every time I go, I have a hard time
trying to decide whom I should use…
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizSalon.et:
Kuula, kuula!
GOLDENRODIS on #MON SALONG,
mida peavad kaks venda.
Vanem vend on hea, aga noorem
tõesti mitte.
Aga vahel teeb noorem
paremat tööd kui ta vend.
Iga kord, kui lähen, on mul raske
otsustada, keda kasutada…

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWhitn.label: LizWhitneyGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWhitn.en:
Listen, listen!
GOLDENROD GYM's WHITNEY began
battling only a little while ago!
But the #MON LEAGUE chose her as a GYM LEADER!
I bet she must be totally talented.
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizWhitn.et:
Kuula, kuula!
GOLDENRODI SAALI WHITNEY hakkas
võitlema alles hiljuti!
Aga #MON LIIGA valis ta SAALI JUHIKS!
Vean kihla, et ta on tõesti andekas.

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBugCa.label: LizBugCatchingContestGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBugCa.en:
Listen, listen!
Have you ever taken part in a
Bug-Catching Contest at the NATIONAL PARK?
I did once, but all I could catch was a CATERPIE.
But guess what!
I won with that CATERPIE. Isn't that great?
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBugCa.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Kas oled kunagi osalenud
putukapüügivõistlusel NATIONAL PARGIS?
Osalesin kord, aga püüdsin vaid CATERPIE.
Aga kujuta ette!
Võitsin selle CATERPIEGA. Kas pole tore?

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBeaut.label: LizBeautifulTrainerGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBeaut.en:
Listen, listen!
I saw a beautiful {RAM}!
I wish I could become a beautiful {RAM} too.
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizBeaut.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Nägin kaunist {RAM}!
Sooviksin saada ka kauniks {RAM}.

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizForgo.label: LizForgotGossipText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizForgo.en:
Listen, listen!
Uh… Um… Whoops!
I forgot what I was going to say!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizForgo.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Öö… Öö… Uups!
Unustasin, mida öelda tahtsin!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFawni.label: LizFawningOverMonText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFawni.en:
Listen, listen!
My {RAM}… it… so pretty…
and… giggle… so awesome… yes… but…
very much… eeek! And… lovely…
Just ravishing… Oh, too much!
…Hug it… sleeping… That's right…
pretty… sigh… So nice… Cute…
…Oops! Look at the time! I chatted too long!
I'm sorry I took so much of your
time! I love chatting!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizFawni.et:
Kuula, kuula!
Mu {RAM}… see… nii ilus…
ja… kihel… nii vinge… jah… aga…
väga… iiik! Ja… armas…
Lihtsalt lummav… Oh, liig!
…Kallista seda… magab… Just nii…
ilus… ohh… Nii tore… Nunnu…
…Uups! Vaata aega! Vestlesin liiga kaua!
Vabandust, et võtsin nii palju su
aega! Armastan vestelda!

data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRemin.label: LizReminderText
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRemin.en:
I've got too much time on my hands!
Let's battle right away!
I'll be waiting on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/liz_caller.asm::LizRemin.et:
Mul on liiga palju vaba aega!
Võitleme kohe!
Ootan {RAM}!

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.label: LizAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.en:
Oh? You're on a big journey to see the sights? Neat!
Let's be friends! Can I have your phone number?
I want to hear about everything you've seen!
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.et:
Oh? Oled suurel teekonnal vaatamisväärsusi vaatamas? Vahva!
Olgem sõbrad! Kas saan su telefoninumbri?
Tahan kuulda kõigest, mida oled näinud!

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.label: LizAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.en:
Let's be friends! Can I have your phone number?
I want to hear about everything you've seen!
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizAs.et:
Olgem sõbrad! Kas saan su telefoninumbri?
Tahan kuulda kõigest, mida oled näinud!

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.label: LizNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.en: I'll telephone you if I hear anything interesting.
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.et: Helistan sulle, kui kuulen midagi huvitavat.

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.label: LizNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.en: Aww… You won't be my friend?
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizNu.et: Ohh… Sa ei taha mu sõber olla?

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizPh.label: LizPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizPh.en: Wait! Your phone list is filled up!

data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizRe.label: LizRematchText
data/phone/text/liz_overworld.asm::LizRe.en: You're late! Let's get started now!

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneLandmar.label: MomPhoneLandmarkText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneLandmar.et:
Oh, nii et oled {RAM}…
Kas mitte seal pole {RAM}?
Kas käisid vaatamas?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneGeneric.label: MomPhoneGenericAreaText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneGeneric.en:
Really, you're in {RAM}?
I've never gone there. That's kind of neat, <PLAYER>.
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneGeneric.et:
Tõesti, oled {RAM}?
Pole seal käinud. See on omamoodi vahva, <PLAYER>.

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNewBark.label: MomPhoneNewBarkText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNewBark.en:
What? You're in {RAM}?
Come see your MOM sometime!
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNewBark.et:
Mida? Oled {RAM}?
Tule millalgi oma EMA vaatama!

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneCherryg.label: MomPhoneCherrygroveText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneCherryg.en:
You're visiting {RAM}?
How about coming home for a bit?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneCherryg.et:
Külastad {RAM}?
Kuidas oleks korraks koju tulla?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomOtherAreaTex.label: MomOtherAreaText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomOtherAreaTex.en:
Wow, you're in {RAM}?
Good luck on your #MON quest!

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomDeterminedTe.label: MomDeterminedText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomDeterminedTe.en:
That sounds really tough.
But, <PLAYER>, I know you're really
determined. You'll be OK, right?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomDeterminedTe.et:
See kõlab tõesti raskelt.
Aga, <PLAYER>, ma tean, et oled
väga sihikindel. Sul saab hakkama, eks?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomCheckBalance.label: MomCheckBalanceText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomCheckBalance.en:
By the way, you've saved up ¥{RAM}.
Do you want to keep on saving?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomCheckBalance.et:
Muide, oled kogunud ¥{RAM}.
Kas tahad edasi koguda?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomImportantToS.label: MomImportantToSaveText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomImportantToS.en: It's important to save your money.

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYoureNotSavi.label: MomYoureNotSavingText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYoureNotSavi.en:
Oh, <PLAYER>, you're not saving
any money. Would you like to save?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYoureNotSavi.et:
Oh, <PLAYER>, sa ei kogu raha.
Kas tahaksid koguda?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYouveSavedTe.label: MomYouveSavedText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYouveSavedTe.en:
By the way, you've saved up ¥{RAM}.
Want to start saving again?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomYouveSavedTe.et:
Muide, oled kogunud ¥{RAM}.
Tahad uuesti koguma hakata?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneWontSav.label: MomPhoneWontSaveMoneyText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneWontSav.en: OK. I won't save your money.
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneWontSav.et: OK. Ma ei hoia su raha.

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneHangUpT.label: MomPhoneHangUpText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneHangUpT.en: <PLAYER>, keep it up! I'm rooting for you, baby!
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneHangUpT.et: <PLAYER>, jätka samas vaimus! Hoian sulle pöialt, kullake!

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPokem.label: MomPhoneNoPokemonText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPokem.en:
Hello?
Oh, hi, <PLAYER>! Wasn't PROF.ELM waiting for you?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPokem.et:
Halloo?
Oh, tere, <PLAYER>! Kas PROF.ELM ei oodanud sind?

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPoked.label: MomPhoneNoPokedexText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPoked.en:
Hello?
Oh, hi, <PLAYER>! You're on a big
mission for PROF. ELM? Be good!
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoPoked.et:
Halloo?
Oh, tere, <PLAYER>! Oled suurel
missioonil PROF. ELMILE? Ole tubli!

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoGymQu.label: MomPhoneNoGymQuestText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoGymQu.en:
Hello?
Hi, <PLAYER>! If you're done with
your errand come on home, dear.
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneNoGymQu.et:
Halloo?
Tere, <PLAYER>! Kui oled oma
asjatoimetuse lõpetanud, tule koju, kallis.

data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneLecture.label: MomPhoneLectureText
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneLecture.en:
Hello?
…… <PLAYER>? I heard from PROF.
ELM that you went on a long trip.
I wish you would have told me…
What about money? Should I save it?
data/phone/text/mom.asm::MomPhoneLecture.et:
Halloo?
…… <PLAYER>? Kuulsin PROF.
ELMILT, et läksid pikale reisile.
Sooviksin, et oleksid mulle öelnud…
Aga raha? Kas hoian selle?

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.label: ParryAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.en:
Yup, yup! It's {RAM}!
Hah, and here's <PLAY_G>!
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.et:
Jah, jah! Siin {RAM}!
Hah, ja siin on <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.label: ParryAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.en:
Yup, yup! It's {RAM}!
Hah, and here's <PLAY_G>!
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.et:
Jah, jah! Siin {RAM}!
Hah, ja siin on <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.label: ParryAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.en:
Yup, yup! It's {RAM}!
Hah, and here's <PLAY_G>!
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryA.et:
Jah, jah! Siin {RAM}!
Hah, ja siin on <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.label: ParryGreetText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.en:
<PLAY_G>, it's {RAM}!
Have you had a proper breakfast?

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.label: ParryGreetDayText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.en:
<PLAY_G>, it's {RAM}!
Have you had a proper lunch?

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.label: ParryGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.en:
<PLAY_G>, it's {RAM}!
Have you had a proper dinner?

data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.label: ParryGenericText
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.en:
Are your #MON looking good?
My {RAM} and me--we're looking
mighty dandy! Hahahah!
data/phone/text/parry_callee.asm::ParryG.et:
Kas su #MONid näevad head välja?
Mu {RAM} ja mina - näeme
üsna toredad välja! Hahahah!

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryN.label: ParryNothingCanMatchText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryN.et: Miski ei saa nüüd mu {RAM}-le vastu.

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryD.label: ParryDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryD.en:
Yeah, we KO'd a wild {RAM}!
That was OK, but I wanted to get it…
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryD.et:
Jah, alistasime metsiku {RAM}!
See oli OK, aga tahtsin selle püüda…

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryL.label: ParryLostAMonText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryL.en:
And yesterday, we spotted a wild
{RAM}. We were debating
whether to catch it or beat it.
When along came another guy who
caught it! How about that!
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryL.et:
Ja eile nägime metsikut
{RAM}. Arutasime, kas
seda püüda või alistada.
Siis tuli teine tüüp ja
püüdis selle! Kuidas selline!

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryB.label: ParryBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryB.en:
You're thinking you'd like to
battle me. Am I right or what?
Yep! We'll meet on {RAM}!
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryB.et:
Sa mõtled, et tahaksid minuga
võidelda. Kas mul on õigus?
Jah! Kohtume {RAM}!

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryH.label: ParryHangUpText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryH.en: OK, give me a call again!

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryB.label: ParryBattleWithMeText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryB.en: You'll battle with me again, right?

data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryH.label: ParryHaventYouGottenToText
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryH.en:
Haven't you gotten to {RAM}?
Waiting here isn't bad, but I'd sure like to battle!
data/phone/text/parry_caller.asm::ParryH.et:
Kas sa pole veel {RAM} jõudnud?
Siin oodata pole paha, aga tahaksin küll võidelda!

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
Sheesh, the way you attacked! That
was something! We should meet again!
How about giving me your number?
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Oih, kuidas sa ründasid! See
oli midagi! Peaksime uuesti kohtuma!
Kuidas oleks, kui annaksid mulle oma numbri?

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
So you want to register my phone
number for a rematch, huh?
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Nii et tahad mu telefoninumbri
tagasimatši jaoks salvestada, mis?

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en: I'll call you whenever I feel like battling!
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et: Helistan alati, kui tekib võitlemise tuju!

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
No? That's fine.
A definite no is easy to take!
I'll be right here when you're ready for a rematch.
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Ei? Pole viga.
Kindel ei on kerge vastu võtta!
Olen siin, kui oled tagasimatšiks valmis.

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en: Oh? There's no room to register my phone number.
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et: Oh? Mu telefoninumbri jaoks pole ruumi.

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryRematchText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
Hey, here comes the kid! Let's go!
Ready for my usual no-brainer, allout offense?
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Hei, siin tuleb poiss! Lähme!
Valmis mu tavaliseks lihtsaks täierünnakuks?

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryPackFullText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
Your PACK looks stuffed full!
You can't have this now.
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Su PACK näeb pilgeni täis!
Sa ei saa seda praegu.

data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.label: ParryRematchGiftText
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.en:
Well, you're special all right.
If only I'd begun #MON when I was a tad younger…
I want you to work and succeed for
the both of us. So take this, OK?
data/phone/text/parry_overworld.asm::Par.et:
Noh, sa oled ikka eriline.
Kui vaid oleksin #MONidega alustanud pisut nooremana…
Tahan, et sa töötaksid ja edeneksid
meie mõlema eest. Nii et võta see, eks?

data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.label: RalphAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.en:
Yes? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
You're courteous enough to state
your name when you call on the phone.
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.et:
Jah? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
Oled piisavalt viisakas, et helistades
oma nimi öelda.

data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.label: RalphAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.en:
Yes? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
You're courteous enough to state
your name when you call on the phone.
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.et:
Jah? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
Oled piisavalt viisakas, et helistades
oma nimi öelda.

data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.label: RalphAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.en:
Yes? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
You're courteous enough to state
your name when you call on the phone.
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphA.et:
Jah? Ah, <PLAY_G>.
Oled piisavalt viisakas, et helistades
oma nimi öelda.

data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphG.label: RalphGenericText
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphG.en:
Are you taking good care of your
#MON? You have to be good to your partners!
data/phone/text/ralph_callee.asm::RalphG.et:
Kas hoolitsed oma #MONide eest
hästi? Pead oma kaaslastele hea olema!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.label: RalphNeglectingKidsText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.en:
I've been spending more time with my
{RAM} than I have with my kids.
That's a bit sad, actually.
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.et:
Olen veetnud rohkem aega oma {RAM}-ga
kui oma lastega.
See on tegelikult pisut kurb.

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphD.label: RalphDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphD.en:
I just beat a wild {RAM}.
I told my kid, but he scoffed that he
could do the same thing easily.
Boy, has he gotten cocky…
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphD.et:
Alistasin just metsiku {RAM}.
Rääkisin oma lapsele, aga ta muigas,
et suudab sama kergesti.
Poiss, on ta ülbeks läinud…

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphL.label: RalphLostAMonText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphL.en:
Yesterday a wild {RAM} slipped
away from me, in front of my kid.
I was feeling down about it until he
shared his # BALLS with me.
Hahah, that sure made my day!
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphL.et:
Eile pages metsik {RAM} mul
käest, mu lapse silme all.
Olin sellest morn, kuni ta
jagas minuga oma # BALLE.
Hahah, see tegi mu päeva!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphB.label: RalphBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphB.en:
What do you say to a battle with me?
Good, you're going to do it!
For a kid, you're quite agreeable.
{RAM} is the spot!
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphB.et:
Mida ütled minuga võitlemisele?
Hea, sa teed seda!
Lapse kohta oled päris vastutulelik.
{RAM} on see koht!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphH.label: RalphHangUpText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphH.en: You call your mom sometimes too!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphI.label: RalphItemText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphI.en:
Listen, I… Yowch!
Uh, sorry! See, {RAM} are
biting like there is no tomorrow
over here on {RAM}!
Aiyee! Ouch! One jabbed me!
Heh, they're some kind of feisty!
<PLAY_G>, you have to see this rare
sight! Get ready to fish!
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphI.et:
Kuula, ma… Aih!
Öö, vabandust! Näed, {RAM}
näkkavad nagu hullud siin
{RAM}!
Aijee! Ai! Üks torkas mind!
Heh, on nad alles tigedad!
<PLAY_G>, sa pead seda haruldast
vaatepilti nägema! Valmistu püüdma!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.label: RalphNoItemText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.en:
Yeah, I know.
You're looking for rare #MON.
Recently, all I've been catching are MAGIKARP, though…
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphN.et:
Jah, ma tean.
Sa otsid haruldasi #MONe.
Hiljuti olen aga püüdnud vaid MAGIKARPi…

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphR.label: RalphReminderText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphR.en:
So where are you? I'm waiting for
you to show up on {RAM}.
You shouldn't make your elders wait!
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphR.et:
Nii et kus sa oled? Ootan, et
sa ilmuksid {RAM}.
Sa ei tohiks vanemaid oodata lasta!

data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphH.label: RalphHurryText
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphH.en:
Hey, what's the matter with you?
Aren't you coming over to fish for QWILFISH?
I'm on ROUTE 32, so hurry up!
data/phone/text/ralph_caller.asm::RalphH.et:
Hei, mis sul viga on?
Kas sa ei tule QWILFISHi püüdma?
Olen ROUTE 32-l, seega kiirusta!

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en:
Don't young people fish anymore?
I've seen rare #MON while I've been fishing…
You young people like that, right?
Want to trade phone numbers?
I'll let you know if I see anything.
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et:
Kas noored enam ei kala?
Olen kalastades näinud haruldasi #MONe…
Teile noortele meeldib see, eks?
Tahad numbreid vahetada?
Annan teada, kui midagi näen.

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en: Hm? So you do want me to phone if I see rare #MON?
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et: Hm? Nii et tahad, et helistaksin, kui näen haruldasi #MONe?

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en:
Yep, phone if I see rare #MON.
Don't worry, I won't forget!
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et:
Jah, helistan, kui näen haruldasi #MONe.
Ära muretse, ma ei unusta!

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en:
Oh… My own kids won't
even give me their phone numbers…
Is that how young people are today?
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et:
Oh… Mu enda lapsed ei anna
mulle isegi oma telefoninumbreid…
Kas noored on tänapäeval sellised?

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en:
Your phone's memory is full.
It seems that young people all have #GEAR.
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et:
Su telefoni mälu on täis.
Tundub, et noortel kõigil on #GEAR.

data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.label: RalphRematchText
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.en:
Hey, kid!
No losing for me this day!
data/phone/text/ralph_overworld.asm::Ral.et:
Hei, poiss!
Täna mina ei kaota!

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh. Hi, <PLAYER>. What's up?
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.et:
Tere, siin {RAM}…
Oh. Tere, <PLAYER>. Mis toimub?

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh, hi, <PLAYER>, what's up?
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.et:
Tere, siin {RAM}…
Oh, tere, <PLAYER>, mis toimub?

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh, hi, <PLAYER>, what's up?
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaA.et:
Tere, siin {RAM}…
Oh, tere, <PLAYER>, mis toimub?

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.label: ReenaGreetText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.en:
You're slow! Hurry up and answer!
It's me, {RAM}!
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.et:
Oled aeglane! Vasta juba!
See olen mina, {RAM}!

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.label: ReenaGreetDayText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.en:
You're slow! Hurry up and answer!
It's me, {RAM}!
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.et:
Oled aeglane! Vasta juba!
See olen mina, {RAM}!

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.label: ReenaGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.en:
You're slow! Hurry up and answer!
It's me, {RAM}!
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.et:
Oled aeglane! Vasta juba!
See olen mina, {RAM}!

data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.label: ReenaGenericText
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.en:
Hey, how are your #MON doing?
What? Great? I see…
What? My #MON?
Of course they're doing great! What
kind of a question is that?
data/phone/text/reena_callee.asm::ReenaG.et:
Hei, kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mida? Suurepäraselt? Ma näen…
Mida? Mu #MONid?
Muidugi läheb neil suurepäraselt! Mis
küsimus see selline on?

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaM.label: ReenaMonsIsAPerfectMatchText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaM.en:
Listen, dear…
Do you recall my {RAM}?
Yes, exactly. That lovely {RAM}.
Wouldn't you agree it's a perfect match for me?
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaM.et:
Kuula, kallis…
Kas mäletad mu {RAM}?
Jah, just. Seda armsat {RAM}.
Kas ei nõustu, et see sobib mulle ideaalselt?

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaD.label: ReenaDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaD.en:
Have I ever faced a wild {RAM}?
You need to ask?
{RAM} I've beaten on numerous occasions!
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaD.et:
Kas olen kunagi kohanud metsikut {RAM}?
Mida sa küsid?
{RAM} olen alistanud arvukalt kordi!

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaL.label: ReenaLostAMonText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaL.en:
Have I ever failed to catch a wild #MON?
You need to ask?
I would never fail to catch a wild
{RAM}… Oh! Never mind!
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaL.et:
Kas olen kunagi metsikut #MONi
püüdmata jätnud? Mida sa küsid?
Ma ei jätaks kunagi metsikut
{RAM} püüdmata… Oh! Pole tähtis!

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaB.label: ReenaBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaB.en:
We are going to battle!
The place shall be {RAM}!
Don't make me wait! Got it?
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaB.et:
Me hakkame võitlema!
Koht olgu {RAM}!
Ära pane mind ootama! Selge?

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaF.label: ReenaForwardText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaF.en:
Don't be too proud just because you
happened to beat me…
It was a fluke!
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaF.et:
Ära ole liiga uhke lihtsalt sellepärast,
et juhtusid mind alistama…
See oli juhus!

data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaH.label: ReenaHurryText
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaH.en:
What are you doing?
I told you that the place was
{RAM}! Don't try to run!
data/phone/text/reena_caller.asm::ReenaH.et:
Mida sa teed?
Ütlesin sulle, et koht on
{RAM}! Ära ürita põgeneda!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en:
Not bad… It's something to
beat me, even by an unlikely fluke…
I like you! Give me your number!
You can be my practice partner!
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.et:
Pole paha… Midagi on selles, et
mind alistada, kasvõi ebatõenäolise juhusega…
Sa meeldid mulle! Anna mulle oma number!
Võid olla mu harjutuspartner!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en:
Give me your phone number!
You are going to be my practice partner!
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.et:
Anna mulle oma telefoninumber!
Saad olema mu harjutuspartner!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en:
Don't be too proud about beating me!
It was a fluke!
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.et:
Ära ole liiga uhke mu alistamise üle!
See oli juhus!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en: I don't believe it! You're going to regret this!
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.et: Ma ei usu seda! Sa kahetsed seda!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en: What? Your phone list has no room!

data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.label: ReenaRematchText
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.en: What took you? Start right away!
data/phone/text/reena_overworld.asm::Ree.et: Mis sind kinni pidas? Alusta kohe!

data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.en:
Yes? This is {RAM}.
Oh, <PLAY_G>. Good morning.

data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.en:
Yes? This is {RAM}.
Oh, <PLAY_G>, good evening.

data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyGreetText
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.en:
Is this <PLAY_G>?
Good morning. This is {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.et:
Kas see on <PLAY_G>?
Tere hommikust. Siin {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.en:
Is this <PLAY_G>?
Good evening. This is {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.et:
Kas see on <PLAY_G>?
Tere õhtust. Siin {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyGenericText
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.en:
Are your #MON doing well?
I hope you take them to a #MON CENTER every day.
Don't push them too hard.
My {RAM} is cute and lively
precisely because I take it to a
#MON CENTER every day.
data/phone/text/tiffany_callee.asm::Tiff.et:
Kas su #MONidel läheb hästi?
Loodan, et viid nad iga päev #MON KESKUSESSE.
Ära suru neid liiga kõvasti.
Mu {RAM} on nunnu ja elav
täpselt seepärast, et viin selle
iga päev #MON KESKUSESSE.

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyMonIsAdorableText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
My {RAM}'s adorable, don't
you think so? I always sleep
with it--it's so fluffy and warm!
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Mu {RAM} on armas, kas ei
arva ka? Magan alati sellega -
see on nii kohev ja soe!

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
Oh, and we had to battle a wild
{RAM} a while ago…
My CLEFAIRY came close to fainting!
Isn't that awful?
I hate those nasty {RAM}!
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Oh, ja pidime veidi aja eest võitlema
metsiku {RAM}-ga…
Mu CLEFAIRY oleks peaaegu minestanud!
Kas pole kohutav?
Vihkan neid vastikuid {RAM}!

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyLostAMonText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
Oh, and we had to battle a wild
{RAM} a while ago…
My CLEFAIRY got frightened, so we
ran away as fast as we could!
I just can't help feeling protective of my CLEFAIRY.
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Oh, ja pidime veidi aja eest võitlema
metsiku {RAM}-ga…
Mu CLEFAIRY ehmus, seega
jooksime nii kiiresti kui saime minema!
Ma lihtsalt ei saa oma CLEFAIRYT kaitsmata jätta.

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
I know this might surprise you, but
would you like to battle?
I'll be waiting with CLEFAIRY on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Tean, et see võib sind üllatada, aga
tahaksid võidelda?
Ootan CLEFAIRYGA {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyItsAwfulText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
{RAM}!
It's awful. My CLEFAIRY…
Huh? <PLAY_G>?
Oh, sorry! I was in a hurry, and I…
I have to go! Bye-bye!
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
{RAM}!
See on kohutav. Mu CLEFAIRY…
Häh? <PLAY_G>?
Oh, vabandust! Mul oli kiire ja ma…
Pean minema! Head-aega!

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyFoundItemText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
I bought some PINK BOWS at GOLDENROD
DEPT.STORE for my CLEFAIRY.
I got too many, so I'll give you one!
Come collect it on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Ostsin GOLDENRODI KAUBAMAJAST
oma CLEFAIRYLE PINK BOWE.
Sain liiga palju, seega annan sulle ühe!
Tule võta see {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyNoItemText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en: I love dressing up my CLEFAIRY!

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyAsleepText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
What's wrong? Can't you visit?
CLEFAIRY got tired and fell asleep.
I'm not sure if I can wake it up…
Please hurry to {RAM}!
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Mis lahti? Kas sa ei saa tulla?
CLEFAIRY väsis ja jäi magama.
Ei tea, kas suudan selle äratada…
Kiirusta palun {RAM}!

data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.label: TiffanyHurryText
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.en:
What's wrong? Can't you visit?
I'm sure this will look good on your CLEFAIRY.
Please hurry to {RAM}!
data/phone/text/tiffany_caller.asm::Tiff.et:
Mis lahti? Kas sa ei saa tulla?
Olen kindel, et see sobib su CLEFAIRYLE.
Kiirusta palun {RAM}!

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en:
Hi! You like CLEFAIRY too?
They're so very cute, aren't they?
I think we can be good friends!
I want to know your phone number!
Let's talk about CLEFAIRY!
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et:
Tere! Sulle meeldib ka CLEFAIRY?
Nad on nii nunnud, kas pole?
Arvan, et meist saavad head sõbrad!
Tahan su telefoninumbrit teada!
Vestleme CLEFAIRYST!

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en:
I want to know your phone number!
Let's talk about CLEFAIRY!
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et:
Tahan su telefoninumbrit teada!
Vestleme CLEFAIRYST!

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en:
Aww… Oh well. Look for me if you
want to talk about CLEFAIRY.
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et:
Ohh… No hea küll. Otsi mind, kui
tahad CLEFAIRYST rääkida.

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en: Oh? Your phone registry is full.

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyRematchText
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en:
There you are!
CLEFAIRY, I want you to try hard!
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et:
Seal sa oledki!
CLEFAIRY, tahan, et pingutaksid!

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyGiftText
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en:
You took a long time. See this?
Isn't it cute? It's a PINK BOW.
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et:
Sul kulus kaua. Näed seda?
Kas pole nunnu? See on PINK BOW.

data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.label: TiffanyPackFullText
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.en: Uh-oh. Your PACK is crammed full.
data/phone/text/tiffany_overworld.asm::T.et: Oih. Su PACK on pilgeni täis.

data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddAns.label: ToddAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddAns.en:
Yes? This is {RAM} speaking.
This must be <PLAY_G>.

data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGre.label: ToddGreetDayText
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGre.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
<PLAY_G>, what are you doing?

data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGre.label: ToddGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGre.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}.
<PLAY_G>, sorry to call you so late.
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGre.et:
Tere, siin {RAM}.
<PLAY_G>, vabandust nii hilja helistamise eest.

data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGen.label: ToddGenericText
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGen.en:
How do you raise your #MON?
I do all sorts of things, like
leaving them in DAY-CARE and
toughening them up with items.
data/phone/text/todd_callee.asm::ToddGen.et:
Kuidas sa oma #MONe kasvatad?
Mina teen igasugu asju, näiteks
jätan neid PÄEVAHOIDU ja
kõvendan esemetega.

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.label: ToddLooksCuteLikeMeText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.en:
My {RAM} is looking more and
more like me. It's getting cuter!
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.et:
Mu {RAM} näeb aina rohkem
minu moodi välja. See läheb nunnumaks!

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDef.label: ToddDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDef.en:
And, you know?
Now we can KO {RAM} easily.
I should challenge the GOLDENROD GYM.
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDef.et:
Ja tead?
Nüüd suudame {RAM} kergesti alistada.
Peaksin GOLDENRODI SAALILE väljakutse esitama.

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLos.label: ToddLostAMonText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLos.en:
And, you know? We just failed to
beat {RAM} by a tiny margin.
I'm guessing my #MON's levels
aren't high enough yet…
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLos.et:
Ja tead? Jäime {RAM}
alistamisest napilt ilma.
Oletan, et mu #MONide tasemed
pole veel piisavalt kõrged…

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddBat.label: ToddBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddBat.en:
You must be a lot better now, huh?
How about showing me your technique
in a real battle with me?
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddBat.et:
Oled nüüd kindlasti palju parem, mis?
Kuidas oleks, kui näitaksid mulle oma
tehnikat päris lahingus minuga?
Ootan {RAM}.

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDep.label: ToddDepartmentStoreBargainSaleText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDep.en:
This is it--the one we've all been waiting for!
GOLDENROD DEPT. STORE's bargain sale is on now!
Want it cheap? Want it lots?
Don't miss this GOLDENROD chance!
Huh? I sound like a huckster?
Well, yeah. I was mimicking them…
Anyway, you've got to get there as soon as you can!
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddDep.et:
See ongi - see, mida kõik on oodanud!
GOLDENRODI KAUBAMAJA soodusmüük on nüüd!
Tahad odavalt? Tahad palju?
Ära jäta seda GOLDENRODI võimalust vahele!
Häh? Kõlan nagu kaupleja?
Noh, jah. Matkisin neid…
Igatahes, pead sinna jõudma nii ruttu kui saad!

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddSav.label: ToddSavingUpForBargainSaleText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddSav.en:
I'm saving up for the next bargain
sale. When's the next one?
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddSav.et:
Kogun raha järgmiseks soodusmüügiks.
Millal on järgmine?

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.label: ToddLookingForwardToBattleText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.en:
Where are you?
Let's have our battle soon!
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddLoo.et:
Kus sa oled?
Peame varsti oma lahingu pidama!
Ootan {RAM}.

data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddHav.label: ToddHaveYouGoneToDepartmentStoreText
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddHav.en:
Haven't you gone to GOLDENROD DEPT.
STORE? I've scoped it out already!
They had some real bargains.
You should get there quickly.
data/phone/text/todd_caller.asm::ToddHav.et:
Kas sa pole GOLDENRODI KAUBAMAJJA
läinud? Mina uurisin selle juba läbi!
Seal olid päris soodushinnad.
Peaksid sinna kiiresti minema.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en:
From here, I can see GOLDENROD's
DEPT.STORE. They have bargain sales
up on the rooftop every so often.
Could I get your phone number?
I'll call you when they have a sale.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et:
Siit näen GOLDENRODI KAUBAMAJA.
Neil on katusel aeg-ajalt
soodusmüügid.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?
Helistan, kui neil on müük.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en:
If you give me your number, I'll
call you when they have a sale.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et:
Kui annad mulle oma numbri, helistan,
kui neil on müük.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en:
I check GOLDENROD DEPT.STORE every
day, so I know when there's a sale.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et:
Kontrollin GOLDENRODI KAUBAMAJA iga
päev, seega tean, kui on müük.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en:
Anyway…
If you're short on money, take down my number.
I'll call you when there's a sale.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et:
Igatahes…
Kui sul on rahast kitsas, kirjuta mu number üles.
Helistan, kui on müük.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en: Your phone doesn't have enough memory for more numbers.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et: Su telefonil pole rohkematele numbritele piisavalt mälu.

data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.label: ToddRematchText
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.en:
I waited for you! I even cut back my
shopping to raise my #MON better!
Shopping under the sky!
It feels so nice up on a rooftop.
data/phone/text/todd_overworld.asm::Todd.et:
Ootasin sind! Vähendasin isegi oma
ostlemist, et #MONe paremini kasvatada!
Ostlemine lageda taeva all!
See on katusel nii mõnus.

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.label: TullyAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
Oh, Good morning, <PLAY_G>.

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.label: TullyAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
That voice… <PLAY_G>, right?

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.label: TullyAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyA.en:
Hello, this is {RAM}…
This must be <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.label: TullyGreetText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.en:
Hello! {RAM} here…
Good morning! The weather's great!
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.et:
Tere! Siin {RAM}…
Tere hommikust! Ilm on suurepärane!

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.label: TullyGreetDayText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.en:
Hello! {RAM} here…
What a perfect day for fishing!

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.label: TullyGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.en:
Hello! {RAM} here…
It's a great night for fishing!

data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.label: TullyGenericText
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.en:
How's your trip coming along?
I can't complain about my fishing!
data/phone/text/tully_callee.asm::TullyG.et:
Kuidas su reis edeneb?
Mina ei saa oma kalapüügi üle nuriseda!

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyM.label: TullyMonHasGrownText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyM.en:
My {RAM} has grown again.
It was only about so big when I
caught it, but now it's way bigger.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyM.et:
Mu {RAM} on jälle kasvanud.
See oli vaid umbes nii suur, kui selle
püüdsin, aga nüüd on palju suurem.

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyD.label: TullyDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyD.en:
Oh yeah, I KO'd a wild {RAM}.
It was huge, like this big even.
Heh, I guess you can't tell over the phone…
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyD.et:
Ah jaa, alistasin metsiku {RAM}.
See oli hiiglaslik, isegi nii suur.
Heh, vist ei näe seda telefonis…

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyL.label: TullyLostAMonText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyL.en:
Oh yeah, I lost a wild {RAM}.
It was huge, like this big even.
Heh, I guess you can't tell over the phone…
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyL.et:
Ah jaa, kaotasin metsiku {RAM}.
See oli hiiglaslik, isegi nii suur.
Heh, vist ei näe seda telefonis…

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyB.label: TullyBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyB.en:
We should get a battle going!
I'll be fishing on {RAM}.
Swing by if you have the time.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyB.et:
Peaksime lahingu maha pidama!
Kalastan {RAM}.
Astu läbi, kui sul on aega.

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.label: TullyFoundItemText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.en:
I picked up a good little thing at the water's edge.
Like I promised, it's yours.
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.et:
Korjasin vee ääres hea väikese asja.
Nagu lubasin, on see sinu.
Ootan {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyN.label: TullyNoItemText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyN.en:
Have I found anything good?
Nope, not yet.
It's like fishing, you need patience.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyN.et:
Kas olen midagi head leidnud?
Ei, veel mitte.
See on nagu kalapüük, vajab kannatlikkust.

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.label: TullyForwardText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.en:
Yup, TULLY here…
<PLAY_G>? What? You're lost?
Our battle will be on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyF.et:
Jah, siin TULLY…
<PLAY_G>? Mida? Oled eksinud?
Meie lahing tuleb {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyH.label: TullyHurryText
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyH.en:
I've got something good for you.
Hustle over to {RAM}.
data/phone/text/tully_caller.asm::TullyH.et:
Mul on sulle midagi head.
Vurista {RAM}.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
Hey, you're trying to be the ultimate
trainer too? Then we're comrades!
If I find any more items by the
water, I'll give you some.
Just give me your phone number.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Hei, üritad ka olla ülim treener?
Siis oleme kaaslased!
Kui leian vee ääres veel esemeid,
annan sulle mõned.
Anna lihtsalt oma telefoninumber.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
If I find any more items by the
water, I'll give you some.
Just give me your phone number.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Kui leian vee ääres veel esemeid,
annan sulle mõned.
Anna lihtsalt oma telefoninumber.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en: You'll be hearing from me if I find something good.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et: Kuuled minust, kui leian midagi head.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en: Is that so? Then I'll just have to use them myself.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et: Ah nii? Siis pean need ise ära kasutama.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
Your phone list is all filled up.
Come back if you make room for me.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Su telefoninimekiri on täis.
Tule tagasi, kui teed mulle ruumi.

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyRematchText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
I've been doing more than just
fishing since we last met.
You're in for a big surprise!
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Olen viimasest kohtumisest saati
rohkem kui lihtsalt kalastanud.
Sind ootab suur üllatus!

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyGiftText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
Hey, there you are!
Here's a gift, as promised!
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Hei, seal sa oledki!
Siin on kingitus, nagu lubatud!

data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.label: TullyPackFullText
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.en:
Your PACK's full?
Come back later-that'll do it.
data/phone/text/tully_overworld.asm::Tul.et:
Su PACK on täis?
Tule hiljem tagasi - siis sobib.

data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.label: UnknownGenericText
data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.en:
How are your #MON doing?
My #MON are a bit too energetic.
{RAM}, especially.
Every time it spots a trainer, it has to battle.
It gets to be a bit much for me!
data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mu #MONid on pisut liiga energilised.
{RAM}, eriti.
Iga kord, kui see treenerit märkab, peab võitlema.
See muutub mulle pisut liigaks!

data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.label: UnknownTougherThanEverText
data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.en:
My {RAM}'s looking tougher than ever.
It looks even tougher than me!
data/phone/text/unknown_callee.asm::Unkn.et:
Mu {RAM} näeb kõvem kui iial.
See näeb isegi kõvem kui mina!

data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.label: VanceAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.en:
Yes, hello? {RAM} here!
Morning, <PLAY_G>!
Are you using bird #MON?
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.et:
Jah, halloo? Siin {RAM}!
Tere hommikust, <PLAY_G>!
Kas kasutad linnu-#MONe?

data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.label: VanceAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.en:
Yes, hello? {RAM} here!
Hi, <PLAY_G>!
Are your bird #MON flying?
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.et:
Jah, halloo? Siin {RAM}!
Tere, <PLAY_G>!
Kas su linnu-#MONid lendavad?

data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.label: VanceAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.en:
Yes, hello? {RAM} here!
Evening, <PLAY_G>! Are you letting
your bird #MON see some action?
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceA.et:
Jah, halloo? Siin {RAM}!
Tere õhtust, <PLAY_G>! Kas lased oma
linnu-#MONidel tegevust näha?

data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.label: VanceGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.en:
Good evening, <PLAY_G>!
It's {RAM}! Are you free now?
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.et:
Tere õhtust, <PLAY_G>!
Siin {RAM}! Oled nüüd vaba?

data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.label: VanceGenericText
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.en:
Are you and your #MON fine?
My {RAM} looks like it will
get tough enough to face and beat
the legendary bird #MON!
data/phone/text/vance_callee.asm::VanceG.et:
Kas sul ja su #MONidel on hästi?
Mu {RAM} näib saavat piisavalt
kõvaks, et vastu astuda ja alistada
legendaarne linnu-#MON!

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceM.label: VanceMonHasBecomeTougherText
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceM.en:
My {RAM}'s become tougher.
We've achieved liftoff!
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceM.et:
Mu {RAM} on kõvemaks saanud.
Oleme õhku tõusnud!

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceD.label: VanceDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceD.en:
We can easily beat {RAM}!
…Huh? You too? Isn't that great?
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceD.et:
Suudame kergesti alistada {RAM}!
…Häh? Sina ka? Kas pole tore?

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceL.label: VanceLostAMonText

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceB.label: VanceBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceB.en:
Right now, I'm on {RAM}.
You know, where I first met you?
Want to battle? I'll wait here.
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceB.et:
Praegu olen {RAM}.
Tead ju, kus sind esimest korda kohtasin?
Tahad võidelda? Ootan siin.

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceL.label: VanceLookingForwardText
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceL.en: I'll be looking forward to our next battle!

data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceH.label: VanceHurryHurryText
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceH.en:
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Hurry, hurry!
{RAM}! FLY over now!
data/phone/text/vance_caller.asm::VanceH.et:
Oh, <PLAY_G>! Kiirusta, kiirusta!
{RAM}! Lenda kohe siia!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en:
You know, you are really strong.
But I don't want to just slink off…
I know! Could I get your number?
Let's meet up for more battles!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et:
Tead, sa oled tõesti tugev.
Aga ma ei taha lihtsalt minema hiilida…
Tean! Kas saaksin su numbri?
Saame kokku rohkemateks lahinguteks!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en:
I want to battle tough trainers as often as I can!
Could I get your number?
Let's meet up for more battles!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et:
Tahan võidelda kõvade treeneritega nii tihti kui saan!
Kas saaksin su numbri?
Saame kokku rohkemateks lahinguteks!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en: Don't forget to come see me when I challenge you!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et: Ära unusta tulla mind vaatama, kui sulle väljakutse esitan!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en:
A bird-user friend isn't a bad thing to have, I think…
Won't you reconsider?
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et:
Linnu-kasutajast sõber pole halb asi, arvan…
Kas mõtled ümber?

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VancePhoneFullText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en: Your phone's out of memory. Delete a number for me!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et: Su telefoni mälu on otsas. Kustuta mulle üks number!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceRematchText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en: Am I happy to see you! I won't lose!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et: Küll on hea sind näha! Ma ei kaota!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VancePackFullText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en:
Oh, too bad. You don't have room.
I'll give it to you next time!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et:
Oh, kahju. Sul pole ruumi.
Annan selle sulle järgmine kord!

data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.label: VanceRematchGiftText
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.en:
You are really, really strong!
Thanks for taking me on so often--I
learned a whole lot from you.
I know! This will do as my thanks!
data/phone/text/vance_overworld.asm::Van.et:
Oled tõesti, tõesti tugev!
Aitäh, et minuga nii tihti võitlesid -
õppisin sinult tohutult palju.
Tean! See sobib mu tänuks!

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.label: WadeAnswerPhoneText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM} speaking.
Oh. Hi, <PLAY_G>! Good morning!
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.et:
Halloo? Siin {RAM}.
Oh. Tere, <PLAY_G>! Tere hommikust!

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.label: WadeAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM} speaking.
Oh, hi, <PLAY_G>!

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.label: WadeAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.en:
Hello? This is {RAM} speaking.
Oh, hi, <PLAY_G>! Good evening!
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeAns.et:
Halloo? Siin {RAM}.
Oh, tere, <PLAY_G>! Tere õhtust!

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.label: WadeGreetText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, good morning!
It's me, {RAM}. Isn't it nice out?
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tere hommikust!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kas pole väljas kena?

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.label: WadeGreetDayText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.en:
<PLAY_G>, howdy!
It's me, {RAM}. Isn't it nice out?
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.et:
<PLAY_G>, tervist!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kas pole väljas kena?

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.label: WadeGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.en:
Good evening, <PLAY_G>!
It's me, {RAM}. Were you awake?
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGre.et:
Tere õhtust, <PLAY_G>!
See olen mina, {RAM}. Kas olid ärkvel?

data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGen.label: WadeGenericText
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGen.en:
How are your #MON doing?
My #MON have too much energy to
burn. It gets to be a problem.
Of all my #MON, {RAM} is the hardest to handle.
Working with it is exhausting.
data/phone/text/wade_callee.asm::WadeGen.et:
Kuidas su #MONidel läheb?
Mu #MONidel on liiga palju energiat
põletada. See muutub probleemiks.
Kõigist mu #MONidest on {RAM} kõige raskem käsitseda.
Sellega töötamine on kurnav.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeAre.label: WadeAreYourMonGrowingText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeAre.en:
Are your #MON growing?
My #MON are growing a bit too
quickly for me. It's overwhelming!
{RAM}'s growing especially
quickly. I think it'll get tough.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeAre.et:
Kas su #MONid kasvavad?
Mu #MONid kasvavad minu jaoks pisut liiga
kiiresti. See on ülekaalukas!
{RAM} kasvab eriti
kiiresti. Arvan, et sellest saab kõva.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeDef.label: WadeDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeDef.en:
Oh yeah, we KO'd a wild {RAM}
with one hit a while back.
It went down so easily, I felt a
little sorry for the poor thing.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeDef.et:
Oh jaa, alistasime mõni aeg tagasi
metsiku {RAM} ühe löögiga.
See läks nii kergesti maha, et mul oli
vaesekesest pisut kahju.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeLos.label: WadeLostAMonText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeLos.en:
Oh yeah, a wild {RAM} got
away from me at the last second.
I know it's a common #MON…
But it does annoy me that it got
away when I almost had it.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeLos.et:
Oh jaa, metsik {RAM} pages
mul viimasel hetkel käest.
Tean, et see on tavaline #MON…
Aga see häirib mind, et see pages,
kui olin selle peaaegu kätte saanud.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBat.label: WadeBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBat.en:
Do you feel like a #MON battle?
It won't be like last time!
{RAM}'s where I'll be.
Let me know when you get there.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBat.et:
Kas sul on #MON-lahingu tuju?
See ei tule nagu eelmine kord!
{RAM} on koht, kus olen.
Anna teada, kui kohale jõuad.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBug.label: WadeBugCatchingContestText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBug.en:
The Bug-Catching Contest is at the
NATIONAL PARK today.
Are you going, <PLAY_G>?
I'm trying to make up my mind.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeBug.et:
Putukapüügivõistlus on täna
NATIONAL PARGIS.
Kas lähed, <PLAY_G>?
Üritan otsust langetada.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeFou.label: WadeFoundItemText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeFou.en:
I found all kinds of BERRIES. If you
want, I'll share some with you.
I'll be waiting on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeFou.et:
Leidsin igasugu BERRYsid. Kui
tahad, jagan sinuga.
Ootan {RAM}.

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeNoB.label: WadeNoBerriesText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeNoB.en:
Huh? BERRIES?
Sorry, I haven't found any yet.
I'll call you if I find any. Will you please wait?
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeNoB.et:
Häh? BERRYsid?
Vabandust, pole veel ühtki leidnud.
Helistan, kui leian. Kas ootad palun?

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeQui.label: WadeQuickBattleText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeQui.en:
Let's battle already!
{RAM} is where I am.
Please get here as soon as you can!
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeQui.et:
Võitleme juba!
{RAM} on koht, kus olen.
Tule palun nii ruttu kui saad!

data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeCom.label: WadeComeQuickText
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeCom.en:
How come you're not here yet?
{RAM} is where I am.
Please get here as soon as you can!
data/phone/text/wade_caller.asm::WadeCom.et:
Miks sa veel siin pole?
{RAM} on koht, kus olen.
Tule palun nii ruttu kui saad!

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en:
You're awesome! I like you!
I look for #MON here every day.
When I'm in the grass, I find all kinds of BERRIES.
If you'd like, I'll share some.
Could I get your phone number?
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et:
Sa oled vinge! Sa meeldid mulle!
Otsin siin iga päev #MONe.
Kui olen rohus, leian igasugu BERRYsid.
Kui tahad, jagan mõned.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en:
When I'm in the grass, I find all kinds of BERRIES.
If you'd like, I'll share some.
Could I get your phone number?
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et:
Kui olen rohus, leian igasugu BERRYsid.
Kui tahad, jagan mõned.
Kas saaksin su telefoninumbri?

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en:
You'll hear from me as soon as I
find anything that you might like.
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et:
Kuuled minust kohe, kui leian
midagi, mis sulle meeldida võiks.

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en: Oh well. Don't be shy if you want to get my number.
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et: Oh, hea küll. Ära ole häbelik, kui tahad mu numbrit.

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadePhoneFullText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en: Your phone list has no room for my number.
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et: Su telefoninimekirjas pole mu numbrile ruumi.

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeRematchText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en: I was waiting for you. Let's battle!

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadeGiftText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en:
Good to see you! See? This is what
I found. It's for you!
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et:
Tore sind näha! Näed? See on see,
mida leidsin. See on sulle!

data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.label: WadePackFullText
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.en:
Oops, your PACK's full. Too bad.
You should come back for it later.
data/phone/text/wade_overworld.asm::Wade.et:
Oih, su PACK on täis. Kahju.
Peaksid selle järele hiljem tulema.

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonAnswerPhoneDayText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Hello, you have reached {RAM}…
Ah, <PLAY_G>, is it?

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonAnswerPhoneNiteText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Hello, you have reached {RAM}…
Ah, if it isn't <PLAY_G>.
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.et:
Tere, sa jõudsid {RAM}…
Ah, kui see pole mitte <PLAY_G>.

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonGreetText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Ah, it's {RAM}…
Have you got a moment?

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonGreetDayText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Ah, it's {RAM}…
Can you talk now?
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.et:
Ah, siin {RAM}…
Kas saad nüüd rääkida?

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonGreetNiteText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Ah, it's {RAM}…
Sorry for calling so late.
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.et:
Ah, siin {RAM}…
Vabandust nii hilja helistamise eest.

data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonGenericText
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.en:
Have your #MON grown any?
My {RAM} has grown quite a bit.
data/phone/text/wilton_callee.asm::Wilto.et:
Kas su #MONid on kasvanud?
Mu {RAM} on päris palju kasvanud.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonMonHasGrownText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
My {RAM}'s grown impressive!
My fishing skills have improved too!
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Mu {RAM} on muljetavaldavaks kasvanud!
Mu kalapüügioskused on ka paranenud!

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonDefeatedMonText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
We beat a wild {RAM}…
You know, I have more fun fishing
than beating wild #MON.
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Alistasime metsiku {RAM}…
Tead, mul on rohkem lõbu kalapüügist
kui metsikute #MONide alistamisest.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonLostAMonText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
But a while back, we came this close
to landing a wild {RAM}.
I tell you, it was huge. Believe me.
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Aga mõni aeg tagasi olime nii lähedal
metsiku {RAM} kättesaamisele.
Usun sind, see oli hiiglaslik. Usu mind.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonBattleRematchText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
I'm fishing on {RAM},
but nothing's biting today.
Help me while my time away, come over for a battle.
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Kalastan {RAM},
aga täna ei näkka miski.
Aita mu aega veeta, tule võitlema.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonFoundItemText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
I snagged an item while fishing.
Come pick it up on {RAM}.
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Napsasin kalastades eseme.
Tule võta see {RAM}.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonHaventFoundAnythingText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
Nah, I haven't found anything
that's worth your time.
You have to have patience.
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Ei, ma pole leidnud midagi,
mis su aega väärt oleks.
Pead kannatlik olema.

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonNotBitingText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
Sigh… They're not biting
like before on {RAM}…
You have to come for a battle!
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Ohh… Nad ei näkka nagu
varem {RAM}…
Sa pead võitlema tulema!

data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.label: WiltonWantThisText
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.en:
Don't you want this item?
Hah? You don't know where?
{RAM}… Just head from
MAHOGANY toward BLACKTHORN!
data/phone/text/wilton_caller.asm::Wilto.et:
Kas sa ei taha seda eset?
Häh? Sa ei tea, kus?
{RAM}… Suundu lihtsalt
MAHOGANYST BLACKTHORNI poole!

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonAskNumber1Text
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en:
Eh, our battle was fun, I'd say…
When I'm fishing, I sometimes snag
items that people have dropped.
Do you want them? What's the number?
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et:
Eh, meie lahing oli lõbus, ütleksin…
Kui kalastan, napsan vahel esemeid,
mida inimesed on pillanud.
Kas tahad neid? Mis on number?

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonAskNumber2Text
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en:
If I snag an item while I'm fishing,
it's yours. What's your number?
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et:
Kui napsan kalastades eseme,
on see sinu. Mis on su number?

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonNumberAcceptedText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en: If I snag anything good, I'll be sure to let you know.
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et: Kui napsan midagi head, annan sulle kindlasti teada.

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonNumberDeclinedText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en: All right… Come back if you have a change of heart.
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et: Hea küll… Tule tagasi, kui meelt muudad.

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonPhoneFullText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et: Sa ei saa veel üht numbrit salvestada.

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonRematchText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en: Argh! You startled POLIWAG into fleeing again!

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonGiftText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en:
So here you are.
See this? I snagged it just
a little while ago. It's yours.
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et:
Nii et siin sa oledki.
Näed seda? Napsasin selle just
veidi aja eest. See on sinu.

data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.label: WiltonPackFullText
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.en:
Your PACK's full?
I'll give it to you later.
data/phone/text/wilton_overworld.asm::Wi.et:
Su PACK on täis?
Annan selle sulle hiljem.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en:
Hello, glad to meet you!
I do hope we have a good battle.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et:
Tere, meeldiv kohtuda!
Loodan, et meil tuleb hea lahing.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Thank you! A most enjoyable battle!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Thank you. You are formidable.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Work, work, work… I'm always busy!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: But, I work hard in battle too!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I'm too busy to be battling!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Brace yourself for my all-out attack!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: What a cakewalk! You're too easy!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I won't lose next time, all right?
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Järgmine kord ma ei kaota, eks?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Heh, your #MON look pretty cool.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et: Heh, su #MONid näevad üsna lahedad välja.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Hey, hey, no way! You won't win!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Hei, hei, ei iial! Sa ei võida!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: You serious? This is brutal!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: #MON every day! I love battling!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: I'm on top of my game, but not you!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I don't care that I lost, really!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Ma ei hooli, et kaotasin, tõesti!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Hi, there! Let's keep this clean!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Whoops, sorry for that wipeout!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Whoops! Come on, let me win one!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Uups! Ole nüüd, lase mul üks võita!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Do you want to see my battle level?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Hehehe, I know your level now!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Ouch… I'm just too weak…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Hey, let's battle. I'm your opponent.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Wow, you're not serious about it!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Vau, sa ei võta seda tõsiselt!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: …Urgh… Nothing positive here…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en:
I'm your opponent.
Get ready to be hammered.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et:
Olen su vastane.
Valmistu peksa saama.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Hahah! That was a pushover!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: No way! There has to be a mistake!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Ei iial! Siin peab olema viga!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Hah! Let's get rolling!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Wahahaha! Didn't break a sweat!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Tough! I'm no match for you!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Kõva! Ma ei ole sulle vastane!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en:
You want to be a leader?
Let me battle you, then!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et:
Tahad juhiks saada?
Siis lase mul sinuga võidelda!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en:
You need another ten years of
training to get better, I'd say.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et:
Vajad veel kümmet aastat
treeningut, ütleksin.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en:
You're incredibly talented.
No one can touch you now!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et:
Oled uskumatult andekas.
Keegi ei saa sulle vastu!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Today, I'm going to whomp you.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: I knew I'd win. I'm so great!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Teadsin, et võidan. Olen nii tore!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Uh? My plans are out of whack…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I bet you can't beat me!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et: Vean kihla, et sa ei alista mind!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Those #MON aren't enough!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I want your #MON. Please?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM15Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I'll show you a real battle!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM15Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: This battle… I'm bored!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM15Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: …I won't turn tail in battle!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM16Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Let's go! No holds barred!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM16Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Sorry! I wanted the win more!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM16Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Wahah! Congrats! I can't do better!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM17Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: My #MON skills are phenomenal!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM17Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en:
You've got a long way to go.
Well, keep trying! Best of luck!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et:
Sul on veel pikk tee.
Noh, jätka! Palju õnne!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM17Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Aww… Don't lose after beating me.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Ohh… Ära kaota pärast mu alistamist.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM18Text
