data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Who are you? I don't know you…
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et: Kes sa oled? Ma ei tunne sind…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM18Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en:
I must've imagined that.
There seems to be no one here…
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et:
Pidin seda ette kujutama.
Siin ei paista kedagi olevat…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM18Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Who am I? I don't know…
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Kes ma olen? Ma ei tea…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM19Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Um… Are you that… um…person?
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et: Öö… Kas sa oled see… öö…inimene?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM19Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: It doesn't appear to be you…
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Ei tundu, et see oled sina…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM19Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Then you really are the legendary…
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Siis sa tõesti oled see legendaarne…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM20Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I heard that you're hot!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM20Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Not bad. I was just a bit better.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Pole paha. Olin lihtsalt veidi parem.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM20Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Eh, you're not that special.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM21Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en:
I'm scared about what might happen.
My #MON are way too strong.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.et:
Kardan, mis juhtuda võib.
Mu #MONid on liiga tugevad.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM21Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: See? My #MON were too strong.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM21Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Graa! My #MON were total wimps!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM22Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Hey, there! I'll take you on!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM22Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Don't you have a better strategy?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM22Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: You've got decent style!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM23Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I wonder if I can battle properly…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM23Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Um… Sorry… I think I won.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM23Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I guess I'm not good enough yet…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM24Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Wrrooar! I won't lose!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM24Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Wrrooar! I knew I was a genius!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM24Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Arrooh! I hate it when I lose!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingM25Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Sorry, but I'm going to win.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossM25Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Yeah! My #MON rule!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinM25Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh, close! I lost by just a bit!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: OK, I'm not fooling around!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Yay! Too easy! Like, no way!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Jee! Liiga lihtne! Nagu, ei iial!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF1Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: No! Like, no way!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Look! My #MON are really cute!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Aren't they really adorable?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF2Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I'm sorry, it's all my fault!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Vabandust, see on kõik minu süü!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Let's get our battle started!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Was I too strong for you?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF3Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Ooh, you're in a different class.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Are we going to battle? Let's!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Oh, you're too weak. Shame.
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Oh, sa oled liiga nõrk. Kahju.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF4Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Wow! Are you quite satisfied?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Oh, you have some rare #MON.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: May I have one of your #MON?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF5Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: …I want one of your #MON.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Want to hear about my cute #MON?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: What do you think about my cuties?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF6Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh! My! You're a dreadful trainer!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Battle? Sure! Right now!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Oh, I love it! Battling is wild!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Oh, ma armastan seda! Võitlemine on metsik!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF7Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh, how rude! Wait till next time!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Oh, kui ebaviisakas! Oota järgmist korda!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Please let me win! Please?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Wow, thank you! You're so nice!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Vau, aitäh! Sa oled nii kena!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF8Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: You're mean! I hate meanies!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Well, can we begin?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Well, I beg your pardon…

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF9Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Sob… That's not fair!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I'm good! You can't win.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Giving up? You're pretty weak!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF10Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: I won't accept this… No way!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Ma ei lepi sellega… Ei iial!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF11Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Are you treating this seriously?

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF11Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Oh, sorry! Looks like I won!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF11Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh, how nasty! You were serious!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Oh, kui alatu! Sa olid tõsine!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: Ahahah! I'll take it easy on you!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Oops, sorry! But I'm happy too!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.et: Uups, vabandust! Aga olen ka õnnelik!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF12Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh, oh, I lost! Thanks. Bye!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Oh, oh, ma kaotasin! Aitäh. Nägemist!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: BATTLE TOWER is a tough place!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: You might have a hard time.

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF13Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Ooh, you might make a run here!
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.et: Ooh, sa võid siin kaugele jõuda!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.label: _BTGreetingF14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTG.en: I want to see your style in action!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.label: _BTLossF14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTL.en: Every battle is a drama!

data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.label: _BTWinF14Text
data/battle_tower/trainer_text.asm::_BTW.en: Oh… Want to trade something?
